sanskrit: bhāti tasyai tasmai namonamaḥ maheśaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ cārcitā taistu vāmadakṣiṇamārgibhiḥ vidhiharyādyāstvāṃ tvaṃ dhyāyasi kaṃ punaḥ kiṃ dhyeyaṃ tattvaṃ me kṛpayā vada vidhīndrādīnvākyametaduvācaha devayonīnāṃ dinamāyuśca tacchatam sārdhaṃ sampūrṇaṃ dharmaśāstra pramaṇataḥ samayaḥ kāyapūrakaḥ mahāmāyā mayā tacchvāsanirgamaḥ ghaṭikayā varṣamekaṃ vidhessmṛtam satīrupaṃ śuklaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tu pārvatī vai mahākālasya gehinī tiṣṭhet samayā viṣayīkṛtaḥ vilayaṃ kṛtvā bhītā natāḥ punaḥ sarva īśvarā itivādinaḥ na ca tvaṃ maśakāyase kathañjñeyaḥ kathayasva sadāśiva yadi kṛpā devyāṃ viṣṇau sureṣu ca vṛddhintasya māyākṛtañjagat prārthitohaṃ devī samprārthitā mayā bhavati sa sa mārgaḥ prakāśitaḥ anyāndevānvinindanti ṣaṭkarmaniratāssadā niratāstena nirdhanāḥ pretarūpiṇaḥ dharmasāraṃ tantrāṇāṃ hṛdayaṃ param

yātantattantraṃ merusañjñitam nijasandehāndūrīkurvantaśaṅkitāḥ kṣatravāyustaṃ bindurūpaṃ karoti ca sambhinnāste devaḥ koṭiśobhavan tathaivopāsanāmārgaguṇā yānti ca devatām dūratalaḥ syādvai tadvaddevo'pi mohitaḥ nyastaḥ punarvṛṣṭiḥ punarjalam sanmārgāttaṭinīto mahānadīm vāḍavodarasaṃveśāttadvajjīvo'pi devatām samudrādāhṛtaḥ kaṃściddaivāttyaktastu tatra tu brahmajñānādvinirmuktā hitvā copāsanākramam tatra tatra praśaṃstikā ca sarvāśyastūttamottamā samutpannā surā kalaśadhariṇī devī trailokyasyāpi mohinī tāñjagṛhustasyāḥ kalaśācca papuḥ surām bhuktimuktyekabhājanam revā suraiva paramampadam stūyamānāstāśśaktyaste ca dānavāḥ dhandhantarissamāyātassudhākalaśahastavān viṣṇussāntvayaṃśca pratārayan nissārampuruṣāhṛtam śukrācāryo jñātavāṃstatsamagram dhigdhigjñānaṃ surārīṇāmanayā surayā hṛtam ghoraṃ tiṣṭhantviha piśācavat

nirdahantīva lokāṃstrīnprākampanta surāsurāḥ pātitaḥ śukraḥ putro'yantemiyojyatām vimocaya punastadvarṇakāntikā ṣoḍaśārṇastavākhyāto mantritāṣṭottaraṃ śatam dīkṣākramo yeṣāṃ vaṃśe devi samāgataḥ pradhāno'yaṃ sa tu vāmapathaḥ smṛtaḥ kulamārgapraviṣṭena sadā sevyaṃ suharṣiṇā madhyamassyātsiddhāntī yo'varo bhavet pītamamṛtaṃ te te somapā bala darpitāḥ teṣāmupāsanā proktā dakṣamārgeṇa sā dvijaiḥ paurāṇī madhyamā khyātā tāntrikī tvavarā smṛtā yadā dakṣaṃ praviśettatsu rassai tu vāmaṃ praviśet tatsurāstadā tasmātsvakulamārgaṃ tu jñātvā kuryādupāsanām mārgastatkālaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥ cobhayossiddhirdevatānāṃ viḍaṃbanam nāstīha syāccopanayanādiṣu nādhikāro'styataḥ kuryādātmānaṃ mantrasaṃskṛtam iti proktā prāptā cetsugurormukhāt viṃśadviśvopakaguṇairyukto yaḥ sa gururbhavet sarvāṅgamārgatattvajñaḥ sarvamantravidhānavit antarmukho'bahirdṛṣṭissarvajño deśakālavit kāmye rataḥ karmaṇyanindite maraṇāyāsaduḥkhakṛt kṣatraviṭchūdrajātīyaḥ pratilomaṃ na dīkṣayet

gṛhasthasya vāmamārgetivīryavān dvādaśābdaṃ tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vātha dīkṣayet lajjābhimānagarvādivarjitaṃ kulanāyakam japadhyānābhinirataṃ mokṣamārgābhigāminam sadācāraṃ śraddhābhaktisamanvitam anukūlapriyāyuktaṃ dhīraṃ sarvopakārakam dīkṣāṃ tu lobhādyairdevatāśāpamāpnuyāt sāmaye traste vyaṅge dīkṣā tu niṣphalā mantro vedāṅgañcāgamaḥ smṛtaḥ sādhyate sarvaṃ grahayajñādikaṃ kila mantro nāvedo mantra īritaḥ yāvantyarṇāni mantrāṇāṃ śūdrāya pratipādayet rahitaṃ dadyātpaścācca tāntrikam saṃskṛtaistaiśca svāgamoktena vartmanā dīkṣyate bhāryā yato'sau sarvadā guruḥ vaiṣṇavo vāpi strīśūdrāṇāṃ namontakaḥ nāmamantra iti jñātvā cāṇḍālānapi dīkṣayet pañcadhā manavaḥ khyātāḥ pradeyāścānulomataḥ kāmabījaṃ bhavedvaiśyo vāgbhavaṃ śūdra īritaḥ nodadyānmantraṃ tvadhikavarṇakam viprairdeyā vindhyanivāsinī nārasiṃhī kārtavīryasya nānyataḥ varṇatrayepi dātavyaṃ dakṣiṇāmūrtyaghorakam lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ vāsudevatākaṃ varāhakam sarvavarṇeṣu dātavyāḥ kālikā śyāmalā tathā

yakṣapatnīnāṃ traipurā baṭukādayaḥ proktā śreṣṭhā tatra tu sāttvikī dakṣiṇo mārgaḥ pratimāyāṃ ca pūjanam proktaṃ pīṭhādau balidānataḥ samproktā vāmadakṣiṇayoḥ parā gopitā sarvatantreṣu kimanyacchrotumicchatha śivapraṇītavyavasthāprakāśaḥ prathamaṃḥ dṛśyate kvāpi kimparatra bhaviṣyati satyaṃ sādhakā duḥkhitāḥ katham saṃskārāśca kathaṃ kāryāstāntrikāṇāṃ vadasva tat karmatrayaṃ ceti saṃskārāḥ ṣoḍaśa smṛtāḥ śiṣyāṃstataḥ kuryātsiddhe mantre punastrayam mantrasaṃskārāḥ ṣaḍeva parikīrtitāḥ yavanakalpoktāstanmantreṣvapi te trayaḥ surāṃ vāme homādyarthaṃ prakalpayet maithunaṃ brahmacaryaṃ ca mudrāstatkarmikāstathā dakṣiṇānāmatho vāme dvitīyāṅgaṃ samācaret devatāyā mantranyāsaṃ samācaret bhairavo bhūtvā ratikarma samācaret pañcasahasraṃ ca yatheṣṭaṃ labhate sutam tasyāssomastasya sūryo garbhastiṣṭheddharātale kurvīta atha puṃsavanaṃ budhaḥ homasthāne svadevatāḥ puruṣāṇāṃ dvayaṃdvayam sapaśuṃ dadyānniśāyāṃ bhairavaṃ balim

caturthaṣaṣṭhāṣṭameṣu māssu sanmadhyamādhamaḥ devatāmantraṃ sīmante surucā likhet gacchettāṃ bhāryāṃ devatāśāpabhītitaḥ saṃgaḥ sīmantastadadhovahaḥ jātakarmābhidhaṃ vipraḥ svakalpoktena vartmanā kriyāṃ kuryādviṣṇusmaraṇapūrvakam lekhanyā vilikhetkaraṇāgrayā tarpayetpaścādanyatkarma tu dakṣavat sarveṣāmevamuddiṣṭaḥ sūtakānte śubhe dine mātrācakrāṇi ṣoḍaśa nāma tādṛśaśced gurustadā yasmādakṣaguṇaiḥ siddhirviprāṇāṃ samprajāyate iryame ca ī u ū vahnibhe tathā puṣye kakāraḥ sarpabhe khagau ṭaṭhau tvāṣṭre svātyāṃ ḍo dvīśabhe ḍhaṇau pūrvāṣāḍhāyāṃ bakāro bhastu vaiśvabhe pūrvabhādrāyāṃ ṣasahāḥ syurupāntime sādhyanāmādivarṇarkṣatrirāvṛttyā phalāni tu vyādhimāpnoti sādhakaḥ kāryasiddhaye tārācakrasya phalaṃ jñātvācaredidam strīpuṃsorvā vyastayośca gaṇacakraṃ vicārayet haryantyamitrādityenduvāyyijyakaraghoṭakāḥ nṛdevayoḥ phalaṃ śīghraṃ vyastayoḥ kaṣṭataḥ phalam devadānavayoryuddhaṃ vyastayorniṣphalambhavet yugmaṃ yugmaṃ yugmaṃ vadanti ṣaṭ

bhavedyatrādigo varṇaḥ phalaṃ tatra bhavedidam strīsaukhyakṛdvātakārī bhāgyadaḥ kāryasiddhikṛt strīśūdrapratilomānāṃ nāmamantrairupāsanā manurgrāhyo vaidiko'tra viśeṣataḥ vāyvagnibhūjalākāśapañcatattvāni vinyaset kādikāścāpi ṣaḍvargāḥ śaṣasā haśca kṣastathā tasmātpunarmanurlekhyo yugapatsyātsamāpanam kaṣṭaṃ tu śatrau rūpaṃ same dalam pādo mitre tu tadvattu tatkaṣṭaṃ syātkalātmakam bhūtavetālāḥ piśācāścānyathā manum salilānilayostathā siddhādicakraṃ vakṣye'haṃ yajjñātvā nāma kārayet tathā cakre kūṭaṣaṇḍhavivarjitān svanāmākṣaramārabhya jñeyo mantrākṣarāvadhiḥ sidhyati kālena sādhyaḥ siddhyati vā na vā mahāvidyāsādhane siddhimātṛkām kramādeteṣu koṣṭheṣu mātṛkārṇānsuvinyaset pañcāṅgatithiviśve ca koṣṭhāstatra prakīrtitāḥ tattatsthānāptakoṣṭhāttu pūrvāṅgulyā gurūktitaḥ susiddhasamprāptaḥ siddhārirhanti gotrajān susiddho bhajanātsādhyāriḥ svāśrayaṃ haret susiddhaḥ susiddhāriḥ kulāpahaḥ patnīghno'thāryariḥ sādhakāpahaḥ bījātmako mantrastatra ṣaḍdalamātṛkāḥ nyasenmātṛkārṇānkūṭaṣaṇḍhavivarjitān

sampraddāridryadhairyāṇi bandhuvigrahasaṃśayau mantrasya siddhissyādetadarthamahaṃ bruve vakṣye'tra tu yathā lekhyā aṅkā ekādaśa svarāḥ tadadhodvikusaptābdhikhatrisapteṣusāgarāḥ svaravyañjanabhinnānāṃ mantrārṇānāṃ pṛthak pṛthak bhāgaśeṣāvubhau sthāpyau yāvannāmāṅkatā manoḥ tāvatsaṅkhyānsamāyogānasādhyānapi sādhayet punaḥ kuryānmantrasandīptaye punaḥ yāvatsyādadhikastāvatsaṅkhyāṅkāni yadā caret punaḥ kṛtvā tadā syātkāryasādhakaḥ sarvataṃtreṣu gopitam tasyāścakre tu racayedevameva hi saṁllekhyāstadadhaḥ ṣaṇḍhavarjitāḥ kacaṭādyāṁllikhedvarṇān ṅañaṇākṣaravarjitān dvayoryogaḥ kāryaścāṣṭāvaśeṣitaḥ mantraṃ yantraṃ binā kaliḥ ṣaḍvedatrīṣusaptābdhinagadvirasakhaṃdharāḥ hānirādhikye jayo gopyamidaṃ bharāḥ vargāṣṭakāṅkā vahnīṣuṣaḍvedāṅkendu vahnayaḥ vargabalādvargaikyaprāṇavīryataḥ vahnīnduvedayugmenduraṅkāḥ pañca svarāṁllikhet pañcabhakte'dhike śeṣe jayo hīne parājayaḥ bhūṣaṭpañcāgnivedāgnidvibhūkheṣu śarāḥ kṛtāḥ nāmavarṇāṅkānmātrābhedakramoditān kuryātprāṇācca vargataḥ

rasāgnilocanayugā nāgaṣaḍgo'bdhivahnayaḥ ādyāstadaṅkayogotra hīne'ṣṭāṅke'dhike jayaḥ rasāgnivedayugmāṅgaṣaṭkṛtāgnīnduśūnyabhūḥ taṣṭāṣṭabhiścedadhikā gadino jīvitambhavet gurumukhānnāmakarma samācaret svakalpoktavidhānena śūdrādīnāmamantrakaḥ devāśca cakrasya pūjānteṣvavaśeṣitam kṛtavidhānasya kṣudvipattirna jāyate sarveṣāmevamuddiṣṭaṃ bālyapātakanāśanam strīṇāmapi ca kartavyaṃ saubhāgyārogyavṛddhaye kṣiptvā khaned bhūmau viśeṣo vāmināmiti samīpe nayanaṃ taccopanayanaṃ smṛtam pūrvaṃ kartavyaṃ kuladīkṣaṇam laghudaivatyā prākpaścānmahatastathā grāhyā mantradīkṣā puraścaryāṃ samārabhet suputraṃ vā vineṣṭaṃ dāpayenna ca jāyate siddhirguroḥ śāpaḥ prajāyate prasaktā sā svavidyā rājavadbhavet yatpṛṣṭaṃ tasyādhikyaṃ tu varṇitam vaidikaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tataśca smārtamuttamam yāmalāstatsaṃgamācca mantrīśānī ca tāṇḍavam kramādapacitaṃ jñeyaṃ yathāyogyena mukhyatā dadyācca sarvasmai svāṃcārātkarma kurvate mārgeṇa vaidikastāntrikaḥ punaḥ vakratuṇḍādikā dakṣe ucchiṣṭādyāstu vāmake

mārgeṇa tatsthāne tāntrikaḥ punaḥ kālabhairavabhedasya yasya kasyāpi dakṣiṇe sādhakairgrāhyaḥ svarṇākarṣaṇabhairavaḥ kuryādgṛhyoktamārgeṇa tasminsthāne tu tāntrikaḥ pūjādimantrāṃstacchikṣāṃ taddravyaniyamāṃstathā sthāne bhaveddīkṣā sveṣṭamantre tu tāntrike tāntrikaḥ kuryātsarvapāpavimokṣaṇam satyavācā tataḥ samprārthayediti kurve devatāḥ santu sākṣiṇaḥ pāpāni tiṣṭhanti mama devatāḥ ca yathā sandṛśyatāṃ tathā dakṣakukṣisthitaṃ kṛṣṇamaṅguṣṭhaparimāṇakam gurutalpakaṭīyutam duṣṭamadhovaktraṃ sudussaham pāpanaraṃ japānte prekṣayetpunaḥ nirgataṃ pāpaṃ puraścaraṇayogyatā puraścaryā kartavyā tāntrikairjanaiḥ japaṃ kuryāccakrapūjāṃ tathā niśi siddhimavāpnoti nānyathā japakoṭibhiḥ vidhavāyā vivāhantu pippalenaiva kārayet cetkuryādanyamekaṃ tathā patim vaidikastāntrikastatra devasthāne svadevatām yajamānasya mārgasthastadabhāvataḥ dvijāḥ kaulamārgāścakrārcane matāḥ kaulikavastūnāṃ piṇḍāśca rudhirokṣitāḥ

jīvanmuktastadā jñeyaḥ sāmarthye devatāsamaḥ śāpairmantrā vimucyante yānkṛtvā devanirmitaiḥ prakartavyā śiṣyasya siddhihetave svāpakāla iḍāyāmagnirūpiṇaḥ sañjapto jāgṛto jāyate manuḥ savisargāṃstāṃstrikālaṃ kevalaṃ japet śābaramantrāṇāṃ jāgṛtiṃ śṛṇu pārvati prajapedravirātrau tu yāmeyāme śatāṣṭakam mantra tvaṃ bhāṣayātha turīyake cānyadeveṣu sphoṭayennārikelakam bhagavānprovāca madhusūdanaḥ unmattāstu tadā devāḥ śreṣṭhohamiti cābruvan vākyaṃ śāpe cānugrahe kṣamam vaco viṣṇoḥ śepuścaiva parasparam śāpamokṣeṇa kaḥ siddhiṃ prāpnuyājjanaḥ niśśāpatvaṃ kathaṃ teṣu siddhiḥ syāditi me vada caturādyaścaikabījo nidhāyaikatra saṅgamaḥ śāpāttu cchidyante'sya manorathāḥ dvidhā vajrī tridhā madhyaṃ dvidhā vāmadakṣamārgayorapi viśrutau huṅkāro vā sa mantrastu śaktihīnaḥ kṛtaḥ suraiḥ śaktihīnasya vāmasya maraṇannātra saṃśayaḥ parāṅmukho mantro jātaḥ sūryasya śāpataḥ daivātkāryepi saṃsiddhirlokaḥ syācca parāṅmukhaḥ kṛtā mantrā devācāryeṇa śāpitāḥ

nūnaṃ mahākālena bhāṣitam repho'gnibījamuddiṣṭa me-e-nnettratrayaṃ mama śāpānnetrahīno duḥkhaśokāmayapradaḥ śrūṃ vāthavā hrūṃ vā namo vā hrīṃ manuḥ sa tu latrayaṃ vā na cetsaṃstambhito manuḥ duḥkhaṃ ca prāyaśo bahulaṃ bhavet yakāreṇa saṁyyuktāni manussa tu tasmātsaṃskārayeddevi siddhaye sādhakottamaḥ yadakṣarairantaritaḥ phaṭkāraḥ sa nigadyate sādhako naiva siddhaḥ sandṛśyate kvacit brahmaśāpāddhīnasiddhirbhavedatyantakaṣṭadaḥ māyāśāpānmālinyakārakaḥ rudraśāpātsādhyaṃ kuryāttiraskṛtam kuryādbālāśāpena bheditaḥ siṃhaśāpena proktobhīṣṭa phalāpahaḥ cāmuṇḍāśāpato jāto madonmatto na śobhanaḥ mūrcchitaṃ kuryādvāminaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ hatavīryastu śāpena kṛtaḥ kṣīṇatvakārakaḥ aṣṭādaśākṣaro hīno hānirbhairavaśāpataḥ kāmaśāpena dhvaṃsayetkāmakāraṇāt ṣoḍaśārṇastu taruṇaḥ prauḍho vyomābdhivarṇakaḥ ete kālena śaptā duḥkhāni kurvate saṃśapto nityaṃ nairāśyakārakaḥ namo vā svāhā vā nāsti vā yasya madhyamaḥ sevāṃ kurvallaṁbheddeśanāśaṃ varṣatrayāditaḥ

śāpena siddhihīno na siddhikṛt mūrkhatvaṃ kuryājjanmanijanmani hānirmātaṃgyāḥ śāpataḥ smṛtā nāśayetsādhakabalaṃ rājñaḥ senāṃ vināśayet mantraṃ cakṣuṣā naiva paśyati tajjapādvaṃśavṛddhirna cānyathā strīsukhaṃ nahi vyākulaṃ cittaṃ jāyate sādhakasya tu āliṅgitenāyaṃ japātsatvarato mṛtiḥ sādhakaṃ kuryātpānādivyasanākulam rājamātaṅgyāḥ śāpāddāridryakārakaḥ tenaiva mandatā jāyate nṛṇām śāpādaṃgahīnaḥ kāmanāpūrako nahi sādhyanāśaṃ kṛtvā naśyecca sādhakaḥ atikruddhastajjapena svakṛte svasya saṃkṣayaḥ savrīḍāmātṛkāśāpātsavrīḍāstasya sādhakāḥ yatra varṇāḥ śāpitāśchinnamastayā niṣkāmairyā jibhirjaptā saṃsārasnehanāśanāḥ yajñaśāpātpauṣṭikādiṣu varjitāḥ daṇḍakākhyāḥ pīḍitāśca tajjapātkaṣṭamāpnuyāt khaṇḍīkṛtāssaptadhā te siddhikhaṇḍakarāḥ smṛtāḥ jātā tu tadā dattaḥ śāpaḥ sudāruṇaḥ kuryāttasmāttanmantraśodhanam gudameḍhrāntaraṃ dṛḍham dakṣiṇaṃ gulphagranthyoranyonyamardanam viniṣpīḍya sthirakāya upāviśet

prāṇānvāyuṃ samyaṅnirodhayan citsvarūpe kuṇḍalyāṃ paramātmani mantrasyākṣarāṇi kramādekaikaśastataḥ tataścakre maṇipūre tvanāhate brahmarandhraṃ somasya maṇḍalāmṛtāt tatastanmantramṛṣyādinyāsapūrvaṃ japettataḥ uktaśāpādvinirmuktaṃ paścādupadiśecca tam tu śāpānāṃ nāśādyarthamathocyate kastūrīkuṃkumādyaiśca vilikhetpāñcabhautikam yathoktavidhinā pūjāṃ kṛtvā cāṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ svaravyañjanabindūṃśca sargayogyākṣarāṇi ca janayenmantraṃ proktaṃ sañjananaṃ tvidam aṣṭottaraśataṃ mantravarṇānetattu jīvanam śatāvṛtyā tāḍayeccandanāmbhasā mantrāstāḍitāḥ siddhikārakāḥ karavīrasya puṣpāṇyatha samuccaret uccaranvahnibījaṃ ca bodhanaṃ tvetaducyate tatkarṇikāyāṃ mālatyā likhetkalikayaikayā bodhidrupallavāṃścaiva gṛhītvā mantramuccaret nānāsugandhinopetapallavairyāvadakṣaram mantraśuddhiṃ kuryānnṝṇāṃ yathā jalam manostasya dāgdhyamevaṃ vibhāvayet māyikaḥ proktastanmantre tu malatrayam jātaḥ svamantra iti cintayet mataḥ || vimalīkaraṇaṃ tvetatprayogaṃ cāpi kārayet

tāmrādipātre karpūravāsitena jalena ca jalaṃ tena mantreṇa kuśabindubhiḥ puraścaryākleśitānāṃ samāvartanavattvidam pātrāntare ca karpūraguṭikāvāsitaṃ jalam japedetaddīpanaṃ syātsarvamantreṣvapīṣyate samproktāḥ sarvatantreṣu gopitāḥ vakṣyamāṇā japo homaśca tarpaṇam saṃskārāḥ kimanyacchrotumicchasi saṃskāraprakāśo dvitīyaḥ tatrāvaśyakaṃ karma ceti me nirṇayaṃ vada pañcavidhaṃ tadrājñāmuttamottamam brāhmaṇānāmalpamuktaṃ yatīnāmapi cālpakam cottamādibhedānāṃ viṣayo bhavet sthalādarkāṅgulocchrāyaṃ maṇḍapasthalamīritam asthikīṭatuṣāṅgāramalahīnaṃ śubhāvaham grāmādbahiḥsthayā tatra viprādyaiśca svavarṇayā surekhyā tatpūrayitvā pracālayet yatronaṃ nimnayettatsthalaṃ budhaḥ sūtrakarkaṭakīlāni gṛhītvā vai niśāntare tanmadhye kendrādvattaṃ samālikhet dhanuṣkuryāttataścāpaṃ dhanuṣkuryāttataḥ punaḥ trayaṃ kṛtvā dalānāṃ madhyadeśataḥ yāmyapaścimayossaumyapūrvayoruparisthayoḥ anyayoścāpayorevamāgneyī vāyavī bhavet bahirānīya nikhanettatra kīlakān

samakarṇaṃ digantaṃ tacchuddhaṃ syāccaturasrakam pañcaninādaiśca maṇḍapaṃ racayecchubham madyamāṃsapurandhrīṇāṃ samāveśo yathā bhavet kuṇḍānāmadhikepi sapañcake sāmagryāmalpāyāṃ vedahastakaḥ daśahastaḥ syānnavahastaḥ sadā viśān mānaṃ maṇḍapānāṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitam kāle ca samutpannā yathā yavāḥ śūdrāṇāṃ saṅkarādau tathā rasaiḥ svayaṃ tatra mānametadatonyathā parvaṇorantarandīrghamātrāṅgulamudāhṛtam vedikāpīṭhaśibikārathādyetatpramāṇataḥ vibhajedeko bhāgo muṣṭyaṅgulaṃ tu tat yajñopavītamuñjādi kuryānmuṣṭyaṅgulena tu dvādaśabhāgantu kṛtvā teṣvekamaṅgulam ebhiścaturviṃśatibhirhastaḥ syādaṅgulaiḥ punaḥ nārīṇāṃ kuryādgopyaṃ prakāśitam lakṣahomeṣu dikkaram vedikākoṇe maṇḍapārdhocchitā vahiḥ kalaśākāraṃ taddaśāṃśena kārayet tṛtīyāṃśadīrghānstambhānsuvinyaset madhyastambhasthitaṃ kūṭaṃ mṛdaṅgābhaṃ prakalpayet dakṣadīkṣāvidhau padmanibhaṃ kūṭaṃ tu kārayet catursrā catuṣkoṇā vedī sarvaphalapradā syātsarvatobhadrā caturbhadrābhiṣecane

dīkṣāyāṃ guptā tryasrā tu vedikā patrāṇi baddhā stambhagale nyaset jhañjhāmārutavṛṣṭyādibhayaṃ na syādyathā tathā kapāṭaśākhe kuryāddehalikāṃ ramyāṃ sāṣṭāṅgulakaradvayām madhyame maṇḍape kuryātsārddhāṅgulakaradvayam pūrvadvārādbahirhastamātraṃ tyaktvā tu veśmataḥ phalakaṃ kuryādvistṛtaṃ tadguṇāṅgulam connataśikhaṃ dvārasyobhayapārśvayoḥ maṇḍape tau dīrghatāyāṃ kramātsārddhakaradvayam nikhanedagnimīḍeti gāyatryā pārśvayordvayoḥ viṣamaṃ dvayorupari kīlayet dakṣiṇe dvāre taddvāraṃ plakṣakāṣṭhajam kuryātpaścimadvāratastvidam prakurvīta vaṭavṛkṣamayaṃ tathā tiryaksthakāṣṭhānāṃ madhyato bilam śreṣṭhamadhyajaghanyeṣu śaivayāge triśūlakam vaiṣṇave dvādaśāṃśena śaṅkhacakragadāmbujam śṛṅgaṃ kiñcidvakrantu pārśvayoḥ maṇḍapasyāgre bhūmyūrddhadaśahastakaḥ vistṛtaścaikahastena dīrghaḥ pañcakarairdhvajaḥ ghaṇṭācāmarasaṃyuktaṃ devatāvarṇavarṇakam patākāśca dhvajasyārdhapramāṇataḥ trātāramiṃdramiti ca pītavarṇāṃ harerdiśi panthāmanunā kṛṣṇavarṇā yame smṛtā

brahmaṇetivāruṇyāṃ sitavarṇikā saumyāyāṃ candravarṇikā īśānapūrvayormadhye śeṣaṃ raktapatākinam vedamantro vajrapātasamassmṛtaḥ nāmamantrānpraṇavādyānhṛdantakān maṇḍapopari badhnīyādatiśvetaṃ vitānakam āmrāśvatthadalotpannayuktayā dīrghamālayā iṣṭikābhirapakvābhirhastavistṛtapiṇḍikām samunnatāṃ vāpi tāratamyaṃ vilokya ca ayutāhutihomastu vidheyaḥ sthaṇḍilopari daśakenaikaṃ hastaṃhastaṃ vivarddhayet kuṇḍa eva vidhīyate mānaṃ bhavati śate'ratnisamaṃ bhavet lakṣe ṣaṭkaraṃ daśalakṣake ekakuṇḍavidhāne tu caturasraṃ vidhīyate navakuṇḍavidhāne tu vahnibhāge bhagākṛti ardhacandranibhaṃ yāmye vaiśyānāṃ sarvakarmaṇi trikoṇakuṇḍaṃ nair-ṛtye ripughātakaraṃ smṛtam kṣattriyāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ śāktakarmaṇi ṣaṭkoṇamuccāyyati tacchedeṣu ca viśiṣyate pauṣṭike kuṇḍaṃ vṛttidaṃ tuṣṭidaṃ tathā muktikaramaiśānyāṃ tadvidhīyate aṣṭakuṇḍīvidhāne tu kramo'yaṃ navakuṇḍake pañcakuṇḍīnāmīśāne pañcamaṃ bhavet pañcakoṇamabhicāravināśanam

caturasrasya kuṇḍasya vidhirucyate dvimekhalaṃ tu śūdrāṇāṃ saṃkarāṇāṃ kumekhalam yāvatkuṇḍamiheṣṭaṃ syāttāvaddiksadhane kṛte yatkarṇo bhujā tasya karadvayī caturhastādikepyevaṃ kuṇḍaḥ sarvatra bhūsamaḥ dvādaśāṅgulavistārā cotsedhā caturaṅgulā caturbhiraṅgulairdīrghā tāvaduccā tadardhataḥ ekāṅgulocchritā sā tu praviṣṭābhyantare tathā aṅguṣṭhamekhalāyuktā madhye bāhye dhṛtiḥ kṣamā bhavetpīṭhaṃ kuṇḍamaṣṭāṃśavistṛtam tu tadvṛttaṃ kuṇḍaṣaṣṭhaṃśamānataḥ pūrvamukhā yoniḥ kuṇḍayoniñca varjayet vyāsārkabhāgatulyena tatparam karṇikāgre bāhyavṛttābhyantareṣṭadalāni tu caturasrasya jināṃśo bhāga ucyate prakuryācca caturdhā caturasrakam pātayetsūtraṃ dvayorapi tadā bhavet daśadhā vibhajedbudhaḥ kuṇḍaṃ ramaṇīyamidaṃ bhavet saumyapṛṣṭhaṃ tato nyattra yoniḥ paścimadigmatā sarvatantreṣu proktamatra nirantaram trayaḥ pañca trihastehyarkabhūmayaḥ tryabdarāmāśca nage trikṛtisāgarāḥ vedāgnidhṛtiyugmāni daśahastabhujā smṛtā tāvatkarkaṭakād vṛttaṃ vṛttakuṇḍamihocyate

tāvatkarkaṭakenāpi kuryād vṛttaṃ manoharam tattribhujāṃ dattvā kuḍamevaṃ ṣaḍasravat tanmadhyataḥ sūryabhāgaṃ karkaṭakena tu digvidigantarāle ca sūtrāṇyaṣṭau prapātayet nayedbāhyavṛttapūrvasūtrasya mūrddhani tasmādevamaṣṭadalāni tu ṣaḍaṅgavyāsārdhavṛttaṃ tatkeśarāṇi ca gurūktayuktyā nikhanedyathā padmākṛtirbhavet vālukābhiścaturasrasamaṃ yathā bhrāmayed vṛttaṃ cihnānyatra digaṣṭake kuṇḍaṃ tadvatkaṇṭhaśca mekhalāḥ tadvyāsārdhena vṛttaṃ syāttatra cihnāni pañca tu dhanurlopātkuṇḍaṃ pañcāsrakaṃ bhavet bhrāmayettatra vṛttaṃ tu saptadhā sakalaṃ tu tat anābhikāni kuṇḍāni viyonīti śrutīritam catvāri dikṣu kuṇḍāni tāntrike vāmapathyakaṃ yonikuṇḍakam tasmātsamyakparīkṣyedaṃ kartavyaṃ śubhamicchatā santāpo maraṇaṃ chinnamekhale bhāryāvināśakaṃ kuṇḍaṃ proktaṃ yonyā vinā kṛtam śṛṅgārarahitaṃ yacca kuṇḍaṃ jarjaramekhalam suhṛddveṣaḥ sūtrahīne daridratā yathoktakuṇḍepyutpātādevaṃ jāte phalaṃ tvidam jātibhede cācāryayajamānayoḥ vāmamārge ca bauddhe jaine ca śābare

kuryādanyathopadravo mahān purā kaścidbabhūva tvasurottamaḥ sammukhe yātāstena tetinipīḍitāḥ divyavarṣasahasrānte devāḥ śaraṇamāgatāḥ sobhyadhāvannāradena pracoditaḥ madotsikto viṣṇumāyāvimohitaḥ uvāca vacanaṃ tuṣṭo vriyatāṃvriyatāmiti tadyuddhaṃ tvayā tu jaṭilena hi tuṣṭimāpannastrailokyaparameśvaraḥ vacastasya śivayorbhrūpracoditaḥ deva evāparo na hi daityendrastamabhāṣata svapratijñārthaṃ yo gacchati sa jīvati darśayitvā dehoyaṃ vinipātyatām mā śokaṃ bhuvo janma tavābhavat varṇāḥ svasya bhogārthaṃ kariṣyanti navaṃ gṛham dāsyo vināyakamukhāśca te vacassopi gartaṃ kṛtvā mahābilam nirjitāḥ devāḥ punarudgamaśaṅkayā te pūjyā gṛhavāsasukhecchayā pratimāyāṃ vā kuryādvāstoṣpate tathā cānyeṣāṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā prapūrayet samatalāṃ bhūmiṃ vitastyuccāṃ ca vedikām ekāśītipadaṃ cakraṃ vaidikyastatra devatāḥ āpavatsantadīśāne prāgaryamṇaṃ trikoṣṭhake

nair-ṛtyadigbhāge mitraṃ paścimagaṃ triṣu caiśānyāmīśaṃ koṇācca davatoḥ kramādete pañca devā jñātavyāḥ savyamārgataḥ vātaḥ pūṣā sāvitra eva ca gṛharakṣayamau tathā jayamṛgau pitṛdauvārikau tathā varuṇāsuraśeṣāśca vāyavye īśatastvahiḥ bhallāṭasomau ca bhujaṅgaścāditistathā tāntrikamārge tu catuṣṣaṣṭipade tathā tatpūrvāttatra koṣṭhe dvikedvike savitā śakra indrajidrudratajjayau cāryamaṇaṃ jambhakaṃ pilipicchakam parjanyo jayantaḥ śakrabhāskarau pūṣā ca vitatho yamotha gṛharakṣakaḥ nir-ṛtiścātha dauvārikaśca sugrīvakastathā vāyurnāgamukhyāstataḥ param raktavarṇaṃ diśaḥ pītairvidiksitaiḥ paridhiḥ kāryaḥ sundaraṃ maṇḍalaṃ bhavet aṣṭottaraśataṃcāṣṭottaraviṃśatimeva ca kurvīta pāyasairvyañjanānvitaiḥ vyādhirbhūtapretādibhīrna ca khyātaściraṃjīvati tadgṛhe tu proktasiddhyai sudeśikaḥ bhairavakṣetrapālānāṃ yoginīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ vāmena jāyantetibubhukṣitāḥ

madyamāṃsapramattāste prāktanena pracoditāḥ tāsāṃ prātastu nikaṭe yataḥ syātka japaḥ kva ca devatāḥ yaḥ sa siddho'nyastu pātakī bahunoktena sarvanāśastu vāmataḥ śāntiṃ vidhāyaivaṃ sadasajjñānahetave bījāropaṇakarmedaṃ kartavyaṃ sarvakāmadam kuryāddakṣaḥ prāgvaruṇāyanam gomayenopaliptāyāṃ bhūmau dakṣe'tha vāmake pañcakarā dīrghāḥ kāryāśca pañca ca catvāriṃśatkoṣṭhakāssyuścaturviṃśatikoṣṭhakaiḥ paścātkoṣṭhacatuṣkaṃ yadbrahmasthānaṃ tadīritam kṛṣṇaiśca rajobhissṛṣṭimārgataḥ tadagre tu jñeyaṃ koṣṭhacatuṣṭayam ḍamarukākārāścatasro viṣṇudevatāḥ viṣṇusthānasya catuṣkoṣṭhe niveśayet āyāmocchrāyadīrghākhyairyuktāḥ paścānniveśayet śarāvāścatvāro bhānvaṅgulasamucchrayāḥ śālipuñjeṣu gandhādidarbhakūrcāyaneṣu ca nādaiśca pañcabhirbrāhmaṇāśiṣā prajapenmaṃtrī dugdhena kṣālayetpunaḥ mudgāḍhakyastuniṣpāvā khalvā māṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ pañcavādyabrahmaghoṣapurassaram saṃdhyayoruyoścaiva rātrau cāpi baliṃ haret dadyāttattadyuddiśya daivatam

haridrācūrṇasaṃyukto bhūtebhyoyaṃ balirmataḥ lājā yakṣebhyo dadhisaṃyutāḥ dadyātpadmākṣatabaliṃ paṃcame brahmaṇe mudā saptamehni viṣṇave vinivedayet bhairavī syādajastasyā balirmataḥ paiṣṭī ca surāstatra kramānmatāḥ śaśamāṃsaṃ ca yakṣebhyaḥ kukkuṭaṃ madhu dineṣu ca vilokayet samyagabhyudgame siddhiḥ kuṇṭhite vighnamāpnuyāt priyaṅgubhirjñeyā śyāmākaiḥstrīsukhaṃ bhavet sarvasammāno mudgairdevakṛpā bhavet satkarmasiddhiḥ syānmāṣaiḥ śāntī raṇe bhavet caitrāddīkṣāphalaṃ duḥkhaṃ pratiṣṭhāratnasiddhaye vṛddhiduḥkhethākṣepā nindā iti kramāt medhāvināśaśca svarṇāptirjñānavarddhanam manastāpaḥ śriyaḥ saukhyaṃ saukhyaṃ mantrasya siddhayaḥ devamaitrī sarvahāniḥ kalahaśca mahābhayam phalaṃ bhānāṃ kramāddakṣe tha vāmake agaurīmāntrikā bhraṣṭā vigaṇeśāśca duḥkhitāḥ samṛddhirduḥkhasiddhiśca mūrkhatā gurunāśanam śreṣṭhā naiva kṛṣṇā śubhrā śubhatarā hareḥ siddhirdhāturviśeṣeṇa putrahāniḥ pitṝnṛte putrā dhanāptirmṛtyurīritā ānandādikayogānāṃ sarvatrāvikalaṃ phalam sarvasiddhirviṣṭipucche sthire tu sthiratā bhavet

devatāsiddhirhānirmedhāvināśanam pūrṇasiddhiḥ pratāpaśca hānirvijñānanāśanam tathā hānirvāmināṃ mithunaṃ śubham triṣaḍāyagatāḥ pāpāḥ śubhāḥ kendratrikoṇagāḥ mantraścandrabale grāhyo'nyathā syādaghasambhavaḥ siddhiprado madhyosti nāśakṛt dāridryaṃ saure sarvasamṛddhayaḥ prātaḥkṛtyaṃ nivartya ca vidhānena puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥ ācārya-ṛtvigvaraṇasambhāro daśadhā mataḥ aṣṭāṅgulasamucchrāyasahitāni samāni ca viṣṭarāḥ sarvayajñeṣu lakṣaṇaṃ parikīrtitam ācā modakapūritāḥ madhūkapatracchatrāṇi soṣṇīṣāṇi samācaret kṛtvaitatphalamāpnoti mahāyajñārhaṇopamam taddviguṇaṃ dadyādācāryāya subhaktimān tasminyajñaphalaṃ svalpamanāvṛṣṭau yathā kṣiteḥ varaṇasāmagrīṃ saṅkalpya vṛṇuyādgurum sambhāṣya tvāmahaṃ ca tato vṛṇe karma kuruṣveti vadecchiśuḥ brāhmaṇānvṛṇuyādaṣṭau vedavedāṅgapāragān kuṇḍāni tadā catvāra ṛtvijo matāḥ taddvāre parīkṣāmārabhettataḥ purataḥ sthaṇḍile hastamātrake yaddiśāsaṃsthaṃ tatredaṃ pūrvataḥ phalam

saukhyaṃ jñānalābhaḥ kramātphalam sahasraṃ vā śataṃ viṃśatireva vā doṣāñjahijahītyevaṃ padaṃ caiva namo'ntakam punardeyaṃ punarduṣṭaṃ ca cetphalam sakṛdapi guruṃ śiṣyo vināśayet dakṣiṇānāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca vāminām samācakṣva svapne suptasya yatphalam svapnaṃ śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham rātrau svapnaṃ paśyedyathā tathā samutthāya pādaśaucaṃ vidhāya ca ityarthaḥ] || śivadaivatayoraikyaṃ bhāvayettu japedidam viśvarūpāya svapnādhipataye namaḥ kriyāsiddhiṃ vidhāsyāmi tvatprasādānmaheśvara devā bhoḥ sarve sāvadhānāstu tadvidhim juhuyāttaddaśāṃśena bilvapatrairghṛtaplutaiḥ bhavenmantraḥ svapne vakti hṛdi sthitam mantroyaṃ dvādaśākṣara īritaḥ ṣaḍbhirmāsairdviyāme tu tribhirmāsaistriyāmake phalaghnī syātsvapno vācyo na cānyathā vātādhikyādbhavet svapnassahasoḍḍānapūrvakaḥ śvetaśītādi śayanādyaṃ balāsanam kaphātpravepate nityaṃ hṛddve dvandve trayaṃ triṣu bhāgīrathīṃ bhānuṃ liṅginaṃ liṅgamaiśvaram kuñjaraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ mālyaṃ samudraṃ phalitadrumam vidhuṃ sūryaṃ ratnānyābharaṇāni ca

śvetacandanavastrāṇi śālayaḥ kuṅkumaṃ madhu phalāni siddhānnaṃ dadhi bālaṃ vilāsinam baddhamekaparaṃ puṣpaṃ sadvākyaṃ cakṣurañjanam rodanahīnaṃ ca puṇḍrāṇi ca patākikā māṅgalyagītāni cāṅkuśaṃ yuddhadaṃ priyam vyādhyādyārte nāsti duḥkhaṃ sāmānyaḥ sukhamāpnuyāt nadīṃ sindhuṃ dvijaṃ śvetāmbaraṃ tathā harmyaprāsādanāgāśvavṛṣaśailāgnirohaṇam kṛmiviṣṭhānulepaśca rudhireṇābhiṣecanam pracandrakiraṇaṃ svapne kāryasiddheḥ sulakṣaṇam svapne sā rātristasya paścimā hatyā pītayā karado bhavet svapne tasya śrīḥ sarvatomukhī tasya śrīḥ sarvatomukhī bhavedbhogī rogī rogādvimucyate vardhate tasya dugdhapānadhanātyayaḥ bhavetprītirgodhūmaiśca dhanāgamaḥ dadhilābho dadedarthānghṛtalābhād dhruvañjayaḥ liṅgānāmarcanandṛṣṭvā vyavahārotra jāyate patre taṃ vidyātpṛthivīpatim svapne tattathaiva bhaviṣyati maṇḍalarājyaṃ syānnagare pārthivo bhavet grasanaṃ śatrūṇāṃ vā vadhakriyā vaḍavāmahiṣīsiṃhīgohastinyādidohanam rājyābhiṣekaśca svaśiraśchedanaṃ mṛtiḥ

parastryāliṅganaṃ tasyā lābho rodanameva ca raṇadyūtavimardeṣu jayo nigaḍabandhanam [mayūralābhaḥ ||] śvetavastraṃ puṣpacandanadhāraṇam paśyettadā sādhakasya jñeyā siddhiritastataḥ vandhyācarmatuṣāgnyādilavaṇāṅgāramindhanam saṃnyāsī nagnastyaktaḥ kṣudhāturaḥ kārpāso garbhiṇī ca rajasvalā khañjakubjakau kāryaṃ syādrogī mṛtyumavāpnuyāt salilandṛṣṭvā naraḥ śokamavāpnuyāt snānaṃ putrabhāryāvināśanam raktagandhāmbaraḥ sragvī kṛṣṇo vā dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ maṭhe gehe dvāraṃ yasya pidhīyate svapne tasyāyurdaśamāsakam pāṣāṇaistāḍyate vāpi tasya mṛtyurna saṃśayaḥ dakṣiṇāśāmprasthito yastasya mṛtyurna saṃśayaḥ vṛkṣāṇāmadhikārāccyutirbhavet gṛhasammārjanaṃ lepo gomayena mṛdāpi vā rogādvimucyeta hāniḥ svasthasya jāyate vāmāṅge kokilāḥ śivāḥ dakṣe kākarkṣakukkurāḥ dhanalābhādi bahuvyāpāraśobhanam ghṛtāktānāṃ samidhāṃ cāṃ śataṃ hunet dīpandadyādvipragehe viṣṇorgehe śivālaye hānireva syāccānyadevaṃ vicintayet

vidhāyācamanantatra sāmānyārghyaṃ vidhāya ca vighnāndivyānāsphoṭanena ca pārthivānpārṣṇighātaiśca tribhirutsārayettataḥ utsārayet vighnānāṃ dadanmārgaṃ tu dakṣiṇe śākte vāmapādapuraḥsaram arghyābunā ca gavyena yāgasthāne susecayet saṃvīkṣya mūlamanunā tvastreṇa prokṣayettataḥ śrīkhaṇḍāgurumantraiśca dhūpitestreṇa saptadhā salājānvikirenmantrī pratyūhaghnānhi maṇḍape vardhanyā īśāne sthāpayecca tān likhetpaścātsarvatobhadramaṇḍalam dhṛtivargasamāḥ kāryāḥ koṣṭhakāścaturasrakāḥ pañcabhiḥ koṣṭhaiḥ śṛṅkhalā kṛṣṇavarṇikā śṛṅkhalobhayato bhadramaruṇaṃ navabhiḥ padaiḥ ṣoḍaśapadmaṃ tu ruciraṃ veṣṭayedbahiḥ athānyatsampravakṣyāmi kuryāttāntrikakarmaṇi ṣaḍvargakoṣṭhāni mārjayettatra saṃlikhet vṛttatrayaṃ madhye samaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi patrāgraṃ tyaktabhāgataḥ tribhiḥ koṣṭhaiḥ pādānkoṇeṣu vinyaset kuryānmārjayitā caturdikṣu ca madhyataḥ koṣṭhatrayeṇa caikena pratyekaṃ dvārapārśvayoḥ koṣṭhaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ kośāni kalpayet samāḥ kāryāḥ sīmarekhā dalāni ca pūraṇīyāni raktenaiva dalānyapi

pītapādāḥ sarvavarṇairviniścayāt upaśobhāśca vipreṇa pītagarbhāśca kṛṣṇataḥ patramūlaphalākārāmaṇḍitā hṛdayaṅgamāḥ kalpavallīśca pītaraktena keśarān koṇāni bahī rekhātrayaṃ tataḥ sarvatantreṣvidaṃ proktaṃ sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam tatra koṣṭhakāravivargakāḥ paṃktyā bhavetpīṭhaṃ dvāraśobhāstu pūrvavat pīṭhapādāḥ paridhayaḥ padmādyaṃ pūrvavanmatam paṅkajaṃ madhye tadbāhye vīthikā tu vā padmāni caturbhiḥ koṣṭhakaiścaret catuṣkapadmavīthīnāṃ madhye svastikasannibham śuklahāridraraktanīlaiḥ prapūrayet hyetannavanāgaṃ suśobhanam ekakoṣṭhacatuṣkādyaṃ pañcapadmaṃ pravakṣyate pūryā vīthikā tu pīṭhe tu surayoniṣu caturasraṃ catuṣṣaṣṭikoṣṭhakaṃ yo niveśayet madhyasthacaturasrāṇi dvāssthākhyāni tu pūrvataḥ koṇakoṣṭhaṃ vihāyaikaṃ pañca te pādasañjñitāḥ āgneyītaḥ koṇakoṣṭhānyāraktaharitāsitaiḥ catvāri madhye vṛttāni kārayet karṇikākāraṃ sitarekhāvṛtaṃ tataḥ pītaraktaśvetavarṇamūlamadhyāgrakesaram tṛtīyāṃśatulyavyāsaṃ ca vartulam kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ prāgvadrekhāṃ sitāṃ kuru

śyāmapītāruṇaśvetaistadantastūpabāhyataḥ daṇḍakhaḍgapāśāṅkuśagadā likhet maunī ṛjukāyo jitendriyaḥ vāmabhāge tu sthāpayetkalaśaṃ śubham nidhāyātha dīpānprajvālayecchubhān saṃskuryāttāni sarvāṇi vakṣyamāṇavidhānataḥ ||] || śaramantreṇa digbandhaṃ kuryānmaṃtrī samāhitaḥ bhūtaśuddhintataḥ kṛtvā prāṇasthāpanamācaret mūrdhni cchando vaktragataṃ nyaset vinyasenmantrī paṃcāṅgaṃ vā yathāvidhi aṅgairvihīnasya manoraṅgaṃ tenaiva kalpayet mantrajño yogapīṭhaṃ prakalpayet tato mudrāḥ sthāpayedarghyamuttamam tatrālpamalpaṃ śaṅkhāmbu tattaddevarato nyaset mantri prokṣaṇyadbhiḥ samāhitaḥ prokṣayedgandhapuṣpādyairdeśe sve deśikottamaḥ tatastatra pūjayediṣṭadevatām tathādhāre caraṇe sarvagātrake sarvopacāraistañceṣṭaṃ gurvādiṣṭena vartmanā pānīyaṃprokṣaṇīsaṃsthaṃ tyaktvā saṃsicya pūrvavat pūrvaṃ śālibhistaṇḍulaistataḥ chinnamūlāḥ kuśā dīrghāḥ saptaviṃśatisaṅkhyakāḥ yajedādhāraśaktyādipīṭhamantrāvasānakam triguṇātmakasūtreṇa veṣṭitaṃ sarvato bahiḥ cātra sthāpayeddeśikottamaḥ

dūrvācandanasaṃyuktaṃ vinyaseddakṣiṇānvitam mūlamantrañjapannante cintayannaikyamātmanaḥ pañcāśadoṣadhīkvāthaiḥ pūrayettadanantaram candanañcāpi raktākhyaṃ candanañcāgurustathā jātiphalaṃ jaṭāmāṃsī murā tathā citrakañca mudgaparṇī kuśāḥ punaḥ śaṅkhapuṣpī mayūrasya śikhā tathā pāṣāṇabhedakaḥ kṛṣṇā śaśipuṣpī ca rohiṇī indravallī bhṛṅgībhirānṛpāḥ śrīdevakanyākhyābhāgatho bhadramustakam dugdhavṛkṣatvacāṃ kvāthairbrahmabhūruktvagudbhavaiḥ kvāthāditoyairāpūrya śaṅkhantasminviloḍayet candanāgurukarpūrarocanākuṅkumaṃ madaḥ jaṭāmāṃsī vaiṣṇavaṃ tadudīritam śāktaṃ gandhāṣṭakaṃ viduḥ tagarāgurukarpūraiḥ śāmbhavaṃ cāṣṭagandhakam tagarāgurukarpūraiḥ sauraṃ gandhāṣṭakaṃ viduḥ madābhyāñca vāridena ca patrajam saśaktikañjalaṃ kumbhe bhavedevaṃ vidurbudhāḥ dhūmrā marīcirjvālinī ruciḥ kalāṣoḍaśakañcāndraṃ yajetpaścād gurūttamaḥ śaśinī candrikā kāntirjyotsnā śīḥprītiraṃgadā vedādibhede sañjātāḥ kalāḥ pañcāśabinduyuk pratiṣṭhā vidyā śāntir-ṛddhiśca dīpikā jñānāmṛtāpyāyanī ca vyāpinī vyomarūpikā

lakṣmīrdyutiḥ sthirācchittissiddhirjarā ca pālinī tīkṣṇā ca raudrī ca bhayā nidrā ca tandrikā tathānantā madhyemadhye prapūjayet gāyatrīṃ viṣṇoryoniṃ tathaiva ca kalādaśakamāvāhya sṛṣṭyādyaṃ sannidhāpya ca prāṇasaṃsthāpanaṃ kṛtvā kalānāṃ pūjayecca tāḥ nivṛttyādyāścāpi yajeduktayuktyā vicakṣaṇaḥ sapta dhruvaṃ bhedāḥ prakīrtitāḥ tvaśvatthapanasacūtānāṃ pallavāndṛḍham taṃ ca bhāvayetkalaśopari kalpavṛkṣaphalaṃ hyetatsthāpayedanayā dhiyā etatpradhānakumbhasya sthāpanaṃ parikīrtitam maṇḍalāni kuryādaṣṭadalāni ca pūrṇakalaśaṃ tatra caitānprapūjayet cāgneyyāṃ dikṣu kumbhāṃstu vinyaset rudrādikāṣṭhāsukramādrudrādikānyajet puṇḍarīkaṃ vāmanaṃ kumudāñjanau svavedyāṃ tu gatvā svasyāsane viśet samāvāhya pūjayediṣṭadevatām caitanyaṃ nāsikāgravinirgatam samutthāpya tasyāmāvāhayettataḥ sammukhakiraṇaṃ cāpi śakalīkaraṇaṃ tataḥ kuryātkramaśastasya mudrikāḥ āsanādiprasūnāntānupacārānprakalpya ca lokapālānāṃ tadastrāṇāṃ ca pūjanam

tato maṇḍalamparitaḥ kramāt dakṣabhāge kṛtvā sthaṇḍilamuttamam yathāvidhi tatastatra gandhādyairdevatāṃ yajet juhuyānmūlamantreṇa pāyasena ghṛtena ca tāṃ candanādyaiḥ pīṭhamūrtau nidhāpayet pārṣadebhyaścandanādipuṣpākṣatasamanvitam punaryajeccopacāraiḥ pañcabhirdarśayettataḥ sahasraṃ ca japenmantrī mūlamantraṃ samāhitaḥ pūrvaṃ sthāpito vikirotra ca devatāṃ ghorarūpiṇīm tiṣṭhansampūjya ca tato gṛhītvā tampradakṣiṇam devatāntārayettataḥ bhūyastaṃ gandhādyairdeśikottamaḥ devateṣṭādijepātre kṣālite ca śarāṇunā tithiprasṛtimānena śarāṇūnprapacetkṣipet mūlamantreṇa deśikottamaḥ sruvasaṃsthena ghṛtenāthāvatārayet tvekandevatāyai paraṃ vahnau nivedayet prādeśamātraṃ hṛjjaptaṃ yathoktaṃ dantadhāvanam śiṣyāya dadyātsa radānviśodhya kṣālitaṃ tyajet ṛtvijaśca gacchedyajñagṛhaṃ prati manunā hyaṣṭottarasahasrakam snātaṃ pañcagavyaṃ pāyayenmantravittamaḥ hṛtpuṇḍarīkacaitanyaṃ śiṣyasyātmani yojayet kalāstattvabhuvanārṇapadā mantrapūrvikāḥ

pratiṣṭhā ca vidyā śāntistathaiva ca guruḥ śiṣyaṃ spṛśankuṇḍe svake hunet śodhayāmidviṭhāntena mantreṇāṣṭāhutīrhunet liṅgapradeśesya tattvādhvānaṃ vicintayet śivaśaktī ca sadāśivamaheśvarau kalā rāgaḥ kālo niyatireva ca manaścendriyadaśakaṃ tanmātrā bhūtapañcakam manobuddhistanmātrā bhūtapañcakam saṅkarṣaṇaḥ pradyumnaścāniruddhakaḥ prakṛtirbuddhiriti ca caturviṃśatisammitāḥ tathātmeti cātmā vidyā śivā punaḥ vilīnaṃ tu cintayed bhuvanādhvani pātālarasātalamahātalam homavyūhastu pūrvavat akārādikṣakārāntānvarṇānsañcintayeddhṛdi prāgvadevātra lalāṭe cintayettataḥ yadādhvātrohahomādi prāgvadeva samācaret mantrādhvā cintayecchiṣyamūrddhani sthitandhyāyedetatsyādadhvaśodhanam hunenmahāvyāhṛtibhistato deśikasattamaḥ brahmārpaṇākhyamantreṇa sarvakarmacchide sudhīḥ mantrī stutvā mūlāṇunā tataḥ puṣpantatra prapātayet māṃsamāṣābhyāṃ tīrthāhvābhyāṃ ca pūrṇatām dakṣapādampuraskṛtya dakṣaḥ pūrṇāhutiñcaret

gandhādyairmūlamantreṇa mantravit sāvaraṇāṃ tatra pūjayecca yathāvidhi pariṣicyāgniṃ prārthayīta tato guruḥ samprāpte sānnidhyaṃ kuru sādaram brahmāṇamudvāsya brāhmaṇāya prapādayet taṇḍulaistatsamāpūrya sahiraṇyaṃ sadakṣiṇam paristarānagnau paridhīnnikṣipenna tu netramantreṇa śiṣyanetraṃ nibadhyate prapūryāsya hyañjalīnkṣepayeddhare netrabandhamapāsyopaveśayetkuśasaṃstare brūyācchiṣyaḥ ślokañca tatra vai yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ nyāsāndehe parinyaset tantroktavartmanā tatra sakalākṛtimācaret kumbhāsyasthasuradruṃśca mūrddhanyasya śiśorguruḥ niyatātmānaṃ siñcetkalaśapuṣpakaiḥ toyairakṣarasaṃyuktairghaṭaistenaiva vartmanā gṛhītvābhyarcitaṃ pūrvaṃ karakaṃ mantrarūpiṇam śiṣṭena śiśuṃ gururācāmayettataḥ paridhāyājñayā guroḥ vadedvidvānviprasyoṅkārapūrvakam vidyāṅgacchantīṃ bhāvayed guruḥ kṣiṣyaḥ prajaped guruṇoditam gurudevātmamantrāṇāmaikyaṃ śiṣyo vibhāvayet sāṣṭāṅgaścātha pañcāṅgaḥ pūjākarmasu sammataḥ

dṛṣṭyā tathā caiva cittenāṣṭāṅga īritaḥ ācāryājñāṃ sadā kuryāttattaḥ śiṣyo vicārya ca īśvarārpaṇabuddhyā ca dvijāśīrbhiśca nanditaḥ vā pradadyācca vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ dadyādvittanusārataḥ nityaṃ taccintanaparāyaṇaḥ nānāvidhairbhakṣyairlehyaiścoṣyaistathāparaiḥ kriyāmayī dīkṣā sampaddātrī nirūpitā || ayandīkṣākramaḥ prokto bhogayuk siddhimicchatām yatprakṛtyātmatattvañca varṇānāṃ samudīritam śiśornyasyedarṇāndeśikasattamaḥ svasāmarthyāddāpayeddevatātmatām kalādīkṣāmaṇimādyaṣṭasiddhidām kupañcāśatkalā vāme siddhamantragurostu sā nivṛttipramukhā bhūtānāṃ pañca ceritāḥ pādādijānuparyantaṃ nivṛttissaṃsthitā kalā nābhitaḥ kaṇṭhaparyantaṃ vidyākhyā saṃsthitā kalā bhālācchirovadhi proktā śāntyatītā kalā tathā svīyājñayācaiva dīkṣā pañcakalā smṛtā kādikā varṇā yatra dvādaśa saṃsthitāḥ sūryasya ṣoḍaśāśu vidhostathā varṇakalānāntu varṇasthānācca saṃhṛtiḥ vāmamārge cāvedadikṣā phalapradā vedamayīṃ vakṣye yāṃ labdhvā sukhadāñjanaḥ śiṣyasya dhyāyetkañjaṃ caturdalam

trirāvarṇamayīṃ devīṃ vidyutpuñjasvarūpiṇīm aṇoraṇīyasīṃ devīṃ cakraṣaṭkaprabhedinīm sāntavādidalasthārṇānpadmasthāne samāharet phāntaḍādyarṇasaṃyukte digdale vedhayetsvayam ṭhāntakādyarṇapatrābje vedhayedīśvare svayam padme svarānsaṃyojya yatnataḥ lakṣasaṃyukte vedhayitvā tu deśikaḥ śiṣyo dagdhājñānastadā kṣitau svayaṃbhūyātsatyameva na saṃśayaḥ svayaṃ guruṃ dhyāyet svahaste śivarūpiṇam mastake dattvā kṛpayā dakṣiṇaṃ karam cidrūpe guruścittaṃ nidhāpayet gurostu kṛpayā kevalohaṃ sadāśivaḥ dhyātvā paramātmani devatām prasannacittaḥ sanpaścādupadiśediti gurorālokamātreṇa bhāṣaṇātsparśanādapi bhuktimuktiprasiddhyarthamparīkṣya vidhivad guruḥ dadyādgṛhṇātyanyāyataśca yaḥ guruśiṣyāvubhau mohādaparīkṣya parasparam aśāstrīyopadeśantu yo gṛhṇāti dadāti yaḥ asaṃskṛtyopadeśaṃ tu yaḥ karoti vimūḍhadhīḥ mantravijñānaṃ na tiṣṭhati kadācana sacchiṣyāyātibhaktāya vijñānamupadiśyate dhanecchābhayalībhādyairayogyaṃ yadi dīkṣayet gururdīkṣāṃ kuryātpūrṇābhiṣecanam

nāpnoti sadgatiñca samīhitām vipulāṃścakrānmaṇḍapetimanohare kalaśāṃstatra vastrahemasamanvitān madhye cānteṣu sāṅgāvaraṇadevatāḥ caturo vedāṃstatastena jalena tu sarvatantrāṇi tantrebhyo munayastathā bhavedācāryanāmā ca kuryānnāmāntaraṃ guruḥ sarvamantrapradhāneṣu samarthaḥ sa tu jāyate vidhistasya mārgaḥ syāddakṣiṇābhidhaḥ yamunāyāśca sarasvatyā mahodadheḥ sarayūcarmaṇvatyośca puṣkarāt kurukṣetrasyagaṇḍakyāḥ pūrṇāyā mānasasya ca abhiṣiktastu taistoyaiḥ siddho vai mānavotra tu tīrthaghaṭaṃ sthāpya śeṣāstoyaghaṭā matāḥ sānnidhyaṃ mantrarūpāśca tanmukhe nāmito mūrddhā tasya mṛtyurna saṃśayaḥ nirahaṅkāraḥ sadā daivatatparaḥ syādanyo nirayabhājanam kriyādīkṣāvidhiṃkuryādyathāśaktyā gurūktitaḥ etattattvaṃ samākhyātaṃ kimanyacchrotumicchatha dīkṣāprakāśastṛtīyaḥ tadiṣṭasiddhaye tatra devaṃ saivaṃ vyajijñapat saṃśayaṃ chindhi tvadṛtenyaḥ pumānna hi tadbhedā bhinnāḥ kasmādvadasva naḥ devatāḥ santi mantrā eva tu devatāḥ

mukhyaṃ svarūpaṃ teṣāṃ tu mantrā eva na cetarat janmāntare bhaveyuśca bījarūpā na saṃśayaḥ durgatimavāpnoti teṣāṃ saṃsevanānnaraḥ suvarṇaṃ durbuddhyā grāmyavattāracāriṇaḥ na sadbījā bhavāntare yadvadvaṭodumbarapippalāḥ yathā drākṣākharjūrapanasādayaḥ tacchreyo yathā nāḍyonnajaṃ rasam grahastadvacchreyassaṃvahate suraḥ poṣayeddaivikānmantrānitarānhanti vāmavat sitasyāpi vāmānāmapi puṣṭidā sarvamantrāṇāṃ puṣṭikṛcca tatastriṣu gurornāḍī satvaraṃ mantrasiddhidā ketunāḍī tu sadbhūte mantradevakṛt tantre pratyakṣāgnisvarūpakam phalaṃ dhatte bhūmau vai viśvarūpakaḥ kuṇḍasaṃskārānaṣṭādaśa samācaret kuśaissantāḍayetkuṇḍamastramantraṃ paṭhaṃstridhā khananaṃ kuṇḍasyāṅgulamātrataḥ śuddhamṛdā taṃ ca pūrayeddhṛdayāṇunā kuṭṭayettanmantreṇa syāttathā dṛḍham gomayādbhiḥ kavacenaiva kārayet trisūtrīkṛtasūtreṇa veṣṭayetpratimekhalam tāraścāmukakuṇḍāya āsanāya namastviti mekhalānāṃ ca kuryādevaṃ prapūjanam

vahnerjvālānirāsāya hṛnmantreṇa kuśaistataḥ kuśairastramantritaiḥ kuṇḍabhittiṣu proktāḥ saṃskārā dhṛtisammitāḥ saṃskārā ādyāścatvāra eva hi prāṅmukhāgrāṇāṃ devā viṣṇvīśavāsavāḥ vilikheddarbhakāṇḍena vāmamārgestramantrataḥ viṣṇvīśavāsavādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ tatra tu pūjanam praṇavenātha yogapīṭhaṃ samarcayet tasyordhvaṃ śaktiyuktaṃ vicintayet śvetadvīpaṃ tatra cintyaṃ sudhāsindhusuveṣṭitam kalpavṛkṣāṃśca tatraiva ciṃtayetpūjayedapi tanmadhye tasya pādānvicintayet aiśvaryamapi cāṅgāni pīṭhasyoktāni tatra tu tasyoktā vikāramayakesarāḥ pāvakasya maṇḍalatritayaṃ tataḥ antarātmayutaścātmā paramātmā tataḥ param vidyātattvaṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ yogapīṭhamitīritam pūjayedetā jayāñca vijayāṃ tathā dogdhrīmaghorāñca tathā maṅgalāmatha tatra tu kuṇḍe pūjayedbhuvaneśvarīm tatra devīmṛtumatīṃ tathā saure lakṣmīmṛtumatīṃ smaret vipragehādvā dadyādagniṃ kumārikā cāpihite tāmrapātrādike śubhe pātregniṃ kavacena vidhāya ca

kuryādvyādhihānibhayāvaham mūlamantreṇa sthāpayedagrataḥ sudhīḥ pradīpakalikākāraṃ teja āvāhayettataḥ smṛtvāgnibījantenātha caitanyaṃ yojayettataḥ śareṇātha kavacenāvaguṇṭhayet tataḥ svasya saṃmukhaṃ svīyakuṇḍale jñātvā nikṣipedāśuśukṣaṇim prabhāṣyaiva kṛśānuṃ jvālayettataḥ suvarṇavarṇamamalaṃ samiddhaṃ sarvatomukham dhamedagnimmukhādeṣa vyajāyata suvinyasejjihvā dehe mantrairvibhāvasoḥ jihvāstā vakṣyante trividhātmikāḥ cātiraktā jihvāḥ sapteti sāttvikāḥ pravinyasedbhūyo vahneraṅgāni vai kramāt saptajihvo dhanurdhara itīritāḥ mūrddhāsyapārśvakaṭyaṃghrikaṭipārśvāṃsakeṣu ca havyavāhastṛtīyakaḥ mūrtayoṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ mekhaloparisaṃśuddhaiḥ punardarbhacatuṣṭayaiḥ ekamekhalake kuṇḍe mekhalādhaḥ paristaret sikatānāṃ tu bāhyabhūmau paristaret vidvānmadhyamāmekhalopari ekavṛkṣodbhavānārdrānparidhīnbāhumātrakān svagṛhyoktavidhānena vāyudeśācca pūrvataḥ ājyasthālīñca paridhīṃstathaiva kuśamuṣṭayaḥ

gandhapuṣpākṣatādīni sarvāṇyāsādayettataḥ prokṣaṇīpātrayugalaṃ paripūrya śubhāmbunā tatpātraṃ praṇītetyucyate budhaiḥ yajñasādhanasambhārān prokṣayenmūlamantrataḥ dakṣiṇe bhāge veśayettaṃ kuśāsane dīkṣāṅgabhūtahomesminbrāhmaṇaṃ tvāṃ vṛṇe tviti cāpi labhyate brāhmaṇo na cet nānākeśarasaṃyuktaṃ caturdvārasamāvṛtam tadvahnestatra maṇḍalakādinā prādakṣiṇyena madhyāntaṃ pītāṃ śvetāṃ tathāruṇām rucirāṃ jvālinīñceti sarvapīṭhamprapūjayet samastapīṭhapūjāyāṃ vahnimantra udāhṛtaḥ saṃyuktairbhujaiḥ samyagvirājitam trinetrañca jaṭāmaulimpītavastrāruṇasrajam p. 60) vaiśvānara jātaveda ihāvaha lohitākṣa saptaviṃśatyakṣaroyaṃ mantraḥ syādvahnipūjane jihvājvālārucaḥ sarvā varābhayakarāstathā vaiḍūryavarṇā kanakā prācyāṃ stambhanakāryavṛt kṛṣṇāñjanacayaprakhyā nair-ṛtyāṃ māraṇakṣamā jayābhāsā vaśye vāyudiśaṅgatā anekakāryasaṃsiddhirnāśakartrī ca sā matā tathā siddhirviparīte viparyayaḥ lelihā ceti jihvā vaiṣṇavakarmaṇi sakalā jihvā varadābhayasatkarāḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni patreṣvāvṛttidevatāḥ

tataścādhomukhau kṛtvāsruksruvau ca pratāpayet mūlaistridhā caiva mārjayitvā pratāpayet karāgreṇa punaḥ santāpayeccatau sruksruvau paścāddhṛtasaṃskāramācaret samāpūrya vīkṣaṇādisusaṃskṛtam samuddiṣṭaṃ kuśadvayamata kṣipet darśayettaṃ hṛdā kṣipet mantrajñaḥ kuryādutplavanaṃ tataḥ aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ ca gṛhītvā ghṛtamutplavet tatsyātsamplavanaṃ ṣaṭ saṃskārā itīritāḥ adhamaṃ chāgalījātaṃ niṣiddhaṃ tveḍakādijam ghṛte nyasya tataḥ prādeśasammitam vāma iḍāṃ dakṣe piṅgalāṃ madhyatastataḥ dakṣabhāgātsruveṇājyaṃ pragṛhṇīyāddhṛdāṇunā vāmabhāgāttadvadvāmegnilocane gṛhītvājyaṃ madhyato madhyalocane dakṣabhāgātpunastvājyaṃ hṛnmaṃtreṇa samāharet satārābhirvyāhṛtibhirājyena juhuyātpunaḥ garbhādhānādikāṃ vahnessamudvāhāvasānikāḥ pūrvamuccārya karmanāma samuccaret puṃsavanaṃ sīmaṃtaṃ jātakarma ca caulopanayanaṃ vahnermahānāmavrataṃ tathā śākte vāgbhavapūrvakāḥ visṛjyātha mūlāgreṣu ghṛtaplutāḥ sabījasvasvanāmnā vai caikaikāmāhutiṃ hunet

devamukhāya svāhā ||] juhuyādvahnermūrtyaṣṭakaṃ tathā pūrvoktenāgnimantreṇa vauṣaḍantena vai tataḥ daśāhutīḥ pañcaviṃśatisaṅkhyakam ātmāgnidevatānāṃ ca cintayannaikyamātmavit nāḍīsandhānametaddhi proktaṃ deśikasttamaiḥ sarvāsukuṇḍeṣu ca yathāvidhi sarvartvijaścandanādyaissampūjya proktadevatām sarpissaṃyutena priyāndhasā hotavyaṃ tīrtheṇārṣeṇa vā tathā mandāgnyāmayasaṃyukto daridraścāpi jāyate vārāṇāṃ rāśīnāṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak vārebhyaścātha sarvebhyo bhūtebhyaśca namo vadet gūḍhamapi vakṣyāmi śaraṇāgatān homavidhi prakāśaścaturthaḥ paradeśasthitānāṃ ca kārāgehādivāsinām kāryāṅgavastvabhāve vā vāmikānāṃ kṛpānidhe cāpi dinacaryāṃ vada prabho yatsarvatantreṣu gopitam sarve bho devāḥ sādhakānāṃ prasiddhidam adhikārivibhedena tadapi trividhaṃ bhavet pratyavāyo na galite saphalañjanaiḥ yatinā kṛtaṃ tacchuddhamiṣyate pathikenāpi kārāgṛhagatena vā vā vittasaṃkṣayādanyakāryataḥ

yacca ekānte niyamena ca yadvācayitvā śraddhābhaktiṃ vidhāya ca lokānāṃ yācitaṃ devanāmataḥ samāśritya kaulaṃ dharmaṃ vicārya ca yatkāmataḥ karma caihikaṃ pāralaukikam yatpānaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ kāmato ratam mokṣaḥ syātsvargaḥ syānmiśrasattvataḥ syādrājasācchuddhātkāmaḥ syānmiśrarājasāt sāttvikāttāmasāddevayonitvaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ pañcavidhaṃ proktaṃ pañcadhā muktidāyakam sammārjanopalepādisaṃskārā devamandire pūjāsādhanasāmagryā melanaṃ bhaktasevanam pīṭhapūrvāṅgapūrvañca ṣoḍaśādyupacārakaiḥ tacchāstrādhyayanaṃ samyakkṛtvā mantrārthabhājanam gurudevātmakālānāṃ samyagaikyavibhāvanam yāme smarediṣṭāṃ ca devatām gṛhādbahirgatvā kṛtvāvaśyakamādarāt ācamya śuddhadehaḥ syāddevatāyogamandire nivedyātha dadyādvai dantadhāvanam proṃchanāyātha dadyādvāso'malaṃ śubham smarettatra śrīguruṃ nijarūpiṇam varābhayajñānamudrāpustakairvyāvṛtaiḥ karaiḥ vāmāṅkagatayā śaktyāliṅgitaṃ raktavarṇayā vāmalīlākamalayāliṅgaṃtyā dakṣiṇena ca tatpādapadmayugalacyutapīyūṣadhārayā

arcayedgandhapuṣpādyairbāhyasthairmānasaistu vā hṛnmanunā bhāvayettallayaṃ hṛdi suṣumṇāṃtaṃ sahasravisasannibham viciṃtyātha prāṇāyāmatra yaṃ caret vidhāyā'tha hṛdi devaṃ vicintayet dharāṃ śvāsayuktaṃ pādaṃ nidhāpayet pādasparśaṃ kṣamasvame smaredastrandūre [phaṭ iti mantram |] yāyād dvijālayāt kīṭayoṣādirahitaṃ śaucasthānamidampaṭhet paritastyajyatāṃ sthānaṃ viṇmūtrotsarjanāya me tatra vāsasā kaṃ [jalam |] praviśya ca liṅge gude sapta daśa vāmakare tathā karadvaye caikā pādayorathavā caret gaṇḍūṣānpūrīṣotsarjanāntare [viṣṭhātyage |] dantadhāvanakāṣṭhaṃ tu proktaṃ tantravicakṣaṇaiḥ mūlānuno nityaṃ lakṣayetsiddhihetave yāyājjalaniketanam kṛtvā taṭaṃ tatra caikabhāge vicakṣaṇaḥ mattikāgomayābhyāñca kaṭyantaṃ snānamācaret vaidikasnānaṃ tadaṅgaṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā samādāyāstramantreṇa mantrayitvā tṛṇādikam mūrddhādipādaparyantaṃ vilipya praṇamejjalam tato jātāstā āpaḥ praṇamāmyaham tūṣṇīmutthāya nābhimātre jale naraḥ mūlamantreṇa prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ caret

hastamātre tajjale parikalpite deveśa tīrthaṃ dehi divākara bhitvārkamaṇḍalaṃ tasmāttīrthānyāvāhayediha sminsannidihiṃ kuru tanmantreṇa ca pūjayet gaṅgāsindhusaridvarādisahitāṃ śrītīrthaśaktiṃ bhaje vahnigehinī gāṅgamantreṇa mantrayedaṣṭavārakam || p. 67) ambālike mahāmālinyehyehi bhagavatyatha ca gaṅge gaṅgāmbike dviṭhaḥ devatāṃ tatra sāṅgāṃ sāvaraṇāntathā smarenmūlamantraṃsnāyājjale triśaḥ tribhirlokairmūlamantraistārakaṃ bījapūrvakaiḥ sarvabhūtānāmāpo devyaḥ punantu mām nijasparśādāpo devyaḥ punantu mām karṇayorakṣṇorāpastad ghnantu vo namaḥ santarpya toyamadhyāttaṭaṃ vrajet mṛdādbhistata ācamya devasnānavidhissmṛtaḥ durge kāyāsvāsthye ca vārddhake diśaḥ prāgvatsaṃśodhyopāviśettataḥ mātṛkādīṃstathā mūlamantranyāsānaśeṣataḥ kevalādudakasnānātsaṃskāraparivarjitāt tatpādodakajāṃ dhārāṃ nipatantīṃ svamūrddhani tasmātsaṃkṣālayetsarvametaddehagataṃ malam snānavaraṃ mantrasnānādaṣṭaguṇaṃ matam

mānasikasnānaṃ manasā mūlamantrataḥ śivātmakairmantraiḥ kṛtvā tīrthaṃ śivātmakam kriyāḥ śuddhāḥ sarvāḥ siddhiṃ prayānti ca tilakaṃ kuryājjātervā daivatasya ca brāhmaṇasyordhvapuṇḍraṃ syātkṣatriyasya tripuṇḍrakam ūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ mṛdā kuryāttripuṇḍraṃ caiva bhasmanā vaiṣṇavasyordhvapuṇḍraṃ syāttripuṇḍraṃ śivasevane yastu candraṃ tasya triśūlakam vibhūtiḥ syādvidhinā vidhṛtā yadi saṅgrāhyamagnīṣomodbhavantu vā śakṛdvastragṛhītaṃ gagane patata piṇḍīkṛtya śivāgnau tu tatkṣipenmūlamantrataḥ vāsasā'loḍya bhasmādhāre viniḥkṣipet yasmāccaṇḍabhasma prajāyate pañcākṣareṇa tu lalāṭe vijñeyo hṛdaye havyavāhanaḥ bāhumadhye ca śaśī ca maṇibandhane vasavaḥ pṛṣṭhadeśe hariḥ smṛtaḥ kastūryādikasaṃyuktaṃ bhasma syāttattu dhārayet kārayedbhāle brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakam anāmāmadhyamāṅguṣṭhairathavāsyāttripuṇḍrakam baddhvā tu mūlena prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ caret saptavārantataḥ param pratyarṇaṃ prokṣayenmūrdhni kuśairmūlena ca tridhā toyamāmantrairbījairbhūtātmakaistathā

punaḥ saptavāraṃ mūlena mantrayet samprokṣya kampaṭhenmūlamantrakam śiṣṭena tejorūpeṇa tena tu dakṣanāsāpuṭenaitatsmṛtvā dakṣiṇahastakam hastāvācamya mūlamantreṇa mantravit ravimaṇḍalasaṃsthāya sveṣṭadevāya tarpayet tarpaṇīyaṃ vāmakaiḥ kāraṇena tu brāhmīṃ tu vaidikaṃ matamāśritaḥ cārpayedevaṃ stutvā natveṣṭadevatām praṇamediti sandhyā tu tāntrikī lopaśca tadā mūlaṃ śataṃ japet kṛtvā tatastāntrikamācaret ṛṣyāditritayasyātha purato dhenumudrayā devaṃ dhyātvā mūlaṃ samuccaret viṃśatyaṣṭayuktamukhābjake tadāvaraṇadevāṃśca tadvadekaikavārakam digīśāṃśca khagānnatā bhāṇḍaṃ kare dadhat vīkṣeta yāvatprāpnoti vai gṛham prakṣālyācamya pūjāyā gṛhadvārāntare sthitaḥ praṇamediṣṭadevaṃ svaṃ dikpālānapi cetasā tatpāpasyāpanodārthaṃ mantradvayamudīrayet cittānme pāpaṃ phaṭ huṃ ca te namaḥ śubhāśubhasyeha karmaṇo nṛṣu sākṣikāḥ evaṃkṛte prathamataḥ pāpotsādanakarmaṇi pūjanaṃ sthānaṃ svaṃ prayātu punaścatat

pāpāsyakāmamiṣṭaṃ kṣaṇādbhavet dineśāya tatprakāra ihocyate tataḥ paścādupaviśya nijāsane prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā sūryamantreṇa mantravit tathendrādīndhyātvā sūryamananyadhīḥ samastajagatāmadhipaṃ bhajāmi kṛtvā jalena caturasrakam gandhapuṣpākṣatāndarbhadūrvāsarṣapasaṃyutān tatpātraṃ spṛśannaṣṭottaraṃ śatam sūryamantreṇa dadyādarghyaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ tataścayogakaraṇe parivṛttāsaneti ca catustriṃśadakṣaroyaṃ sūryasyārghyanivedane sūryaṃ dhyāyeddeśikasattamaḥ vidhivaddvārapūjāṃ samācaret taddakṣiṇe mahālakṣmīṃ vāme cāpi sarasvatīm ūrdhvabhāgottaraṃ yāvatpañcapañcavibhāgake devānetānprapūjayet śaṅkhanidhiṃ dakṣe vāme vasumatīyutam hṛcchaktiṃ gaṅgāṃ ca yamunāṃ tathā paścimadvārapūjā ceyamprakāśitā sampūjyaivamudagdvāraṃ prāgyāmye ca prapūjayet tathā skanda umācaṇḍeśvarau tathā prabalaścaiva bhadraścāpi subhadrakaḥ tu yoginyoṣṭāvetā dvārapālikāḥ tathendrāṇī cāmuṇḍā ca śriyā saha

dvāradevāḥ svayamudghāṭayanti yat vighneśvaraṃ vande gajavaktraṃ trilocanam nirdagdhahemagaurāṅgīṃ mahālakṣmīṃ trilocanām śuklāṃ śvetavastrāṃ sarasvatīm tīkṣṇaṃ bhāvayāmi kṣetre'smin kṣetranāyakam śaṅkhadharaṃ muktānibhaṃ śaṅkhanidhimbhaje nityaṃ vāmenotpaladhāriṇam śyāmavarṇāntāṃ śyāmāṃ māyāmahaṃ bhaje grāhārūḍhāmahaṃ vande gaṅgāṃ sarvasaridvarām varābhayakarāṃ vande kālindīṃ kālavigrahām garuḍārūḍhaṃ dhātāraṃ kṛṣṇavigraham vidhātāraṃ vande tryakṣasamanvitam adhaḥsthāṃ dehaliṃ vande paścimāsyāṃ sudakṣiṇām cāstreṇa mantritānsarṣapākṣatān bhavet ||] samyagastramantreṇa deśikaḥ yāścātranivasantyanyadevatā bhuvi saṃsthitāḥ vighnakartāraste naśyantu śivājñayā jahyāttānmaṇḍapasyāntastato vighnāṃstu nirgatān smaranvāmapārṣṇighātatrayeṇa ca tiryagdṛṣṭyavalokena divyānvighnānnivārayet dvāramācchādya vāsasā sammārjanopalepādyairdarpaṇodaravatkṛtam pañcavarṇarajaścitraṃ sthānaśuddhiriyaṃ matā vāstvadhīśaṃ ca brahmaṇe nama ityapi dīpanāthaṃ bhairavaṃ prārthayediti

namastubhyamanujñāṃ dātumarhasi saṃskuryādāsanasthānaṃ caturbhirvīkṣaṇādibhiḥ ādhāraśaktimārabhya svāsanaṃ tatra vinyaset vidhivatsmaredviṣṇuṃ guruṃ tathā devatā proktā viniyogo nijāsane dhāraya māṃ devi pavitraṃ kuru cāsanam īśāne kṣaṃ kṣetrapataye namaḥ |] samarcayet |] vāpi ṛjukāyo manassthiraḥ suvāsitāmbusampūrṇaṃ savye kumbhaṃ suśobhanam ghṛtādijvalitāndīpānsthāpayetparitaḥ śubhān saṃsthāpya saṃskuryāttāni cātmavān nārācamudrayā dṛṣṭvā samayāṃśca vilokayan aspṛśyasparśanaṃ vāpi yadanyāyārjitañca vā tatpūrvannāśamāyāti naivedyādyavalokanāt syācchubhado dīpo niṣkravyādaḥ sukhapradaḥ vasāmajjādisambhūtairghṛtādyairupayojitam dīrghayā bhavet ||] saṃspṛśet pāṇinā dhṛtvā vāmapārśvasthitaṃ ghaṭam jalāśayaśavasparśājjalaṃ sthāne ca saṅgatam kṛtāñjaliḥ pūto vāmadakṣiṇapārśvayoḥ sugandhapuṣpāṇyādāya candanāktāni mantravit vāmahastena samādāya ca mastakam pūrvampaṭhecchokamimaṃ sādhakasattamaḥ mṛtyurogabhayakleśāḥ patantu ripumastake tyajet || karaśuddhiṃ tatostreṇa kuryāttālatrayaṃ tataḥ

tejo vahniprākāramudrayā tataḥ kuryāttatprakāramatha bruve pītavarṇaṃ ca bhūsthānaṃ brahmadaivatam jīvānāmevaṃ rūpaṃ vicintayet ardhacandranibhaṃ śṛṅgadvayaṃ tatpadmalāñchitam pratiṣṭhākalayā yuktaṃ dhyāyettadviṣṇudaivatam kalayā yutaṃ vidyākhyayā tathā mahāpralayavatsthānaṃ vahnitattvaṃ vicintayet ṣaḍbindulāñchitaṃ vṛttaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇakam yaṃbījarūpaṃ dhyātvetthaṃ prāṇarūpaṃ vicintayet vṛttākārandhūmravarṇaṃ mahoccadhvajalāñchitam dhyātvetthaṃ dehe bhūtāni vinyaset tatkarṇikāsaṃsthaṃ pradīpakalikānibham sohaṃmantreṇa sādhakaḥ cintayetpāpapūruṣam brahmahatyāśiraskandhaṃ svarṇasteyabhujadvayam tatsaṃsargapadadvandvamaṅgapratyaṅgapātakam krūraṃ ruṣṭaṃ pāpaṃ vicintayet prāṇasaṃrodhaṃ vāyubījena vāyunā dvātriṃśanmātrayā tataḥ candrabījaṃ kundendvayutasuprabham catuṣṣaṣṭimātrayā toyabījakam dehaṃ vicintyaivaṃ manasā piṅgalādhvanā sañjāte sakale dehe devatopāsanakṣame hṛdayāmbhojādānayetparamātmanaḥ

yogyamutpannamiti bhāvayet dadyādabhaktyā pūjanaṃ yathā munayojeśapadmajāḥ vakre tucchandāṃsi hṛdi devatām namaḥ kroṃ kīlāya niyogo'susthitāviti pañcatattvaṃ samuccārya dīrghākāraṃ tathaiva ca tādṛkṭavargaṃ śrotrakādi ca eṃ tuṃ ca vāgādīni tadātmane pūrvoktamoṃ pavargaṃ ca tādṛśam ca antādṛgyavargaṃ mana-ādi ca hastatalānte nyasedevameva hi kroṃ kramato nyasya hṛtpadmāṣṭadaleṣu ca haṃ ṣaṃ yaṃ ca vaṃ ca saṃ śaṃ kṣaṃ iti vargataḥ dhyānaṃ yadatraiva tadbravīmi śṛṇu priye karābjai raktāṃ trinetrāmpraṇamāmi devīm punastaduktvāmama tu vāṅmanaścakṣuruccaret tiṣṭhantu vahnijāyāntamuktvā tāraṃ tato japet prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā mātṛkānyāsamācarat pāpanāśāya yogasiddhiḥ phalaṃ kramāt japasyādau japasyānte kṛto yadi yāvacchaktoniyamyāsuṃ manasaiva manuṃ japet prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ proktaṃ yadanyanmanasā kṛtam sārddhaṃ saptavyāhṛtipūrvikām madhyamūlādyāvadagramaṅguṣṭhena nipīḍyate jānupradakṣiṇī kuryādyāvatkālena hastakaḥ

syājjinamātrastu madhyamaḥ kumbhake siddhe siddhissyādrājayogajā siddhe kriyāyogasya siddhayaḥ kumbhako reco yadā tulyaḥ prajāyate jaghanye tu madhyaṃ madhye parekhilam prāṇāyāmavidhiḥ prokto mayā tubhyaṃ varānane cittajñādevatāyāstu hṛdaye dhāraṇaṃ matam vijñānamatastatprāpakastu saḥ chando mantrārthacchādanāttu vā sādhakeṣṭaṃ dadātīti devatā parikīrtitā namaskuryānmukhyāṅguṣṭhena saṃspṛśet anāmātarjanībhyāṃ sā cākṛṣṭābhyāmiheṣyate yasmāttasmādvaṣaḍiti kriyateṃgulimadhyayā kavacaṃ tarjanyānāmayā'pi tat tasmāttaduktaṃ tatra vauṣaṭ tarjanyādyaistu tatsmṛtam viṣṇvādike rudrādau tu netratrayātmakam tatphaṭ karābhyāṃ prapaṃcyate caikaviṃśatiḥ proktāḥ kāmanābhedatopi ca tadrahasyannirūpyate yannyāsādupacaryādyā dharmāḥ siddhāntisādhake gāyatrī chandaḥ śaktiḥ svarāssmṛtāḥ ca karabhe tathā binduyuktānkrameṇaiva svarānnyāso'yamādimaḥ samācaret svarāṁlḷkārādīṃstathā dakṣatalādapi

munidevādiprāgvatkāyasthitāvayam aṅguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntaṃ dakṣahastasya parva karaṃ dattvā karaśuddhikarastvayam sabindukairaṅgulyādinyāso hṛdādikaḥ krodhādijātapāpanivṛttaye dhyāyetpadmavarṇaṃ śvetaṃ śirasi saṃsthitam kādikān rogo hyapamṛtyurvinaśyati kvacitpāvakasaṅkāśā sūkṣmatejassvarūpiṇī sandhyāyenmātṛkākhyasarasvatīm tāṃ namāmi paṅktyośca mūrdhni vaktre nyasetsvarān padodasta dvatpārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhadeśataḥ caturvarṇāñchādiṣaṭkaṃ tato nyaset varṇamātrāhīnapāṭhaprapūrakaḥ saṃhāranyāsanāmāsau bindunyāsa itīritaḥ antarnyāsātparaṃ bindunyāse syācchukradhāraṇam vāmadakṣiṇamārgeṇa devatādhyānamucyate varṇeśvarīṃ praṇamata stanabhāranamrām patettasmādato binduvisargakau śāktaistṛptiṃ binā sarvaṃ nyāsenāpi vimucyate lokepyavaṃśassyādvihīno brahmatejasā sarpamaṇiṃ te grahītuṃ samudyatāḥ varṇoccāro bhavediti eva mantrādyāḥ ṣaḍaṃgadhyānamucyate

saṃhārasṛṣṭisthitayo nyasyante gṛhasevibhiḥ vānaprasthāśca yatayo sṛṣṭisthitilayāntramāt kalāmātṛkāyā nyāsaṃ tasya ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ mātṛkākhyā niyogobhīṣṭasiddhaye kalāmātṛkāyā nyāse vakṣye śṛṇu priye tāṃ namāmi ṅentakalānāmāḍhyāṃ namasānvitām pratiṣṭhā ca vidyāśāṃtistatharddhikā sūkṣmāmṛtā jñānāmṛtā cāpyāyinī tataḥ tataḥ kāntirdyutirlakṣmīḥ sthirā sthitiḥ cānyā hlādinī prītisaṃyutā samṛtyukā kalāmātṛkeyaṃ sthāne'kārādike nyaset akṣamālāmpustakaṃ ca pāśañcāpikapālakam viṣṇorukārātsañjātāḥ kacavargakalā daśa viṣṇorukārātsañjātāṣṭatavargakalā daśa jātāḥ payavargakalā nava varandheyā dadhatya iti sādhakaiḥ ṭaṅkaṃ varaṃ ca karapallavaiḥ keśavādimātṛkāyāḥ sādhyo nārāyaṇo muniḥ astrāya phaṭ |] śaktiśrīkāmaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret meghacapalāvarṇaṃ lakṣmīhariṃ bhaje namontā uccāryāḥ sthāne'kārādike nyaset kīrtisaṃyuktaḥ kāntirnārāyaṇānvitā dhṛtisaṃyuktaḥ śāntiyuṅmadhusūdanaḥ

yukto hṛṣīkeśaśca harṣayā lakṣmī yuṅma dhusū'nasarasvatī gadī durgā śāṅgīṃ tu prabhayānvitaḥ vāṇīsamāyukto muśalī ca vilāsinī narakajitsamaddhyā śuddhiyugghariḥ bhūdharaḥ kledinīyukto viśvamūrtiśca klinnayā balānujaparāyaṇe prabhāsamāyukto varāho niśayānvitaḥ mātṛkoktā yādiyogaśca pūrvavat syāddakṣiṇāmūrtirgāyatraṃ chanda īritam svarāñchaktīḥ padornyaset ṣaḍdirghasaṃyutaṃ kṛtvā ṣaḍaṅgāni nyasettanau trinetramardhāmbikeśamaniśaṃ vapurāśrayāmaḥ ṅentaphentakatacchaktiṃ namontā mātṛkāsthale krodhantathātmānaṃ ṅentaṃ yādidaśasvapi śālmallī yukto lolākṣī yuk trimūrtikaḥ bhārabhūtirdīrghamukhyā tithīśo gomukhīyutaḥ jhiṇṭīśaścordhvakeśī ca bhautiko vikṛtāsyayā śrīmukhī mahāseno vidyāmukhīyutaḥ sarvasiddhigaurīyuktaḥ prakīrtitaḥ mantraśaktyā kūrmeśaścāṣṭaśaktiyuk proktastvajeśo drāviṇīyutaḥ mañjaryā dārukeśaśca rūpiṇī tathāṣāḍhī pūtanāyukta īritaḥ śaṅkhinīyukto meṣeśastarjanīyutaḥ

kapardinyā dvidaṇḍīśaśca vajrayā recanīyuktaḥ pinākī mādhavīyutaḥ rakṣovidāriṇyā bhaguḥ sahajayā yutaḥ mahāmāyāyukta etāstu mātṛkāḥ rudrāḥ smṛtā raktā dhṛtaśūlakapālakāḥ raktotpalakapālābhyāmalaṃkṛtakarāmbujāḥ bījapūrvamātṛkānyasane surāḥ bhuvaneśī devatātha niyogobhīṣṭasiddhaye prāgvaddhare ṣaḍaṅgaṃ syādaṃguṣṭhādi tathaiva ca jagadīśvarī trinayanā padme niṣaṇṇā sukham mātṛkāṇāṃ nyāso nārpatyasādhane ṛṣirbhṛguśca gāyatrīchando mātṛsvarūpiṇī ṣaḍaṅgādi śeṣaṃ śrībījapūrvakam bhāsvadratnasamujjvalāṃ kucanatāṃ dhyāyejjagatsvāminīm mātṛkānyāsaṃ muniḥ sammohanaḥ smṛtaḥ mahādevī pūrvayuktyā ṣaḍaṅgakam dhyāyetsamastajananīṃ navacaṃndracūḍām mantradoṣā naśyanti bahuvarṇitāḥ nyāsaḥ prāṅmātṛkāsamaḥ sammohanīṃ trinayanāṃ navacandradūḍām gaṇeśamātṛkāyāstu munirgaṇaka īritaḥ dīrghādyayā cāṅgaṃ kṛtvā dhyāyedgajānanam liṅgitaṃ raktaṃ trinetraṃ gaṇapaṃ bhaje vināyakaḥ puṣṭiyutaḥ śāntiyuktaḥ śivottamaḥ yukta ekadantaḥ sumedhayā

mohinīyukkapardī tu naṭīyutaḥ nandayāyuksuyaśāgaṇanāyakau [sureśā iti] trilocanastejovatyā lambodarastu satyayā kāmadāyugāmodo madajihvayā yukta ekapādo ramāyutaḥ yuktaḥṣaṇmukho bhrukuṭīyutaḥ vakratuṇḍo dvirado yāminīyutaḥ śaśiprabhāyukto vimatto lolalocanaḥ yuktaḥ khaḍgī durbhagayā tathā bhaginī gaṇeśo bhoginīyutaḥ kāliketi proktā vighneśamātṛkā prapañcayāganyāsoyaṃ vakṣyate bhuktimuktidaḥ prapañcayāgasya gaṇakaśchanda īritam nyasettāṃśca gaṃbījaṃ cāpi guhyake klīṃ glauṃ gamiti pūrvaṣaḍdīrghayugmakam kṛtvā digbandhamācaret prakurvīta gaṇapasyeṣṭasiddhaye airvahantaṃ bhaje bījaṃ gaṇakosya munirmataḥ yāgasya sāṅgatāsiddhihetave ṣaḍdīrghayuktena kuryādaṅgāni gena tu sindūrābhaṃ candramauliṃ sarpabhūṣaṃ galanmadam gaṇapatirdevatā parikīrtitaḥ sarvārthasiddhidāyeti sarvaduḥkhapraśeti ca gaṃ gāṃ namo vahnigehinī

caturvāraṃ munyādisahitaṃnyaset svarādisaptavargaistu grahānsapta pravinyaset haṃsaśca sohaṃ svāheti vai punaḥ prapañcayāgamantrasya munirbrahmā samīritaḥ samākhyātaṃ devatācinmayātmikam pañcavarṇaiḥ prapañcamanusaṃsthitaiḥ tāramāyādikairetairyuktairhariharākṣaraiḥ pūrṇakṛpāmburāśi vadanhṛdi kṣakārāntānakārāntānpunarhunet prapañcayāgākhyamātṛkānyāsa īritaḥ ca tataḥ sveṣṭamantrasya saṃcaret mārgeṇa nyāsānnityaṃ karoti yaḥ nyāsakavacacchanno mantrajāpaparapriyaḥ akṛtvā nyāsajālaṃ yo mūḍhātmā kurute japam nyāsānāṃ pracaratvena phalānāmapi bhūritā hasauṃ bījena saṃnyaset dvividhaṃ proktaṃ saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ tathā somasūryāgnimaṇḍale na virājite taddhisaguṇaṃ dhyānamīritam dhyānamiti vedavido viduḥ tālugatāṃ caret kṛtvetthaṃ tu yajetpīṭhe nyāsamārgeṇa mantravit yajeccandanādyairmānasairbhojanāntakaiḥ smaretkuṇḍaṃ kuṇḍalyagnisamujjvalam

tryasre mūlamantrapuraḥsaram ahantā'satyapaiśunyakāmakroddhādikaṃ haviḥ bhūtvā japedaṣṭotaraṃ śatam guruṃ pūjācakraṃ samuddharet yantraṃ sarvaiśvaryapradaṃ matam māṇikyaracitaṃ cedaṃ rājyadaṃ bhuktimuktidam yantraṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ matam śrīparṇīpīṭhamuddiṣṭaṃ pūjārthaṃ dhanarājyadam gaṇḍakībhavapāṣāṇe bhuktimuktiradūrataḥ yantraṃ sampattiṃ santatiṃ haret mohena nāśayettasya tatkulam kartavyamarcāpīṭhaṃ manoharam nirmāṇaṃ pūjācakrasya kārayet śrīparṇīcandanādīnāmadhikaṃ cenna doṣakṛt kārayedeṣāṃ sati tithyādikekṣaṇe abhiṣicyātha toyena kvathitena varauṣadhaiḥ gandhapuṣpairnavairdhūpairdīpairnaivedyadarpaṇau pañcabhiryuktāścareyurvāminorcanam dinatrayaṃ kṛtvā tato nityakramaṃ bhajet strīśūdrāṇāṃ vāmināṃ ca kaulikānāmayaṃ vidhiḥ pāpaviśeṣaṇam ||] raghubhiḥ sandhyāvandananāśitaiḥ vāminopāsitaṃ yantraṃ teṣāṃ dṛṣṭipathaṃ gatam dakṣiṇopāsitaṃ yantraṃ sūryāgnisamatejasam nṛbhirdinakarodayaḥ sarvairiheṣyate sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ tulyaduḥkhasukhāvubhau

purandhrīṇāṃ vāmāṃge dakṣiṇāṃgake jātivicyutā ye dvijādayaḥ vāmena siddhyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ vedoditairmanttraiviprognyuttāraṇaṃ caret codayatsamatsvagnirvṛtrāṇi dayate purūṇi agnirdivi havyamātatānāgnerdhāmāni bibhṛtāpurutrā agne prāvajaritāraṃ thaviṣṭhāgne mahi draviṇamāyajasva uktaṃ devatāgniḥ prakīrtitaḥ abhiṣiñcedgandhatoyaistataḥ sampūrṇasūktakaiḥ kṣālayeddhātujaṃ yantraṃ mṛdā cādbhistu nityaśaḥ prakṣālitaṃ yantraṃ maṇḍayeccandanādinā mūlamantreṇātha teṣāṃ svasya devāṃgataścaret tadbahiścaturasraṃ ca vidadhyānmatsyamudrayā caturagnyādikoṇeṣu puratastasthā śaṅkhādi cādhāraṃ maṇḍale sthāpayettvatha vahnermaṇḍalaṃ ca devanāma ca kīrtayet prakṣālyāmukadevārghyapātraṃ saṃsthapayāmyaham ca namo manunānena pūjayet cāṅgāni pūjayetpūrvavattataḥ sudhāmayaistoyairmūlāṃte mātṛkāṃ japet somamaṇḍalāyeti ṣoḍaśeti kalātmane gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatayavakuśāgratilasarṣapāḥ tattoyaṃ gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ pūjayitvā samarcayet prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kurvīta pūjānte sādhakastataḥ mūlamantreṇa puṣpaṃ nyasya śarāṇunā

amṛtīkṛtya vidhivatsvadhābījena sādhakaḥ cāstreṇa kalpayecca diśo daśa avaṣṭabhya tato dīpya mudrayā yonirūpayā sampūjya mantrayenmūlamantrataḥ tacchaṅkhasthaṃ jalaṃ kiñcitkumbhatoye vinikṣipet saṃsthāpya trikoṇeṣu yathākramam sakṣaudro dadhi tatra na labhyate tatpadaṃ devi madhusañjñaṃ yaducyate raupyasya śaivaḥ śaṅkhavaro harau prokṣaṇīpātramādhāyādbhiḥ prapūrayet punarācamanīyārthaṃ pātraṃ saṃsthāpayettataḥ jātīlavaṅgakaṅkolairmatamācamanīyakam || pātayetprokṣaṇīpātre lalitaṃ praṇavena ca pradātavyāḥ kṣālitāstaṇḍulāḥ śubhāḥ sarvakāmapradaṃ svārṇaṃ raupyamāyuḥsutapradam devatuṣṭirbhavetpātre tathaiva ca || māraṇoccāṭane lauhaṃ stambhe pāṣāṇajaṃ bhavet ratnādīnāṃ tu pātrāṇi śubhalekhāṅkitāni ca kāryaḥ pātrāṇyevottamāni ca ṣaṭtriṃśadaṃgulaṃ pātramuttamaṃ parikīrtitam kārayetkvacit ca || śaṅkhanīlotpalābhāni pātrāṇi parikalpayet secayetprokṣaṇīpātratoyairmūlaṃ samuccaret dravyaśuddhiriyaṃ matā bhāvanayā tataḥ pūjyā svadevatā

puṣpasyāñjalayo deyā mastake hṛdaye gude caturbhirupacāraiśca naivedyaṃ vinivedayet prayuñjīta sarvametatsamāhitaḥ catuṣkoṇamagnikuṇḍaṃ vicintayet dharmādharmahavirdīpta ātmāgnau manasā tu vai svāheti ślokānte proccaretpunaḥ saṅkalpo vikalpo dharma eva ca prakāśāmarśahastābhyāmavalambyonmanīṣu ca dattvā prāṇāyāmanirodhataḥ prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā ṛṣyādinyāsamācaret gurupaṅktirudakpūjyā mahāgaṇapatistvavāk tasyordhvaṃ rudraḥ kālānalastathā daṃṣṭrāgre pṛthivīmarcayetpunaḥ ca tanmadhye tadūrdhvaṃ nandanaṃ vanam svarṇaprākāramasyānte tanmadhye ratnamaṇḍapam bhāvanīyaṃ pūjayeccandanādinā yajetsamyagāgneyādiśivāntakam vairāgyaṃ bhūtavatpītamaiśvaryaṃ kṛṣṇahastivat ca tanmadhye'nantaṃ tattvākṛtiṃ yajet saṃvinnālaṃ vikārakeśaram cāṇimādyaṃ tannāmāni bravīmyaham prākāmyamīśitvaṃ vaśitvaṃ cāṣṭasiddhayaḥ guṇānsattvādikāṃstatra tadvadagre trayaṃ yajet māyā kalā vidyā parapūrvaṃ ca tattvakam tattanmatroktapīṭhasya nava śaktīḥ prapūjayet

caturthīnamasā yuktaiḥ svasvadaivatanāmabhiḥ mūlamantraṃ samuccārya ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ pīṭhanāma ca samuccārya devanāma tataḥ param ekapīṭhenyapūjāṃ ca vinā yantraṃ karoti yaḥ pūjayedyantraṃ devatāśāpamāpnuyāt devatā śāpakāriṇī pṛthakcandanapuṣpāṇi dhūpadīpādi mantrataḥ vyaṅgenarhapaśuspṛṣṭe patite duṣṭabhūmiṣu sannidhānaṃ divaukasaḥ daśasthānāni devānāṃ pūjane kalpitānit ca jīvavatproktaḥ pratimādyaṃ śarīravat maṇau yantre śālagrāme ghaṭe ravau caiva kṛtā pūjā putrāyurdhananāśinī prathamā diṣṇorgṛheṣu gṛhamedhibhiḥ bhuktimuktidhanārogyapradaṃ tu tat liṅgaśālakyā jalāhāryāstathaiva ca śālagrāmasamutpattiṃ śṛṇvantu paramādbhutām sukhaṃ dātuṃ janānāmiti te surāḥ tadā śaptāstayā krudhā prapadyadhvaṃ kruddhāstepyaśapaṃśca tām tvaṃ vai kṛṣṇā nadī bhava prakampitāḥ surā yātā brahmāṇaṃ te vyajijñapan śrūtvā brahmā śaṅkaramabravīt sṛṣṭikartā viṣṇustu pālako buddhimattaraḥ māheśvaraṃ śrutvā vacanaṃ viṣṇurabravīt

grāhamātaṅgau śāpato yadā bhaviṣyati yadā tanmedomajjasambhavāḥ gaṇḍakī puṇyā gaṅgātulyā mahānadī tanmanukṣetrampuṇyaṃ kṣetraṃ mahītale śālagrāmaśilā yatra yatra dvāravatī śilā sarvadevaprītikarā bhuktimuktipradāyinī pārthivāṃśaṃ vinā sarve vajrakīṭā bhavantviti mūrteśca na vṛkṣasyāpi pūjanāt viṣṇuvacaḥ śrutvā brahmā vacanamabravīt kodhikāri ca kena mārgeṇa tadvada pūjyā brāhmaṇādyaiḥ sukhāptaye pāpaśamanī malinā pāpadhīkarā lakṣmīṃ dhūmābhā harate matim dāridryakāriṇīvakrā samā sarvārthasādhikā pūjāphalaṃ lāñchitayā niṣphalaṃ lāñchanaṃ vinā dadyādbahucakrā pradhānatām vikṛtāvartanābhiśca vittānnaṃ kurute bahu duḥkhadātrī yathā sūkṣmā tathāmṛtam lakṣmīhariḥ sa vijñeyo yatra padmaṃ sacakrakam vijñeyo yaddvāre cakrayugmakam sa vijñeyaḥ prākpaścāccakrayugmakam sūkṣmacakraṃ syācchidraṃ dīrghaṃ vicintayet nīlābho vartulaścātiśobhanaḥ sa tu vijñeya ekaṃ vā dvayameva ca nārāyaṇaḥ śyāmavarṇo nābhau cakraṃ tathonnatam

sā syādyasyā ūrdhvaṃ mukhaṃ bhavet vijñeyaḥ padmacakrānvitastu yaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ syātsthūlacakre śubhānane kapilaḥ pṛthagvaktro bṛhanmukhaḥ narasiṃhastu guḍalākṣānibho bhavet vijñeyaḥ pūrvoktairlakṣaṇairyutaḥ lakṣmīnṛsiṃho vijñeyaścatuścakrassabindukaḥ śaktiliṅgacakre ca viṣame tathā varāhanāmnī sā yā varāhākṛtiḥ śilā sā śilā jñeyā bindutrayavibhūṣitā kūrmākhyā tu śilā pṛṣṭhe vartulā connatā bhavet vijñeyā kūrmākārā tu yā bhavet hayagrīvoṃkuśākārā rekhā cakrasamīpagā hayagrīvo hayagrīvasamā śilā dīrghayā rekhayā yuktā rekhā vā tādṛśī bhavet bhavedvāpi sākṣamālaṃ śirastathā tathā rekhā pūjakāya suśobhanaḥ rekhāpañcakabhūṣitaḥ bindunopari śobhitaḥ hrasvaśca subhikṣakṣemadāyakaḥ tathācakraṃ rekhaikaiva tu dakṣiṇe paṃktiḥ sa naṣṭadravyadāyakaḥ dvārasaṅkīrṇapītarekho dhanapradaḥ nātidīrghamukhaṃ madhye lambarekhaḥ sa bhogadaḥ bhavecca vivaraṃ pūjitassukhadassadā

sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ dṛśyante puruṣārthaphalapradaḥ brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ nāśako yogasiddhidaḥ pūjayitvā taṃ daridropīśvaro bhavet athavā jāyate nānāsvarṇarekhābhiranvitaḥ dṛśyate rekhā sa sarpaviṣanāśakaḥ cakrāṇi catvāri pitṛtṛptikṛt sūkṣmadvāraścatuścakro bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥ tamabhyarcyāmuyātsvargaṃ viṣayāṃśca samīhitān same cakre gṛhasthābhīṣṭadāyakaḥ cakrayugmamekarekhā tu dakṣiṇe pradakṣiṇāvartakṛto vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ pārśvagā rekhā vedaśāstrāgamapradaḥ pūjānte pratiṣṭhāṃ nātra kārayet naiva pujyante sarvakāmaphalārthibhiḥ dharmavṛddhiḥ pāpanāśo bhavediha svayantuliṅgākṛtimānmantrasiddhividhāyakaḥ tathā rekhā gatāyuṣṭvapradāyakaḥ pradṛśyante socito jñānadāyakaḥ bilvapramāṇastejasvī pūjitaḥ strīvaśaṅkaraḥ hyantare'dhaśca gopadam tadūrdhvañca śvetā rekhā triśūlabhāk tasya sevanādroganāśanam cakramadhye bhavedrekhā mārayedripusantatim pūjanato devī bhavānī suprasīdati

ghaṇṭāṅkito mūrddhā snigdhā sevyākhilaistadā dvicchidrādyāssarvaśilāstrikoṇenāṅkitāstu yāḥ yā dakṣamārgeṇa tāṃ yajet śilā tāṃ vāmatorcayet śilā durlabhaiva prāyaḥ kaliyuge surāḥ sūryasyordhvasthitaṃ vahniṃ sābhiṣiktā pravarṣaṇam ityādilakṣaṇairyuktā śilā sūryasya sammatā śuṇḍākārā śilā vāpi gajānanasamāpi vā tasya dikpasya sevyā taddiśi rājyadā tryasrayuktā bhaumaśilā matā caturasreṇa yuktā guruśilā matā rāhoḥ syātketostu dhvajarūpiṇī bhakṣyābhakṣyavicārādirahite mlecchasaṃkule gururmantraḥ kva japaḥ kva ca siddhayaḥ tadardhañjāhnavītoyaṃ tadardhandevatāśilā sūryārghyadānasamaye dānaṃ vibhavataḥ param ādāvāvāhanaṃ kāryaṃ trirjapenmūlamantrakam evaṃ bhāvayitvā suṣumṇāvartmanā sudhīḥ sthāpya taddadyāddevamūrddhani saṃsthāpanaṃ kuryādiha tiṣṭheti tiṣṭha ca vibhāvayet bhaktisulabha sarvāvaraṇasaṃyuta samprārthya deveśaṃ sannidhāpanamācaret sannidhehīti dviruktvā svasya sannidhau kuryānmūlamuccaryasannidhim

bhaktibhāvanirodhitām sammukhī kuryānmūlamuccārya deśikaḥ dhyāyetsvasammukhaṃ devaṃ suprasannānanāmbujam devāvaguṇṭhanaṃ kāryaṃ mūlamuccārya mantravit darśayeccintayediti sakalīkaraṇaṃ caiva devasya hṛdayādiṣu sakalīkṛto bhava vadettataḥ yasmādbhinnasvabhāvānāṃ yadabhinnaṃ prayojanam vakṣye pīṭhe saṃsthāpya devatām cāmṛtaścaiti dhyāyannarghyodakena ca akārādikṣakārāntamātṛkābhistridhā punaḥ kledini kledaya mahākṣobhamityāpa punaḥ prāsādaḥ saptatriṃśadakṣaraḥ hṛdayaṃ spṛśan ca sarvaṃ prāgvattadeva hi pūrayantyaddhā dehadvāreṇa cātmanaḥ grahādibhyaḥpāpaughaṃ drāvayanti ca sampūjayeddevaṃ śaktyālabhyopacārakaiḥ svāgataṃ cārghyaṃ pādyamācamanīyakam dhūpaṃ ca dīpanaivedyavandanam syātsā gṛhasthairvidhīyate gandhādayo nivedyāntāḥ upacārā daśa smṛtāḥ agṛhasthairgṛhasthairvā kartavyā kāryatatparaiḥ tāntrikairmantrairvāmī śūdraśca tantrataḥ pañcadaśākṣaraḥ

vahnijāyāyāḥ sthāne śūdro namaḥ paṭhet vāstraṃ cārmaṃ kauśaṃ ca taijasam nānāvarṇasugandhaṃ ca komalaṃ sarvakāmadam kevalairāsanaṃ hanti sādhakasya manorathān samākhyātaṃ śrīparṇasyepsitapradam sambhūtaṃ varjayecca bibhītakam caturvidhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pūrvaṃpūrvamudāhṛtam turagāṇāṃ ca kṛṣṇasārasya carmaṇaḥ śṛgālasya vṛkasyāpi goḥ śaśasya kapestathā kauśaṃ daśavidhaṃ smṛtam saisaṃ ca paittalam tu mūlānte svāgataṃ parikīrtayet tathārcāyāṃ snātumāsanagāya ca arghyadravyayutaistoyairupacāramanuṃ paṭhan syātpādyaṃ syātpādadhāvanam śuddhatoyaiḥ ṣoḍhā prakīrtitaḥ dadhisaṃyuktamupacāramanuṃ paṭhan punarācamanīyārthaṃ toyaṃ devamukhe'rpayet [abhyaṃgaḥ |] vidhāyātha snāpayeduṣṇavāriṇā bahubhistathā gandhodakena ca śuddhodakaiśca mūlena yathāśaktyabhiṣecayet [daśasahasrāṇi |] śaktyāvāthābhiṣecayet prītidaḥ śaṅkho na sūryasya kadācana śaṃkhodaistataḥ śuddhodakena ca mukhyaṃ pītaṃ kauśeyamambaram

malahīnaṃ ca sadyadananyadhāritam saṃkaraḥ] bhavet dagdhādvipadbhaveddāsyaṃ datte gātrāvalambite putranāśaḥ pūjanādau prayojite strīpumprabhedataścāpi vijñeyāni vicakṣaṇaiḥ gandhaḥ pañcavidho jñeyo modadaḥ svargavāsinām gandhāhvayāni syuścūrṇādyaḥ prathamaḥ smṛtaḥ kṛṣṇāguruḥ kadambaśca dvitīyoyaṃ prakīrtitaḥ pippalīyantrataḥ kācakupyāṃ siddhastṛtīyakaḥ kākaṃ turagābhidhānam [aśvakarṇaḥ |] dṛṣṭidoṣāpahārī caturthastu sammarda iti kīrtyate tadardhailājaṭāmāṃsī tvakkuṣṭhaṃ ca śilārasaḥ |] rājavacā tathā kṛṣṇāguruśca kālīyaṃ tadbhāgāṣṭakamucyate devatārājatoṣakṛt sugandhastu devadānavatāṣekṛt madhyamaṃ hīnanteṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam puṣpaṃ tāmrajaṃ ca prakīrtitam jātī vā mālatī prasiddhaiva |] mālatī koṣṇakaṃ [taptam |] kṛmibhakṣitam |] tathā || ugragandhamagandhaṃ ca madhyāhnasnānatastathā samākhyātaṃ yathotpannaṃ tathārpaṇam neṣṭaṃ puṣpāñjalividhau na tat mālākāragṛheṣu [mālākārāgāre |] ca

|| na dūrvayā yajeddurgāṃ bilvapatrairdivākaram nārkapuṣpairyajeddevīmādityaṃ tagareṇa ca pravālairvā tadabhāve ca korakaiḥ [mukulam |] | 13- dhātrī | 14- rasālaḥ |] kuryādāvaraṇārcanam gandhapuṣpādyairdevasyāṃgaṃ samarcayet ādāvāvaraṇaṃ pūjyaṃ tadante devatāṃ yajet keśareṣvagnikoṇādau hṛdayādīni pūjayet tuṣārasphaṭikaśyāmanīlakṛṣṇāruṇārciṣaḥ agnīśāsuravāyavyamadhyadikṣukramātsthitāḥ tadādiparivārāṇāṃ prādakṣiṇyena pūjanam devasyābhimukhaṃ tāssamāsthitāḥ teṣāṃ dhyānamathocyate dvibhujaṃ pīṭhavajradharaṃ bhaje meṣavāhaṃ devaraṃ kāntalocanam kāladaṇḍakaraṃ krūraṃ vṛtaṃ dūtairbhayānakaiḥ khaḍgahastañca piṅgalaśmaśrukūrcakam tundilaṃ vande varuṇaṃ yādasāṃ patim vānaprasthasamārūḍhaṃ dhāvantaṃ vegato bhaje nārasiṃhāsanārūḍhaṃ pānapātrayutaṃ bhaje bhālacandraṃ ca jaṭājūṭadharaṃ sitam pīnottuṅgaṃ cakradharamanantaṃ viśvalaṃ bhaje haṃsārūḍhaṃ vedapāṭhaṃ kurvantaṃ tamahaṃ bhaje nāmadevyāścaturthyantamudīrayet tatostreṇa lakṣayetpūjayettataḥ

[manaḥśilā] bhāskarasya priyaṃ matam nakhaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ sarjarasamekaikāṃśaṃ prakalpayet lākṣā tribhāgā catvāro bhāgāḥ śailajamustayoḥ sihlasiddhārthaiḥ śeṣadevadaśāṅgakaḥ vitaredbhūmau nāsane na paṭe tathā neṣṭo viṣṇave dārusambhavaḥ vibhavairnānāvādyapurassaram ghaṇṭāyāssarvasiddhidaḥ prakurvīta viśeṣāddhūpadīpayoḥ pūjāṃ kārayetsiddhilālasaḥ pradarśayeddīpaṃ na ca medādinā kvacit miśrīkṛtasnehāttāmisraṃ narakaṃ vrajet paṭhet jyotirdīpoyaṃ pratigṛhyatām sitāvartirdakṣiṇato vāmato raktavartikā śataṃ samāḥ pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca dattvā naivedyamarpayet saṃsthāpya caturasaṃ ca saṃskuryācchāstramārgataḥ [yamiti mantreṇa] śoṣayet spṛśet |] pradarśyātha gandhapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet hemapātrasthitaṃ divyaṃ paramānnaṃ susaṃskṛtam samuccārya svāhāntaṃ jalamarpayet dakṣiṇe haste jalaṃ dattvā paṭhedidam |] || darśayeddakṣahastena vikacotpalasannibhām

kaniṣṭhānāmikāṃguṣṭhayogaḥ prāṇasya mudrikā svāhāntamatha ca vyānāya ca tato vadet kaniṣṭhāṃ sarvābhirudānāyāgnigehinī svarṇādije pātre sutoyaṃ dhenumudrayā suśītalam jalapātraṃ niveśayet ghṛtapakvaṃ dugdhasiddhaṃ sādhitaṃ kevalāgninā puṣpāñjaliṃ dadyādastramantreṇa bandhanam 115) amṛtātmakanaivedyaṃ nama ityuccaretpunaḥ aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā mūlamantraṃ dadejjalam pūrvavatsaṃskṛte vahnau devamāvāhya mantravit haviṣā tilairvā pāyasaiḥ śubhaiḥ aṅgāvaraṇadevānāmekaikāmāhutiṃ hunet upaviśyāsane mantrairdadyādbhūtabaliṃ tataḥ sampūjya tatastebhyo baliṃ haret yoginyopyagnirūpāśca gaṇānāmadhipāścaye prītamanaso bhūtā gṛhṇantvimaṃ balim smādāya bhūtāni prārthayediti nārācamudrayā visṛjettataḥ rakṣodigbhāge pātraṃ tatsthāpayettataḥ gṛhītvā tu nirmālyabhojine namaḥ punarāmacamanaṃ dadyātkarodvartaname vaca tāmbūlaṃ viṣṇave dvādaśāṅgakam jāvitrīkastūrikeśarairyutam mṛganābhitamālābhyāṃ hīnaṃ vidheśvarasya tu

jātikośayutaṃ tacca maheśituḥ tathādarśaṃ kalpayecchatracāmare kuryāddharmakāmārthasiddhaye likhetpadmamaṣṭapatraṃ suśobhanam valayāñcitaśobhābhiḥ śobhitānghṛtapūritān prāgvattataḥ śrīṃ hrīmiti kramāt tatastatpātramuddhṛtya mastakāntaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ca tataḥ prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ caret aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu nava dve triśataṃ tu vā gṛhītvedaṃ paṭhetpunaḥ me deva tvatprasādājjagatpate gītastutibhirghaṇṭāvādanapūrvakam paurāṇikādyairvaiśyastu śūdrastu prākṛtādibhiḥ nityaṃ tarpaṇasevanam naraka yāti pitṛbhissaha pāpakṛt duḥkhitāvasminbhavenyatra ca nārakau śṛṇuyādvedaṃ sa nirvaṃśastu nirdhanaḥ prājāpatyatrayaṃ kṛtvā tau saṃśuddhau bhaviṣyataḥ gṛhāṇārādhanaṃ varam deveśaṃ ślokairebhiḥ samarpayet ca naivedyaṃ tadgṛhāṇānukampayā jānāmi tvaṃ gatiḥ parameśvara bhūtānāṃ draṣṭā tvaṃ parameśvara bhaktiravyayāstu sadā tvayi yo devaḥ sohameva hi

bhūssvāhā |] manunā kuryādbrahmārpaṇaṃ tataḥ vācā karmaṇābhyantarā tataḥ kṛtaṃ tacca sarvaṃ brahmārpaṇaṃ bhavet udvāsayettato devaṃ parivāragaṇaissaha vilīnaṃ tu raśmivṛndamaśeṣataḥ kṣamayāropayetsvīye hṛdambhoje tu devatām brahmādayo devā na viduḥ paramaṃ padam mantreṇānena dhyātvā tāṃ sthāpayeddhṛdi brahmādayaḥ sarve surāstiṣṭhanti me hṛdi maṇḍalaṃ kuryāddvāri padmavivarjitm pañcaiva īśānādyaṃ samarcayet prokta īśvarī ca maheśituḥ lehyacoṣyānnapānādi nirmālyaṃ pravilepanam naivedyaśeṣaṃ tu dattvā natvā visarjayet bhāskarāyārcāmacchidrārthaṃ nivedayet savitre karmadāyine bhāskarasya prasādataḥ mantrayedaṣṭadhā punaḥ mastake dhāryaṃ mūlamantreṇa mantriṇā tadbhaktebhyaḥ svayaṃ bhuktvā tanmayo hi vasetsukham na doṣaḥ pañcasaṅgame śaivā hyaśaivā vā mucyante pāparāśitaḥ tatsambandhiprasādādi gṛhṇannirayamāpnuyāt tarpaṇaṃ ca vaidikaṃ tāntrikaṃ tathā mātṛkānyāsaṃ tathā chandarṣidaivatam

mantrasnānaṃ devatāyāḥ pūjāṃ pañcopacārikām japeccāṣṭottaraṃ śatam samprārthayeddevaṃ sāyaṃ sandhyāṃ samācaret athāparāhnikaṃ vakṣye tatsthānadaśake bhavet sthāne sarpavyāghrādije bhaye tatra snānādikaṃ cintyaṃ kṛtvā mānasapūjanam pṛthivīmadhye pūjā devasya cācaret kartavyā sarvāśāpratipattaye vakṣye nityaṃ svāsthyādhikasya tat kartavyā sthaṇḍile pratimāsu ca ravimaṇḍalamālokya pratimāmathavā punaḥ svakartavyaṃ samāpayet gurūnviprāṃstadagre ca vākyametadudīrayet samprārthya punaḥ pūrvavadācaret dhyānena homena dānatopi vā tāntrikapūjādi manasaiva samācaret vāmācāre na sūtakam devatattvaṃ no vetti sa tu guhyakaḥ kṣuttṛḍbhyāmarditaḥ pretastasmāddharmaṃ vicārayet sampūjayeddevaṃ bhāvanākusumādibhiḥ jaḍānāmāhnikaṃ vakṣye tathā saṃkṣepakarmaṇi mūlamūrtiṣaḍaṅgāni teṣāṃ pūjābhidhīyate nirmalenodakenaiva pūjayetsthiramānasaḥ adhikārinimittābhyāṃ bhidyate śatadhā punaḥ yathālabdhairviniṣpādyā dravyaiḥ pūjā tu madhyamā

vihitākhilavedoktairbrahmarṣibhirakalmaṣaiḥ rājarṣibhistaponiṣṭhairbhagavattattvavedibhiḥ strībālavṛddhamukhyādyairbhaktairakṣuṇṇamānasaiḥ no śaktāstantrāṇi tu yuge yuge preritā viprāstattantrapathagāminaḥ bhaviṣyanti kṣīṇapuṇyāśca raurave gopaṃ paṭalairviṣṇugopanam kṛtaṃ tantraṃ tasya tatra pradhānatā samākhyāto yuṣmatpraśnavinirṇayaḥ karma kāryaṃ niḥśreyasāya vai āhnikaprakāśaḥ pañcamaḥ vaidikādyāssarva mantrā na siddhyanti ca yaṃ vinā sāraḥ sa tu gopitaḥ purā yacca caryate tatprakīrtitam sa syāttatprakāraṃ bravīmyaham pañcāṅgakasvarūpaṃ tadāhuḥ kecana tatra tu mantrāstiṣṭhanti vedeṣu tathā tantre ca śābare aghamarṣeṇa sūryārgheṇa japena praṇāmakaiḥ hutiryāgastathā cārcā karmataścakrapūjanāt bhavatyekādaśāṅgakaḥ sarvapāpakṣayaṃ kuryādatha vā siddhibandhakṛt proktena mārgeṇa tasya siddhiradūrataḥ kaulikānāṃ vāmināṃ nādhikāritā ṛkśākhādhyāyibhiḥ kāryo gaṇako yotha tadvidhiḥ saṅkalpya pūjayitvā gaṇeśvaram

dvirādyoṃnayate tataḥ ityathātra ṛco vakṣye mābhūcchākhāviparyayaḥ dakṣiṇāvāḍrājiniprācotihavirbharantyagnaye ghṛtācī puruṣāya na mameti santyajet tadidānīṃ nigadyate viśvato vṛtvātyatiṣṭhaddaśāṃgulam utāmṛtatvasyeśāno yadannenātirohati bhūtāni tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi viṣvaṅvyakrāmatsāśanānaśane abhi paścāddhūmimatho puraḥ grīṣma idhmaḥ śaraddhaviḥ yadyajñaṃ tanvānā abadhnanpuruṣaṃ paśum ayajanta sādhyā ṛṣayaśca ye paśūṃstāṃścakre vāyavyānāraṇyāngrāmyāṃśca ye tasmādyajustasmādajāyata tasmāttasmājjātā ajāvayaḥ kau bāhū kā ūrū pādā ucyete yadvaiśyaḥ padbhyāṃ śūdro ajāyata mukhādindraścāgniśca prāṇādvāyurajāyata bhūmirdiśaḥ śrotrāttathā lokānakalpayan marudbhyastu dvādaśaikādaśe bhavet havyavāhāgnaye ca tithi saṅkhyake vaiśvānarāyāgnaye ca tathaivāṣṭādaśepi ca ceti ṛcastāḥ śṛṇu sāmpratam muñcatvaṁhasaḥ

|| staumyagniṃ nāthito johavīmi sa no muñcatvaṁhaṃsaḥ muñcatvaṁhaṃsaḥ tyārājānaṁ sarathe pāthaṃ ugratau no muñcatamāga saḥ muñcatamāgasaḥ || yau viśvasya paribhūbabhūvatustauno muñcatamāgasaḥ savitāraṃ nāthito johavīmi tau no muñcatamāgasaḥ || yayorvāndevau deveṣvaniśitamojastau no muñcatamāgasaḥ viśvāndevānnāthito johavīmi tau no muñcatamāgasaḥ || āsūnhave suyamānūtaye te no muñcantvenasaḥ staumi devānmaruto nāthito johavīmi te no muñcaṃtvenasaḥ || āsūnhave surāmānūtaye te no muñcaṃtvenasaḥ viśvāndevānnāthito johavīmi te no muñcaṃtvenasaḥ bhavatāṃ dāśuṣe mayaḥ hinu praṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣaḥ suṣṭutetīrupa divā sariṣaḥ pātu naktam muñcatamaṃhasaḥ kṛdhāsvasmānaditeranāgāvyenāṁsi śiśratho viṣvagagne evoṣvasmanmuñcatāmaṃhaḥ pratāryagne prataraṃ na āyuḥ nānyathā yāvāmitrāvaruṇā yatavyā tanūstaye mamāṁhaso muñcatam yāvāmindrāvaruṇā sahasyā tanūstaye mamāṁhaso muñcatam yāvāmindrāvaruṇā tejasyā tanūstaye mamāṁhasomuñcatam indrāvaruṇābhyāmiti tyāgaḥ sarvatra nānyathā yo vāmindrāvaruṇāvagnau snāmastaṃ vāmetenāvayaje

yo vāmindrāvaruṇauṣadhīṣu snāmastaṃ vāmetenāvayaje triṣaṣṭivākyaistatrādyā ṛktrivākyātra śāktakaiḥ pāvamānībhyo mama tyāgo vācyastvaśāktakaiḥ pāvamānyai atho śaivaiḥ pāvamānāya nānyathā mā tathā yuñjyānna mama tyāga īritaḥ bhūtāni jātavedaḥ punīhi mām tyāgaḥ sopi prakāśyate devadīvyadagne kratvākratūṁranu tyāgaḥ savitre ca ubhe yathā naḥ viśvataḥ vaiśvadevyai iti vadenna mameti ca sā yathā rayīṇām ceti saptamyāṃ tyāga iṣyate mama tyāgoṣṭamyāṃ ca sāyathā punīhi mā pāvamānībhyo daśamyādiṣu tā yathā idaṃ brahma punīhi mā sapūtamaśnāti svaditaṃ mātariśvanā duhe kṣīraṃ sarpirmadhūdakam samhṛto raso brāhmaṇeṣvamṛtagūṃhitam devairdevīḥ samāhitāḥ sambhṛto raso brāhmaṇeṣvamṛtaṃ hitam pāvamānyaḥ punantu mām

prājāpatyāya pavitrāya ceti ṣoḍaśīṃ śṛṇu vayaṃ pūtaṃ brahma punīmahe varuṇāya tato vadet ūrjayantyā sahitāya jātavedasa ityapi kṛtametābhistaiḥ snātaṃ jāhnavajile punātu māmutaḥ sarasvatyai na mama vākyamuccaret ||] pāhyenaso yatkiñcānṛtamūdima tyāgastadvatkṛto yathā cakṛma karotu māmanenasam gārhapatyāya navame cāgnaye vadet karotu mānanehasam pitarau mayā tattadagne anṛṇo bhavāmi tvagnayethāgregnaye gārhapatyāya ca yāni cakṛma karotu māma nenasam yāni cakṛma karotu māma nenasam yāni cakṛma karotu māmanenasam āpastā naḥ śudhantu śundhanīḥ hiraṇyavarṇāstata utpunīta naḥ aheḍamāno varuṇohabodhyuruśaṁsamā na āyuḥ pramoṣīḥ avayakṣva no varuṇaṁ rarāṇo vīhimṛḍīkaṁsuhavo na edhi vaiśvānarāyāṣṭarcāntyāgoyamīritaḥ dhehi bheṣajam dharmamīmahe

divāsaripaḥ pātu naktam devānabhiśasteramuco vaiśvānara jātavedo mahitvā tavotibhiḥ sūryāya kalaśamādāya nair-ṛtyāntu catuṣpathe saha vīkṣetacchāyāṃ tasmiñcchubhāśubhām oṣadhayaḥ santviti kṣipet vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ |] santu pṛṣṭhataḥ kalaśaṃ kṣipet upaspṛśya svagṛhaṃ praviśettataḥ paśyettoyamadhye chāyāmacchāntadā bhavet āśīrvacogṛhyādbrāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥ samaśnīyāddhaviṣyaṃ brahmacaryabhāk tasya nāśārthaṃ kūṣmāṇḍībhistu homayet mārge dāridryādibhirardditaḥ lokadvayapratiṣṭhārthaṃ sopi guptaṃ samācaret varṣaṃ vratametatsamācaret dānaṃ gṛhītvāyutamekakam karagrahe || devaviprādhikāre cāpadante lakṣamācaret ājyabhāgānantaraṃ ca kūṣmāṇḍībhistu homayet viralaiḥ saṃyuktā jvariṇe hitā] ghṛtaṃ vāpi samāśrayet goghṛtenaiva tadabhāve tu māhiṣam sarvatra yojanā ||] ṛgbhinnā sā ca kathyate ādityāstasmānmāmuñcatartasyartena māmutaḥ viśvedevāḥ sajoṣasaḥ

pāhyenaso yatkiñcānṛtamūdima caturthī yā adhunā sā ṛgucyate muñcantvenaso yatkiñcānṛtamūdima pūrvamudīritā tyāgastathāṣṭamyātha socyate na ākṣi etattadagne anṛṇo bhavāmi jīvanneva prati tatte dadhāmi mātaraṃ prākproktā daśamāhutiḥ yadāśasāniśasāprākproktātra dvādaśāhutiḥ pūrvoktāṣoḍaśī bhavet varuṇetyādi pañcarcaḥ pūrvamīritāḥ dvāviṃśe tyāgaḥ sā ṛgathocyate tena ṛṇānṛṇava itsamāno yamasya loke adhirajjurāya dvayoriha tyāgo varuṇāya na vai mama nasmabhyamasurapraceto rājannetāṁ siśiśrathaḥkṛtāni athāvayamādityavrate tavānāgaso aditaye syāma dūrāddūramavīvatam tyāgaḥ pañcatriṃśattame mataḥ tasmai prasuvāmasi tenātyorasmatsamṛcchāte tasmai suprasavāmasi parā yakṣmagūṃ suvāmi te āyurdāyāgnaye tyāgaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśetha tadagrime agnaye varuṇāyādityai viśvebhyo devebhyaśca jaradaṣṭiyathāsat dvayorjātavedasegnaye tyāga ucyate
