bādhasvaducchanām dadhatyoṣagūṃ rayiṃ mayi śarmaṃtesyāmatrivarūtha udbhau sapatnān uṣase nimuce bhavet vṛtrahañjahi vasvasmabhyamābhara kṛtvā tubhyamagne pidadhmasi tasmai nimruk ca sarvapāpagūṃsamūhatām jātavedase'gnaye ca tatastyāgognaye bhavet prakṣāyato mātasyoccheṣi kiñcana asmāndiśāśca sarvāgūṃ stānmapyapākuru tathāntime vaiśvānarāya ca kṣatraṃ me jiṣṇu yasyāhamasmi purohitaḥ brahmaṇāmitrānunnuyāmi svāṃ aham punarādhītaṃ ma agāt vahniṃstuvīta dvādaśarcabhiḥ etānpāśānpramuñcanveda sa no muñcatu duritādavadyāt anājānanmanasā yācamāno yadatraino ava tatsuvāmi yacchatāmetadbaddhakāmocanam pracyuto garbhaḥ sarvānyatho anuṣva jāyāparīkṣagūṃrabhethāḥ yāni cakṛma karotu māmanehasam tasmādanṛṇaṃ kṛṇotu kṛṇotu mantreṇa tyāgo vaiśvānarāya ca

mogdhi tvagūṃhi vettha yathātathagūṃsvāhā janmakṛtāghānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ nivāraṇam sitāṣṭamyāṃ kṛtanityakriyaḥ śuciḥ ca ekādaśyāmupoṣaṇam nārāyaṇāyeti sveṣṭabījādikaṃ manum dvijocchiṣṭabhojī tatsevane rataḥ jāyate pūrṇe jape no cetpunaścaret homādyārambhadivase mṛnmayaṃ nrvraṇaṃ dṛḍham tasmiṃstīrthādijaṃ toyaṃ niḥkṣipetkalaśonmitam dvayoścaiva kuryāddhariharārcanam nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣādapsu sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam toyaṃ saṃprārthya dadyātpuṣpāñjaliṃ tataḥ tathā toye dṛṣṭā cetpātakaṃ gatam tataḥ kuryādyadicchāyātinirmalā mantro japtaścedarbudākṣaram gaṇeśasya ravestava tadardhakam apadaṃśastadardhaṃ cetyetatsarvatra gopitam sarvatantreṣu devatānāṃ pṛthakpṛthak māpūraṃ gaṇeśamanusiddhidam yamunāyāstaṭaṃ kāśyāṃ dineśamanusiddhidam gaṇḍakītīraṃ dvārakā viṣṇusiddhidā vaidyanāthaṃ rāmeśaḥ śivasiddhikṛt sarasvatyāstathātīraṃ śāktaṃmantrasya siddhikṛt aṅgavaṅgakaliṅgāśca kṣudradaivatasiddhidāḥ pūrṇagirirvāmamārgasya siddhidāḥ

vidrumākulito deśo gaṇeśasyātivallabhaḥ godhūmadūrvākṣetrāṇi śilā bhānumataḥ priyā śrotriyayuggrāme harermudvaidikāntike vaṭasyārātsaṅgame vipine hrade śakteḥ prītiśca nirjane śuṣkanadyāṃ ca modante kṣudradevatāḥ śavākīrṇe sthāne tuṣyanti vāmakāḥ devālaye syādvaidikodhikaḥ śūdrāśca siddhistatra tu vaidikī yuvatyaśca na vartante tatra siddhiradūrataḥ bhūchidrādiṣu no vaset sampūjya bhūsutasya balena ca bhūmirmantroyaṃ siddhyatāmiti vitastipramitānvṛttāngṛhṇīyātkīlakāndaśa paścānnair-ṛtyayormadhye yantramastreṇa kīlayet kīlite mantrī na vighnaiḥ paribhūyate kṣetrapālaṃ pūjayecca gaṇeśvaram samāśritya kūrmacakraṃ vicārayet paradeśagrāmagṛhabhedātkūrmaścaturvidhaḥ lekhyāḥ pūrvāśādiṣu lakṣakau pūrvato lekhyāḥ śrībījaṃ madhyakoṣṭhake varṇo yasyāṃ diśi vyavasthitaḥ vijñeyaṃ svarādvyañjanatastathā mukhasya pārśvayoḥ pāṇī kukṣī pādau tatastataḥ jīvanāśo vaire syāddhananāśanam

ḷpau jāhau paṣau enau irau ulau gādau jaṭau rākhau budhau ralau pacayoścāpi tarayo ralayorapi sthānavargayutaṃ taṣṭamaṣṭabhiścāpi ucyate ubhayoḥ kāryamadhikaṃ yasya śeṣakam kiñciddāsatvaṃ pādayoḥ pucchato mṛtiḥ kāśyāṃ ca kūrmasthānaṃ na cintayet mantraḥ sarvasiddhiphalapradaḥ arthakṛcchaktikṛtpūrvakāṣṭhādau balinārcayet kūrmapṛṣṭhe gṛhaṃ kṛtvā gṛhastho japamācaret sthracittānāṃ cañcalā calacetasām pratyekamantrayugmantrā japtavyāḥ sarvasiddhidāḥ cāṣṭottaraśataṃ punarvarṇasya yojanam pañcaviṃśatyā bhasaṅkhyaiḥ sarvadā japet śatātsāmyaṃ tathāṣṭādhiśatātsakalasiddhayaḥ mataḥ vidrumotthā vaśyakarā mauktikā muktidā matāḥ ||] svāgatampadam jvarahantrī tu lākṣāyāḥ śaṃkhasya pitṛtṛptikṛt padmakāṣṭhodbhavā tuṣṭau devadārūdbhavā niruk sarvārthaṃ mohane tāmrajā matā candanotthā śaktikṛcchvetakāṣṭhajā raktacandanabījotthā yakṣiṇyādikasādhane stambhanaṃ rujām vanyasiddhiḥ śārdūlāttasya devatāḥ

rāsabhāsthnā kṣudrasiddhirmānyatā tu gajāsthibhiḥ japedvipraḥ suvarṇamaṇibhirnṛpaḥ rudrākṣasphaṭikendrākṣamadhye kiñcinna dāpayet protayenmālāṃ gaṇanāthasya mantrakaiḥ dvādaśyāṃ vaiṣṇavī mālā protavyā viṣṇumantrataḥ aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ navamyāṃ bhūminandane paṭṭasūtreṇa devyāḥ prītyai tu mālikā ūrṇābhirvā vālkalairvā śaivī kārpāsasūtrakaiḥ dvijendrapuṇyastrīnirmittaṃ granthivarjitam ṣaḍvaktrairvātha kartavyā mitho miśrāṃstu varjayet proktaṃ mukhaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ tu nimnakam adhamaścaṇakābhaḥ syāttato hīno vipattikṛt tatastasmānnyūnaṃ nyūnataraṃ tataḥ granthirahitāṃ dṛḍhacakrasamanvitām pradakṣiṇāvartaḥ sa brahmagranthirucyate śuddha ukteṣvakṣeṣvatandritaḥ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭho japamālākṛte bhṛśam vipro yathā viprāḥ svadharmagāḥ purādhṛto jīrṇo rudrākṣo na śubhaḥ smṛtaḥ kāryā nātra muktādi vinyaset tathā bhaktādikeṣṭadaḥ gṛhasthāśramasaukhyadaḥ dharmārthakāmāḥ siddhyanti dhāraṇāttajjapādapi vidyā vāksiddhiścāpi jāyate śaivagāṇeśaśāktānāṃ hutasiddhistu tajjapāt

bāhau dhāraṇātsamare jayaḥ sarpaviṣamṛtyurna jāyate tajjapātsarve kāmakrodhādiśatravaḥ prasīdanti vāmabāhau sthitoghahā piśācagrahavetālabrahmarākṣasapannagāḥ hayamedhādiyajñānāṃ phalabhāgbhavet pratāpī ca gomedhaphalabhāgbhavet dhṛto dadyātpitṝṇāmakṣayāṅgatim devamanujairakṣayāṃ labhate gatim kāñcanavarṇāyāḥ śvetāyāścaiva gomayam kṛṣṇavarṇāyā evaṃ pañcāmṛtepi ca varṇavibhāgena pañcagavyāni cāharet gośakṛddviguṇaṃ mūtraṃ sarpirdadyāccaturguṇam yaśasebhiṣiñcāmi |] tvā kuśodakam |] gharṣayet lepayeccandanādibhiḥ padmākāreṇa navamiḥ sthāpite tatra vinyaset hrīṃpūrvairmātṛkārṇaiḥ kramādekaikaśo maṇim kevalājyairvā sadyojātādibhiḥ pṛthak homābhāve japaḥ proktaḥ protayenmālikāṃ tataḥ sadyojātādibhirmantraiḥ pūrvavatkṣālanādikam ṣaṭtriṃśaddvātriṃśatkaṇṭhamālikā aṣṭottaraśatairyuktamupavītaṃ vidhīyate ṣaṭsaṅkhyā dhāraṇakrama īritaḥ dhārayannevaṃ dehānte sa śivo bhavet

home vaiśvadeve surārcane rudrākṣadhārī bhūtvā ca yatkiñcitkarma vaidikam haste ca karṇayorupavītake pibanmadyaṃ saṅgacchannantyajādiṣu devānpuṣṇanti ye devāḥ paśavastetra vaidikāḥ saṃrakṣaṇārthāya nānyo rudrākṣato bhuvi kaṇṭhamāśritya śūkaro mriyate yadi rudrākṣadhāraṇāt pāpakarmāpi yo nityaṃ rudraloke mahīyate mauḍyānnāsāvāpnoti tatphalam gaṇeśasūryaviṣṇvīśadurgāḥ sampūjya bhaktitaḥ aṣṭottaraśataṃ pañcagavye tāṃ sthāpayetryaham granthayitvā sthaṇḍile tāṃ nidhāpayet saṃsnāpya śītalena jalena ca kuryāddhasauṃmantreṇa sādhakaḥ navagrahānpūjayitvā dikpālāṃścāpi pūjayet dadyādgurave maṇisaṅkhyakam svarṇapatrasya grāhyamaśvatthapatrakam kīkasādikamālānāṃ kaulikānāñca vāminām pūjayedādau vastragandhānulepanaiḥ pañcāśanmaṇibhiḥ kāryā ṛtumatyā bhage kṣipet śuddhodairmūlamantreṇābhiṣiñcedvijayārasaiḥ sveṣṭajape nīlaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ māraṇakarmaṇi vaśye pītaṃ kaṣāyantu vikṣepakaraṇe matam hunenmadyapalābhyāṃ ca mūlamantreṇa sādhakaḥ

sādhakāṃścāpi bhojayenmaṇisaṅkhyakān yā mālā kṛtā tantu japettayā niyuñjīta japettu sthagito yathā tarjanyā na spṛśetsūtraṃ kampayennaiva dhūnayet cālaneṃguṣṭhaścānyamakṣaṃna saṃspṛśet tu saṅghaṭṭaṃ naiva kārayet vidveṣaḥ sphuṭite vyādhisambhavaḥ vāṃgulimālābhirjapaṃ kuryāttaducyate mūlaparyantā karamālā prakīrtitā cānāmikāmūlātkaniṣṭhānukrameṇa ca kalpayenmeruṃ madhyānāmādiparvakam proktastathāyantrividhomataḥ aṃgulyākhyo japaḥ prokto matonyo na mamaiva ca viyuñjīta japakāle kadācana guṇavānkiñcitsaṅkocayettalam mātsaryaṃ kāmaṃ dveṣañca tāḍanam vādyaṃ madhu cchāyāṃ vibhītakakarañjayoḥ varjayedvidvānkartavyānyatha me śṛṇu śrautamaune parasaṅgasya varjanam guroḥ pādapūjāhāranimantraṇe pañcayajñāstarpaṇameva ca sakṛduccarite śabde praṇavaṃ samudīrayet cāvaśyaṃ nyasyāṅgāni tato japet japenmantraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ vā smareddharim sūryogniścandramāḥ kheṭā munayo bhāni tārakāḥ

kṣutedhovāyugamane patitādikabhāṣaṇe paścājjapenmantramambho'lābhe hariṃ smaret dṛṣṭvācamya caretkarma spṛṣṭvā snānaṃ vidhīyate bahuvastraikavastro vā muktakeśo galāvṛtaḥ cintādyākulacitto vā kruddho vāntaḥ kṣudhānvitaḥ dhautapādaḥ paścādvā dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ raktavastraḥsnigdhavastro dvikacchakaḥ parityajya tajjapaṃ punarā caret maunena daśakumbhamitairjalaiḥ syādakṣarāvṛttiḥ sa tredhā parikīrtitaḥ uccanīcaiḥ svaritaiḥ śabdaiḥ spaṣṭapadākṣaraiḥ śanairuccārayenmantramīpadoṣṭau pracārayet yadākṣaraśreṇīṃ yathāsthāneṣu coccaret ṣaṭkarmakṛdvācikaḥ syātkāyikaḥ sarvasiddhikṛt devatā nityaṃ stūyamānā prasīdati santuṣṭo jāyate kṣullako naraḥ mahāguṇairvaśyo jāyate guṇavānprabhuḥ proktaṃ nityakāmikabhedataḥ dvihastañca sundaraṃ mṛdu nirmalam vakṣyante jñānasiddhyāyihājinam śrīvivarddhanam kṛṣṇakambalaḥ tyajenniṣiddhaṃ matimāṃstvaniṣiddheṣu saṃviśet daridraḥ syādvastre sthānavināśanam pṛthagupādānāt ||]

bhavetpīḍā niṣiddhaṃ tviṣṭakāsanam saṃnyāsī snātakaḥ siddhimāpnuyāt viprānsantarpya yatnena bhojanācchādanādibhiḥ japaṃ paścāttadanujñāpurassaram tadbahiścaturasraṃ ca tatra kṣetre samarcayet annodakādisampūrṇaṃ balipātraṃ nidhāpayet siddhāntibhistatra nivedyo manunā surāḥ paścādvighnavighna maheti ca gṛhṇagṛhṇasvāheti vai vadet saparivārāya baliṃ dadyānna bhakṣayet gurūnviprāngaṇeśaṃ paripūjya ca kālaḥ sandhye bhūtānyahaḥ kṣapā brahmaśāsanamāsthāya kalpadhvamiha sannidhim saṅkalpaṃ kuryātsaṃvatsarādikān māsaṃ pakṣaṃ pañcāṅgameva ca svadeśabhedānuccārya kāmanāsahitānvadet jātināmāntaṃ punaḥ śarma ca varma ca puraścaryāmetatsaṅkhyajapātmikām durgāṃ mahyaṃ natvā ca pūjanam ṛṣyādivinyāsamaṅganyāsaṃ tathaiva ca samprokṣya tatastāṃ prārthayediti nyastastasmānme siddhidā bhava [gamiti bījam ||] gaṇapateḥ pūrvamuccārya tadanantaram dakṣiṇe paścāccintayenmanasā śivam dhyāyetkaṇṭhamadhye pītavarṇaṃ hiraṇmayama

|| ājñācakre tataḥ paścādgurormantrasya cātmanaḥ gurusvarūpamekaṃ taṃ ṣaṭcakraṃ prati laṅghayet lambayenmūlamantreṇa cādiṣoḍaśacakrakam devīṃ jātakarmasamārabhet tripathasthānaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ caturaṃgulam nāḍīnāṃ veṣṭanaṃ vidyate nṛṇām tattvacakramiti proktaṃ śuklaṃ kaṇṭhasya madhyagam ṣoḍaśāraṃ syātsaptāṃgulapramāṇataḥ mantrāṇāṃ cintitasya japasya ca utpannaḥ pūrvamādisutasya tu nissetuḥ kṣaṇātkṣarati yajvanām setumādāya japakarma samārabhan caturdaśasvaronyeṣāṃ candrānusvārasaṃyutaḥ cālayet bhavettasya sa japo niṣphalaḥ sadā mālāmantrastu hrīṃ siddhyai namaḥ samprārthayediti kuruṣva me bhadre yaśo vīryaṃ ca vardhaya pañcākṣarastato devaṃ sveṣṭaṃ samprārthayediti me deva tvatprasādājjagatpate cārghyatoyena madhyāhnasamaye tvidam nyāsāvasānamakhilaṃ karma kuryātpuroditam tu bhūyaḥ snātvā tato dvijaḥ bhojanaṃ kuryātsatataṃ tārakodaye bhavecchreṣṭhasteṣāṃ lakṣaṇamucyate raktahastīśaṃkhamadhuśālukaṃ śreṣṭhamucyate

kuvākuśca mūle pāvitryakārakam satkulasthānajātānāṃ bhikṣāśī cāgrajanmanām bhikṣālabdhaṃ bhakṣyaṃ vratasthitaiḥ taṇḍulāḥ ṣaṣṭhinīvāraśālijāstrividhā matāḥ kaṅgavaśca makuṣṭhāśca yāvannālakaṇaśikā cakramardaḥ palaṅkaḥ śatapuṣpikā mṛṇālamusalī ghoṇṭā śatamūlī vidārikā kañcyukaśca śṛṅgāṭakakaserukau dugdhaṃ sasāraṃ madhuraṃ payonyattvalapabījakam bheṣajaṃ sarvaṃ hitvā mīnānsurāṃ palam māhiṣaṃ cānyadvratasthānāṃ niṣidhyate deśakulataḥ praśastaṃ sodhamaḥ smṛtaḥ masūrāśca kodravāścaṇakāstridhā kṣāraṃ palāṇḍuśca gṛñjanaṃ kācabhojanam paryuṣitaṃ tailaṃ tāmbūlaṃ kṣudradhānyakam dvipakvaṃ ca guḍānnaṃ tālajaṃ phalam mantrapūtaṃ pāvanaṃ devadurlabham bhojanaṃ kāryamupastīryāvidhārya ca sammantrya bhuñjīyāddhṛdayāṇunā bhuñjīta tvanyatpatraṃ vivarjitam śayane suśuddhe vasudhātale mūlamantreṇa jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ samutthāya pādaśaucaṃ vidhāya ca kuryādyathāśakti tvarpayecca tatheśvare vanasthānāṃ prokto vai brahmavādinām

kālaḥ proktotyāvaśyakepi ca sārdhayāmatrayaṃ hīno'vaśyake proktalakṣaṇaḥ pratidinamāmadhyāhnaṃ japaṃ caret tarpaṇaṃ mārjanaṃ kṛtvā tathā brāhmaṇabhojanam dvitīyaḥ kalpastu lakṣamekaṃ japaṃ caret kalpastu sampūrṇaṃ japamācaret daridrairdviguṇo japaḥ [kārya iti śeṣaḥ ||] tathā kalpo yasya devasya yatpriyam japapriyāssarvadevyo vāmamārge balipriyāḥ gaṇeśasya viṣṇorbrāhmaṇabhojanam puraścaryācatuṣkeṇa tridvyādyaiḥ kṣattriyādayaḥ śuciḥ pūrvamupoṣitaḥ sparśādimuktiparyantaṃ japenmaṃtraṃ samāhitaḥ brāhmaṇānbhojayetpaścātpuraścaryāsamantvidam home ca saṅkhyā tantreṣu noditā mantrāṇāmevamevānyaducyate dhyātvā japenmantramayutānāṃ catuṣṭayam asiddhatvādgurordevāḥ śiṣyasiddhirna jāyate bindumanmātṛkākṣaraiḥ tato homādikātsiddho bhavenmanuḥ siddhayetra ca sasvarāḥ hrasvadīrghaplutairbhedaira i u ṛ tridhā matāḥ dīrghaplutavibhedena hyanusvāravisargakaiḥ kādikā varṇā jihvāmūlīyayukca kaḥ upadhmānīyasaṃyuktaṃ pakārastena tatra ṣaṭ

smṛtaḥ anadhyāyānvarjayitvā catvāriṃśaddinaṃ tathā tu bhūtalipyā puṭīkuru saṃ |] hayavaralā ādyantimadvicaturthakam tataścaivaṃ dvicatvāriṃśadakṣaraiḥ gandhapuṣpādyairniśīthe parataḥ punaḥ labdhācāryādisthānamāśritaiḥ bhāgyavato vāpi sukumārasya vā yathā parijñeyā varṇamāsaistu siddhidā varṇakrameṇa tāḥ proktā anulomavilomataḥ sarpadvayākṛtirmālā bhavennityaṃ tato japet samānā maṇayaḥ protavyā sārṇasūtrakaiḥ rājate sūtre ye hyatāḥ paripūjayet kvāthena nityaṃ snānaṃ caturthakaḥ dvartanaṃkuryādeṣa ṣaṣṭhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ jāyate santāpāpyāyane drāvo bodhanaṃ ca vaśīkṛtiḥ samānīya padmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhet nāmārṇairmantraṃ sandarbhitaṃ likhet sādhakasya nāmāthāṣṭadaleṣu ca |] || tatsaṃveṣṭya mṛdā samyagveṣṭayedbrāhmaṇādikaḥ kṣipettrimadhure tattu mṛṇmaye laghubhājane agnisaṃsthāpanaṃ kṛtvā sannidhau tasya taṃghaṭam aṣṭādhikasahasraṃ tu samyaktaṃ kalaśaṃ kṣipet brāhmaṇāṃścānnaistoṣayeddakṣiṇādibhiḥ

tadā kuryāttatprakāra ihocyate uśīrarocanābhyāñca śilākarpūrakuṃkumaiḥ japāddhomāddrāvitaḥ phalado bhavet [aiṁbījena |] ca bījena sampuṭīkṛtya taṃ japet mahādāru haridrā ca manaḥśilā bhavedvaśyo no cetkuryātprapīḍanam paṭhetturyamudāttataḥ anudāttapadoccāre devaṃ dhyāyedadhaḥsthitam bhūrje bhānudugdhena lekhayet mantraḥ pīḍitaḥ sa prasīdati sombījapuṭitaṃ mantraṃ likhedbhūrjasya patrake poṣaṇamityuktamatha śoṣaṇamucyate sveṣṭamantraṃ tatkaṇṭhe dhārayediti mantrāṇāṃ caturdikṣu samāvṛtān taddhāryaṃ kaṇṭhe dāhakriyā tviyam tu kāmākṣā yatra devatā mantraṃ hi vaṃśopari yathākramam tasyaiva mūle śailasya parvaṇi yoginīśaile dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi dhruvam jvālāmukhīsamīpe vā hiṃgulājasamāpataḥ strīsamīpe tu kāmapīṭhe manorgrahaḥ pūrṇakumbhe nidhāpayet tāntrikamantrāṇāṃ dīkṣāṃ śṛṇu guruṃ vinā dakṣiṇāmūrteḥ sannidhau pūjayecca tam likhitvātha mantraṃ devaṃ ca pūjayet

aṣṭottaraśataṃ caiva mantragrahaṇamucyate dakṣiṇāmūrtito manuḥ tapaḥkṣayakarāścaiva jāyante naikasiddhayaḥ aṇimādiṣu magnaścenmokṣavārtātidurlabhā siddhidvāramidaṃ tasya mayā lakṣaṇamucyate jāyeta na khyātavyaṃ guruṃ vinā yānti dūrataḥ svalpanidrā sadā cittaprasannatā rādhanaśaktasya prathamaṃ vatsaratrayam karmaṇā manasā yadi prārthayantenurodhena garvitā api māninaḥ prapaśyanti tejasā vibhavena ca navamādvatsarādūrdhvaṃ svayaṃ siddhyati mantrarāṭ daridrasya mantrasiddhiryathā bhavet varṇānāṃ triguṇādirvidhīyate proktastarpaṇāddviguṇo japaḥ bhojayedviprānkṛtasāṅgatvasiddhaye ṣaragāni ca santuṣṭo mantraḥ siddhyati mantriṇaḥ gāthāvā tajjapo naiva cārthakṛt teṣāṃ pātakaṃ parikīrtitam gurumukhātprāpta ekaḥ syātsarvasiddhidaḥ siddhilakṣaṇasampūrṇaḥ prāṇimātrasya yassamaḥ kāryo nānyo vāme kadācana tu pāpahāniḥ prajāyate

puraḥ || itthaṃ proktā puraścaryā kimanyacchrotumicchatha puraścaryāprakāśaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ janāsteṣāṃ sthirā siddhiḥ kathaṃ bhavet sādhakasya tathā vada kṛpānidhe svadharmācaraṇātsarvamanāyāsena jāyate kurvīta siddhiḥ syātputrapautrikī pādukāsanaviṇmūtramaithunādi vivarjayet muktakeśīṃ ca kāmārtāṃ ca na nindayet nālokayetparadravyaṃ paradārāṃśca varjayet na caitāni vilaṅghayet paranindāṃ ca varjayet purāṇāgamaśāstrāṇi manasāpi na dūṣayet sammārjanīṃ daṇḍaṃ dhvajaṃ vai turyamāyudham bhogayogyāni cānyāni yāgadravyāṇi yāni ca caitāni padā spṛśet parahiṃsātmikā yā ca na tāmavataretkvacit devatātithipūjārthaṃ dānatopyarjayeddhanam [yatnata] stambhadīpamanuṣyāṇāmanyeṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā tyajeddūraṃ kharaśvājarajastathā pravāha yetsarvaṃ dadyādvā śivadīkṣite kāle kāmaṃ krodhaṃ viśeṣataḥ laṅghayetspṛśennaiva tatsamakṣaṃ na dhārayet līlāṃ ca na kuryāddurusannidhau guroragre prabhāvaṃ svasya śiṣyakaḥ sannidhau naiva svaguruṃ praṇamedbudhaḥ

gurordadyāttvamityādi na vā vadet kvāpi śapathaṃ gurusañjñitam nirvahedyatnādante pūjājapāhutīḥ prāyaścittaṃ manoḥ kuryānmūlasyaiva sahasrakam ca tāṃ giraṃ naiva bhāṣayet na gṛhṇīyātkadācana ācarannādarācchāntiṃ dīkṣitaḥ sodhigacchati svasya mantro mahāpadyapi sādhakaiḥ kuryādanātheṣu dayāṃ sadā vastavyaṃ prayāyātsaṃsmaranhṛdi yatra nindā tu tasminsthāne na vai vaset vacaḥ satyaṃ sauśīlyaṃ samatāṃ dhṛtim gamanāgamane kuryātpraṇamya gurupāduke malayuktādirahitaḥ keśaśmaśruviluñcanāt bhāvayeddevatāṃ viṣṇuṃ guruvipraśarīragām viśvāśrayo viṣṇurātmā jñeyaśca viṣṇuvat kartavyā satataṃ mantrasiddhaye gurornāma devanāma taduttaram ca vadennāma tithyarṇaṃ ca harermama bhajanaṃ devi karotyāpatparaṃparām tatsaṃkhyā pañcatulyā pare dine pūjā proktā viṃśatibhedikā yugādyāśca yadaṅgaṃ devatābhavam dīkṣāyā divasaṃ navarātrakam kṛtā pūjā yasminbhavati niṣphalā

lābhe home mahotsave rogeṣvāpatsu doṣeṣu dussaṅge durnimittake yathā deśastathā pūjāṃ samācaret vighneśaraviviṣṇvīśaśaktayaḥ varṣakṛtāpūjāphalaṃ gṛhṇāti kāmarāṭ navamī paurṇamāsyamā ca caturdaśī kṛtanityakriyaśśuddho yuktaḥ sāmayikairjanaiḥ kṛtvā ṛṣyādīnvinyasettataḥ ṛṣigandharvadevādimohanāya namostu te samāyāhi kṣamasva ca namostu te netavyosi śivājñayā pūjayettatra tattanmantreṇa sādhakaḥ kroṃ ratyai namaḥ ||] procya ratyai hṛccāṣṭavarṇakaḥ svagṛhamāgaccheddvitīye divase punaḥ utpāṭayecchedayedvā svamūlenāstramantrataḥ ghore hrīmiti kīrtayet rudrarūpebhyo hrīṃśrīmiti manuḥ smṛtaḥ pīṭhādau navāṃśāṃstasya kārayet candanāgurukarpūracandanairlepayecca tān tadbījaṃ japanniha kṣamāpayet tasyāṣṭadikṣu saṃsthāpyā ghaṭāḥ svarṇādinirmitāḥ svāsanapūjādiyogapīṭhāntamarcayet kuryādvṛttayugmaveṣṭitaṃ bhūpureṇa ca prārthayitvā taṃ pūjayeccandanādibhiḥ nityamānandaṃ janayasva me

kālaṃ pañcaraṅgairvicitritam viśvaṃ yastasmai kālātmane namaḥ maṇḍūkādijñānātmāntāṃ pīṭhapūjāṃ samācaret tathā hṛdyāṃ vṛṣāṃ cāpi dhṛtiṃ ratim kāmadevaṃ ca tadgāyatryā taduttaram pracodayāt pāśāṃkuśadhanurbāṇābhidhā dhyāyettataḥ param taruṇaṃ vāmadakṣiṇayoryutam pāśastataḥ pūjyaṃ pūrvoktamanubhistrayam gauravarṇāṃ dhyāyedratiṃ śubhām tāmbūlāsyāṃ bhajetprītiṃ ghaṭapuṣpalasatkarām dakṣiṇe kusumākaram gaurāṅgaṃ surūpaṃ lokamohanam tatognīśarakṣovāyavyamadhyataḥ hṛdayādīni ṣaḍaṅgāni prapūjayet bhasmaśarīraṃ cānaṅgamanmathameva ca tadagre tu lokapānāyudhāni ca kāmadevaṃ ca ślokābhyāṃ prārthayediti kāmarūpa namostu te ratiprītipriyāya ca avāhayenmadhyakumbhe devaṃ sāṅgaṃ ca pūjayet yathālābhaṃ pūrṇaṃ parva tvadājñayā kṛtvā nityahomaṃ samācaret samāpyātha prārthayeddevatāmiti deva kāmānkāmeśvareśvara

dravyādyaistoṣayedviprānbhojayediti tadvidhiḥ yaistu na kṛtaṃ tatphalaṃ tava māsaḥ śrāvaṇo madhyamo bhavet ca caturthyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ pavitrakam rājataṃ tāmraṃ kalau kārpāsakaṃ śubham padmajātaṃ saugatānāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ kṣaumamiṣyate muñjajātaṃ vratasthānāmāvikaṃ samaraiṣiṇām paramaṃ proktaṃ tadardhaṃ madhyamaṃ smṛtam pūjāvaraṇadevānāṃ tulyāni racayedbudhaḥ dvādaśaiva kaniṣṭhe syurathānyacca pavitrakam śiṣyāṇāṃ pavitraṃ tadudāhṛtam pūjāsthānetha sindūrakuṃkumāraktacandanaiḥ granthisthāneṣu saṃsthāpya pīṭhe tannavatantuṣu nāgagurū raviścāpi śivāśivau pauruṣī vīrā gāyatrī cāparājitā pūjyaṃ mūlamantraiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam nyāsādikaṃ tatra prāgvatpūjāṃ prakalpayet mūlamantreṇa pavitrasya samarpaṇam bhūyasīṃ paścātsvayambhūñjīta vāgyataḥ vakṣyāmi tatrādau śāntirucyate ṣoḍhāhorātraṃ pañcameṃśe tu śāntikam tvapastattvaṃ tasmiñchāntikamācaret pūjayeccandanādyairvaṃbījena śatruśāntike darśayet triṣūttarāsu parvāsu śāntikaṃ syāddvijanmasu

devarakṣorājalokasarpastrīhayahastinām nirmāya vaśyampūrvamukhaścaret tayoḥ |] || svastikāsanamāruhya svāhāntaṃ mantramuccaret stambhampravakṣyāmi tadudyoganivāraṇam ca sainyasya kruddhasya viṣadaṃṣṭriṇaḥ gatvā stambhanasya kriyāṃ caret nāsādaṇḍena saṃlagno vāyuścedbhūdayo bhavet pīte maṇḍale tāṃ samarcayet madhyame bhūyaḥ saṃlagne suprasārite ||] pradarśayet gajacarmāsanaṃ stambhe gadāmudrāhutau tathā bharaṇī citrā rohiṇī cottarātrayam vidveṣaṇaṃ ghasrasyāṃśake tu dvitīyake hastayormuṣṭiyugalaṃ kuryātsā vighnanāśinī ||] bhavet vā ārdrācatuṣṭayaṃ mūlaṃ jyeṣṭhā vidveṣaṇe matā śastā tṛtīyāśe dinasya tat śatroruccāṭanaṃ kuryādyaṃ bījena tamarcayet mṛgacarmādikaṃ tatra vāyavyasya ca karmaṇi manuḥ varjayedviprānanyāṃścāpi sudhārmikān rakṣārthaṃ tu tadā haret ca kartavyaṃ devi taddoṣaśāntaye kṛṣṇatilairvā ghṛtasaṃyutaiḥ ṣaṣṭhoṃśaḥ [veti śeṣaḥ |] śaranmāraṇakarmaṇi dakṣiṇābhimukhaḥ kuryādbhadrakālīṃ samarcayet

huṃkārāntena mantreṇa māhiṣaṃ vātha lohajam kuryātkṛṣṇavarṇaṃ kṛṣṇadravyaiśca pūjanam sthitaḥ tiṣṭhankuryānmāraṇaṃ vā bhūmau pādaṃ niveśayet vakṣyante tvabhicārāśca tatra ca vāpi śūkaryāṃ mudrayā hunet mṛgāntyacitrāmaitreṣu devadhyānantu rājasam haridrāmiśritantoyaṃ tarpaṇārthaṃ prayojayet sarvāṇi karmāṇi raudrabhe tu prasādhayet sarvarakṣamibhākāraṃ dhyāyenniścalamānasaḥ dhyāyedevaṃvidhaṃ vāpi sarvakāryaṣu sādhakaḥ proktaṃ pūrvā caivottarātrayam vahnikoṇasammukhastu samācaret sarvajñānaprasiddhyarthamīśānābhimukho bhavet mantro vauṣaṭpallavasaṃyutaḥ yathoktadevatādhyānaṃ kuryātpauṣṭikakarmaṇi mahāsukhasamāyuktadhyānaṃ vai nirbhayambhavet tu phaḍantaḥ syāddhomo dhyānantu tāmasam kalpāntāgnisamaṃ yuddhe dhyāyeddevaṃ ca tāmasam samarcayedvighnaṃ vāreśāṃśca tithīśvaram tatorcayediṣṭadevantato homaṃ samācaret jñaviṣṇū ca caturvaktrabṛhaspatī vāreśvarā devi tithīśāṃstvamatho śṛṇu vasavo nāgā dharmaḥ śivadivākarau vahnirbrahmā candraḥ śivo'ditiḥ

vāyurathendrāgnī mitraścaiva sureśvaraḥ varuṇo'jaikapādahirbudhnyapūṣakau ityādi |] namasā ca samanvitāḥ eteṣāṃ nāmamantrāstu grāhyāḥ pūjādisādhane viparītāni kṛtvā nirayamāpnuyāt parasyāpi kāmyakarmāṇi cācaret kurvīta nānyeṣāntu kadācana bhaktasya nyāyārjitadhanasya ca kāryaṃ kuryācca deśikaḥ vṛṇuyātkarmakartāraṃ dīkṣoktavidhinā tataḥ jitendriyo jitakrodho mānakṣobhavivarjitaḥ yathoktantu kṛtvābhyaṅgaṃ samācaret aṣṭottarasahasrañca rakṣārthaṃ prajapenmanum suhṛdbhiḥ susnigdhairātmarakṣāntu kārayet japahomārcanādyaiśca brāhmaṇārādhanādibhiḥ prayogānkurvīta hyanyathā duḥkhamāpnuyāt muhuścāpi yathā syāttuṣṭimāstathā siddhyantyasiddhasya devatāśāpamāpnuyāt prayogasiddhirevaiṣāṃ phalamanyanna vidyate parasyāpi ṣaṭ karmāṇi susādhayet prayogadoṣaśāntyarthamātmarakṣārthameva ca sarvaṃ kathayeta śubhāśubham kāryā karmakāle viśeṣataḥ kṣudrāṇāṃ vāmamārgiṇām paraniṣṭhāparāṇāntu vāmināṃ paramā gatiḥ

na kurvanti kadācidiha ninditam kulasaṃśuddhāḥ kalpoktenaiva saṃskṛtāḥ caryā kimanya cchrotumicchasi siddhisthirīkaraṇaprakāśaḥ saptamaḥ sarvadevapriyā yāśca pūjāsāphalyadāyikāḥ kurute sarvā devāssyustasya saukhyadāḥ tarjanī vakrā saralā cāpi madhyamā yatraikamuṣṭiraṃguṣṭho dakṣo vāmaṃ samāśritaḥ vahnernayedastrāhvayāpi ca aṃguṣṭhena catasrastu tarjanyāṃguṣṭhameva ca catasroṃgulayo vyastā hṛdaye tasya mantrataḥ catasroṃgulayaścāpi prasārya śirasā dhṛtāḥ tena śikhāṃ spṛṣṭvā śikhāmantreṇa sādhakaiḥ skandhādānābhiparyantaṃ pāṇyostu prakramo bhavet tvanāmā tu vāme tryakṣadivaukasām ca sūryaviṣṇvādibhedayoḥ vakṣyāmi ṣaṇmudrāṇāntu lakṣaṇam madhyame'nyonyakarayoḥ pṛṣṭhalagne pare tathā namaskāramudrā lalitāyāḥ prakīrtitā kaniṣṭhāmadhyaparvasthāvaṃguṣṭhau kṣobhiṇī matā kaniṣṭhāsthāvaṃguṣṭhau drāviṇī bhavet sarale śeṣā mukhayuktānukarṣiṇī kṛtamuṣṭipadau hastau kṛtvāṃguṣṭhau hṛdi nyaset kuryādūrdhvaprasaktāgre tarjanyau jyeṣṭhayā yute prasaktāgre kaniṣṭhe tūrdhvataḥ sthite

tarjanyāvānayenmūrdhni mukhe pārśve kare hṛdi saṃyutāgre aṃguṣṭhakakaniṣṭhike śabdayettabhyāṃ jyeṣṭhāgravalitāgrayā karayostarjanīmadhyā nāmāyuktā na vakritāḥ cāpi dakṣaskandhe pradarśayet vāmāṃgulyagradakṣāṃguṣṭhasya yoge prajāyate śeṣāṃgulyāvaṃguṣṭhāvanāmike dakṣiṇaṃ nyasyāṃguṣṭhakau cālayediti anāmayormūlaparvaṇyaṃguṣṭhau nikṣipettadā sā cetsarvasaṃsthāpane kṣamā sthāpane yā syādaṃguṣṭhadvayamuktakam kriyate nyāso hyaṅgānāmaṅgine sakṛt hastasya savyasya bhrāmayecca tām anyonyagrathitāṃguṣṭhaprasāritakarāṃgulī jātau tvaṃguṣṭhāvucchritau yadi dvāvaṃguṣṭhau muṣṭiyogo niśchidraśca bhavedyadi madhyasaralābaddhamuṣṭikā kṣiptvā baddhā muṣṭiyugaṃ tarjanyaṃguṣṭhayoryutiḥ cotthitau lagnau mudrā vaśakarī matā dṛḍhaṃ baddhānāmikāgre tu yojayet anyonyāṃguṣṭhakau lagnau mudrā conmādinī matā saṃyojyānāmikāmukhyau saralau syānmahāṃkuśā madhyamāsandhinirgatāṃguṣṭhamuṣṭikā prasṛtāsaṃyutā hastā talaṃ hastatalānvitam aṃgulyo viralā namrā nimnaṃ karatalaṃ tathā

ṣaḍgaṇeśasyāṃkuśamudrā ca saptamī dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ kṛtvādho nāmayecchanaiḥ vāmahastaṃ baddhāṃguṣṭhakaniṣṭhikam śaktipriyā matā kaniṣṭhāgre dakṣiṇāṃguṣṭhapīḍitam hastayormuṣṭiyugalaṃ kuryādvighnavināśanam dakṣañca śirasi sthāpayediti varādyāḥ pāśaścāṃkuśaḥ śakterdaśa smṛtāḥ kaniṣṭhānāmikāntare bhūyaḥ sallaṁgne suprasārite kuryātsaṃhatā unnatāṃgulī vāmāṃguṣṭhodare śeṣā vakrācordhvaṃ kaniṣṭhikā kaniṣṭhayormūlagate tarjanyau bhavato yadi kaniṣṭhātarjanīgranthiḥ sthāpyau tiryaṅmukhau karau mālāvatspṛśedākaṇṭhapādakam vāmahastāmbujaṃ vā tu yadi mūrdhani vinyaset anyonyahastāṃgulayastanniṣṭhāḥ sthāpayeddhṛdi samyaksaṃyojya madhye ca tarjanībhyāṃ suveṣṭayet anyonyāntargate dakṣakarṇānte khecarī matā kṛtvā tarjanyaṃguṣṭhayoryutiḥ binā sarvaṃ vṛthā pūjājapādikam saṃyutā mithaḥ padatulye ubhayāṃgulī vare aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ ca karayorākrameta kanisṭhike aṃgulyagrāṇi saṃyojyādhastātsannamayediti madhyamayā madhyāṃ nāmayediti sā bhavet

madhyamāsaṃsthamaṃguṣṭhayugalaṃ yadi cakrādyāśca dhanurbāṇaparyantāśca harerimāḥ dhārayettasmiṃścandrāgre sampradarśayet kamalākṛtimudrā syādubhe sto bhāskarapriye vāmāṃgulyau dakṣiṇābhirveṣṭayetsā śivapriyā prasārayeccheṣamaṃgulīnāṃ trayaṃ tadā prasārayedaṃgulīnāṃ trayaṃ japasusiddhaye anāmikāguṣṭhamadhyāgrāṇi tiryagyutāni ca dakṣiṇāścenmilitā ūrdhvamucchritāḥ pātravacca kuryātsā bhairavapriyā pracālayetkarṇapārśve daśaitāḥ śūlinā matāḥ hastau kalikābhāvadhomukhau phaṇākārau svasvadigbhāgasaṃsthitau ānayedvāmakarṇe tāṃ mudrā saubhāgyadāyinī ripujihvāgrahākhyeyaṃ mudrikā śatrunāśinī uttānāvūrudeśasyāsannau namrastathā pumān yadā baddhau muṣṭī karṇavadāśritau aṃguṣṭhatarjanīyogaḥ kartayo hastayordvayoḥ kaniṣṭhajāstisro'ṃguṣṭhāgraṃ tarjanīyutam anāmikāṃguṣṭhayoścedagrayogaḥ prajāyate yuktāsāsnānenantaphalapradā spṛśedeṣā dāne vastrasya dhāraṇe anāmikāṃguṣṭhayoścedagrayogaḥ prajāyate karaṇādike skhalitadhāraṇe kaniṣṭhāgre spṛśetsyādgandhadhāraṇe

tathāṃguṣṭhāgraṃ saṃyojyeti pūjane tarjanyāḥ spṛśedagraṃ ca pūrvavat spṛśedagraṃ madhyamāyāśca pūrvavat viśeṣonāmikāgrantu jyaṣṭhāgreṇa tu yojayet darśayetpañcavāyūnāmucyante pañcamudrikāḥ kaniṣṭhānāmike samyagaṃguṣṭhāgreṇa yojayet vāyurodhādyogī vimucyate vāyurdṛṣṭvā tāṃ suprasīdati tarjanīmadhyamānāmāssarvarogāpanodinī praṇavādicaturthyantā namo'ntānāmamantrakāḥ mahāyonyabhidhā mudrā sundaryānandadāyinī antarvalitamutthāpya tarjanyau sarale kṛte śaktiranayā svasthāne varadā vrajet kaniṣṭhāṃguṣṭhayugalaṃ maṇibandhau ca saṃyutau haste kākatuṇḍanibhe mukhe śanaiśca sarale tarjanyo mudritāḥ parāḥ tuṣṭitkrtrī tatra saṃyuktārivināśinī tarjanyaṃguṣṭhasaṃyogaḥ pūrṇakarmaṇi yojayet pārśvayoścāpi salagnau dvāvevābhimukhau tadā dakṣiṇāniviḍā muṣṭirnāsikārpitatarjanī yamināṃ sevyā brahmābhivyaktikāriṇī prasṛtāṃgulikau dṛśyau mithaḥ śliṣṭau ca sammukhau saṃyutau kṛtvā prasṛtāṃgulikau tathā spṛśettasya tarjanībhyāṃ tadānnadā

tarjanībhyāntu sarvapātakanāśinī cāntarikṣe ca sthāpitaśca nirīkṣitaḥ cordhvamukhau hastau granthiraṃguṣṭhayorbhavet madhyamānāmayoragre mūle pṛṣṭhe ca taddvayam kaniṣṭhā dakṣā syāttayorūrdhvantu vāmaje pṛṣṭhānmadhyāparinipīḍite darśayettāsāṃ devatāśca tathā phalam śaktiḥ sumukhānandadāyinī śaktirnityaviśvā viśvasyātipriyaṅkarā tacchaktiḥ sarveṣāṃ hṛdayaṃgamā śaktistu vimalā tasyāḥ prabhāvādamalo bhavet yogaḥ śaktistasyāssadābhidhā śeṣamaṃgulyo bhinnāḥ śaktiḥ prabhāvatī śeṣāṃgulyastu sambhinnā līlā śaktiprakīrtitā bhinnāḥ śaktiḥ śāntiśca śāntikṛt kaniṣṭhādvitayaṃ hitvā śaktirdurgā prakīrtitā saṃyuktau śaktirasyāḥ sarasvatī cottānau viśvarūpāsti devatā baddhamuṣṭī viśākhyā śaktiratra tu saṃlagnau vāmā lopātra devatā cocchritāṃguṣṭhau vāmā śaktiḥ samīritāḥ vāma ūrdhvamāpyāyinī bhavet vimalā tasyāḥ śaktiḥ prakīrtitā tatra śaktiḥ proktā tamomayī aṃgulyaścordhvayuktāgrāḥ śeṣāḥ śaktirhiraṇmayī

tacchaktiḥ sūkṣmā sūkṣmārthasādhikā sthāpayitvādhomukhaṃ tannāmayedviśvayonikā darśayecchaktirgadārūpā prakīrtyate davatāstasya viphalantu kṛtaṃ bhavet tathā bhaktakṛtā mudrā dṛṣṭvā hṛṣyanti devatāḥ padārtha ekaścetsādhakante śapanti ca macatuṣṭayamicchanti taṃ vinā praśapanti ca āvaśyakamaṃtra pañca taṃ vinā praśapanti ca tepi praśapanti ca sādhakam mokṣaṃ labhate mudrāvinnātra saṃśayaḥ tattvaṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasi mudrālakṣaṇaprakāśo'ṣṭamaḥ śiṣyo dhanārthī gurureva ca dūresmāddaihikī siddhiḥ pārakīyā kathaṃ bhavet siddhiḥ syādvinā nindāṃ vadasva tat granthā āgamākhyāḥ prasāritāḥ sarvadevagaṇaistyaktaṃ tadā tu pṛthivītalam āgamairbhāsite deśe sopyagamyo bhaviṣyati cirajīvibhyaḥ pārthivaṃ liṅgapūjanam paratrāpi siddhiḥ karatale sthitā nityaṃ vidhāyādau gacchecchuddhāṃ bhuvaṃ sudhīḥ śamīgarbhāśvatthamūle nadīkūle ca nirjane vaṭādhastāttatra bhūmiṃ mantrayetprārthayediti pūjayitvā tu dharaṇīṃ prārthayediti grahīṣyāmi prasannā tvaṃ liṅgārthaṃ bhava me sadā

nidadhyātsaṃśuddhe pratyahaṃ pūjanāya tām gṛhṇīyātsaptapūjāyāstathā guhagaṇeśayoḥ namaḥ saṃghaṭṭanaṃ bhavet vastrādyācchādite pīṭhe oṃ pinākadhṛte namaḥ bhedena tatra dhyāyecchivaṃ prabhum pūjyaḥ pañcopacārakaiḥ gaṇataye glauṃ gaṃ hrīṃ ca bhavākṣaraḥ imānmanūn gṛhītvā tu japedaṣṭasahasrakam śuddhaḥ pradāyārghyaṃ vivasvate piṇḍayetsveṣṭamānaṃ pātre nidhāpayet pārthivānīha pūjayemukasakhyayā gaṇeśvarasya mantreṇa kuryāddvāragaṇeśvaram sthāpayetpīṭhe tato viprassamācaret aviprāṇāñchṛṇu nyāsaṃ gopyaṃ pārthivapūjane hrauṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktirnamaḥ kīlakamucyate bījapūrvāṃstu nyāse mantrānpravinyaset cānantaśaktiśivāya ca bahusthaleṣu gaditā atotra noktāḥ |] mṛttikām kuryādaghoreṇārcayettatpuruṣeṇa ca gaṇeśānaṃ pīṭhamadhye niveśayet aṃguṣṭhamānādadhikaṃ vitastyavadhisundaram pakvajambūphalākāraṃ sarvakāmasamṛddhidam syātsvalpe siddhirna jāyate avaśiṣṭamṛdā kuryātkumārantasya mantrataḥ arccayanpārthivaṃ liṅgaṃ yathoktaphalabhāgbhavet

tāntriko māsamantraistu phalārthī śivamarcayet parāprāsādabījādyaiḥ pūjayetkaulikaistu taiḥ dhyāyetkāmanābhedanāttu tat dhyānamidaṃ jñeyaṃ noktaṃ vā yatra tatra ca trilocanaṃ caturbāhuṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam vyāghracarmottarīyaṃ ca nāgayajñopavītakam varadābhayahastaṃ ca namajjanavarapradam kapilaṃ dantanakhābhidyotakāriṇam surāsuranamaskṛtam sarvavyāpinamīśānaṃ rudraṃ vai viśvarūpiṇam manuṣyaistvaṃ siddhairdevāsurādibhiḥ svāminsarvajagannātha yāvatpūjāvasānakam deveśaṃ pārthivaṃ pūjayettataḥ kārtikeyaḥ proktā pūjeyamuttamā vidhijñaiḥ sā pūjeyaṃ madhyamā tadā dhūpadīpanivedyādi yathāṃśena nivedayet paśupatiṃ tathā kṣityaptejonilākāśayajamānendubhāskarāḥ dhūpadīpanivedyādinamaskārapradakṣiṇaiḥ oṃ namaśca śivo ṅentaḥ prasannāyedamuccaret pūjānteṣṭhottaraśataṃ japenmantramananyadhīḥ ekādaśāhutīḥ paścātpraṇameddaṇḍavatkṣitau patnīṃ ṅentāṃ namonvitām dvitīyāntaistarpayāmi bilvapatrairjalākṣataiḥ bhojayedekamabhāve vedavittamam

siddhissyānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā sā pūjā snānadānādikāḥ kriyāḥ taṇḍulodbhavapiṣṭena vidyārthī tu sahasrakam vidyāṃ dhyānamasya nirūpyate caturdikṣu tathā yaśaḥ kṛṣṇāgurorliṃgaṃ pūjitaṃ dhāraṇāpradam prāgvadvrīhimayaṃ liṃgaṃ kṛtvā hanyātskhaladgiram dadhaddhastairvaṭamūlamupāśritaḥ tu liṃgāni māsātsā sarvatomukhī nīlakaṇṭhastrinetraḥ nadītīradvayānītamṛdā tāni ca pūjayet indranīlaśaraccandranibho bhūṣaṇapūgavān pīyūṣapūrṇakalaśaṃ dadhatpāśāṃkuśāvapi pārthivānyatha vā kuryādardhalakṣamitāni tu dadhibhaktastu naivedye paiṣṭenātra yathecchayā dvayaṃ pūjyaṃ dhyānamatra nirūpyate lohaliṃgāni tuṣajānyatha vāpi ca śmaśānamṛttikāyāstu vidveṣe yutamācaret dveṣe dhyātavyaḥ punarīdṛśaḥ || muṇḍamālālasatkaṇṭho rāvavitrāsitākhilaḥ koṭiliṃgāni pūjayeddhyānamucyate dhyāye śivāliṅgitamaṣṭadeham divyānbhogānavāpnoti dhyānamatra nirūpyate liṅgānyayutasaṅkhyāni dhātrī phalabhavāni tu labhate bhūmiṃ trisandhyaṃ tvekameva vā

viśvavandyaṃ nikhilabhayaharaṃ pañcavaktraṃ trinetram pṛthakpṛthagbilvadalaistatra dhyānamudīryate diśatu girisutāyā vallabho no vibhūtīḥ prītivṛddhaye pūjayitvā bhartuḥ priyatarā bhavet gomayasyāpi vālukāyāstathā phalam niścalamanā jaganmitraṃ sa jāyate saśāstrābhyasanādeva gurutopyadhiko bhavet patrairnaivedyaṃ guḍamarpayet liṅgāni gomayasyaiva yo yajet sampado yāyātṣaṇmāsānevamācaret durbhūpānāmaṣṭaśataṃ tripakṣaṃ nityamarcayet || kruddhaṃ maheśvaraṃ dhyāyetsaparājayate ripūn sahasrāṇāṃ pañcakena mahīpatim durganirmuktikāmastu kuryātpañcasahasrakam mahādurganibaddhastu ṣaṇmāsānmokṣamāpnuyāt vā pañcaśataṃ pūjayecca tripakṣakam nāsti sukhenāyāti deśataḥ pañcaśatakaṃ yorcayettu tadantakaḥ pūrvajanmārjitādvāpi dāridryātparimucyate māsamātreṇa sakalaṃ kalmaṣaṃ dahet varṣatrayaṃ tasya sarvapāpanāśaḥ prajāyate syāttrivarṣaṃ vā pūjayetsphāṭikaṃ tathā kanyakā satpatiṃ labhet sarvaguṇā jāyante samupasthitāḥ

rudrasaṅkhyaṃ varṣādgrāma patirbhavet naktabhojī ca rudrasūktaparāyaṇaḥ saubhāgyaṃ nirdhanasyāpi vardhate pratyahaṃ cedannaṃ kṣetre bhavedbahu dhattūrakusumotthāni liṅgānyekādaśārcayet cāyutasaṅkhyāni vaśīkuryājjagattrayam śeṣaḥ] phalaliṅgāni pūjyāni tena cāyutasaṅkhyayā tasyālpamṛtyunāśaḥ syāttathā nīvārapiṣṭajāt tāmrajaṃ liṅgaṃ tasya siddhyati pauṣṭikam pūjanāttasya bahusvāmitvamāpnuyāt liṅgamayutaṃ paripūjayet saṅkalpenātra saṃśayaḥ || dehasaugandhyalābhāya gandhakotthaṃ samarcayet pūjayedyastu dāridryātpratimucyate mudgapiṣṭānmude nityaṃ liṅgaṃ pūjyaṃ trayaṃ dvijaiḥ māṣapiṣṭamayaṃ liṅgaṃ nityapiṣṭānnasiddhidam [sīsakasya ||] liṅgaṃ priyadaṃ sarvadehinām priyaṃ tasya liṅgaṃ kṛtvā tadāpnuyāt pūjayedyastu tasya syāddviguṇākṛtiḥ kāryasya siddhiṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ matimāñchivena saha modate pāṣāṇaṃ pāṣāṇātsphāṭikaṃ param kāśmīrātpuṣparāgotthamiṃdranīlodbhavaṃ tataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ tasmācchreṣṭhaṃ tu rājatam

hīrakātpāradaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bāṇaliṅgaṃ tataḥ param bāṇāsurārcitaṃ liṅgaṃ bāṇaliṅgamitīritam cāndrāyaṇasamaṃ jñeyaṃ śambhornaivedyabhakṣaṇam jalaṃ cānnaṃ grāhyaṃ prāsādasañjñayā sarvaliṅgebhyastaddhi pajyatamaṃ matam liṅgamākhyātaṃ pañcasūtraiḥ susādhitam pūjanīyaṃ na kadāpi na satphalam śālagrāmo nārmadaśca sūkṣmaḥ sūkṣmo viśiṣyate pūjayetsatataṃ liṅgaṃ tattanmaṃtreṇa sādaram śambhornacāvaidikavartmanā śraddhā pūte vaidikakarmaṇi pārthivaliṅgataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ pārthivaṃ tu kalau yuge pūjayetpārthivaṃ liṅgaṃ śāstroktavidhinā naraḥ yathākathaṃcidvidhinā ramaṇīyaṃ prakalpayet ratnahemadharāsūtapiṣṭasphaṭikasambhavam tu dvikhaṇḍaṃ tu sthiraṃ smṛtam pītā ca śūdrāṇāṃ kṛṣṇā vā labhyate yathā śarvāya śaśimauline pūjāsamāptau tu dadyātpuṣpāñjalitrayam vakṣyamāṇāṃ stutiṃ paścātpaṭheddevasya tuṣṭaye sarvalokānāṃ tvameva jagataḥ pitā gurustvaṃ gatiḥ sākṣī tvaṃ pitā tvaṃ pitāmahaḥ dharmarūpahitāya ca caiva pāvakāmitatejase

somāya amṛtāya namostu te dharmagovāhanāya ca bhagavānrudro vāñchitārthaṃ prayacchatu athaikādaśaliṅgānāṃ vidhānamabhidhīyate droṇapuṣpairghṛtameva samarpayet naivedyārthaṃ guḍassmṛtaḥ trayaṃ kṛtvā ṣoḍaśairupacārakaiḥ pañcaśatakaṃ kanyā bhavati śobhanā pūjayedyavanaivedyaṃ puṣpāṇi campakasya tu ṣaṭṣaḍbakulapuṣpaiśca naivedyaṃ kṣaudrameva ca puṣpaiḥ śatapatraiḥ prapūjayet yattīrthaṃ tadbhaveddevatāpi ca tatra laḍḍukā upacārāśca ṣoḍaśa kṛtvā naivedyaṃ pañcamāsakam kāñcanapuṣpakaiḥ pratidinaṃ naivedyaṃ pañcakhādyakam muktāphalapravālādi yadiṣṭaṃ prāpnuyācca tat sampūrṇe sañjāte ca manorathe vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta tatpramāṇena nirmitam śaivayoga ekasmiṃstu dinaṃ śivam phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ brāhmaṇāṃścāpi homārthaṃ vṛṇuyāttataḥ prāṇapratiṣṭhāpūrvantu vahnisthāpanamācaret yajelliṅgaṃ tanmitaṃ homamācaret tilājyābhyāṃ careddhomametadbhinnaṃ yadarthayet

mārjanaṃ kuryāttato brāhmaṇabhojanam pūjayitvā dadyāttaṃ gurave punaḥ bhūyasīṃ dattvā suhṛdbhissaha bhojanam pārthivānāṃ sarvakāmaprapūrakaḥ udyāpanena sahitaḥ kimanyacchrotumicchasi pārthiva pūjāvidhiḥ varṇanaṃnāma navamaḥ prakāśaḥ ūrdhvāmnāyaṃ kvaciddakṣamuttaraṃ paścimaṃ kvacit kvacidbauddhaṃ pākhaṇḍaṃ ca kvacitkvacit mārgaṃ vedāntaṃ vaidikaṃ kvacit deśadharmānkāladharmāñjātidharmānkvacitkvacit brūhi niḥsandehā ca māṃ kuru tattadādhikyaṃ sāhaṅkāraṃ bravīmi tat sarveṣāṃ pṛṣṭaṃ tattvaṃ bravīmi tat kalerdaśasahasrāṇi yadā varṣāṇi yānti ca devi jñeyaḥ kālaḥ samāgataḥ śāstrāṇi tathā jānantu devatāḥ tāvattanmārgiṇāṃ saukhyaṃ vedamārgodya kuṇṭhitaḥ tānānayanti sve mārge yattattāvatsukhaṃ bhavet ṣaḍaṅgairvedārthajñānaṃ bhavati niścitam kālamaheśasya pañcāmnāyā mayoditāḥ pramāṇaṃ vedāssyustadaṃśāḥ smṛtayastathā vayaṃ yasya vācamartho'nudhāvati lakṣaṇe devi svācārādbrāhmaṇo bhavet caturlakṣaṇahīnānāṃ mārgāssyuḥ kaulikādayaḥ yathākālaṃ kartavyo dharmasaṃgrahaḥ

yatkiñcijjanma yatkarma na japona tapaḥ kriyāḥ dharmaḥ sopi vākkāyakarmabhiḥ bhuktvā yātyante paramaṃ padam jīvanmuktaṃ na saṃśayaḥ tanmanasā yena jīvanmuktaḥ sa eva hi duḥkhaṃ syātkarmaṇā sa vimucyate nirvāhastāvatkālaṃ parikṣipet kāmayetkiñcijjīvanmuktaḥ sa eva hi tadaṃśārādhanātsaiva prasannā cedvimuñcati pratāryate ceyaṃ jīvanmuktaḥ sa ucyate viditaṃ bandhātsvayaṃ muktastadā bhavet śukavadyopratigrāhī jīvanmuktaḥ sa kopi hi galito jīvanmuktassa eva hi sarvaṃ yo nayetsa tu mokṣavān sambhāvayannityaṃ mahākāle layaṃ vrajet samastairathavājñātairvañciteyaṃ na cetaraiḥ mahākālaṃ jīvanmuktastadā bhavet yairjñātā gurumārgeṇa tairbandhoyaṃ vimocitaḥ parityajya yetra magnāstu te hatāḥ bhogopi mokṣopi bhavedyeṣāṃ ca durgatiḥ bhavettejaḥ śiṣyopi labhate sukham syācchiṣyaḥ syādduḥkhabhājanam kuryātkiñcidbrāhmaṇatāṃ gataḥ kathaṃ lapsyāmyahaṃ sukham mako nityamitthaṃ vicārayet

ye kecinmāse madye ratā vayam pūrvoktalakṣaṇairyuktāstepi śiṣyāḥ prakīrtitaḥ tathā viṣṇustasyājñāvaśavartinaḥ caturlakṣaṇasampanno vipro jñeyosti madhyamaḥ phalati cādyasya kriyayā cāparasya tu phalade sto na vāmake syātāṃ na kadācana vaidikaḥ śūdrādiyavanāntānāṃ siddhirvāmapathe sthitā spṛśedvaiṣṇavaṃ vipraṃ praṇamenna ca vaidikam tadvartmatvādvratairviṣṇoḥ pūtā niṣkilviṣāstathā satsaṅgaśca vivekaśca niścalaṃ nayanadvayam sāṃsārikasukhāsaktaṃ brahmajñosmīti vādinam māṃsaṃ surāpānaṃ matsyastrībāndhavāstathā mārge guptaṃ bhuktaṃ palādikam sadā sevyo vaidiko dharmasañcayaḥ vinānyasya strīgo vāpi sa nārakī guruścaiva śiṣyaśca yoginīnāṃ bhavetpaśuḥ bāhubhyāṃ tartumicchati te bhuktimuktyośca bhājanam dṛṣṭvā rājāno daṇḍayantu vā lakṣmīstiṣṭhatu vā yātu na muñcāmi pathastvimān nārthalobhānna ca krodhānna dveṣānna ca matsarāt nārcayeddevīṃ mārgesminvighnamāpnuyāt soyaṃ kaulo na cetaraḥ pratyakṣaphaladantadevottamadarśanam

pūrvavimohitāḥ ityevācaraṇaṃ proktaṃ pāmarāḥ pravadanti ca sarve kiṃ siddhā na bhavantvime tadā mokṣo māṃsādanyanna bhuñjate muktāssyuḥ kasya janma bhaviṣyati bhujaṅgāvaraṇaṃ nūnaṃ śakyaṃ vai kulavartmataḥ jñeyaṃ vedādiṣu nirūpitam paśūnāṃ tu kaulikānāṃ mahatphalam surāmadyaṃ sarveṣāmuttamaṃ smṛtam surādarśanamātreṇa kuryātsūryāvalokanam ājānubhyāṃ bhavetsnānaṃ nābhyāmupavasedahaḥ kṛte vahnijvaladdaṇḍaṃ praveśayet hanyādātmārthaṃ prāṇinaḥ priye durācārastiryagyoniṣu jāyate ca khādatyaṣṭau ca te samāḥ vadhabandhādyarityekastrividho mataḥ vāpi hatvā pāpairna lipyate adhikārī bhaktiyukto yo bhavedgurusevakaḥ pūrvaṃ bhaktiyogaṃ tu dakṣiṇam mātṛkānyāsasaṃsthāne vāme kaulikavartmani dvipamāye kamalājaladhī tathā samudratanayāpīṭhe kṣetrayuglokamātṛkā ramāguhyau padmācaraṇakau tathā aṇḍajāśca mahālakṣmīstu jarāyujalakṣmikā truṭyame ca caṇḍikā ca kalānvitā

ambikāghaṭike ceva muhūrtaśca satīyutaḥ sandhyā ca pārvatī rātrisaṃyutā dākṣāyaṇyā tathā vāraṃ haimavatyāyutaṃ nyaset ca karaṇaṃ mṛḍānyā pakṣameva ca athartuparameśvaryau kālī cāyanasaṃyutā yādisthāneṣu vinyaset tato vāṇī pañcakarmendriyānvitā ca vāgantaḥkaraṇānvitā ceti vyāpakaṃ vidyayā nyaset vadetprapañcarūpāyai śriyai nama iti kramāt mātṛkānyāsasaṃproktasthāneṣu tadanantaram parāmbādevyai ca namoktyā vyāpakaṃ nyaset tritāramūlamantrānte vibhāgenākṣarāṇi ca tu koṭi guhyapadaṃ vadet procya proktāṅgeṣu pravinyaset sthāne sthānayugme dvayaṃ dvayam lokānāmatalaṃ vitala tathā bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca maharjanastapastathā dvitīyetha cātiguhyamacintyakam yoginīsthāne rahasyaṃ jñānamagrataḥ ḍākinīṃ cātha mahārahasyahākinī śrīhākinīṃ paścānmahākāyaṃ ca yākinīm malādhāraṃ svādhiṣṭhānanābhikam tritāramūlamantrānte caturdaśa tu vaṃ vadet pravakṣyāmi tatrādau praṇavatrayam

yuktānproktāṅgeṣu pravinyaset dakṣapārśve tu madhusūdanaḥ rukmiṇīyugvāmakaṭyāṃ kāntiyuktastu vāmanaḥ ekanāsāhṛṣīkeśo dakṣajānuni vinyaset dakṣāyāṃ jaṅghāyāṃ vāsudevayuk saṅkarṣaṇayutā dakṣapāde pradyumnasaṃyutā vinyasyāḥ sānusvārādipūrvakāḥ dakṣapāde karabhadrābhavau matau īśānau jagatsthānasamanvitaḥ jñānanādī ca tataṣṭaṅko dharāyutaḥ bhavennyāsaḥ pāde brahmā ca pakṣiṇī coruge ca sraṣṭāraṃ haritānanām hiraṇyagarbhaṃ ca brahmarandhre pravinyaset āryāparāmbādevyai ca namasā vyāpakaṃ caret bhūtapretajanādyaiśca sa japī naiva bādhyate aṃśā na ca tṛpyanti mātaraḥ ca varṇānāṃ pātralakṣaṇamucyate śaṅkhasaddārukūrmādikapālālābumanmayam nātisūkṣmaṃ chinnaṃ bhinnaṃ vivarjayet suvarṇe syādduḥkhāntastārapātrataḥ kūrmaje jñānaṃ śuktirmuktipradāyinī vīrasaṃsiddhiralāvau yogasiddhayaḥ jambālasadṛśaṃ pacet punardinadvayaṃ sthāpya punarevaṃ prakalpayet kuryāttāṇḍulīyā surā smṛtā

somapānaṃ tu tatsmṛtam bhavati vinā kaṣṭena vāminām śaktisomo nigadyate taccakrapūjānte vājapeyaphalapradam pānādagnidānaphalaṃ labhet pacedanalanāmāsau mahāpātakanāśanaḥ jambūtvagghātakīpuṣpaṃ tadardhaṃ nārikelajam tāvadvibhītakaṃ proktaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ kaṭutrayam bhrāmayetsamyaganulomavilomataḥ pākaḥ syādvāruṇīyantragaṃ pacet pūrvaṃ svayaṃ pītā tu bhairavaiḥ pākassyāccheṣamanyatpuroktavat vaśyā mānuṣīṇāntu kā kathā kṣaudraṃ ca bhāgaikena vivardhitam madyaṃ yoginīpānamuttamam dadhi saṃgrāhyaṃ catuḥśataguṇo guḍaḥ dadhicaturthāṃśastatsammardyaghaṭe kṣipet tathā paiṣṭī trividhā tu surā smṛtā brahmānandasurā yaistu vipraiḥ pītā tu kaulikaiḥ brahmaciṃtaivaṃ nityamevaṃ mataṃ satām cāṇḍālavadbahiṣkāryo nāsau vāmī na kaulikaḥ te tu tadgandhaṃ sa tu vandyo bhaveddvijaḥ paiṣṭī gauḍī bhogapradāyinī vidyāpradaikṣavī proktā khārjūrī ripunāśinī śrīdā nimbajā roganāśinī

rucikaraṃ sāmodaṃ ca manoharam deyāstatorcayet vatsavṛkṣasya ca tu valkalam binduścāṣṭagandhābhidhāno devatāpriyaḥ kuryādetatkarma na lopayet dravairvāthābhāve tarpaṇamācaret kaulikavāmānāṃ mantradevāḥ śramāturāḥ ca bhaktebhyo mantrā yacchanti taṃ vinā vāme kṣudrā api vicārataḥ mekaikaṃ tarpaṇāya prayojayet gandhapuṣpākṣataiḥ pūjā cānyathā narakaṃ vrajet paśotvaṃ hi nāśivastvaṃ śivo hyasi tadānande tasmātsevyamidaṃ priye vātha vaṭakā masūrāṇāntathaiva ca kuryānmāṃsamatsyābhyāṃ vinā dravyeṇa pūjanam devatābhāvonyathā pretavibhāvanam vaiśyirgolambhane peyaṃ śūdraiḥ strīratikarmaṇi smaranpibenmadyaṃ khādenmāsaṃ na doṣa bhāk madhumāṃsāni tṛptaye cetsa pātakī vinānyatra sa mahāpātakī bhavet kaulānāṃ pūjānte na vigarhitam niṣavyante cānyathā patito bhavet pānāddevatāśāpamāpnuyāt tatskandhe citāṃ veṣṭuṃ samudyataḥ śakreṇa tūrṇa nirvāpito jalaiḥ

tadbindupātanirdagdhā dharaṇīyaṃ tadābhavat laghubhirbāṇaistvadaṅgāni samācchinat pīḍitaścāhaṃ yāto dharmokhilastadā pariṣvaktastava śokaśca vismṛtaḥ vākyaṃ viṣṇuḥ provāca pārvati śarīreṇa saha praveṣṭuṃ havyavāhane śāstramanādṛtya kathaṃ deva vimohitaḥ śleṣagiro'ṅgaistu satyāścedaṃ dharātalam saṃśuddhiṃ viprāṇāṃ vāpi śuddhatām mayā proktaṃ sammatīkṛtya viṣṇunā viprāḥ śāpanirdagdhāḥ śabdabrahmavivarjitāḥ pīṭhasañjātāḥ śāpanirdagdhavipratāḥ pūjyatvātkaulīnapatha ucyate tayostatrādhikāraḥ samudāhṛtaḥ pāramparyamajñātvā kauladharme viśanti te hyasiddho yaḥ palaṃ vai bhoktumicchati svairavṛtterdurātmanaḥ śāstravidhimutsṛjya vartate kāmacārataḥ nindyaśca vede caiva tathaiva saḥ tadaṅgaromasaṅkhyātabhūtayoniṣu jāyate tapaścaryā na dharmo na ca satkriyā viṣayāsaktaḥ patatyeva na saṃśayaḥ cāgatya mahāyajñavanaṃ śrayet ciccandrakuṇḍalīśaktimudrayā syātsukhāśayaḥ proktamitare madyapāyinaḥ

cittaṃ palāśī sa nigadyate proktaḥ śeṣā dhīvaravṛttayaḥ sevayedyastu sa bhavecchaktisevakaḥ gurumukhātsamyak sevate sa ca mucyate ātmasthānamanudravyadevaśuddhimprakalpayet syādātmaśodhanam vitānadhūpadīpādyaiḥ sthānaśuddhiriyaṃ matā kramotkramatrirāvṛttirmantraśuddhiriyammatā darśayeddhenumudrāṃ ca dravyaśuddhiriyammatā mūlena dīpadānaṃ pradarśayet phaladā jñeyā tvanyathā niṣphalā bhavet vidhivallikhitvā tatra pūjayet maṇḍitaṃ yena maṇḍalaṃ tatsadāśivam cārdhacandraṃ pūrṇaṃ pūrṇagirirmataḥ śāṃkhamarghyaṃ bhogapūjābalipātrāṇi pañca ca mantrapūtena kuleśvari vidhānavit paryuṣitocchiṣṭairdurgandhairgandhavarjitaiḥ svādiṣṭhaiśca madotsiktairdravyairamṛtasannibhaiḥ surā pāpā kalahavyādhiduḥkhadā vidhivatkuladravyaṃ tatorcayet āyuḥśrīkīrtisaubhāgyadharmavidyāvivardhinī saṃśayaḥ || vinā dravyādhivāsena na smarenna japettathā vinā mantro na mantreṇa vināśayaḥ tarpaṇayogyaṃ syāddevatāprītikārakam pūjayet

ślokānetānpaṭhetpaścāttānbravīmi śṛṇu priye nidhehyamṛtarūpiṇi nidhehyasminvastuni klinnarūpiṇi bhūtvāmṛtāparākāre mayi visphuraṇaṃ kuru amṛtavarṣiṇītipadaṃ vadet proktaḥ pañcatriṃśadbhirakṣaraiḥ saṃspṛśyārccanapātrantu pūjayeddhenumudrayā mahāmadyapīyūṣarasamāvaha nyāsoktasarvamantraiśca svātmānaṃ plāvayettathā tarpayedādau ādināthaḥ sadāśivaḥ dvādaśa tataḥ siddhaughāstānpratarpayet vyāsaśca vāmadevaḥ śukastathā tarpayetṣaṇnṛsiṃhaṃ ca maheśaṃ bhāskaraṃ tathā ca siddhaughe mānavaughe sadāśivam āvāhayeddevīṃ mantrābhyāṃ pūjayettathā mātaradyaihi parameśvari pūjayāmīha tāvattvaṃ susthirā bhava cinmayasyāprameyasya nirguṇasyāśarīriṇaḥ liṅgasthaṇḍilavahnyapsu phalake mūrdhni maṇḍale rūpiṇaṃ kṛtvā karmakāṇḍe ratā janāḥ sarvagato devaḥ pratimādau virājate viśvāsātsānnidhyaṃ devatā labhet cājyaṃ punastadapi poṣayet devo na dadāti phalaṃ nṛṇām pratiṣṭhāpyārcayeddevi anyathā niṣphalaṃ matam

sādhayate sarvaṃ hīnamaṃgaṃ yathā tathā sarvaṃ vyarthaṃ bhavati śāmbhavi svayaṃ jātaṃ pūjitaṃ sukhadāyakam gamyatvānnaśvaratvācca tādṛk tāntrikapūjanam yantramityāhuretasmindevastu paripūjitaḥ kaulādau guptametatprakāśitam dinānsarvān gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ tarpayeddadhibindubhiḥ apātrasyedamaṣṭau ca tarpayeddevatāmukham antaḥśaktimanusmṛtya tarpayeddehadevatām tasmāttābhyāṃ tarpaṇīyaṃ yantraṃ tattu tayoḥ priyam tarjanyaṃguṣṭhayogena tarpayedābhicārike santarpya devādīngurupaṅktiṃ prapūjayet siddhaughairyajati gurupaṅktiṃ kṛtamatiḥ kadalyādiphalānyevaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca samarpayet mukhyaḥ surādyantena nirmitam yastu mahādevaṃ prapūjayet pūjayettasmādgandhapuṣpāsavāmiṣaiḥ kṣetrapatye dadyādasya manuṃ śṛṇu kapilajaṭābhārabhāsurapiṃgala phaṭ svāhā ṣaṭ catvāriṃśadarṇakaḥ santuṣṭo baṭukaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ vadetkramāt pūjābaliṃ gṛhṇīta ityapi catuścatvāriṃśadarṇo mantroyaṃ parikīrtitaḥ

vyomacarīprītā sadāstu me saptadaśākṣaraḥ pātālatalasaṃsthāśca śivayogena bhāvitāḥ tṛpyantu prītamanaso bhūtā gṛhṇantvimaṃ balim sarvopacārasahitamimaṃ pūjābaliṃ vadet kṣetrapālasya samproktaḥ sarvasiddhividhāyakaḥ balidānena sarvarakṣāṃ karotu me bhairavādhiṣṭhitāyākṣo vadediti mahākṣetrapālāya vauṣaḍ humiti kṣetrapālasya mahāprītikaraḥ paraḥ imāṃ pūjābalimataḥ param rājarājeśvarākhyasya daivatasya samarcane prasīdatu sarvadā dadyāt kṣetrapālāya dakṣiṇe aṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyāntu baṭukasya bhavedbaliḥ aṃgulībhiśca sarvābhirdadyādbhūtabaliṃ dvijaḥ aṃguṣṭhamadhyamābhyāṃ tu rājarājeśvarasya ca supiṣṭena kuryādvedāṃgulonnatān karṣājyagrāhiṇaḥ kuryānnava saptātha pañca ca kuladīpaṃ nivedayet devi gṛhāṇa mama siddhaye gurupādarajojoṣī śraddhābhaktisamanvitaḥ pibenmadyaṃ ceti śāstrasya niścayaḥ niṣphalaṃ tasya devatā na prasīdati khaṭakī caiva kaivartī viśvayonikā

cāpi śastrījīvā tu rañjakī mantrasamāyuktāḥ samayācārapālikāḥ pūjayetkulamārgasthastatra śaktimanusmaran svataḥ prāptā sā pūjyā sahasā budhaiḥ śāntānukūlā muditā śuciḥ ca smitāsyā priyavādinī viśeṣajñā devatārādhanotsukā kutsitā stabdhā nirlajjā kalahapriyā mantrayuktāṃ hi striyaṃ yogī vivarjayet mantrī devyai samarpayet kāmaṃ tato deyaṃ śeṣikāyai sa kathyate vadet || sarvavaśaṅkari svāhā caikaviṃśativarṇakaḥ devīmucchiṣṭamātaṅgī dhyāyellokaikamohinīm pātramuddhṛtya sadvitīyaṃ samarpayet kṛtvā pibettattadanujñayā dvitīyena gṛhṇīyānmantramuccaret kāraṇaṃ bhairavoditam bhāvānāṃ bhāvāścāntaritā rase devīṃ pūrṇakāmaḥ pibāmyaham kuryānmadhupānaṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ guruṇā śiṣyebhyaḥ śeṣado bhavet strīgurujyeṣṭhapūjyānāṃ purataścopaviśya ca pibenmadyaṃ sa surāpo nigadyate kuṇḍalyākṛticidrūpe huneddravyaṃ samantrakam homasvīkāralakṣaṇam

yāvadullāsaparyaṃtamupadeśaiḥ pibenmadhu tadvijānīyādyadanena samaṃ pibet pānaṃ kevalaṃ viṣabhakṣaṇam devyagrataḥ pānaṃ vīraṃ mṛdvāsane kṛtam kaulikācāraṃ lokadvayaphalapradam mitraṃ pātramelāpakāvṛtam śāntaiḥ paradravyaparāṅmukhaiḥ strīstutairdhanyaiḥ sundarairmṛduvādibhiḥ prayogasiddhairdravyāḍhyairbhāgyavadbhiśca kāmukaiḥ melaṃ ca saukhyavṛddhirdvayorbhavet parāṅmukhā yānti vighnāścaiva pade pade mohena devatāśāpamāpnuyāt anabhijñairanarhaiśca saṃkaraṃ naiva kārayet pūrvadakṣiṇayoraikyamudakpaścimayostathā samantrapādukāmūlamantrajaptaṃ pibettataḥ pūrvavajjaptvā pibettacca guruṃ smaret svajyeṣṭhasyāpi cocchiṣṭaṃ khādennānyasya karhicit śaktyucchiṣṭaṃ pibenmadyaṃ vīrocchiṣṭaṃ tu carvaṇam bhakṣayetstrīṇāṃ nābhyaḥ svocchiṣṭamarpayet tatorcayeddevīṃ tarpaṇādi samācaret smareddhyanyonyamiti pātramelanam abhīṣṭasiddhidāṃ nātaḥ paraṃ kiñcicca vidyate lakṣmīḥ kolāsuraṃ hatvāśeṣāttadrudhiraṃ papau viṣṇunā vāpi mayāpi praṣṭumicchatā sakalaṃ jātaṃ mumūrṣuriva dṛśyate

jāte brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ munayo vidhe viśrīkatā kutaḥ mahadidaṃ viṣṇustūṣṇīmupasthitaḥ jātā gatā tasmādrasātalam tasmādviṣṇuḥ śivohaṃ ca yūyaṃ śakrapurogamāḥ ārādhayantu tāṃ devīṃ stuvantu ca mahāstavaiḥ kiñcicchobhāṃ śriyo dṛṣṭvā cakrurārādhanaṃ tataḥ varṣatrayādūrdhvaṃ pratyakṣā śrīrvyajāyata hāsitaṃ viprairdevaiścākulitaṃ kutaḥ mayā proktā sarvaṃ viśvaṃ tvayā tatam mayā hāsyaṃ kṛtaṃ hṛdayasākṣiṇī prasīdeśe lokayātrāṃ ca nirvaha bhaginī tatpradhānantu pūjanam māyāprapañcoyaṃ vṛthā bhavati māṃ vinā bhogavāñchā devatātvaṃ paratra cet gopyaṃ tadvidhiṃ kathayāmyatha kārye kārye vā pūrṇatāṅgate yoge vā śaktisaṅgame niśīthe vāṣṭamīyute caturdaśyāṃ yogoyaṃ śaktisaṅgamaḥ proktaṃ yathecchākrāḍanāya tu devīmabhyarcya kāmanām sampravakṣyāmi cānukalpaṃ prakalpayet tatrādau tāntrikoṣṭavidhaḥ smṛtaḥ kukkuṭaśceti sāmānyaṃ pūrvapūrvataḥ

sādhakendreṇa sadyo yoti ca sundaraḥ mūlyādgṛhīto vāpīṣṭo daivataḥ svayamāgataḥ bhavedbaliyogyaśca nānyaścaurādikāhṛtaḥ mahākrūro nirukkṛṣṇaikavarṇakaḥ devatāyā varṇarūpo gadoñjhitaḥ vigandhīkṛtya balaye yogyaḥ sarvottamastvayam prītidaśca yajñeṣyeṣa viśiṣyate vihīnāṇḍo bālo vṛddho na śasyate māṃsabhārāttathānena samo vai sāraso varaḥ varṣādūrdhvaṃ gṛhe puṣṭo balyarthaṃ yogya ucyate māṃsalastvekavarṇo vā tāmracūḍo viśiṣyate nītāḥ kukkuṭā balayokhilaiḥ vastrasaṃveṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā chedayecchurikādibhiḥ pūrvapūrvatrāpi cokto viśiṣṭo devatoṣakaḥ yamairyuktaḥ sakalairmūrtirātmana sarocanamatikrūradaivate vaṭakānvitam kāliyugaṃ yajñeśvari lohapadam vadet aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā tata utthāya sādhakaḥ mūlamantreṇa sapuṣpākṣatacandanam cālayedgātraṃ paśustāvanna hanyate sādhakaḥ paścādimaṃ mantramudīrayet sarvarūpiṇaṃ balirūpiṇam cāmuṇḍābalirūpārthaṃ bale tubhyaṃ namostu te ghātayāmyadya tasmādyajñe baṃdhovadhaḥ cintayitvā nyasetpuṣpaṃ mbhakenāsya mastake

khaḍgeti mantreṇa taṃ khaḍgaṃ paripūjayet prahāreṇa cchinno daivatatuṣṭaye varṣasyābhyantarevaśyaṃ rājyanāśaḥ prajāyate rāmā narāścordhvaṃ nimantrayet cakrapūjotsavārthaṃ tvaṃ śvo mayāmantrito hyasi strībhyaśca puruṣā nyūnā adhikāste tu hānidāḥ dīkṣāniratā nimaṃtryāścakrapūjane paśyeccakravighnaṃ tathā śubham śāntirgāṇeśvaro homo grahāṇāṃ bhairavasya ca ||] namaśca triruccārya amukakṣetrapālaka cakravighnakarāṃstambhayayugmakam kṛtyaṃ nirvartya sāyaṃ cakraṃ prapūjayet tatra devīmāvāhyārcanamācaret bhakṣyāṇi yojayetsopadaṃśakaiḥ śaktayaśca tathā vīrāḥ pūjyāḥ puṣpākṣatādibhiḥ cogragandhapuṣpādibhiryajet taddoṣaparihārārthaṃ bhairavaṃ pūjayāmyaham gṛhṇayugaṃ huṃ phaṭ svāhā dvāviṃśadakṣaraḥ samāgatya praṇameccakrasaṃsthitān pariṣiñcetsāmayikānarthaśāntistavaṃ paṭhet śirasā nāthaṃ bhairavaṃ bhairavīpriyam śrīnāthavaidyāya kulauṣadhividhāyine vinaśyantu divyacakrasya melanāt kāntirmanorathaścāstu pāntu sarvāśca devatāḥ śāntimbhagavānkuleśaḥ

viśeṣapadabhedakaśāmbhavā ye bhūmipatigodvijasādhulokāḥ guṇāntamanaso hṛtaśokaśaṅkāḥ kumāryo nandantu bhāvaniratā gurubhaktiyuktāḥ yasyāṃ guroścaraṇapaṅkajameva labhyam ripupakṣabhakṣaṇaparāstṛpyantu kaulārcitāḥ kulamārgapālanaparāḥ śāṃtiṃ prayacchantu me pāntu vīrendravandyā kulaputrakasya pibataḥ pānammadīyaṃ varam vāpi ca kauliko yadi tadā syānme jayaḥ sarvadā kṣetrapālāśca mama dehe vyavasthitāḥ kālājñādiśivāntañca pānayajñena tṛpyatām kumbhasthaṃ yoginībhyaḥ pṛthak pṛthak strīṇāmanyatamaṃ sthānaṃ puṃsāmanyatamaṃ pṛthak vā samyakcakrākāreṇa vāpunaḥ vīreṣu kāryākāryaṃ na vidyate devatāprītyai jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ proktaṃ charditaṃ bhairavo baliḥ nyāso'vayavasaṃsparśo bhojanaṃ havanakriyā tadullāsakṛtānāṃ ca yā ceṣṭā sā ca satkriyā vijñeyāḥ parayoginaḥ kopaśamanaṃ patanaṃ gāyanaṃ tathā bhāṣaṇaṃ caiva samutthānaṃ vijṛmbhaṇam yadollāsaḥ pravartate kaulikānbhairavāveśānyo vinindati mūḍhadhīḥ

yadyadbhaktisamāveśādadbhataṃ kaulike jane devatāsaktamanasaḥ śuddhā devi sadā hi te kaulikebhyastanmantrānprabruvanti te hasetkupyeccakre madhumadākulān kurvītanāhitaṃ ca samācaret madākulāndṛṣṭvā cintayeddevatādhiyā bhairavīcakre sarve varṇā dvijātayaḥ māhātmyaṃ devīpūjopayogataḥ cakramadhye na bhedosti sarve devasamāḥ smṛtāḥ sarvāśca pārvatyastasmādbhedaṃ na kārayet mahāmāyā bhagaliṅgāmṛtaṃ vinā saṃskārasaṃśuddhāṃ vihitatvādbrajetstriyam putrāptirnīrogo daśabhirbhavet sārvabhaumosau varṣamadhye bhaviṣyati syāddhanaprāptiścakrapūjā vidhistvayam madhumattāya cakre vācakre vā puṇyabhāksa tu proktā māsādūrdhvantu niṣphalā santoṣayektuladravyaiścakrapūjāpuraḥsaram pūjayedyoginīvṛndaṃ devi taddoṣaśāntaye pakṣe pratipadyekavārṣikīm navavarṣā ca surūpā vyaṅgavarjitā gaurī durgā ca nava kīrtitāḥ abhyaṅgasnānaśuddhaṃ tāṃ pūjāyatanamānayet gandhapuṣpākṣatairdhūpadīpaiśca kuladīpakaiḥ kadalīnārikerādiphalaistāṃ paritoṣayet

japedekottaravṛddhyā svakaṃ manum devatābuddhyā namaskṛtya visarjayet sacaturthyantaiḥ pūjayettāḥ pṛthakpṛthak tathādau ca gandhādyaiḥ paripūjayet dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā kumārīṃ tāṃ visarjayet cātra mṛto devo bhavetsa tu pūjayedbhaktyā navamātṛṣu mantravit icchājñānāṃ kriyāṃ durgāṃ baṭukaṃ ca gaṇeśvaram sarvaiśvaryasamṛddhātmā sa bhavedāvayoḥ priyaḥ sarvalakṣaṇasampannāmanukūlāṃ manoharām abhyaṅgasnānaśuddhāṅgīmāsane copaveśayet gandhapuṣpādyairalaṃkuryācca sādhakaḥ karmārcanaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpāṃśca kuladīpakān māṃsādibhakṣyabhojyādyaistoṣayedatibhaktitaḥ yauvanollāsasahitaḥ svayaṃ taddhyānatatparaḥ tayā saha niśāṃ nayet nāśaḥ syātpañcabhirbhṛguvāsaraiḥ navabhirbhṛguvāraistu devasāyujyamāpnuyāt viṣuvatyāṃ vāyane vā tatsamācaret rohiṇīcandrau svāhāgnī ca tathaiva ca navābhyarcya pūrvoktenaiva vartmanā saṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyairmadyādyaiḥ paritoṣayet sandehastuṣṭāḥ syurnava devatāḥ navavārantu dhanārthaṃ pratimāsakam puṃstvārthamaṣṭavārānsamācaret

sukhotpattistadvarṣepakṣapūjanam śuklāmbaradharaḥ sāyaṃ sandhyāmupāsya ca candrāstamānaparyantaṃ japenmantramananyadhīḥ yathāśakti pūjayecchaktikaulikān śuklārcanaṃ kṛtvā rātripāpaiḥ pramucyate vidhānena sarvānkāmānsamaśnute cotthāya snānaṃ sandhyāmupāsya ca gandhapuṣpādyairalaṃkṛtya ca vartayet sāvaraṇāṃ sarvairupacāraiḥ prapūjayet gururūpāya matsyamāṃsādibhakṣyakam sahito nirvikalpena cetasā tāṃ pūjāṃ devatāśca samudvaset kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ ca susthiraḥ yugmībhūtāstadāghasrakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vyapohati sambhyarcya kīrtiryāti [tasyeti śeṣaḥ |] digantaram pūjayedyastrisandhyāsu yoginyastasya vaśyagāḥ vidhānena dhanalobhavivarjitaḥ prayacchanti sādhakāyepsitaṃ phalam śrīkaṇṭhādivadabhyarcya tattalloke mahīyate sahasrakoṭiyoginyastāvanto bhairavā api viśeṣeṣu sarve muditamānasāḥ pūjitāḥ bhaktihīnāndurācārānnāśayanti prakāśakān kule jāto jyeṣṭho yadi na dīkṣitaḥ śeṣamādāya jyeṣṭhe tattu nivedayet

gurau jyeṣṭhe pūjye vāpi samāgate divā kuryādrātrau naimittikārcanam svasvagurūnmantraṃ svasvamārgeṇa tarpayet vinā māṃsaṃ kulapūjāṃ na kārayet tathā pānamekahastena nārcayet praviśeccakraṃ vinirgacchetpraṇamya ca śrīcakramekataḥ kuryādekapātre ca nārcayet cedvraṇadvandvaṃ kaulikasyākṣiyugmakam śivagaurīdhiyā sarvānbhāvayennāvamānayet cānnaṃ tadabhāve jalaṃ pibet pragṛhṇīyādanyathā narakaṃ vrajet nātibhaktaśca vivāde ca parāṅmukhaḥ kuladravyasevanānnirdhano bhavet ūrdhvaṃ galena pānācca devatāśāpamāpnuyāt ye te yānti nirayaṃ dhruvam svajyeṣṭhe kuladeśike spaśeccakraṃ kuladravyaṃ tathā gurum samuddhṛtya na pātraṃ paripūjayet śucidhiyā karāsyakṣālanādikam malaṃ mūtramadhovāyuvisarjanam ghaṭe bhinne pātre vā skhalite tathā pralāpaṃ ca viḍambambahubhāṣaṇam pātrahastaścakramadhye na nametpūrṇapātrakam spṛśetpātraṃ na ca bhindyātkadācana cālayetsthānna mudrāvarjitaṃ pibet

pātrasyāṃśadvayaṃ madyapūrṇaṃ tryaṃśantu riktakam noddharetpātramanādhāre na nikṣipet gomaye pātraṃ namonte vipramīkṣayet ca saṃgastu karaṇaṃ śrautakarmaṇām gacchanna kurvīta kadācana jñeyo rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet paśyettenoktaṃ paruṣaṃ sahet bhaktyā śrīpūrvakaṃ vidvānpraṇamya parikīrtayet gurumukhāllabdhaṃ saphalaṃ syānna cānyathā svadāravanniṣeveta kalaśāstrāṇi tāntrikaḥ chinnabhinnānvyastavarṇāṃśca vaidikān dharmaśāstraviruddho ya ācāraḥ sa tu kaulikaḥ kurvīta kṛtvā nirayamāpnuyāt vīrabhāryāṃ kumārīṃ vratadhāriṇīm snuṣāṃ sakṛtkāmagatā vṛddhāṃ naivāmanoharām śyāmāṃ pūjayetkaulikāṅganām kṣubdhāṃ vā svataḥ prārthinīṃ yabhet sahakāramaśokaṃ ca krīḍālubdhāḥ kumārikāḥ raktavasanāṃ dṛṣṭvā vandeta bhaktitaḥ kuladarśanaśāstrāṇi kuladravyāṇi kaulikān śikṣakānbodhakānyogiyoginīsiddhapūruṣān jugupseta na hasennāpamānayet kurūpetyatikṛṣṇeti na vadetkulayoṣitam paśyetpatitāṃ nagnāmunmattāṃ prakaṭastanīm śatāparādhāṃ vā puṣpeṇāpi na tāḍayet

kulayoginyaḥ kulavṛkṣeṣu sarvadā svapyātkulavṛkṣādho na copadravamācaret śleṣmāntakakarañjākṣanimbāśvatthakadambakāḥ bhṛgoḥ proktaṃ sannyāsaṃ vratadhāraṇam ekākṣarapradātāraṃ yo guruṃ cāvamanyate hananātkṣemaṃ bahūnāṃ cecchubhā gatiḥ gopayeddevi nārikelaphalāmbuvat aprakāśaprakāśābhyāṃ kṣīyante sampadāyuṣaḥ kulācāraparibhraṣṭo rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet śiṣye pātakī sa gururbhavet duḥkhāpahārāya kuryādaṣṭāṣṭapūjanam viśuddhātmā kṛtvā nyāsānpuroditān caiva kaumāri vaiṣṇavī tathā samākhyātā mayā te cāṣṭamātaraḥ saṃhāra eteṣṭau bhairavā matāḥ prauḍhāntollāsaparyantaṃ kāryaṃ siddhyatyasaṃśayam tapovidyāvrataṃ kulam sadā sevyo manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ kulāgamatvamārgoyaṃ guruṇā sampradarśitaḥ samyagācaritaścetsyādbhuktimuktyostu sādhanam bhaktimāñchiṣya ucyate ahitācaraṇācchiṣyo viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ gurumantraparityāgādrauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet nametsantāḍito vāpi prasādamiti saṃsmaret grāhyaṃ tasyājñayā mudā

kuryādagurubhiḥ sārddhaṃ nodvahettatkulodbhavām ubhayacyuta eva na saṃśayaḥ phalamāpnoti bhaktireva hi kāraṇam syādanubhūyāttadājñayā yonimāpannaḥ kravyādaiḥ sa bhakṣyate gurumitrasuhṛddāsadāsyādīnnāvamānayet namaskuryānnānābhogāya kāmayet guruḥ sarvasya kāraṇam svayaṃ śakto nāparaṃ preṣayetkvacit tiṣṭhañjāgratsvapankhādanprapibaṃścintayedgurum jātividyādhanādibhiḥ gobrāhmaṇavadhaṃ kṛtvā na yatpāpamavāpnuyāt vidhyāsanaṃ kaniṣṭhānāmitareṣāṃ samāsanam daṇḍapraṇāmaṃ kṛtvaikaṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇamācaret tataḥ śiṣyaḥ pravādayet pūjyānāmañjalistadvadanyeṣāṃ bāhyavandanam vidyādhikānsvakarmasthāñchrotriyānpraṇametsadā vikarmiṇaṃ kṛtaghnaṃ cānāśramasthaṃ namenna ca bhuktamamedhyaṃ syānmṛto jāyeta sūkaraḥ krośamātrasthito bhaktyā guruṃ pratidinaṃ namet yojanadvādaśāvadhi tattadyojanasaṃkhyākamāseṣu praṇamedgurum paśyecca rājānandevatāṃ gurum nārcayedvipro brahmarākṣasatāṃ vrajet kaniṣṭhānāṃ putravatparipālakaḥ

varṇāśramajñānatapodharmāṇāṃ ca prakāśakaḥ kaulikācāryastvanyaḥ kulaviḍambakaḥ samyagvijānāti sa guruścoddharetparam yovijānāti sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priye varārohe sa guruḥ parikīrtitaḥ śīlaṃ tathā śaktiraṣṭau pāśāḥ prakīrtitāḥ tasmātpāśaharo yotra sa gururnānya ucyate jīvacālaphalaṃ vetti sa gururnāparaḥ priye vratopavāsaniyamairbhiyo hantā gururmataḥ ādirahitaṃ sa gururdurlabhaḥ kalau vṛṇuyānnāparaṃ matimānnaraḥ bhakṣitā yena sa gururdurlabhaḥ kṣitau jñānalubdhastathā śiṣyo gurorgurvantaraṃ vrajet pratīkṣyaiva paścācchiṣye samarpayet sampradāyosti tāvatsyādyoginīpadam dadadgṛhṇanprāpnuyātāṃ piśācatām tanmantraḥ saikate śālibījavat devatāśāpamāpnoti kṛtaṃ ca viphalaṃ bhavet darśayetsamyagdīkṣaiṣā kaulikī matā abhiṣiñcetpriyaṃ śiṣyaṃ gaṇḍuṣākhyeyamīritā susampūrṇaśaṅkhena kalaśena vā pūrṇābhiṣekotra kulamārge prakīrtitaḥ piśācatvaṃ yāvadābhūtasamplavam dīkṣeyaṃ vidhinā guruṇā kṛtā dīkṣāviddhastathā hyātmā śivatvaṃ labhate drutam

parāṃ jñānakāṣṭhāṃ nirviṇṇaḥ sa śivo bhavet dīkṣāsaṃskārasampanne jātibhedo na vidyate yathocyate mahādevastathā varṇāstu dīkṣitāḥ jyeṣṭho'ntyajaḥ proktaḥ kulaśāstraviniścaye pūjyā nāvamānyāḥ kadācana mārgenyathā tu patito bhavet yogyena yallabdhaṃ tacca siddhyatyasaṃśayam anulomavilomābhyāṃ ṣaṇmāsātsiddhyate manuḥ kramotkramācchataṃ japtvā māsātsiddho bhavenmanuḥ sandehastattvaṃ sarvaṃ tadudbhavam phalaṃ cārdhaṃ kartuścārdhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ siddhirnānyathā janmakoṭibhiḥ tatparārthānusandhānaṃ kurvanmantraṃ śanairjapet japadhyānādiyuktasya kṣipraṃ mantraḥ prasiddhyati śāpaprasādadaṃ mantraṃ tattvalakṣamitaṃ japet juhuyātpaścātsaṃskṛte havyavāhane toṣayedyoginīcakraṃ yathāvidhi savistaram prayogānkurvīta tasya siddhirna saṃśayaḥ japenmantraṃ dhyānanyāsasamanvitam svaravarṇapadadvitvabinducaitanyasūcakam prāsādabījaṃ tu taruṇādityasuprabham parasparakarasparśamilitānandanirbharaiḥ bhāvayennityaṃ sa prayogairna bādhyate śāntiryenābhijāyate sampūrṇacandramaṇḍalamadhyakam

muktāsphaṭikakarpūrakundendudhavalaṃ śubham bhāvayedevaṃ parasyātmānameva vā maṇḍalaṃ pūjayedyadā devāḥ kadāciditi niścayaḥ sāgraṃ pūjitaḥ sarvamānavaiḥ granthau tattatsthāne vicintayet tatkṣaṇācchāntimāyānti sarvarogā na saṃśayaḥ sañcintayenmūrdhniṃ sa bhavedajarāmaraḥ parāprāsādabījaṃ tattaruṇādityasannibham sparśākṣaraiḥ saṃvītamantrataḥ saṃsmareditthaṃ yauvanollāsasaṃyutaḥ devadānavagandharvasiddhacāraṇaguhyakān vaśīkarotyasandehaḥ kimpunarmānavādikān smarañjapyātsa vaśyo jāyate'ciram tatkalpāgnisadṛśaṃ smaret kālānalasamaḥ sarvabhūtabhayaṃkaraḥ maṇḍalaṃ japyādaṣṭottarasahasrakam bhūtogragrahavetālapiśācānbrahmarākṣasān sa mṛtyumadhigacchati panasodumbarāśvatthaplakṣāpāmārgajaiśca vā vārdhaślokoktaistilataṇḍulasaṃyutaiḥ sahasrādayutāntaṃ ca yathākāryaṃ tathācaret pauṣṭikaṃ sandhirupakāraśca sāttvike campakadvayapālāśapāṭalaśrīkapitthajaiḥ kumāryaruṇamandārajātīkuṃdajapādibhiḥ

candanāgurukarpūrarocanākuṃkumādibhiḥ pṛthakchlokārdhasamproktaiḥ prāgvaddhomastu rājase mohanaṃ ca kautukaṃ rājasaṃ matam kṛṣṇavarṇaiśca hyagnikundarkṣavṛkṣakaiḥ madhyapādarajobhiśca śatroḥ pratikṛtiṃ caret samyakpratiṣṭhitaprāṇāṃ kuṇḍasyopari lambayet manasātyugradṛṣṭiramarṣaṇaḥ syātpiśācatā puraskṛtya paścātkarmāṇi sādhayet p. 228) mūlamantraṃ likhenmadhye sādhyanāmasamanvitam bhūgehe catuṣkoṇeṣu mantrakam ekatriṣaḍvasucatuṣkalaśānsthāpayetkramāt vāṣṭādaśa daśa sapta vā caturekakam vastraṃ śikhā kūrcaṃ nārikeraphalaṃ śiraḥ trimūrtiraṃśādimātaro bhairavānvitāḥ vidhivanmaṃtravittamaḥ āyuḥśrīkāṃtisaubhāgyavidyārogyādikaṃ bhavet akiṃcano'bhiṣiktastu mahadaiśvaryamāpnuyāt bhūtāpamṛtyurogādyā vinaśyanti na saṃśayaḥ pūjitaṃ devi sarvarakṣākaraṃ bhavet kulākulānusandhānanipuṇāḥ kaulikāḥ priye yajñādisarvahetutvādāmnāya iti kīrtitaḥ ye tetra dharmedhikāriṇaḥ kaulikoyaṃ panthā narakahetave dambhaḥ pāpaṃ gṛhe gṛhe

na hi || tathā śaktiṃ vinā devo na kiñcitkartumahati tasmātpuṃśatkisaṃyogaṃ kṛtvā mantraṃ prasādhayet śivaṃ dhyāyeddevatā śaktirūpiṇīm mātṛbuddhiḥ strībuddhiḥ kaulike pathi etadrahasyamākhyātaṃ gopyaṃ mātari jāravat dadyāddevataiva mantraṃ tatprabravīmyaham yuktānsvaracatuṣkeṇāthottarottarasaṅkhyakān punardvau ca vargau saṅketavācakau svarāstatkrameṇa paścimottaradevayoḥ prakartavyaṃ vaidikena tu kiñcana grāhyā varṇā ekādisaṅkhyakāḥ yadāyāti tadā svapnaḥ prajāyate naiva yadā pīṭhenāmāṅkayojanam gṛhītaścetsa mantro nāśako bhavet |] yathā lekhya udaṅmadhye tathāntikam likhetpaścādaśvagatyeva pūrvavat kuryātprāgvadaśvagatiṃ punaḥ jāyate pūrtiḥ sarvataḥ saṃmatā kramāt prakalpyātha māheśyāmantimaṃ nyaset vāyavyāṃ tu dvitīyaṃ syāttataḥ saṅkhyā yathā bhavet tatpratisparddhinaḥ sthāpyāstatspardhinyāṃ tathā diśi bhājyabhājakapatrāṇāmatha vā lekhayetkramam snātvā prāksūryodayatastataḥ tu nekṣeta śabdaṃ naiva prayojayet

tattaddevāṣṭagandhena dale vā maṇḍale likhet likhedyantraṃ taddine maunamācaret vilikhenmantraṃ tadudagvātha ṭhadvayam pītavasane cakraṃ kṛṣṇe site tathā saṃveṣṭayettatra snehaḥ kuḍavasambhavaḥ vasā ceti pūrvādiṣveva kalpayet karṇikāyāmuttaratotha vighnagaṇapaṃ yajet digīśānpattreṣu pūjayitvā visarjayet dīpaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya jvālayetpūjayettataḥ prāpnuyāddevatāgaṇam gurordhyāyettajjātīyāṃśca mānayet niṣpāpaḥ prāpnuyānmanum madhyaḥ ṣaṣṭhe sa pāpakaḥ proktaṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitam lobhātkāmātpradadyādyassa lokadvayataścyutaḥ sādhakāḥ sarve siddhiṃ yānti na cānyathā tiṣṭhanti bho devāstrayastriṃśanmitāni ca tu samuddiṣṭaṃ tatrātha hṛdayordhvataḥ dakṣiṇamārgaśca siddhayenyatra vāmakaḥ devi kulamārgaḥ pravartitaḥ kulaśāstraṃ tu kaulānāṃ jñānināṃ muktidāyakam hyaṇimā dīnāṃ siddhikāmaiśca gamyatām lope tu rajastambhaḥ prajāyate jātaṃ siddhiḥ śābaracerakī nāśosya yatproktassa maheśvaraḥ

phalaṃ tatra muktistasyopapīṭhake sāsiśca varuṇābhavat mantrāstatkālaṃ phaladāyakāḥ devāstatsiddhiḥ puraścaraṇamātrataḥ tajjātaṃ gardabhakṣetramadbhutam dakṣiṇamārgasya mantrāḥ siddhipradāyakāḥ vāmasya mārgasyātīva siddhikṛt tasmādvāmasya mārgasya mūlasthānaṃ taducyate ca sahasre dve pīṭhānāṃ ca śatatrayam siddhidāni pīṭhānyaṣṭau ca tatra tu patitaṃ jātaṃ tadupapīṭhakam sahasrāṇi devayonīni santi hi vāmanetraṃ te mahatpīṭhaṃ taducyate devā devatādar"anaṃ bhavet vāmastasmātpīṭhottamaṃ tu tat pāradarśī syāttattvajñānī bhavettathā tatra deveśi prāyaścittakarāṇi ca kariṣyāmyatiguptāni kalau mlecchāvṛtāni ca dakṣakarṇastu patitotīvaśobhanaḥ pānāṃ hi nivāsāyopakalpitam vaidikamantrāṇāṃ siddhirdevāḥ pade pade loke prasiddhamupapīṭhakam punarlabdhāstato jātaṃ tīrthaṃ nigamabodhakam vā tadbhavedyadvarecchayā prerayāmāsa siddhiṃ ca prakaṭā dadau

mantrādhiṣṭhānadevatāḥ nipatitastvata eva ca vallabhaḥ bhavenmuktissahasrabhagasaṅgamāt mahatī jātā tayā devyā mayā saha madbhartā sa evaiko bhaviṣyati dakṣe vighnā bhavanti hi nipatitastatpīṭhe mahadadbhutam japatasteṣāṃ siddhiḥ prajāyate taptaṃ vidyādharairbahu granthastatra sārasvatājjapāt trivāte vasanaṃ jātaṃ prākpaścāddakṣiṇepatat varṇo manavaḥ pauṣṭike sthitāḥ siddhyanti kāmamantrā na saṃśayaḥ ṣoḍaśastrīsahasrāṇāṃ bhoge sāmarthyavānbhavet tatra ye mantrāḥ strīprasaṅgikāḥ labhate siddhimiṣṭāṃ manoramām parvabhirliṅgatāṅgatāḥ puraścaraṇamātreṇa tuṣṭā bhavati devatā dantāstatpīṭhaṃ mahadadbhutam tiṣṭhanti sevātassadyaḥ siddhā bhavanti hi pīṭhe tu siddhayaḥ karasaṃsthitāḥ patitaṃ tatra sarvasiddhividhāyakam nāma yattatra sendreṇopāsitā purā rājarājeśvarīti ca yakṣiṇyāstatra syurdṛṣṭigocarāḥ

manavassiddhyantyatra na saṃśayaḥ sapāpānāṃ gamanaṃ durlabhaṃ kalau bādhante vidharmaṃ bhakṣayanti ca sthitā śaktirbrahmavidyāprakāśikā śaktirmukhaśuddhakarā matā śaktiḥ kaumārī jayakāriṇī vaiṣṇavyāvasthitaṃ jātamindrajāle susiddhidam vārāhyadhiṣṭhitaṃ jātaṃ śatrumardanakārakam cāmuṇḍādhiṣṭhitaṃ jātaṃ kṣudradaivatasiddhidam mahālakṣmyā sūktānāṃ tatra siddhaye tvadbāhupatanātpīṭho narmadādhiṣṭhito'bhavat jātā jīvanmuktā maharṣayaḥ nivāsosau jyotirmantraprakāśataḥ jvālayā tatra vahninā ca tapaḥ kṛtam jvālāmukhīti vikhyātaṃ sa vahnirdevatāmukham prakartavyo mantrasiddhiḥ prajāyate darśanādeva tannṝṇāṃ sarvasiddhividhāyakam gandharvairāgajñānakasañjñitam dveṣoccāṭanamṛtyūnāṃ prayogāstatra siddhidāḥ rākṣasaistatra siddhirdevajayābhidhā yatra tacca pīṭhaṃ mahādbhutam pīṭhaṃ śivamantraprakāśakam tadgaṇeśasya mantrasiddhikaraṃ matam samastaviṣṇumantrāṇāṃ tatra siddhiradūrataḥ tadadhastātkṣudraghaṇṭā patitā copapīṭhakam

upavedārthaniṣpatirbhavedrājagṛhe tathā jātiduṣṭairdvijaistatra svaśarīraṃ samarpitam kalau mārgāścālitā dehasaukhyadāḥ samastavanadevānāṃ tatra siddhiradūrataḥ elāpure ḍhakārobhūddakṣoruḥ patitastava mṛtyuñjayāyuṣkaraṇamantrāḥ siddhyanti tatra tu japātsiddhyerddhanurvedo na saṃśayaḥ te || siddhyai kavacamantrāṇāmavantīti nigadyate vāmakā mantrāstatra siddhyanti netare vaitālikā mantrāḥ siddhiṃ yānti ca śābarāḥ nūpuraścaiva tatra hi pīṭhopapīṭhayostatra mantrāḥ siddhyanti bhāskarāḥ nipatitastatra kṛtasādhakasiddhidam patito yatra ḍāmarañcopapīṭhakam patitastatra dṛśyate śvetamṛttikā testhīni patitāni dvijottamaiḥ prāk ca bagalādyupapīṭhaṃ mahādbhutam gaṅgāyamunayormadhye rājarājeśvarīśvaram prayāgotastīrtharājaḥ pīṭharājaśca kathyate dakṣiṇaḥ patito devi pādukāsiddhiratra tu devadānavagandharvamāyāḥ siddhyanti tatra tu raktāmbarādibaudhānāṃ mantrasiddhisthalantu tat siddhā vaiṣṇavāstu viśeṣataḥ siddhetsvarṇākarṣaṇabhairavaḥ patitantatra japādvāksiddhyati dhruvam

śaktimantrāṇāṃ siddhistatra na saṃśayaḥ mukhyatvaṃ mantriṣu prāpnuyādapi tatpīṭho vāmamārgedhikobhavat śarīrātpatitā tatra sarvasiddhiḥ prajāyate yāvantyaḥ siddhayastatra saṃsthitāḥ tu labdhvābhūcchāyāpīṭhamatastu tat patito devi tatra siddhiradūrataḥ athānyatsampravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam siddhiḥ kutrāpi nāśa eva dinedine suśiṣyāya deyaṃ nānyatra kutracit caturthyantaṃ namontaṃ prajapediti uddiṣṭo gopyaṃ mātari jāravat pūrvoktamātṛkāṇāṃ tu nyāsamādau samācaret laghumātrāṇāṃ śrīkaṇṭhādyāḥ śivādiṣu sarvatra kartavyo dehaśuddhaye tatstotraṃ bhaktasthāne svayaṃ bhavet prayogāḥ siddhyanti mokṣamante labhetasaḥ kurvīta mātarampiraṃ tathā duḥkhī mantragrāhī ca nirdhanaḥ śāstraṃ guruṃ kuryāttadā sukhamavāpnuyāt devi kimanyācchrotumicchasi tantrāṇāṃ puraścaryādinirṇayaḥ puraścaryākaulikācāraprakāśo daśamaḥ kutra kalpāḥ ke ca phalapradāḥ sthāsyanti kāścaiva upaśākhāstathā ca kāḥ

vinā sindhupāramicchasti mānavāḥ vinaśyanti te tu mānuṣyavarjitāḥ tyaktvā jāyante yavanādhipāḥ strīmāṃsamadyanirate loke dharmaparāṅmukhe pṛthivīmadhye yāvatpūrṇaḥ kalirbhavet kalkisvarūpasya viṣṇorjanma bhaviṣyati svādhyāyābhyasanasyādau vratānyeva caturdaśa pūrvavidhinā niṣpāpaḥ sansamabhyaset tathaikānte namro gurvājñayā paṭhet paraṃ ca nāśnīyātprājāpatyavrataṃ tvidam copavasedantyamatikṛcchraṃ vrataṃ tvidam upavāsaśca saptāhaṃ śiśusāntapanaṃ vratam sakṛtsnāyī taptakṛcchraṃ vrataṃ tvidam ekarātropavāsaśca kṛcchrasāntapataṃ vratam upavāsastadā proktaṃ mahāsāntapanaṃ vratam vardhayeccāpi proktaṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ vratam vrataṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ syādeva madhyamam caturostamite sūrye śiśucāndrāyaṇaṃ vratam haviṣyasya yaticāndrāyaṇaṃ vratam sthiracittopramattaśca parākākhyamidaṃ vratam saumyakṛcchranāmakaṃ vratamuttamam tulāpuruṣavattrīṇi stomāyanamidaṃ vratam haviṣyānnasya vaibhāgamṛṣaṣicandrāyaṇaṃ vratam vāyubhakṣaśca stomāyanamidaṃ vratam pratyekaṃ pratyahaṃ pītaiḥ parṇakṛcchravrataṃ tvidam

haviṣyāśī bhuñjanmaunaṃ samāsthitaḥ ācārahīnāñcchūdrāṃśca dṛṣṭvā naiva paṭhecchrutim samāviśya jñātaṃ vedaṃ samuddharet rūpavatīṃ dṛṣṭvā dhyāyedviṣṇuṃ sanātanam namaskāramādāvante guroścaret rātrau yattasmātpūjanīyo gaṇādhipaḥ gaṇeśaṃ punarāgatām paṭhedanadhyāyastadā pāṭhaṃ na kārayet kārtikeyasya gātuṃ tasmātprapūjayet rātrau punardhyātvā svāgatāntāṃ punaḥ paṭhet kailāsaṃ yāti nṛtyantī pradoṣavratakāriṇī haṭhātpaṭhati tadyāvadvṛthātvamupagacchati maunī tryabdācchāktastu siddhyati sanakṣatrā sasūryā sāyamucyate āsannobhijitaḥ kālaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhastathā tathā tvekamarpyamadhike sampradīyate tatra gāyatryā japa iṣyate prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā gāyatryaṣṭottaraṃ śatag vakṣyāmi mantrāṇāṃ gāyatrīṃ vedamātaram vinā muktirna kasyāpi prajāyate yatprabhāvādahaṃ tvañca jātaḥ kāla ivāparaḥ ityuktaṃ devatā savitā smṛtaḥ cakramānnyasya nyāsoyaṃ prathamaḥ smṛtaḥ gulphajānvostathā sandhau tathā jānūrusandhiṣu karāṃgulīmūlasandhau maṇibandhe ca kūrpare

bhruvoḥ śīrṣṇi cūḍādho vāmakarṇake akṣaranyāso dvitīyaḥ samprakīrtitaḥ kaṇṭhahṛnnābhigulpheṣu jānvoraṃghryoratha nyaset brahmaṇe proktaṃ viṣṇave śira īritam sadāśivāyoktamastraṃ sarvātmane smṛtam pajjānukaṭinābhau ca hṛdaye kaṇṭhabhālayoḥ punarvyāhṛtinyāsoyaṃ pañcamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ śikhā kavacaṃ dhīmahi smṛtam ṣaṭhaḥ syātṣaḍete pāpahārakāḥ gāyatryā dhyānaṃ bhaktamanoramam cakramathāraviṃdayugalaṃ hastairvahantīṃ bhaje deveśīṃ koṇāgre pūjayettataḥ māheśvarī caiva vaiṣṇavī prathamāvṛtiḥ bhāskaraṃ cāpi saṃdhyāṃ ca dvitīyāvaraṇaṃ tvidam tṛtīyoktaṃ dalamadhye yajedimāḥ prabhāvatīṃ jayāṃ śāṃtāṃ caturthāvaraṇaṃ tvidam kramātproktaṃ pañcamāvaraṇaṃ tvidam pūjyā viśvayonirjayāvahā tvaruṇā proktāprokta māvaraṇaṃ tvidam aṣṭamāvaraṇaṃ caitaccaturasradigaṣṭake sampūjayeddevīṃ tasyā mudrāḥ pradarśayet caturviṃśatilakṣāṇi puraścaraṇamucyate sahasraṃ tu juhuyānmantrasiddhaye prayogānācaredvidvāṃstadanujñāpurassaram sarvapāpavinirmukto dīrghamāyussa vindati

dūrvānvitaistilairmantrī juhuyāttrisahasrakam śvetārkairayutaṃ niyatendriyaḥ japenmumukṣurgāyatrīṃ turyapādena saṃyutām ityuttaratrānvayosya ||] saptavyāhṛtigāyatrīnyāsādyānpūrvavaccaret brahmātmane tu hṛdayaṃ śiro viṣṇvātmane tathā netramastraṃ sarvātmane iti yadagrataḥ vedamaṃtrāṇāṃ yacca saṃsiddhikārakam gurudveṣṭre procyaśāpamavāpnuyāt tānādipādasahināngāyatryāstu sadā japet saṃyuktānantimena tu nāśakān saṃkṣepataḥ prokto gāyatryā gopito vidhiḥ svarau digvidiśaṃ pratipatraṃ samālikhet tadbahirvṛttayugalāntarāle tu samālikhet bhūrbhuvaḥsvaromiti ca yantraṃ sarvārthasiddhidam devādīnmokṣāntaṃ sādhayejjanaḥ tasya tasmādvaṃśelpāyuśca no bhavet bandhanānmṛtyormukṣīyamāmṛtāt kuryānnyāsaṃ tathāṅgeṣu nābhihṛtkaṇṭhakukṣiṣu jānuvṛttayugmayoḥ stanayostathā manuvarṇāṃśca nyāsoyantu dvitīyakaḥ punaḥ kuryānmātṛkānyāsapūrvakam saṃkalya vakṣyamāṇena vartmanā

pūrvādiprādakṣiṇyeneśānāya sūryamūrtaye śarvāya jalamūrtaye bhīmāyākāśamūrtaye ṅentaṃ paśupatiṃ tathā jyotsnā pūrṇeṣā pūraṇī sudhā sitā yuktā sārā sādhyā śivā niśā pañcamāvaraṇe caitāḥ ṣaṣṭhāvaraṇagā atha saptame lokapālāśca tadastrāṇi tathāṣṭame juhuyāddaśabhirdravyairayutaṃ ghṛtasaṃyutaiḥ dūrvāṃ ca tathaikena sahasrakam prayogārho jāyateyaṃ mahāmanuḥ juhuyādbrahmavṛkṣasya samidbhirbrahmatejase samidbhirvaṭavṛkṣasya juhuyācca yathāvidhi hutvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate vidhānena na syānmṛtyurakālataḥ siddhānnaṃ hutvā kṛtyāṃ vināśayet saṃvādaṃ kuryādvidveṣiṇormithaḥ āmayānnikhilāñjitvā dīrghamāyuravāpnuyāt lakṣmīmārogyaṃ vipulaṃ yaśaḥ jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sukhī juhuyādbrāhmaṇānante bhojayenmadhurānvitam dīrghamāyuḥ śriyā saha ṣaṇmāsānnātra saṃśayaḥ kṣīradrumasamiddhomādbrāhmaṇādīnvaśaṃ nayet sādhayediṣṭamātmanaḥ medhātithir-ṛṣiḥ prokto gāyatraṃ chanda īritam

tu catvāriṃśatsahasrakam puraścaraṇametatsyātsvaśaktyā viprabhojanam svarṇavarṇaṃ vande gandharvanāyakam mahābhāṇḍārikaḥ kuryāttasya dāridryanāśanam jalandharavadhāyāhaṃ yatsmarāmi śṛṇuṣva tat pariṣadati durgāṇi viśvā nāveva sindhuṃ duritātyagniḥ jātavedogniḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret aṃguṣṭhayorgulphayośca jaṅghayorjānunostathā ūrvvoḥ kaṭyorliṅganābhyorhṛdaye stanayostathā bāhvoścaivopabāhvośca dvayoḥ kūrparayorapi nasyakṣṇoścaiva karṇayoḥ karṇayostathā padanyāsaḥ proktoyaṃ dhyānamucyate tatkarṇikāyāṃ ṣaṭkoṇe maṇḍukādyānsamarcayet vijayāmbhadrāṃ rudrāṃ kālīṃ ca pūrvataḥ durgāṃ yajetpaścādāsanaṃ siṃhamantrataḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni pūrvatoṣṭadale punaḥ vaiśvānarakaumāratejasam jalātmānaṃ vahnyātmānaṃ nirātmakam pūṣāvāṇyau tato vīthī śacī toyātmikā tathā nāmnā proktā caiva tiraskriyā nandinī ca śarīreṣuvimardinī viśālākṣī saumyā sāyaṃ nirūpyate dhūmrā ca durviṣaṃhāriraṃsukā lokapālāṃstadastrāṇi pūjāṃ prāgvatsamāpayet

vedavedābdhisaṅkhyākaṃ tilasiddhārthacitrajaiḥ || arkaplakṣodbhavaiścāpi ghṛtena haviṣānnakaiḥ tatassantarpya satilaiḥ kṛtvā cātmābhiṣecanam siddhe mantresminsādhakottamaḥ proktaṃ vilomaprathito manuḥ gnityatāridudhuṃ siṃ proccāryātra hṛdayaṃ matam pūrvoktārṇavilomataḥ padanyāso japaḥ pūjā ca pūrvavat catvāriṃśaccatuṣṭayam kuryādgāyatryā dviguṇaṃ japam pauṣṭikaṃ karma kartavyamanulomataḥ dvitīyaḥ karmendriyātmakaḥ varṇādi ṣaḍarṇonyaḥ ṣaṭkauśikamayo mataḥ varṇādyoṣṭamo jñeyaḥ pañcāṇā vacanādikaḥ prajvalatkeśavasanā bhīmadaṃṣṭrā bhayāvahāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ūrdhvavadanāḥ kośotthāstiryagānanāḥ sarvāssmṛtāḥ klībā indriyārthodbhavāstriyaḥ manuṣyanakṣatre prārabheta vicakṣaṇaḥ nandāsuriktāsvastraṃ visarjayet bhaumavāre śanivāre visarjayet rāśiṣvārambhaścareṣu syādvisarjanam caredastraṃ visṛjecchaśinā punaḥ mokṣasaṃhārau kuryātpakṣadvaye sudhīḥ nakṣatravṛkṣasakalānsādhyākhyānkarmasaṃyutān

bhūtvā ripuryamapuraṃ vrajet vṛṣṭikāle marīcairmanunāmunā samālikhya śatrunāma yathāvidhi hanetkraddho jvarākrāntaḥ sa jāyate hiṃguṃ viṣaṃ jīrakalohite vinikṣipya yaṣṭyā viṣatarūtthayā saptāhānmaraṇaṃ yāti śatrurjvaravimohitaḥ liptāṅgaṃ dagdhaṃ bhānumarīcibhiḥ tarpayedbhānumālokya śatrurmṛtyupriyo bhavet vidveṣayechatruṃ nakhenāhṛtya deśikaḥ kuryātsenāyānātra saṃśayaḥ vimohayecchatruṃ maricairvā sasarṣapaiḥ prajuhuyājjayenmāsena vairiṇam śarānkārmukanirmuktānvahnijvālāmukhākalān bhānubimbaṃ samālokya śatroruccāṭanaṃ bhavet senāyāsstambhanaṃ bhavet saptāhānmaṃtravidvaśayennṛpān mantrī tasya viśvaṃ vaśaṃ bhavet vetasairmadhurāsiktairjuhuyādbṛttisiddhaye mantravinnātra saṃśayaḥ tathānyādyā gāni durgā prakīrtitā viśvādyā caiva maṃtresminviśvadurgā samīritā tyāṃtāmagnyādikāmevamagnidurgāṃ vidurbudhāḥ tatrārcayennityaṃ prāguktenaiva vartmanā kṛtyārogabhayadrohabhūtāni nāśayedayam

syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā mantrārṇasaṃkhyayā maṃtrī ripumātmavaśaṃ nayet nivāsya pañcagavyeṣu saṃskṛte havyavāhane viśadadhīḥ samiddhegnau yathā purā kuryātsādhyaṃ tatprāśayedguruḥ kṛtyā punastāneva bhakṣayet juhuyātsampadāṃ bhūmiḥ sādhakā bhavati dhruvam japanmantraṃ satataṃ puṣkalāmbhasi darvyā brahmatarūtthayā viśākhākṛttikāmūlahastottaramaghāsvatha kurvīta sikatāsthāpanaṃ sudhīḥ prasthāḍhakaghaṭonmānā madhyādiṣvavareṣvimāḥ madhyādidevīmastrāṇi kapālāntāni deśikaḥ kapālaṃ svasvamantreṇa sampūjyānte baliṃ haret rakṣā yā vardhante tatra sampadaḥ vidhinā nātra saṃśayaḥ brahmavṛkṣeṇa nirmite pravardhante'kālavṛṣṭyādibhiḥ saha kuryātsthāpanaṃ vidhināmunā gomūtrāttriguṇaṃ dadhi kapilāḥ śvetāḥ sitadhūmrāruṇaprabhāḥ ekonapañcāśatkoṣṭhe phalake brahmaśākhinaḥ tadūrdhvakoṣṭhamārabhya prādakṣiṇyena saṃlikhet pūrvoditaṃ phalam sādhyanāmānvitāṃ māyāṃ madhyakoṣṭhe tu saṃlikhet

pūrvoktānaṣṭau pādāṃśca tadbahiḥ sarvabhūtabhayaharaṃ śrīkīrtyāyuḥpradaṃ śubham śreṣṭhastasyādhīnaṃ jagattrayam mantraṃ kṛtvāstraṃ paricakṣate sunavāma somamarātīyato nidahāti vedaḥ sa naḥ pariṣat varṇānāmpadānāṃ nyāsa iṣyate nyāsādikaṃ tathā dhyānaṃ muniśchandaśca pūrvavat śatruṃ madhye vakraṃ viṣāhatam dinadvayājjvarākrānto ripuḥ prāṇānvimuñcati japetsadyaḥ sa bhavedyamavallabhaḥ prajapetsa mṛtyuvaśatāṃ vrajet śīghraṃ sa nīyate yamakiṅkaraiḥ smṛtastūrṇamparāsuḥ syāddinatrayāt putramitrakalatrādisahito mṛtyumāpnuyāt dinādarvāgyamalokaṃ sa gacchati yamagrasto bhavedariḥ śatrurjvarito maraṇaṃ vrajet mahatāviṣṭo jāyatesau yamātithiḥ tarpayeddinabāṇena syādasau yamavallabhaḥ japenmantraṃ sa prayāti yamāntikam śīghraṃ taṃ yamadūto yamālayam ghorāṃ siṃhaskandhaṃ niṣeduṣīm visphuliṅgairnirdahantīṃ ripumākulavigraham tarjayantīṃ nijaṃ śatruṃ tarjanyā bhīmarūpayā vakṣo dārayantīṃ bhayaṃkarām

astramantrakṛtanyāsaḥ pralayāgnisamaprabhaḥ tacchiraśchittvā kṣaṇādvyomasthalaṃ gatām tu rātriṣu nyasya sajīvaṃ mahiṣaṃ puraḥ vahnau yathāvaddeśikottamaḥ devīṃ savitṛmaṇḍale udyadāyudhasandīptāṃ nṛtyantīṃ siṃhamastake raktārdramāṃsavasanāṃ ghūrṇitogratrilocanām putramitrādibhiḥ saha bhānubimbagatāṃ durgāṃ sahasrādityasannibhām sahasranāgabaddhāṅgīṃ trāsayantīṃ jagattrayam kālapāśena vairī muñcetsvajīvitam ghorasiṃhāsanāsīnāṃ mahābhīṣaṇadāriṇīm gacchedarātirnātra saṃśayaḥ viniḥkṣipya niṣpīḍya vidhinā tataḥ nayanatrayasaṅgacchadvisphuliṅgaśatākulām śatruryukto bhavati mṛtyunā vahnau mahiṣīśakṛtā kṛtām chittvā chittvā prajahuyādajaraktānvitāṃ niśi mahiṣasyāṅgaṃ bhindaṃtī ghoradarśanām pradīptānalasaṅkāśāṃ bhramannetratrayānvitām khaḍgakheṭakayuktābhiḥ kanyakābhiḥ samāvṛtām kathitaṃ rātrau kṛtyāstramucyate brahmarandhramārgeṇa gatāṃ vyomasthalaṃ tataḥ śatrurmṛtyumāpnoti mohitaḥ

ripuryamapuraṃ vrajet śaturmṛtyumeṣyati kātaraḥ chittvāchittvājaraktena saptāhānmriyate ripuḥ pītamacirānnihanti sakalāñjanān māhiṣājyena saṃyuktaistanmantrākṣarasaṃkhyayā caturdaśītrayādarvākchatrurmṛtyuvaśo bhavet saṃsmareddevīṃ jvālāgnisadṛśaprabhām prajuhuyādanenāyutamastravit bahudhā bhinnā jvareṇāpi vimohitā kṣiptaṃ kuryāduccāṭanaṃ drutam saptamāhendradigvarjaṃ gṛhītvā prajapenmanum mantradavāgninā jāyate ripoḥ ṣaḍbinduṣaṭkaputtalyāṃ nikhanedodanānvitam śīghraṃ sakuṭumbaḥ sabāndhavaḥ tāṃ prajapedastraṃ prāṇasthāpanapūrvakam gacchenmahājvaravimohitaḥ chādayedraktavāsasā bhaumavāre diśo madhye yathāpūrvaṃ samāhitaḥ vraṇatailena hutvānte taṃ paṭaṃ punaḥ tena tridinairmriyate ripuḥ kuśairābaddhasarvāṅgaṃ sthāpitaṃ prāṇatejasā divasenārirgacchedyamapuraṃ prati gandhapuṣpādyairayutaṃ juhuyātsudhīḥ gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ spṛśanmantraṃ tu taṃ japet

bhakṣayedacirācchatrumīśvareṇābhirakṣitam mantrānmṛtyuñjayādikān juhuyādājyaistarpaṇādi tataścaret triśaktestu mantrasiddhirna jāyate cāntarikṣāya ca mahate ca svāhā deśakālānurūpeṇa śreṣṭhā tvayutahomataḥ tadvakṣye tejasvī ghṛtahomataḥ juhuyāddugdhaṃ vāpyatha vā dadhi hutvā yatheṣṭaṃ kanakaṃ labhet juhuyādayutasaṅkhyākaṃ sampadaṃ sa sadā labhet samidho juhuyādrāmakāmukaḥ dūrvābhiḥ ṣpaistu dhanakāmukaḥ juhuyānmantrī tvabhicāraḥ prasidhyati tatra hunetsarvavrīhibhirādarāt ullūkakākapakṣābhyāṃ homo vidveṣakārakaḥ caiva jāyate prajapennityaṃ guṇinaṃ labhate sutam putravatsiddhisādhanam brahmaviṣṇuśivāḥ siddhā yatprasādāddharistathā etattrayaṃ triśaktyākhyo mantraḥ proktaśatākṣaraḥ vedagamyaṃ parantejosya devatā ṣaḍaṅgāni prāṅnyāsāṃśca samācaret nityānandaguṇālayaṃ parataraṃ vandāmahe tanmahaḥ śaktibhiḥ paścātpūjayedāvṛtitrayam
