catuścatvariṃśatsaṅkhyā jātavādyāstu śaktayaḥ saṃpūjā mṛtyuñjayoktaśaktibhiḥ japeddhunetkṣīraṃ bhaktādyaistarpayettataḥ khaṇḍairjuhuyātkṣīrasaṃyutaiḥ dūrvābhirdhṛtasiktābhistadeva phalamāpnuyāt mahālakṣmīmavāpnoti māsaiḥ ṣadbhirvidhānavit [bilvaprasūnaiḥ |] prajuhuyādramāyā vasatirbhavet bhānusaṅkhyāndvijānnityaṃ bhojayenmadhurānvitaiḥ kṛtyādrohagrahānsarvāñjitvā dīrghaṃ sa jīvati bhānumālokayetsamyaksa jīveccharadā śatam japenmantraṃ sarvapāpavimuktaye prajapedāyurārogyavṛddhaye cedṛṅmantrastvaritasiddhidaḥ tasmai rudrāya namo astu rudraḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni nyasetkramāt dhyānamācaret sampūrṇau kalaśau hastayordvayoḥ sarvakāmaphaleśānaṃ śaṅkaraṃ karuṇānidhim ca śūlapāṇiṃ jaṭādharam satyavāṇīṃ puraścaryāvidhau caret mārjanaṃ viprabhojanaṃ mantrasiddhaye samācaret || evaṃ siddhe manau mantrī prayogānkartumarhati audumbarairannakāmastejaskāmastu khādiraiḥ grahabādhāvināśāya japedaśvatthasannidhau hūyante samidhaḥ śuṣkāḥ svāhāntaṃ mantramuccaret

sa muñcati kanyārthī kanyāṃ prāpnoti rūpiṇīm harite deśe tasya viśvaṃ vaśībhavet arisainyapraśāntyarthaṃ tilānājyena sammitān mantrayitvāṣṭasāhasraṃ śarāvāṃstatra vikṣipet grahagrāmādiśāntyarthaṃ rājyasyāpyevamācaret vāstupūjā prakartavyā catuṣṣaṣṭipadaiḥ śubhaiḥ paśūnāntu prajānāṃ śāntimāpnuyāt japedrudraṃ tvaritaṃ bahubhiḥ saha baliṃ kuryādyasyāṃ diśi tadadbhutam japellakṣaṃ tilahomo ghṛtānvitaḥ kāryasya labhyate yogyatā yadi sarvānkāmānavāpnoti tvaritasya prasādataḥ kāryeṣu homaḥ kāryastathā yavaiḥ śrīphalaistadvadāyuṣkāmastu dūrvayā puṣṭikāmastu tuṣṭikāmastathā hi taiḥ madhvabjājyāmraparṇāni tīvrajvaravināśane lakṣaṃ rogiṇāntāratamyataḥ jaṭhare hṛdi kaṇṭhe mukhe nasi ṣoḍaśa manoriti tvaritarudriyam tatrāvṛṣṭirna jāyate aṣṭāṅgavasuvasvadriṣaḍarṇairaṅgakalpanam gudaliṅgayoḥ sthale gale hastāgrayoraṃgulimūlayoḥ cāsye kapolayugale nasoḥ

kramānnyasya mantrārṇāndhyānamācaret vibhūtyai kṛtvāṅgapūjanaṃ śeṣaṃ vāsukiṃ takṣaka punaḥ kulikamindrādīnāyudhāni ca juhuyāttarpaṇādi tataścaret labhate sammatāmakṣayāṃ śriyam daśaśataṃ ṛṇamuktyai mahāśriye juhuyādvṛṣṭisaṃsiddhyai mantravidvijitendriyaḥ sarvairupadravaiḥ sarvopadravanāśāya sarvadābhyudayāptaye sādhayetsakalānkāmāñjapahomāditatparaḥ japenaiva siddhiḥ samprati vartate tāntrikāya kadācana japenaiva nānnahīnaḥ prajāyate tāriṣa ūrjaṃ no dhehi dvipade catuṣpade jāyate cānnaṃ yaddhūtaṃ na ca varṣataḥ hunedannaṃ yāvajjanmākṣayaṃ bhavet agniñcopasamādhāyodumbaryā samidhā yutam bhavantyavṛṣṭāviti ca kimāścaryaṃ suvarṣaṇe juhuyāllavaṇaistathā mātā lavaṇasya varuṇaḥpitā lavaṇaṃ chindati bhindati majjāni asthibhyo maddviṣāṃ daha śighramagniṃ lavaṇatejasā lavaṇamantrapuraskṛtāḥ

munirākhyātaśchandonuṣṭubudāhṛtam pañcatripañcavedeṣu dvyakṣaraiściṭimantrajaiḥ ṭhadvandvañcaturviṃśākṣaro manuḥ kathyante sāvadhānatayā śṛṇu durgāmaribhaṅgadakṣām bhūyādvibhūtyai mama bhadrakālī ghṛtasiktenajuhuyādarcite'nale mantrī māraṇakarmaṇi sādhyaḥ kiṃkarojāyate kṣaṇāt aṣṭottarasahasraṃ yastasya sādhyo vaśo bhavet saptabhirdivasairbhūpānvaśayedvidhināmunā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā sarvajantūnāṃ prayogoyamudāhṛtaḥ vahnau māse vaśyo bhavennaraḥ prakurvīta saṃskṛte havyavāhane sucūrṇitaṃ prajuhuyātsaptāhādvaśayejjagat vaśayedakhilāndevānacirātkimu pārthivān vaśyaḥ syādanena vidhinācirāt śuddhalavaṇena hutvā śatrūnvaśaṃ nayet juhuyādvaśayennārīṃ narānnarapatīnapi kurvīta sāṅgopāṅgāḥ samāḥ śubhāḥ cakrihastamṛdānyā syādanyā tu sikatāmayī samyaṅmiśritenāmunā punaḥ prāṇānpratiṣṭhāpya pūjayetkusumādibhiḥ mātṛkānyāsaṃ mantrasya samanantaram

tārādyānvinyasedvarṇānsthāneṣveṣu samāhitaḥ kukṣyornābhau kaṭidvaye jānuyugme jaṅghāyugme padadvaye śuddhaḥ puttalīṃ dāruṇākṛtām pratimāṃ pādenākrāmecca tathātmanaḥ kṛtāṃ paścātputtalīṃ saṃspṛśañjapet punarnābhau jaṭhare hṛdayāmbuje karṇayorakṣṇorlalāṭe mūrdhni vinyaset mantroktadevatāṃ rūpyapātrake mantrairetaiḥ prayogādāvante saṃyatamānasaḥ niśāyāṃ mantrajaptena tṛpto bhava tayā saha lavaṇaṃ daha śatruhan namastubhyaṃ varade kāmadā bhava vaśamānaya devi me duṣṭaśatrubhyaṅkare śaraṇaṃ me bhavānaghe śoṣaya tāpayatāpaya mahākāli rakṣāsmānakṣarātmike ṛkpañcakaṃ samuccārya juhuyādedhitenale śirastṛtīyamākhyātaṃ vāmahastastataḥ param saptamo vāmapādaḥ syāditi bhāgakramaḥ smṛtaḥ kṛtvaivamarcayitvāgniṃ praṇameddaṇḍavattataḥ mantrī vaśayedasurānsurān pūrvasamproktaputtalīnāṃ catuṣṭayam vakṣyamāṇena vidhānena prakalpayet

vaśyasiddhyarthaṃ sādhyanāmāṃghrireṇubhiḥ puttalīṃ samyakprāṇasthāpanamācaret kuṇḍe rātrau prajvalitenale dhārayenniśitaṃ śastraṃ savyahastena sādhakaḥ prajuhuyānnirāhāro jitendriyaḥ anenaiva vidhānena homaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ trisaptāhaprayogena mārayedripumātmanaḥ khadiraḥ kuṣṭho vaṃśapippalanāgarāḥ vaikaṅkataścāpi bakulaḥ saralaḥ kramāt madhūkaśca lodhromantravidhistviti vakṣyāmi siddhaye sugamā ṛcaḥ tu yāsu siddhiradūrataḥ sarvalokopakārārthaṃ kathayāmyatra tā ṛcaḥ riṣyati pūruṣaḥ bhāṇḍāgārasya vastūni caturthāṃśena homayet yaḥ kuryādakṣayostyayutena ca devā avantu śobhāyai pitaronnamadantu sahasraṃ tasya śāntaye tebhyaḥ sarpebhyo namaḥ svarṇamutpadyate tataḥ śerate tebhyaḥ sarpebhyo namaḥ ājyāhutisahasraṃ tu tena svarṇaśataṃ labhet tasyāgnikṛtaṃ duḥkhaṃ patati vairiṇi śatrunāmāsya grāmanāśaḥ prajāyate sahasraṃ tu sarṣapānpuṃvaśīkṛte

pratanu sahasreṇa śatena ca vidhema haviṣā vayam mārakaṃ hanyāddviguṇena puraḥ sthitam nānādeśodbhavaṃ hanyānmārakaṃ lakṣahomataḥ naḥ prayutāvadheyuk tataḥ śatagūṃsenā ajayatsākamindraḥ vṛṣṇā pratihitābhirastā rathānām abhivīro abhisattvāsahojājaitramindrarathamātiṣṭhagovit devasenānāmabhibhañjatīnāṃ jayantīnāmmaruto yantvagram jayatāmudasthāt gacchāmitrānprapadyasva māmīṣāṃ kaṃcanocchiṣaḥ bāhavo'nādhṛṣyā yathāsatha bṛhaspatiraditiḥ śarma yacchatu viśvā hā śarma yacchatu urorvarīyo varuṇaste kṛṇotu jayantaṃ tvānudevā madantu yāyādvijayo jāyate dhruam śrutvā tasminsthale cintyonuvāko manasā dvijaiḥ kuśānvāpi kṣipedrakṣā bhavatvitaḥ saptayonīrāpṛṇasva ghṛtena svāhā tejasvī hunedayutasaṅkhyayā saptatolakaparyantaṃ ṣaṇmāsābhyantare dhruvam brahmaṇasmai kṣatrāya mahiśarma yaccha svāhā vāstudoṣātpramucyate

sūtikāpīḍāṃ bhayaṃ naikākino bhavet p. 270) anenājyaṃ sahasrantu hutvā śatrugṛhaṃ vrajet suvarṇavṛddhisiddhyarthaṃ ghṛtāktāḥ samidho hunet naukāstho jale yadvanna majjati śṛṇvannūtibhiḥ sīda sādanam samidha audumbaryastathaiva [dvitīyārthe prathamā |] ca vivardhate cātha homaṃ kuryāccatuṣpathe mṛdā liṃgaṃ kṛtvā ca snāpayettathā sastanūbhirvyaśema devahitaṃ yadāyuḥ bhavati ṣaṇḍhatvācca vimucyate vṛddhāyumanuvṛddhayo juṣṭā bhavantu juṣṭayaḥ vṛṣṭirbhavetkālaṃ vinā tadā jyotiṣāṃ jyotirekaṃ tanme manaḥ śivasaṃkalpamastu śivasaṃkalpamastu tanme manaḥ śivasaṃkalpamastu śivasaṃkalpamastu pārthivaṃ liṃgamuttamam kroḍīkṛtyākṣatāścaivaṃ sthāpyāḥ sthānacatuṣṭaye ṛcāṃ pāṭhamekaṃ kṛtvākṣatānnyaset dvitīyādipraharake dakṣiṇādyāsu vinyaset syādāsāyaṃ tu kṛtyaṃ kṛtvā ca bhakṣayet aṣṭavāra sahasrantu jāpyā etā ṛcaḥ śubhāḥ vartamānaṃ vā bhaviṣyadapi dṛśyate dāridryanāśāya nānyaktiñcinnṛṇāṃ tatha hiraṇmayīṃ lakṣmīṃ jātavedo ma āvaha

hiraṇyaṃ vindeyaṃ gāmaśvaṃ puruṣānaham devīmupahvaye śrīrmā devījuṣatām alakṣmīrme naśyatāṃ tvā vṛṇe rāṣṭesminkīrtimṛddhiṃ dadātu me abhūtimasamṛddhiṃ ca sarvā nirṇuda me gṛhāt īśvarīṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tāmihopahvaye śriyam rupamannasya mayi śrīḥ śrayatāṃ yaśaḥ kule mātaraṃ padmamālinīm mātaraṃ śriyaṃ vāsaya me le hiraṇmayīṃ lakṣmīṃ jātavedo ma āvaha candrāṃ hiraṇmayīṃ lakṣmīṃ jāta vedo ma āvaha prabhūtaṃ gāvo dāsyo'śvānvindeyaṃ puruṣānaham caturdaśānāmīśānāmānandaḥ kardamastathā hiraṇyāditisṛṇāṃ cacchandonuṣṭubudāhṛtam upaitu māṃ devādyaṣṭa -ṛcāmapi prastārapaṃktiruddiṣṭā devate śrīvibhāvasū kīlakaṃ prīktaṃ tvaṃguṣṭhādiṣaḍaṅgakam hiraṇyasragdhiraṇyākṣī tathā hiraṇyavarṇikā kuryāddhyānaṃ tataścaret santataṃ śrīḥ śriye naḥ āgneyakoṇatastadvattadbāhyeṣṭadaleṣvimāḥ tṛptiśca jvalantī tadanantaram cāsanaṃ syādarghyapādyācamāni ca dīpabhojye prodvāsanamiti kramāt dattvā nīrājayecchriyam

cācamanaṃ tāṃ ma āvahamantrataḥ nityapūjeyaṃ puraścaraṇamucyate ādityābhimukho japtvāyāvattāvacca tarpayet tāvaddvādaśasāhasraṃ japenniścalamānasaḥ padmaistrimadhuropetairghṛtāktena payondhasā siddho bhavenmantro nātrā kāryā vicāraṇā lakṣmyāścātipriyāṇi ca karotyevaṃ sa syāllakṣapatiḥ svayam hunetsudhīḥ catvāriṃśadbhirasya syānmahālakṣmīracañcalā ṣaṇmāsātsyānmahendirā priyato bhūtvā juhuyādājyamanvaham āvāhayecchriyaṃ padme pañcabhiḥ kanakethavā śālīnāṃ payasā samprakalpayet sarvauṣadhībhiḥ phāṇṭaiśca snātvābhipācitairapi paśukāmābhiṣecane aśvapūrṇāmiti snāyādrājyakāmaḥ samāhitaḥ kāryastvanantaram ādityavarṇetyanayā bilvahomo vidhīyate prathamaṃ samyaganantāṃ viṃdate śriyam anuktāmavyavacchināṃ śāśvatīṃ vidate śriyam jape tu prayutaṃ samyaganantāṃ viṃdate śriyam juhuyānnityaṃ padmānyayutaśopi ca siddhiṃ sa gacchati bilvāni sasa kāmaḥ samṛddhyati

kāmena homaḥ kāryaḥ kathañcana prārthayatā ratnādyuktaiḥ śrīrijyate dhruvam vasurūpā hiraṇmayī bhuktiścāpi pramuktiyuk bhuvaneśī ca śuddhā ca bhoginī bhogadā tathā praṇavādicaturthyantairnamobhiścaiva tarpayet kāryo niyamaśca nigadyate bhavejjātu kutsitānnaṃ na bhakṣayet lakṣmīpriyāścaite kadācidbuddhimāṃstataḥ jambūṃ pravālañca dhārayenmūrdhni sarvadā saprathāḥ apa naḥ śośucadagham bhūmimasapatnāmakaṇṭakām cakṣurātatam jale japtvā teṣāṃ nāśaḥ prajāyate hiraṇyayena savitā rathenādevo yāti bhuvanāni paśyan japedaṣṭottaraśataṃ sampūrṇāyurgadojjhitaḥ hutvānayācā jyaṃ dīrghamāyuravāpnuyāt nātibhave bhavasva māṃ bhavodbhavāya namaḥ sarvaśarvebhyo namaste astu rudrarūpebhyaḥ kalpayedraudraṃ bhūtyarthaṃ pañcaparvasu sūryam tasya paramārogyavardhanam somaṃ tasya duḥkhaṃ layaṃ vrajet vindeta candrasyaiti salokatām vicakramāṇastredhorugāyā viṣyāvocā

viṣṇordhruvo'si || vaiṣṇavamasi viṣṇave tvā sakhā śucirbhūtvā upratiṣṭheta yonvaham prāpnoti paramaṃ sthānaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam no dūre adyasa soyo antyagne mākiṣṭe vyathirādadharṣīt avasthirā tanuhi yātujūnāṃ jāmi majāmi pramṛṇīhi viśvānyasmai sudināni rāyo dyumnānyaryauviduro abhidyaut asya vacasaścikiddhi hotaryaviṣṭhasukratodanūnāḥ tepāyakasaṃciyaṃconiṣadhogne tava naḥ pāntvamūḥ ubhāśagūṃsāsudayasatpatā te rakṣasaḥ pāhyasmāduhonidomitramaho avadyāt pātu naktam madaicidasya dvyarujanti bhāmānavarante parivādho adevīḥ haretprāṇānbhayannaivopajāyate ghoṣayitvā no mṛḍātīdṛśe dvijo nityaṃ vindate kṣetramuttamam sūktasya triṣṭubantyasya devatā yathoktavidhinā prāṅmukhaḥ śuddhamānasaḥ vāmapāde tu caturthīṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset vāmakaṭyāṃ vai cāṣṭamīṃ dakṣiṇe kaṭau kaṇṭhadeśe dvādaśīṃ vāmabāhuke nyāsavidhiṃ kṛtvā paścātpūjāṃ samācaret apsvagnau hṛdaye sūrye sthaṇḍile pratimāsu ca viṣṇuryogināṃ hṛdaye hariḥ pratimāsvalpabuddhīnāṃ ṣaṭprakārāśca tāḥ smṛtāḥ

sajīvāśca pratimāssanti vai hareḥ dvividhā śālagrāmotipāvanaḥ daśadhā proktāḥ śreṣṭhāstāḥ pūrvapūrvataḥ mṛttikājātā citrarūpeti ca kramāt yāstu mūrtayastāścalācalāḥ brāhmaṇā gāvo nirjīvaḥ pippalaḥ smṛtaḥ gāyatryakṣaranyastāṅgaḥ pūjayedviṣṇumavyayam dvitīyayāsanaṃ dadyātpādyaṃ dadyāttṛtīyayā snānaṃ prakurvīta saptamyā vastrameva ca dātavyamekādaśyā tu dhūpakam namaskāraṃ pañcadaśyā pradakṣiṇam śaktyā ṣoḍaśyā tu samarpaṇam japitvā tu sūktaṃ tasmai nivedayet kārayetprathamenaiva dvitīyena tu prokṣaṇam pañcamenājyaśrapaṇaṃ carośca śrapaṇaṃ tathā cintayeddevadeveśaṃ kālānalasamaprabham kuryātsaptamyādi yathākramam juhuyāccaruṇā ca tataḥ punaḥ agnerbhagavatastasya samīpe stotramuccaret hṛṣīkeśa mahāpuruṣa pūrvaja caraṇadvandvaṃ vrajāmi śaraṇaṃ tava cāguṇo māyāsamāvṛtaḥ prāpya nistaranti manīṣiṇaḥ puruṣākāro bhaktānāṃ ca prakāśase sādhyosti vinā bhaktiṃ bhavānprabho

paramā siddhiḥ paramaṃ te padaṃ viduḥ puṇḍarīkākṣa na jānāmi paraṃ padam cāpi vartate me mahadbhayam prāpya yadidaṃ jñānavarjitam jātasya tvadgato me manorathaḥ ātmajñānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ yogajñānamidaṃ param niṣpāpo jāyate manujo yadā śubhe vāre yadā caikādaśī bhavet putrakāmāya caruṃ kurvīta vaiṣṇavam puruṣasūktena prāśayetputrakāmyayā puruṣasūktena juhuyācchiṣṭaṃ striyābhakṣayet |] mārgaśīrṣādimāseṣu kramātpūjyaśca keśavaḥ padmanābho gadādharaḥ homañca pūrvavatkuryātsarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt suputraḥ syāttamupāyaṃ bravīmyaham ca saghṛtamupatiṣṭheddhutāśanam kuryātpratyahaṃ vāgyataḥ śuciḥ ca patiṃ viṣṇuṃ namaskṛtya prabhakṣayet pravartenāvaśyaṃ garbhavatī bhavet japedaṣṭottaraśataṃ sūktametattrikālakam daśaśataṃ tribhirvarṣairjapeddinam taṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam svadharmanirato nyāyavṛttaḥ śucivrataḥ samprasupteṣu lokeṣu yogaṃ yuñjīta yogavit saṃveśayettataḥ

baddhāñjalikaraḥ svastho yogasammīlitekṣaṇaḥ samādadhyādiṃdriyāṇi manastathā prāṇānāyamya cāsīno'nudvignaściṃtayettataḥ ucchasecaivamasakṛttanmanā yogamunnayet hṛdayādūrddhameva tu paraṃ sthānaṃ tatra taddvārapaddhatiḥ yathākālaṃ nābhitaścocchvasetpunaḥ mahātmānamātmānaṃ pratipadyate brahma gatiṃ jñātvā bhavecchuciḥ devaṃ sa gacchetparamāṅgatim vā ramate manaḥ jānīyātpradhvaṃse dhāraṇātmake praviṃdetedṛgjapasya prabhāvataḥ yogīśvaraṃ prāpya nirdvandvaṃ paramātparam svarānsnātaḥ pavitramidamuttamam sukṛtī bhavet syācchraddadhānasya kurvataḥ tatsiddhirupajāyate vākyamatyantayatnena brahmābhyeti sanātanam vedagarbhaśarīreṇa sa vai nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ pretya draṣṭavyaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam bhagavāñcchruyate puruṣottamaḥ āraṇyakavidhānena nirvapetpratyahaṃ carum cakṣurdivyaṃ hoturdadāti saḥ bhaktavatsalaḥ

hārī hiraṇmayavapurdhṛtaśaṃkhacakraḥ sthānaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitameti viṣṇoḥ nityaṃ jāpyena ravimaṇḍale mālatīkuśapatraṃ ca sadyastuṣṭikaraṃ hareḥ prasādāttu devadevasya cakriṇaḥ na yatnaḥ vṛhaspatiprasūtāstā asyai sandatta vīryam riṣyati pūruṣaḥ saṅgatya vīrudhosyai sandatta vīryam dvipāccatuṣpādasmākagūṃsarvamastvanāturam brāhmaṇasta gūṃ rājanpārayāmasi vaidyastvamṛtahastaḥ syādanyaḥ svastyayanaṃ bhajet jāyante tathājīrṇāni pañca vā hyoṣadhīrvipraḥ sūktametajjapetsadā varuṇaṃ ceṣṭvā vindate dviṣadoṣadhīḥ homena ca samanvitaḥ namaskṛtya vṛṣṭiṃ vindati śobhanām deśadeśe thāsyantyanyāśca vai kṣitau devāḥ kiṃ vaktavyaṃ taducyatām mahāmāyā tviyaṃ parā muktiśca kleśo naiva ca naiva ca ca tāmasaṃ rupaṃ tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ tu sāttvikam tanme jānīhi śatarudriyam bhavedrudra ādityaḥ parapūruṣaḥ lalāṭe ca bhruvormadhye ca haṃsa ṛk

śantamayā giriśantābhicākaśīhi vadhanvāni tanmasi sahasrayojane vadhanvāni tanmasi vediṣadatithirduroṇasat havāmahe śalyānāṃ mukhā śivo naḥ sumanā bhava te hetidvayaṃ bāhvoḥ prakoṣṭhayoḥ gūṃ sahasrayojanevadhanvāni tanmasi gūṃ sahasrayojanevadhanvāni tanmasi bāhubhyāṃ tava dhanvane tayāsmānviśvatastvamayakṣmayā paribhuja sahasrayojanevadhanvāni tanmasi pañca hṛdaye tu nyasedimāḥ vicinvatkebhyo nama ānirhatebhyaḥ kukṣyostu namastakṣabhya ityapi namo namo virūpebhyo viśvarūpebhyaśca vo namaḥ puṣṭānāmpataye namo namo bamluśāya namo namaḥ śvanibhyo mṛgayubhyaśca vo namaḥ miḍhuṣṭameti kaṭyāñca ye bhūtānāntu guhyake iṣava ābhurasya niṣaṅgadhiḥ āyudhannidhāya kṛttiṃ vasāna ācara pinākambibhradāmahi teṣāgūṃsahasrayojanevadhanvānitanmasi mahāntamūrvośca eṣa te jānunornyaset parṣadatidurgāṇi viśvā nāvevasindhunduritātyagniḥ || satīnasatvā havyobhareṣu marutvānno bhavatvindra ūtīḥ

rīriṣaḥ pinākāvasaḥ kṛttivāsā ahigūṃsannaḥ śivotīhi pathāṃ pathiraṅghryoḥ syādadhyavocaśca varmakam sarvo hyeṣa rudrastasmai rudrāya namo astu teṣāgūṃsahasrayojanevadhanvāni tanmasi sarvāñjambhayansarvāśca yātu dhānyo dharācīḥ parāsuva nyasennetre tṛtīyake sattvāno hantebhyokarannamaḥ parā tā bhagavo vvapa etāvanta iti ca kuryāddigbandhanantataḥ teṣāgūṃsahasrayojanevadhanvāni tanmasi imannyāsamprakurvāṇaḥ pāvakepi na naśyati proktonena kuryānnyāsānte tu namaskṛtim dakṣahaste vāmahaste nābhau pādadvaye tathā nyāsastṛtīyopi procyatetra śṛṇuṣva tam tṛtīyesmiñśaivaṃ tejaḥ samāviśet dikpālāṃstattanmantreṇa vinyaset haviṣā yajāmaḥ anyamasmadicchasāta ityā namo devi nir-ṛte tubhyamastu naḥ dīpyamānamaśaktāste palāyante vidūrataḥ nyasya mukhemarmāṇi te tathā iva pravayāmujjihānāḥ prabhānavaḥ siṣanenākamaccha devāḥ urorvarīyo varuṇaste kṛṇotu jayantantvā nu devā madantu

jātavedāstacchirasi nyāmaḥ proktaścaturthakaḥ sambhūta iti varma pratirathaṃ matam viśvamājānamagre jāto namo rucāya brāhmaye vidyāttasya devā asanvaśe ma iṣāṇa pañcamaḥ proktoyaṃ sarvābhīṣṭasādhakaḥ tu tmanā dvitīyāstṛtīyeṣu śrayadhvaṃ tṛtīyāścaturtheṣu saptamā aṣṭameṣu ṣoḍaśāḥ saptadaśeṣu śrayadhvaṃ vi gūṃ śā ekavi gūṃ śeṣu gūṃ śeṣu ekonatrigūṃśeṣu śrayadhvaṃ dvātrigūṃśāstrayastrigūṃśe bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥsvāhā nivedya rudrāyopatiṣṭhettataḥ punaḥ asya dvipadaścatuṣpadaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema bharīmabhiḥ śatrūn pūrbhirāyasībhirnipāhi nāsikāyāṃ caṃdrādityau ca netrayoḥ mūrdhni cādityā mahādevaḥ śirogataḥ śailī ca pārśvayoḥ śivaśaṅkarau agnijvālāmālikāśca tiṣṭhantu bahuśo mama

māmiti procya prapañcaṃ manasā hunet ahamamṛte amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi ahamamṛte amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi ahamamṛte amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi ahamamṛte amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi ahamamṛte amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi pārthivoktaprakāreṇa liṅgapūjāṃ tataścaret bhaktyā tvāṃ māṃ gṛhāṇa maheśvara śīghrammama havyāya śarva saḥ kṛttivāsā ahi gūṃ sannaḥ śivotī hi cātra tvaṃ mama cābhimukho bhava prītibhāvena liṅgesminsannidho bhava paścācchuddhodakenātha tataḥ pūjanamārabhet rudrāgnāviṣṇū ityadhyāyadvayena ca tu yaḥ kuryātpratyahaṃ naraḥ sandhyāvandanataḥ kṣīṇaṃ taccetprāgjanmajambhavet nastasyuḥ ā nā viṣṇustathaikakam yastu kuryālliṅgābhiṣecanam pāpe naṣṭe lakṣmīrvivardhate cāsya yathārūpaṃ tathā toye pradṛśyate yairliṅgante na paśyanti bhāskarim

dhanaprado'dhanānāñca mahāpātakanāśanaḥ dīkṣāyāntasya pāpakṣayaṅkaraḥ syāddṛṣṭanyāyena niṣkṛtiḥ sāmarthye śaraṇāgatanāśanam yattadatirudro vināśayet paṭhanīyau tathā tena śākhākhaṇḍaṃ na kārayet yajamānasya brāhmaṇadvārataḥ kṛtā śākhāmiśraṃ kṛtaṃ karma yajamānaṃ vināśayet cāṇḍālavajjñeyo nirdhanassaptajanmasu cejjapadānābhyāṃ tadrudrāṃśosya niṣkṛtiḥ devyannabhoktā plavago mūṣako viṣṇuvittabhuka prasādaṃ na ca gṛhṇanti svayandattādṛte kvacit pūjakāste tu sukhaṃ kurvantyanuttamam paṭhedrudrantaittirīyaṃ luptaśākhastameva hi vācyaṃ tāntrikāya kadācana bāhubhyāmuta te namaḥ yā tava tayā no rudra mṛḍaya śantamayā giriśantābhicākaśīhi kuru māhigūṃsīḥ puruṣaṃ jagat prajuhuyādgoghṛtaṃ yotra suprabham yatkiñcitkāryamuddiśya tasya siddhiḥ prajāyate grāme naśyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ pañcadaśāhantu rājyopadravanāśanaḥ naśyenmāsamātreṇa homataḥ prajāyate || ayutaṃ rudrahomena mahāśāntirbhaveddhruvam

prātarlakṣañjaptvā sukhī bhavet vyādhīnāṃ nāśanaṃ cetthaṃ prayogāntaramucyate kṣipedrakṣā daśadigbhyaḥ prajāyate kṣipennityaṃ pathi kṣemaṃ prajāyate sarṣapaistāḍyaḥ saptavārābhimantritaiḥ gṛhītvā gacchanti kare candanameva hi samastāṃ skandādigrahapīḍā vinaśyati tadguṇo yaḥ syādanyathā tu yathā tithiḥ haretsavigrahāṇāṃ ca sarṣapaistāḍanaistathā tathā rātrau triśūlamabhimantrayet triśūlenāstavegāste nāśaṃ gacchanti pannagāḥ kṣipettattālaśabdena pannagotsādanaṃ bhavet bhito dikṣuḥ śritāḥ sahasraśo vaiṣāgūṃheḍa īmahe mṛḍayāti naḥ tryabdamakṣayovibhavo [tasyeti śeṣaḥ ||] bhavet syādghṛtasrāvācca varṣaṇam yāti savitā varado bhavet cārkasamidhāṃ śaktaścetsa jale japet tu bhajatāmiṣṭāṃ siddhiṃ prayacchati kṛtvā saghṛtapāyasam kārṣāpaṇasahasrakam lakṣamekaṃ puraskṛtiḥ parā tā bhagavo vapa śalyānāmmukhā śivo naḥ sumanā bhava iṣava ābhurasya niṣaṅgadhiḥ

tayāsmānviśvatastvamayakṣmayā paribhuja bāhubhyāṃ tava dhanvane iṣudhistavāre asmannidhehi tam nirasayedgacchedgacchanti śatravaḥ coccārya śatrornāma smaranhunet japannutsādayetsagrāmameva ca vaiśyantu ṣaḍbhāgenaikajātikam viprādivaśyakāmastu dadhikṣaudraghṛtānvitāḥ hīnavarṇānvaśīkartuṃ varuṇārkakavetasān saugandhikānutpalāgnikumudāni prayacchati bhavedrājā ṣaḍbhirmantraiḥ pṛthakpṛthak lakṣamekantilānāṃ yaḥ pṛthagdhatte śivopari ayutaṃ rājavṛkṣasya samidho homayettu yaḥ ṣaṭsahasraṃ yo dakṣiṇāmūrtisannidhau asādhyasyāpi siddhiḥ syāddhṛtvā cāṣṭasahasrakam sahasrāṣṭakametasya dravyambhavati cākṣayam lokopakārāya sāvadhānatayā śṛṇu sahasraṃ tu juhuyāllokavanditaḥ puṣṭānāmpataye namonamaḥ namo namaḥ sūtāyāhantyai vanānāmpataye namonamaḥ saṃgrāmagatastasya kauśalyārthamidañjapet sūtāyāhantyai pūrvantu pariśiṣṭaṃ nigadyate vārivaskṛtāyauṣadhīnāmpataye namonamaḥ uccairghoṣāyākranda yate patīnāmpataye namonamaḥ taskarāṇāmpataye namo namaḥ

vyāghracaurādikairvane naktañcaradbhyo vikṛntānāmpataye namonamaḥ namonamaḥ yā nāśakosya japaḥ smṛtaḥ namastiṣṭhadbhyo dhāvadbhyo śca vo namonamaḥ vo namaḥ śāntaye prajapedidam upagaṇābhyastṛ gūṃ hatībhyaśca vo namaḥ namo namo virūpebhyo viśvarūpebhyaśca vo namaḥ arbhakebhyaśca vo namaḥ vo namaḥ dattvā japtvā caitānnirāmayaḥ trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhedetadevaṃ varṣeṇa bhāgyavān srotasyāya ca dīpyāya ca tṛptimāpnoti yanmataṃ ca parairapi ślokyāya ca vasānyāya ca nama urvaryāya ca khalyāya ca jñātiśreṣṭhatvamāpnoti japenaiva na saṃśayaḥ śrutāya ca śrutasenāya ca naśyati khaṃjatvaṃ pādukāsiddhimāpnuyāt namo nādeyāya ca vaiśantāya ca jayakṛccāyamanuvākaḥ prakīrtitaḥ medhyāya ca vidyutyāya ca nama indriyāya cātathyāya ca abhimantraṇametena tena toyaṃ vimuñcati śaṅgave ca paśupataye ca nama ugrāya ca bhīmāya ca namo vṛkṣebhyo hrikeśebhyo namastārāya

mayaskarāya ca namaḥ śivāya ca śivatarāya ca bhasmatoyañca bhakṣayellepayettathā bhaveddivyo rogaḥ kṣudro dinatrayāt tattīrthaphalaṃ labhate ceha janmani kṣayāṇāya ca namaḥ kapardine ca pulastaye ca harityāya ca namo lopyāya ca colpyāya ca sidhyatyetatprasādataḥ namontasyāgrataḥ paṭhet varhiṣodakamārjanāt deyaṃ śokaśāntyai tu śokine pariśiṣṭaṃ caitadatra prayogeṣvapi yo japet bhūpālātprāpnuyādvarṣamadhyataḥ pradātavyā gāva ekādaśaiva hi tu rājalakṣmīḥ svayaṃ vaset śatapuṣpamayīṃ kṛtvā pratimāṃ rājarūpyakām lakṣantu hutvā bhūpaśriyaṃ labhet hṛtasāmantarājyaṃ sa prāpnotyeva na cānyathā rāṣṭraṃ sāmantasya labheta saḥ dadyādbhūtebhyaśca tathā balim cārdhapalaṃ vāpi dakṣiṇāmūrtisannidhau kapilājyena pradīpinyābhimantritam vākyaṃ sarvatra niścitam bahugavāṃ sa syātkṣīyante nāsya dhenavaḥ suvarṇāṣṭakamāpnoti hyasiddho rajatāṣṭakam haimavatī tadabhāve vibhītakam

hunedyastasya lakṣmīstu svayamevopatiṣṭhate paśūnāṃ mā bhermā roṅmocanaḥ kiñca nāmamat vāsāṃsi bhavanti ca tathātathā urṇābhāścājīvadavestanūṃ vihāya ca sampramantyāthaikādaśa granthayassmṛtāḥ vāmahaste tu garbhiṇyāḥ sa suvīta sukhaṃ sutam sūtrantu mantreṇaivābhimantritam kadāciduttamarṇādvai bhayantasya na jāyate asminnanāturam mahājvaropaghātepi mṛtakalpaḥ sa jīvati mahāgrahajvarādibhyobhicārācca pramucyate pīḍā sadya eva vinaśyati tuṣānprajuhuyādayutaṃ sukhamedhate juhuyāllakṣaṃ sarvaśaktikaraṃ smṛtam saṃsthāpya juhuyādvaikaṅkatīghṛtaplutāḥ ghṛtāktānāṃ prajuhuyānmahājvaramukhā grahāḥ gajaṃ vāśvaṃ muktvā gacchanti dūrataḥ hānirvā tatra śāntirudīryate mahāmārīvyāghrādibhyo bhayaṃ na vai madhyabhāge tu vahnisthāpanamācaret sthāpyāstataḥ karma sāvadhānaḥ samācaret tatordharātrasamaye tvodanaṃ saghṛtantilān dadyātsthānesthāne tato balim pakṣamekaṃ sarvopadravanāśanam bhavediṣṭaṃ tridinārvāṅmiletkhalu

rudrarīriṣaḥ śītalādibhya ārogyaṃ jāyate kṣaṇāt kāryasiddhaye saṃśodhya cātmānaṃ pūtakāyo japañcaret bhikṣāñcājyañjapastasya bhavedayutasaṃkhyakaḥ tvahorātrañjapaḥ kāryo nirantaram mahāvyāhṛtibhiḥ paścāttāvadeva ghṛtaṃ hunet karma prakurvīta prāyaścittaṃ punaḥ punaḥ maraṇādiprayogāṇāmbhavetpātakamocanam samidhāñcauṣadhyaḥ sarvakarmasu juhuyāllakṣmīkāmo vā śivadarśanāt ghṛtāktānāṃ sarvārthasya smṛddhaye sahasrāṣṭakamādarāt labhetāṣṭasahasrakam bhāryāmukī me bhavatu hyedarthe hunecchuciḥ sūtā vṛṣabhaṃ vāsitāpi gauḥ aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā tathā cāṣṭasahasrakam āyuṣmatoṣṭaputrāṃśca janayennātra saṃśayaḥ āyuṣkāmoṣṭasāhasraṃ cirāyuṣṭvaṃ sa vindate sahasrāṇyaṣṭa juhuyādicchetkṣudrānyadā paśūn nṛpatirbhavedvaśyo na saṃśayaḥ samyakspṛṣṭastena spṛṣṭo yoyosau vaśago bhavet hutvā lakṣaṃ tejonidhirbhavet samidhoṣṭasahasrāṇi śatroruccāṭanaṃ bhavet sahasraṃ tu caturdikṣu kṣipettataḥ

vāram || mayā bhuvo ye dakṣiṇena tuvimātramavobhiḥ naḥ no vasornirbhāk makṣu jarantam na iṃdra vidmahi na hi tvā śūrameva ca tveti bahiśca hṛdayādiṣaḍaṅgakam dvādaśa-ṛgbhistu nyāsamatra samācaret bhuje jaṭhare nābhimadhyataḥ mantrarājākṣaraiścaiva tṛtīyo nyāsa eva ca dgbandhaṃ pāde śirasi caikakam sampūjya ṛgbhirdvādaśabhistathā naivedyairvividhākārairmodakaiḥ siddhalaḍḍukaiḥ ikṣukhaṇḍairikṣurasaiḥ kadalīpanasādibhiḥ tāmbūlairdakṣiṇābhiḥ samantataḥ japenmantrarājaṃ vāradvādaśakaṃ budhaḥ antardvādaśapāṭhe tu mantrarājaṃ punarjapet japaḥ saṃsiddhikārakaḥ vakratuṇḍasya japa ādau prajāyate itimantraḥ |] ṣaḍakṣaraḥ evamaṣṭottaraśataṃ kṛtvā sūktaṃ japaṃ hare japāddaśā.śahomastu pāyasena ghṛtena ca bilvapatrairikṣudaṇḍairdāḍimaiḥ kadalīphalaiḥ sarvadravyāṇāṃ juhuyāttilasarpiṣā

tadabhāve guḍodakam daśāṃśena brāhmaṇānbhojayedbahūn apūpairmaṃḍakādyaiśca saghṛtaiḥ śarkarānvitaiḥ evaṃsiddhe tu sūkte tu saphalaṃ tannigadyate samavāpnoti cānte brahmapuraṃ vrajet tattadgaṇapaternūnaṃ prasādātsidhyati dhruvam mahotpāte paracakrabhaye tathā bandhoccāṭanayordveṣe sarṣapairlohasaṃyutaiḥ śmaśānastho rātrau kuryājjapaṃ ruṣā meṣīlomānvitaiścaiva homaḥ syānmāraṇe dhruvam ākarṣaṇārthaṃ sādhyānāmunmattaphalabījakaiḥ saptavāsaraparyantantataścākarṣaṇaṃ bhavet sūryāstamanamārabhya yāvatsūryodayo bhavet prakartavyo madhupuṣpaiḥ phalaistathā raktacandanasaṃyuktairmodakaiḥ saghṛtaistilaiḥ rājaputrāśca rājakīyāśca mantriṇaḥ bandhamokṣāya kartavyo japo rātrau śivālaye ekaviṃśatisāhasraṃ divā homaḥ śivālaye homaḥ pratyarcaṃ hi vidhānataḥ paścānmantravibhāgena pratyarcaṃ juhuyādbudhaḥ prakāreṇa sarvasādhāraṇe jape devīsūktaṃ tathaiva ca cecchā yatra tatprati pṛcchyatām kalipratyayavedamantraprakāśo dvādaśaḥ vedamārgeṇa kīdṛkpūjā manuśca kaḥ

brūhi teṣāṃ pūjāvinirṇayam tu duḥkhena sarvānsampīḍayanti hi cakravartisutaṃ dāsaṃ yadā te nīcasaṃsthitāḥ vacaścāndrirjīvo jñānasukhe tathā kheṭopāsanato martyastrikālajñaḥ prajāyate saukhyaṃ grahaiśca saha bhuñjate devatā tu savitā parikīrtitaḥ paśyan bhuvanasyātha mantrasya padanyāsaṃ samācaret śrīsūktokta-ṛcāṃ sthāne tato dhyāyeddivākaram saptakhaḍgaṃ ca jātaṃ deśe kaliṅgake raktāmbaradharaṃ raktābharaṇairupaśobhitam sakeyūraṃ maṇḍitaṃ raktacchatriṇam pratyadhidaiveśvareṇāsavyayuktaṃ ca prāṅmukham dvādaśāṃgulayukte ca śrīparṇādikapīṭhake japenmantraṃ juhuyāttaddaśāṃśataḥ raktacandanamiśritaiḥ madhucchandā muniśchando gāyatryagniśca devatā viniyogastu savituḥ prītaye ceti kīrtayet ratnadhātāram prītaye ceti kīrtayet agniṃ purā tanayitno savitā hiraṇyarūpamavase kṛṇudhvam yavatilaghṛtairvā madhuratrayaiḥ lavaṇaṃ takraṃ divā svāpaṃ ca maithunam manau jāte nṛpāḥ syustasya kiṃkarāḥ

cchāyāṃ paśyatyaśīrṣikām tvṛcā pādairatha ṛktritayaiḥ svayam trikālādyaistadā hanti duḥsādhyānapi bhāskaraḥ kuśāgrāṇi tilāṃstattrayameva ca tāmrapātre tu kastūrīṃ keśaraṃ vidhum dṛṣṭvā sūryaṃ namaskṛtya dadyādarghyamananyadhīḥ sarvaṃ bhānuvāre viśeṣataḥ upakuṣṭhādayo ye ca kṛte sandhyādvayepi te saptatidinairmaṇḍalena trisaptakaiḥ ca pūjayitveṣṭamāpnuyāt harimāṇaṃ ca nāśaya harimāṇaṃ nidadhmasi randhayanmo ahaṃ dviṣateragham triṣṭubjagatyauchandasī devatā savitā mataḥ hiraṇyayena savitā rathena devo yāti bhuvanāni paśyan bādhamānaḥ taviṣīndadhānaḥ tasthuḥ dāśuṣe vāryāṇi santuṣṭyai duṣṭo vā yasya bhāskaraḥ sarvañcaikataraṃ dadyānnityaṃ bhāskarasevakaḥ tu nityaṃ syāddhārayedarkamūlakam ityekaṃ somo devaḥ prakīrtitaḥ saṅgathe rudroktāṅgeṣu dikṣu ca

pāśapāṇiṃ dvibāhuṃ tamatrigotrasamudbhavam śvetadhvajapatākāḍhyaṃ keyūramaṇibhūṣitam vāyavyābhimukhaṃ yutam candramarceddevadvayānvitam japādyampūrvavatsarvamadhipratyadhidevayoḥ śvetadūrvānvitaistarpyaḥ palāśasamidho hunet vā japenmantraṃ daśāṃśataḥ devatāścandraprītaye viniyojanam viśvaśambhuvam samākhyātā niyogaścandratuṣṭaye kṣīreṇārghyaṃtu śaṅkhena dadyāddevasya tuṣṭaye dāntaḥ sukīrtiśca śrīmāndātā surūpavān chandastriṣṭubdevatā ca candramāḥ parikīrtitaḥ vṛṣatvebhirmahitvādyumnebhidyumnyabhavonṛcakṣāḥ śuciṣṭvamasi priyo na mitro dakṣāyyo aryamevāsi soma jīvase ttvāvataḥ sakhā āviśa kaviḥ naḥ saṃgathe suśravastamaḥ sakhāvṛdhe sādanyaṃ vidathyaṃ sabheyampitṛśravaṇaṃ yo dadāśadasme tvamātatanthorvantarikṣa tvaṃjyotiṣā vitamo vavartha tvā tanadīśiṣe vīryasyobhayebhyaḥ pracikitsāgamiṣṭhau

kṣiptvā snānañcandrasya tuṣṭaye muktāhāraṃ ca vibhave tāraṃ vā śaktito dadet phalairyuktaṃ somamūlaṃ ca dhārayet mahāpātakajānrogānsa tu nāśayituṃ kṣamaḥ samuccārya tannāśāya tato vedet ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ hyṛcā kalpena coccaret śikhābandhantataḥ kṛtvā bhūtotsādanamācaret mantreṇa diśāmbandhaṃ samācaret saśarāyāstrarājāya caturthyantaṃ sudarśanam kṛtvā prāṇasthāpanamācaret guruṃ dhyātvā nyāsaṃ kuryāttataḥ param mitro rakṣatu māntataḥ vihitākaraṇātpāpādravī rakṣatu māṃ sadā sūryo rakṣatu māṃ sadā sarvabhūtebhyaḥ sarvadā māṃ ca rakṣatu niṣiddhagamanātpāpādbhānū rakṣatu māṃ sadā ṛtustrīsaṅgasambhūtātpāpātpūṣābhi rakṣatu māṃ tamojātpāpataḥ sadā mukhajihvodbhavātpāpānmarīcirmāṃ sadāvatu dṛksamudbhavapātakāt taddṛṣṭantatpāpātsavitāvatu tvaglomasambhavātpāpādbhānurmā parirakṣatu vidveṣaṇakṛtātpāpādbhāskaro māṃ sadāvatu vinyasya prāgvaddhyāyeddivākaram gandhākṣatādipuṣpāṇi raktānyeva prayojayet

praskaṇvanāmā tu cchandonuṣṭupca devatā santarpayāmīti caivaṃ proktaṃ sitetare vadedardharcake mitraravibhyāmarghyamityapi sarvatra sūryantu tarpayābhīti saṃvadet tu kāryaṃ nānyatra vāsare sahasraṃ tu śītatvādimahāgade sarvanīrukprajāyate bipulāṃ lakṣmīṃ brahma prāpnotyanāmayam śrīsūryaḥ kriyayā jātaḥ pūjā tatra viśiṣyate samabhavaccandraḥ pūjā tatra viśiṣyate devatā ca gāyatrī chanda īritam āpāgūṃretāgūṃsi jinvati kartavyaḥ padanyāso dvitīyakaḥ pūjyamānaṃ caturbāhuṃ kirīṭinam vaśiṣṭhagotrasambhūtaṃ jamadagnyarṣikaṃ kujam avantīdeśasambhūtaṃ dhyātvā devamprapūjayet tatrāvāhya prapūjayet gāyatrī bhūśca devatā saprathāḥ || apanaḥ śośucadagham kujaprītyai japārthaṃ viniyojanam gojihvāndhārayennityaṃ bhaumavāre tu rogikaḥ ripavo netracchāyāgnisannibhāḥ uddiṣṭaṃ devogniḥ kujatuṣṭaye haryanaḥ naḥ

adharāṇāmabhiśriyam kratupaḥ ketumīmahe sahaṣkṛtaḥ vṛdhe apāgūṃretāgūṃsi jinvati jyotīgūṃṣyarcayaḥ śarmaṇi giraḥ dhṛṇīmahe āhutaḥ bodhinaḥ ihāśiṣaḥ manmabhiḥ ||] || phalinībakulairyuktaṃ snānambhaumasya tuṣṭaye suraktavastramasṛjastuṣṭyai cāśvāripuṣpakam budhavāre tu jātastatra mahotsavaḥ devatāsya buddho buddhiprado mataḥ pītavarṇampītagandhānulepanam dadhataṃ hastairatrigotrasamudbhavam bṛhatīchandasampītacchatradhvajapatākinam yuktaṃ jñaṃ cintayāmyaham jñaṃ [budham ||] samyagāvāhya pūjayet apāmārgasamidbhiśca tarpaṇāni tataścaret medhātithirmunistasya gāyatraṃ chanda īritam

pāṃsure svāhā munirdīrghatamāḥ proktaśchandastriṣṭubudāhṛtam vicakramāṇastredhorugāyaḥ malinaṃ dadhyādvṛddhadārujaṭāntathā pratipakṣāṇāṃ svayaṃ jetātra jāyate bṛhatītriṣṭubjagadgāyatragāni ca vaḥ yajñaṃ praṇayatā sakhāyaḥ ca śruṣṭiḥ sabharā asanno nedīya itsṛṇyaḥ pakvameyāt sumnayā mudriṇaṃ vayaṃ suṣekamanu pakṣitam akṣitam dṛṃhatātam mahī gauḥ ityanekārthadhvanimañjarīkośe ||] snapet [snapayet ||] prītaye dadyānmālatyāḥ kusumāni vā himagorjāto budhastasyotsavotra tu devapativanditosti hi devatā pravakṣyāmi yattadasya bṛhaspateḥ sauvarṇakirīṭena virājitam anuṣṭupchandasaṃ cāṅgirasagotraṃ sureḍitam brahmapratyadhidevena yutaṃ sañcitya cāhvayet haridrākṣatasaṃsiddhe maṇḍale taṃ prapūjayet kāṣṭhaiḥ syāttarpaṇaṃ pītapañcabhiḥ munirgṛtsamadastriṣṭupchanda indraśca devatā

adhisañjñā gurostasya tuṣṭaye viniyojanam sudinatvamahnām gurośceyaṃ proktā pratyadhidevatā sandhārayedbāhau brahmamūlaṃ tu dhārayet rājamānaṃ svaśaktyā vārthabodhanam ityuktaṃ devatātra bṛhaspatiḥ yo vīravaḥ kṛṇoti brahmaṇe rājā tamavanti devāḥ mālatīpuṣpayuktāśca snānena gurutoṣaṇam pradeyaṃ syādabhāve caṇakāstathā gururjātastatra kāryastadutsavaḥ nigaditaṃ daityācāryastu daivatam hi māyā avasi svadhā vo bhadrā te pūṣanniha rāti rasti śuklavarṇaṃ śuklagandhānulepanam daṇḍinaṃ ca sākṣasūtrakamaṇḍalum śvetacchatradhvajapatākinaṃ bhārgavagotrajam śvetavarṇe pañcakoṇe navāṃgule daityaguruṃ maṇḍale pūjayettataḥ kāṣṭhaiśca tarpaṇādi tu candravat devatā proktā niyogaḥ śukratuṣṭaye na jarasā marate patirviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ niyogosya viśvataḥ śukratuṣṭaye nāmbarandadhyānmunimūlaṃ [agastyamūlam ||] ca dhārayet yātrāsiddhiḥ prakāśaśca cāntarbhūpatayo vaśāḥ triṣṭubjagatyaśchandāṃsi pūṣā daivatamucyate īyate

tābhirvāpi ityā sūryāsya kāmena kṛtaśrava icchayāmaḥ yo devāso adaduḥ sūryāyai kāmanakṛtantavasasya cam ebhiryuktairjalaiḥ snāyādbhārgavasya tu tuṣṭaye ghṛtandadyācchukratuṣṭyai tadabhāve tu taṇḍulān punarvasau śukre maghāyāmetadantaram ityuktaṃ devatā tu śanaiścaraḥ naḥ varadaṃ gṛdhravāhanam gāyatrīchandasaṃ devaṃ kṛṣṇābharaṇabhūṣitam yuktaṃ dhyātvā samarcayet kṛṣṇapuṣpaiścandanantu kālīyairaguruṃ hunet mantramatra tu kīrtayet gacchatyagnidūto araṃ kṛtaḥ phūtkāramātreṇa vinaśyantyakhilā gadāḥ pratiṣṭhā vānuṣṭupa caiva samīritāḥ [navānāmṛcām ||] japataḥ pāpaṃ kāmajātaṃ vinaśyati naḥ śaṃyorabhisravantu naḥ bheṣajam viśvaśambhuvam yadvāśeṣa utānṛtam māsaṃ sṛja varcasā śanerdadyādaśaktastu lohaṃ vā maraṭānapi ityuktaṃ saiṃhikeyastu devatā śaciṣṭhayā vṛtā

khaḍgacarmaśūlabṛhaddharam kṛṣṇapūṣpaiḥ pūjyamānaṅkeyūramukuṭānvitam pāṭalīgotrasaṃbhūtamanuṣṭupchandasaṃgraham sarpādhidevatāyuktaṃ kālapratyadhidaivatam dvādaśāṃgulavistīrṇe pūjayecchyāmalākṣataiḥ dravyaiḥ kaulikāṃstarpayeddvijān devatāḥ proktā niyogo rāhutuṣṭaye prayantsvaḥ bhavetkālo niyogo rāhutuṣṭaye yadīṣṭatṛṣṇayā saha nindennindyakarmasthānvaṃdīmokṣaṇamācaret sādhakājñāṃ tu sadaiva samare jayaḥ gāyatrī devatā devanāyakaḥ vṛtā nayudbhiścarṣaṇīnām kariṣyataḥ abhīṣṭayaḥ asmānviśvābhirūtibhiḥ navāmirindrotibhiḥ gavyurapurīyato dyāmivopari vacāguḍūcītagaraiḥ snānaṃ pātracatuṣṭaye janayāmāsa tasmiṃstaṃ viśeṣeṇārcayenmude proktā gāyatraṃ chanda īritam samuṣadbhirajāyathāḥ

dhūmrākṣabāhavaḥ pāśadharāśca vikṛtānanā citrāmbarāścitravarṇāścitragandhānulepanāḥ citraguptākhyapratyadhidevatāśceti cintayet citravarṇākṣataiḥ puṣpaistatrāvāhya samarcayet madhuratrayasaṃyuktaiścitradravyaiḥ prapūjayet ketuprītaye viniyojanam citraguptotra niyogaḥ ketutuṣṭaye adhvarāṁ upa ye tvā gṛṇanti vahnayaḥ nāśnīyāddagdhamannādi ketusevanatatparaḥ bhavedgupto dṛśyo na sādhakottamaḥ candramarutau gāyatraṃ chanda ucyate kāmyaiḥ vārajasaḥ etadyuktajalasnānātprasīdati sadā śikhī ketutuṣṭyai tu dadyādvā rājamāṣakān kāryaḥ ketūnāntu mahotsavaḥ teṣāṃ siddhiḥ karatale sthitā vacmi tadbruvantviha devatāḥ navagrahakathanaprakārastrayodaśaḥ mantraścedato duḥkhamavāpyate paratrāpi yena saṃlabhyate sukham śiṣyāssukhepsavo'bhaktā hyato na kvāpi siddhayaḥ sampravakṣyāmi sarvatantreṣu gopitam mantratyāgavidhiṃ vakṣye yena sañjāyate sukham prātastasya gṛhaṃ gatvā svīyaṃ duḥkhaṃ nivedayet

ramyabhavane kumbhaṃ dīkṣāvidhānataḥ vilomaṃtantramantreṇa tatrāvāhyeṣṭadevatām mantrī samabhyarcyeṣṭadevatām vāpi tataḥ santarpayedamum yavānnaiścāpi dugdhānnairdigvidikṣvadha ūrdhvataḥ gṛhāṇemaṃ puṣpadhūpādikaṃ balim balimenaṃ prayojitam gṛhāṇemaṃ suprīto varadobhava balipūjādi mayā bhaktyā niveditam pūjāṃ gṛhītvā sukhamāpnuhi vidhivadgṛhāṇa balimādarāt prītau bhavatāṃ varadau mama puṣpadhūpādyaiḥ prītobhava vibhūtaye sarvaviprāgrya jagatkarte namostu te bhaktyā bhava tvaṃ sukhado mama viparītena puṣpadhūpopacārakaiḥ anukalpādinālocya mayā taralabuddhinā mestu bhūyācchreyaḥ sanātanam maṃtreśaṃ maṃtraṃ yaṃtre vilomataḥ bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ mantrapūtaiḥ punaścānyaṃ kumbhaṃ toyaiḥ prapūrayet nimnagāyāṃ ca śuddhe vānyajalāśaye kṛtavidhānasya durlabhasya manorujaḥ jāyate'tīvasampannā vardhate tatkulaṃ sadā dṛśaḥ pātādbhūtapretādhidevatāḥ

puṣṭiṃ samṛddhiṃ ca sādhakāya prayacchati śuddhavākchuddho manasā tathā dambhāhaṅkāramohādivikalo jñānavittamaḥ maṃtrarājamimaṃ labdhvā jāyate sa ca bhūpatiḥ proktaśchandonuṣṭupprakīrtitam tvabhīṣṭeṣu tathāvidhaḥ saṃśodhya pañcagavyena vai punaḥ tataḥ siddhaṃ mantraṃ kāryeṣu yojayet maṃtrarājaḥ brāhmaṇe maṃtro viparītaphalo bhavet prakurvīta tadvidhānaṃ nigadyate śakvarī proktā śāntyarthaṃ viniyojanam daivī svastirastu naḥ dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade vātaye manaḥ gāyatryaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā karma samācaret mantrāṇāṃ bījamoṃśaktiratra hrīm devatā cāsya niyogobhīṣṭasiddhaye pratyakkartāramṛcchatu hrīṃbījāntaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni mantrasya tu samācaret nābhāvūrvorjānunośca padāni padayornyaset dhyāyetsiṃhamukhīṃ muktakeśāṃ digambarām grasantīmahitānnudratejasā dhyānamīritam apāmārgasamidbhistu homo havyaghṛtādibhiḥ lokapālāstadastrāṇi pūjayeditthamarcanam

dikṣu daśamantrairbaliṃharet rājānte bhañjayatviti paścānmārayatvityato balim svastyayanaṃ cāstu balimantra udāhṛtaḥ baliṃ haret] dipadaṃ vadet mantrāḥ syustattaddikṣu baliṃ haret p. 334) evaṃ kṛte śatrukṛtā kṛtyā kṣipraṃ vinaśyati devatā cāsya niyogo ripunigrahe prāhiṇodihādya tvaṃ nityaṃ yojaya svastibhiḥ prāgvanniyogorinivartane syāmyatso anāgasaḥ kālāgnirudrotra niyogorivināśane prajāśca puruṣādini yātudhānyobhicāranāśe niyojanam kṛtyānāśāya sarvāstu yātudhānyaḥ pañcarcakaṃ sūktaṃ śuklāṣṭamyāṃ samācaret ānayeddaṇḍamekaṃtu puruṣasya pramāṇataḥ japettadārātirdahyate sa mahāgrahaiḥ aṣṭaprādeśamātrantu daṇḍaṃ baibhītakaṃ samam mahāvyādhigṛhītosau mriyate nātra saṃśayaḥ hunetsaptarātramaṣṭottaraṃ śatam prakurvītaripurmṛtyumavāpnuyāt nāmavarṇānmantreṇa garbhitān nikhatettatkṣaṇādeva jvaraḥ satroḥ prajāyate dadyādgobhūhiraṇyādi yathā śaktyeti tadvidhiḥ

devatā cāsya niyogo ripunigrahe paśūṃścaivāsya nāśaya vīryaṃ cāsya nibarhaya devatā proktā niyogo riputakṣaṇe parāvṛtya tanuṃ kṛndhi yathā tarum devatā prokto niyogorinikartane rakṣohā coja ekapāt devatā proktā niyogorinikṛṃtane vaśiṣṭhaśca tathaiva nāyasedhi mām devatā proktā niyogorinikartane tantracchatagate jananajñāstejano yataḥ kapilākṣīramanuvākaṃ tryahaṃ japet vijñeyāḥ kāmakrodhādayorayaḥ hunedaṣṭasahasraṃ tu brahmavarcasavānbhavet dugdhāktāścāṣṭa śatakaṃ saptabhirdivasairgrahāḥ pippalasya samidbhiryaśa āpnuyāt rāśiṃ dhyātvāyaṃnāma cetasā bhasmāhorātraṃ mantritaṃ goṣṭhake kṣipet paurṇamāsyāmupoṣyātha rajanyāmaṃgulīyakam sa syādājñayā vibhavena ca tilānbhāraśataṃ dadyāddakṣiṇāṃ tesya pāṭhine caiva viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ viddhvāgniṃ tanumṛccha svahetinā niyogastu vivādādau jayāya ca sarasvatītyavakṛtyamacchiṣastasya kiñcana vivādādau jayāya ca

vā tasya hṛdyasṛk piba dussādhyakāryasiddhyarthaṃ viniyogosya kīrtitaḥ vyaneccāvyanahīnastaharasāśaniḥ kṛtyāmārgasthacaurādināśe tu viniyojanam tairdevirātryāḥ kṛtye no gamayemānnikṛntaya śuklapakṣapradipadamārabhya pratyahaṃ japet bhakṣayetkapilākṣīraṃ haviṣyaudanameva ca samarthodarśanādeva bhavedbhūtasya kā kathā skandagrahabrahmarakṣopasmārādigadāṃstathā sarvopadravaśāntiḥ syādbhavane sādhakasya tu sarvavyādhivināśaḥ syācchivameva dinedine sarvarogāṇāṃ tvaritaṃ śāntikaṃ smṛtam cāṣṭottaraśataṃ māsaṃ tatsarvaduḥkhahṛt svarṇāṃgulīyādi dakṣiṇā mantrapāṭhine devognirviniyogastu sarvaśatrunikarttane vrajāsmābhiḥ kartuṃ tvaṣṭapadīgṛhān niyogastu jarābhavatu śatrave vakṣyāmi taṃ pratyasmatvamṛtyave niyogastu śatruvidveṣaṇe mataḥ brahmācapakuddhaśayāśarvatatkandhaspatim uddiṣṭaṃ niyogoripalāyane tvasindhayiṣṭāya dāvitsarpa tākṣiraḥ gatvā japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyākāṃdadyāttadvatpunarjapet bibhītadaṇḍamādhāya caikaprādeśasammitam

ripukulaṃ jñātājñāvinaśyati prajapecchatrurjvareṇa paripīḍyate putrakalatrāśvagajatādyaṃ vinayaśyati devabhaktānāṃ jātu kuryānna vipriyam uddiṣṭaṃ niyogosyārināśane tiṣṭhati kṛtye vṛko vā vimato gṛhāt cāsya niyogo'ripalāyane śatrūnevābhinojñehi divyāvṛkṣamivāśaniḥ gajā'jaturagādīnāṃ niyogo ripumohane paścādbhara uttarato gṛhe niyogastu ripūṇāṃ trāsanāya ca mṛgoriḥ prāṃtatvāni kartumarhati samārabhya yāvacchuklāṣṭamī bhavet kṛtyādīnhayānāṃ hastināmapi japennaśyedaristasya rakṣitopīśvareṇa cet viṃśaddināvadhi tathā ripoḥ kartavyā rudranyāsāvadhānataḥ purādīnāṃ niyogosya bhavettathā pratigṛhṇasva pramādāya hi cādbhutam rājādeḥ kopaśāntyai niyojanam rudraśca tvaṣṭā caiva prajāpatiḥ niyogastu tvaritaṃ roganāśane ahorātrāstathābdāśca diśaḥ pratidiśaśca me paśūṃścaiva cotpādayasi cādbhutam kasyāpi rakṣaṇārthamudāhṛtam

puruṣosomapasya pūrvakarmasamudbhūtamādhivyādhibhayaṃ haret japansatatañjanturnāribhiḥ paribhūyate mohanāśāya niyogosya prakīrtitaḥ kṛtyānāṃ śatruhanyāya cetasaḥ chandonuṣṭubniyogosya durvadhyārivināśane vayaṃ tasya nikupnaḥ sthātujaṅgamam chandonuṣṭubniyogastu cāsya śatruvināśane pratikṛtsyāmividravaḥ chandonuṣṭubniyogastu tapovighnakarāśca ye lobhālasyādayo vātha dṛśyante ye tapopahāḥ tapovighnakarāḥ pāṭhe svāyudhāśśamidaṃ paṭhet taistairnikapalā pāpinojīvayasyarīn pāpasya nāśāya viniyojanam jānasyānmanave kṣipraveśinau japetpūjayedrudraṃ tasya śatrukṣayo bhavet sahasrantu japanvyādhiṃ nibarhayet sūryasyābhimukhamaṣṭāviṃśatisaṅkhyayā mananābhyāsādvidvattā sūpapadyate chandonuṣṭubniyogastu sudurlabhaprasādhane tvadanu yo mataturyāyaśritaḥ uddiṣṭaṃ niyogaḥ pāpakartane gatvā pāpadhīneva no na hi niyogastu śatrūṇāṃ śoṣaṇe mataḥ sa yo me pāpaṃ cikīrṣati

kṛtābhicārādau yāmaṃyāmaṃ paṭhedidam yo me pāpaṃ cikīrṣati tathā yogo durgasthāne sukhāya ca sarvaṃ dhunvantu brahmavarma mamācaram hunedaṣṭottaraśataṃ ghṛtāktatilataṇḍulān huneddevyāmṛtamaṣṭottaraṃ śatam cittaśāntiḥ prajāyate brahmatejomayastasya bhāti dehotibhāsvaraḥ vṛtāktairaṣṭasāhasraṃ hutvā pātakanāśanam varṣamadhye prajāyate vaidikāṃśca manurvedamayo yataḥ uktaḥ sarvatantreṣu gopitaḥ pravakṣyāmi sarvatantreṣu gopitam tataḥ kuryāddevatyāgādipūrvakam vā samakṣaṃ vā guroḥ samprārthayetsuram dvibhujādidehī dhyātoparādhaśatakaṃ mama tatkṣamasva bhagavankṣamasva kṣamasva karuṇākara dīnabandho siddhirjapānna ca bahiṣkṛtapūjanādyaiḥ mantramūrtyādikaṃ sarvaṃ gurave tatsamarpayet dviguṇitaṃ sarvatrāpi ca taddināt devatātyāgo mayā tubhyaṃ niveditaḥ pratyaṅgirāmantrakathanaprakāśaścaturdaśaḥ yantrāṇiśrotumicchāmi vāñchitārthapradāni tu smṛtirgatirnṛpāṇāṃ ca purāṇāni viśāntathā

sarveṣāmupari tṛṣṇā tena duḥkhaṃ prajāyate vedakarmavihīnastu vijñeyo brahmarākṣasaḥ vaśīkṛtyasusevetāniśamadhyāyatatparaḥ vaidikairmantrairnānyasya tu kadācana kuryāddhrīṃkāraṃ karṇikāsthitam tadagreṣu gāyatryarṇāṃstriśastriśaḥ kakārādyāṃstathomāpojyotīrasomṛtaṃ brahma vā kṛtvā haste tu bandhayet sarasvatyā mahādbhutam madhye koṇaṣaṭke vāgbhavaṃ bījamālikhet mendro medhayā spṛṇotu amṛtasya devadhāraṇo bhūyāsam mantravarṇānvā bahirvṛtracatuṣṭayam bahirvṛtraṃ mātṛkārṇaiḥ prapūrayet kāmamākūtiṃ vācaḥ satyamasīmahi saṃyunakti aiṃklīṃsauṃhrīṃ ca bījāni paṭasvarṇādinirmite śrutidhārā ca nīrogaśca priyaṃvadaḥ sarvajñastvabhyāso bhavati dhruvam ālikhyāṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ tāraṃ tatkarṇikāntare keśareṣu galeṣu tryambakākṣarān vakṣyamāṇāmṛcaṃ sādhyo nāmavarṇavibhūṣitām munirgṛtsamadastriṣṭupchando rudrastu devatā śṛṇomi etattraiyambakaṃ yantraṃ gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ āyurārogyasaubhāgyadharmārthasukhamokṣadam

|| labhate nātra sandeho yantrasyāsya prabhāvatah madhyamakoṣṭhe tu sasādhyaṃ hrīṃ samālikhet māsāṣṭakena hutvā tu siddhirbhavati bhūyasī cittaśāntiḥ prajāyate || brahmatejomayastasya bhāti dehoti bhāsvaraḥ ghṛtāktairaṣṭasāhasrahomātpātakanāśanam varṣamadhye prajāyate japettadā tasya gaṅgāsnānaphalaṃ bhavet sarvagrahakṛtā doṣā na taṃ pīḍayituṃ kṣamāḥ kuṃkumendusamāyuktaṃ candanaṃ sthāpayetpuraḥ vinaśyettu grahopagrahadūṣaṇam patimāpnoti kanyārthyāpnoti kanyakām tadā mahāvṛṣṭirnagairdinaiḥ havanaṃ kāryamevaṃ sarvasukhāptaye chandastvanuṣṭupsyānmuniḥ pratyāṅgirā mataḥ nakhenaiva raṃjane dantadhāvane sphoṭaya padameṣāṃ kulājali bhūnnaivasyamasyadanaṃ paramasya kṣamabhisaṃdasva śanaiścaradine cāyurārogyaiśvaryamāpnuyāt prakartavyo mantrāṇāmiti nirṇayaḥ mahādevi mamaśatrurvinaśyatu ṣaḍaṅgānyaṃgulinyāsaṃ vakṣye nāmānyanukramāt śikhāyāṃ ca mahābhairavi varmaṇi sarvaparonmuktamantracchedinyathāstrake

sarvāṃśca mātṛkānyāsānpūrvameva samācaret vedaṃ punargāyatrikāṃ paṭhet pārayānavya iti mantraḥ |] pārayeti ca durjuhoti || gāyatrīpūrvakaṃ mūlaṃ yajanājinamityṛcam kāmanāyā vicārya ca vidhau kāmaḥ siddhyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ pañcarcabhiśca pañcāṅgaṃ pañcamyā punarastrakam sopi bādhyate madanādikaiḥ japatastasya śatrunāśosti tatra ca śatrūṃstriśūlena kupyasva piba śoṇitam samastaroganāśārthe niyogo nandivṛddhaye bhayaṃ krodhaṃ viṣaṃ nāśaya nokṣare pūrvatatkuryādaṃgulyādiṣaḍaṅgakam gāyatryādimataistattu prāgvatsaṃdarbhitaṃ matam kāryasiddhiḥ puṇyā girāṃ tviyam tasmāttaṃ parivarjayet syāttithau tasyāṃ bhavedbhuvi karomīti naraṃ vā devameva ca guruṃ tatra pūrvābhāve paraṃ param mantrāvaraṇadevāśca jātidevaḥ kuleśvaraḥ pūjayitvā praṇameddaṇḍavatkṣitau palāśasya prāgre muṣṭestu dakṣiṇe ghaṭaṃ prācyāṃ dugdhapūrṇantu paścime vedikāṃ kārayetsudhīḥ devīmāvāhya sampūjya havanaṃ caret

paścāttadyantraṃ nikhanedbhuvi nakṣatragraharāśīnāṃ lokeśānāṃ baliṃ haret vidhinā nātra saṃśayaḥ kartavyamanyathā duḥkhadaṃ bhavet samuddiṣṭāsteṣāṃ yantraṃ vadāmyaham prādakṣiṇyena tadbāhye vṛttayugmāntare likhet bhuvicāstramidaṃ yantraṃ bhūtaroganivāraṇam dhārayedbāhumūle ca kaṇṭhe vā mastakepi vā sarvārthadaṃ tatra padmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhet śivapañcākṣarasya tu jātavedasamantrasya pūrvārdhantu dvitīyake ṭhaṃ caṃ kaṃ samiti hyauṃ yaṃ maṃ tataḥ pacam yeti saṃ kaṇṭhaṃ tāro māyā dhruvastathā tryambakasyottarārdhantu pañcamethottarārdhakam lekhyamomāpojyotirityapi likhedaṣṭamapatre tu bahirvṛttadvayaṃ likhet koṇeṣu kūṭaṃ cintāmaṇiṃ likhet tataḥ paraṃ candraiḥ kūṭaṃ cintāmaṇermahat śatākṣaramanoryantraṃ bhavedīdṛśameva ca lakṣmīṃ sa jīveccharadāṃ śatam ghṛtena tāvattu kṛtvā sampātameva ca yantrametattu gosatyārogyapuṣṭidaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ teṣāṃ vairivyāghrādibhītitaḥ sasādhyaṃ praṇavaṃ likhet cāsya koṇaṣaṭke likhenmanoḥ

dhruvaṃ dattvā svavarṇānpañca saṃlikhet vismṛtyāśaṃ caturthe tu likhedvaruṇamumoca tat saptame tu ante svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ṛṇamocanametattu yantraṃ sarvasamṛddhidam kimatrabahunoktena vāñchitārthapradaṃ nṛṇām sādhyagarbhaṃ tāraṃ patreṣu cāṣṭasu abhisūryātha ṣaṣṭhake vṛttadvayaṃ kṛtvā mātṛkārṇāṃstadantare suvarṇaratnadhānyādisarvasampatkaraṃ param caitattathā vāgvibhavapradam viṣṇugṛhiṇī bhaktānāṃ tu viśiṣyate prāgdakṣiṇena likheddalacatuṣṭaye abhīṣṭasiddhaye cāsya mantrasya viniyojanam evendrāgnītyṛcaḥ pādā lekhyāstatra vidikṣu ca triṣṭupchandaścandro munirmataḥ someti-ṛco varṇāconpañcāṅgābdhiśarartavaḥ likhedvarṇānvedapañcasaptasaptagavendraṣaṭ hiraṇyagarbhakastriṣṭummunyādyāstadagrime tavapraṇīti pitaro na indro devodyarannamabhajanta dhīrāḥ yaktāmāste juhumastanno astu vayaṃ syāmapatayo rayīṇām sabindukāstasya veṣṭanākāratāṃ gatāḥ bāhumūletha vā kaṇṭhe mūrdhni vā yadi dhārayet putrapautrādiśālinīṃ santatiṃ tadā ṣaṭkoṇamadhye sādhyasya nāmayukpraṇavaṃ likhet vilikheddvandvaśaśca svarānkramāt

viśvāvasurdevī sadā no juṣatāṃ gṛhe kṛtvā tayorantaśca veṣṭayet akārādikṣakārāntavarṇairmadhyaṃ praveṣṭayet śrīyaścaitatpriyaṃ yantraṃ sthāpitaṃ yatra mandire satataṃ caiva tatraiva ramate ramā ṣaṭkoṇamadhye praṇavaṃ sādhyanāmābhigarbhitam klīṃ aimatha tadbhāye likhedaṣṭadalaṃ punaḥ munirdevatā vātriṣṭupchandaḥ prakīrtitam ṛṣirdīrghatamāstriṣṭupchando vāṇī ca devatā munistriṣṭupchando vāgdevatā matā āsūryasya duhitā tatāśravo deveṣvamṛtamarjjayā prāgvanmunyādisarvāsāṃ niyogo vāstusiddhye koṇeṣu vāgbhavaṃ bījamālikhet samāvāhya pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ tārkikāṇāṃ ca cakravartī bhavedasau dyusarillolakallolanibhā niryāti bhāratī padmasya karṇikāyāntu saṃllikhet pūrvādi sukoṇeṣu aṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ krameṇa ca śrīvidyāprathamaṃ kūṭaṃ ka-e-īla ca hrīmiti dvitīyantu likhetkūṭaṃ tṛtīyake proktaṃ likhetṣaṣṭhadale punaḥ tataścāṣṭamapatrake tadbahirvṛtrayorantarveṣṭayenmātṛkākṣaraiḥ likheddhemapaṭādau ca hemasūcyā vaśaṅkaram kamale karṇikāyāñca ṣaḍdalam

śrīṃhrīṃklīṃglaugañca tataḥ pūrvadale likhet mebdhau vaśamānaya svāhā saṃvādasūktasya tadidānīṃ nigadyate samidhyasamano vasūnyā bhava bhāgaṃ yathā pūrve śannānānā upāsate sahavitameṣāṃ samanimātraṃ abhimantraye vaḥ hṛdayāni vaḥ samāni vastu vo mano yathāvatsusahā sati agnirdevastathājāyasañjñānamitarāsu ca jātavedase sunavetyṛcā punaḥ tadbahirbhūpuraṃ kṛtvā tatra pādacatuṣṭayam koṇeṣu ca vikoṇeṣu likhedyacca taducyate rājeti || śannobhavadvipade śañcatuṣpade vaśyaṃ kāntisaubhāgyapuṣṭidam madhye tatra koṇeṣu saṁllikhet tanmadhye sādhyaṃ sādhakakarmayuk sudhīḥ bahiścāpi likhetpārśvadvaye punaḥ binduyutaṃ likhedatha likhetpunaḥ śṛṅkhalākārarekhābhirekaikenāntarāṇi ca vṛttadvayaṃ likhettatra vīthyā lekhyaṃ vilomataḥ tadbāhye kuryādvīthīcatuṣṭayam dvitīyāyāṃ vilomena kuryādbāhyeṣṭakoṇakam triśūlāni kuryātṣoḍaśasaṃkhyayā sarvasaubhāgyajananaṃ sarvaśatruvināśakṛt kartavyā pūjā yantrasya siddhaye

vaidikena sulekhyaṃ kuṃkumādibhiḥ ādyāyāṃ tu ṣaḍaṅgāni parasyāṃ dikcatuṣṭayam tṛtīyavīthyāṃ brāhmādyāḥ pūjanīyā digaṣṭake vikarālīṃ ca dhūmāṃ sarasvatīṃ śriyam medhāṃ matiṃ kāntiṃ cāryāṃ tasya bahiḥ punaḥ vidyāhrīpuṣṭayaḥ prajñā sinīvālī tathā kuhūḥ kālarātrirbhadrakālī mahārātriḥ kapālinī niśumbhaśumbhamathanī mahiṣāsuramardinī dvātriṃśacchaktayastvimāḥ viśālākṣīṃ samṛddhiṃ vṛddhimeva ca trilokadhātrīṃ gāyatrīṃ sāvitrīṃ tridaśeśvarīm śyāmalāṃ paścādaruṇīmāruṇīṃ tathā prakṛtiṃ vikṛtiṃ sṛṣṭiṃ sthitiṃ saṃhṛtimeva ca devamātṛbhagavatyau devakīṃ kamalāsanām cārdhamukhikāṃ bahuśiśnāṃ kṛśodarīm pātālavegāṃ ca madanāturām viśvarūpāṃ daityabhayaṅkarām cāpi viśveśīṃ tadbāhye ca digīśvarān kāmamāpnoti tāntrikopyanayejyayā cāṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ karṇikāyāṃ likheddhruvam kramāddaleṣu sulikhettāraṃhrīmī tathaiva ca kṛtvā pūrvavīthyāṃ samālikhet ca daurgaṃ yantramidaṃ smṛtam strīṇāṃ putradaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ kṛtvāṣṭapatraṃ kamalaṃ śrīṃ bījaṃ kamalāntare

kardametyādipañcarcāmarddhamarddhaṃ daśa tvatha mantrasya dvayoḥ syādardhamardhakam ṛcā cādyā mātṛkārṇaiśca tatparā pañcadaśarcaṃ ca śrīkāmaḥ satataṃ japet koṇacatuṣkeṣu śriyo mantraṃ tu vaidikam lakṣmīṃ jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyākaṃ hutvā sampātasecitam parivārayutāṃ lakṣmīṃ balidānena toṣayet saukhyaṃ tvasaṃkhyantatra jāyate ṣaṭkoṇakarṇikāmadhye tāraṃ sādhyasamanvitam svāgrādiprādakṣiṇyena likhettatraiva sandhiṣu sucakrāya ghīcakrāya caturthakaḥ caturdalaṃ tu kamalaṃ tadbahiṣkeśareṣu ca vāsudevasya mantrasya trīṇitrīṇyakṣarāṇi ca vāsudevāyetyaṇurdvādaśākṣaraḥ ekaikamakṣaraṃ tāro namo nārāyaṇāya ca jayalakṣmīti priyāya nityamuditam namo mantrassyānnṛsiṃhasya radākṣaraḥ bhagavate mahāsudarśanāya ca puruṣasūktasya bahirvṛttadvayaṃ caret saṃbadhyate] puṇyaṃ putrāyuṣkāntikīrtidam japtvā tvṛtusnātāṃ tu bhojayet sannipātike phiraṅgaśītalādyeṣu lekhanātsukhamāpnuyāt

sūktasya yantraṃ sarvārthasiddhidam praṇavaṃ lekhyaṃ stasminhuṃ bījamālikhet cakramantrasya cākṣaram varṇāṃllikhedaṣṭadale punaḥ trayatriṃśadvarṇakoyaṃ varāhasya manuḥ smṛtaḥ ṛcastā atra vakṣyāmi sāvadhānatayā śṛṇu yoṣayitnavā sano mūlatīdṛśe kṣetrasya patirmadhumānno asya ripyaṃ attvenaṃ carema varatrā vadhyantāṃ śunamaṣṭrāmudiṅgayā yamaste na māmupasiñcatam yathā na suphalāsasi duhāmuttarāṃ samām śunamasmāsu dhattam pulastyarṣiranuṣṭup ca triṣṭupchandosti sūktake glauṃbījenādyavīthyāṃ tu veṣṭayenmātṛkārṇakaiḥ huṃbījaṃ yantrametacchubhe dine bhavane dvāre kṣetre vā nagarepi vā gajāśvadhenumahiṣavṛṣoṣṭrāśvatarādibhiḥ vibhavairanyaiśca syātsamāgamaḥ sulikhetkāmabījaṃ sādhyasamanvitam likhitvāgre kuryātpadmaṃ caturdalam vāsudevamanovarṇā dale lekhyāstrayastrayaḥ gopījanavallabhāya svāhā mantraṃ daśākṣaram ramātha gopāla tato viṣadharāya ca ṣoḍaśadalaṃ kṛtvā tatra likhetsvarān

pratidalaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ yathā bhavet nidadhāti devayam sabhāsu māvastena īśatamāghaśaṃsaḥ pāravohaṃtīsavṛjyāḥ syupendra tava vīrye akārāntāṃstadbahiśca bhūpuraṃ samyagālikhet gopālayantrametaddhi vidhinā sthāpitaṃ gṛhe bahurūpāśca viśālāśca bhavanti hi sthirā bhūtvā nivasetsatataṃ tadā madhyeṣṭadalapadmasya sasādhyaṃ praṇavaṃ likhet bahiṣkṛtya tadvīthyāṃ mātṛveṣṭanam gośvādivṛṣaiḥ pūrṇaṃ sadā bhavet sulikhetsādhyaṃ sapraṇavaṃ tataḥ kamalaṃ tadbahiḥ keśareṣu ca udyannadya ṛcaḥ pādā lekhyāstadbāhyato likhet sūryastathāditya idamekaikamakṣaram tadbāhye vīthyāṃ mātṛpraveṣṭanam etadyantraṃ tu sūryasya nāśayetsakalāngrahān etadgomayaliptāyāṃ likhedāraktacandanaiḥ viśiṣṭārghyaṃ prakalpyāsmai pradīyate tāmrapātre likhitvā sthāpitaṃ gṛhe vismṛtiṃ ca rogāṃścaivābhicārikān prajapedudyannadyamiti tryṛcam likhedyantraṃ navīne navanītakam rogaśāntiḥ syātsatyametanna saṃśayaḥ

samastarogāṇāṃ nāśanaṃ sūryavallabham bahistasya trikoṇaṃ tu mantrāgāreti saṃlikhet tatra likhetpañcākṣarāṇi tu huṃphaḍiti aṣṭakoṇe tato likhet likhecśrīhrīṃmiti bījadvayaṃ punaḥ putrajananaṃ strīṇāṃ saubhāgyadāyakam vidhinā dhṛte haste phalapradam mayā proktaṃ sāramātharvaṇasya ca bhaviṣyanti sarve kāmārthasādhakāḥ samayācāravibhraṣṭā vikṣiptāste ca nirdhanāḥ devāyantraṃ tu prakaṭīkṛtam ghrāṇādikaṃ caturbhiśca indriyaistasya madhyagam kartavyamagrayoḥ śūlakadvayam hastābhidhaḥ prokto madhyaṃ kuryācca śūlavat pīṭhikāyuktau pādayostatsthale nyaset dakṣabāhāvūrdhvamaṣṭadalaṃ likhet vāmabāhūpariṣṭācca homo ityakṣaradvayam kāryā hṛdasthānaṃ tiryagūrdhvaṃ tu saṃ sadā vibhāgeṣu alīyaṃ prathamā bhavet caturthantu vihakastattu pañcakam ityaṣṭamañca nastaraṃ na tathāntimam ūrdhvapaṃktau kramāllekhyaṃ ṣaṭkatrādvitayaṃ tathā peśyābahirmama hṛdapeśyadhastāttu dakṣiṇe lekhyaṃ masyā tannīlakarpaṭe ādityavāsare sāyaṃ gomayenopalepayet

tatkarṇikāyāṃ prathamaṃ pūjayecca gaṇādhipam patreṣvindrādikānarcetkarṇikāyāṃ tu dīpikām kuḍavonmānaṃ tilānāṃ tatra tiṣṭhati dīpikādi sāyaṃ tatropaveśayet dīpādhiṣṭhātṛdevasya tuṣṭyai sāvaraṇasya ca prajvaleddīpaḥ paśyettāvadatandritaḥ kāryaṃ śāntirbhavati niścitam kartavyaṃ rogī sukhamavāpnuyāt mahāṃścāpi kṣaṇekṣaṇe kṛtyākṛtadoṣavināśanam mantrabhakṣaṇadoṣotha caturdīpairvinaśyatu naśyedetanmahādbhutam kālimavacchidraṃ vāpi pradṛśyate pūrṇamāyurvinirdeśyaṃ sa rogī naiva jīvati svadharmatyāgināṃ naiva yantraṃ kāryaṃ tu paṇḍitaiḥ yaṃtrāṇi mantrāśca siddhyantyatra na saṃśayaḥ nyāyosau dharmasādhanam bhūyaḥ preto vā brahmarākṣasaḥ karmaparā bhogaṃ svargaṃ prayacchati śaṅkhaśca likhito vyāso vaśiṣṭhaḥ kaśyapo muniḥ bhagavāñjamadagniśca gautamaḥ teṣāṃ vijñeyo daśabhedataḥ deśaṃ jñātvā dharmaṃ samādiśet saṃhitā horā trividhaṃ jyautiṣaṃ tathā yadyattatproktandharmasādhanam

etadviruddhaṃ varṇānāmbhavenno dharma sādhanam gaṇitaṃ śakunaṃ ceti sapta ca yaddarśitambhavettatra samarthaṃ puruṣārthakṛt kāmaśāstraṃ syātprāptyarthaṃ guruśāstrataḥ buddhiṃ puruṣārthaḥ praṇaśyati prākṛtā graṃthā dharmābhāsāśca te surāḥ sarvakarmavivardhanaḥ kuladīpaṃ taducyate [vidhānamiti śeṣaḥ] sīmantonnayanaṃ kāryaṃ tathā puṃsavanaṃ smṛtam jātaḥ saṃskṛto brahmabījataḥ saṃskārā brāhmasiddhaye [brahmatejovarddhanāya] saṃskārāḥ kaumāre brahmakārakāḥ brāhmaṇo jñeyo maṃtrāḥ sarvepi tadvaśāḥ karmāṇi daśa te dṛṣṭvā palāyante tu dūrataḥ prathamaṃ karma cocyate yogyaśiṣyaṃ dvitīyaṃ pāritoṣikam pratigrahaṃ kuryāttṛtīyandhanasādhanam yadvittaṃ tallabdhaṃ pañcamaṃ smṛtam sanmaṃtrasyopadeśena yallabdhantattu saptamam kālānuguṇataḥ prāptaṃ navamaṃ pāritoṣikam dhanārjanākhyaṃ karmaitatprathamaṃ parikīrtitam bhāryā mātā janayitā tataḥ śvaśrūścāyaṃ poṣyavargo vipattauyacca labhyate rajyeta brāhmaṇyānna tu hīyate sābhyajaṃ ca dvitīyakam

cāpi vāyavyaṃ kāyikaṃ mānasaṃ tathā aṣṭādhikasahasraṃ ca japo mukhyamidaṃ smṛtam mudrikāyuktā tathā cānyā vimudrikā sandhyārghyaṃ gāyatryā sampradīyate pañcayajñāśca daśakarmeti kīrtyate proktā uttamottamamukhyakāḥ devayajñaprakāro devatarpaṇam tatsūktasya tathā japaḥ vaiśvadevānte yanvatā iti mantrataḥ bhūtayajñaḥ syātkṣudrabādhānivāraṇaḥ dhyānamātraṃ vedānāṃ ca paṭhedṛcaḥ hantakāraśca pitṛyajño dvidhā mataḥ satkulīnānāṃ mano vaidikavartmani nṝṇāṃ nṛyonistena durlabhā jñānī kukkuratāṃ vrajet pratyahaṃ ca balipūjāditatparaḥ dhātuvāde dhanakṣayaḥ śaivādivaiṣṇavādīnāṃ dveṣānnirayagāminaḥ siddhiḥ paratrāpi parā gatiḥ sarvopakārāya kimanyacchrotumicchasi vaidikayantrakathanaprakāśaḥ pañcadaśaḥ mantrāntarairdeva naiva siddho yathā guruḥ deveśa kīdṛksiddhistu taṃ vrajet ūrdhvāmnāyī tathā nyeṣu pūrvāmnāyī pareṣu ca kutrāpi gurutvaṃ ca vilokitam

devatāyāstathā pūrvaḥ sārūpyaṃ labhate paraḥ lobhatyāgaścopakāro hyadhoṃmārgepyudarkakṛt yathoktācaraṇāttasya siddhiḥ śiṣyasya jāyate mantraḥ syādbahuvighnadaḥ puraścaryā svataḥ siddhyenmanūttamaḥ vighnamantraṃ suddhidam binduyukto dvibinduḥ pūrvamārgiṇām ca pātālāmnāya īritaḥ svāhā hṛtkamekadaṃṣṭrāya [śiraḥ] huṃphaṭ namastathā netramudīryate ṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena tāntriko nyāsamācaret raktavarṇaṃ raktagandhānulepanam vāmanaṃ vighnādhīśaṃ pūjyaṃ ca śuṇḍinam padmāsanaṃ sarvabhūṣaṃ dhyāyedvighnavināyakam yantrametadbudhaḥ kuryāccaturasratrayaṃ śubham pūrvoktavidhinā maṇḍapādi prakalpayet paraṃ tvarcediṣṭadalātmake jvālinī nandābhogadā kāmarūpiṇī cāntamanāḥ pīṭhamanuṃ śṛṇu yajetpīṭhaṃ gaṇādhipam nīlavarṇaṃ keśareṣu tato yajet ṣaḍaṅgāni dhyātavyāstāśca devatāḥ varadābhayadhāriṇyaḥ pradhānatanavaḥ striyaḥ lambodarākhyavikaṭau vighnarāḍdhūmravarṇakau tāsāṃ pravakṣyāmi proktaṃ savyakrameṇa tu

akṣamālāmayodaṇḍaṃ kuṇḍikāṃ dadhatī karaiḥ candragaurāṅgīṃ maheśīṃ bhāvayecchubhām indragopāruṇāṃ dhyāyetkaumārīṃ karuṇālayām vaiṣṇavīṃ dhyāyennīlameghasamaprabhām bhāvayenmantrī nīlavarṇāṃ subhūṣaṇām bhāvayecchaktimañjanācalasaṃnibhām cāmuṇḍāṃ śoṇavarṇāṃ ca muṇḍamālāyutāṃ smaret dadhatīṃ hastairmahālakṣmīṃ smaretsudhīḥ tadastrāṇi pūjāvighnaharasya tu samprāpto mantrosau siddhikṛdbhavet modakaiḥ pṛthukairlājaiḥ saktubhiścekṣuparvabhiḥ dviśataṃ pañcāśapramitaṃ tathā ghṛtāktena homobhīṣṭaphalapradaḥ sitapakṣādimārabhya pratyahaṃ juhuyātkramāt ghṛtasaṃyuktairhomaḥ śrīvaśyakīrtidaḥ kanyāṃ putrārthī labhate sutam vaśyādau bhavedvaśyaṃ tathepsitam jñātvā homasaṃkhyāṃ kalpayecca sahasrataḥ sitārkadrumamūlena kucandanasudārubhiḥ sampūjya taṃ pṛṣṭvā prajapenmanum vyavahārādau samare vijayī bhavet lokāḥ syurvaśagāssadā ca taddhṛtaṃ sthāpitaṃ jale saptāhādvaśagaḥ sādhyaḥ sādhakasya bhaveddhruvam maṇḍādibhiravāpnoti mantroyaṃ praṇavādikaḥ

dakṣiṇāmnāye lakṣmīgaṇapatiṃ surāḥ coccārya mahāgaṇapatiṃ tathā svāhetyekonatriṃśadakṣaraḥ ṣaḍdīrghayuktenāṃgāni jātiyuktāni kārayet dakṣordhvakaramārabhya dakṣiṇedhaḥ karāvadhi vāmāṅkeviṣṇulakṣmyā cāśliṣṭaṃ dakṣabhujena tu caturdvārasamāyuktacaturasratrayāvṛte prathamāvṛttiraṅgaiḥ syādvakratuṇḍādibhiḥ parā vaśitvaṃ ca prākāmyaṃ prāptiragrataḥ kāmyakarmāṇi sādhayet homaḥ putramitrakalatradaḥ catvāriṃśaddinānmantrī vāñchitāṃ labhate śriyam nyāsadhyānādikaṃ prāgvatpūjābhedo nigadyate bibhīṣikā ca mālikā tadastrāṇi pūjayetkāmyamucyate japato dhanavṛddhiḥ prajāyate aśokakāṣṭhairjvalite vahnāvājyāktataṇḍulaiḥ narapatirlakṣmīṃ [labhate iti śeṣaḥ] pāyasahomataḥ ṣaḍdīrghabījayuktena ṣaḍaṃgāni samācaret adhodakṣeṇābhayadāṃ vāmena varadāyinīm sicyamānāṃ ca kṣaumavastrāṃ kirīṭinīm dharmādikalpite pīṭhe bhūpurāḍhye dalāṣṭake vibhūtirunnatiścaiva hṛṣṭiḥ kīrtiśca sannatiḥ siṃhāsanaṃ pūjyaṃ sarvaśaktimayaṃ tathā sampūjya punaraṣṭadalercayet

cāniruddhaṃ ca vidiśāsu tathā kramāt devīdakṣiṇahastāgre śaṅkhākhyaṃ nidhimarcayet vimalāṃ caiva kamalāṃ vanamālikām lokapālānāyudhāni proktametacchriyorcanam padmaistrisvādusaṃyuktaistrinavaiḥ śrīphalairapi siddhamanurmantrī sādhayennijavāñchitam dāridryātparimucyate nānyathācirāt tribhuvanaṃ sarvaṃ vaśaṃ kuryānnacānyathā vaśyaṃ dhanavānarthavānbhavet rājyalakṣmīṃ sa cāyuṣpurtrāṃllabhet kam [sukham] bhavati sādhakaḥ paṭhenneva tatraiva juhuyātpunaḥ skandhabhedaistasya narastiṣṭhanmūlepi saṃhunet bhavettasya kathamaśrīḥ kule bhavet tryakṣaroyaṃ virāṭ chando munirbhārgava īritaḥ ṣaḍdīrghayuggakāreṇa tato dhyāyedgajānanam bījapūraṃ svayaṃ tattu dakṣiṇe svarṇavarṇakam pūjayetpīṭhe pūrvādinavaśaktike proktā dvitīyā cāpi mātṛbhiḥ japenmantraṃ haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥ siddhamanurmaṃtrī kāmyakarmāṇi sādhayet apūpairguḍasaṃmiśraiḥ pakkānnaiśca ghṛtaplutaiḥ sannidhau mantrī juhuyāttrisahasrakam madhuhomena rājānaṃ vaśamānayet

sambhojayetkanyā yadvaikāṃ sa labheta tām tathā candragrahaṇe cābhimantrayet svīye devatādhyānapūrvakam dhyānapūrvaṃ devatāyāḥ prātaḥ prātastadā bhavet kavittvena śaninā prativādakaḥ niṣkārdhapādamānena haridrāñca vacāntathā gurum || gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā pibennārī tadauṣadham surūpaṃ ca buddhimantaṃ śriyā yutam pūrvavacca ṣaḍaṅgāni hemābho hemavastravān dakṣordhvahastapāśaṃ cādhovāme cākṣasūtrakam gaṇeśaṃ cintayāmyaham tilairhomaṃ tarpaṇādi tataścaret mahatīṃ śrīyamāpnoti mānavaḥ ākhyātaśchandaḥ proktaṃ virāḍiti bījena kuryādaṅgakriyāṃ budhaḥ pāśāṃkuśau vilasatāṃ patrāgraṃ ca dadhatkaraiḥ pūrṇacandramauliravyādgaṇeśvaraḥ syāddvitīyā cāṣṭabhirgaṇaiḥ ibhavaktraścaikadanto lambodara iti kramāt japenmantraṃ trisvādvaktaistilairhunet śarkarāghṛtayuktena haviṣā juhuyātsudhīḥ tatprajuhuyāllakṣmīvānsādhako bhavet sarvasampatsamṛddhiḥ syātpratyahaṃ vāñchitārthakṛt bhavedaṣṭabhiśca dravyaistrimadhuraplutaiḥ catuścatvāriṃśadākhyaṃ catuḥśatamatandritaḥ

tryakṣaroktaprayogāṃśca kuryādatrāpi sādhakaḥ ākhyāto gāyatrī chanda īritam ṣaḍdīrghabījayuktena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirītitaḥ gajavatpaṃcabhiryuktaḥ kirīṭī cāsihastakaḥ svayantamabhayaṃ cāpi varaṃ modakameva ca koṭisūryapratīkāśaṃ dhyāyeddherambamavyayam caturdvārasamāyuktaṃ tatrādāvāsanaṃ yajet namaśceti proktaḥ saptadaśākṣaraḥ kuryānmūrtipravartanam tadbāhye herambārcanamīritam madhuratrayasaṃyuktaistarpaṇādi samācaret modakairiṣṭasiddhaye kṣipraprasādanaproktānprayogānvā samācaret praṇavāntoṣṭavarṇoyaṃ śaktibījādikopi vā ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret pūjyamānaṃ bhaktapātakahāriṇam hastairdadhānaṃ candrāsyaṃ nānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitam pūjite pīṭhe paścātsampūjayedvibhum jayantaścāgniveṣaśca kṛttikāputra eva ca viśālākṣaśca samproktāḥ śaktiśūlakarā ime vighnaṃ kukkuṭameva ca tadastrāṇi ca sampūjya subrahmaṇyārcanaṃ tvidam juhuyānmantrī tarpayedviprapuṅgavān samyagarcayedbrahmacāriṇam aihikāmuṣmikānbhogāṁllabhante nātra saṃśayaḥ

ityuktvā sarvajanapadaṃ vadet ṛṣirmadana ākhyātaśchando'nuṣṭupsamīritam saḍdīrghayuktabījena viprādīnāṃ prakīrtitaḥ prāpte śuklapakṣasya mantravit tāṃ samālipya snāyācchuddhajalaistataḥ svarṇāṃgulīyahāraughairbhūṣaṇaiśca śubhāmbaraiḥ sumanobhistaṃ yajeddevadhiyā punaḥ pūjyamānaṃ maṇisiṃhāsanasthitam krodhamudrāṃ sṛṇiṃ pāśaṃ paraśuṃ vibhrataṃ karaiḥ taṇḍulairhutvā brāhmaṇānapi bhojayet sarpirguḍapuṭaiḥ samyagapūpairjuhuyādbahiḥ bhojayettāvadbrahmacāriṇameva ca kanyāmavāpnoti kanyāpi labhate varam palapramāṇagomūtre piṣṭāḥ sindhuvacāniśāḥ tadauṣadhaṃ putraṃ labhate guṇasāgaram jalāgnisiṃhacaurāstrapramukhānapi rodhayet ete'ṣṭau gaṇapāḥ proktā dakṣiṇāmnāyagocarāḥ dakṣiṇāmnāyagaṇapatimantraprakāśaṣṣoḍaśaḥ bhuktimuktipradaṃ tatra mahāgaṇapatiṃ śṛṇu aṣṭāviṃśativarṇoyaṃ gaṇakosya munirmataḥ ca śaktiḥ syāddīrghaṣaṭkayutastu gaḥ manorasya jātiyuktāni cācaret svabījenāṃgulinyāsaṃ ṣaḍaṅgāni tathācaret śrotrayośca netrayoścanasormukhe ca vāmabāhāvapīdṛśaṃ

svādhiṣṭhāne mūlādhāre tadagrimān pādayorglau hṛdi punaḥ pratyaṅgaṃ bījameva ca nyāsavidhiṃ kṛtvā hṛdi devaṃ vicintayet tattaraṅgalasattoyairdhaute śīte mahītale patadbhiḥ samalaṅkṛte anekaphalasaṅkīrṇe sevite cāpsarogaṇaiḥ vilasatpadmarāgaughakuṭṭimāruṇabhūtale tasyādhastātsiṃhāsanaṃ smaret gaṇeśañca tatsaṃsthaṃ ca mahāgaṇam śūlaṃ ca bibhraṃtaṃ hastapaṅkajaiḥ ardhendumauliṃ tryakṣaṃ ca dīpyamānaṃ kṛpākaram maṇimuktāpravālādīnvarṣantaṃ dhārayā muhuḥ karṇatālairvārayantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ nānābharaṇabhūṣitam pūrvokte tīvrādinavaśaktike caturdvārasamāyuktaṃ caturasratrayāvṛtam trikoṇācca bahirmantrairyajetsurān yajettañca dhyāyedbilvatale sthitam hrīṃgaurahirābhyāṃ ca hṛdanto navavarṇakaḥ jaṭādhastātsuvarṇarajataprabhau ratikāmābhyāṃ hṛdantoyaṃ navākṣaraḥ nālayuktotpaladvandvacāpapuṣpeṣusaṃyutau priyaṅgostu mahīkolau yajettataḥ lakṣmīgaṇakābhyāṃ hṛdantoyaṃ daśākṣaraḥ ṣaṭkoṇeṣu yajenmantramoṃgaṃ pūrvo hṛdantakaḥ

samṛddhyāyutamabhyarcetpramodaṃ vahnikoṇake madanāvatyā yajedvāruṇakoṇagam vighnakarttāraṃ drāviṇyā sahitaṃ yajet raktāraktāmbarālepabhūṣaṇā madavihvalāḥ śaṃkhanidhiṃ vāmercayettathā lokānāṃ meghavatsadā ṣaḍāvaraṇasaṃyuktamitthaṃ devaṃ samarcayet daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādaṣṭadravyairekākṣaroditaiḥ praṇamya visṛjedevaṃ siddho bhavenmanuḥ kurvīta siddhayaḥ syurna cānyathā sahasrāṣṭakamasyānte juhuyātkaravīrajaiḥ bhūtvā sāmātyaḥ sanniṣevakaḥ vighnāḥ syurvaśāstasya na saṃśayaḥ vipulāṃ cirakālānubandhinīm lavaṇājyasurābhiśca śodhayitvāsya bhasma tu bhavatyāmaraṇāṃtaṃ sā dāsītoṣyadhikaṃ vaśā mokṣamavāpnuyāt vedārthakaraṇe buddhiṃ prāpnoti sādhakaḥ tasyālpamṛtyurogādyā naśyantyāyuśca vardhate uccāṭayedvairisaṅghāngrāmaṃ deśaṃ purādikam raṇḍāstasya vaśyā jīvena ca dhanena ca ūttarapadārthasya buddhyā pravibhāgātpratyavamarśaḥ] ca pravadedetadamukaṃ cāmukena ca mantrayedaṣṭottaraṃ tacca sahasrakam bhavati niścayena yamātithiḥ

samāyānti nāgakanyāḥ sahasraśaḥ nānāmaṇīṃśca ratnāni yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ bhavet kṛpāṇasiddhiṃ labhate prārthanīyāṃ surāsuraiḥ madhupuṣpīṃ melayitvā supeṣayet cāñjayitvā nidhānaṃ paśyati dhruvam phūtkṛtya haretpīḍāṃ sarvāṃ nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ kumbhaṃ candanādyaiśca carcitam sampūrṇaṃ dīpaṃ nyasyettathopari spṛṣṭvā japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam bhūtaṃ ca vartamānaṃ ca bhaviṣyannātra saṃśayaḥ kathayetsvapne cāpi śubhāśubham saṃsiddhiḥ sadhānyapaśuyoṣitām samāgatya dhanādyākṛṣya yacchati gaṇeśaṃ tāṃ spṛṣṭvā mantrāyutaṃ japet kapilājyaiḥ pibetprātaḥ saptabhirdivasaiḥ kaviḥ karpaṭe śodhayedādau rasamaṣṭottaraṃ śatam kumārikākāśavallyostadā raupyasamo bhavet śulvādetatsārdhabhāgaṃ śulvārdhaṃ kanakantvayaḥ dinaikamāranāle tu mardayitvāranālake japenmantraṃ siddhā sā jāyate tadā sarvabhūtānāṃ śastrāstraiścaiva jāyate tatprabhāvādvajradeha ākāśe labhate gatim sā kuryātsādhakecchayā vajrāṇukaṃ trilohaṃ ca tābhyāṃ samyagvimardayet tadyadā kajjalītulyaṃ syāttadā guṭikāṃ caret

vicintya svakare gṛhṇīyāttanmanuṃ japet prabhāvānnāyānti cauravyāghroragādayaḥ p. 377) rājāno vaśyatāṃ yānti sundarīṇāmatipriyaḥ brahmadaṇḍī himaṃ kṛṣṇāguruḥ samam moho gaṇeśasya prabhāvataḥ taccūrṇena karau liptvāṣṭādhikaṃ ca sahasrakam nāgā airāvatasamā api kārayecchālāṃdṛḍhāṃ gajanibandhinīm prapūjayet gaṇapataye padenāpi ca homayet edhaiśca goghṛtaiḥ juhuyācca navāhutīḥ tataścāṣṭadravyaiḥ svādutrayānvitaiḥ bahūnsambhojayedviprāṃstadāśīrbhirvivardhitaḥ taddaśāṃśaṃ vā dattvā santoṣya sadgurum aṅgamātṛdigīśānāṃ tanmaṃtraiḥ sarpiṣā hunet varāhāviti tu catvāri mithunāni ca durmukhasya priyoktā madanāvatī ṣaṭproktā gaṇeśāśca nidhidvayam homaṃ samāpyātha naivedyaṃ tu samācaret hṛdi samudvāsya vicarecca yathāsukham kalabhāḥ śataśastathā proktarūpaṃ gaṇeśaṃ samyagarcayet saṃyuktaiḥ puṣpaiḥ śarkarayāpi ca vetālasañjñā guṭikā kuṇḍamadhyātprayāti ca

samutthāya kṣīṇacandre ca parvaṇi vyāghrakroḍāricorādīnnātra kāryāvicāraṇā śikhādikarṇikākhyādi tvagjihvācakṣuṣāmalaiḥ samprajapenmantraṃ tvaṣṭādhikasahasrakam tvaṅganāyā bhakṣitaṃ vaśyakārakam dhyāyedvināyakam nigaḍānmucyate kasmādatha bilvasya puṣpakam madhunā bhāvayetsamam siddhaguṭikā taddhūpādroganāśanam strī syātkumārī labhate varam jalāśaye prayogaṃ kāmikaṃ śṛṇu lakṣmyai payase huneccharkarayā dvijaḥ yaśase homo dhanārthantilataṇḍulaiḥ vaśayedbhūpamutpalaiścāpi tadvadhūm hunedvadhūrvaśyā vaṭātplakṣādudumbarāt viprādyānvaśayedvarṇālloṇahomādavarṣaṇam pravakṣyāmi kāmyakarmāṇi saṃsmaret dhanaprāptyai muktyai śuklaṃ ca saṃsmaret yacca prakaṭaṃ vakṣyatedhunā pūrvavannyāsasaṃyutaḥ mahāpadmantaruṇādityasannibham dhyāyenmantrī pūrvoktamantravat vinirgatyāvaruhyāha karṇikāmadhyasaṃsthitam || pravarairgandhakusumaiḥ prāgvatsāvaraṇaṃ yajet ratnadhārābhirdhyātvā devasya mūrdhani

bhaktyā devadevaṃ prasannadhīḥ vidhiścāyaṃ śṛṇu vaidikatarpaṇam brūyādvāmācārī namo vadet prathamandaśavāraṃ pratarpayet samuccārya mūlamantrasya tarpayet ṣaṭpaṃcasaṃkhyākaṃ catuṣkantarpaṇambhavet punarmūlena tarpayet punarmūlambhavedevaṃ catuṣkamapi tarpaṇam mūlamantreṇa catuṣkājinasaṃkhyakam tābhyāmmadhye mūlena cāṣṭadhā bhūbhūcatuṣkāṃkairvedavedakṛtairmitam santarpya mantravarṇaiśca tarpayet antarāntaramūlena caivaṃ siddhiścatuṣkikā hyāyudhānāṃ kramastvayam pravadedamukāya namastviti vasudhāṃ ca gam śaktiṃ ca prāṇabandhaṃ vadettataḥ proktāsteṣānnāmānyahaṃ brūve cakrābjapāśotpalāni kalabhāgraviṣāṇayuk dvāviṃśasaṃkhyākantarpaṇaṃ ca prajāyate mūlāntarāntaraḥ lambodaragaṇeśvarau viṃśacatuṣkāḥ syustato yugmāni tarpayet prāgvattadyugmamābhāṣya mūlenāntaritāni ca ṣoḍaśasaṃkhyāni catuṣkāṇi bhavantyapi

mūlenāntaritāścaiva catuṣkā jinasaṃkhyakāḥ vasundharāśaṃkhau tarpaṇīyau ca pūrvavat padmanidhyorbījantu tarpaṇe vedavedābdhisaṃkhyakāstarpaṇakramāḥ svabījādyasvāhāntāni yugmānyevampratarpayet laghutarpaṇamīritam ṣaḍgaṇeśānnidhiyugamevametattrayodaśa dviśatañcāṣṭādhikamādyantayostathā tarpaṇammadhyamañcaitanmahāgaṇapatermatam mūlamantrasya caikaikenākṣareṇa ca gajāśvineyatulyantajjāyate ca tataḥ param tarpayeddevammokṣārthaṃ śuddhavāribhiḥ madhunā kāmārthaṃ tarpayedvibhum rājavaśyāya devaṃ pṛṣṭhe pratarpayet prītervivṛddhyai skandhe tu payobhistarpayedvibhum jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ mārgaṃ kaliyugapriyam lokaiḥ svasvadharmo vigarhitaḥ kṣudhāturastu bhūmiṣṭhandūrīkṛtya kaśerukam dharmo vāmānte kaulikādikaḥ vasatiḥ kṛtā putraprasādataḥ kāśīpraveśakāmārthaṃ tete santoṣitāḥ paraiḥ dattantantreṣu pratipāditam vedamārge vihitācca dvijātayaḥ tairabhidrutya dharmalopārthamudyatam

teṣāmmadhyātsamudbhūtammama liṅgaṃ mukhānvitam mārgasyāyaṃ vyatikramaḥ gaṅgājalādapyadhikampāvanaṃ kāraṇaṃ tvidam vayaṃ dadma uddhārārthaṃ trijanmanām matsyāstānebhyo dātumudyatāḥ tvayā deva viṣṇunā hṛdaye kṛtā kāruṇikāstāta hyetebhyo dātumudyatāḥ ṣaṭsugandhā ṣaḍrasāśca mudrā dātuṃ samudyatāḥ svarṇapātrasthaparamamannaṃ hitvā tṛṇāśinaḥ madvaco vīrāḥ sarvaprāṇikṛpāyutam atikṣudrādiyonīnāndaśasvekaḥ prajāyate condurādīnāṃ viḍālādiḥ prajāyate kaścinmṛgajātiṣu jāyate kaścitkharo vā karabho bhavet kaścinnaro vākuñjaro bhavet manuṣyāṇāmmadhyādekaḥ prajāyate tu kaścidvarṇaḥ prajāyate kaścitprāpnuyāddvijatāṃ naraḥ kaścitkarmaniṣṭhaḥ prajāyate kaścidyogī bhavati bālakaḥ kaścinmukto bhavati vā na vā brahmasṛṣṭivināśaśca tūrṇameva bhaviṣyati anyonyañjaghnurojasā nirayamparamaṃ gatāḥ pramuditairviprairyācitoyaṃ varastadā

ramatāmmanaḥsvavyabhicāritam taccātra paśubhiryācitantu yat nāthānasmānvihāyādya paśubhiḥ kinnu yācyate tyaktā paśubhirjanaiḥ tenārcitontarātmāyammukto bhavati tatkṣaṇāt tu tuṣṭaścedantarātmā vimucyate kleśānāśaṃ yānti vimucyate sāraḥ śapharaḥ parikīrtitaḥ paśavastantrasāramidaṃ vacaḥ śatasahasrantu kṛtvā mokṣamavāpnuyāt cāmuṇḍādyā mahādevyo bhairavādyā mahābalāḥ tena yena mudrāṣṭakaṃ kṛtam syātsahasrabhagadarśanāt tatpātakavaśājjāto matto daśarathātmajaḥ samanuprāptaṃ viyogaścānukālikaḥ jātaḥ sadā śaktiniṣevakaḥ ṣoḍaśastrīsahasrāṇāñjātosau bhagadarśanāt vinā māsaṃ vinā matsyaṃ ca maithunam paśubhiryācitaṃ yattu kimu caitattadeva hi praphullavadanāḥ śāntipūrvaṃ vaco jaguḥ siṃhavacca sadā māsaniṣevakāḥ tathāsmākaṃ na māṃsaṃ bhakṣituṃ kṣamāḥ tathaiva vīrasiṃhānāṃ bhakṣyaṃ māṃsādikaṃ kila sevayituṃmicchanti paśavo viprarūpiṇaḥ pītvā madyaṃ mattāstathābhavan

tebhyo mayā proktaṃ vriyatāṃvriyatāmiti bhavecchreyastandharmaṃ vada naḥ prabho prakartavyaṃ vedoktaṃ karma nityaśaḥ grahaṇārthantu tadvattantraniṣevaṇam tṛptirjīvanaṃ ca bhavedyathā nānye ca tasmāttaṃ parivarjjayet vacasteṣāṃ na mānayet sa eva nirayaḥ smṛtaḥ divodāsanissārārthaṃdevatāḥ śāsanātkāmo dagdhopi punarutthitaḥ mantrānpravakṣyāmi lokadvayaphalapradān ṣaḍaṅgāni prakalpayet nānāratnaughamukuṭabhūṣaṇairbhūṣitaṃ śubham upaviṣṭaṃ raktapadme kāmadevaṃ vibhāvaye ca ṣaṭpatre koṇeṣvaṅgāni pūjayet caiva trāsinīṃ stambhinīṃ tataḥ ṣaṭpatre madanānaṅgamanmathā kusumāhvayāḥ anaṅgamekhalānaṅgadīpikā ca tataḥ param padme ṣoḍaśapatrāḍhye svāgrataḥ paripūjayet lolā līlā saudāmanī tathā ceti taruṇyaḥ sasmitānanāḥ vilāsavibhramau mohaṃ śokaṃ kāmasya pūjayet cūtapuṣpaṃ grīṣmaṃ tāpanamūrjakam cārpitatūṇīrāḥ śoṇastrīsaktamānasāḥ sārasākṣaśca śuko meghastataḥ param

ca catasraḥ pūjayedimāḥ śvetacāmarasaddhastāḥ śyāmā bhūṣitavigrahāḥ evamārādhayedyastu gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ smaram puraścaraṇametasya lakṣaṃ dvādaśa cocyate mārjanaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇānapi bhojayet siddhamanurmantrī prayogānācarettataḥ sahasraṃ yaḥ sarveṣāṃ sa priyo bhavet vahnau mantreṇānena mantravit ājñānuvartinī sāsya bhavejjanmani janmani mantrī kanyā sāpi priyaṃ patim kāmadevāya sarvajanapriyāya ca hṛdayaṃ mamakīrtayet ṣaḍdīrghayataklīṃbījaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritiḥ drāmādyāṃ drāviṇīṃ devīṃ dromāyāṃ kṣobhiṇīmapi ākarṣiṇīṃ ca saḥ pūrvāṃ sammohinīṃhamādikām pañcāṅgeṣvaṃgulīṣu ca nāsikāṅgepyaṅgeṣvatha tataḥ param śeṣaṃ vyāpakatvena sannyaset mātṛkārṇānāṃ bṛhannyāsaṃ samācaret samuccārya mātṛkāṅgeṣu vinyaset kāmayuktāṃ hi kāntimantañca mohinīm nyasetkāmavardhanena samanvitām kubjikāñcaramākāntañca kāntayā nandayantaṃ pralāpinīm bhramaṇo yajinīyutaḥ

mugdhayā yukto bhrāmako ramayā yutaḥ bhramāvahaścañcalayā mohanodīrghajihvayā mohavardhanaśṛṅgiṇyo madanaṃ pāṭalāṃ tathā bhṛṅganāyakahaṃsinyau gāyakaṃ viśvatomukhīm kāntisaṃyuktaṃ conmattaṃ kalakaṇṭhikām sarvottamāyutaṃ lobhavardhanaṃ nyasya cintayet kartavyāḥ kṛṣṇagopālasambhavāḥ tāmbūlaṃ gajapuṣkarabhakṣitam saṃnyāsa-ekākṣaravanmunirvātsyāyano mataḥ pracodayāt paratrāpi ca sadgatim nārīṇāṃ hṛdayaṃ gataḥ śāpito yastadā kāśyā vivāsitaḥ yasmāttasmātkāmaḥ satāṃ gatiḥ gaṇapastatsahāyārthamudyataḥ tayoḥ prabhāveṇa dṛṣṭavānparamaṃ patim japaṃstasthau varṣamātraṃ vimuktitaḥ kāśikāyāmasau siddhivināyakaḥ lobhadveṣādikānsarvānvāsayāmāsa tatra tu yatprasādāddivodāso guptasenaḥ prapañcitaḥ uddhārārthamaviprāṇāṃ gāyatryeṣā mayoditā pañca mantro yobhyo mayā kṛtaḥ yo vācī sa ādau praṇavo manuḥ iti dvyakṣaroyaṃ tṛtīyakaḥ cedvyarṇo mantraścaturthakaḥ

dvyakṣaro mantraḥ pañcamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ brahmāprapañcādiḥ sa evāsya muniḥ smṛtaḥ devatā sabindumātṛkānyāso dvitīyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ keśavādikamātṝṇāṃ caturtho nyāsa ucyate māyābījādikaḥ ṣaṣṭho mātṛkānyāsa ucyate mātṛkākāmabījādyāstannyāsaścāṣṭamo mataḥ prapañcapūrvāṇāṃ mantro mātṝṇāṃ daśamaḥ smṛtaḥ vyāpakatvācca kālasya na dhyānaṃ na ca pūjanam ugratārādyatikrūrastārādiścaiva sādhakaḥ nānyathā [anyūna ityarthaḥ] bhavet tilasiddhārthājyahavirhomadravyāṣṭakaṃ matam sarvakāryāṇi prayogaḥ kathyatedhunā kāryasyaivānusāreṇa hunedravyāṣṭakena ca vā tadardhaṃ vā hunettataḥ rasasaṅkhyasahasrāṇi huneddravyāṣṭakena ca bhūtāveśagrahāveśakṛtyādīnsuvināśayet kaulike mārge grasyate bhairavādibhiḥ sahasrasaṅkhyahomena svapno bhavati tatkṣaṇāt apasmāraṃ smṛtibhraṃśaṃ śoṣadoṣaṃ sa nāśayet mahālakṣmīstallakṣmyā lajjatetarām dravyāṣṭakaṃ trivarṣārvāktasya lokatrayaṃ vaśe vṛddhyādikaṃ vijānīyāddhomaṃ taṃ kāryagauravāt tasyāśu pralayaṃ yānti nānyathā puṣṭido homo ghṛtahomo yaśaskaraḥ

mālatīpuṣpahomopi sarvavaśyaprado bhavet śālisamudbhūtāṃstaṇḍulānsādhu cūrṇayet kuryātsamyaksaṃpūjya tāṃ spṛśet juhuyānmantrī tāṃ nyāsakramato niśi sopyevaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā tatastasminvaṭāgnau juhuyādghṛtam pūrṇauṣadhivipakvena pañcagavyena pūrite tāvatsaṃkhyaṃ ca sañjapya gṛhṇīyātsarvasiddhidam dhāraṇātsadyaḥ sarve naśyantyupadravāḥ śrīsaubhāgyajayapradam vāpi dadyāddhemno varasya ca siddhiṃ prapañcākhyamantreṇa gaṇapasya hi sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ vaktābhūjjagato guruḥ makārapañcakenaiva jātaṃ sarvatra pūjanam mapaṃcamantramāhātmyādrājāpi bhrāntamānasaḥ sevāto dharmaṃ paśyanti te na hi sarvavidyāviśāradaḥ panthā bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥ samyagātithyaṃ kṛtvā tuṣṭāva cāgamam guruprokto yajño yāgo mapaṃcakaḥ kartavyaṃ vaidikaṃ na kadācana kurvantyābhyantaraṃ karma tattvametadvicāryatām dattvā kathaṃ saukhyaṃ pralabhyate viprāstyajyatāṃ vedakarma tat tatra siddhiḥ pratyakṣaṃ dṛśyatāmidam

tadagnihotrantu caryatāṃ dṛśyatāmidaṃ vedamārgaṃ praviṣṭā vāmakaulayoḥ padmāsanamṛjurbhavet tanmadhye cintanīyaṃ guṇātmakam tanmadhye dhyāyetsattvaguṇātmakam hakāreṇa veṣṭitaṃ tacca cintayet samākrāntantu taddvayam prācyāṃ praticyāṃ ca kauberyāṃ dakṣiṇe tathā madhyādipūrvatastatra jñeyāḥ paṃcāgnayo hyamī cāhavanīyogniranvāhāryaśca paṃcamaḥ sthitāṃ stāṃśca kalpādityānvicintayet saṃ ṣamiti tu jñeyā varṇāśca paṃca ca paṃcaite saṃgrāme vijayapradāḥ nīlendreṇa samā dhyeyā mantrasiddhipradāyakāḥ bhaumasyaite dyūtakalirājadvāreṣu siddhidāḥ cintanīyā vajranibhā yātrākāryaśubhaṃkarāḥ vivāhādikāryādiṣu suśobhanāḥ śatrunāśakarā dhyeyā manīṣibhiḥ hīrakasaṃkāśā rājakāryakarā ime maṃ naṃ ṇaṃ ca ñaṃ ṅaṃ aḥ eṃ ūṃ āvasathyake khaṃ oṃ ṛṃ ca iṃ kāramanvāhārye hunetsudhīḥ svāhetyuktvā proktakuṇḍe hunedekaikamakṣaram śabdajātaṃ sarvaṃ śāstrādikaṃ hunet sparśādikānvāyuguṇānyaṃ bījenendrakuṇḍake rasānsarvānhunetkuṇḍe tathottare

pralayānalasaṃkāśajvaladagniṣvaharniśam nityaśuddhaparānandacidrūposau virājate pañcāśatsaṅkhyayā kṛtvā nyasya tāvadyathāvidhi sūryakalposau kartā hartā ca śambhuvat atharvapariśiṣṭoktairmaṃtrairetaistu pañcabhiḥ vihṛtyātmānamupacaryordhvaṃ gacchantu svāhā vihṛtyātmānamupacaryordhvaudhastiryaggacchantu svāhā vihṛtyātmānamupacarya tiryagūrdhvādho gacchaṃtu svāhā sarvamaśnīyāducyate manuḥ vidhānenordhvādhastiryakṣu gacchatu homaṃ vidhāyātha saṃskṛtānnena maṃtravit paścācchuddhācamanamācaret jagadvyāptaṃ nityamekamananyagam havanīyena śuddhena juhuyāttena tarpitam havirhutaṃ maṃtrī sajvalatpañcavahnikaḥ garbhasthitibhavaṃ kleśaṃ viṃdate na kadācana kācidvāmamārgeṇa sādhyate devatā tu sā viprāṇāṃ mapañcakaniṣevaṇe saṅgaścejjāto nirayamaśnute bhakṣaṇe ciṃtyaṃ hunetpaścimakuṇḍake vīryaṃ tu ghṛtarūpaṃ vicintayet evamātṛptiparyaṃtaṃ bālāyā maithunaṃ caret rātrijaṃ pāpaṃ devatā cetprasīdati tuṣṭā syānna pāpairabhibhūyate pāpaṃ vai dharma eva saḥ

sādhakaścedbhuktimuktipradaḥ sa tu vadayugmaṃ ca vāgvādini padaṃ vadet mokṣamuccārya kuruṣva praṇavaṃ vadet nagairbāṇairjāyatesya manutrayam utpattisthitināśānāṃ kārikāstāḥ prakīrtitāḥ gaṇeśasya prasādena varṇalakṣajapāddrutam vadetsakṛt siddhiraśaktau mitabhāṣaṇāt vāgvādini aimityeko navākṣaraḥ cātra varṇalakṣajapo bhavet proktaṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitam etābhyāmeva mantrābhyāṃ bahavaḥ kaulikāḥ kṛtāḥ vāmamārge ca siddhānte drutasiddhidām nādabindusamāyuktaṃ vāgbhavaṃ kūṭamucyate kāmarājābhidhaṃ matam tṛtīyantu kūṭaṃ varṇatrayātmakam tṛtīyabīje bindvāḍhyaṃ strīṇāmuktaṃ na sargayuk paṭhanīyastathā tāsāṃ deyo mantraṃ susiddhaye devavanditapādābjā devī tripurabhairavī āhṛnmūrddhāgataṃ cāntyaṃ caivaṃ bījatrayaṃ nyaset ca śiraḥ proktaṃ saurantyena śikhā matā mūrdhnyādhāre hṛdi nyasyaṃ mano kūṭatrayaṃ punaḥ karāgre ca kramānnyaset saṃhārakramato nyaset vāme tato dakṣe karṇayościbuke tataḥ

hṛdaye kūrparadvitaye kaṭau stanayugme gale tathā iti cādyabījena vinyaset hṛdaye bhruvormadhye tṛtīyakam mūrtinyāsamathācaret dhareśānaṃ nyasedbudhaḥ nyasedvaktre hṛdaye tu tato nyaset vāmadevarūpāya manmathasyātmane namaḥ kāmadevāya nama ityapi pravinyasyettataḥ pañca bāṇānaṅgeṣu vinyaset aṃguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntamaṃgulīṣu kramānnyaset bhruvormadhye mukhakarṇākṣikaṇṭhake bhagā tvanyā tṛtīyā bhagasarpiṇī proktā cānaṃgamekhalā kusumbhavasanā haritkāñcikikāḥ śubhāḥ kuryādbhūṣaṇākhyaṃ tataḥ sa tu nigadyae gaṇḍayoroṣṭhayordantapaṃktyorāsye nyasetsvarān kūrparayoḥ pāṇyostatpṛṣṭhadeśataḥ guhye punaścorvorjānunorjaṃghayostathā balaye pānake tathā japākusumasaṅkāśāmaruṇāmbarabhūṣaṇām viśvasaundaryasarvasvajanmasāgararūpiṇīm maṇḍitāṅgīṃ mahādevīṃ muktājapavaṭīdharām dhyāyettripurabhairavīm kuryānmaṇḍalaṃ gurumārgataḥ

cāgre trikoṇe madhyame nyaset svarālekhyā dvandvaśogradaleṣu ca kramāddalānāṃ granthīśca praṇavābhyāṃ tataścaret likhedvarṇānkramāttribhyaśca pūrvataḥ thadadhānnaphavāścāpi bhasarāllaṁvaṣāṃstathā caturasratrayaṃ kuryāttadbāhye devatārcanam dvādaśaitāścādyavīthyāmekasyāṃ diśi tu trayam jñānotkriyākubjikā ca bimbā devī viṣaghnikā yūyaṃ tacchṛṇudhvaṃ samāhitāḥ gaṅgātaraṅgadhavalaṃ cāmaradvayamadrije [pārvati] mallikāmālatījātīśatapatrāḍhyadāmabhiḥ paṭīñca vyajanadvandvaṃ navaratnavicitritam karpūramṛganābhyāḍhyaṃ karpūrakṣodasaṃyutam śalākāṃ ca karaṇḍaṃ candrapūritam pūrvādikramataḥ sarvāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ sākṣānmokṣadāyi na saṃśayaḥ ṣoḍaśārṇoyaṃ mantraḥ syātpīṭhapūjanam dhyāyettripurabhairavīm japākusumasaṃkāśāruṇāṃ svarṇavibhūṣaṇām sarvasvajanmasāgararūpiṇīm maṇḍitāṅgīṃ mahādevīṃ muktājapavaṭīdharām devīṃ madāghūrṇitalocanām mudrāviṃśatisaṃkhyākāstato devyai pradarśayet vāmahastatalaṃ kuryātkapālavat yonimudrāstāsāṃ lakṣaṇamucyate

trailokyadrāviṇī cāsya trilokyākarṣṇī bhruvoḥ ṣaḍaṃgāvaraṇaṃ pīṭhasyoparitorcayet paścātprītimuttarakoṇake dvaudvāvarvāgudakcaikamagre kāmāṃśca bāṇavat cādyā dvitīyānaṅgamekhalā pañcamī devī bhagāgre bhagasarpiṇī brāhmādyā bāhye cāṣṭadaladvayam kaumārikāyuktaḥ krodhaḥ syādvaiṣṇavīyutaḥ cāmuṇḍābhīṣaṇau mahālakṣmīḥ saṃhārasaṃyutā kramātsyuraṣṭaśaktīnāṃ pūjaneṣṭau manūttamāḥ malayastataḥ kollagiriḥ smṛtaḥ devakoṭaṃ pīṭhāṣṭakamudāhṛtam bhairavaṃ tvādyaṃ dvitīyaṃ tripurāntakam tato [etadagre tūttarānvayi] bāhye tu bhūpure hṛdayāntastathaiva ca yantrānvadāmyatha vighnānnāśayanāśaya paṃcapaṃcādaśārṇoyaṃ svāhānto vaṭukasya tu gṛhītvā vāmāṃguṣṭhena vai visṛjedbalim svaheti dhṛtyarṇo yoginīnāṃ balau manuḥ sadvīryayuktaṃ kṣaṃ procya sthāne kṣetre nipānabhūḥ agneraṣṭanavārṇoyaṃ kṣetrapālabalermanuḥ gīṃ gūṃ gaṇapataye vara varada śarva ca ekatriṃśacca manau varṇāḥ prakīrtitāḥ nirmālyabhojinī cāsya devī tripuracaṇḍikā

tatsampradāyaśuddhātmagurorladhvā manuṃ sudhīḥ trisvāduyuktairaśvārikusumairathavā hunet candanāgurukarpūrakṛtagātrānulepanaḥ sarvabhūtasuhṛnmaunī kumārīpūjako bhavet muktākalāpavidyākṣamālārājaccaturbhujām tasya nānāvṛttārthaśobhanā suratarormūlavilasanmaṇipīṭhagām dhanuśceti ṣaḍbhujairdadhatīṃ bhaje helāvilāsasampannāṃ navayuvanasundarīm trailokyaṃ kṣobhayedāśu pūrvavatsiddhibhāgasau akṣamālāsudhākakumbhamudrāpustakadhāriṇīm tasya kavitā bhuvi sammatā kuryātsarasvatītuṣṭyai saubhāgyānāṃ gṛhaṃ hi saḥ paranārīnṛpāṇāṃ ca rañjanaṃ bhavati dhruvam siktairhunetkramāttasya kavitvamabhijāyate naranārīnṛpāṃścaiva vaśayennātra saṃśayaḥ samṛddhiśca kamalāyā bhavedapi kāśyāmevaṃ tripurabhairavī gaṇanāthena kaulikācārapūjitām kūṭaṃ prathamaṃ parikīrtitam maṃtraḥ samākhyāto dvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgakam udyatsūryasahasrābhāṃ candracūḍāṃ trilocanām sravadrudhiramuṇḍālilalitāṃ raktavāsasam śarānpāśānaṃkuśaṃ pustakaṃ tathā dhyātvā yajetpīṭhaṃ prathamaṃ pīṭhamantrataḥ
