śrīṃ ca devārṇaḥ pīṭhamantrakaḥ jyeṣṭhāṃ ca raudrīṃ ca kālīṃ ca varalocanām balapramathinīñcaiva sarvabhūtadamāṃ tathā samuddhṛtya prāgvadaṅgāni pūjayet sāyudhānparameśvari sahāvakārasaṃyuktau prathamaṃ bījamīritam visargāṃtāstṛtīyakam mukuṭordhvalasaccandrarekhāṃ raktāmbarācitām varadābhayaśobhāḍhyāṃ pīnonnataghanastanīm dvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgāni nyasyetsarvāṃgalakṣaṇam caturdvāramevaṃ maṇḍalamālikhet vidhuṃ dakṣe yajedbāṇāṃśca pūrvavat anaṅgakusumādyāśca vasupatreṣu pūrvavat apāṅgabhrūvilāsau ca hāvabhāvau prapūjayet || 557 ||| pūjāpi śeṣaṃ nyāsādikaṃ tathā hasāvakārasaṃyuktau prathamaṃ bījamīritam ṣaḍdīrghānvitamadhyena bījenoktaṃ ṣaḍaṅgakam jaṭājūṭāṃ trinetrāṃ raktavāsasam pāśāṃkuśavarābhītīrdadhānāṃ ca śivāṃ śraye cātra pūrvavatparito yajet brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyāstatra pūjā bahiḥ punaḥ anaṅgakusumādyāśca brāhmyādyāśca samaṃtataḥ catuḥṣaṣṭiyoginībhyo hṛdantoyaṃ daśākṣaraḥ ekādaśamahākoṭiyoginībhyo namorcayet sampravakṣyāmi bhairavīṃ kamaleśvarīm

tataḥ śaptā tuhināge'bhavannadī labdhaṃ tayā duḥkhaṃ kalau khyātiṃ gamiṣyati varṇāśca bhaviṣyanti varapradāḥ asyāstīre purīśvaryā na ca teṣu prasīdati tasmāddhyānādyarcanādi prāgvaddakṣiṇamārgataḥ bhuvaneśvarabhairavyā bījādau hasarānpaṭhet hasarādyāṃstathā vidyātprāgvatpūjādikaṃ matam ādyantabījayo repharahitā hasarādikāḥ bhairavīvatsarvaṃ dhyānādikaṃ matam saṃsthātuṃ tadā devena ḍhuṇḍhinā devāstānvakṣyāmi samāsataḥ svāhāṃtaṃ mantrayugmaṃ tadīyakam devatāsya bhuktimuktiphalapradā jātiyuktairaṅgakḷptiḥ ṣaṭpadaistaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam caturdvārasamāyuktaṃ kuṃkumādibhiruddharet jayā caiva suprabhā ca viśuddhikā ekavahniśaraklībahīnairadbhiḥ prapūjayet siddhamanuḥ pīṭhaṃ cānena pūjayet tasyāntaḥ pūjayeccandanādibhiḥ devāyudhairdigīśaiśca hetibhirdhyānamucyate cakraṃ khaḍgaṃ carma daraṃ dadhānāṃ ca kramādbhaje śraddhā medhā śrutiśceti omādyakṣarapūrvikāḥ proktāni lakṣāṇāṃ pañcakaṃ japet siddhamanurmantrī prayogānācaretsudhīḥ ripuṃ hanyānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā

śastrāṇi subahūnyapi mohitaḥ gaṃgāpāre tasyā manuṃ śṛṇu coccārya paścādbrūyātsthitaṃ tathā śamayāgnivadhūśceti mantro nagaguṇārṇakaḥ svakāryaṃ sādhayitvevaṃ gaṇanāthena kīlitā enāṃ japecca niṣkīlāṃ tadā siddhiḥ prajāyate mantrādau yojayedante duṃhīmomi iti mantravit prokto hyanuṣṭup chanda īritam ṛtvaṣṭāṣṭabhūbāṇairmantrārṇaiḥ syātṣaḍaṅgakam mūlādhāre ca jaṭhare tathā nāsāgaṇḍayukkarṇayugmake trinetrāṃ ca hyaruṇe paṅkaje sthitām svarṇodyatkāntivasanāṃ śaśimauliṃ vanasthitām dhyātvā yajeddevīṃ pīṭhe pūrvodite tataḥ mātṝśca lokeśānāyudhāni ca kṣemyā ca vedagarbhā ca śāṅkarī cāṣṭamī matā japenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ hunettilaiḥ mārjanaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇārādhanaṃ tathā siddhamanurmantrī vāñchitārthānprasādhayet śyāmalāṅgīṃ hayārermūrdhani sthitām dadhatīṃ hastaiḥ suprasannānanāṃ bhaje ca tadante ca prayogānkarttumarhati tattadasādhyamapi sādhakaḥ sahasraṃ prajapenmantraṃ sādhakasattamaḥ

hunedāraṇyakatilairājikābhiśca vā hunet apasmārādikānmantrī nātra kāryā vicāraṇā vāñchitārthasiddhirbhavati nānyathā sakalaṃ mantrī hunedvañchitasiddhaye kuṭutailaiḥ sahasraṃ vā hyayutaistadanantaram pūrvavatprajapenmantraṃ tāñccharānapi bhūpatiḥ samantātsaphalāstadā vastrālaṅkaraṇaiścāpi toṣayejjayadāyinam bhrāmyati kākavat juhuyātpādarajobhiḥ sahavairiṇaḥ puṣpairhunetsahasraṃ ca senā saṃstambhayedbudhaḥ viṣavṛkṣasamudbhūtāṃ śatroḥ pratikṛtiṃ śubhām kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ kakolūkavasāyutaiḥ ripurnūnaṃ bhavatyeva sahasrataḥ viṣatrikaṭukāliptāṃ samyaguṣṇajale kṣipet dugdhābhiṣekataḥ śāntirbhavatyasya na saṃśayaḥ ripoḥ sadyaḥ pūrvavacchāntirīritā prajapyātha mārayedripusañcayam mantrajāpena śamayecchatrusañcayam śeṣaḥ] || kāraskaradrusamidhā hyayutaṃ juhuyātsudhīḥ rājavṛkṣasamiddhomādrogā naśyanti daṃtinām bhavettathā śrīghraṃ patrairādityakotthitaiḥ pañcagavyena lokarakṣākaraḥ smṛtaḥ juhuyādibhasaṅghānāṃ vṛddhirbhavati nānyathā dikkrameṇaiva pañcātha āyudhāni prakalpayet

kramatopyuktamāyudhapañcakam juhuyātsampātaṃ tatra pātayet vidadhyāddaivatānpañca pañcagavyaprapūritān mantrairbaliṃ havyaṃ nijaiḥ śubhaiḥ rakṣā kamalā tatra vardhate vaśīkuryāttatpanīmutpalairapi śūdrāllaṁvaṇahomena grāmaṃ jātīprasūnakaiḥ mukundaṃ ca manuprokteṣṭaliṅgakam proktaḥ prakāroyaṃ sumantribhiḥ kulālasya karalagnāṃ pragṛhya ca śataṃ cāṣṭādhikaṃ vaśyo bhavettu saḥ vrīhimāngopayobhiśca paśumānbhavati dhruvam sarvasiddhiḥ syādannairannasamṛddhiyuk dīrghāyurmantrī bhavati niścitam tu japtvā tā vikirecchatrusainyake jvarādikairmahārogaiḥ piḍitā sā nṛṇāṃ ciram hyupadravairnānāvidhairnāśaṃ prayāti ca mantrassarvamantrottamo mataḥ visargeṇānvitena ca kapālāni ca dakṣādhaḥ krameṇa dadhatīṃ smaret pūjādikaṃ prayogādi navadurgāsamaṃ smṛtam kāśyāṃ te cārthadāstānvravīsyaham dakṣavaddevī kamalā samudīritā tārādyā dhyānamasyā nirūpyate bhuvanaṃ bhāsayantīṃ sarojagām

tadbāhye kamalādyaṣṭaśaktayaḥ [dvitīyārthe prathamā] evamabhyarcayellakṣmī bhavetsadyo dhanādhipaḥ taddaśāṃśaṃ sarasijaistrisvādvaktairhunetsudhīḥ lakṣatrayaṃ japenmantrī bhavedarthānvito naraḥ sāhasraṃ tāvadbilvairmadhuplutaiḥ saṃvatsarāddhanaṃ pūrṇaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ vāñchitārthāllaṁbhate vasudhānyasamṛddhiyuk prasiddhosau gajānanaḥ hakāraśca kalarā varṇapañcakam dvitīyaṃ syātproktoyaṃ tryakṣaro manuḥ devatoktā kūṭaṃ bījaṃ prakīrtitam || atasīpuṣpasaṅkāśāṃ ratna bhūṣaṇabhūṣitām karābhyāṃ deveśīṃ varadābhayaśobhitām prapūjayeddevīṃ ṣaḍaṃgāni tato yajet īśakoṇātkrameṇaiva brāhmyādyāśca dalāṣṭake aṣṭādaśamahākoṭiyoginībhyo namostviti samabhyarcya gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ dhyātvā trilakṣaṃ prajapetsudhīḥ lakṣmīṃ sāmrājyaṃ syādasaṃśayam mukhe māyānityaklinne madadave hrīṃ ca bījaṃ svathā śaktiḥ samīritā pādayośca mantrārṇānkramato nyaset tāṃ cārusmaremukhāmbujām virājamānāṃ mukuṭalasadardhenduśekharām bibhratīṃ padmamadhyāsīnāṃ madālasām

trikoṇamādau tasyāntaḥ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ bāhyake likhet yajeddevīṃ candanādibhiruttamaiḥ dikṣu yajedaṃgāni ṣaṭ kramāt drāviṇīṃ ca drāvitāṃ cāṣṭapatrake dvārapārśveṣu koṇeṣu dikṣu dvādaśa pūjayet tadbāhye tadastrāṇi tato bahiḥ bandhūkapuṣpaiḥ svādvaktairjuhuyāddhaviṣātha vā ātmānamabhiṣicyātha brāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥ prakūrvīta prayogānmantravittamaḥ tadbhaktaḥ kuryāduktaṃ na cānyathā kairavairaktairājñaśca svavarśaṃ nayet stambhanaṃ śatrornṛpādīnāṃ krudhopi ca bhūṣāvāhanavāṇijyasiddhayaḥ syuḥ svavāṃchitāḥ tattailāktairniśāmadhye tvānayedvāṃchitāṃ vadhūm māsādarātistīvrārtijvareṇa paripīḍyate naśyeyurdussādhyāśca cikitsakaiḥ siktairbījairaṃkolakairapi vanitāṃ kāmajvarārtāmānayeddhruvam dhanamānakulairnityaṃ duṣprāpyāmānayedvadhūm homācchālīnavāpnuyāt jaṃghābhyāṃjānubhyāmūruyugmataḥ homānnaranārīnarādhipāḥ maricairjīrakairyutām spṛśannijakāragreṇa sahasraṃ prajapenmanum naranārīnṛpāstasya vaśyāssyurmaraṇāvadhi

sādhyanāmasphuṭaṃ kṛtvā prāgvatsampācya bhakṣaṇāt karpūravāsitaistoyairmanuṣyānvaśayetsthitān lavaṇayuktena toyena vanitā vaśā nāmnaivaṃ sa tasya syādvaśe'niśam vaśyā dadyuḥ prāṇānapi priyān nameruvāsitaistoyaistarpaṇādbhūmipā vaśāḥ campakairvāsitajalaistarpaṇaṃ sarvarañjanam sarvalokacamatkārī dhruvaṃ bhavati nityaśaḥ indracandanasaurabhyavāsitāmbhaḥ pratarpaṇaiḥ kevaloṣṇodakaistasya tīvrajvarasamudbhavaḥ jāyatenyonyavairuddhyaṃ yena te nāśamāpnuyuḥ mukhyā devī śrīvidyayā samā maimiti bījāni nityaklinne madadrave caturvargaphalapradā samastenāṃgaṣaṭkaṃ syānnityaklinnāṃ smarettataḥ vanaṃ nānākalpadrumānvitam manojñatṛṇapuṣpādyairyukte māṇikyamaṇḍape devīmupaviṣṭāṃ ca saṃsmaret kalāṃ vīṇāṃ tryakṣāṃ nityāṃ smarāmyaham sayonikarṇikaṃ padmamaṣṭapatravirājitam syādāhlādakāriṇyai jyeṣṭhāyai hṛdgudāsane sarvaśaktikamalāsanāya hṛdayāntataḥ tatra yajedvakṣyamāṇena vartmanā mīṃ subhadrāṃ ca maṃgalāṃ vanacāriṇīm nāmamantreṇa pūjayet

madamantharagāminyaḥ subhūṣāścārubhūṣaṇāḥ ṅehṛdantāṃścānaṃgādīnpūjayetkramāt pañcapuṣpeṣupāśāhvanāṃkuśekṣudhanurbhṛtaḥ bhūṣāyuktāḥ smaredvaktrakamalāḥ sādhu pūjayet ṣaṇḍāntasvarahīnañca kakāraṃ bindubhūṣitat pūjāmantraḥ syātsarvāsāṃ cāpyanukramāt durbhatirnidhṛtirvidhṛtistuṣṭiścāpi vituṣṭikā bāhye tadastrāṇi tato bahiḥ tarpaṇādyaṃ ca kṛtvā saṃtoṣya deśikam pūrvamantroditānsamyakpūrvoktavidhinā sudhīḥ pramadājanaiḥ athātosyāḥ pravakṣyāmi dvādaśārṇaṃ mahāmanum manuḥ prokto muniḥ sammohano mataḥ ṣaḍaṃgāni kṛtvā devīṃ vicintayet sṛṇiṃ pāśaṃ kapālaṃ bibhratīṃ karaiḥ yajeddevīṃ proktāṃgāni purā yajet nīlakamalakapālāḍhyakarāmbujā mahākālīṃ samastajanamohinīm vāmamārgeṇa hyasyāḥ siddhiḥ prajāyate svāhā śakravarṇo mantraḥ kālyā udīritaḥ yatheṣṭabhakṣyapānābhyāṃ maithunena prasīdati brāhmyādibhiḥ śaktibhiśca yuktā bhaktyā prapūjayet śaktiśūladhanurbāṇakheṭakhaḍgavarābhayān dhyātvaivaṃ siddhakaḥ sādhyaṃ sādhayenmanasi sthitam tathendrāṇī cāmuṇḍā caṇḍikāṣṭamī || 772 |||

tamodevī mahākālī bhayāpahā tataḥ kṛtvā siddho mantraḥ [tasyeti śeṣ'ḥ] prajāyate kruddho devīmantraṃ japaṃstathā hanti kālikāmantrayogataḥ nāryaḥ pātivratyavratāccyutāḥ pātivratyādbhraṃśitāstāḥ pāparāśirmahānabhūt samāsādya gṛhasthāḥ sukhino bhavan mahāyoginīṃ procya gaurīmuktvā bhuveti ca munirdevī gāyatrī chanda īritam punarevantrirāvṛtyā ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret daṃṣṭrākarālavadanāṃ trinetrāṃ sarvatojjvalām triśūlacakracaṣakakhaṭvāṅgavarapaṅkajām kṛtyāṃ vidhānenapūjayenmantravittamaḥ pratiṣṭhāñca tathā vidyāṃ tadbāhye tu caturdale dvibhujāṃ saumyavaradāṃ pāśāṃkuśadharāṃ śivām japenmantraṃ nityamaṣṭottaraṃ śatam pratimāṃ māraṇe cāpyadhomukhīm candragauraṃ vidhāyāgniṃ paristīrya śaraistṛṇaiḥ juhuyānnimbatailāktaiḥ kākolūkotthaviṭkakaiḥ aṣṭottaraśataṃ caiva mamunā juhuyādbudhaḥ viṣakravyamasṛktasyetthamuktvā ca nivedayet tenāśaṃ tāvadasya ripormatiḥ mantreṇa ripuṃ dhyātvā niruddhadṛk nātra saṃśayaḥ śatruḥ satyamauśanasoditam

maricaṃ piṣṭvā tatraiva lepayet kṣipetkṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ japtvā mantraṃ sahasraśaḥ vilikhenmantrī kṛṣṇasarpāsyaśoṇitaiḥ kākavadbhramate dhruvam uṣṭrāsthnā ca śavāṅgāraiḥ śatroruccāṭanaṃ bhavet annaiḥ samidbhiḥ pālāśaiḥ śāntiṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ madhuratrayasaṃsiktairebhiḥ kuryāttu vaśyakam mahāvyādhipraśamanaṃ nityamaṣṭādhikaṃ śatam gajārūḍhāṃ vihaṃgamām salilādibhayāpahām viṣamapyamṛtambhavet yaḥ kurute martyaḥ sa puṇyāṃ gatimāpnuyāt saṅgoptrīṃ samastasuratuṣṭidām akālamṛtyumathinī sadā vijayavarddhinī āyuṣyapālinī puṣṭilakṣmīsaubhāgyavaśyakṛt mahāvyādhipraśaminī hyapasmāravināśinī tiṣṭhanti ḍākinyādyā viśeṣataḥ likhetpadmaṃ yoniyuktaṃ sabindukam rasakoṇaṃ tu likhenmūlamanuṃ smaran nyasyettanmadhyagaṃ kumbhaṃ vastraratnavibhūṣitam yathānyāyaṃ pāyasantu nivedayet juhuyādājyasaṃsiktāpāmārgatilasarpiṣā sthaṇḍile vāpi homakarmma samācaret kumbhamadhye nyaseddevīṃ dakṣiṇe tu śriyaṃ smaret vāmapārśve tu pūjayedgaṇanāyakam

bhrūṇahatyāyāṃ madyapāne sahasrakam pañcalakṣamitaṃ japet sādhayenmantramimaṃ parimalāhvayam manorasya jape kṛte pheṇikā mudgā māṃsantu vaṭakeṇḍirāḥ vṛntākaśāko matsyārthe vā mādadhikasiddhidaḥ prapañcepi śaktibhirbahudhā tathā kedārasya tu paścime pravakṣyāmi sordhvāmnāyena siddhidam gaṇapatiṃ varayugmaṃ dāntaṃ sarvajanaṃ vadet prokto gāyatraṃ chanda īritam rudreṣupaṃcavedāṃganetravarṇairmanoḥ kramāt mahāgaṇeśavatsarvaṃ prayogādikamācaret ūrdhvāmnāyagaṇapatimantraprakāśaḥ saptadaśaḥ viriyugmaṃ ca gaṇapate varadvayam mantraḥ proktoyaṃ putrapautradaḥ dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalapradaḥ vibhaktairmūlamantrārṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṃgāni samācaret cāṃkuśaṃ dakṣatale madhye kapālakam hastimukhaṃ dakṣiṇena kareṇa ca liṃgāgrantu gaṇeśasya ūrdhvayoḥ karayordvayoḥ prokte navaśaktisamanvite yajedādāvāmodādīndigambarān arcayellokapālāṁśca tadastrāṇi tato bahiḥ vakṣye virivighneśvarasya tu

ekonaviṃśatyarṇoyaṃ nivṛcchanda udāhṛtam dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi hyūrdhvādūrdhvakareṣu tu padmaṃ pāśabāṇānradaṃ ratnāḍhyakumbhakam āliṃgayantamaruṇaṃ sravanmadakapolakam kuṇḍalinaṃ dhyāyeddevaṃ gajānanam saumyasthaṃ viriñcigaṇanāyakam prāgvadvadedvarādīni ṣaḍviṃśatyarṇako manuḥ dhyānapūjādikaṃ prāgvadviśeṣādasya sādhakaḥ prajāyeta kartā hartā yathāvidhi madhuratrayasaṃyuktaiḥ pūrvoktairaṣṭabhirhunet vaśayetsakalaṃ jagat modakānājyasaṃyuktānhutvā vijayamāpnuyāt bhakṣyabhojyādikaiḥ kṛtaḥ hrīmiticchandosya virāḍbhārgava ucyate ṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena ṣaḍaṃgāni prakalpayet trinetraṃ ca pāśāṃkuśadharaṃ vibhum modakāścaiva dhārayantaṃ tvanusmaret devaṃ caturasratrayāvṛte lokapālaiḥ syādvajrādyaiśca caturthikā taddaśāṃśaṃ prajuhuyādapūpairghṛtasamplutaiḥ caturthyāṃ tu pūjayitvā vināyakam maricairjīrakaiścaiva saindhavena vimiśritaiḥ vāṇī saptāhādbhavati dhruvam juhuyāllājaistannāmāyutamantrataḥ prāpte palantu kapilāghṛtam

niyato bhūtvā devatādhyānatatparaḥ saptāhājjāyate śīghramaparo vākpatiryathā niṣkārdhapādamānena haridrāṃ saindhavaṃ vacām subhakṣyabhojyaiśca bhojayitvā ca kanyakāḥ sā labhate putraṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam nigaditaśchando gāyatramucyate ṣaḍaṃgāni dhyānamasya nirūpyate pāśākṣasūtradaśanāndhārayantaṃ tathāṃkuśam madhyāhnādityasaṃkāśaṃ cāruśaktyā samanvitam prathamāvṛttiraṃgaiḥ syāddalaṣaṭke tataḥ param pūjayedbāhye bhūpure lokapālakān japenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ samāhitaḥ kuryādevaṃ siddho bhavenmanuḥ ājyānnairjuhuyānnityamannavānvatsarādbhavet labhetkanyāmenaṃ yo bhajate naraḥ ca mahetyukatvā ṅentaṃ gaṇapatiṃ punaḥ ākhyāto devaḥ śaktivināyakaḥ mantrārṇairaṅgakḷptirihoditā padmasṛṇī dadhānaṃ vāma ūrdhvake maṇimayaṃ mukuṭaṃ bibhrataṃ prabhum pīṭhe virivighneśavartmanā apūpairghṛtasaṃyuktairvidhivatpūjitenale siddhamanurmantrī prayogānvidhivaccaret nārikelaiśca homo lokavaśaṅkaraḥ saktubhiśca kṛto homo brāhmaṇānāṃ vaśaṅkaraḥ

kartavyāḥ prayogāḥ sādhakairiha gaṃ hrīṃ ca vaśamānaya svāhā bhavāṇarkaḥ varekṣūnhastapaṃkajaiḥ śyāmalāṅgyā liṅgapadmahastayā bhāvayeddhṛdi juhuyāttarpaṇādi tataścaret kāmyaprayogāstu tatkalpoktānprasādhayet gaṇeśo na śaktiścāpi na taṃ vinā pravakṣyāmi śaktiṃ śrībhuvaneśvarīm śaktirvaśiṣṭhaśca sūtaśchandosya kathyate bhavedbījamīkāraḥ śaktirucyate ṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena ṣaḍaṃgāni samācaret devyekatāpādanāya mantranyāsotha vakṣyate hṛdaye sthāpyā gude hrīṃ ca karālikā ūrdhvodagyāmyapūrvāśāpratyekastheṣu ca kramāt dakṣakuce brahmāṇīṃ vāmageṃsake vinyasedbhāle gāyatryā sahitaṃ sudhīḥ vāmagaṇḍe ca vāgīśvaryā yutaṃ nyaset vāme dhanapatiṃ yuktaṃ śriyā śrotrāgrake nyaset dakṣaśrotrāgrake mantrī nidhī śaktiyutau nyaset vāmāṃse hṛdidakṣiṇe nyasyenmātṛraṣṭabhāle cāṃse pārśve tathodare vyāpayenmūlamantreṇa tanuṃ devīṃ tataḥ smaret mandasmitalasanmukhīm ṣaṭkoṇaṃ tadbāhyeṣṭadalāmbujam caturdvārasamopetaṃ maṇḍalaṃ proktamuttamam

caivājitākhyā cāparājitā śaktayaḥ pūjyāḥ keśareṣu ca madhyake devīmāvāhayettasyāmaṅgāvaraṇasaṃyutām samabhyarcya vividhābharaṇojjvalāḥ agnīśāsuravāyavyakoṇeṣvagrehṛdādikān gāyatrīmaruṇābhāsāmaruṇākalpabhūṣitām bibhratīṃ tadvadbrahmāṇaṃ purato yajet pītavasanāṃ keyūrāṅgadabhūṣitām viṣṇuṃ rakṣaḥkoṇegrake yajet ṭaṅkākṣasūtrābhayadavarayuktāṃ caturbhujām priyāṃkasaṃsthāṃ ca dakṣeṇāliṅgyabāhunā pītaṃ ratnaghaṭaṃ ratnakarañjaṃ bibhratīṃ yajet bāṇaguṇasṛṇicāpakarañjakam sṛṇipāśadharaṃ kāntāvarāṅgaspṛkkarāṃgulim vigaladratnasphuraccaṣakadhāriṇam āśliṣṭakāntāmaruṇāṃ puṣṭimarceddigambarām tvanaṅgakusumā hyanaṅgakusumāturā syācchaśiśīrṣā ca saptamī pāśāṃkuśavarābhītikarā raktāḥ subhūṣitāḥ śrīdurgoṣā lakṣmīśrutyau smṛtirdhṛtiḥ samabhyarcyāḥ śaktayaḥ paricārikāḥ syādagre bhuvanapālikā ceti tadbāhye tu digīśvarān raktotpalakarāṃ vāme dakṣiṇe kramatastvidam cāṃśukaṃ puṣpaṃ bibhrāṇāṃ dakṣiṇaiḥ karaiḥ

citte caturbhirapi cottamā madhyāstrāvaraṇaiḥ pūjāṅgalokeśatadastrakaiḥ ananyagatikā pūjā hyaṃgenaikena kīrtitā pāpaṃ pūjālope tathā bhavet vāmī ravau pūjāṃ na lopayet dvātriṃśallakṣamānena japenmantraṃ samāhitaḥ tataḥ kuryānmantrī śāstroktavartmanā dakṣiṇāmūrtimāśritaḥ kṛṣṇāṣṭamīṃ samārabhya yāvatkṛṣṇā caturdaśī dadhikṣaudraghṛtābhyaktā vyāghātasamidho hunet bhavenmantro nātra kāryā vicāraṇā tilasarṣapadugdhājyadravyāṇyaṣṭamitāni ca siddhamanurmantrī sarvānkāmānprasādhayet bhavedvāgmī tāvajjaptāmbupānataḥ tajjaptamañjanaṃ vaśyaṃ karpūrāgurumiśritam tadrātryāmiṣṭāmākarṣayetstriyam [vaśyakaramityarthaḥ ||] bṛhaspatisamomantrī sarvavidyādhipo bhavet vaśayetpadmahomena rājñastanmantriṇastathā piṣṭakṛtāṃ pratimāṃ svādusaṃyutām pramadāṃ vāpi yaṃ yaṃ vāñchatyanuttamam darśayedāśu sā sukhaprasavā bhavet maṇḍalaṃ kuryāddevīpīṭhānvitaṃ śubham dalāgre tu svarṇaraupyasutāmrajān nijeṣṭāyai ca mantravit

pañcakalaśā madhyādiṣu yajetkramāt ghṛtakumbhena kaṣāyeṇa tataḥ param kvāthairabhiṣiñcettataḥ sudhīḥ vaktrahastapadakṣālācamanānyapi mantravit tvevaṃ śakto naro bhavet mahatīṃ lakṣmīṃ sarvadā vijayī bhavet agnimanthalakṣasevyanāmnoḥ karma viduttamaḥ udumbarīpāṭalīndukubhāgāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ca sekāddīrghāyuruttamam dhānyasamākulam tatputrāḥ śayānāḥ pathisādhakam aṃgulyādiṣaḍaṅgāni śeṣanyāsāśca pūrvavat ratnapātraṃ vāmahaste dakṣe padmaṃ tato manum trisvāduyuktahaviṣā tarpaṇādi tataścaret brahmavṛkṣaprasūnaiśca homo lakṣmīprado mataḥ vānyaṃ vaśayennātra saṃśayaḥ ratnaughai rājyalakṣmīṃ ca vindati pūrvoditānprayogāṃśca kuryādatrāpi sādhakaḥ aiṃhrīṃ-aimiti munyādyā jñeyāḥ pūrvoditāstathā ṣaḍaṅgāni vidadhyānmantravittamaḥ trinayanāṃ pīnavakṣojanāmitām muktāhārasamāyuktāṃ bhāvayedbhuvaneśvarīm pūrvavatpūjyā hṛllekhādyāśca mantriṇā nijanāthāṅkasthitāḥ smerānanālasāḥ saṃhāraḥ proktāstatpatayastvime

śūlaṃ kapālaṃ pretaṃ ca kṣudradundubhimeva ca vakrakeśāśca pūjākāle suṃmantriṇā svarapatreṣu karālādyāḥ puroditāḥ japettattvalakṣaṃ brahmavṛkṣaprasūnakaiḥ juhuyāttarpaṇādīni kuryānmantrasya siddhaye ekākṣaroditānsarvānprayogānācarettathā hrīṃkromiti vahnyarṇo munyādyekākṣaroditam prodyadarkakāntiṃ hṛdi vibhāvayet ṣaḍaṅgāni brāhmyādyā dalamadhyataḥ pūjayedbhaktyā sa bhavettu kuberavat japettattvalakṣaṃ juhuyāttatsahasrakam śuddhaistilaiḥ payoyuktaistarpaṇādi tataścaret samākhyātāḥ pratyekaṃ ṣaṭsahasrakam sūryasadṛśastenādhiṣṭhitamandiram sarvajanairetanmantraprasādataḥ rājānaṃ rājapatnīṃ vaśaṃ nayet lakṣmīrenaṃ na santyajet pāpānāṃ nāśo mantriṇa eva hi manau mantrī bhuktiṃ muktimavāpnuyāt mantraḥ proktaścāyaṃ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ surāsuranamaskṛtaḥ ṣaḍbhirmantragatairvarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni prakalpayet ṣaḍakṣarāṇyatho nyasya sarveṇa vyāpakaṃ tathā smerāsyamaruṇaṃ cintayeddhṛdi caturasratrayeṇātha veṣṭitaṃ ca kramāllikhet

pūrvadigdalamūleṣu śaktīraṣṭau kramādyajet pāpaghnī tathā puṇyā śaśiprabhā tadvadvakratuṇḍādikānyajet samyagvakratuṇḍārcanaṃ tviti aṣṭadravyaiḥ purā proktairmadhurāktairyathāvidhi tarpayetpūrvamārgeṇa vakratuṇḍaṃ gaṇeśvaram mathitvāgnimanūcānagṛhāddharet pūrvoktavatkṛtvā mantranyāsaṃ ṣaḍaṅgakam tatrātha nāgayajñopavītinam padmāsanasamārūḍhaṃ caturbāhuṃ trilocanam manasā samāvāhya gaṇeśvaram tataḥ siddho bhavenmanuḥ tvapūpairjuhuyādvatsarāllabhate dhanam lakṣmīṃ prāpnotyayatnataḥ mantribhiḥ bhavanaṃ bhavedvaiśravaṇopamaḥ mantrī dhanavānbhavet sajīrakairbahuguḍaiḥ śubhairatighṛtāplutaiḥ labhate mahatīmacirācchriyam apāmārgasamidbhirvā pakvaiḥ panasajaiḥ phalaiḥ lājakairjuhuyādagnau sahasraṃ kanyakāptaye juhuyāllakṣaṃ mṛtyuñjayo bhavet juhuyānmantrī māsāchatrūñjayedhruvam śmaśānāgnau juhuyānmārayedripum mārayetsaptadinairnātra kāryā vicāraṇā

vaḍavāmukhe vahnau mahotkaṭe tridinenāsau śatrumuccāṭayeddhruvam mantrī pāpaughaṃ nāśayeddhruvam dhyāyeddoṣāngrahabhavānharet juhuyāddhānyairannārthyannairhuneddhruvam palalairguḍābhyaktairhunetsudhīḥ niṣkārdhārdhapramāṇena sampiṣyaitāni nityaśaḥ vatsarātsutam cūrṇaṃ vacāyāśca palārdhakam mahatīṃ kavitāṃ labhate dhruvam sthāpayetkumbhaṃ pūjitaṃ candanādibhiḥ japettanmantrapravaramaṣṭottarasahasrakam prasādānnātra saṃśayaḥ munirasyāṇoranuṣṭupcchanda īritam sarvaṃ mantrī pūrvavadācaret rāyaspoṣasya dayitā nidhidoratnado mataḥ juhuyāttaddaśāṃśataḥ mantrī sādhayediṣṭamātmanaḥ vakṣyāmi mantramanyaṃ tathāvidham rakṣohaṇobalagahanovakratuṇḍāya hūmiti vakratuṇḍagāyatrīṃ gaṇapriyām pracodayāt nityaṃ puraścaraṇakṛnnaraḥ japādyantethāṣṭasaṃkhyānanyajāpī susiddhaye pūrvāmnāyagaṇapatimantraprakāśoṣṭādaśaḥ

nānāścaryakarānkāśīsaṃsthitāngaṇanāyakān gṛhītvā tu yoginīṃ ceṭikāmapi aṣṭāvaraṇakairaṣṭau saṃsthitāḥ siddhidāyakāḥ bahiṣkāśyākīrtitaḥ paridhistu saḥ kṣipraprasādanasamamaṣṭānāṃ sādhanaṃ smṛtam pūrvavaccātra kṣiprameva ca siddhayaḥ nāndyarṇassabindustannāmamantra itīritaḥ śivapatnīti śaṃ śive svakareti ca nirūpyate pāśaṃ dadhānāṃ prabhaje śivām siddhamanurmantrī ceṭikāṃ ca prasādhayet pūjayitvā japenmantrantadā nādāñchṛṇoti ca tadānekasurairyuktā pratyakṣākhya śivā bhavet kṣaṇenaiva manasopyativegavān mohitā bahavo janāḥ varṇalakṣampuraścaryā gaṇeśānāṃ prakīrtitā nāmamantrāssmṛtā mantravarṇalakṣampuraskriyā yoginīsevanādatra na vighnaiḥ paribhūyate cātra jaṭilā viṣadhāriṇī varṇadvitayātpātālatalavāsinīm svasthāṃ karatālīmanoramām japedayutasaṃkhyākaṃ śāntātmā tālakānane karpūrāguruyuktaiśca pūrṇaṃ tattriḥ pradakṣiṇam japedrātrau sahasradvitayaṃ manum āyāti prakāśotīva jāyate

nīlāṃśukaparīdhānā kastūrīcandanapriyā mantriṇe tuṣṭā sā dadāti phalatrayam ca jagatīmohanakṣamam cāsya gṛddhā syādveṣataḥ sā tapasvinī paṃcavārṣikītyuktvā bāle vacanamādhurīm ceti dhyānamasyā nirūpyate caṃdrāvataṃsāṃ lalitavacanāṃ netrasuṃdarīm tatpaścātkuṃkumena ca dhattūrakusumairhomaṃ sahasraikaṃ samācaret nagno vā siddhamantraḥ samācaret tadgṛhe gatvā nagno bālāmanuṃ japet drumārūḍhā dhāvaṃstatsannidhau vrajet jihvā rasasandohinī bhavet vyāghrādipaśujātīnāṃ mohanaṃ tadvaco bhavet namaśceti prokto mantraḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ gajānteti tile dehiyugaṃ vadet vahnermantraḥ samākhyāto nāganetramitākṣaraḥ tādṛgvanavibhūṣite homaṃ kuryāddaśāṃśataḥ tathāṣṭamyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe vidhau niśi bhīṣayanti na bhetavyaṃ tadā kvacit samārabdhe tadā kātyāyanī svayam siñcettataḥ sāpi prayāti ca gajamuṇḍañcarvayantī vamantī śoṇitambhuvi bhairavāṃstāṃśca tato bhālodbhavāsṛjā

nagarendirā rudravarṇoyaṃ mantraḥ proktosya yoginī haritālākṣī mantraḥ saptadaśākṣaraḥ vahnijāyāṃ dhyānamasyā nirūpyate haritālākṣīṃ siddhidāṃ śaṃ vitanvatīm dhruvam || ādime divase rātrau gatvā vai nirjane vane japedayutasaṃkhyakam kuryātkuliṅgena haritālarasaspṛśā sādhakastāṃ na viśvaset ratikalāṃ sādhakāya prayacchati khecaraṃ kurvatī sadyo nayeddeśe vicintite mantriṇo vaśamādarāt nānā vastu pradarśayet hayagrīvā bhavenmāsopavāsinī nāgavāhane phurphurvahnigehinī ca phūtkārāhatabhūruhām siddhiḥ prajāyate hunettasya daśāṃśataḥ lambo dṛśyate yugaviṃśakaḥ purastāttasya nirbhītyā sthātavyaṃ tena mantriṇā vaktrācchataṃ jvālā nissaranti punaḥ punaḥ dhūmapatriṇaścāpi śākhinaḥ dṛśyate devī tannāgaphaṇasaṃsthitā bhūmiṣṭhānvāṇī satyā prajāyate madhuvāsinī

coccārya klīṃsvāheti manuḥ smṛtaḥ dhyāyennavarasāṃ devīṃ mṛgākṣīṃ brahmasaukhyadām madhupuṣpairathāpi vā sitāṣṭamyāmekāṃte nirjane japet prāgvatsahasraṃ syājjapennavasahasrakam viṣāṇena dakṣahastena sampiban yakṣo hi latāvṛkṣādi gulmakān prāpnuyāttasmānmithyātrāsādibhistadā yakṣe devī vṛkṣatale tadā vitastimātrantena syātsarvamohanakārakaḥ prayacchanti tasmai kāmavimohitāḥ proktā maṃtro jinamitākṣaraḥ tuṃ ghaṃ maṃ vahnigehinīm japākusumaśoṇāṃgī mama cittasya mantharā racayitvā śubhaṃ sthalam || 90 ||| mallāriṣaṣṭhīrātrau tu japetsome śatadvayam madhupātraṃ hi divyamādhvīkamiśritam spaṣṭayā dadyātpūjāṃte yanmanogatam sandeho manorasya prabhāvataḥ tāṃ devīṃ madhupānaiḥ prapūjayet rasapañcasamīpe tu bhūmipūjāṃ viṣetaḥ kuṃkumaiścādisindūrai raktacandanavandanaiḥ tāvadbhiḥ paripūjayet bhagavate pūrvaṃ ṅentantannāma coccaret tatra nāpitīrūpadhāriṇī

siddhimicchettadyuktāya padaṃ vadet mahāgaṇapavatsarvaṃ tatastāṃ siddhimāpnuyāt hyeṣā mūrtikārūpadhāriṇī haṃsageṃbodhamiti vākchrībījāgni vallabhāḥ varadābhayahastāṃ ca saṃseve haṃsagāminīm homaṃ padmākṣairājyasaṃyutaiḥ hiraṇyakaśipuprāṇanāśakālatithau dhruvam hotavyaṃ padmākṣaiḥ khakhakhāṣṭakam tasmai padmamālāṃ prayacchati kāśyā yāmye durgavināyakaḥ durgāyai hṛdayāntoṣṭavarṇakaḥ yayā durgavadhārthaṃ sevito gaṇaḥ [gaṇeśaḥ] kramādādyantayormāyāṃ durgāyai ceti madhyataḥ pallavādyāḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni ceti mantrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ śaṅkhacakradhanurbāṇāndadhatīṃ trīkṣaṇāṃ bhaje śaktisamarcanam vijayā pūrvadalātsarvārthasiddhidā vajranakhadaṃṣṭāyudhāyaproktvāmahāpadam samākhyātastena siṃhaṃ prapūjayet prathamāvṛttiraṅgaiḥ syāddvitīyā tu prabhādibhiḥ ṅentairnamontaistṛtīyāvaraṇaṃ parikīrtitam medhā śrutiścāpi caturthāvaraṇaṃ kramāt bāhyavīthīdvaye lokapālānastrāṇi ca kramāt svādulolitairvā payondhasā mantrī prayogānācaretsudhīḥ

pañcaratnasamāyuktānnavasthāneṣu vinyaset samabhyarcya dhūpadīpaiśca mantravit vijayaśrīsamāyukto rājā bhavati nānyathā putraṃ vinītaṃ prāpnuyācchubham bahvāyuścāghanāśanam tasyāḥ sādhanamucyate dadhānāṃ ca pīnonnatapayodharām sahośīrairdaśāṃśaṃ homamācaret bilvavṛkṣāṇāmekāntepyatha vā sudhīḥ hunetprāgvaddevīṃ tathā yajet mantriṇe śīghraṃ sphaṭikākhyaṃ manoharam parasyāpi sarvajño jāyate naraḥ tvaṣṭavaktrāsya vaṇikkarma prakurvatī [prakurute |] svāhetyudito manuḥ kamalākṣairbhaveddhomastattatkāmyaṃ samācaret japenmantraṃ samastāṃ rātrimantataḥ vastrairājamandiragairapi koṭarākṣyasya ceṭī syāddadhidugdhadā svāheti mantrotha tasya dhyānamihocyate svarṇakuṇḍalakṣiptāḍhyagaṇḍāntaṃ vidhipūrvakam trimadhuraiḥ prayogaṃ tata ācaret dvitīyāyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe niśāntare sāyantanaṃ karma kuśūlaṃ pūjayettataḥ baddhāsano yogī śītavādhāmupekṣya hi trinetrāṃ ca paśyedaṣṭabhujāṃ śivām

tatastasmai jalenāsecayetsutam tatkālaṃ tattatkarma karoti ca bhavetkubjā vyālagrāhā svarūpataḥ tasmānmahiṣamardinyā mantraṃ vakṣye samāsataḥ mahiṣamarddinī paṃcāṅgāni prakalpayet māhiṣe śīrṣe naumi bhālavilocanām kārmukaṃ kheṭakaṃ hastairbibhratīṃ śaśiśekharām pītāmbaradharāṃ devīṃ pīnonnatakucadvayām prathamāvṛttiraṅgaiḥ syāddurgādyābhiḥ pareritā kanakākhyātu kṛttikā cābhayapradā klībāntarahitaṃ cātra grāhyaṃ dīrghasvarāṣṭakam procya tṛtīyāvaraṇe yajet prajapedvasulakṣaṃ ca tatsahasraṃ tilairhunet tilahomādvaśīkāro nṛṇāṃ strīṇāṃ bhavet dhruvam rājñaḥ saṃgrāme vijayo bhavet brahmavṛkṣotthakusumairlabhate puṣṭimuttamām maricahomataḥ upāsitopāsitātinikaṭe drutasiddhidā tatra saṃsthitā daśākṣaro manuḥ prokto bhajatāmiṣṭasiddhidaḥ jātiyuktā cāṅgakḷptiḥ kāmyakarma hyathocyate syācchikhā varmma bhūtarakṣākṣi kīrtitam trinetrāṃ siṃhavāhinīm taddaśāṃśaṃ hunedghṛtaiḥ

siddhamanurmantrī prayogānācarettataḥ hanyānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā patākādhvajadundubhiḥ saṃmuhyetsa ca saṃgrāme labhate vijayaṃ khalu jāyate tārānnama uktvā ca pūrvavat pūrvavatproktaṃ dhyānapūjādikaṃ tathā kāśīprāntasthitā ete kīrtitā gaṇanāyakā.ḥ kāśyāṃ vai vedakarmapravartakāḥ vedastvanādistasyātra drutaṃ siddhiḥ prajāyate pāpahartā ca vāmamārgaprasādhakaḥ nidhidātā dvijādhipaḥ nāmāni sarvasiddhikarāṇi ca nāmānusāriṇī siddhiravaśyaṃ syānna saṃśayaḥ sīmāvināyakā aṣṭau mantrasteṣāṃ nirūpyate tannāmagaṃ procyahṛdayānto manuḥ smṛtaḥ dhātrīrūpaṃ samāśritāḥ śūlinīti vadedduṣṭagrahe tataḥ munirdīrghatamāśchandaḥ kakubuktaṃ ca devatā syāddhṛdayaṃ śīrṣaṃ varade vindhyavāsinī vadetpaścāttrāsaya rūpamīritam varmāstrāntāḥ prakīrtitāḥ śarīrādau dhyāyeddurgāṃ surairnutām pāśadhanurdigbhirhastaiśca bibhratīm kanyakābhiḥ parivṛtāṃ tryakṣāṃ bhūṣaṇabhūṣitām durgāpīṭhe purā prokte dhyātvā devīṃ prapūjayet

varadā vindhyavāsinya suramardinī sumahāyogeśvarīti gaditāśca tāḥ pāśaṃ devyagrataścaitānpūjayecca pradakṣiṇam japenmantraṃ juhuyāttaddaśāṃśataḥ viprānvidhivadbhaktyābhyarcya guruṃ tataḥ vidhānena gurorājñāpuraḥsaram vicintya prajapenmantraṃ yastaṃ spṛṣṭvā vidhānataḥ tadānīṃ ca bhūtasaṅghaḥ palāyate vidravantyāśu grahāścopagrahādayaḥ prajuhuyācchatruryamasyātithyamāpnuyāt śaktirasyāpratihatā vatsarātprāgbhavedalam samyagaṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvospitamupavrajet trisahasramitaṃ japtaṃ yiyāsordvārisaṅkhanet nikhātaṃ ca senāstambhaṃ karotyalam pānīyānnakarāṃ caiva prasannāṃ prajapenmanum sahasrabhṛtyavargeṇa sahito nātra śaṃśayaḥ vaśyāstathāśvatthasamidvaraiḥ durgākalpoditānsarvānprayogānsādhayetsudhīḥ sādhakābhīṣṭadāyinī vṛtte svāhānto dvinakhākṣaraḥ anyacchūlinidurgāvatsavarmasyāḥ prakīrtitam svadaṃṣṭrā yoginī cāsya nānāsaṅgītakovidā lakṣamito mataḥ viśālalocanāṃ vande nīrakṣīravidhāyinīm pūrvānvayi] bhūmau tu kārtikyāṃ pūrṇimātithau

mahāśabdaḥ prasannāsmīti śobhanaḥ nīrānvitaṃ tataḥ kṣīraṃ jāyate kṣīramādarāt kṛtvā kāśyāṃ sadā ratā ṅentamuktvāsvāhāntoṣṭādaśākṣaraḥ puraścaraṇamasya tu japenmahāmatrī rātrau valmīkabhūmiṣu samastaviṣanāśinīm ceṭī tatsādhanaṃ bruve saptadaśārṇoyaṃ japedvarṇasahasrakam kaṇṭhamātreyutaṃ caikaṃ dhyāyandevīṃ samāhitaḥ vṛṣṭirāyāti sā hi pañcadināvadhi śaktirmantrādyasya nirūpyate virāṭ chando devatā tu sarasvatī śrotrayonasordṛṣṭayoḥ kapolāsye tathendriye vāgdevīṃ candraśekharām svaradvandvaṃ tatorcayet yogasandhyā ca vimalā jñānavṛddhiḥ smṛtistathā tadāyudhāni pūjyāni bhūpurādau yathākramam juhuyāttaddaśāṃśaistu śuddhaiścātha tilairhunet manau mantrī brahmacaryavrate sthitaḥ bhavetkavīnāmagraṇīrdhruvam sandeho vāksiddhimatulāṃ naraḥ kavīnāmagraṇīrbhavet bṛhattuṇḍā tālavādanatatparā yasyāmantargatā mantrāstrayastriṃśacca koṭayaḥ

samastāgamamantrāṇāṃ dātānāstyatra saṃśayaḥ devīṃ yayā sarvamidaṃ tatam bījānyacaḥ proktāḥ śaktayaḥ kīlakaṃ bhavet prāguktamātṛkā nyāsāssarve mukhyā bhavanti ca pañcāśadarṇavyāptāṃgīṃ candrārdhāṃkitaśekharām muktāvṛtasphuradbhūṣāṃ bhaje mātṛsarasvatīm śubhaṃ padmaṃ bhūpuratritayāvṛtam kacaḍhādikavargāṃśca likhedaṣṭadaleṣu ca pūjāpīṭhamidaṃ proktamādāvaṃgāni saṃyajet svaradvandvaṃ tato vargānkeśareṣu yajedimāḥ vidyeśvarī madhyamāṃte pūjyāḥ pīṭhe tataḥ param kleśinī cāpi dhāriṇī mālinī tathā lokeśvarānagre vīthyāmastrāṇi pūjayet śuddhaistarpaṇādi kṛtvā siddho bhavenmanuḥ saṃgare syājjayāya samyaksa mūrkhopi kavitvabhāk bhakṣitaṃ kavitāpradam sutāgryam kṣayosyāḥ [nivāsaḥ] mameṣṭaṃ dehi durbhugnī śikhivallabhā kuryātprātastu nīrājjayati sukhakarānsādhakendro gatosau dadāti sā devī sustrīvittāmbarādikam vakratuṇḍādyāśceṭīśaktisamanvitāḥ vakratuṇḍavidhiḥ pūrvamuktoṣṭānāṃ sa eva hi yoginīti dehi dehi vadettataḥ

vīṇātantrīsphuraddhastāṃ tannādacalakuṇḍalām hunetsiddho bhavenmanuḥ manuṃ devyā japedaṣṭasahasrakam vīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgānāṃ kinnarīṇāñca bhūyasaḥ yoginīrūpā pratyakṣā mantriṇo bhavet brahmabhūyāya kalpate raktākṣī gānavādaratā sā añjanaṃ ca dehiyugmaṃ nidhiṃ vadet shāheti kathito manuḥ ghṛtāktaguggulairhomo devatāṃ sādhayettataḥ śatatrayam ghṛtāktaguggulairhomaṃ tataḥ kuryācchatatrayam sadyo bhavati bhūpatiḥ paṅkajākṣī prakīrtitā syādabhāve ca samidvaraiḥ kāryakarī nānālaṃkāraśobhitā kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāñcaitramāse bhaume śukre thavā niśi dadāti phalamuttamam sadguruḥprārthitaḥpunaḥ hyekatriṃśākṣaro manuḥ vāḍavaṃ vahniṃ ca śamaya dvayam kārye hunetsaghṛtapāyasam śyāmāmbaraparīdhānā me cittestu payodinī bṛhaspatau vāpi śukre vā tatra vāsare ayutamprajapenmantrampāyasairhomamācaret

dadāti varakāṃ caikāmmantriṇe toṣa māgatā kartavyandhyātvādevīṃ bhavejjalam haṃsavāgīśvarīśaktirmantrādyasya nirūpyate śaktiśca devyādirgāyatrī chanda īritam vidvāṃstṛtīyabījena ṣaḍaṅganyāsamācaret mantrākṣarāṇi vinyasya cintayediṣṭadevatām candrānanāṃ mandahāsā candrārdhakṛtaśekharām yajetpīṭhe mātṛkā yāḥ puroditāḥ tāṃ devīmarcayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥ devīmitthaṃ prapūjayet sumatīḥ svastiraṣṭau tacchaktayo matāḥ kuryātsādhako niyatavrataḥ lakṣmīyaśaḥkāntiyutaḥ kavitvasyālayaṃ bhavet vakṣye yattasyāḥ ṣoḍaśārṇakam vāgdevī svāhānto mantra īritaḥ padairmantrasya ṣaḍdbhiḥ syātṣaḍaṅgaṃ caiva jātimat vyākhyāṃ mudrāṃ pustakameva ca candrārdhabhālāṃ ca pīnonnatapayodharām japenmantraṃ haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥ ājyāplutaistaparṇādi sarvaṃ pūrvavadācaret saṃvatsarādbhavedvidvānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā mantrametaṃ ca puṣpagandhādikaṃ sudhīḥ nityaṃ bhavettasya na saṃśayaḥ daśākṣaravadasyānyatpañcāṃgaṃ tu manoḥ paraiḥ namrāṃ stanabhāreṇa tāmbhaje

prakurvīta pūrvavadvai daśārṇavat tryarṇā ceṭītrayānvitā saṃjapyaḥ kṣattriyaiḥ paratāpakaiḥ ṛṣyādikaṃ daśārṇoktaṃ devī tryarṇā sarasvatī vidhāyātha dhyāyeddevīṃ sarasvatīm ratnakumbhaṃ tvakṣamālāṃ ca pustakam pīnottuṅgakucānamrāṃ śvetābjasthāṃ sarasvatīm pratyahaṃ yaḥ sa bhavedvākpatirdhruvam ājyāktahaviṣā vahnau daśāṃśaṃ juhuyāttataḥ siddhamanurmantrī prayogānkartumarhati so'pratimāṃ siddhimacirāllabhate dhruvam naṃdyāvartodbhavaiḥ kundasaṃyutaiḥ kusumairhunet japenmantrī sabhāyāṃ jayamāpnuyāt ca yaḥ khādetsa medhāṃ vāñchitāṃ labhet pāṇḍavīti bagale tataśca bagalāmukhi sphrīṃ svāheti triṃśārṇo mantro dhyānaṃ nirūpyate pītavarṇāṃ vicitrāṃ pāṇḍavīṃ bhaje puraścaryāṃ paścātsādhanamācaret baddhaṃ gatistambhaḥ prajāyate tailayuktairbhaveddhomaḥ pṛthumadhyā prasīdati pañcabhūtāni tatpīṭhaṃ tena khe gatiḥ kārtikeyaguhākhelāṃ pṛthumadhyāṃ bhajāmyaham || 351 ||| tāruṇyaṃ kuruyugmaṃ ca dhaṃ ca dham vṛṣṭikāle caturdaśyāṃ niśāntare homaḥ kadalīkhaṇḍakaistathā

pārthivīṃ devīṃ tāruṇyāṅkapradāṃ śivām jarāmaraṇarāhityaṃ sambhaveccaiva sarvagaḥ ceṭī kaṃkālikā matā svāhāntaḥsthitivarṇoyaṃ lakṣamasya japo mataḥ tatsādhakasya tadekaṃ sā prayacchati yoginī cāsya ceṭikā paṃkavāsinī caikatriṃśākṣaro manuḥ devyā dhyānaṃ nirūpyate mānase ma vasa smaradevi pratyahaṃ kamalakānanasaṃsthe caikaṃ kalpapuṣpāti gandhavat | rājastriyo bhūpāḥ paṇḍitā devatā api mahāśmaśānamāvṛtya shitānabhayadāyakān bhavennāma yoginī vasuvikramā tanmantraḥ prokta ekādaśākṣaraḥ māṃ sarasvatyai hṛdayānto manurmataḥ siddhyanti pūrvoktāḥ sarva eva hi coktvā vāmalocana ityapi vahnijāyānto manuḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadarṇakaḥ sthirāṃ devīṃ sambhaje tāṃ varānanām sahasratritayaṃ homaḥ śaṅkhaiścāpi kapardakaiḥ sthāpayedyatra kaṇādīnāṃ kuśūlake dhānyāntaraṃ sthāpyaṃ vṛddhistatrāpi jāyate pṛthivyāveṣṭanakarī saptakoṭeśvarī matā caṇḍikāṃ ca saḥ kaḥ saptākṣaro manuḥ saptakoṭeśvarī devī vāgaiśvaryakarī matā

pūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ tripurāvatprakīrtitam syāttāvanmantrañjapejjale pūrṇacandraprabhābhantadamāmpūrṇāṃ karoti ca kāśmīracārutāṭaṅkāṃ dhyāyāmi śivavallabhām yoginī tu putradārūpadhāriṇī samākhyātā tasyāḥ sādhanamucyate paṃktiśchandosya devatā sarve kartavyāstatphalāptaye yasyā iti vigrahaḥ ||] tripurabhairavyāstryakṣarāyāśca tatsamam nitya kāmyasiddhyarthamucyate mūḍhasya śilārūpasya nānyathā havanānmohayenmantrī lokatrayanivāsinaḥ śriyamāpnuyāt rājanāgendradevānāṃ purandhrīrvaśamānayet samidbhirjāyate kṣīraṃ madhunā mṛtyunāśanam kahlārahavanādbhāgyaṃ madhuratrayaraktayuk hutaṃ tadalpamṛtyośca rogāṇāṃ cāpi nāśanam raktotpalairjagadvaśyaṃ lakṣmīrbhāgyaṃ sitotpalaiḥ saṃśayaḥ lākṣāsiddhayaṣṭīkadalīphalahomataḥ lakṣaṃ ceddhutognirnṛpavadbhavet phalairlakṣahomādvaśyāḥ śataṃ nṛpāḥ tilājyābhyāṃ candanena tu śatravaḥ tu homena vāgvaśyaṃ jāyate nṛṇām

nīlataṇḍulahomena śāntirbhavati mandire dhānyasiddhirbhaveddhruvam vaṭakairupasargānvināśayet japāpuṣpairjagadvaśyaṃ bāṇapuṣpaiśca mohanam daśāgadhūpahomācca saubhāgyamatulaṃ bhavet śrīphalairatulā lakṣmīrikṣudaṇḍaiḥ sukhaṃ bhavet varadāḥ sarvaśaktayaḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ viśākhādityasaṃgame kāṃtāśatāsaṃge nāsau skhalati mānavaḥ sadyaḥ sambhaje vāmalocanām stambhaya dviścoktvā nāde mākuru cocyate lakṣajapātsidhyedvā vāmalocanā pure vasati yoginī aukāreṇa samanvitāḥ caitanyabhairavītulyaṃ viśeṣoyaṃ ca pūjane paścādanyatsarvaṃ yathoktavat ||] sādhanaṃ vacmi tadekāṃte nadītaṭe yamaṃ kālaṃ viṣṇumīśaṃ krameṇa ca homastrirelāyāḥ phalairbhavet raviṇā vāpi yadā yuktā bhavettadā tadakṣayyaṃ dhyānamasyā nirūpyate citraveṣāṃ tāṃ sambhaje parameśvarīm yugalaṃ śrīṃ svāhā tridvivarṇakaḥ lakṣaṇajñāsya nāmnā rudhiravāhinī hasakalarakārāṃśca ḍakāraikārasaṃyutān

bhairavīvatsarvaṃ nyāsādikaṃ matam kāśyāṃ sthāpitastvanayā purā caitraśuklacaturdaśyāṃ vasante niśi sañjapet devī tadā dadyācca maṃtriṇe pakṣimṛgādīnāmuragāṇā ca mohanam śivāṅkasthā raktakañcukadhāraṇī mantroyaṃ manvarṇaḥ [caturdaśākṣaraḥ ||] parikīrtitaḥ athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi dantihastaṃ vināyakam śaktiścihnagamyā ca ceṭikā ṛṣiḥ kāmastu gāyatrī chando bāṇeśvarī surī ekākṣareṇa sarvaiśca manorvarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam ca sūryābhāṃ bāṇeśīṃ sundarīṃ bhaje japeddhomo bandhūkakusumairmataḥ prayogādyaṃ sarvamasyāstripurāvatprakīrtitam hemantrindivyabhogānapi dhruvam tithivarṇoyaṃ dhyāyetkaṇṭhebjakamrajām sampravakṣyāmi piciṇḍilavināyakam karmakarī ceṭī cāsya trilocanā mantraḥ] tāraṃ tato nārīṃ ramyā kamalavāsinīm prārthitāṃ śambhuviṣṇubrahmādikaiḥ suraiḥ japetpaścānnāraṅgairhomamācaret bhavetstrīṇāṃ nārīṃ ramyāṃ tadā japet mantro'syāstithivarṇakaḥ ca mantroyaṃ dhyāyeddevīṃ trimālinīm āṣāḍhaśuklasaptamyāṃ caturthyāṃ vā samāhitaḥ

palāśamūlairatyantaiḥ komalerhomamācaret siddhirarcayitvā gaṇeśvaram śaktibhiśceṭikābhiśca yuktāngambījapūrvakān hṛdayāntastathāṣṭānāṃ mantroyaṃ parikīrtitaḥ klīṃ aiṃ brūmiti procya śrīṃ mantraḥ pañcavarṇakaḥ rītyāhṛdayādinyāsamapi kuryāt] pāśāṃkuśaśarānakṣamālikāmabhyaṃ dhanuḥ pūjādikaṃ bhavet siddhikarī naṣṭaveṣāsya ceṭikā strīṃ svāhā viśvavarṇo mantro dhyānaṃ nirūpyate pretāsanāṃ mahādevīṃ naṣṭaveṣāṃ bhajāmyaham gajadantena daśāṃśastuṣyati tviyam bhūtapretapiśācādīnkhelansaṃvaśayedapi klīṃ aiṃ sauśca manurmataḥ ||] || pañcakāmāṃśca vinyasya mūlena vyāpakaṃ caret sphuradratnadukūlāḍhyāṃ nānālaṅkāra bhūṣitām pūjayetpaścātṣaḍaṅgāni prapūjayet tato bhairavāṣṭakañcāpi mātaraḥ puraścaraṇakṛtyādi kāmyakarma tathākhilam strīṃ vahnigehinīm tāṃ cañcalākṣīṃ mahānādāṃ bhajāmyaham kṛṣṇāyāṃ niśi kurvīta tattīre cāyutaṃ japam devī prasīdati bhavenmatrī trilokīgamanakṣamaḥ cāsya dhātuvādakriyākarī

sammohanaśchando gāyatrī devatā matā ṣaḍaṅgāni ṣaḍdīrghānvitamūlataḥ pūrvoktapañcabāṇāṃśca nyaseddhyānaṃ samācaret nānālaṅkāraśubhagāṃ mohayantīṃ jagattrayam kṣobhiṇīṃ caiva śaśinīṃ stambhinīṃ tathā samāvāhyārcayenmudrāśca darśayet anaṅgarūpiṇī | anaṅgamadanā ityādi] madanā tathā tadvaddvipikāṣṭau samīritāḥ vijñeyāstripureśyā yathā tathā gaṇeśāntrājamātaṅyā saṃbadhānyoginīyutān namontā manavasteṣāṃ kramānnāmāni vacmyaham vināyakaścaiva tathā gajavināyakaḥ athāntargṛhamāvṛtya sthitāñchṛṇu vināyakān gajakarṇaścitraghaṇṭaḥ syānmaṅgalavināyakaḥ te vakṣyante mayādhunā jñānapūrvo dvāravighneśa eva ca kīrtyante pretavāhanāḥ [idaṃ parānvayi] dhūrttaviśvāsā vyomaikacaraṇārdhadṛk sthūlanāsā mārjārī kaṃṭhapūraṇā yoginyo ṅentaṃ nāma namontakam sampravakṣyāmi śaktimeṣāṃ susiddhidām śrīṃ manavaḥ proktā bhagavatīpradaṃ vadet sarvamukharāji sarvamukheti ca sarvastrīpuruṣetyuktvā vaśaṃkari padaṃ vadet sarvalokamuktvāmukaṃ vadet

ekaviṃśadviśvadhṛtidhṛtiviśvakarairmanoḥ ṣaḍaṅganyāsa uditaḥ padanyāsaṃ bravīmyaham bāhvorjaṭhare nābhimaṇḍale gude nyasya padānyaṣṭādaśa kramāt vedāgnīndudvitrinetrairvarṇairmantrapadāni tu mūlādhāre pūrvabījatrayaṃ prītyai padaṃ vadet mano bhavāyai ca namo vadet śirovadanahṛdguhyapādeṣu kramato nyaset mahocchuṣmāṃ svanāmādivarṇabījapurassarām mūrdhapādāsyaguhye hṛdaye drāviṇīṃ kramāt bījatrayādyāṃ mātaṃgī padāṃte manmathaṃ mukhe dakṣapārśve manobhavam anaṃgādyāḥ sthāneṣveṣveva vinyaset sambhavā bhuvanapālinī prītiṃ kīrtiśāṃtyau puṣṭiṃ tuṣṭiṃ krameṇa ca bhruvormadhye śirasyevaṃ ca vinyaset mūlādhāre tvadhiṣṭhāne nābhau hṛdi gale mukhe mātaṃgyantānnyasetpaścānmātaṃgyaṃtā imāṃ api raudrīṃ tathā śāṃtiṃ hṛdaye siddhidāṃ gale kalāpade sṛṣṭiṃ rodhikāyāṃ tathā nyaset viṣṇuśaktiṃ dhruvamaṇḍalake nyaset catasraḥ śaktayo nyasyā mātaṃgī śirasi nyaset siddhalakṣmīṃ tathā mūle mūlādhāre pravinyaset nyastaśarīrosau cintayenmantradevatām maṇḍape ratnanirmite

ratnasiṃhāsane śubhe trikoṇaṃ syādaṣṭapadaṃ tato bahiḥ sacaturdvāraṃ maṇḍalaṃ proktamuttamam kadambamālābharaṇāṃ pūjitāṃ ca surāsuraiḥ tilakopetāmīṣatprahasitānanām valītaraṃgamadhyābhāṃ romarājīvirājitām nānāmaṇigaṇonnaddhakaṭisūtrairalaṃkṛtām dvibhujāṃ bālāṃ madāghūrṇitalocanām svarṇottaṃsavirājatām catuṣṣaṣṭikalārūpāṃ pārśvasthaśukasārikām pītavarṇāṃ vā dhyāyenmātaṃginīṃ parām aiṃhrīṃśrīṃbījapūrvāśca ṅemātaṃginamontakāḥ puṣṭirutkṛṣṭir-ṛddhiśca mātaṅgyā nava śaktayaḥ ityuktvā mātaṃgyāḥ pīṭhamarcayet tasyāmāvāhaddevīmarcayettadanantaram bahusthaleṣvalekhiṣam ||] pradarśayet śvetābhā prathamāyāntu sāñjaliḥ trikoṇakāṣṭadalayorantarāle tu pūjayet mantrajñaḥ paṃcabāṇāstatorcayet amalāruṇabhāyuktāndhanurbāṇāyudhāṃstathā guṇasṛṇyabhayeṣṭāni dhārayantyoruṇaprabhāḥ hemapradā padmākarā kausumbhakāmbarā puṣpabāṇekṣuhastā cāmalalocanā kuṇḍasamā padmacinmudrākaraśālinī [varā'bhayeti pā0] puṣṭiḥ pītāṅgā cārubhūṣaṇā

pūjyā manmathādyā madoddhatāḥ patrasaṃsthā mātarastu tadagre cāṣṭa bhairavāḥ brāhmyādyā hrasvādyā bhairavā api ādarśaratnadīpaṃ ca vyajanaṃ ca tataḥ param vāsomālyātapatrāṇābharaṇāśukaśālikaiḥ vāmahastaiśca deveśāḥ khaḍgapāṇayaḥ vīṇāñcatuḥpatre tatorcayet alaṃkṛtabhujā raktā dvitīyā cendusannibhhā pāśāṃkuśasarojāni yonimudrāñca vibhratī ca dhyātavyā mantrisattamaiḥ gaṇeśadurgāvaṭukakṣetrapālānbahiryajet [padadvayamuttarānvayi] kṛtvā brāhmaṇārādhanantathā juhuyājjātīmallikānāgakeśaraiḥ paṅkajaiḥ svāṃ śriyamāpnotyanuttamām japābandhūkabakulairvajravṛkṣasamudbhavaiḥ juhuyāttasya sarvasiddhirbhavatyalam juhuyādvṛṣṭikāmastu guḍūcībhirjvaraṃ haret cānnavāñjāyatecirāt yatproktaṃ trisvādvaktaṃ tu tadbhavet nimbaprasūnahomācca kamalāṃ vāñchitāṃ labhet candanāgurukarpūrarocanākuṃkumairapi aṣṭābhirjapitairetaistilakaṃ janamohanam saṃśayaḥ homādvāñchitamāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā

rañjanīṃ klīṃ tato vadet varṇāṃstu catvāriṃśatkramāttataḥ dvyūnaśataṃ mantre varṇāḥ prakīrtitāḥ duṣprāpyo'kṛtapuṇyaiśca munīndrādyaiśca sevitaḥ pūrvamuditā mantrasyāsya bhavanti hi pañcabāṇānaṃgulīṣu talayormakaradhvajam makaradhvaja ityetatklīṃ namontaḥ prakīrtitaḥ śrotrayorghrāṇayorvaktre gaṇḍayoḥ kakudi kramāt mūlādhāre padorapi ṣaḍaṣṭakaikacandrāṣṭanavāṣṭādaśapatribhiḥ ekonaviṃśatiyutānmantrārṇānāditaḥ kramāt kāmaśaktīṃdirābījānyuktāni ca śikhā manoḥ punaḥ pañca kukṣau pārśvadvaye hṛdi dakṣapādāṃgulīmūle gulphasandhau ca jānuni tato lakṣmyādikā nyaset vāmahastāṃgulīmūle dakṣahastāṃgulītaṭe bhruvormadhye netrayoḥ śrotrayogude mūlādhāre tvadhiṣṭhāne tālau vāmādikā nyaset mātaṅyādicatuṣkaṃ ca hṛdi nābhau śirogude [kaṃ śiraḥ] mūle ca mantreṇa vyāpakaṃ caret bhruvormadhye dakṣapāde tathottare samudre tu ratnadvīpe mahāvane maṇisiṃhāsanasyordhvamupaviṣṭāṃ vicintayet śubhrāṃśuvadanāṃ nīpapuṣpagumphitaveṇikām kastūrītilakāṃ candramukuṭāmunnatastanīm

valayāṅgadahārādimañjīraraśanānvitām pūrvokte ca śubhe pīṭhe yantrametatprakalpayet vedatalaṃ caturasraṃ manoharam yajeddevīṃ mantrī śṛṅgāraveṣataḥ mātāṅgīpīṭhamabhyarcya kṛtvā mūlaprakalpanam prāgvatṣaḍaṅgāni prapūjayet gaṇeśādicatuṣkaṃ ca caturdvāreṣu cārcayet tadbāhye nyāsapūrvaṃ japenmanum sadugdhaiśca nivedyātha devīṃ natvā tato balim bhagavatītyuktvā mātaṅgeśvari tatparam uttarato vāyavyādisakoṇake parameṣṭhigurubhyaśca paramācāryagurubhyaḥ pañcasthāneṣu gurūnsampūjayediti palāśapuṣpaistrisvāduyuktairante'yutaṃ hunet kumārīrbhojayeccāpi vaśayetkṣobhayejjayat sthaṇḍile vāpi vidheyaṃ kāmyakarmakam ghṛtāktaguggulorhomādrājñaśca vaśayetsudhīḥ bilvapatraiśca hunetpadmairviśeṣataḥ prākṛtavācā chītū?ranāmāsya prasiddham] homayet juhuyādannairdhānyārthī śālitaṇḍulaiḥ nandyāvarttaprasūnaiśca vāgarthī juhuyādatha śatrorunmādakṛddhoma unmattakusumairapi ulūkakākagṛddhrotthapakṣaistailapariplutaiḥ pāyasairguḍasammiśraiḥ khaṇḍairikṣudalaistathā lāktaṃ kāśaśvāsajvarāpaham

nirguṇḍīmūlahomena nigaḍasya vimocanam sādhyanāmāmukasthāne sādhye prāṇāṃśca tatra ca japenmūlemukasthāne sādhyanāma tu yojayet tadrūpaṃ tatra sthāne niveśayet uttānāmatha piṣṭotthāṃ svāsanādhastathā khanet sahaitāstu tisraḥ pūryāstataḥ param tato madhūcchiṣṭamayīmūrdhvapādāmadhomukhīm puttalīntena kārayet saṃhārabhāgena nyāsamācaret īritaḥ dakṣastṛtīyaḥ syāccaturtho mastakammatam syātsaptamastathorvādipādāṃtaḥ savyadehataḥ gulphadvayaṃ tathā jānudvayaṃ jaṃghādvayaṃ tathā śarīramekādaśadhā hyasādhyasyātha vakṣyate juhuyādbhāgaṃ smarañchatruṃ niśāmukhe nāryaḥ saṃkṣubdhā madanāturāḥ kṣamasveti paśya māmmā parityajya mantriṇo yoṣitaḥ sadā haridrācūrṇasaṃyuktaṃ lavaṇaṃ stambhane matam tathā tisraḥ pañca saptātha vā punaḥ mantrajñaiḥ kanyakāścaiva sarvadā tathā piṣṭamayāndīpāṃśca kalpayet mātaṃgīprītaye maṃtrī yoginyaṣṭakamāyajet ḍākinīṃ kālikāṃ kālarātriñceśānagocarām rākṣasīṃ vīrakumārīṃ vahnikoṇagām

tripurāṃtā krodhinīṃ ca durmadāṃ dhvaṃsinīṃ yame ādityāṃ cāpi khaṭvāṃgīṃ kālāgnimiti nair-ṛte haṃkālīṃ yamadūtīṃ ca kaumārīṃ ca kapālinīm kāmukīṃ vāyau lomakādhomukhīṃ tathā ghorograrūpavikaṭāṃ codagdiśi kapālinīm pṛthvīśvarāṃstadardhena vaśayennātra saṃśayaḥ sarvā āyāntyayutajāpataḥ sahasratritayātsarvavāñchitāptirbhaveddhruvam aṣṭāśītyakṣare mantre sarvasattvavaśaṅkari punaḥ sarvalokādikaṃ vadet kravyādikampūrvamuktaṃ ṣaḍbījaiśca ṣaḍaṅgakam dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvamaṣṭāśītimanormatam athānyatsampravakṣyāmi catuḥpañcāśadakṣaram gauryevaṃ gāndhārīti padaṃ vadet gheṃgheṃ vā vāgnigehinī ṣaḍaṅgāni tu māyayā bheda ekaṣaṣṭikavarṇakaḥ bhavetpraṇavahīnoyammantraḥ sarvatra pūrvavat samākhyāto vijayasya padaṃ vade mantro nivṛcchando hyajo muniḥ mantrākṣaraiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni dhyānamasyā nirūpyate trinayanāṃ svarṇalekhāṃ bhajāmyaham ādāvaṅgāni ṣaṭkoṇe brāhmyādyāstvaṣṭapatrake prajapenmantraṃ juhuyātpāyasairghṛtaiḥ prayogāṃścānnapūrṇāyā mātaṅgyā vā samācaret

rājābhimukhī vaśyamukhīti ca devādhidevi sarveti janasya mukhamuccaret diksaptakratuvaideṣumaitrārṇairaṅgakalpanam jāniyādviśeṣādvaśyakṛttvayam nyāsapūjādikaṃ bhavet pāyasahomaśca prayogādyaṃ ca pūrvavat vāgbhavaṃ hṛdayaṃ cātha śrīmātaṅgīpadaṃ vedet satyaṃ kathaya yugmakam vāgbhavenātra pūjādyaṃ ca kṛtākṛtam kathayeddevī pṛcchakasya śubhāśubham mantraḥ sarvakāryaprasādhakaḥ cāsya devatā parikīrtitā dviruktaiśca ṣaḍaṅgasya vidhiḥ pūjājapādikam bandhūkapuṣpairhomaḥ syātsitayā pāyasena ca samastamantradānādau siddhaḥ syātsādhakottamaḥ svāhāṣṭākṣaroyamudīritaḥ cāṅgaṃ dvirāvṛttipadairbhavet candrāvataṃsāṃ vividhairgāyanairviśvamohinīm pūjyāḥ keśareṣvaṅgapūjanam vajrādyaissaptāvṛttiriyaṃ matā madhūkajaistrimadhvaktaiḥ sarvaṃ sammohayejjagat athocchiṣṭāṃ pravakṣyāmi mātaṅgīṃ gojavarṇikām svāhā mantroyaṃ mohayejjagat māgaṅgī cocchiṣṭā gobjavarṇikā syurmantravarṇaistato dhāyeddhṛdambuje

muktāpravālamālāḍhyā śaṅkhakuṇḍaladhāriṇīm pañcabāṇāstathāṅgāni brāhmyādyāścāṣṭapatrake lokapālāstadastrāṇi tato bahiḥ pūrvaṃ vā japenmantrāvetayormadano muniḥ pūjājapādikaṃ prāgvadbhedāṃścāsyāparāñcchṛṇu vāgmitvaṃ ca kavitvaṃ ca gānaśaktiṃ karoti ca āṃhrīṃkroṃbhirdvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret nīlacūḍāṃ ca vādayantīṃ ca vallakīm trikoṇaṃ pañcakoṇañca bahiraṣṭadaladvayam tathā nāma vadeducchiṣṭapādukām ratyādyāḥ koṇānte tu triśaktayaḥ drāviṇyādyāḥ pañcakoṇe sampūjyāḥ kāmaśaktayaḥ brāhmyādyāḥ kanyakānāmnyo dvitīyeṣṭadale tathā ṣoḍaśāre kanyakākhyāḥ prapūjayet sukeśī mañjughoṣā nāgakanyakā parakāyapraveśinyāḥ kanyakāṃ dūradarśanām dvāreṣu pūjayeddvāradevatāḥ gaṇeśaṃ ca kṣetrapālaṃ ca yoginīm svanāmādyakṣaraṃ bījaṃ kṛtvāgneyādike yajet sarve śrutiyutā vāmabhāge tataḥ param abhyarcetparameśvaryāḥ pāśvaryoḥ śukasārike bālāyāḥ sādhakasya śubhaṃ bhavet manorucchiṣṭamātaṅgyā dattvādau pūjayenmanum gauravāllāghavādvāpi kartavyantu yathocitam ucchiṣṭabhaktena baliṃ niśi nityaṃ nivedayet

palāśakusumaiḥ svāduyuktairhomaṃ tathātra tu proktaṃ kuryāttadapi sādhakaḥ ucchiṣṭabhaktaśeṣeṇa rātrau tasyai baliṃ haret pūjanīyā nārīṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ strī yācitānaṅgabhogikā tathā dūrvā musalī madhuyaṣṭikā samproktā pṛthagetāḥ spṛśañjapet nṛpo vātha dhatte harṣasamūhakam śataśatametāḥ saṃyojya peṣayet dhṛtāḥ samyaksarvastrījanarañjikāḥ bhavanti sarvalokasya dakṣārañjanakarmaṇi ca kṛṣṇājyayuktayā kajjalaṃ dhṛtam jagadvaśyaṃ nārīsaṃkṣobhakārakam pūrvoktairdaśabhirdravyaiḥ pañcagavyaiśca kāpilaiḥ lalāṭe bhuvanaṃ vaśayeccaiva nānyathā viṣṇvāhvākumudaśyāmapadmareṇusugarbhitā mātaṅgīmanunā japtā netrāktā rañjanī nṛṇām saviṣṇudayitālakṣmīrbhṛṅgarājodbhavaṃ rajaḥ maṣīpūrvaṃ phaladā nātra saṃśayaḥ vaśayatyeṣāmaṣī tatsambhavā bhṛśam nīraiśca tantubhirveṣṭayetphalam ābhaumavārasaṃjaptaṃ karpūraṃ tatphalaṃ tataḥ sasūrakamitā etāḥ khāditā vaśyadāḥ param nareśāya sa vaśyo nātra saṃśayaḥ sampravakṣyāmi dvātriṃśadvarṇakaṃ manum

śrīmātaṅgi tatheśvari munirasyoktonuṣṭupcchandaśca devatā || ṣaḍaṣṭabāhubhiśceti dhyāyecchyāmāṃ sulocanām vādayantīṃ tāṃ mātaṅgīṃ hṛdi bhāvayet yajetpīṭhe vakṣyamāṇavidhānataḥ yajettasminpīṭhaśaktīrnaveṣṭadāḥ tāramāyāvāgramādyaḥ pīṭhamantraḥ kalārṇakaḥ pīṭhapūjānte kuryādāvaraṇārcanam ṣaḍaṃgāni mātṝśca dalamadhyagāḥ vāmākhyā jyeṣṭhā raudrī praśāntikā sṛṣṭimohinyau prathamācāriṇī tathā ṣoḍaśī tu pūjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ mahālakṣmīḥ punarvahnyādikoṇataḥ sarvāvaraṇaśaktīnāṃ ṅentaṃ nāma hṛdaṃtakam pūjanīyāssyuritthaṃ siddhirmanorbhavet phalairvā vaśyā syājjanatā brahmavṛkṣajaiḥ lavaṇairvidyāttagarairvetasairjalam niśācūrṇayutaiḥ kāśairhomātsyātstambhanaṃ dviṣām gandhāṣṭakamudīritam etatpiṣṭvāyutaṃ japtvā tilakena jagatpriyaḥ mātaṅgī pūjitā kāmadā nṛṇām hūyādaṣṭottaraśataṃ khādirāgnau naro niśi kṛṣṇabhūtaniśi dhvāṃkṣodare kṣiptvā śubhaprabhām tadvahniṃ yasmai dadyātsa dāsavat munidevyādisevyānāṃ kāśyāṃ saṅkhyā na vidyate

svabījākhyairvarṇalakṣajapasteṣāmudāhṛtaḥ prakartavyo madhuratrayasaṃyutaiḥ baṭukā devatāstāḥ phalapradāḥ vadeddhastipiśācīti liḥliḥsvāhā navākṣaraḥ proktassarvasampatpradāyakaḥ proktaḥ kāmyakarmāṇyatha bruve sādhyāṃguṣṭhapramāṇāṃ ca gaṇeśasya mahātmanaḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ caiva caturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe ca mantravit vaśamāyāti sādhakasya na saṃśayaḥ tatpatraṃ hastakṛṣṭiriyaṃ matā smṛtvā japenmantraṃ sarvalokaṃ vaśaṃ nayet rājapatnīṃ vā karṣayettatkṣaṇātsudhīḥ dadyādiṣṭāya nānyathā śrīkhaṇḍadhūpadānena rājānaṃ vaśamānayet śatruṃ sa uccāṭayati nānyathā śmaśānāgnau tu juhuyādvidveṣaḥ snigdhayorbhavet kuryātsarvāvayavaśobhitām prāṇapratiṣṭhāntu viṣaraktāḍhyapātrake sandeho devatābhiḥ surakṣitaḥ rocanākuṃkumābhaṃ ca bhūrje nāma samālikhet samyaksneho bhavati tatkṣaṇāt prayogāśca varṇalakṣamito japaḥ ca samuccārya hrīṃ huṃgheṃgheṃ tathā ca phaṭ trinetrāmitamanurbhavati ||] hastimukhadadamātraṃ yadoccaret munyādidevatocchiṣṭagaṇanāthaḥ prakīrtitaḥ

athānyatsampravakṣyāmi mantraṃ ṣaḍviṃśavarṇakam tathocchiṣṭamahātmane ca pūjanam hastipiśāci likhetsvāheti mantrakaḥ puraścaryārkalakṣāsyātprayogādi ca pūrvavat sarvamasya daśārṇavat ekonaviṃśavarṇaḥ syāttadā mantraḥ susiddhikṛt syātṣaḍaṅgakam hastimukheti ca ṅentaṃ lambodaraṃ vadet haṃ ghedvayaṃ cāpi ucchiṣṭāyāgnigehinī ucchiṣṭagaṇanāthasya mantreṣveṣu na śodhanam sadā gopyā na prakāśyā itastataḥ nirdhanatvaṃ vaṃśacchedonyathā bhavet sadā gopyā viśeṣādvedakarmaṇaḥ vatrayaṃ binduvisargābhyāṃ ca saṃyutam tiṣṭhati mantroyaṃ na sa vighnaistu bādhyate raktālaṅkārasaṃyuktāṃ guṇahāravirājitām baliṃ dattvā japettadgatamānasaḥ japato hyasya jāyante sarvasiddhayaḥ pūjayenmaṇḍalaṃ devyā mūlamantreṇa mantravit rājā bhavati vaśyagaḥ vidyāṃ śastraśāstravaśīkṛtām vidhānena bhavanti dhanasiddhayaḥ māsāttasya bhavantyeva siddhā vidyāścaturdaśa mahādevi trailokyaṃ vaśamānayet

siddhayoṣṭau bhavanti ca bhavadākarṣaṇaṃ dhurvam vidyāvittavarānāḥ kokilākākapakṣaiśca homācchatrūnvināśayet vidhānena citākāṣṭhahutāśane śatrūnvidveṣayeddveṣṭā cānyonyakalahākulān vidhānena kuryāddhorma samāhitaḥ putraṃ cirañjīvinamuttamam prayogeṇa bhavedākarṣaṇaṃ dhruvam kāmārttā balādāliṅgayanti tam mahāvidyāṃ śāstraughadaśaśālinīm vidyāvāndhanavānvāpi sarvaśāstravaśaṃkaraḥ mantramucchiṣṭena japetsadā devī pratyakṣā bhavati dhruvam kartavyā kāyena ca dhanena ca viṣṇuprārthanayā sarvatantreṣu gopitam paśavopyasurāścāpi bhakṣyaṃ pānaṃ ca maithunam hi bādhante mamānandavanemutaḥ tatkathaṃ manujāḥ śreṣṭhāstra tvāṃ prabravīmi ca nṛdehāttadbhavedyasmāttasmācchreṣṭhā narā matāḥ yāvatpuṇyaṃ vaseddivi dīkṣyate sa sabhāntare japecca bahujīvati niṣkāmā sakāmā bhavabījakam vāmaṃ vijānāti sa eva paramo guruḥ

vaśiṣṭhādyāḥ śakrādyāḥ pādasammitam jānaṃti koṭayaścātra jāyaṃte kṛmiyoniṣu prakurute trailokyakaraṇakṣamaḥ bhakṣayate yastu sa siddhīnāṃ patirbhavet cārthatritayaṃ sāttviko rājasastathā vijānanti te muktā nātra saṃśayaḥ cintayatā dṛṣṭassamuniśca nirūpitaḥ vāmamārgī bhuktimuktyoḥ sa bhājanam yaḥ pāpī viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ || 84 ||| caikantu śrīkṛṣṇāya tathā param vṛṣṇikādyāśca vāmamārgeṇa mocitāḥ lokeṣu sandāya devaloke praveśitāḥ saṃsāre cānyeṣāṃ tu kathāsti kā tāntu jīvaṃ tasyaipradarśayet śiraścandrāmṛtaṃ tasyāmukhaṃ yātyetadīritam punaḥ pītvā deho bhavati kāṣṭhavat sādhakaḥ syānmaheśvaraḥ vyahaṅkārastu karmataḥ duḥkhaṃ bhavati jñānināṃ dehatāḍane vṛddhistathāsya dehasya vyāpāraḥ sampravarttate candrasurāmattaḥ kāmādyairnānubhūyate surataṃ nāma kīrtitam yatsaukhyaṃ tasmātkuṭiguṇaṃ tu tat proktamanyatsyādrāsabhaṃ ratam matsyabhakṣaṇamityuktaṃ muktimārganidarśakaiḥ

dhāraṇādhyānasamādhyākhyāstu mokṣadāḥ jīvo dehapāśena badhyate ajñānanāśājjñānasyodayānmokṣaḥ prajāyate vāmamārgeṇa mokṣo bhavati sarvathā yattallabhate hīti śāstreṣu niścayaḥ bhūtānāṃ nivṛttiśca mahāphalā spṛśenmadyaṃ vaidike vartmani sthitaḥ niṣevitam samutpannaṃ tena madyaṃ viṣāyate kuladvayaviśuddhena vaidikenaiva vartmanā syātpretya rākṣasatāṃ vrajet kiñcitsukhaṃ prāpya pretya lakṣādhipo bhavet mādhvī ca surā ityabhidhīyate punaḥ stanyaṃ na pibetsa payo naraḥ jātastasyoddhāro mayocyate nānyaviprasya kutracit devatāñcintayecchaktiṃ tāṃ pumānsvayameva hi prāṇasyāyamanādvāpi bheṣajānmantratastathā taddaśāṃśena skhalanaṃ homa eva tat ratānmārjanañca etadaṣṭadinaiścaret kṛte vidhāne ca devatā varadā bhavet trirātrantimibhistṛptiḥ śṛṃgyā vāpi dinadvayam supakvasya grāhyaṃ bhāgacatuṣṭayam tathā yogyaṃ surayā marditaṃ dṛḍham tacchaktimudreyamīritā

māṣāḍhakīmasūraiśca caṇakānnaiḥ samanvitam kaṭutailena pakvāḥ syānmudrikā parā vā madyamāsavaṃ vā na cetarat jale sthāpyaṃ yāvadamlaṃ prajāyate mudrā śaktīnāmatitṛptidā dakṣamārgasthaśaktīnāṃ mudrikāḥ parikīrtitāḥ harimanthānaṃ dvidalena ca melayet dattvā maricāni ca patrajam vāmamārgagaṇeśānāṃ mudrā paramatoṣakṛt samyakpiṣṭvā nibaddhaṃ ca dadhi dattvā viloḍitam elādikasugandhaiścoddhūlikā mudrikā matā bhānukiraṇairājye pakvasya ṣaḍguṇe priyā toṣakarī sadā tena tulyaṃ caṇakacūrṇakam mudrikā ceyaṃ gaṇeśānāṃ priyaṃkarā gaṇeśasya prītidā mudrikā matā jñeyaṃ tryahaṃ kālīyakasya tu khādyamāṃsaṃ daivatāyai samyaktacca nivedayet keśarahimarocanābhiḥ samālikhet ṣaṇmāsapūjanāttasya tvaritaṃ siddhimāpnuyāt taruṇyāstu nīrogāyā rajo matam nikṣipya gharṣitaṃ raktacandanam surayā ghṛtaraktakacandanaiḥ prakāśesti vāmamārge surottamāḥ bhakṣayennātra saṃśayaḥ

kartavyo vāmamārgaḥ kṣayāvahaḥ bhagaḥ śaktirgāṃgaṃ vāri jalaṃ matam buddhirnocennirayamāpnuyāt pāpakṣayārthaṃ gamanāya ca hana hanāmyaham pūrvajanmani yairvāmibhiḥ kṛtaṃ yadupāsanam tyaktvā prāṇānyāṃti surālayam kaṭhoraṃ vāpriyaṃ naiva susaṃvadet tāśca bhoktavyā eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ cāṇḍālīnāmapi strīṇāṃ sparśadoṣaṃ na mānayet surayā homastatpratyakṣaṃ samācaret gṛhāṇeti manobhīṣṭantu yorcayet tiṣṭhanti devatāḥ tīrthayātrāṃ na kurvīta gaṅgāsnānaṃ na cācaret kṛtvā japansiddhimavāpnuyāt siddhiranyathā pretavadbhavet pravakṣyāmi sūkṣmasādhanamadbhutam kṛtvā gacchedaśvatthabhūmikām devatāyāḥ samācaret kuryāccairaṇḍatailenābhāve kāpilahavyakaiḥ kuryādaṣṭaśatasūtrāṇāṃ vartikā matā dṛṣṭvā japenmantraṃ nānyatastu vilokayet bhinnaśabdāḥ sādhakaṃ bhīṣayanti te nānyadṛṣtiḥ prapaśyeddīpameva hi balindattvā stutvā saṃyācayedvaram

grāhyaṃ tatra devīṃ prapūjya ca dattvākṣṇoḥ kajjalaṃ tacca prayogānācarettataḥ samyaṅnocedbhavati bhairavaḥ vaktavyaṃ kimataḥ param sarahasyā mahāmantrāḥ kalau siddhipradāyakāḥ brūhi tasya ca ke mantrāḥ keṣvāmnāyeṣu kīrtitāḥ yathāyaṃ pāvanaṃ vipraṃ svayameva karaiḥ spṛśet caturyugeṣu pratyakṣo devoyaṃ sarvasammataḥ tasya mantrānpravakṣyāmi sāvadhānā bhavāmbike devabhāgo muniśchando gāyatrī devatā raviḥ hṛnmantraḥ [satyatejojvālāmaṇe huṃ phaṭ svāhā hṛdayāya namaḥ || ] satyapūrvoyaṃ brahmapūrva [ brahmatejojvālāmaṇe huṃphaṭ svāhā śirase svāhā || ] śiromanuḥ p. 486) agnipūrvo [agnitejojvālāmaṇe huṃphaṭ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ] netramanurastraṃ [sarvatejovālāmaṇe huṃphaṭsvāhā astrāya phaṭ | iti ṣaḍaṅgaṃ vidhāya mūrtinyāsaṃ vidadhīta sa yathā || ] sarvapadairbhavet mastakānanahṛdguhyapādadeśeṣu deśikaḥ sūryyastataśca mantrārṇānpraṇavādyānnyasedbudhaḥ [atha mantrākṣaranyāsaḥ oṃ ghṛśīrṣaṇi, oṃ ṇiḥ mukhe, oṃ sū kaṇṭhe, oṃ ryyaḥ hṛdaye, oṃ ākukṣau, oṃ di liṅge, oṃ tyaḥ pādayoḥ, itthaṃ nyāsānkṛtvā dhyāyet || ] padme caiva samāsīnaṃ varakeyūrabhūṣaṇam pūjayitvā yogapīṭhantatpīṭhe cārcayedravim īśānānmadhyaparyyantaṃ samārādhyaṃ prabhūtakam tadbāhyeṣṭadalaṃ kṛtvā dalamūleṣu cārcayet bhadrā vibhūtirvimalā hyamoghā vidyutā tathā āsāṃ bījāni rāṃrīṃrūṃraiṃroṃrauṃtu krameṇa ca saurāya yogapīṭhāya hṛdantoṣṭādaśākṣaraḥ mūrtti ca kalpayāmīti cokttvā mūrti prakalpayet tadbāhyeṣṭadalaṃ kṛtvā digdaleṣu yajedimān ādyārṇabījā hṛnṅentā vidikpatre yajedimāḥ sūryyasyāgreruṇaḥ pūjyopyatha vidhvādayo grahāḥ

tadastrāṇi ca tadbāhye bhāskarārcanamīritam juhuyāttatsahasrāṇi dugdhāktaiḥ sādhakottamaḥ svābhiṣekaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā brāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥ raktāmbaradharo raktamālyo raktānulepanaḥ bhikṣāhārastathā vītasaṅgaḥ santoṣavānsadā rathamabhyarcya bhāsvantañcārghyaṃ tasmai nivedayet agre maṇḍalamālikhya yajetpīṭhaṃ yathāvidhi ramyaṃ prasthajalagrāhi mūlamantraṃ samuccaret rocanāṃ rājikāṃ raktacandanaṃ vaṃśataṇḍulān sañcintya devatātmaikyaṃ bhāskaraṃ samyagarcayet samyagaṣṭottaraśataṃ bhūyaḥ puṣpādibhiryajet dṛṣṭiṃ nidhāya vyomnyarkaṃ sāṅgaṃ sāvaraṇaṃ smaret arghyaṃ prasannacetāḥ sandadyācca sumanoñjalim arghādikaṃ samādatte japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam anena tu prayogeṇa bhavedāyurnirugṇatā tanmantrasahitāmbhobhiḥ saptadhāñjalisecanam sthaṇḍile sthāpayetkumbhaṃ tīrthodakasupūritam devaṃ saparivārantu prāguktavidhinā tataḥ pacettenaiva juhuyādravyājyasahitena ca ṛtusnātāṃ suniyatāṃ pūrvāṅgasamupoṣitām abhiṣiñcetkumbhajalairdadyāttasyai tu mantravit naropi sūryya evāhamiti dhyātvā tayā saha atha mantrāntaraṃ vakṣye dineśasya ṣaḍakṣaram munirbrahmā ca gāyatraṃ chandaḥ savitṛdaivatam sūkṣmākārāyāgnivadhūriti mantreṇa śīrṣakam

sūkṣmākārāya huṃphaḍityevaṃ śastraṃ prakīrttitam raktapadmadvayaṃ hastairbibhratañca varābhaye pūrvokte pūjayet pīṭhe devamāvāhya mantravit juhuyāttaddaśāṃśena bilvairatha palāśajaiḥ udumbarasamudbhūtaistrimadhvaktaiḥ samidvaraiḥ arghādikaṃ ca kurvīta pūrvavadvāñchitāptaye na bhāskarasamaḥ kaścidbhuktimuktipradāyakaḥ nyāso dhyānaṃ ca pūjā ca prāgvadeva samīritā bhavettannyāsapūjādi dhyānādyaṅgaṃ ṣaḍarṇavat tanno raviḥ pracodayāt bhagnatrānāṃ rājaputrāṇāṃ kṣatratejovidhāyinī parastrībhiryaccharīraṃ puraścaryyācatuṣṭayam sārvabhaumatvamāpnoti brāhmaṇānpratipālayet ṛṣirbrahmā ca gāyatrī chandaḥ sūryyaśca devatā dedīpyamānaratnaughamukuṭena virājitam navaśaktisamāyukte pīṭhe pūrvodite yajet sampūjya tasyāva raṇānyarcayetkramataḥ sudhīḥ mahocchuṣmā pañcamī ca madhyātpūrvādike yajet keturvidikṣu pūjyāśca caturthāvaraṇaṃ raveḥ ṅentaṃ hṛdantaṃ kheṭasya nāmapūjāmanurmataḥ catulakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ juhuyāttaddaśāṃśataḥ || brahmavṛkṣasamadbhūtaiḥ puṣpaistrimadhuraplutaiḥ evaṃ sādhitamantrastu kāmyakarmmāṇi sādhayet dadyādarghadvayamapi bhavettasyoditaṃ phalam tryakṣarosya tu hrāṃhrīṃsaḥ proktaḥ sarvārthadāyakaḥ devatāsya manoḥ proktaḥ savitā surapūjitaḥ

mūrdhādikaṇṭhaparyyantaṃ mantrārṇānvinyasetsudhīḥ sthitaḥ padmeruṇe tryakṣoruṇavarṇasubhūṣaṇaḥ pūrvodite yajetpīṭhe navaśaktisamanvite dikpālaiśca tṛtīyaṃ syāccaturthantu tadāyudhaiḥ ghṛtāktamadhurāktaiśca yavānnaiścaiva tādṛśaiḥ [ghṛtamadhvaktairyavaiḥ || ] dadyātpūrvoditaṃ cārghyaṃ dineśāya susādhakaḥ karoti ratnavastrādibhūṣaṇāni vivardhayet patramadhye karṇikāyāṃ tāṃśca toyena pūrayet prajapyānyeṣu tanmantrāñchatakṛtvo japetsudhīḥ mucyate nātra sandehaḥ sādhako grahadoṣataḥ grahahomaḥ prakarttavyo grahāṇāṃ vai kṛte tathā vigrahādau bhaye cāpi ghorarūpe mahāgade svadikṣu cāgnīnsaṃsthāpya juhuyācca samidvaraiḥ śamīdūrvākuśodbhūtaiḥ kramāddhomaḥ samīritaḥ ante cānyavyāhṛtibhirhutvā homaṃ samāpayet dadyācca bhojayedviprānsaṃgrāme vijayī bhavet kṛtyādrohārikāṇāñca śāntirevāśu jāyate athānyatsampravakṣyāmi saṃgrāmavijayābhidham sarvaṃ pūjādikañcāsya śreyojanakamantravat brahmā muniḥ samuddiṣṭo gāyatraṃ chanda ucyate ṣaḍdīrgheṇa sakāreṇa haṃpūrveṇa ṣaḍaṅgakam karairdadhānaṃ padmasthaṃ haraṃ gauryyaṅkagambhaje tatra devaṃ yajenmūrtiṃ mūlenākalpya mantravit ṛtuṃ vasuṃ narañcāpi parañca vidiśāsu ca tato lokeśvarāṃścāpi tadagre cāyudhānyapi

pūrvoditena vidhinā sūryyāyārghaṃ nivedayet sūryyāṣṭagandhairatha vā candanābhyāṃ manuntvimam tīrthādijalasampūrṇantasyordhvaṃ sthāpayetkaram japetsudhāmayantañca kalaśaṃ hṛdi bhāvayet gatarogo dīrghajīvī vipadbādhāparicyutaḥ ādau tena vidhātavyaḥ kareṇa karakaḥ śubhaḥ viṣiṇaṃ nirviṣo bhūyātsthāvarājjaṅgamādapi vinyasyeddaṃśino mūrdhni mantrayitvā viṣaṃ haret plutañcāmṛtadhārābhirbhāvayitvā manuñjapet apasmṛtintridoṣotthānrogānhanyānna saṃśayaḥ sañcintya prajapennityaṃ kṣepayetpalitañjarām dvitīyañcandradhārābhirmārjjayettena mantravit hakāro rephasaṃyuktaḥ pakāreṇa samanvitaḥ binduyuktaṃ kūṭamuktaṃ mārtaṇḍasya trivarṇakam vāmamārgeṇa bhajatāmādeśyaṃ kimidaṃ budhaiḥ devatoktotha haṃbījaṃ binduḥ śaktiḥ prakīrttitā ravirdivākaraścāpi nyastavyā hyaṃgulīṣu tāḥ śirovadanahṛdguhyapādadeśeṣu tā nyaset vyāpakaṃ mūlabījena kurvīta tadanantaram mukhemukhe trinayanaṃ maṇivanmukuṭānvitam akṣamālāṃ kapālaṃ ca dadhataṃ karapaṃkajaiḥ padmasthitaṃ hāsyamukhaṃ mārtaṇḍaṃ dyumaṇiṃ bhaje ādāvaṃgāni sampūjya karṇikāyāmuṣādikāḥ netramīśānakoṇe ca tadbāhye khecarānapi daśāṃśaṃ kamalaiḥ phullairjuhuyānmadhurokṣitaiḥ

caturaṃgulasaṃbhūteḥ sumanobhiḥ śriyaṃ labhet juhuyānmātuluṃgaiśca labhaterthaṃ suvāṃchitam putro lakṣmīśca saubhāgyaṃ sarvadā vijayo bhavet śrīṃ mantroyaṃ daśārṇastupañcāmnāyeṣu kīrttitaḥ duṣṭagrahāstu saumyāḥ syū rājamānyaḥ sajāyate bhāskaraḥ sarvatulyastu sarvoṣāṃ phaladāyakaḥ ityetattubhyamākhyātaṃ kiṃ vācyamatha tadvada iti śrīmahāmāyāmahākālānumate merutantre śivapraṇīte sūryyamantraprakāśa ekaviśaḥ śrotumicchāmi ca manūnsaprayogāṃśca tānvada kālena kathitaṃ mahyaṃ tanmayā kīrtyatedhunā tattvato naiva jānanti kimpunaḥ śaktito janāḥ tathā mama grahā rūpaṃ tava māyeti kīrttitam p. 493) tuṣṭaṃ bhavati ruṣṭeṣu śatrutvamupajāyate na tu grahakṛtaṃ duḥkhaṃ saukhyaṃ mithyāprajāyate sadīrghanijabījena [āṃsauṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ, īṃsauṃ śirase svāhā, ūṃsauṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ, aiṃsauṃ kavacāyahum auṃ sauṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ, aḥ sauṃ astrāya phaṭ imaṃ nyāsaṃ kṛtvā cāṃ cīṃ cūṃ caiṃ cauṃ caḥ ebhiḥ ṣaḍakṣarairaṅguṣṭhādi nyāsaṃ hṛadayādinyāsaṃ ca vidadhīta sa yathā - cāṃ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ, cīṃ tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ, cūṃ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ, caiṃ anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ, cauṃ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ, caḥ karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | cāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ, cīṃ śirase svāhā, ityādi || ] ṣaḍaṃgāni samācaret dadhānaṃ bhāvayedevaṃ mṛgāṃkaṃ maṇimaulikam candramaṇḍalaparyyaṃtaṃ tataḥ sampūjayedvidhum āpyāyinī candrikā ca hlādinī nava śaktayaḥ citrā ca kṛttikā kāntiḥ śravaṇā pīṭhaśaktayaḥ anena pīṭhaṃ sampūjya nāmamantraiśca śaktayaḥ rātrirārdrā tathā jyotsnā kalā dhyānamathocyate muktāhārālaṃkṛtāṃgyaḥ pāṇyañjalipuṭāḥ śubhāḥ prasannacandravadanāḥ phullendīvaralocanāḥ vajrādīni tato bāhyepyevaṃ pūjā samīritā tataḥ siddho bhavenmantraḥ prayogānācarettataḥ

p. 494) trisahasraṃ tena labhate rājyaiśvaryyamakiñcanaḥ dharāgataṃ nidhānaṃ sa dhruvaṃ prāpnoti tatkṣaṇāt ayutaṃ prajapenmantraṃ yacchāṃtiracirādbhavet saubhāgyārogyasampattibhājanaṃ manujo bhavet lipte bhūmaṇḍale kṛtvā niṣīdetpaścime tataḥ agrasthamaṇḍale padmasaṃyute pūrvavadyajet śuddhagopayasā mantrī spṛśanpātraṃ manuṃ japet kāntiṃ yathepsitāṃ kanyāṃ satkīrtiṃ labhate dhruvas mukhi śirontastārādyo vidyāmanurayaṃ smṛtaḥ somaḥ śrīśchanda uddiṣṭamekatattvo munirmataḥ bījenaiva ṣaḍaṅgāni dhyānapūjādipūrvavat amṛtaṃ nissṛtaṃ tena plāvitaṃ sakalaṃ vapuḥ samastaviṣarogādyakālamṛtyuvināśanam pāpakṣayāyurvṛddhī ca valīpalitanāśanam daśākṣaraścandramantro japyaścāgre dayāyutaiḥ ete proktāścandramantrā sarvakalyāṇadāyakāḥ aṃ ca aṅgārako ṅento hṛdantaścāṣṭavarṇakaḥ aṅgaṣaṭkantvasya manorādi [amiti bījena ṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ || ] bījena sammatam jānusthavāmahastāḍhyaṃbhājanetarapāṇikam lakṣāṣṭako japaḥ proktaḥ khādirairindhanairhunet anugrahāttasya lokastvanṛṇī vyādhivicyutaḥ daśākṣaro manuḥ prokto virūpākṣo munirmataḥ hrīṃbījaṃ śrīśca śaktiḥ syātkīlakaṃ klīṃ prakīrttitam ṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena aṃgulyādiṣaḍaṅgakam liṃge gude ca mantrasya daśavarṇānkramānnyaset

sthirāsano mahākāyaḥ sarvakarmmāvarodhakaḥ dharātmajaḥ kujo bhaumo bhūmido bhūminandanaḥ vṛṣṭikarttāpahartā ca sarvakarmmaphalapradaḥ mukhe ca cibuke kaṇṭhe skandhayorbhujayostathā jānvośca jaṅghayoraṃghryoḥ kramānnāmāni vinyaset tato dhyāyedraktavarṇaṃ raktamālyāṃśukāvṛtam maṃgalānāṃ maṃgalañca sarvakāmaphalapradam japāprasūnaiḥ purubhirmadhuratritayānvitaiḥ vidhinā bhūmitanayaṃ sarvāṃbhīṣṭaphalapradam ekaviṃśatikoṣṭheṣu tato cāṣṭau grahānnyaset māheśvarī ca cāmuṇḍā kaumārī cāparājitā pūjyā vidhānataḥ sarve mantriṇaibhirmanūttamaiḥ kapālinaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ ca tathā saṃhārabhairavam evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī prayogānkartumarhati svāgato vāmapādena pravrajyāṣṭottaraṃ śatam brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayedekaṃ guḍapracuravastubhiḥ labhate mahatīṃ lakṣmīṃ vatsareṇa na saṃśayaḥ juhuyāttarppayenmantrī prāpnuyānnijavāñchitam tatastṛtīyarekhhantu cihnābhyāṃ lāñchayettataḥ dvitīyāgre samākṛṣya tṛtīyāṃcihnayornyaset turyyā cihnadvayenātha tribhiścihnaiśca pañcamī turyyāgre yojayetsamyakpañcamyāścihnayordvayoḥ evamekādhikā samyakkoṣṭhānāṃ viṃśatirbhavet maṅgalādyāṃstārapūrvānnamontānekaviṃśatim atha mantrāntaraṃvakṣye bhāmajasya mahādbhutam

ṅentaṃ hṛdantaṃ rudrārṇaiḥ prokto bhaumapriyo manuḥ bhagavandevadeveśa ehyehi tvaṃmahāprabho raktagandhādivastraiśca naivedyaṃ ca guḍodanam godhūmacūrṇajāstatra sthāpayitvā prabhakṣayet bhaumastotrapurāṇādicarcayā tu dinaṃ nayet yācanīyaṃ yogyavastu satvarañca prayacchati oṃhāṃhaṃsaḥ khaṃkha iti mantraḥ proktaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ ṣaḍbhirvarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni manoḥ kurvīta sādhakaḥ meṣasaṃsthaṃ raktavastraṃ taṃ vandehaṃ dharātmajam śaivapīṭhe yajedbhaumaṃ prāgaṅgāni tu pūjayet itthaṃ susiddhaṃ mantreśaṃ sveṣṭasiddhyai prayojayet labhate nātra sandehaḥ putraṃ sarvaguṇānvitam dantāndhāveddvedamārgasamidhā maunasevitā vidhijñaṃ vipramāhūya bhaumamarcettadājñayā maṅgalādīni nāmāni svapratīkeṣu vinyaset vāmabāhau dakṣabāhau gale ca vadane nasoḥ bāhudvayetha mūrddhādipādaparyyantavigrahe evaṃ nyastaśarīrosau dhyāyeddharaṇinandanam ekaviṃśatikoṣṭhāḍhye trikoṇe tāmrapātrake aṅgāni pūjayetprāgvadekaviṃśatikoṣṭhataḥ brāhmyādyā mātṛkā bāhye śakrādīnāyudhānyapi phalaṃ nidhāya mantrābhyāṃ bhaumāyārghyaṃ nivedayet sutārthinī tvāṃ prapannā gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namostu te pradakṣiṇā vidhātavyā tāvadbhirnagapātmaje vāmapādena mantrābhyāmetābhyāṃ tatpramārjayet

kṛtarekhātrayaṃ vāmapādenaiva pramārjmyaham mārjayāmyasitā rekhāstisro janmatrayodbhavāḥ dhyāyantī caraṇāmbhojaṃ pūjāsāṅgatvasiddhaye kumāraṃ śaktihastaṃ ca maṅgalaṃ praṇamāmyaham namo vidyotamānāya sarvakalyāṇakāriṇe sukhaṃ yānti yatastasmai namo dharaṇisūnave pūjitaḥ sukhasaubhāgye tasmai kṣmāsūnave namaḥ meṣavāhana rudrātmanputraṃ dehi dhanaṃ yaśaḥ gurave dakṣiṇāndattvā bhuñjītānnaṃ niveditam tilairvidhāya homaṃ ca śatārdhaṃ bhojayeddvijān maṇḍalasthe ghaṭebhyarcya sutasaubhāgyasiddhaye tanno bhaumaḥ pracodayāt etasyāstu japādeva prasīdati dharāsutaḥ daśākṣaro bhaumamantro japyaścāyaṃ navāyutam buṃ ṅento budhaśabdaśca hṛdayāntaḥ ṣaḍarṇakaḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni svabījena vinyasyaivaṃ vicintayet jānusthavāmahastābjaṃ sābhayetarapāṇikam arcanaṃ tvaṅgakheṭāśāpatibhistryāvṛtaṃ smṛtam daśākṣaraḥ saumyamantro japo lakṣaikasaṅkhyayā vahnistrīviśvavarṇoyaṃ japyaḥ pañcadaśāyutam chandonuṣṭummunirbrahmā devaḥ prokto bṛhaspatiḥ suvarṇābhaṃ pītavastraṃ ratnasvarṇāmbarādikam spṛśantaṃ samyagaparaṃ vṛṣaṇau kanakādikam japitvāśītisāhasraṃ hutvā tena ghṛtena vā siddhe manau prakurvīta prayogāniṣṭasiddhaye

saptaviṃśacchatānmantrī vāsāṃsi labhate maṇīn juhuyātpippalotthābhissamidbhistannivṛttaye vastraṃ [vastraṃ me dehi śuṃ śukrāya namaḥ | iti ekādaśākṣaro mantraḥ |] me dehi śukrāya hṛdayāntaḥ śumādikaḥ brahmā munirdevatā tu śukro daityātipūjitaḥ śukraṃ namāmyāsanasthaṃ muktābharaṇabhūṣitam aṅgagrahāśeśaheticaturāvaraṇaṃ [aṅgagrahadikpālatadāyudhairmantrasya caturāvaraṇapūjanam |] manoḥ bhavanti mantramāhātmyānnaśyante ca kṣa yādayaḥ aṅgendrādyāyudhaiḥ pūjā trirāvṛtyāsya kīrttitā etanmantropāsakānā prabhutvamupajāyate daśākṣaraḥ śukramantro japyoyaṃ dvādaśāyutam bhūpaiḥ kṛtā vinaśyanti strīsaukhyamupajāyate ṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret vāmajānusthitaṃ vāmakaraṃ dakṣe varaṃ dadhat śanaiścarasya bhaktānāmāpado na daridratā ṅentaṃ svāhā dvādaśārṇo japaḥ prayutasammitaḥ klībānatrānayetyuktaṃ sādhakosya prabhāvataḥ munyādyā brahmagāyatrīrāhavaḥ parikīrttitāḥ vikṛtāsyaṃ raktanetraṃ dhūmrālaṅkāramanvaham rāhorupāsako bhūpaḥ saṃgrāme vijayī bhavet daśākṣaro rāhumantro japyaścāyaṃ daśāyutam kaṃ ketave hṛdityevaṃ ketumantraḥ ṣaḍarṇakaḥ kaṃ bījaṃ ketuśaktiśca bījenaiva ṣaḍaṃgakam vāmorunyastasaddhastaṃ sābhayetarapāṇikam atra tu grahapūjāyāṃ pūjyaṃ madhye niveśayet oṃ prāṃprīṃprauṃ sabinduḥ saketave vahnigehinī

daśākṣaraḥ ketumantro japtoyaṃ dvādaśāyutam upāsakānāmetasya ketavogre calanti hi grahamātari ruṣṭāyāṃ sugrahaiḥ kiṃ prayojanam ulkā siddhā saṃkaṭā ca vikaṭāgarbhapālikā phalaṃ nāmani rūpaṃ syādekopacayatā dvayoḥ tuṣṭā cecchatruvargasya ruṣṭā kuryyāttu sādhake dīrghaṣaṭkayujā [kṣāṃ kṣīṃ kṣūṃ kṣaiṃ kṣauṃ kṣaḥ | ebhirakṣaraiḥ ṣaḍaṃganyāsaṃ caret || ] pūrvabījenaiva ṣaḍaṃgakam hastābhyāṃ dadhatīṃ padmayugalaṃ tāṃ bhajāmyaham japāpuṣpāṇi śastāni dhūpo guggulasambhavaḥ alaṃkārastathā raktāstathā vastrāṇi candanam tarppayetparameśānīṃ tattanmantraiḥ sahasradhā kṛtvā yantraṃ yathoktantu yoginīṃ tatra pūjayet saptāhena prajāyeta trividhotpātavāraṇam atha vā sthaṇḍile śuddhe sulipte gomayāmbubhiḥ anyāsāṃ daśavārāṃstu viruddhāyāḥ sahasradhā sahasramayutaṃ vāpi lakṣaṃ vā kāmanākramāt icchāṃ jñānaṃ kriyāśaktiṃ triṣu koṇeṣu pūjayet tadbāhye bhūpure lokapālānastrāṇi pūjayet viśeṣaḥ punaratrāsti śatrūcchedābhicārakaiḥ garuḍāsanamāsīnāṃ vairinigrahakariṇīm sarvaśatruvināśaḥ syādduḥkhaṃ nāpnoti kutracit māyādyo [hrīṃ maṃgale maṃgalālayai svāhā || ] vahnijāyānto maṅgale maṅgalālaye kṛtvādyena ṣaḍaṅgāni dīrghaṣaṭkayujā tathā darasmeramukhāmbhojāṃ sindūrasundarādharām suguñjanmañjumañjīrāṃ kāñcīguṇavirājitām

tato lakṣaṃ manuṃ japtvā tāramāyāpuraḥsaram sarvāsāmeva pūjānte maṅgalaivaṃ prasīdati duryoginyanukūlārthaṃ japettatsaṅkhyakāyutam prāptaye prajapettāvatsahasrantu manuṃ sudhīḥ tuṣṭāyā varṇaśatakai rogiṇaṃ cābhimantrayet tasyāḥ pīḍāni vṛttiḥ syādvarṇābhyantargatairjapaiḥ yoginī tulyaphaladā vāme mārge ca dakṣiṇe bhrāmaya klīṃ ṣaḍdaśārṇo mantrosyāḥ parikīrtitaḥ mantrayitvā tathā mārge daśadikṣu ca santyajet śulkino duṣṭabhūpāśca nityamevaṃ samācaret yojanaikaṃ japanmantraṃ sa bhramecca vasundharām blaṃ bījaṃ toyabhṛyogājjātamādau samuccaret punaśca parabhadrāṇi nāśayadvitayaṃ tataḥ ṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena [blāṃ, blīṃ, blūṃ, blaiṃ, blauṃ, blaḥ, ebhiḥ ṣaḍakṣaraiḥ ṣaḍaṃganyāsaṃ caret | yathā blāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ, blīṃ śirase svāhā ityādi || ] ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ piṅgalāvatsamuddiṣṭaṃ japādyaṃ proktavartmanā śrīṃ [śrīṃ dhanade dhānye svāhā iti mantraḥ || ] dhanade samuccāryya dhānye svāhāṣṭavarṇakaḥ nāsti dhānyāsamākācidiha loke dhanapradā dahettu dhānyā dadate dhanyatvaṃ sādhakāya ca puraścaryyāṃ tatra kṛtvā yaśodhanyaḥ prajāyate hrīṃ [hrīṃ siddhide sarvaṃ mama sādhayasādhaya namaḥ || ] siddhide sarvaṃ mama samuktvā sādhayadvayam nāsti siddhopāsakānāṃ karmmāsiddhistu kutracit sidhyet ṣaṭkarmma martyasya manorārādhanaṃ vinā mantraḥ proktaḥ prajaptoyaṃ dhanārogyaprado mataḥ sarvarogāpaho mantro mārjanātsaṃprapadyate śītalāyā mahāmāryā mahiṣaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam

utsṛjettaṃ yamāśāyāmupadravaśamo bhavet hrīṃ saṅkaṭe ca rogaṃ me paramaṃ nāśayadvayam kārāgṛhe japellakṣaṃ bandhamokṣaḥ prajāyate tatra ṣoḍaśalakṣāṇi japtvā homastu dūrvayā amukasyāmukaṃ kaṣṭaṃ gataṃ tadgatameva hi tāro [oṃ namo bhagavati vikaṭe vīrapālike prasīdaprasīda || ] namo bhagavati vikaṭe vīrapālike kāśyāṃ vīreśvarāsannā paścime vikaṭā sthitā udaraṃ cāpi bandhyāyāḥ prajāvatyāstathā śiraḥ sādhakasya karaspṛṣṭā nīrogāścira jīvinaḥ navagrahaprakāśo dvāviṃśaḥ brāhmyādyaṣṭau bhāskarasya taṭe tiṣṭhanti śaktayaḥ svarṇaṃ yāśca prayacchanti tanmanūnbrūhi śaṅkara yogināṃ muktidātrī sā bhogināṃ bhogadā matā gāyatrī chanda uddiṣṭaṃ vaḥ śaktiḥ kīlakaṃ caraḥ akṣamālāvarābhītikamaṇḍalukarāruṇām ṣaṭkoṇeṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni śaktayorcyāḥ kalādale mahatpūrvāścasaptaitāssarasvatyaḥ prakīrttitāḥ vāgīśvarīrudraviṣṇumukhānte cākṣayā matā tattanmantraiḥ pūjanīyā bāhye dikpāḥsahetayaḥ tatpuṣpayuktasalilaistarppayenmārjjayetkuśaiḥ lakṣamātraṃ japenmantraṃ kāryyasiddhiḥ prajāyate tāraṃ [oṃ hrīṃ hraiṃ hrīṃ oṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ iti ekādaśākṣaramantraḥ || ] māyāṃ ca hasarānaikārāḍhyānsabindukān punarmāyāṃ ca tāraṃ ca vadenṅentāṃ sarasvatīm triṣṭupchando muniḥ kaṃṭhaścintāmaṇi sarasvatī svarasampuṭitaiḥ [aṃ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ṅaṃ āṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ iṃ caṃ chaṃ jaṃ jhaṃ yaṃ īṃ śirase svāhā itthaṃ nyāsakalpanam | punaḥ aiṃ hrīṃ bījābhyāṃsaṃpuṭitaiḥ shrāṃ, shrīṃ, shrūṃ, shraiṃ, shrauṃ, shraḥ, ebhiḥ kūṭākṣarairnyāsīnkuryyāt yathā oṃ hrīṃ shrāṃ oṃ hrīṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ ityādi || ] kādivargaiḥ syādaṃgakalpanam

mūrddhabhrūmadhyakarṇākṣināsikāsyagudāṃghriṣu [oṃ mūrdhni hrīṃ bhrūmadhye, shraiṃ dakṣakarṇe, hrīṃ vāmakarṇe, oṃ dakṣanetre, sa vāmanetre, ranāsikāyām svamukhe, tyai gude, na dakṣapāde, maḥ vāmapāde, ityakṣaranyāsaḥ || ] vīṇāmṛtaghaṭākṣasragdīptahastāmbujasthitām vāgdevyau pārśvayoḥ pūjye saṃskṛtaprākṛtāhvaye prajñāṃ medhāṃ śrutiṃ caiva smṛtiṃ śaktiṃ tatorcayet dikpālaiśca caturthaṃ syājjapeddvādaśalakṣakam evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī kāmyakarmāṇi sādhayet sahasratritayaṃ yastu trimāsātsyānmahākaviḥ aikārayuktā hasarā bindvantāḥ pūrvabījakam visargāntāstṛtīyaṃ syādbījaṃ jñānaprado manuḥ antabījaṃ bhavecchaktirādyabījantu kīlakam dakṣiṇe ca kare vāme dvaye bījatrayaṃ punaḥ hṛdayādi ca śīrṣāntaṃ kramādbījatrayaṃ nyaset pīnottuṃgastanīṃ pūrṇacandrāsyāmaruṇāmbarām navayonitrikoṇeṣu vāmā jyeṣṭhādikā yajet ādyā bahvī viṣaghnī syāttato dūratarā matā āgneyeśānanair-ṛtyavāyavye paścime kramāt sandīptasammohanakau tathā conmādanontimaḥ krameṇa śaktayaḥ pūjyāḥ śubhagā ca tathā bhagā anaṃgamadanā ceti dhyānamāsāṃ [dhyānamāha] nirūpyate divyāṃbarāḥ sarvabhūṣāḥ sarvābhīṣṭapradāyikāḥ bhairavānasitāṃgādyāñchakrādīnāyudhānyapi hunetpalāśapuṣpaiśca daśāṃśaṃ vā śatāṃśakam palāśapuṣpairayutaṃ saubhāgyāya ca homayet bhavanti sakalā lokā vaśyā nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ pṛthakprayogo dhyānaṃ ca paṃcāśadvarṇaśobhitām

mudrākapālavidyākṣamālārājanmahābhujām kavitā tasya jāyate nānāvṛttārthaśobhitā sṛṇipāśakapāleṣumātuluṃgadhanuṣkarām helāvilāsasambhinnāṃ navayauvanasundarīm trailokyaṃ kṣobhayedāśu pūrvavatsiddhibhāgasau navakundendusaṃkāśāṃ rājanmauktikabhūṣaṇām yo japetprāya etasya kavitā bhuvi sammatā tāto [oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ shrauṃ huṃ phaṭ nīlasarasvatyai svāhā | iti caturdaśākṣaro mantraḥ || ] lakṣmīśca hṛllekhā hasāvoṃṅkārasaṃyutau ṛṣyādyā brahmagāyatryau tathā nīlasarasvatī mantrotthitairatho dhyāyeddevīṃ sarveṣṭasiddhidām pothayantīṃ pādatale paśuṃ candrakalādharām viśeṣājjayadā vāde vidyeyaṃ sādhitā nṛbhiḥ śrīmadekajaṭe nīlasarasvati padaṃ vadet bhūtapiśācarākṣasāngrasa yugmaṃ mameti ca dvipaṃcāśallipiścāyaṃ dhyānapūjādipūrvavat hrīṃśrīṃhumiti munyādyaṃ yathā tripurabhairavī [tripurabhairavīmantrasye tyarthaḥ || ] trīṃhuṃphaṭ ca navārṇoyaṃ dhyānapūjādi pūrvavat hasakhapharavarṇāśca [haṃsphreṃ hsrauṃ hauṃsphrauṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ drāṃ hrīṃ klīṃ blūṃ saḥ ghīṃ ghaṭasarasvati ghaṭe vadavada tura tura rudrājñayā mamābhilāṣaṃ kuru kuru svāhā ayaṃ vahnivedārṇaḥ || ] aiṃkāreṇa samanvitāḥ visargāntā dvitīyaṃ syāddhasau pho rapha eva ca vācaṃ māyāṃ ramāṃ drāṃ hrīṃ kāmaṃ blūṃ saṃstathaiva ca ghaṭe vadadvayampaścāttvarayugmaṃ vadettataḥ svāhāntognikṛtārṇoyaṃ prāgvatpūjādikaṃ bhavet vāmācāreṇa phaladāṃ vāgbījaṃ haiṃ samuccaret cāmuṇḍāmantravatsarvaṃ japanyāsādikaṃ bhavet vācaṃ māyāmantarikṣasarasvatyagnigehinī

śṛṇuyādīpsitāṃ vārtāṃ dūrasthāmapi sādhakaḥ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ samuccārya sauṃklīṃhrīṃ aiṃ punarvadet drāṃhrīṃklīṃblūṃ sa uccāryya aiṃhrīṃśrīṃklīṃ punarvadet brahmānuṣṭupsarasvatyo munyādyāḥ parikīrttitāḥ navāsanāṃ sarppabhūṣāṃ kartrīṃ cāpi kapālakam muṇḍamālādharāṃ tryakṣāṃ bhaje nīlasarasvatīm daśāṃśaṃ juhuyātpūjāṃ pīṭhe kuryyācca socyate dvātriṃśatpatramante syāccatuḥṣaṣṭidalaṃ tathā evaṃ yantraṃ samālikhya bāhyataḥ pūjanaṃ caret vāyukoṇe kṣetrapālamaiśāne bhairavaṃ tathā bhūgṛhasyādyarekhāyāmaṇimā laghimā tathā garimā prāptirityetāḥ pūjyāḥ pūrvādidikkramāt bhūmigehe tṛtīyāyā rekhāyāṃ mātaraḥ [brāhmī, māheśvarī, kaumārī, vaiṣṇavī, vārāhī, indrāṇī, cāmuṇḍā, mahālakṣmīḥ imā aṣṭau mātaraḥ || ] punaḥ catuḥṣaṣṭidale padme śaktīrarccecca tāvatīḥ umāśrīśāntayaścaṇḍā dhūmrā kālī karālinī vāgvādinī ca nakulī bhadrakālī śaśiprabhā khecarī bhūcarī siddhā kāmākṣī hiṃgulābalā vilāsinī tathā ghorā citrā mugdhā dhaneśvarī vedagarbhā tathā bhīmā ugrā vaidyā ca sadgatiḥ kulikā mālinī [kāminī iti kvacitpāṭhaḥ || ] kāmyā jñānavatyatha ḍākinī hākinī ca catuḥṣaṣṭiśaktayaḥ siddhidāyikāḥ dvātriṃśatpatramadhye tu pūjyā etāstu śaktayaḥ ūrdhvakeśī ca mātaṃgī mohinī vaṃśavarddhinī śarvarī chatrahastā ca raktanetrā vicarcikā śāntirvityā vajrahastā dhūmrā śvetā sumaṅgalā

tataḥ śoḍaśapatreṣu pūjyāḥ ṣoḍaśaśaktayaḥ ratiḥ prītistathā bālā sumukhī śyāmalāvilā sarveśvarīti sampūjya sṛṇimudrāṃ [aṃkuśamudrā || ] pradarśayet namaḥ [oṃ namaḥ padmāsane padmarūpe aiṃ hrīṃ klīṃ vadavada vāgvādini svāhā | iti mantraḥ || ] padmāsane padmarūpe vāgbhuvaneśvarī mahākavirvarṇalakṣajapātprācyāṃ ca pūjanam citreśvarīti vāgbījaṃ svāhānto dvādaśākṣaraḥ strīvaśyakṛttathānena vahni koṇe prapūjayet ekādaśārṇamantreṇa kulajāṃ dakṣiṇercayet trayodaśārṇena yajennair-ṛtye kīrttināyikām vāyavyakoṇe pūrvoktāṃ [ghaṭasarasvatīmantraḥ pūrvaṃ liṃkhitaḥ || ] yajeddhaṭasarasvatīm paṃcamyāvṛttimārādhya [aiṃ heṃ hīṃ kiṇi kiṇi vicce kiṇi sarasvatyāṃ ayaṃ navākṣaro mantraḥ || ] kṣobhamudāṃ pradarśayet darśayeddrāviṇīṃ mudrāṃ ṣaṣṭhāvaraṇapūjane darśayetkarṣiṇīṃ mudrāṃ pūjā cetthaṃ prakīrtitā tārāyai cāpi vitaredbaliṃ nityaṃ catuṣpathe balidravyaṃ samākhyātaṃ yeneṣṭaṃ sā prayacchati caturvaktrāmaṣṭabhujairdadhānāṃ mudrikāṃ bhaje śabdapāthonidhau dhyāyetsṛṣṭidhyānamudīritam raktāmbarāṃ ratnasiṃhāsanasthāṃ hemabhūṣitām śvevadvīpasthitāṃ dhyāyetsthitidhyānamitīritam navavaktrāmbhujairaṣṭādaśabhirdadhatīṃ varam bhindipālañca muśalaṃ kartrīṃ śaktiṃ triśīrśakam raktāmbhodhau sthitāndhyāyetsaṃhāradhyānamīritam evaṃ siddhe manau mantrī girā vācaspatirbhavet samprāpte soṣṭame varṣe sarvaśāstrajñatāmiyāt dvādaśe vatsare prāpte bhakṣitā sā kavitvakṛt

uparāge jalastho yo'śnīyādvācaspatirbhavet japecchavaṃ samāruhya vidyāntatparamānasaḥ pārago bhava vidyānāṃ sarvasiddhimavāpnuhi upaviśya tayormurdhni karau dattvā japenmanum yaḥ kautukī sa āścaryyaṃ vidyāyāḥ paśyatu dhruvam tatrāsīno japedvidyāmarkalakṣaṃ vidhānataḥ punnāgacampakāśokarambhāvipinasaṃsthitām evaṃ kurvannaraḥ sarvamabhīṣṭaṃ labhate dhruvam ayutaṃ kṛṣṇabhūtāhe sa vāksiddhimavāpnuyāt rūpaṃ kāmayamānena sevyeyantu sarasvatī śrīṃhrīṃklīmiti mantrosyāstribījaḥ parikīrttitaḥ chando nivṛcca gāyatrī devī lokeśvarī matā dhyānamasyāḥ pravakṣyāmi nānāratnacaye sthitaḥ tasyādhastādratnamaye sthitāṃ siṃhāsanopari keyūrahāramukuṭarasanānūpurānvitām abhītiṃ puṣpabāṇāṃśca dadhānāṃ karapallavaiḥ cāmarādarśakarakatāmbūlakaracārubhiḥ sūryyalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ hunettrimadhurānvitaiḥ ṣaṭkoṇamadhye deveśīṃ koṇeṣvaṅgāni pūjayet pārśvadvaye śaṅkhapadmanidhī pūjyautadanantaram caturthaṃ pañcamanteṣāmāyudhairiti pūjanam tāvaddhunedbilvaphalaiḥ sampattiḥ paramā bhavet japākusumahomastu samastajanavaśyakṛt athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi tripurāṃ śivasañjñitām tulyaṃ jñānasarasvatyā dhyānanyāsārcanādikam

oṃ vāṃśrīṃhrīṃ [oṃ vāṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ sphreṃsauṃ svāhā || ] samuccāryya sphreṃsauṃ svāhāntako manuḥ rudravāgīśvarī devī gāyatrī chanda īritam sāṃsīṃsūṃ [vāmityādiprāgabhāvādhikaraṇakṣaṇe oṃ sāṃsīmiti saṃyojya taiḥ ṣaḍaṅganyāsānkurvīta yathā- sām oṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ, sīṃvāṃ śirase svāhā, sūṃ śrīṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ, saiṃ hrīṃ kavacāya hum, sauṃsphreṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ, saḥ sauṃ astrāya phaṭ || ] cāpi saiṃsauṃsaḥ pūrvakairaṃgakalpanam tṛptetyuktvā vadavada anādibodhavajriṇe sahajātirūpiṇe cānantaśaktibaliṃ vadet sarvakāmapradaścaivaṃ dhyānamasyā nirūpyate japapūjāprayogādi jñeyaṃ vāgvādinīsamam oṃ śrīṃsphuṃ śrīṃ namaśceti ṣaḍarṇo mantra ucyate śrīṃbījena ṣaḍaṅgāni dhyānamasyā nirūpyate asyā pūjādikaṃ ṣaṣṭhavarṇavāgvādinīsamam hrīṃ vācaspate amṛtaplūḥ plūṃhrīṃsauṃ ca saṃvadet viṣṇuvāgīśvarī devī virāṭ chandaḥ prakīrttitam vācaspate amṛteti netraṃ plūḥ plūṃ tathāstrakam saṃvatsaraṃ haviṣyāśī sahasrampratyahañjapet tena lokottarā medhā jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ bhūtambhavyaṃ varttamānaṃ sarvaṃ jānāti sādhakaḥ culukaikammantritantu daśavārammalatrayam sakṛcchrutantu yattena na ca vismaryyate kvacit hrīṃ ca padmāvati svāhā saptārṇaḥ parikīrttitaḥ prakuryyānmāyayāṅgāni [hrīṃ bījena ṣaḍaṃganyāsaṃ kuryyāt] dhyānamasyā nirūpyate bandhūkābhāṃ trinayanāṃ nānākalpojjvalāṃ smaret lokapālāṃstadastrāṇi padmāvatyarcanaṃ smṛtam padmāvatīsamānyā tu nāsti saubhāgyadā bhuvi tāramuktvā [oṃ ehi parameśvari svāhā | iti mantraḥ || ] tathā caihi parameśvaryyagnigehinīm aśvārūḍhā ṣaḍaṃṅgāni tārādyaistripadairdvidhā

badhvānayantīṃ vāmena dakṣe kanakavetrikām mātṝrindrādidigbāhye tadastrāṇi tato bahiḥ itthaṃ dhyātvaiva sakalaṃ viśvaṃ vaśayate'cirāt trimadhvaktaistathā lonairvaśyā bhūpā hunettu yaḥ anayā vidyayā sarppirhomaḥ kāñcanado mataḥ pūrvoktenaiva homena nārīmākarṣayeddhruvam ṣaḍdīrghamāyayaivāsya ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ dvibhūbhūtrīṣuyugmaiśca ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ indrādibāhyāvaraṇe prokto brāhmyā vidhistvayam oṃ hrīṃnamo bhagavati māheśvaryyehi saṃvadet tārādirekaviṃśārṇo'śvārūḍhāvatparaṃ matam dadhatīṃ śūlaḍamaruṃ mahāhivalayāṃ bhaje juhuyāttaddaśāṃśena paramaiśvaryyavānbhavet ādau bālāṃ tathā śaktiṃ nityaklinnāgnivāsinīm vajreśvarīṃ ca tvaritāṃ śivadūtīṃ trikaṇṭikām tato dikpāṃstadastrāṇi cetthaṃ māheśvarī matā vākkāmasaustribījāni sauḥ klīṃ aiṃ ca punaḥ paṭhet gāyatrī chanda uddiṣṭaṃ devī tripurabālikā raktā tryakṣā candrabhālā dhyeyā bālā surārcitā japellakṣaṃ daśāṃśena homaḥ puṣpairhayārijaiḥ prabhādibhirdigīśāstraiḥ prayogaḥ pūrvavanmataḥ dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvaproktaṣaḍarṇavat bālatripure svāheti daśārṇo'nyacca pūrvavat tataśca bāle tripure siddhiṃ dehi namastviti prayogāścātra sidhyanti trivarṇoktāstathākhilāḥ
