bhārati kavitvaṃ dehi svāhānto'nyacca pūrvavat svāhāntoṣṭādaśārṇoyaṃ nyāsādyaṃ syātṣaḍarṇavat vidyāṃ kuru namaḥ svāhā viṃśatyarṇaśca pūrvavat tripure sarvamityuktvā īpsitaṃ sādhayeti ca siddhe mantre lakṣajapādabhīṣṭaṃ sidhyati dhruvam tripure lalite procya madīpsitāṃ ca yoṣitam aṣṭāviṃśativarṇoyaṃ śrīdaḥ sarvantu pūrvavat āṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃklīṃ ca hrī ca śrīmamaṣṭākṣaro manuḥ strīvaśyā karṣaṇādau ca viniyoga udāhṛtaḥ aṣṭāṅgaṃ vinyasenmantraṃ mūlena vyāpakaṃ caret bibhratīṃ dorbhiraruṇāṃ kucāḍhyāṃ hṛdi bhāvayet mātṛbhirlokapālaiśca vajrādyaiḥ pañcamāvṛtiḥ nityaklinnāmatho vacmi nityaklinne madadrave nityaklinnā devatā ca triṣṭup chanda udāhṛtam klinne svāhā śikhā nityaklinne ca kavacaṃ matam pūjādikamatho mantrī pūrvavatparikalpayet prāgvatprayogāḥ sevyeyaṃ dāridre sukhakāriṇī oṃ hrīṃ ca vahnivāsinyai namaśceti munirmataḥ śaktibījantu śaktissyātkīlakaṃ madhyameritam māyāntena ṣaḍaṅgāni kuryyānmantrī karāṅgayoḥ mantrākṣarāṇi vinyasya sarveṇa vyāpakaṃ caret cārusmeramukhāmbhojāṃ vilasannayanatrayām vāmahasteṣu ratnābjaṃ śaṅkhaṃ puṇḍrekṣujaṃ dhanuḥ puṣpeṣṭaṃ mātuluṅgaṃ ca svasamānasakhīvṛtām aṣṭayoniṣu sampūjyāstadagrāstu pradakṣiṇam

kamalā kitavā viśvā vividhā ceti śaktayaḥ meṣā vṛṣā ca mithunā karkaṭādyāśca tā matāḥ ghasmarāṃ sarvabhakṣāṃ ca viśvākhyā vividhodbhavām acintyāṃ vai bhavastutāṃ tadagre lokapālakān ekalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādghṛtaiḥ siddhamantraḥ prakurvīta prayogānnijavāñchitān śālitaṇḍulamādāya prasthaṃ bhāṇḍe nave kṣipet japtvā homo vidhātavyo mahālakṣmīkaro bhavet śukle sahasrāṇyaṣṭau ca varṣamevaṃ samācaret ghṛtahomādavāpnoti sakalaṃ vāñchitaṃ phalam athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi hyannapūrṇeśvarīmanum māheśvari cānnapūrṇe svāhā viṃśativarṇakaḥ hrīṃbījaṃ cāpi śaktiḥ śrīṃ kīlakaṃ klīṃ prakīrtitam brahmarandhre ca sīmante bhāle bhrūmadhyayornasi ādhāre sphigdvaye bāhudvaye jānudvaye tathā punarmūrdhani bhāle ca bhrūmadhye ca mukhe gale vyutkrameṇa punaḥpāyuliṅganābhyādiṣu nyaset vyāpakaṃ ca tataḥ kuryyātsarvamantreṇa sādhakaḥ navaratnaprabhādīptamukuṭāṃ kuṃkumāruṇām nṛtyantīmīśamaniśaṃ dṛṣṭvānandamayīṃ parām annadānaratāṃ nityāṃ bhūmiśrībhyāṃ namaskṛtām dakṣiṇe tu kare devyā darvīṃ dhyāyetsuvarṇajām kalāpatraṃ ca bhūbimbaṃ caturasratrayāvṛtam oṃ hrāṃ śivāyeti pūjāmantroyaṃ vai nagākṣaraḥ gokṣīradhāmadhavalaṃ pañcavaktraṃ trilocanam

nṛtyantamīśvaraṃ devaṃ trikoṇāgre sureśvaram tāro namo bhagavate varāhapadamuccaret varāhapūjane prokto mantro rāmāgnivarṇakaḥ vāmadakṣiṇayoḥ pūjye bhūśriyau svasvamantrataḥ annādhipataye ceti mamānnaṃ ca pradāpaya śrīpūjane śīpuṭaḥ syāccatuṣpatre tatorcayet bhuvaneśī svabījena [hrīṃbījena || ] ramayā [śrīṃbījena || ] kamalā tathā candramaṇḍalarūpiṇyaḥ paścimādikrameṇa ca tannāmānte namaścoktvā iti mantreṇa pūjayet śrīśca svāhā svadhā jyotsnā tato haimavatī bhavet bhūpure lokapālāśca tadastrāṇi tadagrataḥ ramyapāyasasarpirbhyāṃ siddhidā bhavati dhruvam annapūrṇeśvarī devī pūjitānnasuvarṇadā māyātārādikā cānyā gaditāṣṭādaśākṣarā aṣṭanāgendravajrādyaiḥ sādhayetpūrvavacca tāḥ ṛṣirbrahmākṛtiśchando devate bhūśriyau mate kṣīrābdhau svarṇarajatadravadvīpe surānvite vittapasyāgratastatra svāsīne vasudhāśriyau āvāhya vaiṣṇave pīṭhe devyā gandhādibhiryajet digdaleṣu kramātkhaṃ ca vāyumagniṃ tathā jalam vidyāṃ śāntiṃ tato bāhyeṣṭadale cāṣṭa śaktayaḥ indrādayastadastrāṇi pūjā caivaṃ samīritā guruṃ santoṣya yatnena mantrasiddhimavāpnuyāt chatradhānyānnaratnaughasamṛddho bhavati dhruvam nabho bhagavatītyuktvā māheśvari mameti ca

annapūrṇe vahnijāyā caikatriṃśārṇako manuḥ dhyānapūjāprayogādi prāgvatsarvaṃ samīritam tāro ramā ca hṛllekhā namo bhagavatīti ca annapūrṇegnijāyāṃto manvarṇairaṃgakalpanam sarvaṃ prāgvatparijñeyaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ japataḥ phalam hrīṃ gaurirudradayite yogeśvaripadaṃ vadet ajosya munirākhyātonuṣṭupchandosti devatā ṣaḍdīrghamāyayā kuryyātṣaḍaṅgāni manoratha pāśāṃkuśau sarvabhūṣāṃ tāṃ gaurīṃ sarvadā smaret aṅgāni pūrvamabhyarcya subhagādyāstato yajet pāśāṃkuśā darppaṇākhyā cāñjanā ca śalākikā śakrādayastadastrāṇi gaurīpūjā samīritā tarppaṇādi tataḥ kuryyādguruṃ santoṣya yatnataḥ vāmākṣīṇāmakṣimaṣyā vāmorau sulikhenmanum śataṃ sahasraṃ lolākṣīmānayetkāmamohitām dattaṃ saṃsevitaṃ sarvajanatāvaśyakārakam kāṃkṣitastrīvaśaṅkari subhage ca pṛthagdvayam gauṃ gaurīmūrttaye hṛcca pīṭhamantra udāhṛtaḥ tanno gaurī pracodayāt aṅgāni pūrvamabhyarcya subhagādyāstato yajet sabinduṅentaṃ tannāma namontaṃ tanmanurmataḥ vāmā jyeṣṭhā ca raudrī ca guhyaśaktiḥ kramādimāḥ japenmantraṃ śataṃ cāpi sa vaśyo bhavati dhruvam māyā namaśca brahmaśrīrājite rājapūjite na vaśaṅkari cetyuktvā sarvalokavaśaṃkari

ṛṣirbrahmā nivṛcchando gaurī devī prakīrttitā indradigvasuhastāśārudrārṇairdhyānamucyate śoṇalepāṃ jagadvandyāṃ kusumbhāruṇavastrikām lokapālāṃstadastrāṇi pūjākrama udāhṛtaḥ madhuratrayasaṃyuktairhomaḥ syāttilataṇḍulaiḥ dinatrayaṃ sahasraṃ tu śīghraṃ vaśyakaraḥ smṛtaḥ dhyātvā cāṣṭottaraśataṃ japetsarvajagadvaśam oṃ rājamukhi rājādhimukhi vaśyamukhīti ca mahādevīti devādhidevi sarvajanasya ca matravaṇastu hṛdayaṃ triṃśadbhiḥ śira īritam varmmāṣṭabhiḥ śarairnetraṃ meghairastraṃ prakīrttitam sarvajanapadasthāne sādhyanāma niyojayet madhuratrayasaṃyuktamaṣṭottaraśataṃ hunet tadbhasmanā prayogastu samastajanavaśyakṛt aṣṭacatvāriṃśadarṇo mantrastadvatsamīritaḥ meghaiścāpi manorvarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ sampātājyantu sādhyasya prāṇināṃ vaśakārakam tasyā manuṃ pratiṣṭhāpya prāṅgaṇe nikhanecca tām japāpuṣpairniśīthinyāṃ juhuyātsapta vāsarān nikhanetsādhakastasya sādhyo dāso bhaved dhruvam vāgbījaṃ cāpi hṛllekhā nityaklinne madadrave triṣṭupchando devatā ca vajraprastāriṇī matā asyā pūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ nityaklinnāvadācaret hrīṃ klīṃ klinne tathā kroṃ ca paścānnityamadadrave ṛṣirbrahmā ca gāyatrī chando vajreśvarī surī

vāgbhavaṃ kīlakaṃ jñeyaṃ hrīṃ klīṃ hrīṃ ca hṛnmanuḥ hrīṃ nityaklinne hrīṃ netraṃ hrīṃ made hrīmitīritam ityevaṃ śaktipuṭitānmantrārṇāndaśa vinyaset tataḥ sañcintayeddevīṃ sarvasaukhyapradāyinīm caturbhujāṃ trinayanāṃ māṇikyamukuṭojjvalām dadhānāṃ bāhubhirnetrairdarppaṇāmodaśītalaiḥ cakramadhye sukhāsīnāṃ smeravaktrasaroruhām siṃhāsane'bhitaḥ preṅkhatpotasthābhiśca śaktibhiḥ tatra cakraṃ tatra devīṃ samyagāvāhya pūjayet śaktiṃ sampūjya devyāstu vāmakoṇāditorcayet lākinīṃ kākinīṃ caiva śākinīṃ hākinīṃ tathā hṛllekhāṃ kledinīṃ klinnāṃ kṣobhiṇīṃ madanāturām mekhalā drāviṇīṃ vegavatīṃ dvādakṣaśaktikāḥ kṛtyāṃ kāntāṃ ca kalitāṃ kautākhyāṃ ca kirātikām kātarāṃ kakaṭāṃ kīrttiṃ kumārīṃ kuṃkumāmapi kramādyajeddvārayorddhekoṇekoṇe tathaikikām yajedāśādhipānbāhye tadaṇāstri tato bahiḥ rogāpamṛtyudaurbhāgyajarāśokādivicyutaḥ āragvadhaprasūnairvā prasūnairbakulodbhaveḥ ātmānamabhiṣicyātha tarppayedbrāhmaṇānapi gurubhaktaḥ prakurvīta prayogānnijavāñchitān yaḥ sopi kāmyānkurvīta prayogānnijavāñchitān anarthakleśarogādi pīḍāḥ prāpnoti niścitam ṣaṇmāsāllabhate lakṣmīṃ mahatīṃ ślāghyavigrahām juhuyānnityaśo bhaktyā sahasraṃ vikacaiḥ śubhaiḥ

tāvajjapecca homānte yāvatsaṃkhyaṃ hutaṃ kṛtam labhate svarṇaniṣkāṇāṃ śataṃ māsena pūvavat darśādimāsāllabhate citrāṇi vasanāni ca vastūni labhate hṛdyairvastubhirbhāgayogibhiḥ tena śālisamṛddhiḥ syānmāsaiḥ ṣaḍbhirasaṃśayam nirātaṅko mahābhāgo śataṃ varṣāṇi jīvati cirāyuḥ śrīyaśobhāgyapuṇyadṛṣṭyādibhāgbhavet āyurārogyavibhavairjanamānyo bhavettadā ṣaṇmāsādabdato vāpi rogamuktaḥ sukhī bhavet pākādyamapi tenaiva kuryyādrogavimuktaye kṛtvā puttalikāntaistu hṛdayena ca saṃyutām śatayojanadūrādapyānayedvanitā balāt kleśaistaiḥ sa vinirmuktaḥ sukhī jīvati bhūtale vairī ghorajvareṇārttaḥ kṛte prāgvatsukhī bhavet tadvidhānena sahiteśatrurunmādavānbhavet oṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ kheṃ ceṃ kṣaiṃ kṣaḥ śrīṃ hrūṃ kṣeṃ hrīṃ phaṭ manurbhavet virāṭ chandaśca oṃ bījaṃhrīṃ śaktistvaritā surī kṣaiṃ kṣaḥ śikhā ca varmma śrīṃ hrūṃ kṣeṃ netramprakīrttitam jaṅghayoḥ pādayormantrī sarveṇa vyāpakañcaret tāṭaṅkātaṅkavidyotiraśanānūpurātmakaiḥ dvidvikramādaṣṭanāgaiḥ kalpitodyatsubhūṣaṇām valayairbhūṣitabhujāmmāṇikyamukuṭojjvalām guñjāphalalasaddhāravilasatkucamaṇḍalām varābhayakarāṃ gaṇḍadvayāmmukuṭaśobhitām āsane hemaracite tvaṣṭasiṃhavṛte'bhitaḥ

kṣaṃhruṃhaṃvajradeheti [kṣaṃhuṃ haṃ vajradeha kṣiṃ kurukuru garjagarja huṃhuṃchāṃ pañcānanāya namaḥ || ] kṣiṃ coktvātha kurudvayam namaḥ ṣaḍviṃśadarṇoyaṃ kuryyādaṣṭadalantataḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni praṇītāṃ ca tadgāyatrīkramādyajet hūṃkārīṃ vā śacīṃ kṣemakarīṃ pūrvādipatrake phaṭkārīṃ pūjayeddvāramadhye devyāstu kiṅkarīm jayāṃ ca vijayāṃ dvārapārśvayorvetradhāriṇīm kiṅkarāya rakṣarakṣa tvaritājñāsthiro bhava gāyatryṛcā ca sampūjya devasānnidhyakāriṇīm tanno devī pracodayām mohanaḥ sarvalokānāntena mohananāmakaḥ sarvasiddhipradātṛtvātsarvasiddhīśvaro mataḥ dhūpadīpādibhirnṛtyagītaiḥ sampūjayeñchivām śataṃ vā kṛtahomastu prāgvatpūjāṃ samāpayet madhvaktabilvasamidho juhuyāttaddaśāṃśataḥ ātmānamabhiṣicyātha brāhmaṇānapi bhojayet namaskriyāmprakurvanti nātra kāryyā vicāraṇā siddhavidyādhāraṇāṃ ca yoṣitopsarasastathā praskhalatpadavinyāsāḥ saṃsphuraddaśanāṃśukāḥ tadaiva vāñchitantasmai dadāti tvaritākhilam santāḍya śīrṣe sahasā mṛtamutthāpayedasau kṛtvā yoniṃ kuṇḍamadhye samādhāyāgnimatra vai tilasarṣapagodhūmaśālidhānyayavairhunet bakulaiścampakai raktaiḥ kahlārairaruṇotpalaiḥ aśokaiḥ pāṭalairbilvaistattadāpnoti niścitam sitājyalakṣakaṃ hutvā rogānmukto naro'cirāt [bhavediti śeṣaḥ || ]

acalāṃ labhate lakṣmīṃ bhoktā ca bhavati dhruvam ekaikairvanitā vaśyā yāvajjīvaṃ dhanādibhiḥ kṣīrāktaistairhunenmartyo vaśe tiṣṭhantyaśeṣataḥ taduktavairiṇo nityammāṣairapi ca tatkṛte kāraskaraghṛtopetaṃ phaṇiśīrṣasrucā hunet niśāyāṃ juhuyātsadyo nihantuṃ vairiṇaṃ haṭhāt saptarātrādarātestu gajāśvā rogamāpnuyuḥ saptāhādrogamāpnoti duḥkhārtto naiva saṃśayaḥ tajjaptamaṣṭadhā tāvadyajjalaṃ culukodakāt tatkarṇarandhrajāpācca naśyeyuśca viṣagrahāḥ athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi śivadūtīmanumparam ṛṣī rudrosya gāyatrī chandaḥ syāddevatā śivā ṣaḍdīrghayuktamanunā ṣaḍaṃgavidhirīritaḥ pṛṣṭhe manasi vinyasya vyāpakaṃ vidyayā caret navaratnakirīṭāṃ ca trīkṣaṇāmaruṇāmbarām śucismitāmaṣṭabhujāṃ stūyamānāmmaharṣibhiḥ dakṣiṇairaṃkuśaṃ khaḍgakuṭhāraṃ kamalantathā dhyātvaivampūjayeddevīṃ dūtīṃ duritanāśinīm icchājñānakriyāśaktīstriṣu koṇeṣu pūjayet siddhā vāṇī pūrṇasiddhāgre vigrahavatī tathā ḍākinyādyāstadagre tu yajedaṣṭadalāmbuje sumukhīṃ sundarīṃ sārāṃ sumanāṃ ca sarasvatīm vāgīśāṃ varadāṃ viśvāṃ vinadāṃ vighnakāriṇīm dvārasya dakṣiṇambhāgaṃ samārabhya pradakṣiṇam pramodāṃ kautukāṃ puṇyāṃ lokeśāstrāṇi tadbahiḥ

tarppayedgandhasalilairātmānamabhiṣecayet nārikelaphalopetairguḍairlakṣmīmavāpnuyāt trimadhvaktaiścampakaiśca prasūnairbakulodbhavaiḥ punnāgajairhutairvastrāṇyājyairiṣṭamavāpnuyāt avāpnoti hutairājyairamlai ratnādi sādhakaḥ hṛddeśenyasya sādhyākhyāmpacettailājyayorniśi dāsavacca samāyāti priyaṃ prāṇādi cārpayet trisaptarātrānmahatīmavāpnoti śriyaṃ naraḥ padmākṣairjuhuyāllakṣmīmavāpnoti tribhirdinaiḥ śrīkarā śivarūpāhvā proktā sarvasamṛddhidā huṃkheṃkṣaḥ phaṭ ceti mantra ṛṣyādi tvaritāsamam pādādinābhiparyyantamaruṇāṃ nābhito galam hasteṣu śaṅkhacakre ca dīpau candrārdhaśekharām varṇalakṣaṃ japedante daśāṃśena ghṛtairhunet śūlamudrāṃ grahagrastāndṛṣṭvemamprajapenmanum nātaḥ paratarā vidyā grahanirvāpaṇakṣamā kheṃstrīṃkṣeṃ tryarṇamantroyaṃ nikhilaṃ tvāratāsamam kauṃ kaumāryyai nama iti ṣaḍarṇo mantra īritaḥ devatā kaumidaṃ bījaṃ kaumāryye śaktirucyate śaktyakṣasragvarābhītikarāṃ bandhūkasannibhām haritkañcukikāṃ ramyāṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣitām ahalyāndraupadīṃ sītāntārā mandodarīmapi mukhyā pūjā bhavedasyāḥ kumāryyā eva nānyataḥ lakṣaṣaṭkañjapaḥ proktaḥ pañcakhādyaistathā hunet tarpaṇammārjanaṃ kṛtvā kumārīrapi bhojayet

bhāryayā sādhakendrasya pātivratyādiyuktayā alaṃkṛtāḥ pavitrāstā ekapaṃktyopaveśayet tāḥ sampūjya mahatpātraṃ pavitraṃ ca tathā caret dugdhaṃ ca nikṣipettatra naivedyantatra nikṣipet tanmanthanānmaheśāni devāveśaḥ prajāyate sarvaṃ manogataṃ vakti devatā suprasīdati nakhairbhavedvivāhastu pañcāśadbhiḥ sutāstathā aṣṭottaraśatenāpi sādhakena tu melayet akacaṭatapayaśairvaiṣṇavyā mantra īritaḥ chandastu vaiṣṇavī devī nyāsaḥ praṇavapūrvakaḥ vinyasedakṣarāṇyaṣṭāvoṅkāraṃ ca tathā smaret lasatkāñcanasambhūtakuṇḍalojjvalaśālinīm kṛṣṇaśuklāruṇairnetraistribhiścāpi vibhūṣitām kambugrīvāṃ viśālākṣīṃ sūryyakoṭisamaprabhām dakṣiṇābhyāṃ karābhyā tu khaḍgaṃ ca japamālikām gātreṇa ratnastambhaṃ ca samyagālambya saṃsthitām pañcānanaṃ puraḥ saṃsthaṃ nirīkṣantīṃ svavāhanam svabīje sumano dadyātsāhamevaṃ vicintayet āvāhanaṃ tataḥ kuryyādgāyatryā śirasā saha tanno devī pracodayāt naivedyaṃ ca tato dadyānmodakaṃ pāyasaṃ tathā evaṃ sampūjya madhye tu mantreṇāṃgāni pūjayet kālarātriṃ ca dikpatreṣvarcayeccandanādibhiḥ mahāgaurīṃ cāgnikoṇanair-ṛtyādiṣu pūjayet mahāmāyāṃ namāmīti mūlamantreṇa cāṣṭadhā

aṣṭabhiśca mahāmāyāṃ namāmīti ca mantrataḥ lakṣadvayaṃ bhavedasya puraścaraṇakarmma tu aśucirna mahāmāyāṃ pūjayettu kadācana dantarakte samutpanne smaraṇaṃ na cavidyate dhūmodvāre maithune ca sūtake mṛtake ca vai kāmājjāteṅganāsparśe mṛte pitari vatsaram ākarṣe mātṛmaraṇe ṣaṇmāsaṃ ca gurau mṛte na smarecca mahāmāyāṃ śucitāpatyasiddhidām prāgvanmunyādikaṃ proktaṃ pūjājapamukhaṃ tathā mantrārṇairatra cāṅgāni śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret amite padamuccāryya tadagre cāparājite siddhasmṛte mahāvidye anekāṃse ume dhruve mānastoke sarasvati ramaṇī rāmaṇīti ca ditīti vinate ceti gauri gandhāri saṃvadet brahmavādini kālīti kapālini karāli ca antarikṣagataṃ ceti jalagataṃ vadetpunaḥ sarvopadraveṣu svāhā tārādyanto manurmataḥ aghoravaiṣṇavī devī cāyutaṃ japa īritaḥ yasyāḥ praṇaśyetpuṣpaṃ hi garbhaścāpi patedyadi bhūrjjapatre tvimā vidyāṃ likhitvā dhārayedyadi pumāṃśca dhārayedyaśca sobhīṣṭaṃ phalamāpnuyāt agnicaurabhaye ghore nityaṃ tasya jayo bhavet śirorogajvarāṇāṃ ca nāśanaṃ sarvadehinām vaiṣṇavīṃ candravedāgnivarṇāṃ sādhakasiddhidām māsikadvimāsiketi vātikapaittikeṣu ca

viṣajvaragraharkṣādisarvadoṣāntakāriṇi vidyāśāle tālamāle rudrarūpe paca dvayam rajanī sandhye dundubhināde mānasa ityapi viśveśvarī drāviḍīti vaded draviḍikeśi ca vimarddini padaṃ paścādvadetsādhakasattamaḥ mātaṅgī praṇavaṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ kṣauṃ kuruyugaṃ tathā sarvānhanayugaṃ coktvā damayugmaṃ pacadvayam dviḥśoṣayotsādaya dvirbrahmāṣaḍiti ca saṃvadet āgneyīti ca cāmuṇḍe vāruṇī vāyavī tathā jaye ca vijaye śānti svastipuṣṭi dhṛtīti ca sarvakāma phaletyuktvā prade sarvapadaṃ vadet prāgvaddhomaphalaṃ cāsya sādhakaḥ sāttviko bhavet darśanādeva naśyanti bhūtādyā bhairavā api tāramākarṣiṇipadaṃ āveśini padaṃ vadet dhāriṇī tapanītyuktvā tāpini madonmādini tathā nīlapatāketi mahānīle mahāpriye vajriṇīti tathādityādye ca jāhnavi saṃvadet surabhi surotpanne ca sarasvati padaṃ tataḥ kāryyaṃ tanmama siddhyatviti svāhāntoyaṃ manurmataḥ japedvarṇaśataṃ homādikaṃ pūrvavadācaret tārādyā vahnijāyāntā pṛthak ca ṣaḍyugaṃ vadet yata evāgataṃ pāpaṃ tatraiva pratigacchatu svāhāntaḥ ṣaḍbāṇavarṇo lakṣamekaṃ japaḥ smṛtaḥ homapūjādikaṃ prāgvadyena siddhyati devatā vasudevasahasrāṇi cāvadānāni tatra tu

prākkarmmapratibaddhāpi vaiṣṇavītrāsatastu sā upāsitā tadā japtā lalitā lalitā [abhūditi śeṣaḥ || ] ca sā balātkāreṇa kāmasya vaśīkṛtya yayā punaḥ mantreṇānena juhuyāttattatkarmma prasiddhyati māraṇoccāṭane cāpi na prayojyā kadācana aiṃlauṃṭhaṃṭhaṃṭhamiti huṃsvāhāntoṣṭākṣaro manuḥ vārāhyatra ṣaḍaṅgāni kramādvidvīndubhū?kabhiḥ dadhānāmaṃkuśaṃ pāśaṃ mudgaraṃ śaktimeva ca aṅgaṣaṭkadiśādhīśāyudhānītyāvṛtitrayam dhātrīphalairbhṛṅgarājaiḥ kaśaiścāpi daśāśataḥ evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī prayogānkarttumarhati mudgareṇa ghnatīṃ mūrdhni tāṃ smarannayutaṃ japet vāpīkapataḍāgādau tatpānīyasya pānataḥ sthānaṃ tyaktvā ca gacchanti nātra kāryyā vicāraṇā oṃ aiṃ glauṃ aiṃ namaścoktvā tato bhagavatīti ca glauṃ aiṃ andhe andhinīti namo rundhe ca rundhini namaḥ stambhe stambhinīti nama aiṃglauṃ ca vāgbhavam cittacakṣurmukhagalajihvāstambhaṃ kurudvayam huṃphaṭsvāheti mantroyaṃ vedarudrākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥ vārāhyasya ṣaḍaṅgāni vārttālī hṛdayaṃ smṛtam andhe andhini varmmoktaṃ rundhe rundhini netrakam raktābjakarṇikāyāntu śavāsanasamāsthitām abhayaṃ musalañcāpi phalañcāpi varantathā japenmantraṃ sahasrāṇi bandhūkakusumaistilaiḥ pīṭhe svarṇamaye raupye tāmre bhūrjjetha vāruṇe

yonipañcāsraṣaṭkoṇāṣṭapatraśatapatrakam kailāsācalamadhyasthaṃ pīṭhametadvicintayet trikoṇamadhye deveśīṃ ṣaḍaṅgānyapi tatra tu jṛmbhiṇī mohinī caiva stambhinī pañcakoṇake ḍākinyādyāḥ pārśvayośca stambhinīṃ krodhinīmapi śūlaṃ muṇḍañca ḍamaruṃ kapālaṃ dadhataṃ karaiḥ aṣṭapatre tu vārtālīmukhaṃ devyaṣṭakaṃ yajet śatakoṇāgrataḥ siṃhaḥ pūjyo mahiṣasaṃyutaḥ kroṃ vārāhyai nama iti pūjāmantraḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ yoginīṃ gaṇanāthañca tattanmantraiḥ prapūjayet kṣeṃ kṣetrapālāya namoṣṭārṇaḥ kṣetrapapūjane gaṃ gaṇapataye namoṣṭavarṇoyaṃ gaṇeśituḥ pūjānte baṭukādibhyo balimantraibaliṃ haret kapilajaṭābhāreti bhāsureti vadettataḥ nāśayadvitayaṃ sarvopacārasahitaṃ balim baṭukasya baliṃ dadyādanena śraddhayānvitaḥ svāhāntaḥ ṣaḍdīrghayuktaḥ kṣādyastridvimitārṇakaḥ gāṃgīṃgūṃgamiti [gāṃ gīṃ gūṃ gaṃ gaṇapataye varavarada sarvajanaṃ me vaśamānaya sarvopacārasahitaṃ baliṃ gṛhṇagṛhṇa svāhā || ] procya ṅentaṃ gaṇapatiṃ tathā sarvopacārasahitaṃ baliṃ gṛhṇayugaṃ punaḥ evaṃ tebhyo baliṃ dattvā svasvamudrāḥ pradarśayet kiñcidvakrīkṛtā madhyā gaṇanāthabalau smṛtā yoginīnāṃ balermantraṃ sādhanānte paṭhedimam yoṃ yoginībhyaḥ svāheti saptārṇaḥ sragdharā tviyam kṣetre pīṭhopapīṭhādiṣu ca kṛtapadā dhūpadīpādikena prītā devyassadā naḥ śubhayutavidhinā yāntu vīrendravandyāḥ siddhamantraḥ prakarvīta prayogāñchivabhāṣitān

pūreṇa vividhairmāṃsairjuhuyādiṣṭasiddhaye sphāṭikaiḥ padmabījaiśca rudrākṣaiḥ śubhakarmmaṇi vārāhīṃ tarppayetsarvakāmaṃ sampūrayennaraḥ lājacūrṇatilaiḥ kuryyādvarameṣāsṛganvitaiḥ sampannamadanaṃ sāṅgametasyai vinivedayet ekaviṃśatirātrīṣu lājai raktasamanvitaiḥ evaṃ vārttālikāyāstu sādhanaṃ vāmamārgataḥ oṃ [oṃ hrīṃ namo vārāhighore svapnaṃ ṭhaḥṭhaḥ svāhā || ] hrīṃ namaśca vārāhi ghore svapnaṃ visargayuk īśvarosya muniḥ prokto jagatī chanda īritam hṛllekhāśaktiruddiṣṭāṭhadvayaṃ kīlakaṃ matam pādayorvyañjane kaṭyoḥ kaṇṭhe gaṇḍadvaye tathā tato dhyāyedghanaśyāmāṃ trinetrāmunnatastanīm aśvārūḍhāṃ ca kolāsyāṃ nānālaṃkārabhūṣitām ṣoḍaśāre yajecchaktīrvakṣyamāṇāśca ṣoḍaśa māraṇī māriṇīśī ca bhīṣaṇī bhīṣaṇīśvarī āśāvivartinī paścādāśāvivarttinīśvarī etāḥpūjyāścaturthyantāḥ praṇavādyā namontakāḥ lokapālāndaśadale dvitaye hetisaṃyutān evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī kāmyakarmmāṇi sādhayet ānayettaruṇīṃ varṣātsarvakāmasamṛddhaye catuṣpathānnadīkūladvayātkulālaveśmanaḥ racayetputtalīṃ ramyāṃ sādhyāsusthāpanānvitām pītāṅgārayujā yoniṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ bhūpurānvitam sahasraṃ cāṣṭakaṃ bhūyaḥ pūjayettāṃ samāhitaḥ siṃhā gajā mṛgāḥ krūrā bhaveyurvaśagā dhruvam

yathā bhāvi tathā devī svapne vadati mantriṇe iṃ indrāṇyai nama iti mantraḥ proktaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ iṃbījaṃ śaktirindrāṇī namaḥ kīlakamucyate caturdantagajānalpacchāyāsaṃsthāṃ hiraṇyabhām bagalāṃ chinnamastāṃ ca tārāṃ dakṣiṇakālikām tattanmantraistu tadbāhye lokeśānāyudhānyapi trimadhvaktaistāvadeva rājyārthaṃ rājavṛkṣajaiḥ tāraṃ māyāṃ samuccāryya vadecca bagalāmukhi stambhayetipadaṃ [oṃhrīṃ bagalāmukhi sarvaduṣṭānāṃ vācaṃ mukhaṃ stambhaya jihvā kīlaya buddhiṃ vināśaya hrīṃ oṃ svāhā || ] jihvāṃ kīlayeti tataḥ param viniyogosya vikhyātaḥ puruṣārthacatuṣṭaye śikhātu sarvaduṣṭānāṃ tato vācammukhampadam buddhiṃ vināśayāstraṃ syātṣaḍaṅganyāsa īritaḥ gaṇḍadvaye tathā coṣṭhe'dharāsyacibukeṣu ca aṃgulīnāntathā mūle hastāgre caivameva hi dakṣajānuni gulphe cāṃgulimūle padāgrataḥ caturbhujāṃ trinayanāṃ kamalāsanasaṃsthitām pītāmbaradharāṃ sāndravṛttapīnapayodharām pītabhūṣaṇabhūṣāñca svarṇasiṃhāsanasthitām bhūpradeśe manoramye puṣpāmodasudhūpite sauvarṇe vātha raupye vā paittale vāpi bhūrjjake likhedyantraṃ prayatnena lekhanyā hematārayoḥ caturasratrayaṃ bāhye caturdvāropaśobhitam tatra māyoditaṃ pīṭhaṃ jñeyāstā eva śaktayaḥ tatrāvāhya yejeddevīṃ supītairupacārakaiḥ gaṇeśaṃ baṭukaṃ cāpi yoginīḥ kṣetrapālakam

bagalāṃ pūrvapatre tu stambhinīṃ ca tataḥ param bhrāmikāṃ mandagamanāṃ bhogyākhyāṃ caiva yogikām ṣoḍaśasvarasaṃyuktāḥ sampradāyātkulāgame pūrvādbrāhmyādikā aṣṭau vāhanāyudhasaṃyutāḥ yonimadhye mūladevīṃ trirañjalibhirarccayet nīrājya vidhivatpaścādyathāsaṃkhyaṃ nivedayet deyaṃ cāpi sitānnena pratyahaṃ balipañcakam pītāsanaḥ smaretpītaṃ cāyutaṃ japamācaret sarvapītopacāreṇa mantraḥ siddhyati mantriṇaḥ gatistambhakarī vidyā aristambhanakāriṇī ekānte parame ramye śucau deśetha vā gṛhe tathākarṣaṇakāmastu loṇaṃ trimadhurānvitam stambhane homayeddevīṃ prajñāyāśca gatermateḥ gṛdhrāṇāmapi kākānāṃ gṛhadhūmayutena vai pūrvā kulālamṛttāvatyeraṇḍaścaturaṃgulaḥ lakṣamekaṃ japeddevi brahmacārī dṛḍhavrataḥ saṅgame ca mahānadyorniśāyāmapi sādhayet alaktasya ca rāgeṇa rañjitāñca haridrayā śatayojanamātrantu sa gaccheccintite pathi piṣṭvābhimantrya lakṣaikaṃ sarvāṅge lepane kṛte surabherekavarṇāyā dhārotthaṃ kṣīramāharet pāyayitvā tu harate viṣaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam daśāṃśena kṛte home ebhirdravyaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak indrāṇyāḥ paramāṃ śaktiṃ chinnamastāṃ maheśvarīm vajravairocanīye hrīṃ hrīṃ phaṭ svāhā dhanākṣaraḥ

chinnamastā bhaveddevī vāmamārgeṇa siddhidā ūṃ vajrāya śikhā proktā aiṃ pāśāya tanucchadam svāhāntā sarva evaite tato dhyānaṃ samācaret ratikāmasamārūḍhāṃ vikīrṇasakalālakām ḍākinīvarṇinībhyāñca sakhībhyāṃ paridhāritām pīṭhe jayākhyā vijayā ajitā cāparājitā dikṣu madhye ca sampūjyā navapīṭhasya śaktayaḥ siddhiprade ḍākinīye praṇavaṃ vajraṃ vai vadet pīṭhamantro vedavahnivarṇaḥ pīṭhārcane mataḥ bāhyāvaraṇamārabhya pūjayetpratilomataḥ tadantaḥ surarājādīn dvāreṣu dvārapānyajet ekaliṅgāṃ yoginīñca ḍākinīmbhairavīṃ tathā mahābhairavikendrākṣyāvasitāṅgīñca hāriṇīm [saṃ punarhāriṇīmekatrakaraṇena saṃhāriṇīmiti siddham ḍākinī [oṃ aiṃ ḍākinyai namaḥ || oṃ aiṃ varṇinyai namaḥ iti mantraḥ || ] varṇinī tāravāgbhyāṃ tatpārśvayoryajet pālāśābalvajarvāpi juhuyātkusumaiḥ phalaiḥ śrīpuṣpairlabhate lakṣmīṃ tatphalaiśca samīhitam māsamekantu vaśagāstasya syuḥ sarvapārthivāḥ rogajālaṃ parābhūya sukhī jīvecchataṃ samāḥ phalairhutvāpnuyāllakṣmīmudumbarapalāśajaiḥ bandhūkakusumairbhāgyaṃ karṇikāraiḥ samīhitam nārīrajobhirākṛṣṭaṃ mṛgamāṃsaiḥ samīhitam [vāñchitam || ] unmattakāṣṭhadīptegnau tatphalaṃ vāyasacchadaiḥ vijayaṃ labhate mantrī dhyāyeddevīṃ japanmanum raktāṃ vaśye matau dhūmrāṃ stambhane kanakaprabhām gopanīyaḥ prayogotha procyate sarvasiddhidaḥ

snātvā raktāmbaradharo raktamālyānulepanaḥ sundarīṃ yauvanākrāntāṃ narapañcakagāminīm vivastrāṃ pūjayitvaināṃ cāyutaṃ prajapenmanum bhojayedvividhairannairbrāhmaṇāndevatādhiyā nārīmāyuściraṃ dharmmamiṣṭamanyadavāpnuyāt manoratheṣu cānyeṣu gacchettāṃ prajapenmanum śāstrajñānaṃ pāpanāśaḥ sarvasaukhyaṃ labheddhruvam aṅgamāsāntare mantrī kavitvena jayetkavim māyā tārapaṭāṃ mantre japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam eṣa nūnaṃ vidhirgopyaḥ siddhikāmena mantriṇā atha vakṣye ṣoḍaśārṇaṃ caturbhedaṃ manūttamam dahanasya tithirvarṇo lakṣmībījādiko [śrīṃ bījamādau saṃyojya pūrvoktamantro dhanāptikara iti bhāvaḥ || ] dhane vāgbījādyena mokṣaḥ syāccatvāraḥ praṇavādikāḥ upāsyāścaturāmnāyairmunirbrahmā samīritaḥ dharmmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ gurureva samāśrayaḥ dadātyaṣṭau mahāsiddhīḥ kimpunaḥ kṣullakāḥ priyāḥ kāmyakarmmaṇi sarvatra dhyānaṃ syātpuṣpavarṇakam sadākālaṃ japenmantramāpattasya na vidyate stambhayetpaśuśastrāṇi yāvanmuṣṭiṃ na muñcati vimucyate haṭhādrogānmuktarogaḥ sukhī bhavet dhyānapūjādikaṃ prāgvatkiñcitkāmyamudīryyate mahoragasatairdaṣṭaṃ mṛtamutthāpayennaraḥ pītena stambhayennityaṃ naukāvājigajādikam mārayedapyayatnena kṛṣṇadhyānānna saṃśayaḥ ghṛtena madhunā vāpi surayā tatra sādhakaḥ

tarppaṇasya vidhānena haṭhātsiddhaḥ prajāyate śrīphalānāṃ ca homena tathaivodumbarasya ca śatamaṣṭottaraṃ kṛtvā [japamiti śeṣaḥ |] juhuyāttarppaṇottaram nityamaṣṭottaraśataṃ māsaṣaṭkaṃ samācaret ājyayuktaḥ sāmiṣaśca homānte pratyahaṃ baliḥ madhvaktatilapuṣpaistu bhavetsampattiruttamā sājyairbandhūkakusumairayutaiḥ subhago bhavet raktacandanaraktāśvamārapuṣpairnṛpo vaśaḥ samyaggurumukhātprāptān vāmācāreṇa sādhitān jyeṣṭhaputrāya dātavyo nānyebhyaśca kadācana svaputrādau pradātavyā dakṣiṇā na kadācana vāmamārgopāsanantu tau dvau lokadvayāccyutau munirakṣobhyasaṃjñosya bṛhatī chanda īritam ṣaḍdīrghayuglajjayātra [hrāṃhrīṃhrūṃhraiṃhrauṃhraḥ eṣvekaikena ṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ kuryyāt || ] ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ tatrādau prathamo nyāsaḥ [śrīkaṇṭhādinyāsastu pūrvamuktaḥ tenātra nāvāci || ] śrīkaṇṭhādiḥ puroditaḥ śrīkaṇṭhādisapatnīkaṃ namontaṃ mātṛkāsthale asminnyāse kriyamāṇe devīmevaṃvidhā smaret ardhenduśekharāṃ nānābhūṣaṇāḍhyāṃ caturbhujām tribījasvarapūrvaṃ tu raktaṃ sūryyaṃ hṛdi nyaset evammantravidhānajñaḥ kavargādyañca maṅgalam budhaṃ śyāmaṃ nyasetpītaṃ ṭavargādyaṃ gale gurum nīlavarṇaṃ pavargādyaṃ nābhideśe śanaiścaram lakṣādyaṃ dhūmravarṇābhaṃ ketuṃ nābhau punarnyaset samānavarṇānuccāryya [hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ aṃ iṃ uṃ ṛṃ ḷṃ aiṃ oṃ aṃ mūrdhniṃ pūrve indrāya namaḥ, hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ āṃ īṃ ūṃ ṝṃ ḹṃ aiṃ auṃ aḥ mūrdhnyāgneyyāmagnaye namaḥ, hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ṅaṃ dakṣiṇe yamāya namo mukhe, ityādi || ] prāgindrāya namostu ke dakṣiṇe yamāya namaḥ kavargādyaṃ lalāṭake

ṭavargādyaṃ gale paścādvaruṇāya namastviti pavargādyaṃ kuberāya namo vai dakṣiṇe kare huṃ lakṣādyaṃ pṛthivyai hṛtpādayoriti vinyaset hrīṃtrīṃhuṃpūrvakaḥ kārya indriyāghaharaḥ paraḥ mūlādhāre [hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ ḍākinīyuktāya brahmaṇe namaḥ mūlādhāre, hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ baṃ bhaṃ maṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ śākinīyuktaviṣṇave namaḥ svādhiṣṭhāne, ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ paṃ phaṃ lākinīyukta rudrāya namaḥ maṇipūrake || ] nyaseccaiva caturdalasamanvite svādhiṣṭhānābhidhe cakre liṅgasthe ṣaḍdale nyaset nyaseccakre daśadale nābhisthe maṇipūrake vinyaseddvādaśadale hṛdayasthe tvanāhate kaṇṭhasthe ṣoḍaśadale viśuddhākhye pravinyaset hakṣārṇapūrvaṃ bhrūmadhyasaṃsthitetimanohare aṃ āṃkavargaṃ [hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ aṃ āṃ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ṅaṃ tārāyai namaḥ brahmarandhre, hrīṃḥ trīṃ huṃ iṃ īṃ caṃ chaṃ jaṃ jhaṃ ñaṃ ugrāyai namaḥ lalāṭe, hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ uṃ ūṃ ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ mahogrāyai namo bhruvoḥ, agrepyevaṃ jñeyam || ] hrīṃtrīṃhuṃ tārāyai nama ucyate hrīṃtrīṃhuṃ nama ugrāyai lalāṭe cāpi vinyaset hrīṃtrīṃhuṃ ca vajrāyai namontaṃ sakaleṣvapi omauṃ savaraṃ hrīṃtrīṃhuṃ kāmeśvaryyai ca liṅgake mūlādhāre nyasetpaścātpīṭhanyāsaṃ samācaret hṛdi jālandharaṃ pīṭha [hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ āṃ īṃ ūṃ ṛṃ ḷṃ aiṃ auṃ aḥ jālandharapīṭhāya namaḥ hṛdi || ] dīrghapūrvaṃ pravinyaset uḍḍiyānaṃ [hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ caṃ chaṃ jaṃ jhaṃ ñaṃ uḍḍiyānapīṭhāya namaḥ keśasandhau || ] cavargāhyaṃ keśasandhau pravinyaset tavargapūrvikāṃ [hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ avantīpīṭhāya namaḥ nayanadvaye ityādi || ] nyasyedavantīṃ nayanadvaye kaṇṭhe tu mathurāpīṭhaṃ yavargādyaṃ pravinyaset kaṭau kāñcīpurīpīṭhaṃ daśamantu pravinyaset mahāpralayapānīye lasacchvetāmbujasthitām sarppakāñcīṃ sarppakarāṃ sarppakaṃkaṇakuṇḍalām piṅgograikajaṭāṃ tryakṣāṃ vyāghratvakparidhāyinīm narāsthipaṭṭaṃ badhnantīṃ bhāle'kṣobhyamunīśvarām nānāprakārapūjāsyāstantretantre prakāśitā

saṃskārā vaidikā yasya tasmai vidyā na sidhyati ubhayoḥ kulanāśaḥ syāddaridro janmajanmani sādhitā vāmamārgeṇa devānāṃ vijayāya ca svavikramaṃ khyāpayitvā śakro devapatiḥ kṛtaḥ kṛtvā tu tāntrikasnānampūjārthaṃ jalamāharet upānatpāduke tyaktvā pūjako jalamāharet tāraṃ [oṃ hrīṃ suviśuddhadharmmasarvapāpāniśāmyāśeṣavikalpānayanāya svāhā || ] māyāṃ suviśuddhadharmmasarvapadaṃ vadet yaḥ svāheti ca ṣaḍviṃśadarṇa ācamane manuḥ dharivajriṇi śikhariṇi ca sarvavaśaṅkare bhūmiśuddhiṃ navārṇena tataḥ kuryyāttu sādhakaḥ trayodaśārṇamantreṇa vighnānutsārayettataḥ oṃsarvavighnānutsāraya [oṃ sarvavighnānutsāraya huṃphaṭ svāhā || ] huṃphaṭ jvalanapriyā tadutthenāgninā dehandahetsārddhaṃ svapāpmanā pavanena tadutthena pāpabhasma kṣipedbhuvi anayā bhūtaśuddhyā tu devīsādṛśyamāpnuyāt pavitravajra [oṃ pavitravajrabhūme huṃphaṭsvāhā || ] bhūme huṃsvāhā mantro bhavākṣaraḥ āsure [oṃ āsurekhe vajrarekhe huṃ svāhā || ] khe vajrarekhe huṃsvāhāpraṇavādikaḥ tārādihuṁphaṭsvāhānto nṛpavarṇo manurmataḥ oṃ [oṃ oṃ hrīṃ svāhā || ] āṃ hrīṃ vahnigṛhiṇī pañcārṇaścittaśodhane bhūmiṃ pūrvoktamantreṇa maṇḍalasya tu maṇḍalam kuryyāttatrādhāraśaktiṃ kūrmmaṃ śeṣaṃ ca saṃyajet ādhāraṃ pūjayettatra vaṃ vahnimaṇḍalāya [oṃ vaṃ vahnimaṇḍalāya namaḥ || ] ca huṃphaṭmantreṇa saṃkṣālya sthīṃbījena niveśayet ekādaśākṣaro mantrastenapūjādikammatam dvādaśārṇenātrabhavetkapālārcā dvitīyikā

ekādaśārṇonenoktā kapālārccā tṛtīyikā tato dhārāya sarvāya tathā sarvodbhavāya ca rāruṇāya ca śubhrāyetisurābhājanāya ca ṣaṭpañcāśatkavarṇoyaṃ kapālasya tu pūjane oṃsūryyamaṇḍalāyeti namontoyaṃ navākṣaraḥ mūlamantraṃ [oṃ hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ phaṭ || ] paṭhaṃstasminsudhābuddhyā surāṃ kṣipet mudrāṃ sā tu karau vyastāvaṃguṣṭhau kārayetsamau kaniṣṭhike nijasthāne trikhaṇḍāhvānakarmmaṇi ekādaśārṇena tataḥ śaṃkhatoyantu mantrayet hsau rhumiti vāgādyo mantra ekādaśākṣaraḥ śaṃkhamudrāṃ [vāmāṃguṣṭhaṃ tu saṃgṛhya dakṣahastasya muṣṭinā | kṛtottānāṃ tathāmuṣṭimaṃguṣṭhaṃ tu prasārayet || vāmāguṃlyastathā śiṣṭāḥ saṃyutāḥ saprasāditāḥ || dakṣiṇāṃguṣṭhake lagnā mudrā śaṃkhasya bhūtidā || ] yonimudrāṃ [mithaḥ kaniṣṭhike badhvā | tarjanībhyāmanāmike || anāmikordhvaṃ saṃśliṣṭadīrghāmadhyamayoradha || aṃguṣṭhāgradyaṃ prasya yonimudreyamīritā |] śaṃkhatoyāya darśayet pūrvoktāṃ pūjayitvaināṃ mūlenātha pratarppayet sāṃguṣṭhābhiścaturvāraṃ mahāśaṃkhasthite jale oṃhrauṃhsauṃ ca namontoyaṃ mantro bhairavapūjane yonimudrāṃ pradarśyātha praṇamedbhavatāriṇīm dharāgṛhāvṛte pīṭhamādāvarcyaṃ saśaktikam caturdaśākṣaro mantraḥ proktaḥ pīṭhasya pūjane vidyeśvarīti samproktā pīṭhasya nava śaktayaḥ kṣetrapālaṃ yoginīṃ ca dhyātvā samyakprapūjayet alaṃkāracayopetaṃ gaṇeśaṃ prākprapūjayet śvayūthaveṣṭitaṃ ramyaṃ baṭukaṃ dakṣiṇe'rcayet kṛṣṇaṃ digambaraṃ krūraṃ kṣetrapaṃ paścime yajet raktamālyāṃ raktavastrāṃ yoginīmuttare yajet muniṃ dvādaśavarṇena manunā sa nigadyate atha sampūjayetkoṇaṣaṭkadevyā ṣaḍaṅgakam

padmanābhaṃ śaṃkhapāṇḍuraṃ pūrvādau samarcayet pāṇḍurāṃ tārakāṃ cāpi bhūgṛhadvāratorcayet vighnāntakaṃ narāntaṃ ca vakṣyante manavorcane sambuddhyataṃ ca tannāma vajrapuṣpampratīccha ca śakrādīṃścāpi vajrādīn pūjayettadanantaram madyāmbumīnapiśitamudrāpiṣṭambhavedyathā śrīmadekajaṭe [oṃ hrīṃ śrīmadekajaṭe nīlasarasvati mahogratāre devi khakhasarvabhūtapiśācarākṣasān grasagrasa mama jāḍyaṃ chedayachedaya śrīṃhrīṃphaṭsvāhā || ] nīlasarasvati mahogra ca tāre devi khakhetyuktvā sarvabhūtapiśācarākṣasān grasagrasa mama jāḍyaṃ chedayachedaya bhaveddvipañcāśadarṇaḥ pūjaiveṣṭārṇatāmiyāt madyaṃ māṃsaṃ ca tāmbūlañjapellakṣacatuṣṭayam ādau yantrampūjayitvā japasthāne japañcaret na kāryyaḥ subhruvāṃ dveṣo yatnataḥ paripūjayet śmaśāne śūnyasadane devāgāretha nirjane samare śatrunihataṃ yadā ṣaṇmāsikaṃ śiśum evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī prayogānkarttumarhati jihvāyāṃ sa likhenmantrammadhvājyābhyāṃ śalākayā gateṣṭamebde bālosau jāyate kavirāḍ dhruvam taracca jalamadhye tatsamānīya taṭe punaḥ madhutailasurābhiśca saṃlikhetpadminīdale nikhāya taddalaṃ kuṇḍe caturasre samekhale homānte tena manunā pūrvadravyairbaliṃ haret svāhāntaḥ praṇavādiśca mantroyaṃ ṣoḍaśākṣaraḥ nivāso bhāratīlakṣmyorjanatārañjanakṣamaḥ lalāṭe tilakaṃ kṛtvā yaṃ paśyetsa tu dāsavat kṛṣṇāmbareṇa saṃveṣṭya nibaddhaṃ raktatantubhiḥ

uccāṭayati saptāhātsakuṭumbaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ravivāre niśīthinyāṃ sahasramabhimantrayet kṣetre kṣiptaṃ sasyahānyai javahṛtturagālaye oṃ [oṃ trīṃhrīṃhrūṃhrīṃhuṃ phaṭ || ] trīṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ samuccāryahrīṃhuṃphaṭ saptavarṇakaḥ śvetāmbarāṃ candrakānticandrārdhakṛtaśekharām nānālaṃkāraśobhāḍhyāṃ trīkṣaṇāmpadmasaṃsthitām madhupuṣkarapatrānnahomādvidyānidhirbhavet uccāṭane dhūmra varṇāṃ śāntau śvetāṃ vicintayet brahmaṇopāsitāntārāṃ dvādaśārṇāṃ sudurlabhām tāre huṃphaḍiti prokto mantroyaṃ dvādaśākṣaraḥ hiraṇyakaśipordātuṃ varaṃ saptārṇasammitām huṃphaḍantaḥ sarvamasya nyāsādyampūrvavadbhavet bauddhamārgapracārārthaṃ siddhidā dvādaśākṣarī sauruktvā sādhitā vidyā dvādaśārṇātibuddhidā tasyāstu pūrvavajjñeyaṃ nyāsadhyānajapādikam lakṣmīprabhṛtirā [rāsasamaye lakṣmīnāmagopyādivilāsārtham || ] sārthaṃ tayā mattastadā halī tyaktvā tatra sauścoktvā vidyā rāmeṇa [dāśarathinā || ] sevitā dhyānapūjādikamprāgvatprayogādikameva ca pañcārṇāṃ yatprabhāveṇa daityānāṃ kadanaṃ kṛtam eṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ tu munirviṣṇuḥ prāgvajjapādikam dattā ca raviṇādityai sā vidyā tu ṣaḍakṣarī jñeyaṃ nyāsādikaṃ pūrvaṃ prayogādi ca pūrvavat jalandharavadhārthaṃ tu mayā siddhīkṛtaṃ purā mayā pañcamukhairjapto dakṣamārgeṇa bhoḥ surāḥ yamānāṃ niyamānāṃ ca tatrasthā nānyadevatā

dakṣiṇārādhitā devā raṇasāhāyyakārakāḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ kṣayārthaṃ tu mayā rāmāya cārpitāḥ matsyasthāne khaṇḍakādyaṃ dharmmapatnyāṃ rataṃ matam kastu tārāṃ na seveta lokadvayaparīpsayā tārāyāḥ sadgurau siddhiḥ strīrate bhrāntatā bhavet siddhā mārgadvayenāpi varṇavarṇādhikārataḥ tārāyai sakaletyuktvā dustarāttārayadvayam nyāsapujājapādyaṃ tu prāgvatsarvaṃ samācaret krīṃ [krīṃ krīṃ krīṃ huṃ huṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ dakṣiṇe kālike krīṃ krīṃ krīṃ huṃ huṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ svāhā || ] krīṃ krīṃ huṃ dviruccāryya lajjābījadvayaṃ tathā krameṇaivāgnigṛhiṇī mantro dvāviṃśadarṇakaḥ devatā kālikā devī hrīṃ bījaṃ huṃ ca śaktikā ṣaḍaṅgāni nyasenmantrī dviḥ sakṛdvā yathāvidhi daśabhirdaśabhiḥ kuryyāttathā jaṅghādvaye kramāt saptabhiścāpi mantrārṇarvyāpakaṃ ca samantataḥ kālikāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ divyāṃ muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitām mahāmeghaprabhāṃ śyāmāṃ tathā caiva digambarām karṇāvataṃsatānītaśavayugmavirājitām śavānāṃ karasaṅgātaiḥ kṛtakāñcīṃ hasanmukhīm ghorarūpāṃ mahāraudrīṃ śmaśānālayavāsinīm śavarūpamahādevahṛdayoparisaṃsthitām mahākālasamāyuktāṃ śarvopariratānvitām evaṃ sañcintayetkālīṃ śmaśānālayavāsinīm padmamaṣṭadalaṃ bāhye bhūpuraṃ tatra pūjayet mahākālaṃ ca tatraiva nyasedeṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ kālīṃ kapālinīṃ kullāṃ prathame tu trikoṇake

kurukullāvirodhinyau vipracittāṃ tṛtīyake mātrāṃ murdrā ca mitrāṃ ca trikoṇe pañcame yajet tarjjanīṃ vāmahastena dhārayanti ca sasmitāḥ sampūjya yatnataścāpi baliṃ sampratipādayet nirmālyaṃ vai śucau deśe dhārayecca sadaiva hi daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādājyaistarpayedabhiṣecayet tataḥ prayogānkurvīta kāmyāniṣṭaphalāptaye devīmevaṃ ca sañcintya mahākālasamīpagām ante tu mūlamantrasya japapūjādikaṃ caret svaṃsvaṃ santyajya bharttāramāliṅganti sadaiva tam dhyātvā sampūjayetpuṣpaiḥ pītairākarṣaṇaṃ bhavet dhyātvaivaṃ sarvamantrānte ṭhadvayaṃ parikīrtayet maraṇaṃ tu bhavettasya yamuddiśya kṛtā kriyā vidrāvayati śuṣkāsyā pronmattayati ghūrṇikā saṅkocayati saṃruddhā viruddhā ca virodhayet uccāṭanaṃ vinānyatra sarvatra surataṃ matam avākyo muktakeśaśca tena syuḥ sarvasiddhayaḥ sa bhavetsarvasiddhīnāṃ pāragaḥ sarvadaiva hi gadyapadyamayī vāṇī tasya sarvavidhā bhavet prajapedayutaṃ tāvadevaṃ pratinidhirbhavet anarghakavitā tasya gadyapadyamayī bhavet prayāti maithunaṃ yosau dhanadhānyasutānvitaḥ yadi yoṣitprasaṅgena retaḥ patati yatnataḥ śmaśānāṅgāramādāya muktakeśo digambaraḥ pretamāruhya tatraiva yo japenmantravittamaḥ

sa yāti paramāṃ siddhiṃ devairapi sudurlabhām śmaśāne'bhyarcayeddevīṃ vāgīśasamatāṃ vrajet śmaśāne'bhyarcayeddevīṃ sarvāṃ siddhiṃ sa vindati sukhī syānnātra sandeho mahākālavaco yathā raktacandanadigdhāṅgīṃ raktapuṣpairalaṅkṛtām tato gatvāpnuyādrājyaṃ yadyasau na bibheti vai asakṛttu japenmantraṃ sarvasiddhiprado [mantra iti vā puruṣaḥ iti vā śiṣyate mantraśeṣapakṣe tasyetyarghyāhāryamiti gauravam 2 || tadanyatra neti jñeyam || ?] bhavet tristrirmantrānudīryyaivaṃ sarvasiddhirbhavettataḥ retobhiśca tathā tadvat svakīyena kacena ca mūṣamārjjāraraktena vāgmitvaṃ tasya jāyate vacasā sa bhavejjīvo dhanena ca dhanādhipaḥ balena pavano jyeṣṭhassarvatattvārthasādhakaḥ mūṣamāṃsaṃ meṣamāṃsaṃ chāgaṃ māhiṣameva ca nivedayecchamaśāne tatsarvasiddhiprado [karmeti śeṣaḥ || ] bhavet pratyekaṃ prajapenmantraṃ tatastaddhomayedbudhaḥ sarvasiddhirbhavettasya vāgmī dhīrassa jāyate yonirūpaṃ hi kṛtvā tu kuṇḍaṃ vitastyaratnitaḥ tatra kāryyā hi mantreṇa vahnisthāpanikāḥ kriyāḥ sruveṇājyena māṃsena bhaktena rudhireṇa ca āmiṣādibhirapyevaṃ juhuyācca śmaśānake divā sarvaṃ prakurvīta sarvakāmārthasiddhaye prakurvīta prayatnena sarvakāmārthasiddhaye śūdrāṇāṃ caiva saṃprokto rātrāveva vidhirmayā tridhā vibhajya mantrādyairyatnātsādhakasattamaḥ ājyaṃ ceti prayatnena hotavyaṃ sarvasiddhaye

yadyatprārthayate jantustattatprāpnoti nityaśaḥ havanāt sarvamāpnoti nityamevamatandritaḥ homaṃ tu raktapuṣpeṇa kuṇḍe kuryyādyathāvidhi pitṛmātṛvadhādyaiśca kimanyaiḥ kṣudrapātakaiḥ yaṃyaṃ spṛṣṭvā japenmantrī sa taṃ taṃ vaśamānayet kuryyānnṛpaṃ vaśe mantrī nāsādhyaṃ bhuvanatraye brahmacārī haviṣyāśī bhavedindrasamo japāt ayutaṃ juhuyānmantrī sahasratritayaṃ punaḥ tarpayecca punastadvaddevīṃ dhyātvā hutāśane ghṛtāktamālatīpuṣpairhomāddrutakavirbhavet devyārādhanaśaktiśca gurubhaktasya nānyathā dakṣiṇe kālike svāhā mantroṣṭākṣara īritaḥ mahākālaratāsaktāṃ śivābhirdikṣu veṣṭitām tathāparājayā nityā vilāsinyapi kīrttitā hrīṃkālikāyogapīṭhātmane nama udāhṛtaḥ kālīṃ kapālinīṃ kullāṃ kurukullāṃ virodhinīm ugrāmugraprabhāṃ dīptāṃ nīlāṃ ghanāṃ vācālikām pūrvoktabhūpure pūjyā bhairavyoṣṭau ca bhairavīḥ dhūmrākhyā bhairavī turyyā pañcamī bhīmabhairavī saptamī bhairavī khyātāṣṭamī mohanabhairavī puraścaryyādikaṃ prāgvatprayogānācarettathā ātmano hitamanvicchankālībhakto vivarjayet tasya syuracirādeva karasthāḥ sarvasiddhayaḥ sādhakena hi ktiyugmamasya nyāsādi pūrvavat pañcamapratimityāyaṃ [pañcamakārapratimityā || ] dakṣiṇāmnāyasiddhidaḥ

krīṃ huṃ hrīṃ dakṣiṇe kālike krīṃhuṃhrīṃ dahanapriyā viśeṣānnasurādīnāmayamākarṣaṇakṣamaḥ huṃca trirdviśca lajjā svāhetyākṛtivarṇavān japādetasya bhūtiśca sarvamanyattu pūrvavat dakṣiṇe kālike svāhā nṛpavarṇaḥ [ṣoḍaśārṇaḥ || ] prakīrttitaḥ viśeṣāṅgatarājyānāmayaṃ rājyaprado mataḥ upavāsaparaścaivamekāhātsiddhimāpnuyāt ārdroṣṇīṣa ārdravāsāstena mantraḥ prasidhyati athavā prajapenmantraṃ śmaśāne vigatajvaraḥ japapūjādiprāgvadviśeṣādbhogamokṣadam nyāsapūjādikaṃ prāgvaddviśeṣādbhogado mataḥ prāgvajjapādikaṃ cāsya viśeṣātsantatipradaḥ nyāsadhyānādikaṃ prāgvadviśeṣādbhūtanāśanaḥ prāgvannyāsādikaṃ sarvaṃ viśeṣācchāntikārakaḥ dhūṃdhūṃ dhūmāvati svāhā mantroṣṭākṣara īritaḥ ṣaḍ dīrghabinduyuktena dhakāreṇa ṣaḍaṅgakam aṃguṣṭhādiṣaḍaṅgeṣu punardevīṃ vicintayet vimuktakuntalāṃ dīrghāṃ vidhavāṃ viraladvijām śūrppahastāṃ tu rūkṣākṣīṃ dhūtahastāṃ tvarānvitām kṣutpipāsārditāṃ nityaṃ sadā kalahatatparām pūrvokte pūjayetpīṭhe jyeṣṭhāṃ śatrunivarttane akṣameti tato devā indrādyā āyudhānvitāḥ śūnyāgāre śmaśāne vā kāntāre bhūdharethavā evaṃ lakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ nāśayedacirādarīn juhuyāllavaṇopetāṃ rājikāṃ niśi tatphalam

sahasrādūrdhvataḥ śatrujvareṇa parigṛhyate dvitīyāntaṃ manau śatrornāmaivaṃ manumālikhet unmādo jāyate śatrormanorayutajāpataḥ virodhināmnāṣṭāśāsu kṣipramuccāṭanaṃ ripoḥ virodhināma saṃruddhaṃ kṛṣṇapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet mahiṣīrūpeṇāgatya svapne śatruṃ vināśayet samuccāṭayate tūrṇaṃ nātra kāryyā vicāraṇā dhūmāvatīmanuṃ mantrī śatruryamapuraṃ vrajet jalasthaḥ prajapenmantraṃ huṃkārānnāśayedarīn bhagavanniti sambhāṣya manasā karmma cintayet citākāṣṭhānale kṣīrahomācchāntiḥ prajāyate mārayatyarimāgatya śāntirnirmālyadhūpataḥ aśvatthapatradhūpena śāntirbhavati nānyathā kṣīreṇa śāntirbhavati madhuratritayena vā japtvā padadvaye mantrī khaneduccāṭanaṃ ripoḥ vāyasebhyo baliṃ dattvā śatroruccāṭanaṃ bhavet śatrugehepi sañjaptāṃ śatroruccāṭanaṃ bhavet gardabhāvāsabhūmau vā pretasthāne catuṣpathe śmaśānastho viniḥkṣipya citāgnau marjayettathā senāmadhyepi sarveṣāṃ kṣaṇāduccāṭanaṃ bhavet bhramate kākavatsarvāṃ mahīmāvaraṇādiṣu āyāsairmantramāvṛtya vakṣyamāṇaiḥ praveṣṭayet saptarātreṇa tasyāpi bhaveduccāṭanaṃ dhruvam mantreṇa damitau sādhyau bhaumavārodaye raveḥ vyatyasya pṛṣṭhato baddhvā keśapāśena taṃ japet

vidveṣaṇaṃ bhavetsadyo gaurīśaṃkarayorapi anyadviṣatarostadvajjapitvoddhṛtya vinyaset ete prayogāḥ kathitā dhūmāvatyā mayā surāḥ caturdaśākṣaro mantro bhadrakālyā udāhṛtaḥ dhyātavyeyaṃ sadā devī bhadrakālī bhayāpahā maṣīmukhī muktakeśī jagadvasanalālasā japapūjāprayogādyaṃ yo viśeṣaḥ sa ucyate iyaṃ devī mahādevī śatruvigrahakāriṇī gṛdhrakarṇi [gṛdhrakarṇi virūpākṣi lambastani mahodari utpādayotpādaya upari vetti vetti huṃphaṭ svāhā || ] virūpākṣi lambastani mahodari dvidhā vetti padaṃ huṃphaṭ svāhā saptāgnivarṇakaḥ bhadrakālī devatā syāddvirutpādaya hṛtsmṛtam huṃphaḍbhyāṃ kavacaṃ proktaṃ svāhayāstramudīritam suvṛttanayanāṃ śūrāṃ dīrghaghoṇāṃ madāturām kuṭilabhrukuṭīdīptāṃ mahāradanabhīṣaṇām triśūlavyagradordaṇḍāṃ narakīṃ pippalāśinīm śiromālābhūṣitāṅgīṃ pibantīṃ śoṇitāsavam piśācaskandhamāruhya bhramantīṃ vasudhātale itthaṃbhūtāṃ bhadrakālīṃ mātṛbhiḥ parivāritām ayutaṃ mantrasiddhyarthaṃ mātṛkānyāsatatparaḥ dhūmāvatyā ca yatproktamanayāpi tadācaret viṣavṛkṣaṃ samādāya tato homaṃ samācaret viṣavṛkṣendhanenāgniṃ prajvālyāvāhayetsudhīḥ aṣṭottaraśataṃ vahnau taṃ daṇḍaṃ nikṣipedbudhaḥ dikṣu sarvāsu saṃsthāpyāḥ svamedāḥ khaḍgahastakāḥ aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā daṇḍāgraṃ jātavedasi

agnyādīṃścāpi santoṣya balidānena devatām śūlāgraprotasiṃhāṃ ca naramālāvibhūṣitām ulkāhastāṃ śatrusaṅghaṃ śilāyāṃ nighnatīṃ muhuḥ gatvā dūreṇa visṛjettaṃ daṇḍaṃ dhyānamāsthitaḥ snātvāvaśyaṃ śucirbhūtvā kaṇṭhamātrodake sthitaḥ aṣṭottarasahasrantu japedanyacchataṃ śatam pādayugmaṃ samālambya varṇalakṣaṃ japenmanum dakṣiṇā vidhivaddattvā śāntihomañca kārayet kṛtvābhiṣekaṃ tābhyāntu śaktito bhojayeddvijān rudradaṇḍaprayogoyaṃ dāruṇoragasūdanaḥ uccāṭanaṃ bhavetkṣipramacalasyāpi kiṃ nṛṇāṃ trikoṇeripratikṛtiṃ likhetsamyagadhomukhīm pādapāto yathā śatroḥ syāttathoccāṭayedbalāt oṃ kṣreṃ kṣreṃ kremataḥ kreṃ ca paśuṃ gṛhāṇa coccaret nāsya munyādikanyāsaḥ siddhamantrasya vidyate bāhmyādibhiśca dūtībhiryuktāṃ sampūjya bhaktitaḥ pañcavaktrāṃ mahāraudrīṃ prativaktraṃ trilocanām vāmadakṣabhujairdevīṃ bibhrāṇāṃ bhogibhūṣaṇām picumandasya samidho ghṛtāktā juhuyāttataḥ evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī mārayedacirādripūn smaredananyamanasā mānavo mānamāpnuyāt huṃsa uktvā huṃ tathāstraṃ svāhāntaḥ ṣoḍaśākṣaraḥ mahāvāyurmahāpṛthvī mahākāśastathaiva ca mahāgniśceti hūṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ parikīrtitā mantradevāṃstato mantrī dhyāyetsusthiramānasaḥ

vyāghrādipaśubhirvyāptaṃ sānuyuktaṃ giriṃ smaret ghanatoyaṃ sakallolamakūpāraṃ vicintayet pītavarṇaṃ mahāvahniṃ saṃsmarecchatruśāntaye pavanaṃ saṃsmaredviśvajīvanaṃ prāṇarūpataḥ ādhārabhūtā jagato dhyeyā pṛthvīha mantriṇā nirmalaṃ gaganaṃ dhyāyetprāṇināmāśrayapradam japenmantraṃ daśāṃśena ṣaḍdravyairhomamācaret etānhutvā yathābhāgaṃ pīṭhe pūrvodite yajet śatrūpadrava āpanne yuñjītātra mahāmanum patanonmukhamatyugraṃ prācyāṃ diśi vicintayet samudrarūpiṇaṃ bhīmaṃ pratīcyāṃ diśi cintayet śatruvargaṃ ca badhnantau cintayenniyatātmavān nirundhānaṃ smarenmantrī vidadhadripumākulam pratyekaṃ tu nirundhānaṃ cintayetsādhakottamaḥ utthāpya vahniṃ taddehaṃ pradahetsa manuṃ smaret maṇḍalatritayādarvāgdārayettena vidviṣam saṃśodhayitvā cātmānaṃ svarakṣāyai hariṃ smaret oṃ [oṃ hrīṃ namaḥ kṛṣṇavāsase stute viśvasahasrahiṃsini sahasrāvane mahabaleparājite pratyaṅgire parasainyaparakarmmavidhvaṃsini paramantrotsādini sarvabhūtadamani sarvadevānbandhabandha sarvavidyāṃ chindhi chindhi kṣobhayakṣobhaya parayantrāṇi sphoṭayasphoṭaya sarvaśṛṃkhalāṃ troṭayatroṭaya jvalajvālājihve karālavadane pratyaṃgire hrīṃ namaḥ || ] hrīṃ namaḥ kṛṣṇavāsase stute viśvasahasra pratyaṅgire parasainyapara karmmapadaṃ vadet sarvabhūteti damani sarvadevānvadettataḥ parayantrāṇīti vadetsphoṭayadvitayaṃ tataḥ jvālājihve karāleti vadane pratyaṅuccaret brahmānuṣṭummuniśchando devī pratyaṅgirā matā ṣaḍaṅgānāṃ vidhiścātra ṣaḍdīrghānvitamāyayā śūlaśastrakarā khaḍgaṃ dadhatī yā tu tāṃ bhaje

hutvā siddhamanurmantrī prayogeṣu śataṃ japet vināśayetparakṛtaṃ yantramantrādisādhanam navadurgātmakaṃ yasya sevanādbhuktimuktike saṃsārabandhanirnāśi jñānamāptaṃ samādhinā japādyasya phalaṃ dadyāttaṃ manuṃ vacmi sāmpratam vicce navārṇamantroyaṃ śaktimantrottamottamaḥ gāyatryuṣṇiganuṣṭup ca cchandastrayamudīritam nandāśākambharībhīmāśaktitrayamudāhṛtam agnivāyubhagāstattvaṃ prāgvadṛṣyādikaṃ nyaset tata ekādaśanyāsānkuryyādiṣṭaphalapradān kṛtena yena devasya sārūpyaṃ yāti mānavaḥ bījatrayaṃ [oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ klīṃ namaḥ kaniṣṭhāyugme, oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ klīṃ namaḥ anāmikāyugme, oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ klīṃ namaḥ madhyamāyugme, asyaiva ṣaḍakṣarasya nyāsāccheṣasthāneṣvapi kuryyāt || ] tu mantrādyaṃ tārādihṛdayāntakam kaniṣṭhānāmikāmadhyātarjanyaṃguṣṭhayugmake hṛdayādiṣaḍaṅgeṣu jātiyuktaṃ punarnyaset nyāsaḥ kāryaḥ saptaśatyāḥ paṭhetkāmaviśeṣataḥ māyābījādikā [hlīṃ brāhmī māṃ pūrvataḥ pātu, hrīṃ māheśvarī āgneyyāṃ pātu evamanyatranyasyet || ] brāhmī pūrvataḥ pātu māṃ sadā aiśānye tu mahālakṣmīrūrdhvaṃ vyomeśvarī tathā tṛtīyesminkṛte nyāse trailokye vijayī bhavet nandajā pātu pūrvāṅgaṃ kamalāṃkuśamaṇḍitā pṛṣṭhe śākambharī pātu puṣpapallavasaṃyutā śiraḥpātrakarā bhīmā mastakāccaraṇāvadhi turyyaṃ nyāsaṃ naraḥ kurvañjarāmṛtyuṃ vyapohati pādādinābhiparyantaṃ brahmā pātu sanātanaḥ viśuddherbrahmarandhrāntampātu rudrastrilocanaḥ cakṣuṣī vṛṣabhaḥ pātu sarvāṅgāni gajānanaḥ

kṛtesminpañcame nyāse sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt madhyaṃ pātu mahālakṣmīraṣṭādaśabhujānvitā adhaḥ pātu mahākālī daśabāhusamanvitā siṃho hastadvayampātu parahaṃsokṣiyugmakam mahiṣaścaṇḍikāyuktaḥ savārṅgāni mamāvatu mūlākṣaranyāsarūpantataḥ kurvīta saptamam brahmarandhre [aiṃnamaḥ brahmarandhre, hrīṃnamaḥ dakṣanetre, klīṃnamaḥ vāmanetre || evamanyatrāpi śeṣeṣu nyaset || ] netrayuge śrutyornāsikayormukhe namontānsaptamesmiṃstu kṛte rogakṣayo bhavet kṛtesminnaṣṭame nyāse sarvaṃ duḥkhaṃ vinaśyati mastakāccaraṇaṃ yāvaccaraṇānmastakāvadhi mūlamantrakṛto nyāso navamo devatāptikṛt kṛtesmindaśame nyāse trailokyaṃ vaśamānayet anyanyāsoktaphaladaṃ kuryādekādaśantataḥ ādyaṃ kṛṣṇataraṃ bījaṃ dhyātvā sarvāṅgake nyaset paṭhitvā sūryasadṛśaṃ dvitīyaṃ pṛṣṭhato nyaset śikhāyāṃ netrayoḥ śrutyornasorvaktre gude nyaset tato devītrayaṃ dhyāyetkālikādhyānamucyate indranīladyutiṃ khaḍgaṃ [khaṅgaṃ] cakraṃ śaṅkhaṃ śiraḥ śarān madhukaiṭabhanāśārthaṃ sālaṅkārāṃ trivīkṣaṇām samastadevatātejojātāṃ padmāsanasthitām khaḍgaṃ vajraṃ gadāṃ cakrandakṣahaste kamaṇḍalum carmadaṇḍau surāpātraṃ ghaṃṭāṃ pāśaṃ triśūlakam śaṃkhaṃ ca muśalaṃ cakraṃ dakṣahasteṣu bibhratīm gaurīdehasamudbhūtāṃ nṛṇāmānandadāyinīm adhiṣṭhātrīṃ tṛtīyaṃ hi caritraṃ ca smaretsadā

pāyasānnena juhuyātpūjite hemaretasi etadyantraṃ vṛttatryasraṣaṭkoṇāṣṭadalānvitam vidārayantaṃ mahiṣaṃ prākkoṇe mṛgapaṃ yajet śākambharīṃ tathā durgāṃ bhīmāṃ ca bhrāmarīṃ yajet sarvāsāmeva śaktīnāṃ nāmamantrā yataḥ smṛtāḥ vaiṣṇavīṃ cāpi vārāhīṃ tathendrāṇīṃ prapūjayet viṣṇu māyāṃ cetanāṃ ca buddhiṃ nidrāṃ kṣudhāntathā lajjāṃ śāntiṃ tathā śraddhāṃ kāntiṃ lakṣmīṃ dhṛtiṃ tathā puṣṭiṃ ca mātaraṃ bhrāntimarcayedbhūpureṣu ca yoginīśca sureśādyāṃstadbāhye cāyudhāni ca puṭitaṃ mūlamantreṇa japannāpnoti vāñchitam vāmadakṣiṇamārgābhyāmadhikāriphalapradā upasargavināśāya madhyamaṃ yojayedbudhaḥ caritradvayaśīlasya na vaṃśaśchidyate kvacit anādyaṃ paṭhate yastu mārayedacirādripūn yastu mantreṇa puṭitaṃ tatpṛṭhāṅkasya saṃkhyayā svaśatrūndaityabhāvena svamitrāndevatādhiyā mṛtā vā mṛtakalpā vā śatravaḥ syurna saṃśayaḥ japellakṣamanuṃ homaḥ khādyaistrimadhurāplutaiḥ viprāngurūnsamārādhya vāñchitaṃ labhate drutam chando gāyatramuditaṃ mahākālī tu devatā prayogāṇāntu navatirmāraṇe mohanetra tu uṣṇik chando mahālakṣmīrdevatā bījamadrijā uccāṭe stambhane cātra prayogāṇāṃ śatadvayam mahāsarasvatī devī triṣṭup chanda udāhṛtam

vidveṣavaśyayoścātra prayogā dikkṛtairmitāḥ tasmātsaptaśatītyevaṃ vyāsena parikīrtitā tasmātsaptaśatītyevaṃ proktā vyāsena dhīmatā tasmātsaptaśatītyevaṃ proktā vyāsena dhīmatā upāsyā devatā yāstā iha saptaśatī hyataḥ sarasvatī ceti sapta hyupāsyā vāmamārgataḥ bālā kubhreti manavaḥ sūcitāḥ samprakīrtitāḥ tattanmantroktasaṅketairmantraśaktiḥ prajāyate carite śaktayassapta cāmuṇḍāntāḥ prakīrtitāḥ brahmāṇyādyāḥ saptasaṃkhyā vartamānāśca tatra hi śaktyaḥ proktāḥ svayaṃ devyāstasmātsaptaśatī smṛtā pādonaṃ śrīharirvetti vettyardhantu prajāpatiḥ yathāmantrastu siddyarthaṃ yojyate kriyatethavā varṇānāṃ ca padānāṃ ca vyatyāsastu vyavasthitaḥ śabdaśāstrāviruddhastu pāṭhaḥ śantikapauṣṭike japedaṣṭaśatammūlaṃ devatāyai nivedayet śatacaṇḍīvidhānantu pravakṣye ca priyaṃ nṛṇām ativṛṣṭyāmanāvṛṣṭau paracakrabhaye kṣaye rogāṇāṃ vairiṇāṃ nāśo dhanaputrasamṛddhayaḥ tatra kuṇḍaṃ prakurvīta pratīcyāmmadhyatopi vā vyutpannāṃścaṇḍikāpāṭhe ratāṃllajjādayāvataḥ pādyārghyamāsanammālāṃ dadyāttebhyopi bhojanam mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇoktaṃ daśakṛtvaḥ sacetasaḥ yajamānaḥ pūjayecca kanyānāṃ navakaṃ śubham nādhikāṅgīṃ na hīnāṅgīṃ kuṣṭhinīṃ ca vraṇāṅkitām

dāsījātāmbhogayuktāmiṣṭāṃ kanyāṃ na pūjayet vaiśyajāṃ dhanalābhāya putrāptyai śūdrajāṃ yajet caturabdā tu kalyāṇī pañcavarṣā tu rohiṇī aṣṭavarṣā śāmbhavī syāddurgā tu navahāyanā ekābdāṃ hyaprītibhāvādrudrābdāntu vivarjjayet mantrākṣaramayīṃ lakṣmīṃ mātṝṇāṃ rūpadhāriṇīm kumārikādi nyānāmpūjāmantrānbruve'dhunā pūjāṃ gṛhāṇa kaumāri jaganmātarnamostu te trailokyavanditāṃ devīṃ trimūrtiṃ pūjayāmyaham kalyāṇajananīnnityāṃ kalyāṇīṃ pūjayāmyaham kāmadāṃ karuṇodārāṃ kālikāmpūjayāmyaham pūjayāmi sadā devīṃ caṇḍikāṃ caṇḍavikramām sarvabhūtātmikāṃ lakṣmīṃ śāmbhavīṃpūjayāmyaham sundarīṃ pūjayedbhaktyā durgāndurgārtināśinīm subhadrajananīṃ devīṃ subhadrāmpūjayāmyaham gandhaiḥ puṣpairbhakṣyakhādyairvastrairābharaṇairapi ghaṭaṃ saṃsthāpya vidhivattatrāvāhyārcayecchivām upacāraiśca vidhivatpūrvoktāvaraṇānyapi pāyasānnaistrimadhvaktairdrākṣārambhāphalairapi jātīphalairāmraphalairanyairmadhuravastubhiḥ ayutaṃ ca navārṇena sthāpitegnau vidhānataḥ kṛtvā pūrṇāhutiṃ samyagdevamagniṃ visṛjya ca niṣkaṃ suvarṇamatha vā pratyekandakṣiṇāṃ diśet tebhyopi dakṣiṇāndattvā gṛhṇīyādāśiṣaḥ śubhāḥ rājyaṃ dhanaṃ yaśaḥ putrāniṣṭamanyallabheta ca

vidyāvataḥ sadācārānbrāhmaṇānvṛṇuyācchatam ayutaṃ ca japeyuste pratyekaṃ ca navārṇakam evaṃ daśāhaṃ sampādya homaṃ kuryyātprayatnataḥ lakṣasaṃkhyaṃ navārṇaṃ ca pūrvoktadravyasañcayaiḥ sahasrasammitānsādhūndevyārādhanatatparān nārīdurbhagarogādyā naśyanti vyasanoccayāḥ evaṃ sāvarṇikā tuṣṭā brahmaśrotṝnprarakṣati aiṃhrīṃśrīṃklīṃ vedavarṇo mantraścāsyā udāhṛtaḥ ekākṣaravidhānena tadaṅgāni prakalpayet padmadvayaṃ ca hasteṣu bibhratī nṛpasevitā pūrvatroktaprayogāṃśca kuryyānmantrī yathāvidhi visargāntāḥ pañcamantu bījametadudāhṛtam praṇavādirayammantraḥ syāttrayodaśavarṇakaḥ saṃśodhya manunā pāṇiṃ praṇavādyaṃ hṛdantakam mantraśeṣaṃ japenmantrī talayorubhayorapi śeṣaṃ saptārṇakaṃ mantrī vinyaseddhṛdayādiṣu caturthaṃ jñānamukhyaiśca yuktaṃ kuryātṣaḍaṅgakam evaṃ nyasenmanuṃ mantrī cintayediṣṭadevatām mandāndolitakarpūrakadalīvṛndamaṇḍitam mallikāyūthikākundamadayantīsugandhikam namerubhirlavaṅgaiśca candanai raktacandanaiḥ nārikelaiśca kharjjūraiḥ pūgaiḥ kurabakairvṛtam naṃdyāvarttairmadanakaiḥ sarvarttukusumojjvalam pramadaiḥ picumandaiśca mandārairupaśobhitam mallikāyūthikākundajātīmālatikāvṛtam

kekikekāravākīrṇaṃ lakṣmaṇāsārasāvṛtam phullaiḥ sarasijai ramyaiḥ kahlāraiḥ kairavairapi sarvartuśobhibhiḥ kalpadrumairmaṇḍitamujjvalam samudyadarkasandohakiraṇadyutibhāskaram prollasadgalitasvarṇaprākārasumanoharam nūtanodyanmahāratnaracitaṃ tuṅgagopuram vaiḍūryyādimahāratnaracitastambharājitam hemadaṇḍasphuraddvīpasahasraṃ sumanoharam vicitravasanodbhūtairyutaṃ candrāyutairapi ghanasārāgurunakhakastūrīkuṃkumairapi kramādevaṃ caturdvāraṃ maṇḍapaṃ paricintayet nānāratnagaṇākīrṇaṃ tatra devīṃ vicintayet muktāhārojjvalāṃ ramyāṃ ratnākalpavibhūṣitām padmadvayaṃ kaustubhaṃ ca sasmitāsyasaroruhām kvaṇannūpurasamphullaraktotpalapadadvayām balitrayalasadvedimadhyadeśasuśobhitām yakṣakardamasaṃliptapīnonnataghanastanīm kṣaumottarāsaṅgavatīṃ puṣpadāmavibhūṣitām kāñcanodyatpadmarāgamaṇisaṃbaddhakaṅkaṇām kambukaṇṭhakalārāvāṃ svarṇagraiveyarājitām udyadarkaprabhābhāsvadratnatāṭaṃkaśobhitām pañcasāyakakodaṇḍajidbhrūyugavirājitām karṇapūrīkṛtasvarṇabaddharatnāṃkurāṃ śubhām śekhare prollasadratnaraśanāvaliśobhitām kāntakuñcitasaṃsnigdhanīlamañjulamūrdhajām

saundaryyasalilāmbhodhiṃ ratnasāravibhūṣitām vāmādhaḥkaramārabhya sādhyadakṣakarāvadhi dadyādbījenāsanaṃ ca svāṇunā mūrttikalpanam sumanoñjalihastaṃ ca puṣpābharaṇamarcayet aṣṭapatre sthitā pūjyā hyumā śrīśca sarasvatī nānālaṃkaraṇāḍhyāssyurambhojadvayapāṇayaḥ pūjanīye prayatnena karābhyāṃ dhṛtacāmare paritaśca yajedrāśīngrahānnava tatorcayet lokapālāṃstadastrāṇi tattadbāhye yajetpunaḥ taddaśāṃśaṃ prajuhuyādvṛtaistrisvādusaṃyutaiḥ suśītaiḥ śucibhistoyaistarppayedayutadvayam kuryyātkāmyāni karmāṇi svābhīṣṭāni ca mantravit sahasraṃ daśarātraṃ ca samiddhe havyāvāhane saptāhaṃ juhuyājjīvedvatsarāṇāṃ śataṃ sudhīḥ kaṇṭhamātre jale sthitvā mahālakṣmīmiti smaret sa vāñchitārthaṃ labhate tathārogyaṃ ca sādhakaḥ socirāllabhate lakṣmīṃ mahatīṃ sādhakottamaḥ śvetasarṣapakairājyaplutairvā juhuyādbudhaḥ mānyate ca tathā sarvairjantubhirnānyathātra ca guḍayuktaghṛtaiḥ pakvairapūpairjuhuyātsudhīḥ guḍamiśrahaviṣyasya homādannasamṛddhimān sahitaṃ tilakaṃ kuryyātsarvaṃ vaśyaṃ [tasyeti śeṣaḥ] bhaveddhruvam vaśyā bhaveyurmukharā vaśinastasya mantriṇaḥ juhuyādaruṇāmbhojairvaśyāssyustasya viśvagāḥ vaśayetpramadā vidvānmadhūkakusumairhunet

madhye yantraṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ kalpayecca yathāvidhi śubhāṃścandanakāśmīraliptānsarvāṅgasundarān pūjayecca yathāvattānvāsitaistīrthapuṣkaraiḥ karṇikāmadhyavilasattatra padmaṃ tu kārayet khādirośīrakāśmīracandrāgurutamālakam kalaśeṣu ca sarveṣu yathāvidhi viloḍayet apāmāgarsya patrāṇi musalī vajravallarī śālimāṣāṃśca satilānyavānprakṣālya niḥkṣipet phalāni padmabakulajātīsaugandhikāni ca puṣpāṇi ketakasyātha tulasīpallavāṃstathā prakṣipya ca ghaṭānvastraiśchādayeccampakaiḥ śubhaiḥ teṣu madhyasthakalaśe samāvāhya maheśvarīm śeṣeṣvaṣṭasu kumbheṣu kramānukramato yajet bhakṣyabhojyanivedyaiśca yathāvidhi yajetsudhīḥ tataḥ sādhyaṃ samānīya saṃyataṃ sthaṇḍile śubhe manoharairalaṅkārairvividhairvasanairapi suvāsinībhirjāyābhirarcitānāṃ dvijanmanām vedaghoṣeṇa ca saha lagne caiva tu śobhane mūlamantraṃ japansiñcetsādhyaśīrṣṇi tatoparaiḥ saṃspṛśanvedagaditāmāśiṣaṃ saṃprayacchati prasīdatu mahālakṣmīḥ sakalā devatā api itthaṃ dattvāśiṣaṃ paścādvāsasī paridhāya ca nānāvidhaiśca vasanairnānālaṅkaraṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ dāsībhirdevatābuddhyā guruṃ santoṣayetsudhīḥ dīnāndhakṛpaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ bhojayecca dvijanmanaḥ

mahātrilokaramyaśca tataḥ sa nṛvaraḥ svayam rājā śatrūn vijayatebhiṣiktaśca yathāvidhi mahāmatiṃ ca labhate nātra kāryyā vicāraṇā kṛtyādrohādidoṣe ca prakuryyādabhiṣecanam sarvāpadvāraṇaṃ caiva sarvasaukhyāni niścitam tāro [oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ kamale kamalālaye prasīda prasīda śrīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ mahālakṣmi namaḥ || ] ramā śakti lakṣmi kamale kamalālaye gāyatrīchanda uddiṣṭaṃ munirdakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ varṇaistripañcarāmāgnirāmairdhyānamatho dhruve arghapātraṃ ca dadhatīṃ saddhāramukuṭānvitām lāvaṇyabhūmikāṃ vande sundarāṅgadabāhukām puroṅgāni yajetpaścācchrīdharādīṃstataḥ param vāsudevaḥ saṅkarṣaṇaśca pradyumnāniruddhakau brāhmī satī dikṣu caitā āgneyādividikṣu tu catvārastu gajā ete tṛtīyeṣṭadalercayet harṣo balaśca tejasvī yajellokeśvarānbahiḥ evaṃ sampūjayellakṣmīṃ yo martyaḥ sa dhanī bhavet daśāhaṃ saṃskṛte vahnau prākproktenaiva vartmanā candanāktaiḥ sarasijairlakṣaṃ prajuhuyātsudhīḥ tathā svaṃ prāpyate nityaṃ nātra kāryyā vicāraṇā bhadrāṃ madhuvratāṃ śakravallīṃ śālmalimūsalī kuṣṭhakaṅkolakāśmīraṃ haridrāśikharī same pūrvoktāścātra siddhyanti prayogā vāñchitārthadāḥ caturdaśākṣaro mantro lakṣmīhṛdayanāmakaḥ japastrilakṣametasya padmairhomo daśāṃśataḥ etasyopāsakānāṃ tu na vaṃśe syāddaridratā

ekādaśārṇo mantroyaṃ jamadagnirmato muniḥ yauṃ nauṃ mauṃ nama aiṃ namo hṛdayāya namostu hṛt yauṃ nauṃ mauṃ nama aiṃ vaṣaṭ śikhāyai ca vaṣaṭ śikhā śriyai netrāya vauṣaṭ ca procya netre tuṃ vinyaset dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ mahālakṣmīvadācaret tena siddho bhavenmantraḥ sādhakasya na saṃśayaḥ kṛtvā brāhmaṇabhojāntaṃ mantrasiddhiḥ prajāyate aṣṭottarasahasraṃ sa labhate vāñchitaṃ phalam māsatrayaṃ japitvā ca grāmaṃ mantrī tathāpnuyāt padaiścaturbhiḥ sarveṇa pañcāṅgaṃ gaditaṃ manoḥ iyaṃ siddhā mahāvidyā bhaktānāṃ kalpavallikā ādau [śrīṃ sh klhrīṃ śrīmititryakṣaramantraḥ || ] śrībījamuccāryya sahakalaharāstataḥ punaśca śrīṃ samuccāryya mantrastryakṣara īritaḥ tathaiva mohinī lakṣmīssarvasāmrājyadāyinī ṣaḍbhirdīrghaiḥ [āṃ īṃ ūṃ aiṃ auṃ aḥ ebhiḥ ṣaḍakṣaraiḥ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ kuryāt | yathā āṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ īṃśirase svāhā ityādi || ] svarairvidvānṣaḍaṅgāni pravinyaset śaṅkhacakragadāpadmaśārṅgabāṇadharāṃ karaiḥ pūjayāmi jagaddhātrīṃ binduṣakoṇameva ca asminsamāvāhya devīṃ pūjayedupacārakaiḥ agre yajecca gāyatrīṃ sāvitrīṃ ca sarasvatīm aṣṭādaśamahākoṭiyoginībhyo namastviti punardevīṃ samabhyarcya gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ evamaṣṭabhujāṃ dhyātvā trilakṣaṃ prajapetsudhīḥ tarppaṇaṃ mārjjanaṃ kuryyādbrāhmaṇānapi bhojayet hṛdayaṃ [namaḥ] brahmatanaye mantroyaṃ parikīrttitaḥ dhyānapūjāpuraścaryyādikamekākṣaroditam

hrīṃ jyeṣṭhāyai namaḥ procya mantraḥ saptadaśākṣaraḥ devatā jyeṣṭhalakṣmīśca śrīmāye śaktibījake trivedābdhīndvagniyugmavarṇairaṅgāni ṣaṭ kramāt hṛnnābhyādhārajānvaṃghrau padānāṃ pañcakaṃ nyaset kuṃkumakṣodaliptāṅgīṃ praphullakamalekṣaṇām dhanapūrṇaṃ sṛṇiṃ pāśaṃ dadhatīṃ bhujapallavaiḥ samyagdharmmādibhiḥ pīṭhaṃ mantravitparikalpayet pūrvādidalamadhyeṣu madhye cārcyāḥ kramādimāḥ tanno lakṣmīḥ pracodayāt aṅgāni mātṛlokeśāṃstadastrāṇi prapūjayet pāyasena susiddhena sarpiḥsiktena sādhakaḥ iha vaṃśaṃ ca sampattiṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ labhate mṛtaḥ ekādaśākṣarairūnaṃ taṃ śatatrayavarṇakam sarvasiddhimātṛkābhyo namo nityoditā vadet kulacakranāmikāyai bhagavatyai padaṃ vadet oṃkṣauṃkrauṃ nama ityuktvā parameti ca haṃsinī praśamani padaṃ procya sakaletipadaṃ vadet sarvāpadāmbhodhitāriṇītyuktvā sakaleti ca haṃsayugmaṃ balāyugmaṃ nareti rudhirāṃtra ca khādakhāda triśūlaṃ no bhindhimindhi vadettataḥ chedayadvitayaṃ procya tāvadyāvanmameti ca sādhayadvitayānte tu vadetparama ityapi kāruṇike bhagavati mahābhairavarūpadhāriṇi tridaśa cetyuktvā vareti namite vadet janeti vatsaledevi mahākālipadaṃ vadet kurukuru surāsurakanyakāṃ hrīṃ vasupriyā

trilocanamuniścātijagatīchanda ucyate tārādikantu hṛdayaṃ vadetparamahaṃsini viṣamopaplavapraśamani dhruvādyā śikhā matā sarvāpadāmbhodhitāriṇīti netraṃ dhruvādikam evaṃ kṛtvā ṣaḍaṅgāni vaktranyāsaṃ samācaret īśānavaktrāya namaḥ pūrvavaktre tu vinyaset tatpuruṣeti vaktrāya namaḥ procya nyasedavāk aghoravaktrāya namaḥ paścime tu mukhe nyaset vāmadevavakrāyeti namaścodaṅmukhe nyaset sadyojāteti vaktrāya namaścordhvamukhe nyaset taḍitkoṭisamaprakhyāṃ sindūrāruṇavigrahām kheṭaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ svarṇapāśaṃ sāṃkuśaṃ varadābhaye sarvasiddhipradāṃ devīṃ siddhilakṣmīṃ vicintayet vāme tu bhuvaneśvaryyā aṅgaiḥ syātprathamāvṛtiḥ satyabhogayogapūrvā lakṣmyo'ṣṭau ca dalāṣṭake caturthamasitāṅgādyairlokapālaiśca pañcamam homayedguggulājyābhyāṃ prayogānatha vacmyaham sahasrantu japenmantraṃ grahapīḍādiśāntaye bilvaṃ vā pūjayeddevīṃ japedaṣṭasahasrakam śālibhiḥ svarṇalābhaḥ syādgodhūmaiḥ puṣṭireva ca kumudairjanavātsalyaṃ bakulairatulāḥ śriyaḥ māṣahomena mūkaḥ syātkodravairvyādhiyugbhavet kaṭutailena vidveṣaḥ stambhaḥ prītaprakārakaiḥ homo'nyeṣāṃ padārthānāmaṣṭottarasahasrakam sarasīruhahomena sāmrājyaṃ bhalate naraḥ

āyuṣe dūrvayā homo vaṭahomena yakṣiṇī mahābhaye samutpanne mahāriṣṭasamudbhave tilataṇḍulahomena mahābhayanivāraṇam śvetapadmakahomena vidyārthī labhate ca tām jvarāścāturthikādyāśca vyādhayo vividhā grahāḥ saptajaptodakānāntu naśyantyabhyukṣaṇāt kṣaṇāt ekaviṃśatijaptāmbupānātsarvaviṣāpaham tilakaṃ saptajapitaṃ sarvavaśyakarambhavet ityaṣṭa mātṛkāḥ proktāḥ kimanyacchrotumicchasi iti śrīmahāmāyāmahākālānumate merutantre śivapraṇīte brāhmādyaṣṭamātṛkāmantraprakāśastrayoviṃśaḥ digīśāstanmanūnbrūhi phalaṃ cāpi maheśvara imindrāya namaśceti śakramantraḥṣaḍakṣaraḥ indrāya śaktirimbījaṃ bījenaiva ṣaḍaṅgakam sarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ naumīndrandikpatīśvaram tadbāhyeṣṭadale proktamantrairetaiḥ kramādyajet vaṃ varuṇaṃ yaṃ ca vāyuṃ saṃ somaṃ ceśamaṃ tviti prajapellakṣamekantu bilvājyaṃ juhuyāttataḥ maṇḍalantu catuṣkoṇaṃ kṛtvā tanmadhyagaṃlikhet avraṇaṃ sthāpayetkumbhaṃ suvarṇodakapūritam [sugandhodakamiti vā pā ||] tajjalaṃ sthāpayettena rājyabhraṣṭo nṛpo labhet nasnāpayeddharmahīnambhaktiśraddhādivicyutam bhūrbhuvaḥsvaragne ca jātaveda ihāvaha ṛṣirbhṛgurbhavecchando gāyatraṃ devatānalaḥ dhyāyedagniṃ kaṇṭhagatasvarṇamālāvirājitam p. 587)jvālāpuñjakṛtātāpaṃ śvetavastraṃ ca bibhratam sruksruvau ca varābhītī raktābhaṃ dahanambhajet

japedbhānusahasrāṇi śuddhācāro jitendriyaḥ bhakṣyairbhojyairyathāśakti dadyāttebhyaśca dakṣiṇāḥ aparaṃ dinamārabhya homaṃ kuryādatandritaḥ nityamaṣṭottaraśataṃ juhuyāddinaśaḥ sudhīḥ sampūjya tarpayedviprairyathāvibhavamādarāt vāsāsi dhanadhānyādi natvā samprīṇayedgurum rucirā jvalinī proktāḥ kramaśo nava śaktayaḥ atra sampūjayedvahniṃ vidhinā proktalakṣaṇam jātavedāḥ saptajihvo havyavāhanasañjñakaḥ kaumāratejāḥ syādvi"vamukho devamukhaḥ paraḥ lokeśānarcayedbāhye vajrādyāyudhasaṃyutān jāyate vatsarādarvāgdhanadhānyasamṛddhimān tasya sañjāyate lakṣmīḥ kīrtistrailokyavanditā karavīraprasūnairvā maṇḍalātsyātsamṛddhimān tilahomena mahatīṃ śriyamāpnoti mānavaḥ vikaṃkatāragvadhayoḥ samidbhiḥ karavīrajaiḥ p. 588) jātīprasūnairdūrvābhirnityamaṣṭottaraṃ śatam sādhayedakhilānkāmānṣaṇmāsānnātra saṃśayaḥ uttiṣṭha puruṣa brūyāddharipiṅgalatatparam caturviṃśatyakṣarātmā samṛddhimanurīritaḥ ṣaṭśarābdhitrivedadvimitairdhyāyeddhutāśanam romavallīlasajjvālaṃ kāntājanavimohanam daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādvahnau turagāgnimanuṃ smaret āśāpālaistadīyāstrairabhyarcya havyavāhanam jitvā rogānsa jīveta śriyā varṣaśataṃ naraḥ

catuḥsahasraṃ prajapennityaṃ saṃvatsarāvadhi kleśānnirjitya tejasvī jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sudhīḥ dadhnā ca samidbhirvā pratipatsu bhaveddhanam tilairjyotiṣmatībhūtai ripurāṣṭrañjayennṛpaḥ kanyāmiṣṭāmavāpnoti sāpi taṃ prāpnuyādvaram sānnaiḥ sahasramacirānmahatīṃ śriyamāpnuyāt ājyāktadūrvāhomena jīvedvarṣaśataṃ naraḥ juhvatā labhyate lakṣmīrdhanadhānyasamṛddhidā śrīrbhavenmahatī tasya ṣaṇmāsādanapāyinī p. 589) juhuyādvatsarādarvāk sa bhavedindirāpatiḥ vatsaraṃ juhvatastaiḥ syāllakṣmīrindreṇa vāñchitā trisahasraṃ pratidinammantrasiddhyai jitendriyaḥ jīvedvarṣaśataṃ bhūtvā tejasā bhāskaraprabhaḥ prasūnaiḥ kusumaiḥ phullaiḥ kuṭajairjātisambhavaiḥ āpnuyānmahatīṃ lakṣmīṃ vatsarādvāñchitādhikām godugdhena haviḥ kṛtvā kavalantena kalpayet gandhamālyādibhiḥ samyagjapitvāṣṭottaraṃ śatam jāyate vatsarādeva lakṣmīstrailokyamohinī bhāratī nivasettasya mukhāmbhojetiniścalā jāṭharāgnirbhavettasya ghṛtenaiva hutāśanaḥ kṣīravṛkṣasamudbhūtaiḥ kvāthaistānpūrayetkramāt kumbheṣu dhūpadīpādyaiḥ puṣpadhūpairmanoharaiḥ abhiṣiñcettataḥ sādhyaṃ vinītaṃ dattadakṣiṇam agnerārādhanaṃ cetthaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakam oṃ-kroṃ-hrīṃ-āṃ [oṃ-kroṃ hrīṃ āṃ vaiṃ vaivasvatāya dharmarājāya bhaktānugrahakṛte namaḥ ||] ca tadbījaṃ ṅentaṃ vaivasvataṃ vadet

caturviśativarṇoyaṃ yamamantrokhileṣṭadaḥ meghaśyāmaṃ prasannāsyaṃ nānālaṅkārasaṃyutam nānārūpadharairdūtaiḥ śvetavastraṃ bhajedyamam digīśāṃśca yamasthāne citraguptaṃ prapūjayet varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ hunedājyānvitaistilaiḥ tasya saṃsmaraṇādeva sakalāpannivāraṇam yametyuktvā ca vahikādhikāriṇe vadettataḥ ukārasvarasaṃyuktāssacandrāḥ kūṭamucyate saptaṣaṇmanuvasvaṅganetrārṇairaṅgakalpanam lekhakaṃ pāpapuṇyānāṃ citraguptamahambhaje rājadvāre vivāde ca saṃgrāme jayadāyakaḥ mānyāṃ kīrtiṃ ca vaṃśaṃ ca saṃsthāpya svargagāminaḥ oṃ kṣaṃ nirṛtaye rakṣodhipataye padaṃ vadet ṅentastataśca hṛdayaṃ triṃśadarṇo manurmataḥ nānārakṣogaṇaiḥ sevyaṃ khaḍgacarmadharaṃ bhaje oṃ [oṃ kṣaṃ nirṛtaye namaḥ hṛdayāya namaḥ, oṃ kṣaṃ rakṣodhipataye namaḥ śirase svāhā, oṃ kṣaṃ dhūmravarṇāya namaḥ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ, oṃ kṣaṃ khaḍgahastāya namaḥ kavacāyahum, oṃ kṣaṃ pretavāhanāya namaḥ netratrayāya vauṣaḍityādi ||] kṣamādyairhṛdantaiśca pañcāṅgaiḥ pañcabhiḥ padaiḥ pañcakoṇeṣu mañcāṅgamaṣṭapatre yajedimāḥ rākṣasīṃ bhītidāṃ kṛtyāṃ kheṭānastrāṇi tadbahiḥ evaṃ tu siddhe mantresminnabhayaṃ jāyate vane manuṣyā api ye vanyā mṛgādīnāṃ tu kā kathā svayameva palāyante sādhakasya raṇādapi parehni vā guḍādyaṃ ca kānane vicaredbudhaḥ na bhayaṃ jāyate tatra vyāghracauroragādijam janmāntare dvijo bhūtvā kāśīṃ prāpya vimucyate kalau drutaphalaścaitatsadṛśo nāsti cāgame

tato rakte padaṃ brūyāttatpaścādraktavāsase aghorakarmake devi amukasya gatiṃ daha suptasyeti procya mano dahayugmaṃ vadettataḥ pacayugmaṃ tāvaditi dahayugmaṃ paceti ca proktoyamāsurīmantro daśottaraśatākṣaraḥ huṃphaṭsvāhāntakairmantravarṇaih pratyaṅgakalpanam ahiyajñopavītāṃ tāmāsurīṃ saṃsmarāmyaham gṛhītvā tu sapañcāṅgamāsurīṃ mantreyacca tām madhvāktāmāsurīṃ hutvā sahasraṃ vaśayejjagat nāryāḥ pratikṛtervāmapādādihavanaṃ caret p. 592) dāsavajjāyate sādhyastriliṅgo hyapi tadvaśe nāmayuṅmanunā hutvā jvariṇaṃ kurute ripum arkadugdhāktataddhomānnetranāśaḥ [riporiti sambandhimahimnā bodhyaḥ ||] prajāyate kṣattriyaṃ tu guḍābhyaktarājikābhirvaśaṃ nayet śūdro lavaṇayugghomātpratyahaṃ sāṣṭakaṃ śatam āsurīsamidho hutvā madhvaktā labhate nidhim āvāhya cāsurīṃ tatra pūjayedupacārakaiḥ tenābhiṣikto bhavati vyādhyādhibhyāṃ vivarjitaḥ āsuryāścāpi puṣpāṇi priyaṃgu ca samaṃsamam guñjānibhā [kāryā itiśeṣaḥ | agre ca tāsāṃ madhye ekāpi guṭikā yasya śirasi nyastā sa tasya vaśavartītyarthaḥ ||]yasya mūrdhni sthāpitaikā vaśastu saḥ aṣṭottaraśataṃ yāmyābhimukho mārayedarīn sarvepi kuṇṭhitā mantrā nāsurī parameśvarī tāraṃ vaṃ varuṇāyeti jalādhipataye vadeta oṃ mamādyairnamontaiśca pañcāgaṃ pañcabhiḥ padaiḥ tundilaśca prasannāsyo varuṇo nidhidostu me

japedvarṇasahasraṃ tu homaḥ padmākṣakaiḥ smṛtaḥ godāvarīṃ ca kālindīṃ samudrāstadanantaram mahāpadmaḥ śaṅkhapālaḥ kulikoṣṭadale tataḥ prayogāścātra siddhyanti devamantroditāḥ pare yasyopāsanato vaśyaṃ mṛtyuḥ kāśyāṃ prajāyate nama oṃ tithivarṇoyaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ mantrārṇaiḥ syātṣaḍaṅgāni [mūloktasaṃkhyākrameṇa nimnalikhitanyāsā vidheyāste yathā - oṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ, aiṃ hrīṃ śirase svāhā, śrīṃ klīṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭa, oṃ maṃ kavacāya hum, maṇikarṇike netratrayāya vauṣaṭ, namaḥ oṃ astrāya phaṭ ||] dhyāyettāṃ paścimāmukhīm śvetavastrāvṛtāṃ tryakṣāṃ dhyāyedbaddhāñjaliḥ parām likhedaṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ karṇikāyāṃ tu ṣaḍdalam vidhiṃ sūryaṃ parvateśaṃ menāṃ cāpi bhagīratham makarāṃścāpi haṃsāṃśca tathā kāraṇḍavānapi indrādīṃścāpi vajrādīnmantroyaṃ dakṣamārgiṇām mantroyaṃ mṛtyukāle tu kāśyāṃ muktiprado dhruvam bhavedyasya prasādena tāraṃ maṃ maṇikarṇike upāsanādhyānapūjāḥ svīyāmnāyena kalpayet puraścaryāprayogādi pūrvamantrasamaṃ matam pañcāmnāyaistatkrameṇa copāsyaṃ siddhikārakam miliyugmaṃ ca gaṅge māṃ pāvayadvitayaṃ dviṭhaḥ trivedāṅgāgniṣaṇnetrairmantrārṇairaṅgakalpanam [tricatuṣaṭtriṣaḍdvimantravarṇairnyāsāḥ kāryāḥ tegre darśyante - oṃ namo hṛdayāya namaḥ, bhagavati śirase svāhā, aiṃ hili hili mili mili śikhāyai vaṣaṭ, gaṃge māṃ kavacāya hum, pāvayapāvaya netratrayāya vauṣaṭ, svāhā astrāyaphaṭ ||] abhayaṃ kalaśaṃ vāmakarayormakarasthitām nānālaṅkāraśobhāḍhyāṃ prasannavadanāṃ bhaje tilājyābhyāṃ bhaveddhomo mantroyaṃ bhuktimuktidaḥ ūrdhvāmnāyena sādhyaḥ syātṣaḍaṅgāni śaraiḥ kṛtaiḥ sarvapāpakṣayakaro bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥ tāro namaḥ śivāyai ca nārāyaṇyai padaṃ vadet

vedavyāso muniśchandaḥ kṛtirgaṅgā ca devatā nikhilaṃ pūrvavatkuryānnikhilābhīṣṭado manuḥ oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hṛdbhagavati gaṅge ca dayite namaḥ tridvyabdhīṣudvidvivarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ varṇalakṣaṃ japeddhomaḥ prāgvatsammatkarastvayam hilidvandvaṃ milidvandvaṃ gaṅge devi namastathā tridvidvyakṣiyugadvyarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ narmadāyai nama iti ṣaḍarṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥ p. 595) lasaddhastāṃ svarṇakāntiṃ sālaṅkārāṃ bhajāmyaham ṣaḍaṅgāni [ekaikākṣarairhṛdayādinyāsāḥ yathā-nahṛdayāya namaḥ rmaśirase svāhā, dā śikhāyai vaṣaṭ ityādi ||] ca mantrārṇaiḥ prajapedvarṇasaṅkhyayā iha saukhyaṃ paratrāpi śivaloke mahīyate sarasvatītaṭe japtāstvaritaṃ siddhidāyakāḥ gaṅgāśabdasya pūrve te godāyā manavaḥ smṛtāḥ śrīkṛṣṇakheladyunadi trāhi māṃ tvaṃ bhavārṇavāt chandonuṣṭupṣaḍaṅgāni pādārdhārdhakrameṇa ca tilājyābhyāṃ hunenmantrī bhāskariṃ naiva vīkṣate amukadvīpāvarakāmukadravyodadhe vadet samudramantra uddiṣṭaḥ sindhudvīpo munirmataḥ padairmanoḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni tattadrūpaṃ vicintayet tattadantargataṃ vastu labhate sādhako dhruvam tāraṃ [oṃ yaṃ vāyave prāṇādhipataye kṛṣṇavarṇāyāṃkuśahastāya mṛgavāhanāya namaḥ ||] yaṃ vāyave prāṇādhipataye padaṃ vadet ya namo godvivarṇoyaṃ vāyumantra udīritaḥ pañcāṅgāni manorasya oṃ yaṃ bījādikaiḥ padaiḥ pāśāṃkuśakarampretakṛtyāparisarānvitam siddhamantrastu tatkālambhavedbhūmau balādhikaḥ

p. 596) yasya vijñānamātreṇa nāsādhyambhuvanatraye bhayaṃkari tathā huṃ ca ṣoḍaśārṇo mato manuḥ siṃhavaktrā mahākṛtyā bhītidoktā ca devatā śikhākavacanetrāstraṃ punarevaṃ prakalpayet daṃṣṭrākarālavadanāṃ trinetrāṃ sarvatojvalām triśūlacakracaṣakakhaṭvāṅgakarapaṃkajām māraṇe kṛṣṇavarṇāṃ ca kṛṣṇapuṣpāmbarāvṛtām pūrvasmiñchāṃkarīṃ nāma śubhravarṇāmbarāvṛtām dakṣiṇe mārikāṃ nāma lambajihvāmadhomukhīm caturbhujāṃ siṃhanādāṃ jvalacchūlakapālinīm paścime vāruṇīṃ nāma svarṇavarṇāṃ hasanmukhīm udīcibhītikāṃ nāma caturvaktrāṃ bhayaṃkarām tataḥ prayoge kurvīta sveṣṭaṃ sa ca nigadyate varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ nityamaṣṭottaraṃ śatam sarvakṛtyāṃ bhīṣaṇīṃ ca śrīmatīṃ ca pratiṣṭhitām tasyādho mekhalāyuktaṃ trikoṇaṃ vahnikūcakam vibhītakaparidhyā ca kalpayedyasya māraṇam p. 597) dārayainaṃ śoṣayainaṃ mārayetyabhidhāya ca homānte vidhivatkṛtyāmārādhyāgneśca sannidhau bhuṃkṣva kravyamasṛk tasya pibetyuktvā nivedayet juhvantiṣṭhati yāvatsa tāvadasya ripormṛtiḥ jale saṃloḍya mantreṇa ripuṃ dhyātvā niruddhadṛk navarātrottare śatrurmriyate nātra saṃśayaḥ juhvato mriyate śatruḥ satyamauśanasaṃ matam phaṭkāraṃ hṛdaye kṛtvā śivanirmālyake kṣipet

sadyovagāhanaṃ kṛtvā tasyāmeva vicakṣaṇaḥ ṣaṇmāsānmriyate śatruḥ sandhyayorubhayorapi uṣṭrāsthnā ca śavāṅgāraiḥ śatroruccāṭanaṃ bhavet annaiḥ samidbhiḥ pālāśaiḥ śāntiṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ madhuratrayasaṃsiktairebhiḥ kuryācca vaśyakam mahāvyādhipraśamanaṃ nityamaṣṭottaraṃ śatam manasā cintayetkṛtyāṃ gajārūḍhāmibhadravīm cauravyāghramṛgādīnāṃ salilāderbhayāpaham medhāvī ca bhavedvāgmī tāvajjāpābhiṣekataḥ p. 598) pakṣammāsaṃ dvimāsaṃ vā ṣaṇmāsaṃ vatsaraṃ tu vā kṛtyāṃ samarcayeddhaste yathā vidhipuraḥsaram tanmadhyeṣṭadalaṃ nyasya yakārādīnnyasetkramāt candrabimbaṃ likhetpadmaṃ tasyordhvaṃ pratimāṃ likhet kumbhamadhye nyasetkṛtyāṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutām paritoṣya ca tānnyasyedasitāṅgādibhairavān lokeśāntaṃ yajeddevi tadagre homamācaret kumbhamadhye nyaseddevīṃ dakṣiṇe tu śriyaṃ smaret ayutaṃ mūlamantrantu japenmṛtyuvināśanam mahāśāntikare [yasmāt iti śeṣaḥ ||] loke duḥkhadāridryanāśanaḥ yakṣāya [yakṣāya kuberāya vaiśravaṇāya dhanadhānyādhipataye dhanadhānyasamṛddhiṃ me dehi dāpaya svāhā ||] ca kuberāya vadedvaiśravaṇāya ca samṛddhiṃ me dehi vadeddāpayāgnipriyāntakaḥ chandastu bṛhatī [yakṣāya hṛdayāya namaḥ kuberāya śirase svāhā, vaiśravaṇāya śikhāyai vaṣaṭ, dhanadhānyādhipataye kavacāya hum, dhanadhānyasamṛddhiṃ me netratrayāya vauṣaṭ, dehi dāpaya svāhā astrāyaphaṭ ||] tryabdhīṣvaṣṭāṣṭāgaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam varaṅgadāñca dadhatantundilaṃ yakṣasevitam dharmādipīṭhe prayajedaṅgalokeśahetikam bilvamūlopaviṣṭena japto lakṣaṃ dhanarddhidaḥ

śrīṃ-hrīṃ-klīṃ-oṃ ca viṃ vitteśvarāya nama ityapi p. 599) pañcākṣibhyāṃ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ syāddhyānapūjādi pūrvavat svāhāntaiḥ praṇavādyaiśca pañcabhirmantravarṇakaiḥ hastābhyāṃ bibhrataṃ kharvakarapādaṃ ca tundilam sevanādasya bhavati yakṣiṇyādyāstathā vaśe praṇavaṃ haṃ samuccārya ceśānāya vadettataḥ varṇoya śūlahastāya ṅentaśca vṛṣavāhanaḥ oṃ hamādyairnamontaiśca pañcāṅgaṃ paṃcābhaḥ padaiḥ bhavanti naiva phaladā yathā nārī naraṃ vinā ubhayopāsanaṃ devi bhuktimuktipradāyakam gaṇeśena sarasvatyā yakṣiṇyādyābhirātmanaḥ vāme tu bhairavairmaṃntraiḥ śeṣāmnāyeṣvayaṃ manuḥ tāraṃ pāśaṃ brahmaṇe ca lokādhipataye vadet namontobāṇarāmārṇo mantroyaṃ parikīrtitaḥ nāsya pūjāvidhiḥ prāyo japosya parikīrtitaḥ na tatra mama śāposti śāpaḥ kevalapūjane gauravarṇāyātalādisaptalokeśvarāya ca ekacatvāriṃśadarṇo mantronantasya kīrtitaḥ p. 600) dugdhaṃ hutvāthaviprendrānbhojayecca caturdaśa rājyabhraṣṭa iyādrājyaṃ vidyākāmastu paṇḍitaḥ evamuktā dikpamantrāḥ kimanyacchrotumicchasi itiśrīmahāmāyāmahākālānumate merutantre śivapraṇīte daśadigīśamantraprakāśaścaturviṃśaḥ tathā dīpasya me mantraṃ phalañca kṛpayā vada ādau gaṇeśadīpastu kāryākāryavinirṇaye mohoccāṭau dveṣaṇañca teṣu dīpañcaretkramāt

kṛṣṇanīlāruṇāraktaharitkapiśasūtrakaiḥ sammukhantu mukhaṃ kuryātsādhakaḥ svasvakarmaṇi mahiṣyājyamumātailaṃ vasātailaṃ kusumbhajam dīpasya diśamārabhya gaṇeśaṃ tatra pūjayet lambodaraśca vikaṭo vighnanāśo vināyakaḥ dvādaśaitāni nāmāni yaḥ paṭhecchruṇuyādapi etānatra yajedvidvānpaścāddīpaṃ pradāpayet tiryakkampena kāryaṃ syātsamyagjyotiṣi satvaram jātāṃ devagaṇe kanyāṃ kumāraṃ vā samānayet p. 601) adhastātsthāpeyatpūtaṃ vistīrṇaṃ kāsyabhājanam kāryānusāraṃ sā paśyetputtalīnāṃ ca kautukam kṛtena yena vighnaugho vilayaṃ yāti mantriṇaḥ ekīkṛtya vidhatavyo dīpaḥ susnigdhaśobhanaḥ gavyamājyañca kausumbhaṃ tailaṃ vā dīpakarmaṇi haridrayā raktavastraṃ paridhāya śuciḥ kṣamī uttarāsammukho bhūtvā haridrāliptabhūtale ghṛtamāpūrya vartiṃ ca dīpaṃ prajvālayetsudhīḥ saṃkalpanyāsapūrvaṃ tu japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam kṣobhayetstambhayeccāpi dveṣayetprakṣipedapi tāraṃ māyāṃ ramāṃ kāmammāyāṃ lakṣmīṃ ca vāgbhavam baṭuketi imaṃ dīpaṃ gṛhāṇa padamuccaret duṣṭānnāśaya yugmañca trāsayadvitayaṃjapet svāhā phaṭ ṣaṣṭhivarṇoyaṃ dīpamantra udāhṛtaḥ tena vartiḥ prakartavyā mantrārṇamitasūtrakaiḥ paścātkuryāttu sādhye tu kāryaproktantu dīpakam

asādhyenaiva kartavyo dīpastrāsaprado bhavet tadeva sarvaṃ vijñeyaṃ dvipalaṃ pātra mucyate kāryantu dvividhaṃ proktaṃ śubhaṃ cāsubhameva ca p. 602) tatrocyate bhairavasya dhyānaṃ śvetaṃ caturbhujam dhyātvā mukuṭamauliṃ ca śvetakaupīnavāsasam vairiṇāṃ duḥkhajanakamaśubhaṃ māraṇādike kiṅkiṇīmālayā yuktaṃ trinetraṃ ca bhayānakaṃ varaṃ kapālaṃ dadhataṃ dhyāyettaṃ krūravigraham kartavyaṃ kuḍavagrāhi śodhayecchvetaparvatam dīpapātraṃ sādhakastu bhairavaṃ kavacaṃ paṭhet tisraḥ pañca tathā sapta vartayaḥ kāryagauravāt uttarābhimukhaḥ śāntau prāṅmukhaḥ pauṣṭike mataḥ mahattrikoṇakasyordhvaṅkoṇeṣvasya ca saṃlikhet likhedaṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ dīpayantramudāhṛtam puṣpaṃ vāsitatailaṃ vā sarvakāmaphalapradam tairnirmitandīpapātraṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam nikaṭe bhairavasyāpi śālagrāmasya sannidhau aśvatthatarumūle ca sarvakamasamṛddhaye madhyameṣṭāṃśarahitaiḥ sādhyeṣṭāviṃśasammitaiḥ śatatrayeṇa kartavyā laghukārye śatena tu dīpaṃ kuryānnṛpadvāre varṣātsyānmahatī ramā pathikāgamanārthantu tilatailena dīpakam varṇataścaiva dhavalaṃ vighnamārgādikaṃ jayet rājadvāre careddīpaṃ vartiḥ kauśumbharaktikā hanumatsannidhau dīpo vartiḥ kausumbharaktikā

dīpaṃ dadyānmāraṇārthaṃ rājadvāre piturgṛhe śatrormṛtyukare kārye vartiḥ syātkṛṣṇatantubhiḥ vartiśca kṛṣṇasūtrasya rājadvāre caredimam catuṣpathe dīpadānaṃ vartiḥ syādatra karburā pradīpe tilatailaṃ syānnṛpadvāre caredimam durgāyāḥ sannidhau deyā raktasūtraiśca vartikā dīpañca saṅgame dadyādvartitriguṇarūpikām pātraṃ ca mṛṇmayaṃ kuryāddīpadāne catuṣpathe śailakūle devatāyāḥ sannidhau dīpamācaret māhiṣeṇa ghṛtenaiva pātraṃ narakapālajam śvetāṃ vartiṃ goghṛtena caturthyāṃ tu samācaret pātre tu tāmraje dīpaṃ dhūmravarṇāṃ tu vartikām śubhāśubhādicihnāni yaiḥ kāryākāryanirṇayaḥ pūrṇā pādonitārdhā ca pādatulyātha vartikā madhyamaṃ nīlakaṇṭhādeḥ śrīkīrtivijayapradam aṣṭabhirdivasaistasya kāryasiddhirna saṃśayaḥ p. 604) kṛṣṇā jvālā tadā śatroḥ kāryaṃ naiva prajāyate yadā caracareddīpaḥ kāryaṃ naṣṭaṃ tadā bhavet dīpavaryeṣu taddīpanayanānmandanetratā etaddīpavidhānaṃ tu baṭukasya prakīrtitam pātre trikoṇe śaktyarthaṃ dīpadānaṃ prakalpayet ūrdhvāmnāye piṣṭapātraṃ kācapāṣāṇasambhavam nṛkapālaṃ vāmagānāṃ kramādvai goghṛtaṃ tathā śvetaraktaharitpītakṛṣṇasūtrāstu vartikāḥ devāgāre sarittīre rājagehe catuṣpathe

gaṇeśavatparīkṣātra kāryākāryavinirṇaye sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvopadravanāśanam bilvapatrodbhavaṃ pātraṃ dadyaddīpaṃ śivālaye tasya vaṃśe na dāridryaṃ nākālamaraṇaṃ bhavet paścime vṛṣṭaye deyaḥ śeṣakāryeṣu cottare tilatailenābhicāre tāratamyaṃ vicārayet kuryātsvarṇamaye pātre tadabhāvepi tāmrake dvādaśāṃguladīrghā sā kuḍavantu ghṛtaṃ smṛtam ghṛtaṃ prajvālya śāntaścedroganāśastadā dhruvam kalpayeddīpadravyasya mānaṃ lokānusārataḥ sarvakāmo goghṛtena māraṇaṃ māhiṣeṇa ca tāmrajaṃ lohajaṃ kācaṃ kramāttriṣu ca karmasu duḥsvapnotpātabhūtāni naśyantyacyutadīpataḥ gopanīyaṃ prayatnena na vācyaṃ yasya kasyacit mantravarṇasya divase kramāddīpamprakalpayet yāvajjvalati dīposau tāvattasya manuṃ japet punardīpe kṛte yā tu dīpaṃ saṃpaśyati sphuṭā tadādidevatā tuṣṭā guptametatprakāśitam tantreṣu taddīpavidhirbahudhā samprakīrtitaḥ ataḥ paraṃ yadiṣṭaṃ tvaṃ pṛccha tattacca māṃ prati iti śrīmahāmāyāmahākālānumate merutantre śrīśivapraṇīte dīpavidhiprakāśaḥ pañcaviṃśaḥ daśāvatārāḥ śrīviṣṇostānsamastānvada prabho tasya mantrampravakṣyāmi bhuktimuktipradāyakam dvādaśākṣaramantroyaṃ munirbrahmā samīritaḥ bhagavānsa ramānātho bījaṃ śrīṃ maṃ ca kīlakam

ghanaśyāmaścaturbāhuḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ padmacihnitasarvāṅgaḥ sundaraścārulocanaḥ pratyahaṃ taddaśāṃśena vaiśākhe kārtike tathā ārabhya bhādrabahulāmaṣṭamīṃ ṣoḍaśāhakam p. 606) tathaiva homaḥ kartavyastathānyadivaseṣu tu ādyantayoḥ śatānyaṣṭau tarpayecca tathā śriyam evaṃ kṛte caikavarṣānmaṃtrasiddhiḥ prajāyate bhojayetpūjanaṃ cāsya carettoyāśaye sadā ṣaṭpatreṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni yajedbāhyacaturdale tadbāhyagadale pūjyāḥ kṣīrādyāḥ saptasindhavaḥ tasya bāhye śakradale ratnāni tu caturdaśa gaṅgādyāḥ ṣoḍaśa tato pūjayecca mahāpagāḥ digīśāṃśca tadastrāṇi navāvaraṇapūjanam etaṃ susaṃskṛtaṃ mantrañjapedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam akuṇṭhitaḥ prayogeṇa na punastasya saṃskṛtiḥ etatsampuṭitāḥ sarve vaidikāḥ siddhidāḥ kalau gāṇeśā vaiṣṇavāḥ saurāḥ siddhiṃ dadyurvidarbhitāḥ tasmātprokto nānyatantre merutantre prakāśitaḥ ekaḥ kūrmāvatārobhūnmathyamāne mahodadhau dhurandharāya natyantaḥ siddhavarṇo manuḥ smṛtaḥ devatā bhagavānviṣṇurjātaḥ kacchaparūpadhṛk niyogo devatādhyānaṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharam dīrghagrīvaṃ mahāgrāhaṃ girantaṃ raktalocanam ājyahomastarpaṇantu candanotpalavāribhiḥ tadbāhye tu caturdikṣu madanaṃ babhrukaṃ [brahmāṇam ||] harim

dharāṃ śeṣaṃ kṣīranidhiṃ maṇḍūkaṃ devatādrumam bhūpure tasya bāhye tu hetayo vā samīritāḥ śmaśāne kūrmacakrasya śatrunāmādivargataḥ rājikāpratimāṃ kuryācchatrupāṃśusamanvitām ādau vāmaṃ tato dakṣaṃ striyā caitadviparyayāt pārṣṇigulphakajaṃghoruyugaṃ sakthiyugaṃ tathā kaṭitrikaṃ ca hṛdayaṃ hunetpārśvadvayaṃ tataḥ rekhāsthānāni coccārya maṇibandhaprakoṣṭhakau hanudvayaṃ tathā coṣṭhau cordhvādhaḥsthaṃ radadvayam netre bhrūmadhyakaṃ bhālaṃ brahmarandhramiti kramāt na brāhmaṇe prayoktavyā yatosau viṣṇudaivatam haridrayā kṛtaṃ cedaṃ stambhayedakhilaṃ jagat śmaśānasya mṛdoccāṭe godhūmairvaśyatā bhavet satkārye prajapenmantraṃ siddhiḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ kalpajātāścaturvarṇā avatārā ramāpateḥ rūpāya bhūrbhuvaḥ suvaḥ pataye bhūpatīti ca ṛṣyādyā bhārgavānuṣṭubvarāhāḥ parikīrtitāḥ p. 608) māṃvyolkāya namaḥśīrṣe tejodhipataye namaḥ mahādaṃṣṭrāya ca namostrametatpallavānvitam nyāsaḥ keśavamātrākhyo nyāso nityastu vaiṣṇave ānābhikarpūranibhaṃ nābhitastu galāvadhi śaṅkhārikhaḍgāṃśca gadāṃ varaśaktī tathaiva ca vāgīśāṃ huṃkṛtau bāhvoścandrasūryau śivaṃ mukhe daṃṣṭrāyāṃ tasya vasudhāṃ dikpatreṣu yajetkramāt punaḥ koṇeṣu pūjyāni rakṣaḥprācyantarāntimam

gadā śaktiṃ varaṃ caiva cāpaṃ bāhyeṣu dikpitīn lakṣaṃ japecca padmāni svādvaktāni ca homayet athāsyānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyate daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādagnau puraścaraṇavānbhavet dhanadhānyadharālakṣmyo bhavantyatra na saṃśayaḥ vāruṇe mṛtyutaḥ śāntirāgneye jvaravaśyatā athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi maṇḍaladhyānamadbhūtam nandyāvartāṃśca koṇeṣu cintayedbhumimaṇḍalam vāruṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ śvetaṃ madhye vaṃbījalāñchitam taijasaṃ maṇḍalaṃ proktaṃ dhyeyaṃ bhāvukasattamaiḥ samīramaṇḍalaṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ dhyeyaṃ sadā janaiḥ nīlavarṇaṃ mahāśūnyamanāhataravaṃ smaret p. 609) pañcagavyaparikṣiptāṃ japitāmayutena ca śatrūṇāṃ sannirodho hi kṣetraṃ cāsya vinaśyati vairiruddhādapi kṣetrānmṛdamānīya yatnataḥ pākapāṃtraṃ dvitīyaṃ ca payasyanne tathāparam tatra devaṃ yathāvacca dhūpadīpādibhiryajet evaṃ bhaumāṣṭavāreṣu kuryānniyatadhīḥ kramāt ahno mukhe bhaumavāre mṛdaṃ saṃgṛhya pūrvavat baliṃ ca dadyātkṣetrasya virodho naśyati kṣaṇāt saptabhirdivasaiścātra ḍākinīvikṛtiṃ haret aṣṭādhikaśataṃ mantrī śālibhirdviniśaṃ sudhīḥ anena juhuyādājyaṃ sahasraṃ pratyahaṃ naraḥ sahasraṃ svādusaṃyuktairvāsasāṃ siddhirucyate jinādikṣetramāsādya vādinaḥ prajayetsadā

evaṃ kṛte tatastasya bhūmivādo vinaśyati aṅgāravāre prajapetkṣetraṃ kuryātpradakṣiṇam vindate mahatīṃ lakṣmīṃ śamayetsarvakaṇṭakān mahatīṃ śriyamāpnoti mahārājo bhavatyalam saptadvīpānavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā āmraparṇairhutenityaṃ jvaraśāntiḥ prajāyate evamprokto varāhasya manuḥ sarvārthasiddhidaḥ oṃ bhūrvarāhāya namo munirbrahmā samīritaḥ padaiḥ samastamantreṇa pañcāṅgāni prakalpayet pṛthvīśaktiyutaṃ dhyāyecchaṃkhacakrāmbujaṃ [dadhānamiti śeṣaḥ] gadām carmāsimadbhiśca kalau drutasiddhipradāyakam evammanuṃ yaḥ prabhajetsa bhavecca dharāpatiḥ hayagrīvo muniḥ proktaśchandonuṣṭup ca devatā prāgvaddhyāyedraktavarṇaṃ pūjādyaṃ pūrvavadbhavet pītavarṇaṃ sadādhyāyeddvāpare drutasiddhidam kramādvakṣye hi tanmantrānvarāhasya priyānati dhṛṣe svāheti mantroyamūnaviṃśativarṇakaḥ tryabdhitrīṣudvidvivarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ dharāmpadmāsanāṃ dhyāyennānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitām tato yajedaṣṭadale pūrvataḥ kuṃ ca bhūkalāḥ indrādīṃścāpi vajrādīniti pūjāvidhiḥ smṛtaḥ vidhinā tena saṃsiddhe manau kāmyāni kārayet iṣṭāṃ bhuvamavāpnoti tadvannīlotpalairhunet bahudhānyadharāśrīṇāṃ satyambhavati bhājanam dharāpatirbhavenmantrī maṇḍalena na saṃśayaḥ
