śuddhatoye samāloḍya tāṃ ca tatra paceccarum māsaṣaṭkaṃ bhṛgorvāre hyevaṃ kṛtvā labheddharām oṃ-mahīṃ [oṃ glauṃ namaḥ bhagavatyai dharāyai dharaṇi dharedhare svāhā glauṃ hrīṃ oṃ m ||] glauṃ namaḥ procya bhagavatyai padaṃ vadet glauṃ hrīṃ tāraṃ samuccārya caturviṃśākṣaro manuḥ eṣa uktastu vārāho mantraḥ siddhokhileṣṭadaḥ ṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ sarvaṃ prāgvatṣaḍaṅgāni dīrghaṣaṭkānvitena ca pratimanvantaraṃ vāyamavatāro harerbhavet ākalpaṃ vidyate tatra bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ dvātriṃśadarṇako gopyo bhuktimuktiprado mataḥ nṛsiṃhaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ rudraṃ? mṛtyumṛtyuṃ namāmyaham prathamo nyāsa uddiṣṭaḥ sarvābhīṣṭapradāyakaḥ ṣaḍaṅgākhyo dvitīyoyamaṅganyāsa udāhṛtaḥ dakṣiṇe bāhumūle ca tanmadhye maṇibandhake tanmadhye maṇibandhe cāṃgulīmūle tadantake kaṇṭhe hṛdi tathā nābhau dakṣapārśve ca vāmake tṛtīyo nyāsa uditaḥ sākṣāddevamayo bhavet vāmāṃ kaniṣṭhāmārabhya vāmāṃguṣṭhāvadhi nyaset p. 612) pātakaṃ turya udito nyāsoṃgulyādikaḥ paraḥ nayane nayanādhaśca kapole karṇamūlake kaṇṭhe nābhau bhuje dakṣe vāme ca hṛdaye stane liṅge corau tathā jānau jaṅghāyāṃ cāpi guhyake sarvāṅge romakūpeṣu raktahṛtpalalāsthiṣu ayantu pañcamo nyāsaḥ sarvāriṣṭanivārakaḥ ūrvoḥ kaṭidvaye nābhau hṛhi bāhvostathā gale

pādādivarṇanyāsoyaṃ pañcamaḥ parikīrttitaḥ hṛdi nābhau kaṭau jānvoḥ pādayoḥ kramato nyaset asminnyāse kṛte dehe rogaiḥ sthātuṃ na śakyate bāhvoścaraṇayornyasyenmantrārṇānācatuṣkakam dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ dāyako nātra saṃśayaḥ pādanyāsoṣṭamaścāyaṃ siṃhavyāghrabhayāpahaḥ arddhanyāsoyamudito navamoghasamūhahṛt ante brūyānnavasthāne nyasedāsye ca mastake nābhau kaṭyādipādāntaṃ nyāsoyaṃ daśamaḥ smṛtaḥ namāmyahaṃ tataḥ procya navasvaṅgeṣu vinyaset ayamekādaśo nyāso nṛhareratipāvanaḥ nyāsaścāṣṭavidhopyevamūnaviṃśaprakārakaḥ p. 613) nābherhṛdayaparyantaṃ nyasedvarṇacatuṣṭayam mūrddhādipādaparyantaṃ cintayennṛhariṃ vibhum evaṃ viṃśatiruddiṣṭā nyāsānāṃ pātakāpahā tatkālaṃ kurute kopaṃ vikṣiptaṃ kurute jagat nyāsairbhavati nāśo'taḥ sarvanyāsānsamācaret grasantaṃ daityarājānaṃ kṛśānūpamatejasā suraiśca munibhirlakṣmyā kṛtāñjalikayā śubham vāmāṅge nṛhareḥ pūjyā lakṣmīrbhūṣaṇabhūṣitā āśliṣyantī śāntimūrtistatoṅgāni prapūjayet tṛtīyeṣṭadale pūjyaṃ nṛsiṃhānāntathāṣṭakam nṛsiṃhastambhanākhyaṃ tu śvetamprācyāṃ samarcayet bāṇacāpadharaṃ lakṣmyā sevitammakaradhvajam vidveṣoccāṭanakaraṃ nīlotpalasamaprabham

viprāṇāṃ puṣṭidaṃ netratritayālaṃkṛtānanam gadāṃ nidhiṃ ca bibhrāṇaṃ lakṣmyā yuktaṃ nidhipradam pāśāṃkuśasphuradbāhuṃ śaṃkhacakradharamprabhum lakṣmyā yuktaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ pūjayetsādhakaḥ sadā śaṃkhaṃ kheṭaṃ gadāṃ śārṅgaṃ pūjayeddevavāmataḥ lakṣmīdakṣiṇatastuṣṭiṃ vāme tatraiva kaustubham pītāmbaraṃ brahmasūtraṃ nābhipadmaṃ kirīṭakam ṣaṣṭhīśraddhādibhiḥ śraddhā medhā tuṣṭiśca kārmukā evaṃ sampūjya vidhivatsādhakobhīṣṭamāpnuyāt tatsahasraṃ prajuhuyādghṛtāktahaviṣānale kuryātsaṃsiddhamantrastu prayogānācarettataḥ udyatsahasrārkabhāsaṃ trinetrambhīṣaṇākṛtim nakhairdāritadaityeśaṃ raktadhārāktakāyakam viśvarūpamayaṃ dhyānaṃ nṛhareḥ procyatedhunā antramālādharaṃ raudraṃ kaṇṭhe hāreṇa śobhitam candramauliṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ prativaktre trilocanam akṣasūtraṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ śaṅkhaṃ gokṣīrasannibham khaḍgaṃ śūlaṃ ca bāṇaṃ ca nṛhariṃ rudragopanam evamugrahariṃ dhyāyetsarvavyādhinivṛttaye nṛsiṃhaḥ sarvalokeśaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ śaṃkhacakradharau ramyāvanyau bāṇadhanurdharau pāśāṃkuśadharāvanyau dvau ripormukuṭārpitau dhyāyedambujanīlābhamugrakarmaṇyananyadhīḥ nṛsiṃhaḥ sarvabhūṣāḍhyaḥ sarvasiddhikaraḥ prabhuḥ halaṃ ca musalaṃ samyagabhayaṃ cāṃkuśantathā

vāmabhāgakaraiḥ śaṃkhaṃ khaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ ca śūlakam karadvandvaiḥ kramācchatrorjānumastakapattalam adhaḥsthitābhyāṃ hastābhyāṃ hiraṇyakavidāraṇam nṛsiṃhaṃ saṃsmarennityaṃ mahāmṛtyubhayāpaham viṣarogabhiyāṃ mṛtyorharaṃ śatrubhayāpaham sumukhaṃ vidyudābhāsaṃ netratrayavirājitam apamṛtyumahākṛtyānāśakaṃ nṛhariṃ smaret ayutaṃ madhurādyaiśca daridro na bhavetkalau apūpalakṣahomena dhanadena samo bhavet sadyo nairmalyamāpnoti prasādaṃ cādhigacchati madhūkapuṣpahomena ceṣṭasiddhiḥ prajāyate śatahomena kālīnāṃ vaśīkaraṇamuttamam badarīphalahomena sarvavighnaḥ praṇaśyati juhuyādayutaṃ yosau cirañjīvati vatsarān japejjitvā sa mṛtyuṃ vai śatavarṣāṇi jīvati dūrvāhomādarogī syāllakṣmīvāñchrīphalairbhavet vaśitā prātarutthāya vāksiddhiṃ sā prayacchati aṣṭottaraśataṃ nityaṃ dūrvābhirjuhuyātsudhīḥ rakṣāṃ karoti duṣṭebhyo dustarebhyopi mantriṇaḥ gadānanyānbhayotpātaduḥkhāni harate dhruvam krūraṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ sañcintya śatruñca mṛgaśāvakam sabāndhavasya jhaṭiti tasyoccāṭaḥ prajāyate nakharairdīryamāṇaṃ taṃ saṃsmarenniśitairdrutam bhavenmaṇḍalamadhyeyaṃ divākarasutātithiḥ ripusaṃghakṣayakaraṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ candanādibhiḥ

sahasramekaṃ ca manuṃ bhakṣayecchatrumutkaṭam juhuyātsaptadivasāṃstato rājñaścamūṃ sudhīḥ prasthāpayettāṃ sudṛḍhāṃ rakṣitāṃ balibhirnaraiḥ bhakṣayantaṃ yajenmantrī kuryādāyāti sā camūḥ āgacchedbhūpatiḥ śūraḥ paścānmantriṇamādarāt mantriṇo yadi santoṣo na bhavedbhapatestadā athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi dvitīyaṃ nṛhariṃ vibhum gāyatrī chanda uddiṣṭaṃ devatā nṛhariḥ smṛtaḥ ekalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥ tarpayetkṣudrasalilaiḥ kṛtvā cātmābhiṣecanam mantrarājoditānsarvānprayogānatra sādhakaḥ vipārtamabhiṣiñceta mucyate hi viṣeṇa saḥ bahupadbṛścikotthaiśca viṣairmukto bhaveddhruvam p. 617) śirokṣikarṇahṛtkukṣikaṇṭharogānvināśayet śamayedbhasmasaṃliptaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā aṣṭādhikasahasrañca mriyate ripurasya hi ayamekākṣaro mantraḥ proktassarvasamṛddhidaḥ āṃ hrīṃ jroṃ kroṃ hrāṃ phaḍiti ṣaḍarṇo mantra īritaḥ mantravarṇairaṅgaṣaṭkaṃ kṛtvā dhyāyennṛsiṃhakam somasūryāgninetraśca nānāmaṇivibhūṣitaḥ vajraṃ gadāṃ dārayantaṃ dvābhyāṃ daityeśvarodaram tasyāṃ sampūjya nṛhariṃ kuryādāvaraṇārcanam tadbāhye ṣaḍdaleṃ'ṅgāni tadastrāṇyaṣṭapatrake khaḍgaṃ kheṭaṃ ca tadbāhye bhūpuraṃ tu digīśvarān lakṣaṣaṭkaṃ japenmantraṃ kevalena ghṛtena ca

evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī prayogānācarettataḥ juhuyācca sahasraikaṃ saptāhaṃ bhūtaśāntaye caturdinaṃ prajuhuyājjvaraśāntiḥ prajāyate mantrajāpī vatsareṇa dhanadhānyasamṛddhiyuk sahasradvādaśamitaṃ hutvā sarvajanapriyaḥ varārthinī labhetāśu varaṃ sarvamanoharam kalatramitraputrādyairdhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ jvālāmālaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ tu śatrubhūtādināśakam jvāleti māline dīptadaṃṣtāyāgnipadaṃ vadet bhūtavināśano ṅentaḥ sarvaghoravināśanaḥ huṃphaṭsvāheti mantroyaṃ ṣaṣṭiṣaṭkākṣaro mataḥ viśvadigbhavadhṛtyāśāvedārṇaiḥ syātṣaḍaṅgakam śaṃkhaṃ cakramasiṃ kheṭaṃ dadhānaṃ daivataistutam lakṣaṃ japeddaśāṃśaṃ tu kapilāsarpiṣā hunet viśeṣatoyaṃ bhūtādijvarahā parikīrtitaḥ manvantare salakṣmīkaḥ sevyate yo gṛhasthitaiḥ pramuditapadaṃ procya cetase ca tato vadet devavarṇo manuḥ prokto japatāṃ sarvakāmadaḥ muniḥ prajāpatiḥ proktaḥ śrīṃbījena ṣaḍaṅgakam paścānnārāyaṇaḥ śaśvannīlajīmūtasannibhaḥ govindo dakṣiṇe pārśve dhanvī candraprabho mahān āgneyyāmaravindākṣo musalī madhusadanaḥ vāyavyāṃ vāmano vajrī taruṇādityadīptimān vidyutprabho hṛṣīkeśo vāyavyāṃ diśi mūrdhani sarvāyudhaḥ sarvaśaktiḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ

sabāhyābhyantaraṃ dehaṃ vyāpya dāmodaraḥ sthitaḥ praviṣṭohaṃ na me kiñcidbhayamasti kadācana sarpendrabhāgeśayanaḥ sarpendrābhogachatravān padmacakravarābhīti dharastryakṣenduśekharaḥ aṅgāni ṣaḍdalebhyarcya śaktīścāṣṭadale yajet ramā kāntirdhṛtiśceti bhūpure tu digīśvarān yaṣṭyuttaraṃ trilakṣaṃ ca prajapettatsahasrakam abhyarcya salile devaṃ tarpayenmantranāmataḥ tataḥ prayogānkurvīta sādhako nijavāñchitān anuṣṭubuktāṃstatrāpi sarvānkuryādgṛhāśramī lakṣmyā saha nṛsiṃho yastanmantraṃ sarvakāmadam muniḥ prajāpatiśchando lakṣmīrvā nṛhariḥ suraḥ dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ ṣaḍakṣaravadīritam pāyasairjuhuyāttatra mantratarpaṇamācaret jaya jayaśrīnṛsiṃha manuraṣṭākṣaro mataḥ ekārṇavatprayogāṃśca gṛhasthaḥ sādhayecchuciḥ daśāvatāro nṛharirdakṣasāvarṇikotra cet oṃ kṣauṃ ca matsyarūpāya oṃ kṣauṃ kuṃrmopi ṅentakaḥ taśā nṛsiṃharūpāya oṃkṣrauṃ vāmanatastathā rūpāya oṃ-oṃ-oṃ-kṣrauṃ-kṣrauṃ-kṣrauṃ rāmāyeti kīrtayet nayaśabdadvayānte tu śālagrāmanivāsine puruṣāya nama oṃ-kṣrauṃ ekonaśatavarṇakaḥ daśāvatāranṛharirdevatā sarvakāmadaḥ mantrarājavadetasya dhyānapūjādikaṃ bhavet ayutaṃ prajapenmantraṃ sādhayeddhaviṣā tataḥ

kāmyakarmāṇi sarvāṇi mantrarājavadeva hi nṛsiṃharūpatāṃ prāpya jātāḥ sthāne nṛsiṃhakāḥ jāyante koṭiśo mantrāḥ śūdrasiddhividhāyakāḥ ekaṃ śreyaskaraṃ proktaṃ nṛharernāmagarjanam narasiṃho vīranāmā śṛṇu tatsādhanaṃ priye tāro namo bhagavate vīrānte nṛpadaṃ vadet pīnordhvāṅgāya cetyuktvā cāgninetrāya saṃvadet rakṣayugmaṃ ca hrīṃyugmaṃ rakṣarakṣāgnigehinī varṇāṃstrayodaśa [oṃ namo bhagavate vīranṛsiṃhāya nīladīptadaṃṣṭrāya agni netrāya sarvarakṣoghnāya sarvabhūtavināśanāya sarvaghoravināśāya hanahana dahadaha pacapaca vadhavadha phaṭ svāhā ||] procya nīladīptapadaṃ vadet ghnāyoktvā sarvabhūteti vaded ṅentaṃ vināśanam p. 621) pacayugmaṃ vadhayugmaṃ phaṭsvāhānto dvitīyakaḥ sarvabhūteti samprocya ṅentaṃ caiva vināśanam rakṣoghnāya padaṃ coktvā hanadvandvaṃ dahadvayam huṃ-phaṭ-svāhā tṛtīyoyaṃ mantraścātra samuddhṛtaḥ mālāmantrā ime khyātā dvaitasiddhividhāyakāḥ oṃ-kṣrauṃ mahānṛsiṃhāya namonto daśavarṇakaḥ ṣaḍdīrghayuksvabījena ṣaḍaṅganyāsamācaret varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ prayogoṣṭākṣaroditaḥ trayodaśārṇa uddiṣṭo bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥ dhyānapūjāprayogādi ṣaḍakṣaravadīritam kāśyāṃ sa nityaṃ vasate duṣṭabuddhipracārakaḥ huṃphaṭsvāhā conaviṃśavarṇo mantra udīritaḥ sudarśananṛsiṃhosya devatā parikīrtitaḥ jagaccakrāya ca śikhā kavacaṃ tvasya sammatam sudarśanāyeti manuḥ pañcāṅgaṃ samudīritam

taptakāñcanasaṅkāśaṃ trinetraṃ cādyavigraham p. 622) vidikṣvagre ca pañcāṅgaṃ kramāddikṣu prapūjayet sahasrāṃ siddhisañjñāṃ ca lokeśānāyudhāni ca hunetpuṣpaistataścāpi catvāriṃśatsahasrakaiḥ tarpaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā prayogānācaretpunaḥ tasmindeśe samārādhya sudarśananṛsiṃhakam | sahasraṃ mūlamantreṇa hyapāmārgasamidvaraiḥ dāsavatkurute śatrūnsarvānnāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ayutaṃ jayamāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā tasyāgre vartule kuṇḍe hotavyājyādibhiḥ śamīm jayamāpnoti saṃgrāme nityamparaśurāmavat tenāṃgulīyakaṃ kṛtvā japahomādisādhitam rājñaḥ sakāśātpūjāṃ ca labhate dhārayetsadā punarnavāśiphāniṣkatrayaṃ lavaṇasaṃyutaṃ kṛtvā sampūjayeddevaṃ rājayakṣmā praṇaśyati netrarogaḥ sahasreṇa padmahomena naśyati daśadhā japatoyena karakeṇaiva secayet saptāhamadhyātsadyo hi nāśayettu visarpakān apasmārādikānsarvāngrahānanyānvināśayet yathāvaccintayettatra pūjayedupacārakaiḥ tathā spṛśedvāmahastaṃ hyaṅgasparśādviṣaṃ haret jātaṃ trayodaśe devaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ kṣrauṃ tu sampuṭam asya pūjāprayogādyamekākṣarasamaṃ bhavet abhayākṣo nṛsiṃhoyaṃ samastabhayanāśanaḥ tejastejasa ityuktvā āvirāvirbhaveti ca

tamodvirgrasavahnistrīṃ vadedabhayamātmani muniḥ śukotijagatī chandaḥ prāgvaddivākhilam tadatra kathitaṃ devi bhuktimuktipradāyakam manvantarantu pratyekaṃ sureśādapahṛtya vai ekamanvantare śakraḥ svayamevābhavadbaliḥ oṃ [oṃ namo viṣṇave surapataye mahābalāya svāhā ||] namo viṣṇave brūyātsurānte pataye mahā munirindurvirāṭ chando devatā caiva vāmanaḥ bhrūmadhyakaṇṭhahṛdayanābhyaṃghryādhārakeṣu ca mūrdhni netradvaye karṇadvaye nasi mukhe tathā jānvośca pādayoragnikāṣṭhāṅganyāsa īritaḥ pāde pṛṣṭhe nyasedvarṇānvarṇanyāsoyamīritaḥ pūrṇacandranibhaṃ dhyāyecchrībhūmyāśliṣṭapārśvakam vaiṣṇave pūjayatpāṭha tatra sūryāgnimaṇḍale mantro hyoṅkārahṛtpūrvaḥ svāhānto navavarṇakaḥ tataḥ ṣaḍdalamadhye tu pūjayedvāmanaṃ vibhum pūṣā sumanasā prītiḥ puṣṭistuṣṭistathaiva ca śaśinī subhagā caiva lakṣmīricchā tathaiva ca tataścāṣṭadale pūjet pūjādyairvāsudevakam daśāśaṃ pāyasaṃ hutvā tarpaṇādi samācaret daghyodanaṃ niśāpakvaṃ naivedyaṃ syādvibhūtikṛt sitānnaṃ ghṛtasammiśraṃ prāpnuyādannamakṣayam alakṣmīrnāśamāyāti [tasyetyavyāhāryam ||] mahatīṃ śriyamāpnuyāt annaparvatamāpnoti yatrayatra sa gacchati vasudhārāṃ mahālakṣmīṃ varṣādvarṣati tatra ca juhuyātpāyasaṃ mantrī sākṣādvāgīśvaro bhavet

tatkāṣṭhadīpite vahnau sa satputramavāpnuyāt hunedayutasaṃkhyaiśca sarvatra vijayī bhavet dhyātvā caindrapadaṃ rājyaṃ labhetāśu hyakaṇṭakam ayutaṃ sādhyanāmādyaṃ sa vaśyo bhavati dhruvam saptāhānmucyate rogaistāvadevaṃ japetsudhīḥ ayutaṃ juhuyāttāvajjapedāyurlabhet vai p. 625) japānnirmuktabandhaḥ syādvāmanasya prasādataḥ athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi sarvajñeśvaravāmanam cyavano munirākhyāto gāyatraṃ chanda īritam dvāviṃśatyarṇakoṅgāni ṣaḍdīrghānvitakāmataḥ prasannañca sunetrañca cārusmitamanoharam cintayejjagatāṃ nāthaṃ sarvasyārtiharaṃ harim kuryāttato mantrasiddhaḥ kāmyānsvābhīṣṭadāyakān sahasraṃ haviṣā homo lakṣmīdo dhānyalābhakṛt sahasrahomādbhītīnāṃ nāśo bhavati niścitam traivikramaṃ vāmanasya rūpaṃ dhyāyenmanuṃ smaret mahatīṃ śriyamāpnoti yadyadanyadabhīpsitam tāro namo bhagavate viṣṇave ca daśākṣaraḥ ṛṣiḥ kapila ākhyāto gāyatraṃ chanda īritam trivedatriṣubāṇadvimantrārṇairaṅgakalpanam sarvānbhogandadātyeṣa bhaktānāṃ bhogavāmanaḥ etādṛśastu nāstyanyo janmanyasminphalapradaḥ tāro hṛdayamāye ca bālakānte vidhe padam tryaṃkaṣaṭpañcapañcadvimantrārṇairaṅgakalpanam yajñopavītī nīlābho dhyātavyaśchadmavāmanaḥ

annavidyābhūmidoyaṃ bhaktānāmabhayapradaḥ śrāddhānnaṃ karkaṭīṃ caiva bhakṣayenna kadācana tuṣakārpāsabījāni na spṛśecca kadācanaṃ evaṃ yo niyamairyuktastasya mantraḥ prasidhyati tadagrime pūrvamantraḥ ṣaḍviṃśatyakṣaro manuḥ svāhā śaktirdevatā śrīmāyābālakavāmanaḥ annavidyābhūmidoyaṃ bhaktānāmabhayaṅkaraḥ tāro namo bhagavate vadecca balivāmanam tataḥ śrībījamābhāṣya trayoviṃśativarṇakaḥ padaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni śeṣaṃ pūrvavadīritam duṣṭakṣatratamodhvaṃsī reṇukodbhūtabhāskaraḥ tanno rāmaḥ pracodayāt aṣṭeṣutryakṣivedārṇairmanoḥ proktaṃ ṣaḍaṅgakam stanayorbhujayoḥ pārśvadvayeṃ'ghryorvinyasetpadam ke dṛśi śrotranāsāyāṃ kapole hanuvaktrayoḥ nābhikaṭyorgude liṅge ūrvorvā jānujaṃghayoḥ sāttvike śvetavarṇaṃ ca bhasmoddhulitavigraham pītāmbaradharaṃ kāmarūpaṃ bālānirīkṣitam āraktanetrakarṇasthabrahmasūtraṃ yamaprabham caturbāhuṃ musalinaṃ rājasaṃ kuddhameva ca jamadagniṃ ca kālaṃ ca reṇukāṃ kāmamarcayet dikṣu vedānvidikpatreṣūpavedāṃstato yajet brahmāstraṃ vaiṣṇavāstraṃ ca raudraṃ vāyavyameva ca aindrapālikamastraṃ ca mahāpāśupataṃ tathā kaśyapaṃ ca bharadvājaṃ viśvāmitraṃ ca gautamam

yājñavalkyaṃ bhārgavaṃ ca ṣoḍaśāre tato yajet sāṃkhyaṃ pātañjalaṃ śilpaṃ vedāṅgāni ca ṣaṭ kramāt smṛtīstu bhūpurāgre ca digīśānāyudhāni ca hunedbrāhmaṇabhojyāntaṃ kṛtvā siddho bhavenmanuḥ sa eva jāyate siddho nānyavipraḥ kadācana lakṣaṃ prāgvaddhunedrāmaṃ sāttvikaṃ tatra cintayet viṣayārthaṃ dhanārthaṃ ca vāksiddhyarthamudāhṛtam sādhyakṛcchretikṛcchre ca daivasādhye tvasādhyake homaḥ sarvatra vijñeyaḥ pratyavāyanirākṛtau manāgapi na kartavyo brahmadveṣaḥ kadācana tilaudanājyaṃ rāmaṃ tu rājasaṃ tatra bhāvayet rakṣaṇaṃ syānmahāmārīśītalāśāntaye tathā p. 628) homaḥ sarṣapatailāktaistāmasaṃ cintayedvibhum evaṃ kuryādyamuddiśya tasya nāśo bhaveddhruvam bhavedasya mahāpūjā tāṃ bhaktaḥ prayataścaret avaśyaṃ sa ripūñjitvā kuśalī svagṛhaṃ vrajet sa tu siddhiprado jñeyo nāsti tasya puraskriyā yantraṃ mantrotha vā vidyā tatsiddhaṃ nāsti saṃśayaḥ kuladvayaviśuddhaṃ tu rāmamantrādhikāriṇam rāmabhaktaṃ pradṛṣṭvaiva trasyanti praṇamanti ca śāntaṃ śatrumadaṃ kuryātkusumāni ca vai hunet saptāhārvāktasya sainyaṃ naṣṭaṃ tāvanmitaṃ bhavet varṣādarvāk tasya rāmaḥ pratyakṣo jāyate ddhruvam sūrpārake paurṇamāsyāṃ prayāge tu mṛge ravau sūryyagrahe kurukṣetre rāmo gacchati sarvadā

paraśvadhadharo dātā mātṛhā mātṛjīvakaḥ gotrāṇakṛdgopradātā viprakṣatriyakarmakṛt nāpamṛtyurna dāridryaṃ naca vaṃśakṣayo bhavet rājyakṛtkalibhūpānāṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitā rāmamantrānsa bhagavanpratimanvantare hyabhūta tato hyasya pravakṣyāmi mantrarājaṃ ṣaḍakṣaram p. 629)śrīṃtārādyaśca ṣaḍvarṇo mantroyaṃ ṣaḍvidho mataḥ agastyaḥ śrīśivaḥ proktā munayonukramādime pañcāśanmātṛkāmantravarṇapratyekapūrvakaḥ rāmacandramanorbhedāḥ śatadvayamitā amī ramābījādikānāṃ tu viśvāmitro munirmataḥ kāmabījādipūrvāṇāṃ muniḥ sammohano mataḥ rāmabhadro rāmacandaḥ ṣoḍhā ṣaḍvarṇa ucyate ṣoḍhā syādvahnijāyāntaḥ sa evaṃ ṣaḍvidho mataḥ caturviṃśatisaṃkhyākā bhedāstena nirūpitāḥ bījaiḥ ṣaḍdīrghasaṃyuktaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ vāmorunyastataddhastaṃ sītālakṣmaṇasaṃyutam bilvapatraiḥ phalaiḥ puṣpaistilairvā paṅkajairhunet śrīṃ sītāyai dviṭhāntena vāmapārśvagatāṃ yajet tatastrikoṇakośāgre pṛṣṭhato lakṣmaṇaṃ yajet tataḥ ṣaḍdalamadhye tu ṣaḍaṅgāni prapūjayet tadbāhyeṣṭadalaṃ proktaṃ pūjayediṣṭadikṣu ca pratiṣṭhāṃ paramātmānaṃ tato vidyāṃ prapūjayet nānātmānaṃ tathā śāntiṃ keśareṣu prapūjayet śāntiṃ pradyumnamagreniruddhaṃ ca ratimarcayet

hanūmantaṃ ca sugrīvaṃ bharataṃ ca bibhīṣaṇam āñjaneyaṃ tadagre ca vācayantaṃ kṛtāñjalim akopaṃ dharmapālākhyaṃ mantriṇaśca kramādyajet bharadvājaṃ kāśyapaṃ ca vālmīkiṃ kauśikaṃ tathā sanatkumāraṃ ca yajettadbāhye dvādaśārake dvividaṃ ca gavākṣaṃ ca sakirīṭaṃ sakuṇḍalam arcayetṣoḍaśadale pūrvatastu kṛtāñjalīn pratyūṣaśca prabhātaśca vasavoṣṭau prakīrttitāḥ ajaikapādahirbudhnyaḥ pinākī cāparājitaḥ sthāṇurbhagaśca bhagavānrudrā ekādaśa smṛtāḥ gabhastistu yamaḥ sarvasākṣī cāpi divākaraḥ citro viṣṇuriti proktā ādityā dvādaśa kramāt dhātāramante prayajeddvātriṃśatpatrake ṣvimān indrādīnbhūgṛhe bāhye tadastrāṇi ca saṃyajet evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī prayogānkarttumarhati bhaveddhanādhipativannīlotpalahutena ca vaśayedviśvamakhilaṃ bilvapuṣpairghanātyaye hutā dīrghāyuṣe dūrvā raktābjairdhanavṛddhaye tato devaṃ samavāhya pūjayedupacārakaiḥ agniṃ hutvālaye samyagyajñiyairathavandhanaiḥ tatra sampūjayetsamyagrāghavaṃ proktavartmanā tilairhutvā yadyadiṣṭaṃ tattadevāpnuyānnaraḥ bilvaprasūnairaiśvaryyamarcitegnau hute bhavet palāśakusumairhutvā mantrī vai vedavidbhavet nirāmayaśca dīrghāyurbhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ

p. 631)kavacasya prayoge yo japahomādikarmasu upaiti sadṛśīṃ kanyāṃ lājahomena sādhakaḥ sarvādhipatyaṃ vai dravyaṃ bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ ārātsaṃvatsaraṃ yāvatṣaṭsahasraṃ dinedine ayamevānnado loke sarveṣāmapi jāyate hutvā tu labhate lakṣmīmacirādatra sādhakaḥ vairājyenādhipatyena martyānāmuttamo bhavet saṃvatsaraṃ prakurvīta japahomādikaṃ budhaḥ brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā tu vratametatsamāpayet bhuktimmuktiṃ ca labhate tvihaloke paratra ca abhīṣṭalokavaśyārthaṃ juhuyādarcitenale patrairbilvaprasūnairvā daśāṃśaṃ juhuyātsudhīḥ pāyasenājyayuktena hutvā vidyānidhirbhavet tadeva punarāyāti svādhipatyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ jātīpuṣpāṇi madhuratritayāktāni saṃhunet vaiśākhe rāghavaṃ kuryyātpaśyannanimiṣe kṣaṇaḥ daśāṃśaṃ kamalairhutvā sa cārogī bhaved dhruvam japellakṣaṃ ca juhuyātpāyasenārcitenale śrīrāmasadṛśaḥ putrapautrāḍhyopi prajāyate tadā hanahanetyuktvā tannāmāntaritaṃ japet ākarṇasaśarākṛṣṭakodaṇḍabhujamaṇḍitam raktanetrammahāvīravaryyamaindre rathe sthitam koṭikoṭimahāvīraiḥ karoddhṛtatarūttamaiḥ nadadbhirabhidhāvadbhiḥ samarerigaṇaṃ prati atyantasusamṛddhopi na śatruravaśiṣyate

vidhāya pūrvavatsarvamanāyāsena mārayet daśāṃśaṃ ca tilairhutvā stambhayecchatrusaṃhatim japenmantraṃ nirāhāro juhuyācca tilairapi rāmabhadraṃ ciraṃ sākṣādrāvaṇaṃ cāpi vairiṇam sugrīvādibhiranyaiśca daivatairnāradādibhiḥ bibhīṣaṇāyāgatāya dadataṃ śaraṇārthine svasthānamānayecchīghraṃ rājānamathavā prabhum pramodayantaṃ sahasā tvacirādānayetpriyam saṃmohayati vegena rājānamapi vā prabhum tārādyaiḥ puṭitānmantrānsarvārthānviniyojayet rāmasyaikākṣaraṃ mantraṃ kīrtyate sa tu rāmiti mūrttipañjaranāmānaṃ tattvanyāsaṃ ca kārayet p. 633)dhyānapūjādikaṃ prāgvadrāmalakṣaṃ japenmanum rāma ityeṣa kathito dvyakṣaro bhuktimuktidaḥ dhyānapūjāprayogādi sarvaṃ jñeyaṃ ṣaḍarṇavat upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhī rāmaṃ dhyātvā yathāvidhi jāyante tena kāryyāṇi hyanuślokadalaiḥ priye ṣaḍkarmāṇi vinaśyanti kṛtyāścāripraṇoditāḥ vidhānaṃ vā mahāsiddhirbhavedvā cakravarttitā dvyakṣaro mantrarājastu tryakṣaraḥ parijāyate nyāsapūjāprayogādi sarvaṃ pūrvavadācaret rāmāya nama ityeṣa mantraḥ pañcākṣaro mataḥ rāmabhadro bījaśaktī prathamārṇastatontimaḥ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ pūrvavatkāryyaṃ mantrārṇairmanunāstrakam avekṣamāṇaṃ jānakyā kṛtavyajanamīśvaram

lakṣmaṇena dhṛtacchatramatha vā puṣpakopari prāgvaddhomastarpaṇādi prayoṃgādyaṃ ca sādhayet rāmacandro rāmabhadro ṅento natiyuto dvidhā dhyānapūjāprayogādi nikhilantu ṣaḍarṇavat tārādiṣaḍbhiḥ saṃyukto dvidhā saptākṣaro mataḥ p. 634)sarvaṃ ṣaḍarṇavajjñeyaṃ dhyānapūjājapādikam tāro rāmaścaturthyantaḥ krodhānto vahnivallabhaḥ nāśanaḥ sarvadoṣāṇāṃ saṃgrāme vijayapradaḥ krūṃhrīṃ namaśca rāmāya hrīmityaṣṭākṣaraḥ paraḥ rāmacandrosya mantrasya devatā parikīrttitaḥ dīrghayā māyayāṅgāni tārapañcārṇayuktayā bhasmoddhūlitasarvāṅgaṃ kapardinamupāsmahe rāmaśaktintu sītākhyāṃ varṇalakṣaṃ japenmanum viśeṣato bhogadosau saṃgrāme vijayapradaḥ saptārṇo yo manuḥ proktaḥ ṣaḍbhistārādikaiḥ pṛthak dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ teṣāṃ saptārṇavaccaret jānakīvallabho ṅentaḥ svāhāntaśca humādikaḥ chandaśca devatā rāmaḥ sītāpāṇiparigrahaḥ śirolalāṭabhrūmadhyanetrakaṇṭhastaneṣvapi ayodhyānagare caiva vicitre svarṇamaṇḍape siṃhāsane samārūḍhaṃ puṣpakopari rāghavam saṃstūyamānaṃ munibhiḥ prahṛṣṭairupasevitam śyāmaṃ prasannavadanaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam japapūjāprayogādi sarvamasya ṣaḍarṇavat rāmo ṅento dhanuṣpāṇistathā syādvahnisundarī

rākṣasāntakaro rāmo rāṃ bījaṃ parikīrttitam varṇanyāsaṃ tathā dhyānaṃ puraścaryyāvidhiṃ tathā viśeṣājjayadaścāyaṃ sarvavāñchitadāyakaḥ oṃ hṛdbhagavate rāmacandrāyeti manurmataḥ daśākṣaravadeva syādayaṃ kalyāṇakārakaḥ śrīrāma jayarāmeti jayarāma jayeti ca padatrayairdvirāvṛttyā cāṅganyāsaṃ samācaret puruṣāya padaṃ paścādviṭhāntoṣṭādaśākṣaraḥ daśāsyadarppadalano rāmabhadraḥ prakīrttitaḥ mūlamantraiḥ kośalendraḥ satyasandhastataḥ param śaśvatprasannavadanaścaturthīṃ namasāvadet ramye sugandhapuṣpādyairvṛkṣavṛndaiśca maṇḍite pavitrarūpe parito jayamaṅgalabhāṣite devagandharvanārībhirgāyatryādivibhūṣite saumitrisītāsahitaṃ jaṭāmukuṭaśobhitam hatvā rāvaṇamāyāntaṃ kṛtatrailokyarakṣaṇam homapūjāprayogādi sarvaṃ jñeyaṃ ṣaḍarṇavat rājyaśriyāḥ pradātāraṃ bhaktānāmabhayapradam p. 636)daśāsyāntaka rāṃ rakṣa dehi dāpaya me śriyam chando'nuṣṭubdevatā tu rāmabhadraḥ prakīrttitaḥ mastake ca lalāṭe ca netrayoḥ karṇayostathā kūrparadvitaye vāpi maṇibandhadvaye tathā meḍhre pāyāvūrumūladvaye jānvośca gulphayoḥ pītaṃ vā cintayedrāmaṃ dhanārthaṃ yo manuṃ japet tāro namo bhagavate ḍentaḥ syādraghunandanaḥ

prasannavadanāyeti tataścāmitatejase saptacatvāriṃśadarṇo mālāmantra udīritaḥ rājyābhiṣikto rāmaścoṃ bījaṃ śaktirnamastviti śiromukhabhrūmadhyeṣu netrayoḥ karṇayornasoḥ tathā kūrparayorasya tathaiva maṇibandhayoḥ kaṇṭhe hṛdi stanadvandve pārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhake kare ūrvorjānvostathāṃghryośca sarvāṅgepi nyasetkramāt bilvaprasūnaiḥ patrairvā tilaistrimadhunā yutaiḥ mārjanaṃ bhojayedviprānprayogādi ca pūrvavat jayadāṃ rāmagāyatrīṃ japitāṃ sūryavaṃśajaiḥ ya dhīmahīti tanno rā tadagre maḥ pracodayāt janmaprabhṛti yatpāpaṃ daśabhiryāti saṃkṣayam caturlakṣaṃ japedyastu mokṣabhāk sa na saṃśayaḥ tārādireṣā gāyatrī muktimeva prayacchati manmathenāpi saṃyuktā saṃmohayati medinīm śrīrāmāya huṃphaṭ ca svāhāntoyaṃ navākṣaraḥ śrīmaddāśarathī rāmo devatā parikīrttitaḥ sabindubhiryakārādyaiḥ pañcāṅganyāsa īritaḥ pītāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ cāpabāṇavibhūṣitam vāmabhāge jagadyoniṃ prakṛtiṃ parameśvarīm dhanurbāṇakaraṃ devaṃ sītāṃ padmakarāṃ smaret sītālakṣmaṇasaṃyuktaṃ dhyāyetkalpataroradhaḥ ṣaṭkoṇamadhye rāmaṃ ca koṇeṣvaṅgāni cārcayet hanūmantaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ ca jāmbavantaṃ krameṇa ca sītāṃ ca sugrīvāgre tu dikpālānhetibhiḥ saha

tarpaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā prayogārho bhavenmanuḥ vā kaṃjapatrairjuhuyāddhomoyaṃ lokavaśyakṛt mallikābhirjagadvaśyaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ navabhirdevakanyābhirdevavatsa pramodate kapilājyaṃ pibedyastu dūrvārasavimiśritam śuddhabrāhmīrasaṃ vāpi sa sarvajño bhaveddrutam p. 638)māsena mahadaiśvaryaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ dhanavāñjāyate mantrī dvitīya iva yakṣarāṭ lakṣamekaṃ vidhisthāne nidhilābho bhaveddhruvam jñānapradaṃ mahāmantraṃ sanakādyairupāsitam uttamaślokavaryyāya nyastadaṇḍārcitāṃghraye śrīrāmo devatā bījaṃ rāṃ varyyaḥ śaktirucyate vāgvaddhyānādikaṃ lakṣaṃ puraścaryā prakīrttitā prayogāḥ pūrvamantroktā mokṣārthī sādhayedamum yena kārāgṛhānmukto rāvaṇasya sureśvaraḥ bandīvimuktaśṛṃkhale svāhā dvāviṃśadakṣaraḥ padairasya ṣaḍaṅgāni japellakṣamitaṃ sadā saptāhājjāyate mokṣo [tasyeti śeṣaḥ ||] nātra kāryyā vicāraṇā śrīsītāyai namaḥ svāhā sītāmantraḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ dīrghasvarayutādyena ṣaḍaṅgāni prakalpayet svarṇābhāmambujakarāṃ rāmālokanatatparām śrīphalāni tilānmuktyai bhuktyai ca juhuyātsadā kṛṣṇaḥ sa eva bhagavānkalidvāparasandhigaḥ ekasaptatirūposau pratimanvantarebhavat p. 639)iti tattvaṃ samākhyātaṃ viṣṇoḥ sandhibhavasya ca

satkarma kurvatāṃ pātastaduktirmokṣasādhanam tasya mantraṃ pravakṣyāmi bhuktimuktiprasādhanam nāradosya muniḥ prokto virāṭ chanda udāhṛtam acakrāya hṛdākhyātaṃ vicakrāya śiropi ca cakrāya kavacaṃ proktamasurāntakaśabdataḥ sarvāṅgeṣu manuṃ nyasya mantranyāsaṃ samācaret hṛdaye śīrṣake caiva śikhāyāṃ kavace tathā tataḥ karatale pṛṣṭe vyāpakatvena vinyaset vāmāṃguṣṭhaṃ samārabhya dakṣāṃguṣṭhāntakaṃ nyaset eṣa saṃhāranāmā tu nyāsaḥ prathama īritaḥ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ samārabhya kaniṣṭhāntaṃ sthitirbhavet evaṃ nyāsatrayañceti pañcanyāsāḥ prakīrttitāḥ nyaseddaśāṃgulīṣvevaṃ ṣaṣṭho nyāsaḥ prakīrttitaḥ viparītaṃ punarmūlaṃ saptamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ punarhṛdi ca sarvāṅge sarvāṅgasakalāṅgake tattvanyāsoṣṭamoyaṃ hi mayā tubhyaṃ prakīrttitaḥ vilomatattvanyāsoyaṃ navamaḥ parikīrttitaḥ tārasaṃpuṭitammantraṃ trivāraṃ daśamastvayam sabindukānmantra varṇānsaṃhāroyaṃ śironvitaḥ mantravarṇāndvādaśoyaṃ sṛṣṭinyāsaḥ prakīrttitaḥ sthitinyāsaḥ samākhyāto mūlasyāyaṃ trayodaśaḥ aṃsayorūruyugme ca nyāsoyaṃ syāccaturdaśaḥ pṛṣṭhegre ca nyasenmantravarṇānpañcadaśastvayam gaṇḍayośca nyasedvarṇānnyāsoyaṃ ṣoḍaśaḥ smṛtaḥ mūlāṃgulīnāmagre ca tathāṃguṣṭhādipañcasu

itthaṃ vāmakare nyasya nyāsastvaṣṭādaśo bhavet aṃgulyagre tathāṃguṣṭhādau nyāsastūnaviṃśakaḥ bāhuyugye sandhiyugme nyāsoyañcaikaviṃśakaḥ liṅge jānuni pāde ca dvāviṃśoyaṃ prakīrttitaḥ yugmanyāsoyamākhyātastrayoviṃśatisaṃkhyakaḥ vibhūtipañjaro nāma caiṣa eva prakīrttitaḥ bhuktimuktiprado bhaktiprado viṣṇoḥ padāmbuje mūrttipañjaranāmākhyaṃ proktaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam proktamādyaprakāreṇa nyāsānāmupakalpane evaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena mantrī mantrakalevaram pūrvaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ ramyaṃ smaretpuṣpavirājitam madhupaiḥ kṛtarāṅkāraiḥ kīrādyaiśca nināditam tasminvane kalpataruṃ navapallavaśobhitam divyāmṛtaughavarṣeṇa siñcantaṃ viśvamucchritam ṣaḍūrmirahitāṃ dhyāyettasyādhastādvasundharām padmamaṣṭadalaṃ tatra yathoktaṃ ratnaparṇakam udyadādityasaṅkāśaṃ prasannavadanaṃ vibhum māyūreṇa supicchena rājamānaśubhāṅgakam kuṭilālakavibhrājadāsyaṃ karṇakṛtotpalam padmanetraṃ dīptamaṇiṃ makarākṛtikuṇḍalam atyadbhutonnāsikaṃ ca pakvabimbaphalādharam āraṇyaiḥ pallavaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kṛtagraiveyasampadam śrīvatsāṅkāṅkitoraskaṃ vṛṣaskandhaṃ ca hāriṇam kṣudraghaṇṭikayā baddhakaṭiṃ graiveyarājitam kuliśapramukhaiścihnairaṅkitasvacchapattalam

tanmṛdudhvanisantānavivaśīkṛtamānasam mukhapadmasamāsaktasvāntanetrābhirājitam kavalīkṛtasantyaktanyāsaleśābhirapyalam ḍiṇḍīravābhisaṃyuktadravairdṛṣṭimanoharaiḥ uttambhanīkṛtaśrotrapuṭayugmaiśca tarṇakaiḥ parasparavimardārthakhuraspṛṣṭamahītalaiḥ p. 642)vatsīvatsasamūhaiśca saṃvataṃ tadanantaram uccakarṇapuṭaiḥ pītavaṃśaśabdasudhārasaiḥ madhurākṛtibhiḥ sarvaiḥ pīyūṣādbhutabhāṣaṇaiḥ tato gopapurandhrīṇāṃ smaredvandaṃ samāhitaḥ vallavīvallavagavāṃ devavṛndaṃ bahiḥ smaret ṛṣisaṅghaṃ tathā dakṣe vedādhyayanatatparam vāmabhāge ca yogīndrānyakṣagandharvakinnarān anekaśrutisampūrṇavīṇāvādanatatparam evaṃ dhyātvā yajetpīṭhe dehe mānasikārcanam nyāsoktaṃ kramataḥ paścādgandhādyairdevamarcayet ādau svīye pīṭhamaye dehe mānasikārcanam vaṃśaṃ ca vanamālāṃ ca śrīvatsaṃ kaustubhaṃ tathā karṇikāyāṃ caturdikṣu devasya paritorcayet tejorūpadharāṃścaitānkesareṣvaṅgapūjanam rukmiṇīṃ satyabhāmāṃ ca nagnajittanayārkaje kamalaṃ cārghapātraṃ ca bibhratīrdakṣiṇānyayoḥ stanabhāranatā nānāratnajālavibhūṣaṇāḥ nandagopo yaśodā ca balabhadraḥ subhadrikā svarṇābho vasudevastu rakto nandaḥ prakīrttitaḥ

p. 643)muktāhāradhare ratnakuṇḍalādivibhūṣite nānopāyanahastābjagopāpatyaiḥ supūjitaḥ santānaṃ kalpavṛkṣaṃ ca candanaṃ ca prapūjayet tadāyudhāni vidhinā kramataḥ samyagarcayet nālikeraṃ guḍaṃ pūrīrnavanītaṃ sitopalam oṃ namaḥ parametyuktvātmane nirupamaṃ vadet samaye ca nivedyaṃ hi kuryādanyatpuroktavat mūlamantreṇa mantrajño mūrtiṃ nirmāya mantrakaiḥ mūlamantraṃ samuccāryya pādapadmadvayaṃ vibhoḥ ambhojayugmataḥ paścāduttamāṅge nivedayet devasya dakṣiṇe dadyācchetapuṣpāṇi mantravit sarvasampatkaraṃ puṃsāṃ bhogamokṣaphalapradam saṃkṣepapūjanaṃ tena kṛtvā kṛṣṇāṣṭakaṃ yajet dāmodarāya govinda hṛṣīkeśa kubhārahṛt etaireva vidhātavyā kṛṣṇārcā hyathavā budhaiḥ sampūjya sve hṛdambhoje samudvāsya namettataḥ mantrārthaṃ cintayanmantrī niyamastho jitendriyaḥ paścānmantrasya śuddhyarthaṃ daśalakṣaṃ japetsudhīḥ śarkarāghṛtasaṃyuktairabjairvā juhuyādvaraiḥ ātmābhiṣekaṃ kṛtvātha bhūdevānpūjayettataḥ tato nijaguruṃ samyakpraṇipatya yathāvidhi toṣayetparayā bhaktyā nijakāryasya siddhaye kuryādbhaktiyutaḥ samyaṅ-nityanaimittike rataḥ dadhataṃ pītavasanaṃ sundaraṃ gaganaprabham vīryaṃ prajñāṃ smṛtiṃ prāpya kavināmagraṇīrbhavet

dhyātvā kṣīradhiyāṃ toyaistarpayellabhate sutam chinnamarmapraṇādāḍhyāṃ tadā naśyanti rākṣasāḥ dhyāyettatastāḥ kṛṣṇasya hutaśeṣāṃstu prāśayet grahapīḍādimuktiḥ syādbālānāṃ rugvināśanam ayutaṃ prajapenmantraṃ vighnasaṃghāḥ śamaṃ yayuḥ dadhānaṃ kiṅkiṇīsaṃghaṃ lasatsvacchavibhūṣaṇam santoṣya guruviprāśca vyādhyādirahito bhavet tenāpi mantritaṃ toyaṃ kṣiptvā pīḍāṃ vyapohati veṇuṃ dhamantaṃ govindaṃ dhyāyetpūrvoditaṃ phalam sudhādṛṣṭyā vīkṣamāṇaṃ tadrātrau prajapenmanum sukhīkaroti dhiṣaṇaṃ kāladaṣṭamapi kṣaṇāt aṣṭottaraśataṃ snāyādviṣārto nirviṣo bhavet dakṣiṇena vrajaprāṇiprāṇasantrāṇasūcakam p. 645)bhītidāstaṃ na bādhante viṣavarṣaṇavāyuvat ayutaṃ lavaṇaiḥ śuddhaiṃranāvṛṣṭirbhaveddhruvam bhūyasīṃ vṛṣṭimiṣṭāṃ hi kuryādasamayepi saḥ mantraṃ japettadānīṃ tu sukhī bhavati nānyathā ātmabhūtaparābhūtairjanaiḥ sarvaiḥ stutaṃ tathā mahāghoragraho duṣṭastadānīṃ nāśamāpnuyāt kṣīrācchinākhaṇḍahomātsarvaṃ krūrajvaraṃ haret dhyātvā spṛśejjapannārtaṃ pāṇibhyāṃ sa sukhī bhavet dhyātvā dugdhaguḍūcībhirapamṛtyurvinaśyati dhyātvā pārthayutaṃ mantraṃ japetputrasamṛddhaye ayutaṃ labhate putrānnīrogāṃścirajīvinaḥ pūjayitvāyutaṃ japtvā śatayoṣāpatirvrajet

evaṃ katipayairmāsairvandhyāpi labhate sutam maunaṃ kṛtvā pibennārī prāgvarṣāllabhate sutam parājityātmacakreṇa kāśīṃ tadbhavavahninā juhuyānniśi siddhārthaiḥ svīyatailavilolitaiḥ kṛtyā bhūyastamevāśu kṣapayennātra saṃśayaḥ ghaṇṭākarṇaṃ ca hastābhyāṃ spṛśantaṃ saṃsmareddharim aśeṣapāpanāśārthaṃ puṣṭyarthaṃ ca japettathā dhāvamānaṃ [dhāvu gatiśuddhyorityataḥ śānac ||] ripugaṇamanudhāvantamāśugam saptāhādvairiṇāṃ bhūyo hyuccāṭo deśato bhavet kṛṣṇaṃ dhyātvāyutaṃ japto manuruccāṭakṛdripoḥ ayutaṃ prajapenmantraṃ hunedvā tatsamaṃ budhaḥ śatrurnidhanamāpnoti sudhābhakṣopi nānyathā yāminyāmayutaṃ svastho ripuryamapuraṃ vrajet evaṃ tailantu juhuyācchmaśāne niśi māraṇe hunecca tāvaddhaviṣā tatpātakanivṛttaye kṛṣṇaṃ dhyāyañjapallaṁkṣaṃ sarvato jayamāpnuyāt dhyātvā dharmasya vṛddhiḥ syādyogasiddhiśca jāyate trisvāduyuktairlakṣaṃ yaḥ kaṇḍakaprasavairhunet mahākaviḥ sa vāgīśo vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ dehagehapuragrāmavāsturakṣā bhaveddhruvam āraṇyakāruṇaiḥ puṣpairmadhyāhne vidhinārcayet hariṃ gṛhe japetsāṣṭasahasraṃ dvijavaśyakṛt kṛṣṇamabhyarcya nṛpatīnvaśannayati dāsavat atra dhyāyecca gāyantaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ janamohanam anvahaṃ saptaśatakaṃ hutvā tadbhasma dhārayet

tadbhasmadhāraṇānnārī svapumāṃsaṃ vaśaṃ nayet puruṣaśca tathā nārīṃ dāsīṃ kuryānna saṃśayaḥ sahasramabhimantryātha yebhyo dadyācca te vaśāḥ p. 647)japitvā'ṣṭottaraśataṃ barībhartti ca sadvacaḥ rāsakrīḍārataṃ dhyātvā japennityaṃ sahasrakam japetkanyāmaṇḍalena labhate vāñchitaṃ varam hutvā vaśīkarotyeva bhūpālānsaparicchadān raktotpalairvā kusumaiścampakaiḥ pāṭalodbhavaiḥ aśvamāraprasūnairyo madhvaktaḥ pratyahaṃ hunet pañcabāṇapraviddhāṅgaṃ dāsīkuryyānna saṃśayaḥ homaṃ kuvāta rātrau ca vahnau viprānvaśaṃ nayet padmaiḥ sataṇḍulairhomāttarppaṇācchrīḥ sthirā bhavet samādāya kadambantu samārūḍhaṃ vicintayet śacīmapyānayenmantrī kimanyāṃ narayoṣitam athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi dvitīye yastu jāyate tārasampuṭitaścāyaṃ mantraḥ syāddvādaśākṣaraḥ puraścaryājapanyāsapūjādyaṃ pūrvavadbhavet prayogāśca viśeṣeṇa prayogotra nirūpyate arikambugadāpadmaṃ bāhudaṇḍaiśca bibhratam pītāmbaralasadgātraṃ taruṇaṃ munisevitam svahṛtpadmagataṃ devaṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ navam lakṣadvādaśakaṃ japtvā tatsahastraṃ samidvaraiḥ madhvādilolitenāpi haviṣā vā jitendriyaḥ bhavāndhakāradyumaṇiṃ svīye hṛtsarasīruhe trisahasraṃ japenmantrī japetsandhyoktavartmanā

saṃsārābdhiṃ samullaṃghya jīvanmuktaḥ sa jāyate ayonijaśarīreṇa prakaṭo jāyate bhuvi daśākṣaroyaṃ yāmādistasya mantro bhavākṣaraḥ kāmadevo muniḥ prāgvadanyatsarvaṃ samīritam haraśiṣya iti khyāto vāmamārgapravarttakaḥ daśākṣaroyaṃ lajjādistasya mantro bhavākṣaraḥ prāgvatsarvaṃ vinā śaktiṃ nāyaṃ mantrosya sidhyati sudāmadāridryaharo mantroyaṃ tadupāsitaḥ daśākṣaroyaṃ lakṣmyādyo bhavedekādaśākṣaraḥ nyāsapūjāprayogādi pūrvavatparikīrttitam saṃsārānandasandohadarśakosya manustvayam evamaṣṭādaśārṇoyaṃ mantraḥ proktokhileṣṭadaḥ kṛṣṇo devastu gāyatrī chandaḥ syānnārado muniḥ svāhā śaktiśca klīṃ bījaṃ vedābdhyabdhivilocanaiḥ mūlamantreṇa sarvāṅge trivāraṃ vyāpakaṃ caret etānyaṅgāni vinyasya praṇavena tataḥ punaḥ ke lalāṭe bhruvormadhye karṇayornetrayornasi jānuyugme padadvandve nyasedekaikamakṣaram śirovadanahṛdguhyapādeṣu manuvittamaḥ nyāsāntarādikaṃ sarvaṃ daśavarṇoktavadbhavet ayutadvayasaṃkhyātamadhikārārthamādarāt tarppaṇādi tataḥ sarvaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā caret trikālārcāvidhiṃ vakṣye govindasya jagatpateḥ ramyaṃ ratnamayaṃ divyaṃ smaretkalpataroradhaḥ yathoktapadmamadhyasthaṃ vāsudevaṃ vicintayet

snigdhavastraṃ lalāṭāntaluṭhanmūddhajasañcayam indīvaradalākāraśobhinetradvayānvitam raktādharaṃ sunāsaṃ ca hasantaṃ hṛtamānasam godhūlidhamaroraskaṃ śārdūlanakhadhāriṇam kaṭideśalasajjaṃghādvaye baddhamanoharam tiraskarantaṃ vanajabandhūkaprasavaśriyam dakṣiṇottarayoḥ pārṣṇyorvahantaṃ sādhu suspṛham pūtanāśakaṭādīnāṃ vināśāya kṛtodyamam ākhaṇḍalamurkhairdevaiḥ ||sevitaṃ kāmatatparaiḥ prāgukta eva pīṭhemuṃ hariṃ saṃpūjayetprabhum svāṅgāvaraṇamādyaṃ syāddvitīyaṃ lokapālakaiḥ melayitvā sunaivedyaṃ nivedya prīṇayedvibhum śrīkṛṣṇaṃ pūjayedyatra pūjopakaraṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ dehānte viṣṇusāyujyaṃ prayāti niyataṃ kṛtī gavyaṃ dadhi nivedyāsmai guḍayuktamathāpi vā aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu mūlamantraṃ japettataḥ indrādidevasiddhaiśca sevitaṃ khacaraistathā nīlāmbuvāhasatkāntiviśiṣṭāṅgaśriyaṃ vibhum udbhramadbhrūlataṃ devaṃ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇam pītavastradharaṃ cārumuktāhāravibhūṣitam alaṃkṛtaśarīraṃ taṃ piśaṅgāmbarasaṃvṛtam kāmabāṇapraviddhāṅgaṃ veṇuvādanatatparam abhirāmataraṃ dakṣaṃ ratnaśreṣṭhamabhīṣṭakam dāmādyairaṅgakaiścāpi mahiṣībhiśca tatparam indrādyaiśca tadastraiśca saptāvaraṇasaṃyutam

naivedyaṃ kāñcane pātre pūrvoktaṃ ca nivedayet śarkarāghṛtayaktena baliṃ paścātprakalpayet devāgrabhāgamārabhya savyamārgādbalirmataḥ sahasraṃ śatamānaṃ vā sāṣṭakaṃ pūjayejjapan gīrvāṇavṛndavandyosau sammataḥ sarvajantuṣu sarvaiśvaryyasametotra sukhaṃ bhuktvā hariṃ vrajet daśākṣareṇa manunā rātrau pūjanamācaret gṛhaiḥ ṣoḍaśasāhasraiḥ sarvataḥ pariveṣṭite haṃsādipakṣibhirvyāptaiḥ saṃvṛtādbhutamandire komalāstaraṇe divyasvarṇapaṃkajamaṇḍite nāradādimuniśreṣṭhaiḥ saṃvṛtaṃ mokṣakāṃkṣibhiḥ agnirūpaṃ paraṃ tejo diśantaṃ mantragauravāt sarojadalasaṃkāśanetraṃ makarakuṇḍalam atyantamadhurākāraṃ prasannamukhapaṃkajam dūrīkṛtadharābhāraṃ prasannahṛdayaṃ vibhum itthaṃ sañcintya deveśaṃ govindaṃ samyagarcayet parvataṃ viṣṇuniśaṭhaṃ vṛddhavṛndārakaṃ tathā lokapālāṃstadastrāṇi pañcamāvaraṇārcanam khaṇḍāktakṣīrasadbuddhyā nīraiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ tu tarppayet sarvārcāsu hunenmantrī madhyāhne tu yathāvidhi nyasyeddevamayo bhūtvā svātmānaṃ pūjayettataḥ iha bhogānbahūnbhuktvā vrajeccānte sa sadgatim rāsakrīḍāsamākrāntaṃ ballavīcakraveṣṭitam kālindīsaikate śubhre śītale tāpahāriṇi caladbhṛṅgāṅganāśabdavācālitadigantare

ākāśe sañcaradbhistaiḥ puṣpavṛṣṭikṛtādbhute nārīṇāṃ yugmayordevaṃ pratyekaṃ cāntarāgatam romodgamasamākrāntanāgavallītaruṃ muhuḥ kṛtacārusvanaiḥ sarvālaṃkārairhṛdayaṃgamam maṇiśaṅkhau suvistīrṇe raktapadmagataṃ prabhum tadānīṃ raktaphullāravindacchadavilocanam śitikaṇṭhaśikhaṇḍaiśca baddhamūrddhajasañcayam ratnakuṇḍalasaṃśobhigaṇḍamaṇḍalamaṇḍitam nānāratnasamākḷptasaṃbhūṣaṇasubhūṣitam navapravālarucirahastapādatalaṃ vibhum aṅganākucasaṃśleṣalagnakuṃkumavakṣasam itthaṃ dhyātvā yajetpīṭhe cāṅgāvaraṇasaṃyutam indrādyā bhūpure pūjyā vajrādīnyāyudhānyapi rājate bhājane samyaksaṃskṛtya vinivedayet pratyekaṃ mithunebhyaścānyatsarvaṃ pūrvavanmatam indirāmandiro bhūtvā sarvārādhyaḥ subhuktimān tulyaṃ phalaṃ sa cāpnoti bhavābdheḥ pārago bhavet puroktānāṃ ca kāmyānāṃ sādhakeṣu phalapradam pīṭhādbhistarppaṇādau tu kṛtvā mūlena caikaśaḥ dhenumudrāṃ pradarśyātra smṛtvā tarppaṇasādhakam samyagañjalinā devaṃ tarpayenmūlamuccaret tattatkālocitānpaścāttarpayetparivārakān guḍayuktaṃ dadhi prātarnavanītayutaṃ hareḥ sitopalavimiśraṃ tu tarpaṇadravyamīritam tatprasādajalaiḥ siñcedātmānamiha mantravit

harimudvāsya mantrajño japenmantrantu tanmayaḥ bhajeduktaprakāreṣu samālabhyaikameva tu paścātṣoḍaśabhirdravyaiḥ pratyekaṃ ca catuṣṭayam guḍo bhaktaṃ ca dugdhaṃ ca dadhyatho navanītakam mṛdvī modakapūryaśca pṛthukāścaiva lājakāḥ prātarevaṃ tarppayedyaḥ sāyaṃ vā saptasaṃkhyayā tasya maṇḍalamātreṇa vāñchitaṃ bhavati dhruvam dhāroṣṇaṃ kvathitaṃ dugdhaṃ dadhi dadhyudakaṃ punaḥ pañcāmṛtaṃ navaitāni pratyekaṃ śatamaṣṭa ca khaṇḍamiśritadhāroṣṇa dugdhabuddhyā jalaiḥ śubhaiḥ sa tu nānārasopetaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca vindati iha santarpaṇādeva phalamāpnoti vāñchitam bhatvā nānāvidhairbhāvairabhirāmairmuhurmuhuḥ balād gṛhṇandadadbhikṣāmāyāti mahatīṃ tulām kṛṣṇaṃ sañcintya mantrajño japedaṣṭādaśākṣaram hutvāyutaṃ japettāvatkanyāmiṣṭāṃ labheta saḥ madhuplutakuśairvāpi hunedvā tilataṇḍulaiḥ evamaṣṭādaśārṇasya prayogaḥ kathito mayā pratyakṣo jāyate mantraḥ klīṃ kṛṣṇāya namastviti ṣaḍdīrghānvitabījena [klīṃmitibījena ṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ yathā-klīṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ klīṃ śirase svāhetyādi ||] ṣaḍaṅgāni ca pūjanam sampatprado viśeṣeṇa mantroyaṃ parikīrttitaḥ ekāvatāre sampūrṇe sūkṣmarūpī janārdanaḥ punaśca kalidharmāṇā vṛttyarthaṃ ca janārdanaḥ bhaktebhyaścābhayaṃ dattvā mohayitvā ca duṣkṛtān darśayitvā ca martyānāṃ punastatraiva yātyasau

syādyoṣṭame kaliyuge sarvasiddhividhāyakaḥ vakṣyamāṇasya kṛṣṇa dvādaśārṇamanoḥ samam klīṃ kṛṣṇāya govindāya mantrosyāṣṭākṣaro mataḥ pādaiḥ karāṅganyāsastu prayogādyaṃ ca pūrvavat jātaḥ kṛṣṇastasya manuroṃ namo ṅentakṛṣṇakaḥ nāradosya muniśchandonuṣṭup kṛṣṇastu devatā varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantramanyatproktaṃ daśārṇavat svayameva munirjātaḥ svagāyatryupadeśataḥ śūdropi rājyaṃ samprāpya gāyatrīṃ samyagabhyaset tasya vaṃśe sthiraṃ rājyaṃ mṛto viṣṇupadaṃ vrajet tannaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pracodayāt pañcatripañcarāmābdhivedavarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam prayogāṃścātra gāyatryāstathā kuryyānna saṃśayaḥ nandagopakumārākhyaḥ prakaṭobhūjjarnādanaḥ rūpāya ca balāyeti gopījanapadaṃ vadet ṣaḍdīrghāḍhyādyabījena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ aṣṭādaśārṇamantrasya prayogānācarettathā gopānāṃ madhyato gopaścamatkārapradarśakaḥ kenedṛśī tu bhavatā siddhirlabdhā tu tadvada tvāmeva praṇamantisma krīḍannārīśataistadā kāmārttaḥ kathyate nātaḥ sarvajñastvaṃ kathaṃ punaḥ evamukto haristatra svapnalabdhaṃ manuṃ jagau tarato rūḍhato khyāto na khyāto devakīsutaḥ varṇalakṣajapena prāgjanmapāpaṃ vinaśyati sarve pratyakṣatāṃ yānti sādhakānāṃ tu mantriṇām

lokānāṃ vaśamāyānti tatsmṛtaṃ kathayanti ca yogino yoginīsaṃgho brahmaviṣṇvādidarśanam prāpyate candradevena śrīkṛṣṇasya sarūpatām siddhā yajjapamātreṇa purāneke maharṣayaḥ gomāno gagano mā go yakṣagatyatyagakṣaya nivasankundakuṃjeṣu mukundo yaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ahaṃ prapadye mantroyaṃ proktaścāṣṭādaśākṣaraḥ daśārṇavatpūjanaṃ syādaṅgendrādi tadāyudhaiḥ palāśapuṣpaistaccūrṇaistarppaṇādi tataścaret sadyaḥ śrutidharo mantrī jāyate vedapāragaḥ phaḍantoyaṃ mahāmantraḥ ṣoḍaśākṣara ucyate chando gāyatramuddiṣṭaṃ bālakṛṣṇastu devatā pūjā cāṅgasvavargādyaiḥ puraścaryādi pūrvavat annarūpa rasarūpa tuṣṭirūpa namonamaḥ prayacchāgnivadhūrmantrastriṃśadvarṇonnadāyakaḥ annādhipatikṛṣṇosya devatāparikīrttitaḥ annado jāyate mantrī mantrametaṃ sadā japet tāro namo bhagavate vāsudevāya huṃ ca phaṭ munirbrahmā grahaghnākhyo devatā devakīsutaḥ arcanāṅgairlokapālairgrahādyaiśca samīritā athātaḥ samprakṣyāmi ūnaviṃśe manuṃ param puruṣottama āyurme dehītyuktvā ca viṣṇave p. 657)prabhaviṣṇava ityuktvā namontastriṃśadarṇakaḥ pañcāṅgaṃ dvādaśānte hi hṛdānandātmane tu hṛt dvādaśārṇānta āyurme dehi syājjyotirātmane

namaścidātmane netraṃ pañcāṅgavidhirīritaḥ lakṣamekaṃ daśāṃśena juhuyātpāyasaiḥ śubhaiḥ prāgvaddaśārṇamantroktāṅganyāsaṃ tu samācaret bālavapuṣe svāheti saptārṇoyaṃ manurmataḥ munyādyaṃ dhyānapūjādi sarvaṃ syādbālakṛṣṇavat bālānāṃ bhayanāśārthaṃ rakṣārthaṃ ca tato japet gopālakapadaṃ brūyāttato vedadharāya ca nāradosya muniśchando gāyatraṃ kṛṣṇadevatā grahagopālarakṣādau praśastaḥ śāntikepi ca yaḥ kāliyaphaṇāmadhye divyaṃ nṛtyaṃ karoti tam kālīyamardanaḥ kṛṣṇo devatā parikīrtitaḥ aṅgairindrādibhiḥ paścādvajrādyairarcayecca tam viṣanāśakarā yogāḥ kartavyā manunāmunā etanmantrasamo loke viṣaghno naiva vidyate netre cāñjanamātreṇa saiṣā viṣavināśinī śrīmāyākāmabījāni [śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ kṛṣṇāya govindāya svāhā ||] ṅentaṃ kṛṣṇamudīrayet bhūbhūbhūrāmavedākṣimantrārṇairaṅgakalpanam bahubhiḥ kalpatarubhirveṣṭite ratnamaṇḍape puṣparāgadharāśobhiratnavidyotitāntare adho vai kalpavṛkṣasya śākhāvyāptasya patriṇaḥ tadyoge ravibimbābharatnasiṃhāsanāmbuje samegharavicandrodyadvidyutkoṭinibhacchavim ariśaṃkhagadāpadmadhāriṇaṃ pītavāsasam rukmiṇīsatyabhāme dve dakṣe vāme sthite prabhoḥ suśīlā lakṣmaṇā ceti samāvṛtya striyaḥ sthitāḥ

smartavyāḥ svarṇaratnādidharā dugdhalasatkarāḥ tatogre dikpatīndevānpūjayedapi pūrvavat pūrvoditaprakāreṇa pīṭhanyāsāvasānakam prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā ṛṣyādinyāsamācaret vyāpakaṃ mūlamantreṇa vinyasya ca karātpunaḥ puṭitaṃ mūlamantreṇa mātṛkāvatpravinyaset p. 659)mūrtipañjarakasthāne mūrtipañjaramācaret gomayenopaliptāyāṃ bhūmau pīṭhaṃ pravinyaset kāmabījaṃ karṇikāyāṃ sasādhyaṃ sulikhettataḥ śakrarākṣasavāyūnāṃ koṇe śrībījamālikhet koṇasandhiṣu ṣaḍvarṇamantrasyaikaikamakṣaram bahiraṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ keśareṣu triśastriśaḥ sulikhetkāmataḥ paścādvarṇānatha daleṣu ca likhedvarṇāndhṛtidale bahirvṛttadvayaṃ likhet dharāpure caturdikṣu ramāṃ māyāṃ ca koṇagām samyaksaṃpūjya prajapeddhṛtaṃ ca manujottamaiḥ karomi lokapūjyaṃ taṃ rājavaśyaṃ ca sarvadā tatra mūrtti prakalpyāsyāṃ kṛṣṇamāvāhya pūjayet caturthe'ṅgācca mūlāntaṃ bhūṣaṇādi prapūjayet dakṣordhvahaste cakrāya vāmordhve kambave namaḥ skandhādipādaparyantaṃ nābhyantopari mālikām ṣaṭsu pūrvādikoṇeṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni samarcayet śāntiṃ śriyaṃ bhāratīṃ ca ratiṃ digdalakeśare dakṣavāmakramātpaścāddevadevaṃ samarcayet dalāgrasthāstataḥ pūjyāḥ pūjanīyāḥ [pūjanīyāḥ kramādamītyeteṣāmuttaratra sambandhaḥ] kramādamī

p. 660)śaṅkhapadmau ca tadbāhye lokeśānāyudhānyapi hareḥ pāyasakhaṇḍādidadhibhiḥ parikīrttitam punaḥ sañcintya sampūjya prajapecchaktito manum sarpiṣā juhuyātpaścāddaśāṃśaṃ tarpayettataḥ itthaṃ sādhitamantrastu prayogānvidadhīta vai ayutaṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktairhutvā tadbhasma dhārayet mantrārṇairlakṣasaṅkhyaṃ yo hunenmadhurasānvitaiḥ raktādivasanākāṃkṣī hunetpuṣpaiśca tādṛśaiḥ madhunā saṃyutaiścaiva sugandhāṣṭakasaṃyutaiḥ rājñaḥ purohito bhūtvā bhuktibhāṅnātra saṃśayaḥ mantreṇānena kurvīta tābhyāṃ mantrottamādvarāt jāyate hastagā tasya sakalā vasudhā ciram ante yāti paraṃ dhāma vaiṣṇavaṃ munidurlabham lakṣmīśaktimanojātabījānte daśavarṇakam ṛṣyādikaṃ daśārṇoktaṃ pañcāṅgamapi tādṛśam abjotpalalasaddhastapadmayāliṅgitaṃ mudā evaṃ dhyātvā japenmantraṃ daśalakṣaṃ samāhitaḥ tarpaṇādyairbhavenmantraḥ siddhośeṣaphalapradaḥ p. 661)daśārṇavajjapaścāpi vidheyo nātra saṃśayaḥ māyāśrīsahito mantro daśārṇo dvādaśākṣaraḥ vidhānamasya vijñeyaṃ ṣoḍaśārṇoktavartmanā devaḥ prāguktavattatra mantrasiddhirdrutaṃ bhavet ye mantrā daśavarṇasya bhedāḥ siddhividhāyakāḥ lakṣmīmāyāsmarādyaśca mantrarājo daśākṣaraḥ munyādyantu vidhisteṣāṃ paṅktyāmuktavidhānataḥ

viṃśārṇoktaṃ dvitīye tu prathametha nigadyate vaṃśamādāya hastābhyāṃ vādayantaṃ mudānvitam aṅgendrādikavajrādyairarcanā sarvasiddhidā tarpaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā siddhamantraḥ samācaret daśāṣṭādaśavarṇoktānaṣṭāviṃśe kalāviti aṣṭādaśākṣaro mantraḥ kāmāntotra prakīrttitaḥ ṣaḍdīrghānvitakāmena ṣaḍaṃgavidhirīritaḥ vāme navīnamājyasya piṇḍaṃ sundaramadbhutam tarppaṇādi tataḥ kuryyātprāgvadbrāhmaṇabhojanam aṃgalokeśavajrādyairarcanāsya samīritatā tasyaiva strīmukhāmbhojamarcayenmantramuccaran yadyadicchati tatsarvaṃ tarppaṇenaiva sidhyati aiṃklīṃ kṛṣṇāya cetyuktvā govindāya ramāṃ vadet aṣṭādaśalipiḥ proktaṃ munyādyaṃ cāṅgakalpanam adhaḥkarābhyāṃ muralīṃ vādayantaṃ manoharam mayūrapakṣasambaddhakeśajālaśriyānvitam pañcapañceṣuvedatrivarṇai(ṃ)ḥ pañcāṅgakalpanam tarpaṇādi tataḥ kuryānmantrī pūrvoktavartmanā devasyānugrahāttasya sukhaṃ padmākṣikodbhavam gadyapadyātmikā tasya bruvato bhāratī sadā dhyānaṃ pūrvoktamapyante dehaṃ tyaktvā hari vrajet tāro namo bhagavate nandaputrāya nanda ca svāhāṣṭāviṃśadarṇoyaṃ munirasya tu nāradaḥ ācakrādipadaiḥ prāgvatpañcāṅgaṃ parikīrtitam bahantaṃ madhyagaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ strībhyāmāliṅgitaṃ sadā

lakṣaṃ japetprajuhuyāddhaviṣā sarvasiddhaye nandaputrasya [nandaputrāya śyāmalāṅgāya bālavapuṣe kṛṣṇagovindāyagopījanavallabhāyasvāhā ||] śabdānte śyāmalāṅgāya kīrtayet govindāya daśārṇaṃ ca dvātriṃśadvarṇa īritaḥ aṣṭādaśārṇakaproktaprayogā iha varṇitāḥ oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ hṛdbhagavate nandaputrāya bālava dvicatvāriṃśadarṇoyaṃ chandonuṣṭubvidhirmuniḥ rāmaikādaśapañceṣudhṛtyarṇairaṅgakalpanam mantroyaṃ sakalaiśvaryakāṃkṣitārthaikasādhanaḥ tāro namo bhagavate rukmiṇīvallabhāya ca chandonuṣṭubdevatāsya rukmiṇīvallabhaḥ smṛtaḥ kalayā śyāmalaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nānālaṅkāramaṇḍitam pītakauśeyasadvastraṃ svarṇavetravibhūṣitam vāmahastadhṛtāmbhojāṃ tāṃ samāliṅgitāṃ priyām pūjanaṃ dharmakarmārthaṃ niḥśreyasaphalapradam daśāṃśaṃ kamalaiḥ paścāttarpaṇādi samācaret abhīṣṭakṛtprayogādyaṃ vijñeyantu daśārṇavat līlādaṇḍaṃ suśikṣantaṃ gopījanapadaṃ vrajet bhagavanprabhaviṣṇo syādevantu triṃśadakṣaraḥ līlādaṇḍadharaḥ kṛṣṇo devastu parikīrtitaḥ purāṅganāśca sākūtaṃ mohayantaṃ mahāprabhum hatakaṃsaṃ smaretkṛṣṇamaprameyaparākramam trimadhvaktairhunetpaścānmārjanādi samācaret p. 664) śubhagaḥ sa jagadvandyo ramāyā bhavanaṃ bhavet govallabhāya svāheti mantraḥ saptākṣaro mataḥ daśārṇoktavidhānena pañcāṅgavidhirīritaḥ

sarppāripicchanikaraiḥ samyakkḷptāvataṃsakam kapilāṃ vanamadhyasthāmāhvayantaṃ ca gāṃ mudā ādāvaṅgāni sampūjya pūjayedyo gaṇāṣṭakam kālaḥ karṇātmakaśceti tataḥ proktaṃ gaṇāṣṭakam purandaramukhāsteṣāmāyudhāni tataḥ param tatsahasraṃ hunenmantrī godugdhena puroktavat mokṣārthaṃ ca gavāṃ vṛddhirjāyate tasya bhūyasī sarve prayogāḥ siddhyanti sampūrṇāḥ syurmanorathāḥ tāro namo bhagavate śrīgovindāya saṃvadet gāyatrī chanda uddiṣṭaṃ śrīkṛṣṇo devatā manoḥ kalpadrumatale ramye ratnasiṃhāsane śubhe prasnutastanabhāreṇa govṛndena yutaṃ bhajet padmāyatākṣaṃ śakrasya hastikumbhāmṛtasya tu rukmiṇīsatyabhāmādibhāgayorvāmadakṣayoḥ rudrādivaruṇānteṣu keśareṣu caturṣvapi nāgnajitī sunandā ca mitravindā sulakṣaṇā āgneyādiṣu sampūjyāḥ kiṃkiṇīdāmayaṣṭikāḥ vanamālāṃ bhūpuretha devāgrādipradakṣiṇam nandaṃ yaśodāṃ dhenūśca gopālāṃścāpi gopikāḥ puṇḍarīkaṃ vāmanaṃ ca śaṃkukarṇaṃ tataḥ param devasyāntarato vāme viṣvaksenaṃ samarcayet tatsahasrāṇi gokṣīrairjuhuyāttarpayettataḥ dinādāvatha madhyāhne samayatritayethavā bhaktyā paramayopeto gopālāṁśca samarcayet tasmādbhajedamuṃ mantraṃ drutaṃ siddhipradaṃ śive

vadedgokulanāthāya namontoṣṭākṣaro manuḥ varṇadvayena pañcāṅgaṃ sakalena prakalpayet prañcāntike ca dhāvantaṃ madanena purānvitam nānāmunigaṇairdṛṣṭaṃ sevitaṃ sarvalīlayā caturaṅgāni sampūjya cāstraṃ koṇeṣu pūjayet tadbahirlokapālānāṃ vajrādīnāṃ ca pūjanam tarppaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā samṛddhirmahatī bhavet tāraṃ ramāṃ hriyaṃ kāmaṃ śrīkṛṣṇāya tato vadet ṅento bījatrayaṃ cādyaṃ pañcaviṃśākṣaro manuḥ vedavedeṣu gorāmasampūrṇena ṣaḍaṅgakam pūjājapaprayogādi sarvaṃ jñeyaṃ daśārṇavat ekacchandarṣidevādiprayoganyāsakāvapi nāradosya munirdevo gāyatraṃ chanda ucyate ṣaḍaṅgāni tato dhyāyetsaṃsthitaṃ kamalādike hastābhyāṃ navanītaṃ ca pāyasaṃ cāpi bibhratam meghaśyāmaṃ ca parito gopagopījanāvṛtam hṛdādikavacāntāni cārcedaṅgāni sādhakaḥ ākhaṇḍalamukhāṃścaiva vajrādīnyāyudhāni ca kṛtvā brāhmaṇabhojyāntaṃ svepsitārthāllaṁbhennaraḥ viprādipādajāntāstu nāmamantrādhikāriṇaḥ oṃkṛṣṇa iti mantroyaṃ trivarṇaḥ parikīrttitaḥ munibhistu viśeṣeṇa saṃsevyo bhuktimuktidaḥ munyādikaṃ prayogāntaṃ sarvaṃ prāgvatsamācaret kṛṣṇāya hṛdayaṃ pañcavarṇaḥ prāgvajjapādikam madhyekṛṣṇāya pañcārṇaḥ sarvaṃ pūrvavadeva hi

ṣaḍakṣaroyaṃ munyādiprayogāntaṃ ca pūrvavat ṣaḍakṣaro mantrarājo japadhyānādi pūrvavat govindāyeti saptārṇaḥ prāgvanmunyādikaṃ matam kṛṣṇāya kāmabījaṃ ca prāgvatsaptākṣaro manuḥ bhakṣaṇāya dviṭhāntoyamaṣṭavarṇaḥ prakīrttitaḥ aṣṭavarṇaḥ samākhyāto munyādyaṃ pūrvavanmatam govindāya punaḥ kāmo navārṇaḥ parikīrttitaḥ ṅentaśca hṛdayāntaśca manuḥ prokto navākṣaraḥ śyāmalāṅgāya hṛdayaṃ daśārṇaḥ parikīrttitaḥ kṛṣṇāya vahnijāyānto mantraḥ prokto daśākṣaraḥ nandeti bālavapuṣe svāhā paṃcadaśākṣaraḥ kāmabījadvayaṃ kṛṣṇapadaṃ vedārṇa ucyate tadvaddhyānaṃ viśeṣotra kalpavṛkṣatale sthitam mahāpadmaśca padmaśca śaṅkho makarakacchapau lokapālaiśca vajrādyaiḥ paścādāvaraṇadvayam daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādagnau śrīphalairmadhuraplutaiḥ madhuratrayasadbuddhyā śuddhatoyairdināgame bhuktiprado muktidaśca sarvakāmapradastviti kṛṣṇasyādau dvayoḥ kāmabījayoraṃkayojanāt ṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena tādṛśenāṅgakalpanam kiṃṅkiṇīsaṃvṛtakaṭiṃ nīlakuñcitamūrddhajam p. 668) prāgvatpūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ puraścaryyā tatheritā tarppaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā guruṃ yatnena toṣayet maṇḍalātsarvasasyādi vastujātaṃ tadā bhavet vāglajjāklīṃramāhrīṃgrīṃjrīṃtrīṃjayajayeti [oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ hrīṃ grīṃ jrīṃ trīṃ jayajaya kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa nirantaraṃ krīṃ trīṃ nityapramuditaretasre nityakriyāya kṛṣṇāya klīṃ gopījanavallabhāya svāhā grīṃ hrīṃ ||] ca

krīṃ trīṃ nityapramuditaretase padamuccaret ya svāhā grīṃ ca hrīṃ ceti dvipañcāśallipirmanuḥ sammohanahariḥ prokto mantravarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam aṣṭabhī ravibhirnetrairnavabhiśca nakhendubhiḥ hastadvaye daśārṇoktavidhinā nyāsamācaret trivāraṃ mūlamantreṇa vyāpakaṃ ca tataścaret daśatattvādikaṃ nyasya tadante mūrtipañjaram sarvamanyatpuroktena vidhānena vidhāya vai pure ca maṇije ramye parvatāmbudhimadhyage udyānavāpikāvāṭīnānājanamanohare nānāratnagaṇākīrṇe gehe sañcintayeddharim nānāsugandharuciramaṅkanyastakarāmbujam āliṃgya tāṃ ca bāhubhyāṃ śvetamuktāvibhūṣitam p. 669) cakravajjāmbavatyā ca śliṣṭaṃ vāmasthayā tathā padmaṃ gadāṃ śaṃkhacakre caturbhirdadhataṃ karaiḥ caturdikṣu bahirdevairmunibhiḥ sevakairvṛtam viṃśārṇoditayantraṃ ca samyagatra sulekhayet hrīṃtrīṃhrīṃtrīṃ ca bījāni śiṣṭairvarṇaiḥ praveṣṭayet ṣaṭkoṇetha kramāllekhyaṃ aiṃhrīṃśrīmīśakoṇataḥ arghyapātrādi saṃsthāpya madhyabīje hariṃ yajet aṅgāni ṣaṭsu koṇeṣu vāmāṃke sarvagāṃ yajet yajetkṛṣṇāgramadhye tu pṛṣṭhagaṃ cāṃjanaṃ dhanuḥ sarvadā cāpi varṣantau dhārābhirvastusañcayam viṣvaksenaṃ ca koṇeṣu varṇagānpakṣiṇo yajet tadbahirvāsavādīnāṃ vajrādīnāṃ ca pūjanam

varjayetprajapellakṣaṃ strīmātrasya gurorapi tarppaṇaṃ mārjjanaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥ samarcayati gīrvāṇāṁllokānandakaraśca saḥ anvahaṃ tarppayedyastu śataṃ sāgraṃ bhaveddhruvam candracandanapaṃkāktamālatīkusumairyavaiḥ trailokyaṃ tadvaśe tiṣṭhetkhyātaḥ kavivaro bhavet vaśyā bhavaṃti satataṃ smarārtāḥ surayoṣitaḥ grahendirā sadasyā syātsevane bhaktitatparā vipattiduḥkhadaurbhāgyamṛtyvādirahitaḥ sadā sampannaḥ sarvasampatyā yaśasvī dīrghajīvanaḥ yajjapādeva putrāderutpattirbhavati dhruvam dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ chandonuṣṭubdevatā ca kṛṣṇaḥ santānadāyakaḥ śaṅkhacakradharaṃ devaṃ śyāmavarṇaṃ caturbhujam samarppayantaṃ viprāya naṣṭānānīya bālakān arcanā cendravajrādyairuditāsya mahātmanaḥ tarppaṇādi tataḥ kuryyānmantraḥ siddhyati mantriṇaḥ putrārthaṃ śāntikaṃ kṛtvā tatrastho viṣṇumarccayet sa varṣāllabhate putraṃ vinītaṃ cirajīvinam vāsudevāya huṃphaṭ ca svāhā viṃśārṇako manuḥ nyāsadhyānajapārccādi daśavarṇoktavadbhavet kamabījātmako mantro munirmohananāradaḥ ṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena ṣaḍaṃgāni prakalpayet aṃgulīṣu nyasedaṃgaṃ hastayostalayorapi bījasampuṭitānnyasya mātṛkārṇānanantaram

ṣaḍaṅgāni punarnyasya yathāsthāne śarānnyaset śeṣatatpramukhānetānpañcabījaprapūrvakān mūle lasatsthalīrājadratnasiṃhāsanopari ariśaṅkhasṛṇīnpāśaṃ puṣpabāṇekṣukārmukam ghūrṇanetraṃ kuṇḍalinaṃ hāriṇaṃ sukirīṭinam āliṅgantaṃ vāmabāhudhṛtapadmāvaliṃ vibhum paścādaṅgāni bāṇāṃñca nyāsamārgeṇa pūjayet cakrādyaṃ triṣu hasteṣu śrīvatsaṃ kaustubhaṃ tathā pītāmbaraṃ mahālakṣmīṃ vāmāṃke bījapūrvikām tato bahiścarānbāṇāndikṣu koṇeṣu pūjayet indrādīnpūjayedbāhye vajrādīnyāyudhānyapi trisvādvaktaistarppayecca sahasradvādaśāvadhi anena manunā toyairmohinīpuṣpasaṃyutaiḥ trailokyaṃ mohayedyastu japenmantraṃ samāhitaḥ p. 672) ayutaṃ sarpiṣā hutvā sasampātaṃ hutāśane yastu tadvaśagā sā syātsāpi taṃ vaśamānayet athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi rāmaṣaṣṭimite kalau tanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayāt nāśayetsarvapāpāni siddheyaṃ kalpavallikā yathāyogyaṃ japetsādhyamasādhyaṃ ca prasiddhyati glaumityekākṣaro mantro jagatī chanda īritam bījaṃ gakāra oṃ kāraḥ śaktiḥ proktaṃ ṣaḍaṅgakam glauṃ nābhau tu tathauṃ gulphe binduṃ pādadvaye nyaset padmopari sthitaṃ vande veṇuṃ gāyantamīśvaram gopībhirgopavṛndaiśca sevitaṃ kṛṣṇamarccayet

lakṣāyutasahasrāṇi catvāryyasya japo manoḥ evaṃ saṃsiddhamantrastu daśārṇoktaprayogakān kuryyādiha tu saubhāgyamante yāti hareḥ puram kāmabījāntare kṛṣṇamantroyaṃ tryakṣaro mataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kakāro bījaṃ syādīkāraḥ śaktirucyate dhyānapūjā prayogādi piṅgagopālavanmatam tāro namaśca kṛṣṇāya mantro rasamitārṇakaḥ p. 673)athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi vasuṣaṣṭimite kalau huṃ bhīṣayadvayaṃ hṛcca humantaṃ trāsayadvayam varma pradhvaṃsayayugaṃ varmāntaṃ rakṣayadvayam aṣṭāṅgāni nyasenmantrī mantravarṇairyathāvidhi vidadhyātkarayornyāsaṃ mantrārṇairaṣṭabhiḥ sudhīḥ sṛṣṭiretadvaiparītyaṃ saṃhāro gaditaḥ sthitiḥ drāvaṇyādyabījayutāmaṃguṣṭhādiṣu vinyaset tāto bāṇārṇapuṭitāṃ mātṛkāṃ ca pravinyaset teja āpo dharā ceti tattvāṣṭakamudīritam mukhe śīrṣe hṛdi punarhṛdaye sakalāṅgake eṣā sṛṣṭiśca nābhyādyā hṛdantā sthitirīritā mantrārṇānāmayaṃ proktastridhā nyāso dhanapradaḥ mantrārṇānvinyasenmatrī nyāsoyaṃ dārḍhyakārakaḥ pṛṣṭhe ca vinyasedvarṇānnyāsoyaṃ śubhakārakaḥ kūrpare cāṃsake nyasya manorvarṇāndhanapradān mantrasya vinyasedvarṇānnyāsoyaṃ kāmyakaḥ smṛtaḥ aṃguṣṭhādau nyasedvarṇānpañcamo dharmavṛddhikṛt dakṣorumūle jānau ca gulphe pañcāṃgulīṣu ca

dakṣāṃguṣṭhaṃ samārabhya vāmamadhyācca vinyaset evantu pādayornyasyennyāsoyaṃ daśamo bhavet pādayośca nyasedvarṇānnyāsa ekādaśaḥ smṛtaḥ karmaṇā vinyasedvarṇānnyāsoyaṃ dvādaśaḥ smṛtaḥ dakṣasphici ca jaṃghāyāṃ pādeyantu trayodaśaḥ prathamārṇaṃ pādatale padapādāgrajānuṣu vakṣaḥ pṛṣṭhahṛdayeṣu kaṇṭhe vaktre nasostale sarvopadravahantāyaṃ nyāsaḥ pañcadaśaḥ smṛtaḥ ṣoḍaśoyamiti proktastattvapañjarasajñakaḥ nṛsiṃhaṃ pañcame proktamāceranmūrtipañjaram ūrvorvaiśyaṃ śūdravarṇaṃ pādayoriti vinyaset graiveyaṃ kaustumaṃ kaṇṭhe hṛdi śrīvatsahārakam kaṅkaṇe hastayornyasya mekhalāṃ ca kaṭau nyaset paridhāne cottarīyaṃ pādayornūpuraṃ tathā adhaḥpāṇyorgadāpadme tato dhyānaṃ samācaret vanaṃ sañcintayettatra sakalarttusamanvitam surāsurarṣipramukhaiḥ sevitaṃ cāpsarogaṇaiḥ pūrvoktapīṭhe mūlena mūrtiṃ saṅkalya cāhvayet śriyaṃ pītāmbarāktāṃ ca dhṛtiṃ kāntiṃ sitāsite aṣṭalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ niyamastho jitendriyaḥ jalaiḥ saghṛtadugdhānnaistarppaṇādi samācaret tataḥ kurvīta mantrajñaḥ prayogāṃśca prasiddhaye madhuratrayasaṃyuktaiḥ palāśakusumairhunet trisvāduyuktaṃ lavaṇaṃ hunenniśi sahasrakam ayutaṃ juhuyādājyaṃ dūrvābhaktaiśca śodhitam

vastrālaṅkaraṇādyaiśca brāhmaṇānapi bhojayet sūryyabimbe nyastadṛṣṭirabdena satataṃ japet aṣṭādhikaṃ sahasraṃ tu sa bhavedgoramānvitaḥ ṣaṭkarmāṇi ca siddhyanti yāti viṣṇoḥ parampadam yajjapenāvatārotra sarvakālaphalapradaḥ nāvatāraḥ sa evātra devaḥ pratyakṣatā gataḥ avatārotra mantrastu śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śaraṇaṃ mama dhyānapūjāprayogādi daśākṣaravadīritam sabhyatvānna dvijātīnāmadhikārosti karhicit golakāśca tathā jātyā kāyasthādaya eva ca patitānāmayaṃ mantraḥ samproktaḥ śaraṇapradaḥ p. 676)kalikālādahaṃ bhītaḥ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃgataḥ ṣaḍaṅgavidhirākhyātaḥ sarveṇa vyāpakaṃ caret gauraṃ muṇḍitasarvāṅgaṃ dhyānastimitalocanam indrādilokapālaiśca tāmravarṇāmbarāvṛtam karṇikāyāṃ ṣaḍaṅgāni dale śiṣyānyajetkramāt sarvajñaṃ sugataṃ buddhaṃ pārśvanāthaṃ tathāgatam kāminīṃ ca mahāmāyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ ca vināyakam ṣaḍabhijñaṃ daśabalaṃ śāstāraṃ śrīghanaṃ kṣayam tadbāhye bhūpure dikpāṃstadastrāṇi ca pūjayet tulasīmiśratoyaiśca bhagavantaṃ pratarppayet evaṃ tu vartamānasya vāksiddhyādi prajāyate bhūtapretādipīḍāyāṃ mahāgadabhaye tathā kaṃkalkine hṛdantoyaṃ mantraḥ proktaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ mantroyamatigopyastu stutyaśca nṛpanāśakaḥ

mahāmudrāḍhyahastaṃ ca kaustubhoddāmakaṇṭhakam antarhitairdevamunigandharvaiḥ saṃstutaṃ harim ṣaḍaṅgāni ca patreṣu pūjayettasya sevakān kālaṃ nīlaṃ lokapālānbhūpure hetayastathā [pūjyā iti śeṣaḥ ||] tarpayetsalilaiḥ śuddhaiḥ prīṇayedbhūsurānapi etatsādhakamālokya dūrato duḥkṣitīśvarāḥ dinedine vardhate śrīrmṛto vaikuṇṭhamāpnuyāt daśāvatārarūpasya kimanyacchrotumicchasi iti śrīmahāmāyāmahākālānumate merutantre śivapraṇīte daśāvatāramantraprakāśaḥ ṣaḍviṃśaḥ caturviṃśatimūrttināṃ mantrāṃśca medhunā vada bhuktimuktipradān viprairārādhyānsacaturthakaiḥ varṇatrayātmako mantraḥ keśavaḥ parikīrttitaḥ ānābhipādaparyyantaṃ maṅgalaṃ madhusammitam bhujaiṣṣaḍbhirdadhānaṃ ca raktavarṇaṃ ca satkaṭim mayūramukuṭaṃ ramyaṃ makarākṛtikuṇḍalam sanakādīnkarṇikāyāṃ gaṇeśaṃ nandikeśvaram dalāgreṣu kramāccāpi prahrādaṃ nāradaṃ balim agradakṣakramādgāṃ ca haṃsaṃ pakṣīśvaraṃ tathā japellakṣatrayaṃ mantraṃ madhuratritayairhunet iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya mṛto mokṣamavāpnuyāt namo nārāyaṇāyeti tārādyaṣṭākṣaro manuḥ devatā paramātmāsya pañcāṅgavidhirucyate pañcāṅgamantrāḥ samproktā aṃguṣṭhādāvapi nyaset sṛṣṭinyāsoyamuddiṣṭassaṃhāraścāraṇādikaḥ mūrdhni netradvaye caiva sumukhānte tathā hṛdi

sarvanyāseṣu tāreṇa puṭitārṇānpravinyaset nabhideśe prathamako nyāsoya parikīrttitaḥ pṛṣṭhe ceti dvitīyoyaṃ nyāsastu parikīrttitaḥ krameṇa vinyasedvarṇānnyāsoyaṃ syāttṛtīyakaḥ daśahaste caturthaḥ syādvāmabāhau ca pañcamaḥ nyāsaḥ ṣaṣṭhoyamudito vāmāṃghrau saptamaḥ smṛtaḥ hṛdi dhyātvā nyasedvarṇānnyāsoyaṃ cāṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ pādayośca nyasedvarṇānnyāsoyaṃ navamaḥ smṛtaḥ vāmordhvakaragaṃ cakraṃ dakṣedhaḥ karaśaṃkhakam vibhūtipañjarākhyoyaṃ nyāso daśavidhaḥ smṛtaḥ tattvāṣṭakamidaṃ binduyugvarṇāḍyaṃ tathoktavat palliṅgahṛnmukhe śīrṣe netrahṛdvyāpakeṣu ca bindunādaśaktiśāntirūpamātmacatuṣṭayam mūrttipañjaravinyāsaṃ praṇavādyaṃ samācaret iṃ mādhavāya mitrāya namaḥ procya hṛdi nyaset uṃ viṣṇave cāṃśumate namo dakṣiṇapārśvake eṃ trivikramāya vivasvate hṛddakṣagaṇḍake oṃ śrīdharāya pūṣṇe ca namo vāmāṃsake nyaset damodarāya kakudi sargānto viṣṇave namaḥ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmahastaṃ pītāmbarāvṛtam ātmajyotiḥsampradīptasahasrādityatejasam dvisaptatyakṣaro mantro vyāpakatvena coditaḥ tāroktyā khādikān varṇān sabindūn hṛdayāntakān jīvaṃ prāṇaṃ sarvatanau nyasedevaṃ dvayaṃ budhaḥ mastakānanahṛdguhyapādāṃseṣu ca vaikramāt

śrotratvagakṣijihvākhyaghrāṇānāṃ tattvapañcakam vākpāṇipāyupādākhyopasthānāṃ tattvapañcakam ākāśavāyutejāṃsi jalakṣmātattvapañcakam tatastu hṛdaye nyasyenmaṇḍalatritayaṃ punaḥ haṃsaraṃ varṇapūrvaṃ ca yojayitvā ca pūrvavat nyasedoṃkhāṃnamaḥ proktā parāya parameṣṭhine tāroyaṃ nama ityuktvā puruṣāyapadaṃ vadet oṃraṃ namaḥ parāyeti nivṛttiṃ ṅentanāmani oṃlaṃ namaḥ parāyeti śarvāyeti padaṃ vadet oṃkṣrauṃ namaḥ parāyeti nṛsiṃhāya padaṃ vadet evaṃ vinyasya vidhivatsākṣānnārāyāṇo bhavet vaiṣṇavīrdarśayenmudrāḥ pūrvoktāśca tataḥ param ūrdhvaṃ cādho dakṣabhedād ghaṇṭāṃ ca kamalaṃ gadām keyūrahāramukuṭaṃ sapītāmbarakuṇḍalam navaśaktisamāyukte pīṭhe devaṃ yajettataḥ prabhā satyā tatheśānānugrahā nava śaktayaḥ sarvātmane vāsudevāya sākṣiṇe padamuccaret pīṭhamantraḥ samākhyātaḥ saptatriṃśadbhirakṣaraiḥ tubhyaṃ tamabhidhāsyāmi mantramāvāhanasya ca yajñabhāgaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ vāsudeva namostu te karṇikāyāṃ yathāsthānaṃ yajedaṅgāni pūrvavat dikpatreṣvarcayedvāsudevaṃ saṅkarṣaṇaṃ tathā gaurahāridrakṛṣṇākhyaśuklanīlanibhānkramāt śuklasvarṇapayaḥśyāmasaṅkāśāścārubhūṣaṇāḥ arcenmusalakhaḍgau ca vanamālāṃ dalāgrataḥ

ataḥ śaṅkhanidhi padmanidhī raktotha raktabhāk āgneyādidaleṣvete pūjyāścāgre digīśvarāḥ nārāyaṇasya gāyatrīṃ bravīmyekamanāḥ śruṇu tanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayāt yogyaḥ syādviṣṇudīkṣāyāṃ dvijavatpāpavarjitaḥ p. 681)juhuyāttarppayetkṛṣṇacandraṃ ca keśarāmbubhiḥ evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī prayogantu samācaret sammukhīkaraṇe dhyāyedviṣṇuṃ garuḍagāminam guḍūcīrayutaṃ hutvā mṛtyumevātitarjjayet japedaṣṭottaraśataṃ sa bhavedapamṛtyujit nirastapātako bhūtvā nīrogo jñānavānbhavet japitvā yastu bhuñjāno dhīmānārogyavānbhavet yaḥ pibellabhate medhāṃ kavitābodhanaṃ ca saḥ dhārayeddakṣiṇe haste sarvataḥ syātsurakṣitaḥ ete hyaṣṭau mantravarṇā mantrāṣṭakamudīryyate jamadagnirvaśiṣṭhaśca kaśyapotrirghaṭodbhavaḥ triṣṭup ca jagatī caiva virāṭ chandāṃsyanukramāt pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca vijñeyā devatāḥ kramāt tattvāni saptalokāstu kṣetrāṇi khacarātmakāḥ padmakiñjalkanīlābhaṃ raktavarṇāṣṭako mataḥ pracayastricaturvarṇairnihataṃ pañcamākṣaram sāntarāḥ syuḥ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmakarāḥ kramāt aṅgānyantimapatre tu madhyasthaṃ punararcayet dvitīyāvaraṇaṃ proktamantravarṇāṣṭamūrttibhiḥ tṛtīyeṣṭadale proktā ratiścāpi dhṛtistathā

vajrādibhiścaturthī syātprāgvatṣaṣṭhī sapañcamī nākārāvṛttipūjāyāmāvṛttitrayapūjane tṛtīyāvaraṇe pūjyā śrīrmāyā ca manonmanī yavarṇamūrtipūjāyāntulyamevāvṛtidvayam śokāramūrttipūjāyāṃ prāgvadāvaraṇadvayam śaṃkhapālaśca kulikaḥ proktamatrāvṛtidvayam vāsudevādibhiḥ śāntyādiyuktairamayā matā caturthyāmaṣṭapatre tu vajrādīnāṃ samarcanam ṣaṣṭhyāmindrādikāścāgre tadastrāṇīti pūjanam iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya viṣṇusāyujyamāpnuyāt nārāyaṇasya caraṇau śaraṇaṃ ca tato vadet namo jinārṇako mantro munyādyaṃ pūrvavanmatam dhyānapūjāprayogādi pūrvavatparikīrttitam kṣiprasiddhikaraḥ kāśyāṃ yadvāsau dhruvapūrvakaḥ dvādaśārṇo mahāmantraḥ pañcāṅgāni kramātpadaiḥ baddhāñjalī ramā vāme vādayantī ca vallakīm prasannavadanaṃ dhyāyedvaradānasamudyatam pañcāṅgapūrvamabhyarcya yajedaṣṭadale kramāt gaṅgāmasīṃ ca varuṇāṃ gaṇḍakīṃ ca dalāṣṭake vibhīṣaṇaṃ ca prahrādaṃ bāhye ṣoḍaśapatrake ḍhuṇḍhirājaṃ viśālākṣaṃ ḍhuṇḍhibhairavamīśvaram jainendraṃ ca mahāmāyaṃ bhūpure dikpatīnapi śāntyādiguṇasampanno dhavanānmuktibhāgbhavet govindāya namaśceti ṣaḍarṇo manurīritaḥ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ mantravarṇaiḥ syātsarveṇa vyāpakaṃ caret

garuḍopari saṃsthaṃ ca sanakādyairupāsitam lokarakṣākaraṃ divyaṃ divyamālyānulepanam devamāvāhya mantrāṅgaiḥ prathamāvṛtirīritā sanakaḥ syāttatopyagre sanandanasanātanau śaunakoṣṭama eva syāccaturthī lokapālakaiḥ lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ huned ghṛtaiḥ evaṃ kṛtaprayogasya roganāśo bhaviṣyati vastrārthī puṣpahomena ārogyārthī tilairhunet aṣṭottarasahasrāṇi jvaranāśo bhaveddhruvam dhyāyellabhedramāṃ [ramayatīti ramā tām sundarīmiti yāvat ||] kanyāṃ kulīnāṃ ca kuṭumbinīm viṣṇave nama ityeṣa mantraḥ paṃcākṣaro mataḥ p. 684)pañcavarṇaiḥ samastena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ pītāmbaraṃ ghanaśyāmaṃ dhyāyettaṃ bhūṣaṇānvitam baliṃ vibhīṣaṇaṃ bhīṣmaṃ prahlādaṃ nāradārjunau bhūpure dikpatīniṣṭvā tadastrāṇi tato bahiḥ tarppaṇairmārjanairviprabhojanairāśu siddhyati na kadāciddaridraḥ syāddūrvābhiḥ syādarogatā campakaiḥ striyamāpnoti mālatyāpi sukhī bhavet pārijātaistu saundaryyaṃ nātaḥ parataro manuḥ tāro namo bhagavate ṅentaśca madhusūdanaḥ chandonuṣṭubdevatā tu bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ śeṣatalpaprasuptaṃ tu lakṣmīsaṃvāhitāṃghrikam pītāmbaraṃ ghanaśyāmaṃ madhukaiṭabhamārakam yoganidrāṃ mahāmāyāṃ kālarātriṃ ca kālikām evaṃ sampūjya deveśaṃ japellakṣacatuṣṭayam

tarppaṇaṃ mārjanaṃ kuryāmantrasiddhiḥ prajāyate palāśakusumairhutvā śatrūṇāṃ stambhayedbalam mālatyā cātulā lakṣmīranyatpūrvavadevatu tāraṃ namo bhagavate vyāhṛtitritayaṃ vadet vyāpakāya padaṃ paścānṅentaṃ cāpi trivikramam padapañcakasarveṇa ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ p. 685)devatā viśvarūposya trivikrama udāhṛtaḥ dakṣiṇaṃ punarutthāpya svargavyāptakaraṃ harim gaṅgaughadhautapādābjaṃ dhyāyedbrahmādikaiḥ stutam lakṣmīṃ bhuvaṃ bhūpure tu digīśānāyudhāni ca trimadhvaktairhunetpaścāttarppaṇādyaṃ ca kārayet evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī labhate vāñchitaṃ phalam tāro namo bhagavate balisarvasvahāriṇe māyāṃ ramāṃ samuccāryya mantro dvātriṃśadarṇakaḥ saptāṣṭārkatribhūcandraiḥ ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ pūrṇakāmāvubhau dhyāyediti prītisamanvitau lakṣaṃ hunedbilvaphalairmadhuratrayasaṃyutaiḥ taddaśāṃśaṃ ca mantrasya siddhiḥ syātpāpanāśikā bhāvayedvāñchitaṃ svārthaṃ sa dadyānnātra saṃśayaḥ prātastadā svayaṃ mantraṃ sādhakāya prayacchati ramāṃ śaktiṃ kāmabījaṃ śrīdharāya tato vadet ṛṣirbrahmā bhavecchando gāyatraṃ śrīdharassuraḥ dugdhābdhau ca site dvīpe sarvarttuphalitadrume śaṅkhacakragadāpadmapāṇiṃ cāmīkaradyutim p. 686)hṛdi lakṣmīdharaṃ dhyāyecchrīdharaṃ puruṣārthadam

ṣaḍaṅgāni yajettatra devāṅgeṣu tato yajet vāme ca kaustubhāyeti grīvāyāṃ pūjayettataḥ bhāle ca karṇikāyāṃ ca pakṣirājāya vai namaḥ puruṣottamakaṃ lakṣmīnivāsaṃ tadanantaram sarvastrīhṛdayonmādaṃ madonmādaka mevaca tadutsaṅgagatāṃ devīṃ pūjayecchrīṃ śriyai namaḥ lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ ghṛtairhunet tataḥ siddhamanurmantrī kāmyakarma samācaret bhajate śrīdharaṃ yastu sa ca lokadvaye sukhī kāmabījaṃ hṛṣīkeśo ṅehṛdanto gajākṣaraḥ ṣaḍdīrghayuktakāmena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritiḥ garuḍopari saṃviṣṭaṃ śubhravarṇaṃ subhūṣaṇam ājyāktaiḥ kamalaiḥ pūrṇaistarppaṇādi tataścaret vijayāyāḥ prasūnaiśca tarppaṇaṃ sarvakāmadam yajjapādeva sidhyanti sādhakābhīṣṭakoṭayaḥ rakṣāṃsi bhītāni diśo dravanti sarve namasyanti ca siddhasaṃghāḥ hṛṣīkeśokhilaṃ sarvaṃ jñeyaṃ vai pūrvamantravat pralayābdhau śeṣatalpe lakṣmīsaṃvāhitāṃghrikam padmaṃ kaumodakīṃ hastairdadhataṃ dīptatejasam dhyātvārcayecchrīdharoktapīṭhe tadvajjapādikam prayogāṃśca vijānīyātpadmanābhārcanaṃ tviti navākṣaro mahāmantro bhogabhājāṃ susiddhidaḥ rādhādāmodaraḥ sākṣādbhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ vāmotsaṅgagatāṃ rādhāṃ cāliṅgantaṃ mudānvitam ṣaḍaṅgaṃ kāmabījena yajeddevaṃ saśaktikam

brahmādikānpadmamadhye patrāgre tu hriyaṃ ratim digīśāṃścāpi vajrādīnevaṃ pūjā samīritā tarppaṇaṃ mārjanaṃ kṛtvā dampatyorbhojanaṃ caret puraścaraṇavatkuryājjapādyaṃ kāryyasiddhaye athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi saṃkarṣaṇamanuṃ param tataścāpratirūpāya parāya ca vadetpadam traimunistu muniśchando mitaṃ saṃkarṣaṇaḥ suraḥ aṃkuśaṃ dakṣiṇe haste vāmenābhayameva ca nāradādiyutaṃ dhyāyedvāṇīlakṣmyau ca pārśvayoḥ yajecca vaiṣṇave pīṭhe navalakṣaṃ japenmanum hunettilaistrimadhurāplutaiḥ syāttarppaṇādikam samastaroganāśastu lakṣmīḥ padmākṣahomataḥ dīrghāyuṣyaṃ goghṛtena mahiṣeṇāpi manmathaḥ vanghyāpi labhate putraṃ homasaṃkhyāyutādikam tāro namo bhagavate vāsudevāyasaṃsmṛtaḥ munirdevo vāsudevaḥ pañcāṅgavidhirīritaḥ pādayostu manorvarṇānnyasedbindūnnamontakān triśastāratripuṭitamūlena vyāpakaṃ caret kayolakarṇadṛkkaṇṭhadorhṛjjaṭharanābhiṣu hṛdādikoyaṃ śīrṣāntaḥ sthitinyāsa udāhṛtaḥ eṣa kramo yatīnāṃ tu vyastato brahmacāriṇām sthitau ca śāntivinyāsaḥ sa syātkāryastridhā budhaiḥ buddhitattvātmanecyutāya namo netrayornyaset karṇe hratpadmatattvāya vadetsaṃkarṣaṇāya ca tato nyasedvāmabāhau tatṣoḍaśakalātmane

agnimaṇḍalatattvāya ṅento nārāyaṇo mataḥ saṃkarṣaṇākhyatattvāya liṅge syādviṣṇave namaḥ dakṣapāde ca vāmeniruddhatattvātmane nyaset mūrttipañjaranāmānaṃ keśavādikamācaret dugdhāmbhodhau sitadvīpe divyayoṣāvirājite tatra kalpadrumādhastādratnamaṃce tu paṅkajam candrakāntiṃ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmalasatkaram sakaustubhaṃ pītavastraṃ dhṛtagraiveyakaṃ kaṇam yajennārāyaṇe pīṭhe mūrttiṃ mūlena kalpayet tatsahasraṃ ca kamalairjuhuyānmadhuraplutaiḥ kṣīravṛkṣasamidbhiśca homaḥ syātpāpamuktaye nārāyaṇoktānnikhilānprayogānācarettataḥ tāraṃ māyādvayaṃ lakṣmīdvayaṃ lakṣmīpadaṃ vadet ṛṣiḥ prajāpatiśchando gāyatrī bījakaṃ dhruvaḥ dvidvidvīṣudvibhirvarṇestārādyairaṅgakalpanam lakṣmyāliṅganataścaikībhūtaṃ cāṅkagatāṃ [paśyantamiti śeṣaḥ ||] hi tām dadhatīṃ śaṃkhacakrābjagadāhastaṃ gadādharam daśāṃśaṃ paṅkajairhomo madhuratrayasaṃyutaiḥ madhurāktaistilairhutvā sarvakāryāṇi sādhayet klīṃ pradyumnāya hṛdayaṃ manuḥ saptākṣaro mataḥ niyogaḥ samare jetuṃ kāmayuddhe tathā striyāḥ āliṅgitaṃ prabhāvatyā nānārūpaṃ subhūṣitam gandharvairabhito gītaṃ prasannamukhapaṃkajam śaratkāle vasante vā dinānāmekaviṃśatim evaṃ sidhyati mantroyaṃ sarvābhīṣṭapradāyakaḥ

yakṣiṇyo vaśagāścaiva vaśyaḥ syād yoginīgaṇaḥ viprāḥ palāśakusumaiḥ sevantībhirnṛpāstathā turuṣkā yānti dāsatvaṃ jayantyāḥ kusumairhunet uṣāhṛdayaruddhāya kāmarūpāya te namaḥ smareduṣāgṛhe taṃ ca citralekhādisaṃyute āliṅgitapriyoṣaṃ ca strīkautukaramānvitam kāmapīṭhe yajed devaṃ varṇalakṣaṃ japenmanum juhuyānmantrarājasya siddhitosya jagadvaśam dāsībhūtāḥ sādhakasya japedṛtumatīṃ yabhet pratyakṣībhūya kāryāṇi kurvate dāsavacciram māyāramātārakāmabījaṃ hṛtpuruṣottama jagatkṣobhaṇa sarva strīhṛdayeti vidāraṇa [idamuttarānvayi] manujasundarītyuktvā manonmathamanāṃsi ca dvirmāraya stambhaya dvirdvirnāśayapadaṃ vadet [idamuttarānvayi] paramoktvā ca surabhe saubhāgyakara sarva ca cakreṇa gadayā ceti khaḍgeneti samuccaret bandhabandhetyaṃkuśena dvistrāsaya kurudvayam me siddhaṃ bhavati klīṃ huṃ phaṭ namo hrīṃ ramāṃ vadet bhedānasya pravakṣyāmi kāmanāvarṇabhedataḥ jñānadīkṣī ca sannyāsī yastu kevalavaiṣṇavaḥ stambhayadvitayaṃ brūyāttathā sammohayadvayam pūrvaṃ samastaśabdaṃ ca yojayeddvidhareti ca sthāne lakṣmyā iti procya bhedāścatvāra eva hi trailokhyamohano nāma devatā puruṣottamaḥ ṣaḍaṅgeṣu padānyatra vadecca puruṣottama

sakalajagatkṣobhaṇeti lakṣmīdayita śīrṣake kavacaṃ syātparamasubhagasarvapadaṃ vadet atraiva kavacānte tu nyasedastraṃ surāsura sarvapraharaṇetyuktvā dhara sarvamanāṃsi vā mahānanteti cāsyānte netre maṃ phaṭ ca kīrtyate hanayugmaṃ dārayadvirme vidyāṃ vaśamānaya kaniṣṭhayornetramanumastraṃ tu karapṛṣṭhayoḥ nyasetkarāṃguliṣu ca kāmabījāni śaktikāḥ vaśīkarāṃ klīṃ kandarppaṃ klīṃ bījaṃmakaradhvajam kāmabījaprapuṭitaṃ mātṛkānyāsamācaret vinyasenmātṛkānyāsaṃ pūrvoktaṃ ca tataścaret saṃhārākhyaṃ ca sṛṣṭyākhyaṃ sthāneṣveteṣu ca kramāt jānunorgulphayoḥ sarvāṅguliṣviti tataḥ kramāt saṃhārasṛṣṭisthityākhyāṃstathā nārāyaṇoditam siddhyanti sarvakāryyāṇi japādviṣṇuprasādataḥ tanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayāt maṇibandhāṃgulīmūle cāṃgulyagre pravinyaset aṃgulyagre tathā vāme bhujamūlādike nyaset nyāsānkuryyāttathā kāmabāṇanyāsamataḥ param svāṃ lakṣmyai ca namaḥ ke svīṃ sarasvatyai namo mukhe kakudi svaiṃ namaḥ kīrttyai svauṃ kāntyai ca namo hṛdi tataśca mūlamantreṇa prāgvadvyāpakamācaret kāmabījairnyasetpaścācchrīvatsaṃ kaustubhaṃ tathā ūrdhvāṃguṣṭhau tvathāśliṣṭau mūrttimūrddhani yojayet evaṃ nyasya śarīrādau dhyāyecchrīpuruṣottamam

sarvāṅgasundaraṃ saumyaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam cakraṃ śaṃkhaṃ dhanuḥ khaḍgaṃgadāṃ musalamaṃkuśam sarvabhūṣāḍhyayā padmakarayāliṅgitaṃ smaret p. 693)pakṣirājāyasvāheti tasya pūjāmanurmataḥ tadvāmorau pūjanīyā mantriṇā śrīḥ śriye namaḥ kramādabhyarccayedaṅgaṣaṭkaṃ syātprathamāvṛtiḥ tṛtīyāvaraṇe lakṣmīvāgratiprītikīrttayaḥ indrādyāṃścāpi vajrādīnpañcame ceti pūjanam ādau klīmatra trailokyamohanāya tato vadet namontaiḥ pañca puṣpāṇāmañjalīṃśca samarppayet paṃca nāmānīti cātra puruṣottapūjane bilvairvā kamalaiḥ paścāttarppaṇādyairbhavenmanuḥ [idamuttarānvayi ||] samastādhau prajuhuyādaṣṭottarasahasrakam aṣṭādhikaśataṃ japtvā sarvalokapriyo bhavet rājāno vaśagāḥ sarve māsamātrānna saṃśayaḥ palāśapuṣpahomena prāgvadviprāśca vaśyakāḥ dinādau sā vaśībhūyāddāsyasmītyādivādinī aśvatthotthasamidbhistu hunetpakṣatrayaṃ yamī cauro yāti dhanaṃ dattvā praṇamya svagṛhaṃ prati nikhātaṃ śatrusadane śatrumuccāṭayeddhruvam krūra vāre ca lagnepi śatrumuccāṭayeddhruvam śuklaṃ raktaṃ keśayuktaṃ ripumuccāṭayeddhruvam ripurnidhanamāyāti sāṣṭādhikasahasrataḥ yadvā jyotiṣmatītailaṃ hunedaṣṭasahasrakam mantrī vivikte bhūdeśe japahomārcane rataḥ

tataḥ pūrvācca madhyāhne pāvakāccandrasannibhā anenaivātha śirasi sa bhavetkhecaraḥ sadā ājyāktābhiśca dūrvābhirhomo bhayavināśakaḥ śamayedāpadastasya nātra kāryyā vicāraṇā ayaṃ manuvaro gopyo na deyaḥ pāpine kvacit tāraṃ māraṃ ramāṃ ṅentaṃ vadecca puruṣottamam brahmā muniśca gāyatrī chandosau puruṣottamaḥ bhūbhūbhūṣaḍdvidvivarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ śaṅkhacakrotpalagadādhāriṇaṃ puruṣottamam vāsudevādīni dikṣu śaktīrvai koṇagā yajet digīśāṃśca tadastrāṇi prāgvatṣaḍvarṇapūjanam tarppaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā mantrasiddhiḥ prajāyate ramā tāraṃ hriyaṃ kāmaṃ hṛd ṅentassyādadhokṣajaḥ sādhakānāṃ kāmadāyī devatā syādadhokṣajaḥ śaṅkhacakragadāpadmapāṇiṃ pītāmbarāvṛtam vāsukipramukhairnāgaiḥ sevitaṃ ramayā yutam sanakādīnnāradaṃ ca jayaṃ ca vijayaṃ tathā nāgāṣṭakaṃ digīśāṃśca bhūpure hetisaṃyutān tarppaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā sahasraṃ bhojayeddvijān viṣārttāya ca sarppādidaṣṭakāya pradāpayet kuṣṭhādikagadairyukto mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ nityapramuditetyuktvā cetase pravadettataḥ chandotijagatī devo nṛhariḥ śaktiradrijā ramābījaṃ ṣaḍaṅgāni śrībījena prakalpayet hastairdadhānaṃ sarppasya phaṇācitravirājitam

varṣāhatulyasāhasraṃ japo'sya parikīrttitaḥ tarppaṇādi tataḥ kuryyādaṅgaiḥ syātprathamāvṛtiḥ kāntī ruciścāṣṭapatre bhūpure divyahetayaḥ mallikākusumairhomaścāyutaṃ tviṣṭadāyakaḥ anyānapi prayogāṃśca kuryyādaṣṭārṇakoditān tāro [namo bhagavate narasiṃhāya namastejastejase āvirāvirbhava vajranakha vajradaṃṣṭhra karmāśayān rodhayarodhaya tamo grasagrasa svāhā abhayamātmani bhūyiṣṭhāḥ oṃ kṣraum ||] namo bhagavate narasiṃhāya hṛdvade vajranakha vajradaṃṣṭra tataḥ karmmāśayānvadet svāhāṃ tathābhayaṃ cātmani bhūyiṣṭhā dhruvaṃ vadet śukadevo muniḥ prokto'mitaṃ chandaśca devatā daśāvatāra nṛharestulyaṃ lakṣamito japaḥ brahmā ṛṣiranuṣṭup cacchando devo janārddanaḥ varābhaye cakragade dadhataṃ pītavāsasam asya pūjāprayogādi japahomādikaṃ bhavet tathā saṃsevite muktirājanmabrahmacāribhiḥ upendramantraṃ praṇavamumupendrāya hṛnnamaḥ paṃktiśchanda upendrastu devo bījaṃ tathā smṛtam dhyānapujāprayogādyaṃ balivāmanavadbhavet haraye nama ityeṣa mantraḥ pañcākṣaromataḥ śrībījādyastu dāridrye sarvanāśāya pakṣirāṭ aiṃsamanvitamantroyaṃ drutaṃ vidyāpradāyakaḥ japankāmādikaṃ tatra mohayeddhanināṃ gaṇān hūṅkārapūrvakaṃ japtvā samare vijayī bhavet kāmapūrvaṃ ca japato vaṃśaḥ kaśyapavadbhavet harirdevastvādyapadaṃ bījaśaktī manormate meghaśyāmaṃ sunayanaṃ kākapakṣavirājitam

p. 697)vicitraparidhiṃ vaṃśīṃ dadhataṃ vāmadakṣayoḥ homaḥ pañcāmṛtenātha prayogosya nigadyate ekāyutādipañcāntaṃ puraścaraṇavajjapet kāmo govallabho ṅento mohitākhilayoṣitam kākapakṣadharaṃ nānākelikautukakārakam vāsudevaṃ rukmiṇīṃ ca tathā saṃkarṣaṇābhidham jāmbavatīṃ ca tadbāhye bhūpure dikpatīnatha brahmavṛkṣasamidbhiśca hunedaṣṭasahasrakam vidadhīta prayogāṃśca pūrvānkṛṣṇamanūditān uktāḥ kecicca tantreṣu vaktavyaṃ kimataḥ param iti śrīmahāmāyāmahākālānumate merutantre śivapraṇīte caturviṃśatimūrtimanukathanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśaḥ prakāśaḥ tanmantrāñchrotumicchāmi bhuktimuktipradāyakān mama viṣṇoḥ priyatamaṃ mantraṃ hariharātmakam nārāyaṇāya ca namo hoṃhrīṃ oṃ ṣoḍaśākṣaraḥ ṣaḍdīrghayuṅgmāyayā ca ṣaḍaṅgāni prakalpayet svasvarūpārdhanīlārdhadehaṃ hariharaṃ bhaje lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ bhūmiṃ dharākhyāmambikāṃ tathā p. 698)lokeśānapi cendrādīnvarṇalakṣaṃ japenmanum evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī hṛdi kṛtvā tu vāñchitam labhate vāñchitānarthānsadyaḥ prītikaro manuḥ sahāvukārasaṃyuktau bindūnā pariśobhitau hasāvaukārasaṃyuktau sabindū kṣatriyasya ca triṣṭupchando munirbrahmā hayagrīvosya devatā kamalaṃ japamālāṃ cābhayaṃ kameva ca bhaktapriyaṃ hayagrīvaṃ vandehaṃ dānavāntakam

mantrādhikārī bhavati devamāvāhayettayā tanno haṃsaḥ pracodayāt prajñā medhā smṛtirvidyā śrīrvāgīśā hayānanaḥ lakṣmyādibhistṛtīyā syāttāśca lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī tryāvṛttiḥ kumudādyaiḥ syātproktāste dadhivāmane vedalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādghṛtaiḥ siddho mantraḥ prayogārho jāyate bhuktimuktidaḥ karaṃ dhyātvā nyasedvaktre sabhāpūjyaḥ sajāyate prātarharati lūtādidaurbhāgyaṃ pañcadhā viṣam saptāhājjāyate tasya divyā vāṇī manoramā pītaṃ cāpi mukhaṃ dhyātvā stambhayetparabhāratīm saṃlikheddarbhamūlena bharjapatre haridrayā p. 699)veṣṭitaṃ pītasūtreṇa mūkatvaṃ kurutecirāt jvālāmālākulaṃ dhyāyetstambhanaṃ paramaṃ matam saṃhārakamidaṃ dhyānaṃ viṣādīnāṃ na saṃśayaḥ āpyāyate kare hyetatsarvarogavināśanam dhyāyeddhṛtpadmamadhyasthaṃ nirviṣīkaraṇamparam mahārakṣā bhavedeṣā sarvadoṣavināśakṛt hakāradvayamadhyasthaṃ japtaṃ māsantu vairakṛt udgiratpraṇavodgītha sarvavāgīśvareśvara svabījapraṇavābhyāṃ ca ślokamenaṃ puṭedatha chandonuṣṭummunirbrahmā hayagrīvastu devatā śaṅkhāripāṇimaśvāsyaṃ jānunyastakaraṃ bhajet yajedaṣṭadale padme devāgrādipradakṣiṇam vedāṅgāni smṛtiṃ nyāyaṃ sarvaśāstrāṇi cārccayet

bhūpure lokapālāṃśca tadastrāṇi tato yajet homayettarppaṇādyantaṃ kṛtvā siddho bhavenmanuḥ śrīkāmo juhuyānnityaṃ kundaistrimadhuraplutaiḥ sevitaṃ vidhinā prātaratibuddhikaraṃ tvidam bhakṣayetsarvaśāstrāṇāṃ vyākhyātā bhavati dhruvam ṛgyajussāmarūpāya vedābharaṇakarmmaṇe p. 700)atha mantrāntaraṃ vakṣye tīkṣṇabuddhikaraṃ param bilvottīrṇasvātmarūpacinmayānandarūpiṇe svāhā sohaṃ ca haṃsādiraṣṭatriṃśākṣaro manuḥ puraścaryyā tu ṣaṭtriṃśallakṣamanyacca pūrvavat svabījaṃ hayaśirase namaścāṣṭākṣaro manuḥ hastairdadhānaṃ mālāṃ ca pustakaṃ varapaṅkajam evaṃ dhyātvākhilaṃ karyyādekakarṇoktavartmanā bhavākṣaro manuḥ prokto bhavarogaikabheṣajam ṣaḍaṅgavidhiruktosya dviruktairmanu nāmabhiḥ sarvāyudhairupetaṃ ca garuḍo parisaṃsthitam śrībhūmi sahitaṃ devamudyadādityasannibham sarvalokasya rakṣārthamanantaṃ nityameva hi govindamanuvaloktampañcāvaraṇasaṃyutam tarppaṇādi tataḥ kuryādroganāśaḥ [tasyeti śeṣaḥ ||] prajāyate vastrārthī puṣpahomaṃ ca nairujyārthī tilairhunet aṣṭottarasahasrantu jvaranāśo bhaviṣyati dhyāyellabhecchubhāṃ kanyāṃ kulīnāṃ ca kuṭumbinīm anantāya namaśceti ṣaḍvarṇoyamudāhṛtaḥ niyogo roganāśārthamanyadgovindavadbhavet

vedavyāsasya vidyādipradaṃ padamihoccaret munirbrahmā tathānuṣṭupchandaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ ṣaḍdīrghādyena bījena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ yogapaṭṭāsanārūḍhaṃ praphullakusumadyatim nānāśiṣyaiḥ parivṛtaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanambhaje pūrvokte tu yajetpīṭhe pūrvamaṅgāni pūjayet sumantuṃ koṇabhāgeṣu śrīśukaṃ lomaharṣaṇam indrādīṃśca tadastrāṇi pūjā caivaṃ samīritā trikāleṣṭottaraśataṃ kavitvaṃ śobhanāḥ prajāḥ vyākhyānaśaktiṃ kīrtiṃ ca labhate sampadonvayam tāraṃ namaḥ samābhāṣya mantrametantato vadet kahoḍosya munirdevī gāyatrī chanda īritam hakārastu ṣaḍaṅgārthaṃ dhyānapūjādi pūrvavat kaṣṭhādikamahāroganāśārthaṃ lakṣamekakam svalpamṛtyuvināśaśca pūrṇamāyuḥ prajāyate tatra vrātyā dvijā ye ca saputrā ye ca va?(vai)ṣṇavāḥ pakṣirājasya sarveṣāṃ nṛṇāmiṣṭasusiddhaye tanno garuḍaḥ pracodayāt dhyānapūjādirahitā japamātraphalapradā tāro namo bhagavate mahāgaruḍaṅentakam pūjitāya vajranakhavajratuṇḍapadaṃ vadet ehyehi mahāgaruḍa duṣṭanāgānpadaṃ vadet dvirbhindhyāveśayayugaṃ baddho huṃphaḍ vasupriyā gāyatrī chanda uddiṣṭaṃ devatā garuḍo mataḥ mantroktaviṣanāśārthaṃ viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥ

kapilākṣastathā nāgagaralāntakaro mataḥ etaiḥ ṣaṇnāmabhirnyāsaścāṅgulyādirhṛdādikaḥ dīrghabāhuṃ vṛṣaskandhaṃ nāgābharaṇabhūṣitam takṣakaḥ kaṭisūtraṃ ca hāraḥ karkoṭa ucyate śaṅkhapālaḥ śirodeśe kulikastu bhujāntare ākaṇṭhādraktavarṇaṃ ca viṣṇadhvajagataṃ bhaje mantrārṇasaṅkhyāśatato japaḥ saptaguṇo mataḥ nāśamāyānti rogāśca visarppādyā na saṃśayaḥ pañcākṣaro manuḥ paṃktiśchandonanto mato muniḥ svāhānto hṛdaye nyasya jvalajvala mahāmate garuḍānte śikhe svāhā śikhāyā manurīritaḥ dviḥ prabhedaya vitrāsayadvayaṃ dvirvimardaya ugrarūpadharetyuktvā sarvaviṣahareti ca bhasmīkurukuru svāhādantavarṇo manurmataḥ trāsanānte vadeddhuṃphaṭ svāhāntoṣṭādaśākṣaraḥ p. 703) taptasvarṇanibhaṃ nāgaprajñaptāṅgavibhūṣaṇam pakṣoccāritasatsāma gānaṃ viṣaharaṃ bhaje pūjayenmātṛkā padme garuḍaṃ vedavigraham ananto vāsukistakṣakākhyaḥ karkoṭapadmakau tadāyudhāni bhūgehe pañcalakṣaṃ japenmanum darśanāddūragastasya sarppo naśyedviṣadvayam [cetyadhyāhāryyam ||] iha loke sukhī dīrghajīvī bhūpatipūjitaḥ gaditā manavo devi kimanyacchrotumicchasi iti śrīmahāmāyāmahākālānumate merutantre śivapraṇīte viṣṇupriyamantrakathanaṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśaḥ prakāśaḥ mantrāstānvidhi pūrvānme brūhi yatsādhanājjayaḥ

sudarśanaṃ nāma yacca mayā prāgviṣṇaverppitam yatsaparyāstu laṅkeśaḥ sahasrābdaṃ cacāra ha tāraḥ sahasrāra huṃphaṭ tasya mantro navākṣaraḥ cakrāyāntairāviśuddhisujvālāvakulaiḥ pṛthak aindraṃ cakreṇa badhnāti namaścakrāgnigehinī diśāsu tarjanyaṃguṣṭhayogenātra sthaleṣu ca phaṭsvāheti dvādaśārṇo vahniprākārasaṃjñitaḥ prākāraṃ parikalpyātha nyāsānanyānsamācaret īṃmadhyānanahṛdguhyajānugulphataleṣu ca dakṣādyūrdhvakramādaṣṭabhujairāyudhadhāriṇam pāśamaṃkuśamādīptaṃ bhīmadaṃṣṭraṃ raviprabham karṇikāyāṃ ṣaḍaṅgāni cakrādyastrāṇikeśare bhūpure lokapālāṃśca tadastrāṇi tadagrataḥ tristhāne cakagāyatryācakamudrāṃ ca tāṃ śṛṇu tannaścakraṃ pracodayāt tilaistrimadhuropetaiḥ sarṣapairmadhurānvitaiḥ tataśca kevalājyena tarppaṇādi tataścaret khātādiśodhitaṃ sthānaṃ gomayenopalepayet vṛttaveṣṭitaṣaṭkoṇaṃ tadbāhye bhūpurāvṛtam tadantarālaṃ śyāmena śeṣaṃ śvetena pūrayet ādāvuttaracakre ca dakṣiṇe ca tato nyaset dīkṣāvidhiprakāreṇa pīṭhapūjāṃ samācaret sampūjya sāṃgāvaraṇamanyacakre tatastathā pratidravyaṃ bhaveddhomaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikaṃ śatam haviṣpṛthakpaṃcagavyaṃ hunedājyaṃ tu tatkramāt
