kumbhopari nidhāyātha sādhyaṃ samupaveśayet p. 705)bhrāmayitvā tataścodaṅmārjjanaṃ kalaśaṃ kṣipet hutaśiṣṭānnena dadyādbaliṃ ca manunāmunā bhyo baliṃ pratigṛhṇantu śāntyai hṛttattvavarṇakaḥ jvarādirogasaṃghātānpraogoyaṃ vināśayet rakṣobhūtādipīḍāṃ ca nāśayetsa tvayaṃ vidhiḥ kṛtvā mantrī paṃcagavyaiḥ pūjayetsādhyamatra ca vipravaryyaiḥ kārayecca homaṃ pūrvoditaṃ kramāt eṣa yogaḥ sarvarogāpamṛtyudrohanāśakaḥ tribhiḥ sampūritairjaptaiḥ kumbhaiḥ sampātasaṃyutaiḥ abhiṣiñcedbhānudine cāmayādyāturaṃ tathā ghṛtaṃ [bhakṣayediti śeṣaḥ ||] pakvaṃ pañcagavyairjapite manunāmunā mantraṃ japeddaśaśataṃ pañcagavyaṃ spṛśetsudhīḥ rakṣā bhavati tadgehe sampadvṛddhiḥ prajāyate ghusṛṇaṃ ca haridrāṃ ca rocanaṃ bilvarājike kṛṣṇāṃ ca tulasīṃ proktāṃ javamarkadrumaṃ tathā kamalaṃ rocanāṃ pañcagavye saṃkvāthayenmuhuḥ japitaṃ manunānena samyakca śirasā dhṛtam āpannāśakametatsyādvaśyadaṃ śivadaṃ param prasthaṃ ca kalkadravyāṇi mustā śuṇṭhī niśā tathā māṃsyāhvā ca viḍaṅgaṃ ca mañjiṣṭhā kaṭurohiṇī bhūtapretapiśācādibhayaghnaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ guṭikāṃ gugguloḥ kṛtvā hunedaṣṭasahasrakam bhavetsarvopadravāṇāṃ nāśo mantragadasya ca bhūtajvarabhayavyādhikṛtyāpasmāranāśanam

ājyāktābhiśca dūrvābhirhomāddīrghāyurāpnuyāt vastrārthī śvetakumudairājyāktairjuhuyānnaraḥ audumbarasamiddhomātputralābho bhaved dhruvam samidvarairmahārogamuktayeyaṃ vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ekopi durjayo yuddhe bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ bhavet triṃśaddinaiścātha prāpnoti maraṇaṃ dhruvam saṃsmaredyasya śīrṣe tu tasyoccāṭo daśāhataḥ mūrdhni smarecca saptāhāduccāṭo vā mṛtirbhavet sakāraṃ saṃsmarenmūrdhni sa jīveccharadāṃ śatam karṇikāyāṃ tathā ṭhaṃ ca śeṣamantrārṇakaṃ tathā āpannivāraṇaṃ yantraṃ bhūtapretabhayāpaham tāro [oṃ namo bhagavate mahāsudarśanāya huṃ phaṭ ||] namo bhagavate mahāsudarśanaṃ vadet tathā nyāsaśca pūjāyāṃ sarva rakṣākaro manoḥ caturviṃśacchatānīti tilāṃścāpi sasarṣapān anurūpajapadhyānānmantroyaṃ vāñchitapradaḥ ekaikaṃ sulikhedvarṇaṃ bahirbhūpuraveṣṭanam unmādagrahabhūtādīnabhicārāṃśca nāśayet tāro namo [namo bhagavate mahāsudarśanāya mahācakrāya mahājvālāya dīptarūpāya sarvanātha rakṣarakṣa māmahābalāya svāhā huṃ phaṭ ||] bhagavate mahāpūrvapadatrayam dīptarūpaṃ sarvanātha rakṣayugmaṃ ca māṃ mahā dhyānapūjādikaṃ prāgvajjapo varṇasahasrakam oṃklīṃ sudarśanamahācakrarāja [oṃ klīṃ sudarśana mahācakrarāja dahadaha sarvaduṣṭabhayaṃ kurukuru chindhichindhi bhindibhindi vidārayavidāraya paramantrān grasagrasa bhakṣayabhakṣaya bhūtāni trāsayatrāsaya huṃphaṭ svāhā cakrāya namaḥ || iti mantraḥ ||] dahadvayam vidārayadvayaṃ procya paramantrāngrasadvayam huṃphaṭ svāheti cakrāya namo vedanugākṣaraḥ dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ jñeyamasya ṣaḍarṇavat japtvādau cāṣṭasāhasraṃ raṇe gaccheddrutaṃ jayī

oṃklīṃ jalacarāyeti svāhāntoyaṃ navārṇakaḥ pūjānte prajapenmantramaṣṭottarasahasrakam kuryādevaṃ māsaṣaṭkaṃ tataḥ siddho bhavenmanuḥ dhyātvābhivādayecchaṃkhaṃ raṇe vijayakārakam dvādaśārṇaḥ khaḍgamantro yo japeddvādaśākṣaram khaḍgasiddhistasya bhavenna kadācitparājayaḥ pūjayitvā tataḥ koṇe sthāpayetpraṇamedapi śārṅgāya [śārṅgāya saśarāya huṃ phaṭ ||] saśarāyeti huṃphaṭ japyo navāyutam ajeyo jāyate dhanvī śārṅgamantraṃ samuccaret kaumodaki mahāsarvabale sarvāsurāntike japellakṣamimaṃ mantraṃ pūjayennityaśo gadām sādhako vā gajārūḍho gadāhasto viśedraṇam bhayabhītāḥ palāyante caturaṅgabalā api huṃphaṭ svāhāntako mantra ūnaviṃśativarṇakaḥ ghṛtāktāścāyutaṃ mantrasiddhistasya prajāyate palāyantesya ripavo dakṣo rudrādyathā tathā kuryādarervā gadādeḥ stambhaḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ kaṃcudvayaṃ ca varmmāstraṃ svāhānto viśvavarṇakaḥ devaścātrāṃkuśo viṣṇurūpī gajavimardakaḥ p. 709)kevalāṃkuśapūjātra japo lakṣaṃ trayodaśa trāsayennātra sandeho bhavanti vacanādvaśe phaṭsvāhetyūnaviṃśārṇo varuṇo munirucyate netrairaṅgāni taṃ caiva dhyāyedvaruṇahastagam māraṇāya madhusite dveṣe tailaṃ tato guḍam munirmantraśca chandosya gāyatrī devatā haraḥ

āraktakalaśaṃ dhyāyenmastake sve ca pūjayet tarppaṇādyaṃ tataḥ kuryyācchatramantrasya siddhaye ekopi sa ripūñjitvā rājyaṃ tu labhate drutam cāmarasya grahāveśadṛṣṭyādikanivāraṇam protsārayāśu duritaṃ cāmara śrīṃ namostu te hutvā siddho bhavenmantro nityaṃ cāmaramarcayet saptāhamarjjitāḥ sāyaṃ prātaḥ syurdoṣavarjjitāḥ śakraketave ca mahāvīryyāya śyāma varṇakam garuḍāsana rakṣadvirāyudhāni ripūndaha dhvajamantraṃ japetpañcasahasraṃ siddhaye hunet dhvajaṃ tu pūjayennityaṃ śatrubhītinivāraṇam hiraṇyakaśiporyuddhe pūtane daivatāsure kālahaṃ trirdahadvandvaṃ ripūnsarvānpatākike p. 710) tatastrimadhurairhomādikaiḥ siddho bhavenmanuḥ sthitaprāṇāṃ ca tā dṛṣṭvā ripuryāti diśo daśa triśūlāya namaśceti mantraḥ saptākṣaro mataḥ homastu bilvapatraiḥ syātsiddho mantrastvayaṃ bhavet śūlākṛṣṭe caṇḍi [ṅyāporiti hrasvaḥ ||] vṛte sarvaduṣṭanibarhiṇi kṣurike rakṣa māṃ nityaṃ sarvāśubhavināśini japtvā varṇasahasraṃ ca siddhaḥ śatrunivāraṇaḥ śastriṇāmeva sarveṣāṃ yosti rakṣākaraḥ paraḥ mama dehaṃ sadā rakṣa kaṭāraka namostu te tatra sampūjayettacca nāgnicaurādijaṃ bhayam gṛhāṇa jīvanaṃ teṣāṃ mama sainyaṃ ca rakṣa mām digaṣṭake raṇe yātvā ripūṇāṃ kadanaṃ bhavet

varmmañcharmaprada tvaṃ māṃ rakṣarakṣa samantataḥ ājyaistāvaddhunetsiddhastatsampātena saṃskṛtam tatraiva svīyavarṣāṇāmaṃkayantraṃ kṣitipradam japamātreṇa saṃsiddhirhunecca ghṛtapāyasaiḥ p. 711)tanno daṇḍaḥ pracodayāt koṭyantaṃ prajapenmantrī sarvadaṇḍairvimucyate tithyakṣaroyaṃ paraśormantraḥ saṃgrāmasiddhidaḥ gopitā bahutantreṣu kimanyacchrotumicchasi iti śrīmahāmāyāmahākālānumate merutantre śivapraṇīte āyudhamantrakathanaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśaḥ prakāśaḥ nacāstīti purā proktamatra śaktīrvadādhunā yatibhiḥ kevalo devaḥ sevyo nānyaistathā tribhiḥ yatastu dharmmapatito vāmamārgī pumānmataḥ teṣāṃ bhuktiśca muktiśca tadante tvaṃ manuṃ śṛṇu vadayugmaṃ ca citreśe vāgbījaṃ dahanāṅganā citreśvarī devatā syācchando gāyatramucyate nīlotpaladalaśyāmāṃ madāghūrṇitalocanām krīḍantīṃ hariṇā sārdhaṃ sthagitāṃ ca vanevane nopāsyā jātu cidviprairvāmamārgaprabhāvataḥ sevyā kaulikamārgeṇa tadadhīnastadā hariḥ ekādaśākṣaro mantro muniḥ syādvāmakeśvaraḥ pañcāṅgaṃ syātpañcapadairaṃguṣṭhādiṣu vinyaset krīḍantī hariṇā sārdhaṃ mahāvaṭasamāśritā bhagapūjāṃ viśeṣeṇa kuryyādvīrāṃśca bhojayet lakṣamātraṃ japedyastu trikālajñaḥ sa jāyate ṣaṇmāsaṃ niyataṃ devīṃ vāgbuddhistasya jāyate

rājamānyo mahātejāḥ pūjyate sakalairjanaiḥ māyāśrīkāmabījāni kṛṣṇāyeti padaṃ vadet pañcamaṃ ca tato bījamebhiḥ saptamakūṭakam gopījanavallabhāya tataśca kamalatrayam trayoviṃśākṣaro mantro bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ chandastu devī gāyatrī devo gopālasundarī ṣaḍaṅgavidhiruddiṣṭo mantravarṇānnyasettanau mūrdhni bhāle bhruvorakṣṇoḥ karṇayornāsayormukhe nābhau liṅge gude sakthnorjānunorjaṅghayorapi hṛdayādyo bhujāntaśca nyāsoyaṃ sthitisañjñakaḥ evaṃ nyāsatrayaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ sṛṣṭisthitiṃ caret hrīṃ śrīṃpūrvaṃ aṃ ca āṃ ca svarau nyasyetkrameṇa tu māyāṃ ramāṃ tathā hrīṃ ca kāmabījaṃ hakārayuk māyāṃ lakṣmīṃ samuccāryya hasayuktāni coccaret namontaḥ śakravarṇoyaṃ vinyasejjānunostathā namaḥ procya nyaselliṅge rudravarṇoyamīritaḥ meghavaṇa vadenṅentaṃ sabinduṃ ṣaṇmitasvaram tadeva bījaṃ vaśinī devatāyai namastathā kavargaṃ bindusaṃyuktaṃ kāmaṃ kāmeśvarīṃ tathā binduturyyānsvaropetānṣaṣṭhaṃ bījamudāhṛtam bhrūmadhye vinyasenmantraṃ ṭavargaṃ bindusaṃyutam vimalāvāgdevatāyai namaśceti gale nyaset binduturyyasvaropetānbījaṃ proktaṃ tathāruṇā pavargabindusaṃyukta mādyamantyaṃ ca paṃcamam jayantīvāgdevatāyai namoyaṃ nṛpavarṇakaḥ

binduṣaṣṭhasvaropetaṃ kūṭakāntamudāhṛtam mūlādhāre nyasedenaṃ savargaṃ bindusaṃyutam nyasedūrvādipādāntaṃ nyāsaṃ vāgdevatābhidham kūṭatrayadvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgaṃ punarācaret kṣīrāmbhodhau sitadvīpe vane kalpadrumādibhiḥ maṇḍape tatra śrīpīṭhe sthitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vibhāvayet bhujairdadhānaṃ vāmaistu cāpaṃ pāśaṃ tathāṃkuśam pītāmbaradharaṃ gopīsamūhaiḥ parito vṛtam pūrvādikadale vāsudevaṃ śāntiṃ kramādyajet aniruddhaṃ ratiṃ patrāgreṣvarcyā aṣṭanāyikāḥ mitravindā lakṣmaṇā ca satyā nāgnajitī tathā mahāpadmaśca padmaśca śaṃkho makarakacchapau yoginyastu rahasyākhyāstadagreṣṭadalercayet jayinī caiva sarveśī kaulinītyaṣṭa śaktayaḥ sarvajñā sarvaśaktiśca sarvaiśvaryyaphalapradā sarvādhārasvarūpā ca sarvapāpaharāparā sarvepsitārthaphaladā paścimādivilomagāḥ sarvasiddhipradā tvādyā sarvasampatpradāparā sarvakāmapradā paścātsarvaduḥkhavimocinī sarvāṅgasundarī caiva sarvasaubhāgyadāyinī paścimādivilomena pūjayetkramatastu tāḥ sarvākarṣiṇikāṃ proktāṃ sarvāhlādakarāṃ tathā sarvajṛmbhaṇikāṃ proktāṃ tataḥ sarvavaśaṃkarīm sarvārthasādhinīṃ caiva sarvasampattirūpiṇīm tatoṣṭāre pu(?)rā proktā yoganīḥ paripūjayet

anaṅgakusumā tvādyā dvitīyānaṅgamekhalā anaṅgalekhā cānaṅgavegānaṅgāṃkuśā tathā tadagre ṣoḍaśāre tu paścimādivilomataḥ ahaṅkārākarṣiṇī ca śabdākarṣiṇikā tathā rasākarṣiṇikā proktā gandhākarṣiṇikā matā nāmākarṣiṇikā caiva bījākarṣiṇikā tathā śarīrākarṣiṇī paścādātmākarṣiṇikā tathā kṣobhaṇadrāvaṇākarṣamanonmādamahāṃkuśāḥ tadvaccādhaḥ samabhyarcya tadbahirbhūpure yajet dvāre dvayaṃ prāgaṇimā mahimā laghimeśitā rasasiddhiśca daśamī saparyyaivaṃ samīritā tarppaṇādi tataḥ kuryyānmantrasiddhaḥ prajāyate karavīrajapuṣpaiśca homānmohayate jagat campakaiḥ pāṭalairbilvairvaśamānayate cirāt bilvaiḥ syādatulā lakṣmīrikṣukhaṇḍaistathā vaśāḥ niśi [niśi cchāgapalairiti vā niśi śākaphalairiti pustakāśuddhyā pāṭho na jñāyate tadahyaṃ yathāmati sudhībhiḥ ||] svarṇaphalairhomo ripusenāvināśakṛt ārogyaṃ sampadaṃ kāmaṃ dhanaṃ śarkkarayā sukham kṣatriyo mātuluṅgaiśca vaiśyo nāriṅgajaiḥ phalaiḥ panasānāṃ lakṣahomādvaśyāḥ syuścakravartinaḥ nārikeraistu pāṇḍityaṃ tilaiḥ sarveṣṭasiddhayaḥ pāyasairdhanadhānyādi bandhūkaiḥ prāṇino vaśāḥ lavaṇai rājikāyuktairhomādduṣṭavināśanam ghṛtahe mādīpsitāptiḥ śaktiḥ syāttilataṇḍulaiḥ kṛṣṇasya śaktiṃ sumukhīṃ dvijānāṃ nādhikāritā [nacetiśeṣaḥ ||] cini hrīṃ ṭhaścaṭhaḥṭhaśca dvāviṃśatyakṣaro manuḥ

munirāmadviṣaṭcandrabandhvarṇairaṅgakalpanam raktāmbarāṃ raktavarṇāṃ raktapuṣpānulepanām śavāsanāṃ pīnakucāṃ devīṃ śrīsumukhīṃ bhaje aṣṭapatre ṣoḍaśāre vṛttabhūpuraśobhite candrāṃ candrānanāṃ cārumukhīṃ cāmīkaraprabhām brāhmyādyā aṣṭapatreṣu ṣoḍaśāre kalādikāḥ kulā kulīnā kalyāṇī kumārī kalabhāṣiṇī bhaktocchiṣṭo'yutaṃ japtvā jāyate sampadāṃ padam gavyājyāktaiḥ prajuhuyāllakṣaṃ siddhārthataṇḍulaiḥ śāstrāṇi vaśagāni syurhomaṃ mārjjāramāṃsataḥ madhupāyasasaṃyuktastrīrajoyuktavāsasā madhusarpiryutairnāgavallīpatrairmahāśriyaḥ yuktenāntyajakoṇādyairhutairākarṣati striyaḥ ummattatarujairdīptacitāgnau juhuyācchadaiḥ garbhapātaḥ sagarbhāyā ulūkacchadahomataḥ saubhāgyārthaṃ durbhagāyā bandhūkakusumairhunet ucchiṣṭasya ca sā devī pratyakṣā jāyatecirāt vāmamārgeṇa sumukhī kṣipraṃ kāmavidhāyinī na kṣipraphaladā devī sumukhī sudṛḍhāparā kṛṣṇapriyāmekajaṭāṃ hrīṃtrīṃhuṃphaṭ ca hṛnmanuḥ tadvatprayogakaraṇaṃ kṛṣṇaśaktiriyamparā puṣpaṃ pratīkṣasva svāhā dvāviṃśatyakṣaro manuḥ dhyānapūjāprayogādi sarvaṃ pūrvoktavadbhavet kṛtvā svaṃ śābaraṃ rūpaṃ vāmamārgeṇa sevitā jarāsandhabhayātkṛṣṇo yadā sindhuṃ samāśritaḥ

tāmāvāhya sa kṛṣṇopi bhogena paryyatoṣayat sambhoge tu japenmantrī yathā santoṣayetstriyam praṇavaḥ kamalā māyā kraumaiṃ pañcākṣaro manuḥ pañcavarṇaiḥ samastena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ ratnamaṇḍapamadhyasthavedikāyāṃ sthitāṃ smaret kodaṇḍabāṇau karayornavavalkaladhāriṇīm yajedaṣṭadale padme karṇikāyāṃ ṣaḍaṅgakam strī tuṅkārī kṣemakārī tadagre bhūpure yajet bilvakāṣṭhaidhite vahnau hunedbilvaphalaistathā mallīpuṣpairhuto vaśyamikṣudaṇḍairdhanāptaye p. 718)annādiratnaiḥ sakalaṃ madhūkairvāṃchitaṃ bhavet ṣoḍaśastrīsahasrāṇā yatprabhāvātprabhurbhavet tāro [oṃ hrīṃ yogini yogeśvari yogeśvari yoge bhayaṃkari sakalasthāvajaṅgamasya mukhaṃ hṛdayaṃ mama vaśyamākarṣayākarṣaya svāhā ||] hrīṃ yoginī dvedhā yogeśvariyugaṃ vadet jaṅgamasya mukhaṃ procya hṛdayammama coccaret pitāmaho muniḥ proktaśchandotijagatī matā oṃ hrāṃ jagattrayavaśyamohinyai hṛdayāya hṛt uraṅgavaśyamohinyai oṃ hraimādyaṃ śikhā bhavet oṃ hrauṃ sarvastrīpuruṣamohinyai ceti netrakam tataśca mūlamantreṇa sarvāṅge vyāpakaṃ caret tattatsukhecchayā kṛṣṇarūpaṃ jagrāha mohanam mohitā svasvarūpañca kṛtvāṣṭaguṇasundaram jagau maṅgalagītāni yāvatsyānmaithunālayaḥ devyai madhūkajāmmālā nāgahāraṃ harorppayat tasmai devī varaṃ prādāttena jātā haripriyā aṣṭadaśadigbhūpāladantāṣṭakṛtisammitaiḥ

tadbāhye caturasrasya dikṣu medhāṃ yajettataḥ dvidvisvarānaṣṭadale śakrādīndigdale punaḥ tārādyena namontena śrībījena yajecchriyam aṣṭākṣareṇa manunā radapatre śivāṃ yajet navākṣareṇa tripurāṃ cataṣṣaṣṭidalercayet yoginīṃ pūjayeditthaṃ navāvaraṇapūjanam evaṃ yo bhajate devīṃ vaśyāstasyāmitā janāḥ labhate vāñchitāṃ kanyāṃ dhanamānasamanvitām dakṣamārgeṇa saṃsiddhā vāmenaite prakīrttitāḥ siddhirmadhye yadā mṛtyustadā janmāntare bhavet tanmārgiṇāṃ mahāpāpaṃ pāpātmānotra ye sthitāḥ yasminbhuktiśca muktiśca kiṃ vaktavyamataḥ param iti śrīmahāmāyāmāhākālānumate merutantre śivapraṇīte viṣṇuśaktimanukathanaṃ nāma triṃśaḥ prakāśaḥ indānīṃ śrotumicchāmi tava mantrānsasiddhidān yānsādhayitvā bhogāṃstu bhuktvā mokṣamavāpnuyāt ṣaḍakṣaroyaṃ viprāṇāṃ bhuktimuktiprasādhakaḥ ṣaḍarṇaistu ṣaḍaṅgāni pañcārṇairaṅgapañcakam tarjjanyorvinyasennaṃ tatpuruṣāya namastviti vāmuktvā vāmadevāya namothāṃguṣṭhayornyaset hṛdaye pādayorguhye nyāsoyaṃ syāttṛtīyakaḥ evameva nyasetprokto nyāsoyaṃ pañcamoghahṛt namuktvā nityatṛpteti śaktidhāmne śiro bhavet śimanantaśaktidhāmne kavacāya namastviti yamanantaśaktidhāmne vadedastrāya phaṭ tathā hṛdi vaktre dakṣiṇāṃse vāmāṃse dakṣiṇoruke

pārśve ca vāmapārśve ca pṛṣṭhe hṛdi dvitīyakaḥ dakṣanāsāpuṭe vāmanasi proktastṛtīyakaḥ madhyeṃgulīnāmagre ca caturthaḥ parikīrttitaḥ dakṣorumūle madhye ca gulphe cāṃgulimūlake pañcamoyaṃ bhavennyāso mūrdhni vaktre hṛdi nyaset vāmorumūlapādāgraparyyantaḥ ṣaṣṭhakastvayam punarvaktrāṃsahṛtpādadvayorujaṭhare nyaset evaṃ dvādaśadhā nyasya vāmena paṅkajaṃ caret caturmūrttivapussthāya bhasitāṅgāya śambhave cārucandrakalārājajjaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitam śārdūlacarmmavasanaṃ ratnābharaṇabhūṣitam vāmordhvahaste hariṇandadhānamabhayampare brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyaiḥ stutaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ surāsuraiḥ dhyātvārcayettataḥ pīṭhe ṣoḍaśairupacārakaiḥ vāmā jyeṣṭhā tato raudrī kālī kalavikarṇikā p. 721)sarvabhūtadamanyākhyā tataḥ proktā manonmanī guṇātmaśaktiyuktāya yogapīṭhātmane namaḥ āvāhya devaṃ sampūjya puṣpāntairupacārakaiḥ tatpuruṣo hyaghoraśca saghojātastataḥ param nivṛttiṃ ca pratiṣṭhāṃ ca vidyāṃ śāntiṃ tu madhyataḥ agnīśāsuravāyavyamadhye sarvatra keśare ekaruṇḍaṃ trimūrttiṃ ca śrīkaṇṭhaṃ ca śikhaṇḍinam kirīṭārpitabālendūnpadmasthāṃścārubhūṣaṇān umāṃ caṇḍeśvaraṃ nandimahākālau maheśvaram uttaradalamālabhya bījanīlāhṛtānsitān

tadbāhye caturasre ca yajedindrādidikpatīn tatpārśve tadvāhanāni bāhyestrāṇi prapūjayet tatsahasraṃ prajuhuyāttilaiḥ śuddhairghṛtaplutaiḥ tāvatsaṃkhyātilaiḥ śubhraistarppayecca tathāsitaiḥ evaṃ saṃsādhito mantraḥ sarvānkāmānprayacchati taddaśāṃśena pūrṇāyurnīrogaḥ sādhako bhavet āmrairhunettaddaśāṃśairdīghāyuśca yuvā bhavet arkairaṣṭaśataṃ nityaṃ hunedrogairvimucyate 722)ayutaṃ rogahīnaḥ syādatha pūrvoditairyajet nityaṃ tasya mahārogā nāśaṃ yānti na saṃśayaḥ ayutaṃ tajjalaiḥ snānaṃ rogāṇāmauṣadhaṃ smṛtam huneccārupalāśaiśca tāvadārogyamāpnuyāt audarairāmayaiḥ sarvairmāsenaikena mucyate bhakṣyaṃ coṣyaṃ tathā peyaṃ viṣamapyamṛtaṃ bhavet yāvadgrahaṇamokṣastu tāvannadyāṃ samāhitaḥ aṣṭottarasahasreṇa pibedbrāhmīrasaṃ tataḥ sārasvatī bhaveddevī tasya vāgatimānuṣī tilājyairaṣṭasāhasraṃ grahapīḍā vinaśyati ghṛtenāṣṭaśataṃ hutvā duḥsvapnaphalanāśanam yatkiñcitprārthayettasya nikaṭena tadāpnuyāt samidbhirjuhuyānmāsamayutaṃ vyādhiśāntaye palāśasya samidbhistu tasya śāntirbhaviṣyati pradhvaṃsayati tacchaktiṃ śatrustasya mariṣyati parāpakāraḥ pāpāya śṛṇu tatpāpanāśanam sandhyopāsanavicchede sahasraikaṃ japettathā

spṛṣṭamannaṃ na bhuñjīta tatra cāṣṭaśataṃ japet yonijeṣu tadardhaṃ syāttadardhaṃ bhūpayonike jitendriyo japellakṣapañcakaṃ śivadṛṅmanāḥ nigṛhītendriyaḥ pañcalakṣaṃ japtvendriyaṃ jayet madhyarātreyutaṃ japtvā nikaṭe brahmasiddhibhāk madhyarātre vivaśyaśca tadvaśo bhavati dhruvam sahasradvayajāpena mahārogaiḥ pramucyate catussahasrajāpena vāñchitāni samāpnuyāt māsaṃ hutvā vinaśyettu rogastasya na sambhavet lakṣamekaṃ puraścaryyā munayomī prakīrttitāḥ bharadvājotha chandāṃsi paṃktigāyatryanuṣṭubhaḥ parabrahmendraviṣṇū ca vidhātryaśviguhāḥ kramāt pītoruṇaḥ kramādvarṇā devatānāṃ prakīrttitāḥ aiśvaryyāya ca vidyāyai nijapāpakṣayāya ca ṣaḍarṇaścāṣṭavarṇaḥ syādevaṃ mantradvayaṃ bhavet tāraṣaḍdīrghamāyādyaiḥ syānmantrārṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam śūlaṃ kapālamabhayaṃ varaṃ ca dadhataṃ karaiḥ smeravaktraṃ trinayanaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam ādau pañcadale padme keśareṣvaṅgaṣaṭkakam hṛllekhā gaganāyuktā caturthī tu kulālikā pāśāṃkuśavarābhītidhāriṇyomitabhūṣaṇāḥ samyagdhyātvā kramādarcyā devāgrādipradakṣiṇam sarvābharaṇasandīptaṃ sākṣācchandassvarūpiṇam kṣetrapālaṃ trinayanaṃ digambaramathārcayet raktākāraṃ trinayanaṃ caṇḍīśaṃ paripūjayet

durgāṃ prapūjayetsaumyāṃ trinetrāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇām vighnanāśakamabhyarceccandrārddhakṛtaśekharam trinetraṃ raktavastrāḍhyaṃ senāpatimathārccayet tadbahiścaturastrāṇi trīṇi tadvīthikādvaye manulakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ tatsahasraṃ yathāvidhi tarppaṇaṃ mārjjanaṃ prāgvadviprasantarppaṇantathā etatsaṃsādhanātsampatsantatiḥ samprajāyate vāmadevo muniśchandaḥ paṃktirdevaḥ sadāśivaḥ ṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ yasminkṛte tu pañcatve jāte pañcamukho bhavet ayantu prathamo nyāso devatāprītikārakaḥ sa eva devo bhūpaṃktyanuṣṭapchandāṃsi cintayet īśānaṃ trīkṣaṇaṃ śuddhaṃ nāgayajñopavītinam āpo devyosya gāyatrī chando dhyānaṃ nirūpyate caturmukhaṃ tatpuruṣaṃ trinetraṃ vṛṣagāminam anuṣṭupchanda ākhyātaṃ deva āpaḥ prakīrttitāḥ khaḍgaṃ kapālaṃ hastaiśca dadhataṃ trīkṣaṇaṃ bhaje p. 725)varābhayākṣavalayakuṭhāraṃ dadhataṃ karaiḥ nānābhīmagaṇairyuktamaghoraṃ cintayeddhṛdi vikṛtiśchanda uddiṣṭaṃ bhargo devaḥ prakīrttitaḥ traiṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ ca tathāhaṃ kṣaiṃ huṃ hauṃ ca śrītrayaṃ vadet amṛtatejojvāleti māline ca padaṃ tataḥ jvalitaśikhiśikhāyānādibodhāya tacchriye sauṃcauṃsaumiti saṃbhāṣya munaye'luptaśaktaye śrīṃ paraśuṃ ca ṅentaṃ huṃ phaṭ tathānantaśaktaye

mukheṣu vinyasedīśānādīnpañca hi ca kramāt nyasettiryyakchirovaktrahṛdayāṃghriṣu pañcamaḥ aṣṭatriṃśatkalānyāsaṃ kuryyāttejobhivṛddhaye praṇavādyaṃ mantrapadaṃ kalā ṅentā namontakāḥ īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāmaṅgadākhyā tataḥ param śivo metrāstu mārīcī caturthī kathitā kalā tatpuruṣāya vidmahe śāntiṃ pūrvamukhe nyaset tanno rudraḥ pratiṣṭhākhyāṃ yāmyāsye tvaṣṭamīṃ nyaset aghorebhyastāmasīṃ tu daśamīṃ hṛdi vinyaset dakṣiṇāṃse ghorarūpāṃ vinyaseddvādaśīṃ kalām sarvebhyo nābhimadhye tu vyācitākhyāṃ caturdaśīm namaste astu pṛṣṭhe tu sudhākhyā ṣoḍaśī kalā vāmadevāya virajāṃ guhye tvaṣṭādaśīṃ nyaset śreṣṭhāya nama ityuktvā vāmāṃse tu ratiṃ nyaset kālāya namo dvāviṃśasaṃjñāṃ vāmoruke nyaset nyasecchriyaṃ vikarṇāya namo vāme ca jānuni nyasejjñānāṃ vikarṇāya namo vāme ca jaṃghake kaṭyāṃ balapramathanāya namo guhyake nyaset vāmapārśve manonmanāya namaścobhayaṃ nyaset ṛddhiṃ codakpādatale sadyojātāya vai namaḥ vāmahastatale lakṣmīṃ catustriṃśatkalāṃ nyaset ṣaṭtriṃśīṃ mūrddhani kṣāntiṃ vinyasecca bhuje ramām udbhavāya namaḥ procya tiryyagvāmabhuje nyaset sadyojātādikānnyasya vyāpakanyāsamācaret avasthitaṃ śivohaṃ ca dhyātvāntaḥ pūjanaṃ caret

prathamāvaraṇaṃ jñeyaṃ dvitīyaṃ syātṣaḍaṅgakaiḥ indrādyaiḥ paṃcamaṃ cāpi vajrādyaiḥ ṣaṣṭhakaṃ matam paṃcaviṃśatisāhasrasammitaiḥ karavīrajaiḥ kṛtvā saṃsiddhamantrastu kuryyātkāmyāni pūrvavat devaḥ sadāśivaḥ proktaḥ paṃktiśchanda udāhṛtam ṣaḍbhistathā mantravarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni sajātibhiḥ ṭaṃkaṃ mṛgaṃ tathā devīṃ cāliṅgantaṃ varapradam pītavṛttaghanottuṅgastanīṃ vāmāṃkasaṃsthitām evandhyātvā ca paṃcārṇapīṭhe tadvadyajeddharam ghṛtāplutaiḥ pāyasānnaistarppaṇādi tataścaret evaṃ siddhamanuḥ kuryyātprayogānhi ṣaḍarṇavat ṛṣiḥ kahoḍo devyādigāyatrī chanda īritam ṣaḍdīrghayuktabhṛguṇā ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret hasteṣu jñānamudrāṃ ca pāśarudrā kṣamālike ardhāṅgaṃ bahubhūṣāḍhyaṃ kāntābhiśca vimohitam aṅgendrādyaistadastraiśca trirāvaraṇapūjanam evaṃ saṃsiddhamantrastu prayogānvaicaredatha ārādhitāgnau juhuyādvidhivadvijitendriyaḥ āyurārogyasampattiyaśaḥputrānvivadhayet ityuktaiḥ saptabhirdravyairjuhuyātsapta vāsarān bhojayenmadhurāktaiśca sarvarogaiḥ pramucyate guruṃ samprīṇayetpaścāddhanādyairdevatādhiyā vimuktaḥ suciraṃ jīvetsādhikaṃ śaradāṃ śatam homoyaṃ śāntidaḥ proktaḥ sarvasampatpradāyakaḥ bhojayenmadhurairbhojyairbrāhmaṇānvedapāragān

samidvaraiḥ kṛto homaḥ sarvamṛtyugadāpahaḥ apāmārgasamiddhomaḥ sarvāmayavināśanaḥ oṃṅkāramāyābījābhyāṃ [oṃ hrīṃ dakṣiṇāmūrttaye tubhyaṃ vaṭamūlanivāsine || dhyānaikaniratāṃgāya namo rudrāya śambhave oṃ hrīṃ ||] puṭaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadakṣaram dhyānaikaniratāṅgāya namo rudrāya śambhave devatā jagatāmādirdakṣiṇāmūrttiravyayaḥ viniyogaḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ puruṣārthacatuṣṭaye rasanetrāṣṭakavasu bāṇavahnimitaiḥ kramāt ṣaḍdīrghaistāramāyāntaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret mūrdhni bhāle dakṣanetre vāme caiva tu karṇayoḥ liṅge dakṣorumūle ca jānumūle ca gulphake evaṃ vāmorumadhyādau kuryyānnyāsoyamīritaḥ nānādrumaiḥ puṣpaphalapatropetairvirājite śukādimunibhiryukte vaṭaṃ tatra vicintayet navaratnamayākalpaistoraṇādyairalaṃkṛtam āsīnamamitākalpaṃ śaraccandranibhānanam p. 729)jaṭāmukuṭinaṃ vīrāsanaṃ nāsāvalokanam dakṣiṇordhvakare ṭaṅkaṃ vyākhyāmudrāmadhaḥ kare prākprokte pūjayetpīṭhe prathame tu dale yajet pūjayedaṣṭapatreṣu pūjayedvṛṣabhādikān puraścaraṇasiddhyarthaṃ prajapedayutāṣṭakam tarppaṇādi tataḥ kuryyātprayogārho bhavenmanuḥ mantraṃ pratidinaṃ mantrī vidvattvaṃ labhate dhruvam akhilānāṃ ca śāstrāṇāṃ vyākhyātā ca mahākaviḥ sugandhadravyasaṃyuktairnandikeśvarakalpitaiḥ anena mantravaryyeṇa jīvitaṃtvayutāvadhi

kāntirakṣāyuṣyadaṃ ca gaditaṃ sarvasiddhikṛt tāro namo bhagavate dakṣiṇāmūrttaye vadet medhāsthāne paṭhetprajñāṃ phalaṃ nāmānusārataḥ bījadvayālpito mantraḥ siddhyate vāmamārgiṇām devatā śrīmahādevo dakṣiṇāmūrttisañjñakaḥ medhāpadaṃ kīlakaṃ syātpuruṣārthe niyojanam śirorumadhyavaktreṣu hṛdi nābhau ca guhyake oṣṭhe dante ca jihvāyāṃ cubukāgreṃsayorgale pādapāṇyośca sarvāṅge tato devaṃ vicintayet gaṅgādharaṃ śaraccandrakarollasitaśekharam divyāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ gandhamālyairalaṃkṛtam muktākṣamālāṃ dakṣordhve jñānamudrāmadhaḥ kare dadhānaṃ cintayeddevaṃ munivṛndaniṣevitam padmatrayasamopete bhūgehatritayānvite svarānṣoḍaśa tatraiva dvandvaśaḥ keśarasthitān sarasvatīṃ caturvakraṃ sanakaṃ ca sanandanam vyāsaṃ ca paratoṣṭau tu pārvatīṃ śubhagāṃ tathā caturasre catuṣkoṇamāgneye śāṃtamarccayet indrādīṃśca tadastrāṇi prāgvadvīthīdvaye yajet tarppaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā kāmyakarmmāṇisādhayet pratyahaṃ maṇḍalādarvākkavīnāmagraṇīrbhavet sarvāpannāśakaṃ caiva sarvarogavināśanam maunī gatvārcayeddevaṃ vidyāyuḥ parivṛddhaye śrīkāmo jalajairbilvairnandyāvarttaiḥ sadā hunet gurave gāṃ ca mahiṣīṃ tasya mṛtyubhayaṃ kutaḥ

mūlamantreṇa mantrajñaḥ sarvadoṣairna bādhyate palāśapuṣpairacirātkavirhomādibhirbhavet ayutaṃ prajapenmantraṃ bhūyasīṃ śrīyamāpnuyāt bhikṣānnamatha vā mantramayutadvitayaṃ japet evamārādhito mantro bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥ haṃsa ityasya gāyatrī chando brahmā munirmataḥ hasavyañjanayoryoge ṣaḍdīrghāṃdyaṅgakalpanam dvātriṃśadakṣaraproktadakṣiṇāmūrttimantravat jñānapradaśca bhavati tathā mokṣapradopi ca dakṣiṇāmūrttibhedasya tasya mantracatuṣṭayam ūrdhvapaścimayoḥ saumyaprāgāmnāyoktasiddhikṛt vāmo munirvirāṭ chando devatā vāmanāyakaḥ liṅganyastamahākāliṃ madirāsaktamānasam dadhataṃ bharjjitammatsyaṃ caṣakaṃ rudhirasya ca itthaṃ saṃcintya deveśaṃ kālapīṭhe samarcayet liṅgasthitaṃ liṅgabhagamātmānaṃ cātmamekhalam madonmattaṃ ratikaraṃ calanmadhyaṃ skhalatpadam tatra sthitaṃ ca tadbāhye pūjayennavayonike homāddhi māṃsaśakalairmantrasiddhiḥ prajāyate tadā na kāryyaṃ bhavati vāmamārgeṇa sādhitam mahyaṃ medhāṃ vadetprajñāṃ prayacchānalavallabhām devatā dakṣiṇā medhā gāyatrī chanda ucyate niyogotha ṣaḍaṅgāni āṃ īṃ ūṃ aiṃ ca auṃ ca aḥ vyākhyāpīṭhetiśubhraṃ ca bhasmoddhalitavigraham prāgvatpūjādika sarvaṃ puraścaraṇamucyate

catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇāṃ japātsyācca puraskriyā pāpādhikyānna cetsiddhistadaivantu samācaret lakṣamekaṃ manuñjaptvā hutvājyaṃ siddhibhāgbhavet yamuddiśyāyutaṃ sopi mūrkho vidyānidhirbhavet pratyahaṃ maṇḍalādarvākkavīnāmagraṇīrbhavet aśrutaṃ vedaśāstrādi vyācaṣṭe nātra saṃśayaḥ māsaṣaṭkaṃ tasya vidyā bhavedgaṅgāpravāhavat mantraṃ śarabhasañjñasya drutasiddhipradāyakam śāntāya pakṣirājāya huṃ phaṭ svāhā namo manuḥ kālāgnirudraḥ śarabho devatā parikīrtitaḥ vedāṃkadaśasaptāgasāgarairaṅgakalpanam candrārkāgnitrinayanaṃ kālīdurgādvipakṣakam vyādhimṛtyuripughnaṃ ca caṇḍavātātiveginam mṛgendratvakcharīresya pakṣābhyāṃ caṃcunā ravaḥ kālāntadahanaprakhyo nīlajīmūtaniḥsvanaḥ aṣṭapādāya rudrāya namaḥ śarabhamūrttaye pratyahaṃ māsaṣaṭkena mantrasiddhiḥ prajāyate naśyanti darśanādeva cādhayo vyādhayastathā tāro namo bhagavate ṅentaṃ śarabha śālva ca nivāraṇāya jvāleti ṅentaṃ mālāsvarūpakam kālarudrasvarūpāṣṭamūrttaye ca tathā vadet krūrabhūtoccāṭanāyetyapratiśayanāya ca gṛhṇayugmaṃ khādayugmaṃ tāraṃ huṃ phaḍvasupriyām pratyahaṃ māsaṣaṭkena siddhaḥ syāttatphalaṃ śṛṇu pānārthaṃ tatprasādena dātavyaṃ lāpayettathā

saptāhāttatprayogeṇa nātra kāryyā vicāraṇā māyāṃ sphuradvayaṃ caiva prasphuradvitayaṃ vadet pracaṭadvitayaṃ paścātkahadvandvaṃ mahadvayam manuḥ proktoghoramuniruṣṇik chandosya devatā varṇaiḥ kuryyātṣaḍaṅgāni padanyāsotha vakṣyate sajaṃghapādayoścaiva padānyekādaśa nyaset rasanetramitairvarṇaistatpadaiśca bhavatyasau [padanyāsa iti śeṣaḥ ||] bhujaṅgabhūṣaṇaṃ raktavasanālepaśobhitam "damaruṃ kheṭakaṃ cāpaṃ nṛkapālaṃ ca bibhratam nigrahe grahabhūtādimuktau muktānibhaṃ smaret ṣaṭkoṇāntasthite padmadvitaye bhūpurairvṛte ḍamaruṃ paraśuṃ khaḍgaṃ kheṭaṃ bāṇaṃ tathā dhanuḥ vīthīdvaye lokapālāṃstadastrāṇi ca pūjayet juhuyāttaddaśāṃśena tilaiḥ śuddhaghṛtaplutaiḥ evaṃ siddhe mantravare kāmyakarmmāṇi sādhayet homoyaṃ nāśayetsadyo bhūtakṛtyādināyakān samidvaraiḥ kṛto homaḥ pūrvavaddrutaśāntidaḥ pṛthaksahasrahomena bhūtānāṃ nigraho bhavet hutvā sahasraṃ pratyakaṃ pātre sampātayeddrute aghorāstrāhvayo mantraḥ sarvakāmyāni sādhayet tāraḥ śrīṃ paśuśabdānte huṃphaḍmantraḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ mantrārṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhiraṅgāni huṃphaḍantaiḥ sabindukaiḥ dhyāyetpaśupatiṃ samyaṅmantrī caikāgramānasaḥ agnijvālānibhaśmaśrumūrddhajaṃ bhīmadaṃṣṭrakam dadhānaṃ dakṣiṇairhastairūrdhvādikramataḥ paraiḥ

nānābharaṇasandīptaṃ bālacandrairalaṃkṛtam padmamaṣṭadalaṃ kṛtvā karṇikākeśarānvitam evaṃ pātre samālikhya svarṇaraupyādike śubhe sarvopacārairārādhya yajedaṅgāni pūrvavat pūjayedvidhinānena sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt tarppaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā prayogārho bhavenmanuḥ sadyastanmuñcati krandatyaho mantraprabhāvataḥ evaṃ mantrastu saṃsiddho bhuktimuktiprado bhavet bhavedaṣṭākṣaro mantro munyādyaṃ pūrvavanmatam praṇavādyaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni prāgvaddhyātvā ca pūjayet ṣaḍaṅgaiśca dvitīyāsyāttadastrādyaistṛtīyikā ṣaṣṭhī cendrādibhiḥ proktā saptamī ca tadāyudhaiḥ anyatsarvaṃ prayogādi pūrvavatparikīrttitam śaṃnīṃṭha iti mantroyaṃ trivarṇaḥ sarvakāmadaḥ nīlakaṇṭhaḥ śaṃ ca bījaṃ ṭhaḥ śaktiḥ parikīrttitā nīlakaṇṭhāyeti śikhā kavacaṃ kālakūṭavi astraṃ ca śitikaṇṭhāya svāhāntā iti sammatāḥ mūrdhni kaṇṭhe ca hṛdaye nyasedbījatrayaṃ punaḥ jaṭābhūtalasaccandrākārakaiḥ phaṇisattamaiḥ śūlaṃ kapālaṃ khaṭvāṅgamakṣamālāṃ ca bibhratam padmamadhye samāsīnamatisundaravigraham padme vasudale ramye caturasratrayāvṛte evaṃ prapūjayemantrī sarvakāmasya siddhaye taddaśāṃśaṃ tarppaṇādi bhojayenmadhurairdvijān spṛṣṭvā japedviṣagrastaṃ tatkṣaṇānnirviṣo bhavet

bījābhyāṃ prathamāntyābhyāṃ pārśvayorviṣamāharet takṣakeṇāpi sandaṣṭastatkṣaṇānnirviṣo bhavet viṣadvayānmucyatesāvacirānnātra saṃśayaḥ manuvarṇatrayaṃ nyasya devatārūpakaṃ gurum mantrākṣaratrayaṃ nyasya tadaṃgulibhiruttamam pradarśya mantraṃ prajapetpañcāśadvāramatra tu rogagrahādyapasmārānapamṛtyuṃ ca nāśayet munirbrahmā ca gāyatrī chando devaḥ prakirttitaḥ prayogāśca viśeṣeṇa mahāviṣaharāḥ smṛtāḥ aruṇosya muniśchando gāyatraṃ devatāmahān huṃ namo nīlakaṇṭhāya śiraḥ svāhā namastviti svāhā namo netramiti oṃ namostraṃ samīritam vargāṣṭakaṃ nyasenmantrī pādorugulphasandhiṣu pūrvādyairānanairyyuktaḥ pītaśvetāruṇāsitaiḥ dhyeyo devosya pārśvasthā gaurī cāpyatisundarī daśalakṣaṃ puraścaryyā sarvatrākṣaravanmatā hṛdi bāhvornetrayośca mastake ca kramādyajet japenmantraṃ dṛśā sarvaviṣāṇāṃ vāraṇambhavet tāro namo bhagavate sarvajñetipadaṃ vadet ḍentaṃ dviḥ kṣipa oṃ svāhā conatriṃśākṣaro manuḥ amalākhyo nīlakaṇṭho rudro devaḥ prakīrttitaḥ saptabhiḥ pañcabhiḥ ṣaḍbhiścaturbhiścāpi saptabhiḥ lakṣamekaṃ puraścaryyā hunedājyaṃ daśāṃśataḥ duṣṭaṃ viṣaṃ dravyasaṃsthaṃ haredatra na saṃśayaḥ viṣamūṣīviṣaṃ hanti japaḥ saptadaśonmitaḥ

ekaviṃśatijāpena tvabhicārakṣayo bhavet netrarogaṃ vedavedaiḥ khabāṇaiḥ sakalaṃ viṣam agninā nihatānāntu japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam p. 738)yadyatproktaṃ vaidikānāntattatsiddhividhāyakam ṣaṣṭibinduyutaṃ kūṭaṃ proktaṃ dakṣiṇamārgiṇām dvitīyaḥ svarabindubhyāṃ yuktaḥ kūṭamudāhṛtam ekonatriṃśakañcaitatsaptavedākṣisammitam etatkūṭaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ munyādyamatha kathyate bījaṃ kṣakāro raḥ śaktirmakāraḥ kīlakammatam vidrumāraktavāmārdhadehaṃ nīlāmbarāṅgakam hāvabhāvavilāsārdhanārīrūpaṃ maheśvaram bhīṣaṇaṃ paradehārdhamālālepavirājitam aṅgāni pūjayedādau vāmeṣṭadalakeśare brāhmyādyā mātaraḥ pūjyā dvitīyeṣṭadale punaḥ pūjādravyādikaṃ grāhyaṃ svasvāmnāyavibhedataḥ paraśuṃ pannagaṃ śūlaṃ kapālaṃ ca śarāsanam gaṅgātaraṅgavilasaccandrakhaṇḍābhiśekharam aruṇāmaruṇākalpāmaruṇāṃśukadhāriṇīm śūlaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirvyagrabhujaṣoḍaśamaṇḍitām evaṃ saṃsiddhamantrasya prayogo vakṣyatedhunā prasādya yo japenmantramayutambhāgyadāyakam trikoṇaṃ cintayenmūrdhni grastasyāgnyarkasannibham grastasya mūrdhni kṣiptaṃ ca kṣaṇādāveśakārakam sakāramādau saṃyojya japetsiddhiḥ prajāyate hakārādyaṃ ca hemābhaṃ stambhane caiva cintayet

śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśo dhyeya ugro mumukṣubhiḥ vāyumaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ mantraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vicintayet kukṣau śūlaṃ mukhe chardiṃ kuryyādvāyuṃ ca marmmasu candramaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ svaraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiryutam raktasrāvaṃ kṛśāṅgīnāṃ yonau dhyānaṃ haretkṣaṇāt smaredyantraṃ bāhugataṃ tatra taddoṣaśāntaye duṣṭāṅganāhṛdambhoje sthitaṃ mantraṃ vicintya ca vaśayettatkṣaṇādyoṣāṃ srāvayecchukrameva ca praveśayedyonimadhye tatsaṃsargācca sā vaśā tanmakārasya rephe tu sādhyākhyāṃ karmmasaṃyutām ṣaṭkoṇaikaṃ samāveṣṭya ṣaṭkoṇe tu samācaret prāṇapratiṣṭhā kṛtvāsya cullyadho nikhanettataḥ patiḥ priyāyāḥ kurute tadājñāṃ dāsavatsadā prapadābhyāṃ ca jaṃghābhyāṃ jānubhyāmūruyugmataḥ evaṃ dvādaśadhā chittvā tīkṣṇaśastreṇa saṃhunet vakāramadhyasādhyākhyāṃ likhitvā manumadhyataḥ likhettasya catuṣkoṇe ṭhakāraṃ bindubhūṣitam aṣṭottarasahasreṇa śirorogī prabhakṣayet sarepheṇa kakāreṇa kaṇṭhe sādhyasya bandhayet dakṣāṃsaṃ rephato vāmaṃ tathaiva ca vakārataḥ maraṇāntaṃ sa vaśyassyādacirānnātra saṃśayaḥ tatpuṣpeṇa ca tadbījaṃ candanāgurukuṃkumaiḥ aṣṭottaraśataṃ tasya sampātaṃ pātayettataḥ aṣṭottarasahasreṇa taṃ kare dhārayennṛpaḥ viṣavetālabhūtādiduritairbādhyate na ca

bhāgā daśaiva tāmrasya trilohetra prakīrttitāḥ antyasaptamavedākṣivarṇaṣaṣṭhasvarānvitam ṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ mūlādyantaṃ tu bhūkūṭaṃ kaniṣṭhāyāṃ punarnyaset kṣakāraṃ mūlabījaṃ tu bhasahābhisamanvitam p. 741)jayākhyā vijayākhyā ca hyajitā ca parājitā mūrddhādipādaparyyantaṃ talābhyāṃ vyāpakaṃ nyaset śirovadanahṛnnābhigudeṣvevaṃ kramānnyaset sṛṇiṃ pāśaṃ kapālaṃ ca khaṭvāṅgaṃ ratnabhūṣitam śaivapīṭhe yajeddevaṃ vakṣyamāṇena cātmanā dharmādikairadharmmādyaiḥ pādagātrāṇi kalpayet caturthapañcamābhyāntu māyāvidyāmayo bhavet sandhyakṣaraiścaturdiṣu sthitā vāmādikā yajet itthaṃ saṅkalpite pīṭhe tumburuṃ tatra pūjayet aṣṭapatrāmbujeṅgāni keśareṣu samarcayet aruṇāṃśukapuṣyāḍhyāstāmbūlākulitānanāḥ aṣṭapatreṣu cābhyarcyā devyo durgādikāḥ kramāt baddhāñjalipuṭāḥ kiñcidānamravadanāmbujāḥ śaṣasahāstu tadbāhye yajedvīthīdvaye manum lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ tu hunedghṛtaiḥ kupitasya hṛdambhoje smṛtvā bījamidaṃ japet p. 742)hṛdrogāstasya naśyanti sarve viṣṭambhakādayaḥ putriṇī kanyakāmātā bhavedatra tu kā kathā śrītumburuśivasyāyaṃ mantraḥ sarvārthasiddhidaḥ praṇavādyaramābhyāṃ [oṃ śrīṃnamaḥ śivāya oṃśrīṃ iti navākṣaramantraḥ |] tu sampuṭo navavarṇakaḥ

dakṣiṇāmūrtirudrosya devatā samudīritaḥ dṛkkarṇanāsikādvandve mukhe liṅge gude punaḥ sṛṣṭinyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryāttṛtīyaṃ bhujayoḥ kramāt sarvāṃgulīṣu vinyasya mūlena vyāpakaṃ caret kaṇṭhe dakṣe bāhumūle nyasetkakudi cāntare nāsāmukhe tṛtīyaṃ tu kaṇṭhahṛnnābhiṣu nyaset kaṭeśca bhāgadvitaye caturthaṃ kathayāmyatha vinyasetprathamaṃ varṇaṃ dvitīyārṇaṃ tato nyaset tṛtīyaṃ vinyasedvarṇaṃ cāṃgulīnāṃ ca sandhiṣu kaniṣṭhādyaṃgulīnāṃ ca nyasetsandhitrike trike vāmapādatale pṛṣṭhe vāmadakṣiṇapārśvayoḥ tathā dakṣiṇapāde ca kramādarṇānimānnyaset vāme karatale pṛṣṭhe tathā jānuni dakṣiṇe evaṃ dakṣiṇahaste ca caturthaḥ parikīrtitaḥ stanābhyāṃ hṛdayābhyāṃ ca nyasedvarṇaṃ tṛtīyakam navamaṃ brahmarandhre ca nyāsoyaṃ pañcamaḥ smṛtaḥ vyāpakaṃ ca punaḥ kṛtvā sthitinyāsaṃ samācaret mūrddhāsyahṛdguhyapāde punastāneva vinyaset punarmunyādikaṃ nyasya ṣaḍaṅgāni tataścaret śatayojanakocchrāyaṃ pañcasaptati vistṛtam maṇḍapaṃ ruciraṃ tadvatsahasrastambhasaṃyutam tatrāsīnaṃ mahādevaṃ dakṣiṇāmūrttivigraham vyāghracarmmadharaṃ śāntaṃ jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitam mudrāparaśvadhamṛgānbibhrāṇaṃ bāhubhistribhiḥ vyākurvantaṃ samastāni brahmatantrāṇi sādaram

śukādimunimukhyaistu pustakojjvalapāṇibhiḥ brahmāṇyā padmanābhena cānandena ca saṃvṛtam mīmāṃsādharmma śāstrābhyāṃ diśi prācyāmupāsitam sāṅkhyapātañjalābhyāṃ tu saumyāśāyāmupāsitam p. 744)trayastriṃśadbhirindrādyairdevaiḥ saṃveṣṭitaṃ prabhum yāvanto vaiśvadevasya nīvīsambandhinaḥ surāḥ tāvadbhirvividhaiḥ sākṣādgandharvādyaiśca saṃyutam bhāvayedyopi sadbhāvaṃ sarvajñaśca bhaveddhruvam aṣṭottaraśataṃ nityaṃ japetpuṣpāñjalistathā sarvaṃ pūrvavadevaṃ syādviśeṣo jñānadastvayaḥ ānandāghahara prīta samyajjñānaṃ prayaccha me tāro [oṃ namo bhagavate paśupataye oṃ namo bhūtādhipataye oṃ namo rudrāyakhaṅgarāvaṇa lalaṃ vihara vihara sara sara nṛtya nṛtya vyasanaṃ bhasmārcitaśarīrāya ghaṇṭākapālamālādharāya vyāghracarmaparidhānāya śaśāṃkakṛtaśekharāya kṛṣṇasarppayajñopavītine calacala balabala atirvītakapāline hanahana bhūtānnāśaya nāśaya maṇḍalāya phaṭphaṭ rudrāṃkuśena śamayaśamaya praveśaya praveśaya āveṇaya āveṇaya rakṣāsi dharādhipatiḥ rudro jñāpayati svāhā |] namo bhagavate ṅentaḥ paśupatirdhruvaḥ khaḍgarāvaṇa laṃlaṃ ca viharadvitayaṃ sara bhasmārcitaśarīrāya tato ghaṇṭāpadaṃ vadet paridhānāyātha ṅentaḥ śaśāṃkakṛtaśekharaḥ caladvayaṃ bala dvedhā ativartikapāline jahidvayaṃ vadedbhūtānnāśayadvitayaṃ tataḥ maṇḍaleti padānte tu madhye phaḍdvitayantataḥ dvirāveṇaya rakṣāṃsi dhārādhipati saṃvadet rāvaṇosyāmitaṃ chando devatā khaḍgarāvaṇaḥ sadyojātādikāndehe ceśānādīnmukheṣu ca pañcānanaṃ karairghaṇṭāṃ kapālāṃkuśamastakam dadhānamabhayaṃ cāpi dhyāyetpañcānanaṃ śivam pañcākṣarodite pīṭhe pūjayetkhaḍgarāvaṇam aṅgāni dalamūleṣu dvitīyeṣṭadale yajet

phālgunīṃ jhiṇṭirillīṃ ca pañcamīṃ mantramālikām pūrvapatrādisavyena khaḍgarāvaṇavallabhāḥ vaināyakīṃ ca cāmuṇḍāṃ māheśīṃ dikṣu pūjayet raudrapiṅgalanāmānau śmaśānānalabhīṣaṇau mahākālaṃ ca keśeṣu kumbhakarṇamaśeṣakam indrādikāṃstadastrāṇi bāhye bhūtabaliṃ haret pāyasena ghṛtāktena juhuyāttasya siddhaye mantreṇānena sadṛśo nānyo bhūtapramardakaḥ triyambakaṃ mṛtyujitaṃ prāsādaṃ vyāhṛtitrayam tāravyāhṛtimantrāṃghricatuṣkoṇāṃgulīmukhe triyambakamanornyāsānpūrvoktānapi saṃcaret tāro [oṃ namo bhagavate tryambakāya śūlapāṇaye rudrāyāmṛtamūrtaye māṃjīvaya candrajaṭila tripurāntakāya haṃhrīṃ rudrāya ṛgyajuḥsāmarūpāya rudrāyāgnitritayāya jvalajvala prajvalaprajvala māṃ rakṣarakṣa aghorāstrāya huṃphaṭsvāhā |] namo bhagavate tryambakāya tato vadet mā jīvaya padasyānte syāccandrajaṭilaṃ padam ṛgyajussāmarūpāya rudrāyāgnitrayāya ca āghorāstrāya huṃphaṭ ca svāhāntobdhyaṣṭavarṇakaḥ svāhāntamaṅgatritaye kavacāni ca phaṭ triṣu nṛpārkeṣu gajasthāṇudantasaṅkhyākrameṇa ca ayaṃ digbandhamantraḥ syāddhyānamasya nirūpyate sravatpīyūṣabindośca kalādhraṃ candrasuprabham somasūryyāgninetraṃ ca baddhapiṅgajaṭādharam bhasmānulepanaṃ bhaktakṛpākaramanusmaret catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi pauraścaraṇiko japaḥ viśeṣeṇa tarppaṇaṃ tu śīghrābhīṣṭaphalapradam prayogāścāpi siddhyanti purāmṛtyuñjayoditāḥ tāro namo bhagavate rudrāyeti prakīrttitaḥ

pṛthakpadaiḥ samastena pañcāṅgavidhirīritaḥ hṛdaye dakṣiṇe haste vāme nābhyāṃ ca pādayoḥ prayogāścātra vijñeyāḥ pañcārṇoktā yathā purā iti śrīmahāmāyāmahākālānumate merutantre śivapraṇīte śivamaṃtrakathanaṃ nāmaikatriṃśaḥ prakāśaḥ tāmasānrājasāṃścāpi sāttvikānsiddhidāyakān ahaṅkāro mahānāsīttatrāvidyāprabhāvataḥ na vedaḥ śrūyate kvāpi smṛtijñānaṃ na vidyate na kaścinmanyate viṣṇuṃ gaṇeśaṃ na raviṃ śivam matvā sarve jagacchāktaṃ bhagapūjāṃ prakurvate brahmannādiśyatāṃ dharmo vayaṃ yena taremahi āgamaḥ pañcamo vedo bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥ brahmannidaṃ tvayā vācyaṃ sṛṣṭikarttā sadāśivaḥ mamordhvamukhato jāto manyatāṃ veda āgamaḥ baṭustvaṃ vetsi no saukhyaṃ bhakṣyapānāṅganābhavam yugatraye tadājātaḥ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ śiro nipātitaṃ dhātuḥ karāṃgulyā dharātale lagnā ca brahmahatyā me pṛṣṭhataścātibhīṣaṇā bhava tvaṃ baṭukākhyaśca sevyaścāgamamārgataḥ yajñādikarmmarakṣākṛdrājasastvaṃ divapradaḥ tanmantrānsampravakṣyāmi sādhakābhīṣṭadāyakān bṛhadāraṇyakamuniśchandonuṣṭup ca devatā bhairavo hrīṃbījaśaktirāṃkīlakamudāhṛtam na jāyate manoḥ siddhistatrādau varṇamātṛkaḥ jakārādichakārāntānnyasyedvarṇāṃstṛtīyakaḥ pañcamo nyāsa uditaḥ śrībījādikamātṛkaḥ

śrībījādyānnyasedvarṇānādikṣāntāṃstu saptamaḥ kāmabījādimātṝṇāṃ nyāsastu navamaḥ smṛtaḥ hrīṃśaktiṃ pādayornābhau āṃ kīlaṃ daśamastvayam hrīṃvīṃ tatpuruṣāyeti namastarjanikādvaye hrūṃ vūmaghorāya namo vinyasenmadhyayorapi hrauṃvauṃ ca sadyojātāya namonyāsaḥ kaniṣṭhayoḥ ke mukhe hṛdaye guhye pādayordvādaśastvayam iti prayogāḥ prāgādivaktreṣvevaṃ trayodaśaḥ jātiyuktaṣaḍaṅgaṃ ca nyasennyāsaścaturdaśaḥ pretabījamidaṃ tena nyāsastithimitassmṛtaḥ sabindūnvinyasenmūrdhni bāhvoścaiva tu vakṣasi sthānaṣaṭke kramānnyasya nyāsoyaṃ syāttu ṣoḍaśaḥ dhyānabījamidaṃ proktaṃ brahmarandhre mukhe dṛśoḥ punarnyasedayaṃ nyāsaḥ proktaḥ saptadaśaḥ surāḥ sthānaṣaṭke pravinyasya nyāsaścāṣṭādaśaḥ smataḥ pañcasthāneṣvaṣṭadhāyaṃ nyāsa ekonaviṃśakaḥ ghṛṇābījamidaṃ nyasya hṛdaye nābhimaṇḍale hṛdaye vāmapāde ca hṛdaye dakṣanetrake hṛdaye vāmakarṇe ca hṛdaye viṃśakastvayam ghaṇṭābījamidaṃ nyasya ghaṇṭikānābhighaṇṭiṣu gulphe stane tu syādekaviṃśakoyaṃ susammataḥ khyātibījamidaṃ mūrdhni sphigjihvānābhikaṇṭhake krameṇa vinyasennyāso dvāviṃśoyaṃ prakīrtitaḥ hastayoḥ karṇayornāsādvaye'yaṃ tu triviṃśakaḥ nādabinduyutānbījamāsuryyāḥ parikīrttitam

gaṇḍayoḥ kaṇṭhadeśe ca stanayorhṛdi pādayoḥ brahmarandhre tathādhāre bhrūmadhyeyaṃ jinonmitaḥ diksaptapañcapañcāgavedapralayasāgarāḥ nyasecchīrṣe gaṇḍayośca mukheyaṃ tattvasammitaḥ binduturyyasvarābhyāṃ tu kālabījamudāhṛtam ṣaḍviṃśoyaṃ samākhyātaḥ saptaviṃśotha kathyate turyyasvareṇa bindvāḍhyā vidyābījamudāhṛtam aṣṭāviṃśamatho vakṣye śṛṅkhalānyāsamadbhutam turyyasvaraistathaikatriṃśanmitābdhitrisāgaraiḥ mahāparokṣaṃ tatkūṭamaṅgeṣveṣu pravinyaset aṇḍadvaye nyasetpaścānmūlādhāre ca gulphayoḥ p. 750)brahmarandhre punaścāṃṅghryoḥ pādayoraṃgulīṣu ca nyāsaścūḍāmaṇiścāyamūnatriṃśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ādyekatriṃśavarṇāstu saturyasvarabindavaḥ vāksiddhyarthaṃ nyaseddehe triṃśoyaṃ samudīritaḥ avāmināṃ trayo nityāḥ śeṣāḥ kāmyaprayogake dīptamudrāvarābhītikiṃkiṇījālanūpuraiḥ dakṣe śūlaṃ ca paraśuṃ dadhataṃ baṭurūpiṇam vaiṣṇavastu caturbāhuṃ jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇam mūlādyasadyojātena sthāpayettadanantaram mūlena sannidhāyātha sannirodhanamācaret ṣaḍaṅgaiḥ sakalīkuryādamṛtīkṛtya mūlataḥ dhyātvā saṃsthāpanaṃ kuryyānmudrāḥ sandarśayettataḥ tāṃ darśayettatpuruṣamūlābhyāṃ ca tato balim tato devājñayā nyāsasthāneṣvaṅgāni pūjayet

devasya dehe vaktreṣu yajeccaiva punaśca tān paścimāyāṃ devadehe sadyojatādikānyajet kapālinaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ ca saṃhāraṃ ca samarcayet deśagrāmādhipau sthānādhipatiṃ saṃyajetpunaḥ kāladūtaṃ ca ṣaṭkoṇe ṣaḍaṅgāni samarcayet ḍādinīputrakānsarvāñchākināputrakānapi mālinīputrakāniṣṭvā devīputrāṃstato yajet indreśānadiśormadhya ūrdhvamukhyā nyajetsutān eteṣāmantarālercyāḥ putravarṇāstrayodaśa brahmāṇītanayaṃ māheśīputraṃ vaiṣṇavīsutam vārāhītanayṃ cāmuṇḍāputraṃ baṭukābhidham bhūpurārvāgaṣṭadikṣu hetukaṃ tripurāntakam ekapādaṃ bhīmarūpaṃ prāgīśānāntare yajet caturasrādirekhāyāṃ devāgrādipradakṣiṇam bhārabhūtaṃ trimūrttiṃ ca tithīśaṃ ca tadagrime sthāṇvīśvaraṃ ca bilvīśaṃ digīśaṃ bhautikeśvaram mahāseneśvaraṃ paścāttṛtīye caturasrake krodheśvaraṃ ca caṇḍīśaṃ kūrmmeśaṃ lāṅgalīśvaram vāmabhāge tu devasya nakulīśaṃ śiveśvaram vāmāgrakoṇamārabhya prādakṣiṇyena koṇajān tadagre lokapālāṃśca pūjāvidhiritīritaḥ hunettilaistrimadhvaktaistarppaṇādi tataścaret puraścaryā tathā homo ghṛtayuktapalāśajaiḥ vighnaṃ durgāṃ samārādhya baliṃ dattvā vidhānataḥ vaśyāya juhuyādikṣuśakalairvaśayejjagat

juhuyātputralābhāya praphullaiḥ kairavaiḥ sudhīḥ bilvaprasūnairjuhuyānmahatīṃ vindate śriyam p. 752)vṛṣṭikāmena hotavyaṃ veṃtasānāṃ samidvaraiḥ vaśyāya juhuyānmantrī madhunā divasatrayam kṛtyādrohe grahadrohe bhūtāpasmārasambhave bhūtādayaḥ palāyante drutaṃ no yānti taddiśam tilaistaṇḍulasammiśrairmadhuratrayalolitaiḥ bhūtādayaḥ palāyante darśanāttasya pārvati nityaṃ nivedya naivedyaṃ madhyarātre baliṃ haret guḍamikṣurasāpūpairmadhvaktaiḥ parimiśritaḥ raktacandanapuṣpādyairbalireṣa prakīrtitaḥ tataḥ kārayitā rājā toṣayetsādhakaṃ dhanaḥ tejo balaṃ yaśaḥ putrānkāntiṃ lakṣmīmarogatām bhavanti graharogā no viṣaye tasya bhūpateḥ nigaḍādivimokṣāya prayogoyamudāhṛtaḥ vibhajya bhakṣayedvandhyā maṇḍalātputrakāṃkṣiṇī ādāvante prayogasya baṭukāya baliṃ haret tāmasaśceti pūrvokto māṃsahīno yadā baliḥ khādyaiḥ phalatrayairyuktaḥ sāttvikaḥ parikīrttitaḥ evaṃ samāṃsobhūpādiyogya uktastu rājasaḥ balistāmasa ākhyātaḥ śūdrādīnā praśasyate p. 753)uśīraṃ candanaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ ghanasāraṃ ca kuṃkumam tvacaṃ bilvaphalaṃ malaṃ śoṣayitvā tu cūrṇayet kṛtvā piṇḍāṃśca saṃśoṣya saṃskṛte havyavāhane ketakīmālatīpuṣpairvāsayedbhasma śobhitam

etadādāya divase prātaḥ puṇḍaṃ karoti yaḥ ripucauramṛgādibhyo bhayamasya na jāyate rājā vaśyo bhavettasya sāmātyaḥ saparicchadaḥ pūrvvokte maṇḍale lipte vitānadhvajaśobhite aṣṭadroṇapramāṇena śālibhiḥ prācitaiḥ śubhaiḥ hemādivihitaṃ kumbhaṃ navaratnasamanvitam kṣīradrumapravālāni lakṣmīṃ dūrvāṃ tathaiva ca kaṃkolamaguruṃ jātīṃ mallikāṃ campakotpale tasminnāvāhya baṭukaṃ rājasaṃ saṃprapūjayet trayodaśasukumbheṣu trayodaśagaṇānyajet tadbahirvyastakumbheṣu ||śrīkaṇṭhādīnsurānyajet ayutaṃ prajapetspṛṣṭvā tānghaṭāndeśikottamaḥ svastimaṅgalavākyāni viśuddhairvedapāragaiḥ jitendriyaṃ śuddhakāyaṃ rājānaṃ brāhmaṇapriyam bhūyasīṃ dakṣiṇāndadyātprasīdati yathā guruḥ parānvijayate bhūpānstūyate sakalairjanaiḥ caturambhodhivalayāṃ śāsti sarvāṃ vasundharām rogādīnāṃ yathā śāntistattacchālāsu kārayet pāyasājyatilairvidvānayutatritayāvadhi prākproktavidhinā kumbhānsthāpayitvātra deśikaḥ yuddheṣu mahatī śaktirjāyate pūrvatodhikā asmātparatarā rakṣā nāsti teṣāṃ mahītale uktena vidhinā mantrī yāminyāṃ balimāharet balipradānasamaye ripūṇāṃ sarvasainyakam vidarbhayecchatrunāmnā balimantraṃ tathā sudhīḥ

balimantroyamākhyātaḥ sarveṣāṃ vijayapradaḥ śvagaṇebhyo vibhajate sāmiṣaṃ kruddhamānasaḥ vijayaśriyametena rājā prāpnotyayatnataḥ śmaśāne ye tu tiṣṭhanti kālekāle purepure vāmamārgādiniratopyadveṣataravartmanā sa bhavedbhairavo devastasya deśasya śāsakaḥ svargamokṣacyutānāṃ sa śāsanaṃ kurute sadā anyasminneva bījena grāme vasati niścitam p. 755)tena mārgeṇa vaśayetkāryyārthaṃ bhairavañca tam pūrvādyūrdhvāṃntakaṃ tvetadāmnāyānāṃ krameṇa ca grāmanāma tataḥ procya pitṛgehanivāsine japādau ca japānte ca nityaṃ dadyādananyadhīḥ evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī bhūtānāṃ nigrahakṣamaḥ kṛtanityakriyaḥ prātaḥ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ pragṛhya sarvasāmagrīṃ sāyamuttarasādhakaḥ vaṭakāścaṇakā bhaktaṃ pāyasāpūpaśaṣkuli aṣṭau vitastidīrghāśca samidhaḥ khādirā matāḥ balidravyaṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ pūrvāmnāye samatsyakam grāmamadhye śmaśāne tadūrdhvāmnāye saraktakam pādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ smṛtvāsya devatām tāḥ prayacchantu me siddhiṃ prasannāḥ santu pāntu mām kapālī dakṣiṇe pātu nairṛtye jaṭilovatu uttare muṇḍamālāḍhya īśāne vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ agrato bhairavaḥ pātu pṛṣṭhataḥ pātukhecaraḥ keśānpātu viśālākṣo mūrddhānañca marutpriyaḥ

kapolau pātu vīreśo gaṇḍau gaṇḍādimardanaḥ danteṣu dantividhvaṃsī cibuke nṛkapālayuk dakṣaskandhe girīndreśo vāmaskandherisūdanaḥ vāme bhuje sārvabhaumo hṛdayampātu pāṇḍuraḥ uttare sarvakalyāṇakārakovatu māṃ sadā jānunī pātvajāmitro gulphau gaurīpatiḥ sadā pādādhaḥ pātu satataṃ vyomakeśo jagatpriyaḥ oṃ-hrāṃ-hrūṃ-hrūṃ-huṃ ca pūrve oṃ-hrīṃ-hrūṃ-hrīṃ hutāśane oṃ-pruṃ-mruṃ-prūṃ-sa-āpyatyerāṃprāṃ-yrūṃ-saḥ samīraṇe oṃ-glauṃ-blumūrdhvadeśetho srāṃ-srūṃ-srūṃ-srastvadhaḥ smṛtam madhye mahākīlamatho dikpālārcanamācaret māṃ rakṣarakṣa huṃ phaṭ ca svāhā dvāviṃśadarṇakaḥ kīlasya nikaṭe candramāvāhya pūjayettataḥ mantreṇānena candrāya maṇḍale balimarpayet imaṃ baliṃ gṛhṇagṛhṇa huṃ phaṇnāgāgnivarṇakaḥ agniṃ tatra samāvāhya prāgvaddhyātvā prapūjayet oṃ-raṃ-rāṃ-riṃ-rīṃ-ruṃ-rūṃ tadā gre gre ca padaṃ vadet mudgabaliṃ gṛhṇagṛhṇa huṃ phaḍ devārṇako manuḥ daṃbījena samāvāhya manunā nirvapedbalim pretādhipataye śīghraṃ prasanno bhava saṃvadet p. 757) huṃphaḍantaḥ samākhyāto mantro gorāmavarṇakaḥ kṣaṃbījena samāvāhya balimantro thakathyate rakṣonāthapadaṃ śīghraṃ prasanno bhava saṃvadet ṣaṭtriṃśadarṇo mantroyaṃ tataḥ paścimakīlake imaṃ me caudanabaliṃ gṛhṇagṛhṇa ca huṃ ca phaṭ

tato vrajedvāyukoṇe kalisya nikaṭercayet oṃ vāṃ-vīṃ-vūṃ tataḥ krāṃ-krīṃ bhobho vāyo bhuvaḥ punaḥ baliṃ gṛhṇayugaṃ huṃphaṭpañcatriṃśākṣaro manuḥ āvāhayetpūjayitvā manunā nirvapedbalim mamāpūpabaliṃ gṛhṇayugaṃ huṃ phaḍvedāgnivarṇakaḥ huṃbījena samabhyarcya baliṃ yacchettathāmunā baliṃ gṛhṇayugaṃ huṃphaṭhcandranāgamitākṣaraḥ anena manunā stambhaṃ nirbhayaḥ paripūjayet oṃ hrāṃ-hrīṃ-hrūṃ namo huṃ ca kṣāṃ-kṣīṃ-kṣūṃ-kṣaśca proccaret sruṃ-srāṃ-sreṃ-sraṃ tato mrāṃ-mrauṃ trirho muktvā tridhātridhā rakṣarakṣa padaṃ procya rakṣarakṣeti bhairava japtvātmarakṣāṃ kṛtvātha stambhasya ca samīpataḥ svāgre same tu bhūmyagre gomayādyupalepite tadbāhyeṣṭadalaṃ cāpi hyasitāṅgādibhairavān kulīśaṃ sukulīśaṃ ca jāmitraṃ ḍāmaraṃ ribham cāritraṃ ca camatkāraṃ cañcalaṃ cāru bhūṣaṇam ete svanāmabhiḥ pūjyāḥ ṣoḍaśānandapūritāḥ tadbāhye ca tadastrāṇi tadbāhyepi tvimānyajet vyomakeśaṃ vyomabāhuṃ vyomavyāpakameva ca abhyarcayennirbhayaḥ saṃstato nyāsānsamācaret uccaiḥ svarāṃstadāyāti pratyahaṃ bhairavaḥ svayam sambhojayejjapaṃ kuryānnirbhayaḥ prītamānasaḥ dakṣiṇe payasā caiva tasya tṛptiḥ prajāyate praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau vāñchitaṃ varamuccaret evaṃ kaliyuge siddhiḥ śmaśānasya prakīrtitā

samastabhairavāṇāṃ tu mantrādyevaṃ mayoditam ṅentastu kṣetrapālaḥ syātkṣauṃbījādyo gajākṣaraḥ munirbrahmā ca gāyatraṃ chandaḥ syātkṣetrapālakaḥ ṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ vartulāsyaṃ trinayanamūrdhvapiṅgajaṭādharam dakṣe gadāṃ kapālaṃ ca vāme sarppavibhūṣaṇam madhye devaṃ ṣaḍaṅgāni karṇikāyāṃ daleṣu ca p. 759)mahākopaṃ piśitāsyaṃ piṅgākṣaṃ cordhvakeśakam dhūpadīpādikaṃ datvā naivedyaṃ manunāmunā bhañjaya dvirnartaya dvirvipravipra mahā vadet gṛhṇadvayaṃ vahnijāyā pañcatriṃśākṣāro manuḥ caruṇā ghṛtasiktena tarppaṇādi tataścaret rātrau gṛhāṅgaṇe ramyaṃ kṛtvā sthaṇḍilamuttamam dakṣamārgī ca dugdhādyaiḥ kṛtvā vai siktakaṃ mahat pakṣyamāṇena manunā tasya haste baliṃ haret bhuṃghiṃ dvirhana vighnaṃ ca vināśayavināśaya agnijāyā balermantro bhavetpañcābdhivarṇakaḥ balinānena santuṣṭaḥkṣetrapālo mudānvitaḥ dadāti raudrabhūtādi kṛtyādyāśu nivārayet khaḥkhaṃ syādvyakṣaro mantro muniragniḥ prakīrttitaḥ ṣaḍdīrghasvarayuktena khakāreṇāṅgakalpanam tarppaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā prayogaṃ tu samācaret tasyāpi karṇikāyāṃ tu savisargaṃ khakārakam sudhāmayaṃ ca tajjvālāṃ paścādastraṃ vibhāvayet japedaṣṭottaraśataṃ mantraṃ yasya tanuṃ spṛśet

netrarogādikaṃ pīḍāṃ sarvāṅgasthāṃ haredatha ṛṣistrikonuṣṭubuktaṃ chandaścaṇḍosya devatā dīptaphaṭ-hṛdayaṃ proktaṃ jvālāphaṭ śira īritam hana phaṇṇetramuddiṣṭaṃ sarvajvālini phaṭ param dhyāyeccaṇḍeśvaraṃ raktaṃ trinetraṃ raktavāsasam sphaṭikasrajamābaddhajaṭājūṭaṃ sanāgakam ṣaṣṭhasvaro binduyukto ṅentaścaṇḍeśvaraḥ suhṛt yantrapūjāvidhistasya caivameva samīritaḥ tannaścaṇḍaḥ pracodayāt satilaistaṇḍulairhomastrimadhvaktairdaśāṃśataḥ evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī prayogānācarettadā devakāṣṭhairedhitegnau samyaktrimadhuraplutām juhuyādvāmapādādi yoṣitaścāpi saṃhunet yo martyonudinaṃ puṣpairhunedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam manunānena ca śivaṃ caturmāsāllabhecchriyam spṛśettāṃ ca japetpaścātpūjayitvā hunenniśi pañcākṣaraprayogāṃśca manunānena sādhayet yasyāḥ prabhāvataḥ kāśyāṃ bhairavostyadhikāravān ekādaśākṣaro maṃtro bhairavosya munirmataḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni tato dhyāyedratnasiṃhāsane sthitām p. 761)ekavīrodite pīṭhe yajedbandhanamuktaye kālīṃ tārāṃ bhagavatīṃ tataḥ kubjāṃ ca śītalām agravīthyāmāyudhāni bandīmevaṃ samarcayet vidhāya tarppaṇādyaṃ ca prayogānācarettataḥ brahmacaryyarato mantrī gaṇeśācarnapūrvakam

apūpopari saṃlekhyaṃ ghṛtena caturasrakam amukaṃ mocayetyevaṃ dikṣu hrīṃkāramālikhet mokṣaṃ kuruyugaṃ svāhā dhṛtivarṇo manuḥ smṛtaḥ kārāniketanasthāya pradadyātsuhṛde ca tam tasminsaṃbhakṣite baddho macyate bandhanāddrutam vaṃ vahnaye namaśceti tārādiḥ saptavarṇavān hṛcchaktistārako bījaṃ satārārṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam rakto raktāṃśuko raktapravarākalpabhaṣitaḥ jayantaścāgnikeśaśca kṛttikāputra eva ca citrākṣo bhūpure śakrādikapūjā prakīrttitā tarppaṇādyairmanuḥ siddhaḥ śrīrakṣājayaputradaḥ śītaleti ca vikhyātā tasyā mantraṃ susiddhidam upamanyurmuniśchando bṛhatī śītalā surī dhyāyecca śītalāṃ devīṃ rāsabhasthāṃ digambarām p. 762)tailādimalasaṃyuktavastrapoṭaliśīrṣikām śarāvikāṃ ca koṇeṣu bhūpure tvaṣṭabhairavān hutvā kṛtvā tarppaṇādi mantrī siddhaḥ prajāyate tena sammārjitāścaiva sphoṭā naśyanti tatkṣaṇāt tenābhimantritaṃ bhasma yadgṛhe tatra sā na hi tāraḥ prāsādabījaṃ yaṃ vaṃ vyomavyāpine dviṭhaḥ [svāhādvayam ||] daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādājyaistarppaṇādi tataścaret yathoktaguṇatāmeti nirvīryyamapi nānyathā rogibhyo bheṣajaṃ dattaṃ tattatpūrṇaguṇaṃ bhavet valīpalitanirmukto jīvedvarṣaśataṃ yuvā jale caikādaśāhena rogahṛjjāyate manuḥ

sarvavaśaṅkare svāhā vāgbījādyo nakhārṇakaḥ devatā tu laghuśyāmā vāgbījaṃ bījamucyate vākpūrvikāṃ ratiṃ mūrdhni prītiṃ māyādikāṃ hṛdi icchāśaktiṃ jñānaśaktiṃ kriyāśaktiṃ kramānnyaset drāṃ drāvaṇaṃ nyasecchīrṣe drāṃ ca śoṣaṇamāsyake sa utpādanakaṃ pāde tataḥ kuryyātṣaḍaṅgakam āṃkṣābrāhmīkanyakāyai namomūrdhni pravinyaset kūṃ-hāṃ kaumārīkanyakāyai namo dakṣāṃsake nyaset oṃ sāṃ cendrāṇīkanyāyai namo dakṣiṇapārśvake aḥ lāmuktvā mahālakṣmīkanyāyai ca namo hṛdi bhrūmadhye kaṇṭhahṛnnābhimūlādhārāṃtareṣu ca vaśitā cātha prākāmyaṃ prāptirityaṣṭasiddhayaḥ ke bhāle netrayorvaktre karṇayoḥ kakudi dhruvam sukeśīṃ mañjughoṣāṃ ca mahāraṅgavatīṃ tathā vidyādharakimpuruṣapiśācānāṃ krameṇa ca guhye cādhāradeśe ca klīmādyāśca namontakāḥ nyasetsandhiṣu sāgreṣu karayoḥ pādayorapi karasya sandhayaścaite sphigjānu ca tato bhavet nyāsānevaṃ vidhānkṛtvā laghuśyāmāṃ tataḥ smaret māṇikyābharaṇāṃ smerāṃ nīlotpalanibhāmbarām tryakṣāṃ tāmbūlapūrṇāsyāṃ smarecca śaśiśekharām trikoṇe pañcakoṇeṣu dale ṣoḍaśapatrake icchājñānakriyāśaktīstadagre bāṇapañcakam aṇimādyāśca yantrāgre yajetṣoḍaśapatrake gajānanāṃ siṃhamukhīṃ gṛdhrāsyāṃ kākatuṇḍikām

p. 764)ulakīṃ ca śivārāvāṃ mayūrīṃ vikaṭānanām samarcayeddiśi prācyāmetāḥ ṣoḍaśa yoginīḥ tryakṣā ca kekarākṣī ca bṛhattuṇḍā surāpriyā pāśahastā daṇḍahastā pracaṇḍeti ca dakṣiṇe śiśughnī pāpahantrī ca kālī rudhirapāyinī śūlakeśī bṛhatkukṣī sarppāsyā pretavāhinī vyāghrāsyā bhīmaniḥśvāsā vyomaikacaraṇārdhadṛk vidyutprabhā balākāsyā mārjjārī kaṭilānanā kramāḍḍākinya etāśca pūjyā vahnyādikoṇake durgāṃ tadbahirindrādīnvajrādīnyapi pūjayet suciraṃ ceti pūjoktā dvādaśāvaraṇairiyam mātaṅgīmantrasamproktāḥ prayogāścātra kīrtitāḥ yāgadravyaṃ ca bhūpālastadvaśe rājaputrakāḥ devīvanmānanīyāśca striyo nindyā na jātucit kāmasya bāṇabījānāṃ mantroyaṃ parikīrtitaḥ bāṇeśī sarvavyastena manunoktaṃ ṣaḍaṅgakam nyastavyāḥ pañcabajrādyā drāvaṇī kṣobhaṇī tathā bāṇāndhanuḥ sṛṇiṃ pāśaṃ hastaissandadhatīrbhaje bāṇeśīyogapīṭhāya namo mūlādiko manuḥ ādau ṣaḍaṅgānyārādhya dikṣvagre drāviṇīmukhāḥ anaṅgamanmathānaṅgakusumā madanāturā anaṅgabhūmikā bhūmipure dikpāśca sāyudhāḥ tarppaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā prayogārho manurbhavet sahasraṃ juhuyāttasya vaśyāḥ syuḥ prāṇinokhilāḥ kanyāpi vaśamāyāti māsadvitayamadhyataḥ

ājyaṃ sampātitaṃ dadyātstriyai saṃpādya tattvidam sugandhakusumairhutvā dhanamāpnoti vāñchitam tāro namaḥ śivāye ca nārāyaṇyai padaṃ vadet vyāso muniḥ kṛtiśchando devī gaṅgā prakīrttitā caturbhujāṃ trinetrāṃ ca sarvābharaṇa bhūṣitām cāmarairvījyamānāṃ ca śvetacchatropaśobhitām jayādiśaktibhiryukte pīṭhe bhāgīrathīṃ yajet sūryyaṃ himācalaṃ menā bhagīrathamapāṃ patim haṃsānkāraṇḍavāṃścakravākānsārasakānyajet evaṃ saṃsādhito mantrobhīṣṭaṃ yacchati mantriṇe dadyāddaśabhyo viprebhyo daśaprasthamitāṃstilān p. 766)sarvabhogasamāyukto jāyate mānavo bhuvi śrībījapūrvamanunā tasya śrīḥ sarvatomukhī tilairhutvā dahetpāpaṃ dūrvābhiśca mahāgadān arcayitvā tu yo gaṅgāṃ tulasīmaṃjarīṃ kṣipet gaṃgāpravāhavattasya syādvāgbhūtivijṛmbhitā bahiryajanakarttāraḥ siddhāḥ syuryatprabhāvataḥ hilidvayaṃ ca gaṃge māṃ pāvayadvitayaṃ vadet rāmavedeṣusaptāṃganetrārṇairaṃgakalpanam sadaiva sarvapāpasya nāśāya suniṣevitām tatobdhyasre tu kāverīṃ yamunāṃ gaṇḍakīmapi surāsindhumāsavābdhiṃ dugdhasindhuṃ madhūdbhavam mādhvīsindhuṃ kṣārasindhuṃ sudhāyāḥ sindhumudbhavam alobhādvāmamārgepi kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vināśayet evaṃsiddhamanurmantrī marvādinirjalasthale

homādi sarvaṃ irvartya gaṃgāmāvāhayettataḥ kalpasthāpitatoyaughaṃ samastagadanāśanam prāgvanmunyādikaṃ bāṇavedatritritribāhubhiḥ homadravyādikaṃ prāgvatsiddhamantraḥ samācaret p. 767)tryahādavarṣākālepi vṛṣṭirbhavati bhūyasī sampātājyaṃ pibedyā strī gaurvā kṣīranidhirbhavet tasyāḥ putrāḥ prajāyante bhīṣmatulyaparākramāḥ bhūtāviṣṭasya tatkālaṃ mukto bhavati nānyathā tithivarṇosya munyādipūjā pūrvavadīritā etasya bhajanājjantornātīrthe maraṇambhavet sambuddhau gaṅgadayite namo varma tathāstrakam japādinā siddhamantraḥ prayogānācaredatha guḍūcyā roganāśaḥ syādramā padmādihomataḥ jātīprasūnairvaśyaṃ syājjapāpuṣpairjayo bhavet vāgbījaṃ prathamaṃ hṛcca nāradosya manormuniḥ bījapūrvaiśca ṣaḍdīrghaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ karairdadhānāṃ mīnasthāṃ muktābharaṇabhūṣitām prabhāvatīṃ bhānumatīṃ bhūpure tu digīśvarān tarppaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā siddhamantraḥ prajāyate madhunā svarṇalekhanyā soṣṭavarṣaḥ kavirbhavet dvitīyādapratigrāhī bhikṣāśī vātha maunavān vāksiddhiṃ labhatevaśyaṃ dātā bhoktā tvayācakaḥ namo mameti ca padaṃ dhāraṇāṃ ca dhiyantathā munyādikantathā pūjā puraścaryyā ca pūrvavat vacākalkena mantraṃ tu likhitvā bhānuvāsare

saptabhirbhānuvāraiśca sākṣātsyāddhiṣaṇopamaḥ ravau tu pāyase mantraṃ likhetsvarṇaśalākayā svapne tamarthaṃ śṛṇuyātprātarbījaṃ svayaṃ smaret tāro vāghrīṃ ramākāmastāro maṃ maṇikarṇike munirvyāsotiśakvarī chandaḥ syānmaṇikarṇikā bījapūraṃ dakṣahaste vāme cendīvarasrajam paścimābhimukhī smerāpadmasthā padmamālikā lakṣatrayaṃ japenmantraṃ juhuyāttaddaśāṃśataḥ āvāhya kalaśe devīṃ pūjayedayutaṃ japet pāyasaṃ bhakṣayenmuktī rogapīḍā ca naśyati vaṃśavṛddhikaraḥ proktaḥ kāśīvāsapradāyakaḥ namaścaturdaśārṇoyaṃ munyādyaṃ pūrvavanmatam aiṃ-śrīṃ mekalakanyāyai narmadāyai hṛdādikam hṛdādiṣu prakalpāyai hṛdayaṃ devavarṇakaḥ ḍentaiḥ pṛthak pañcapadaiḥ samastairaṅgakalpanam padmābhayasudhākumbhavarādyānbibhratīṃkaraiḥ ghoṇāṃ jyotiṣmatīṃ cāpi vāmadakṣiṇato yajet lakṣaṃ japeddhunedyo vai bhuktiṃmuktiṃ tato bhajet iti śrīmahāmāyāmahākālānumate merutantre śivapraṇīte bhairavādimanukathanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśaḥ prakāśaḥ durgrahāśca yathā duḥkhaṃ dātuṃ śaktānavidviṣaḥ sādhakaistu prakartavyā kathaṃ siddhiḥ prajāyate siddhasya lekhanādeva yantrasiddhiḥ prajāyate duḥsvapnadarśanaṃ pūrvaṃ tadā yantranna kārayet svapyāttridivasaṃ bhūmau haviṣyāśī japettataḥ kṛtvā pradoṣasamaye likhettridivasaṃ bhuvi

tathaivājñāṃ gṛhītvā tu satsvapno vā likhedbudhaḥ jīvasaṃsthāpanaṃ yantre kuryyādyena phalaṃ labhet dvitīyāntaṃ sādhyamadhye kurudvandvaṃ ca pārśvayoḥ haṃsaḥ sohaṃ manorasya likhedekaikamakṣaram ṭhadvayaṃ vāmapārśve ca likhetpūrvāditaḥ kramāt evaṃ dikpālabījāni vinyaseddikṣu ca kramāt tanno yantrampracodayāt p. 770)evantu likhitaṃ yantraṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam yantraṃ sulikhya guṭikāṃ baddhvā sūtreṇa veṣṭayet yaddevatākaṃ yantraṃ syāttadbījena ca pūjayet aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu mūlaṃ japtvā hunedghṛtam mūrdhni bāhau gale vāpi tattadiṣṭārthasiddhaye akleśenaiva sarveṣāṃ mantrāṇāṃ siddhimāpnuyāt akpratyāhāramuccāryya roṃ-rauṃ-ḍauṃ-ḍauṃ tato vadet vargāntyamādyadvitryabdhivarṇānvargacatuṣṭaye ṛṣiḥ syāddakṣiṇāmūrttirgāyatrī chanda īritam svarahīnairhayābdhyaśvairmantrārṇaiḥ pañcapañcabhiḥ śirasi brahmarandhre ca kramānnyasyā nava svarāḥ haṃ-yaṃ-ṭaṃ-raṃ-vaṃ-lamiti nyasedbījāni vai kramāt dakṣavāmakrameṇaiva ṭādivargaṃ tathādimam tathā sandhāvaṃgulīnāṃ gulphe sargādinādikān guhye hṛtkakudormadhye śaṣasānvinyasetkramāt varākṣamālāpadmāni kapālaṃ bibhratīṃ karaiḥ śrīvidyārādhane cāpi samartho jāyate naraḥ bhūrjapatre likhedyantraṃ kuṃkumena madena ca

amukaṃ cetyadhaḥ sthāne vaśaṃ kurviti pārśvayoḥ ṣaṭṣaḍbhāge keśarāṇāṃ gāṃ-gīṃ-gūṃ-gaiṃ ca gaumiti herambamālāmantraṃ ca gaṃ namo vahnigehinīm sarvārthasiddhidāyeti sarvaduḥkhapadaṃ vadet saṃkṣobhayadvayaṃ hrīṃ-gāṃ namo jvalanagehinī padmādvahiḥ prakarttavyaṃ varttuladvitayantataḥ lakṣmībījāni parata aiṃ-bījena praveṣṭayet akṛtvā cāgnisambandhaṃtāṃtrilohe nidhāpayet amitaṃ chanda ityuktaṃ yantraṃ dayādabhīpsitam sādhyanāma ca tanmadhye tadbāhyeṣṭadalaṃ likhet glauṃbījaṃ taddale lekhyaṃ tadbāhye ca likhetpunaḥ caturviṃśatyakṣaraṃ ca gaṇeśasya manuṃ śṛṇu naṃ me vaśametyuktvā naya svāhā manurmataḥ kādikāṃstānmātṛvarṇānsabindūṃstasya bāhyataḥ tasya koṇeṣu laṃ bījaṃ likhettasya bahiṣpunaḥ tadveṣṭayedbaṃbījena tadbahirvṛttayugmakam bījaṃ cādyantayorlekhyaṃ mahāgaṇapateridam gorocanā gomayantu kastūrī keśaraṃ tathā etadyantraṃ dhṛtaṃ yena satvajeyo naro bhavet gṛhe vane jalādau vā sarvadā sa jayī bhavet raktapuṣpādimiścaiva naivedyaiḥ paripūjayet p. 772)pratāpayecca dīpāgnau saptāhātstriyamāpnuyāt avaśyaṃ vaśayennārīṃ vidveṣaṇamathocyate likhedyantraṃ tu mṛtakavastrapuṅkhe bahiṣkṛte sthāpayedvairisaṅghasya vidveṣo jāyate mahān

pītadravyaiḥ pītapuṣpairarkapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet vākstambhaṃ vā gatistambhaṃ senāstambhaṃ karoti tat narāsthni krodhasaṃyuktaḥ pūjayeccandanādibhiḥ mahāgaṇapateryantraṃ proktaṃ ṣaṭkarmasiddhidam kṛtvā ṣaṭkoṇamādau tu tasya madhye trikoṇakam trikoṇordhvaṃ caturdikṣu śrīṃ-hrīṃ-klīṃ-glauṃ samālikhet oṃ-śrīṃ-hrīṃ-klīṃ-glauṃ ca gaṃ ca likhitvā ṣaḍdale kramāt gaṇapataya ityādi varṇaikaṃ cāṣṭame dale vīthyagre tu hyakārādīnkṣakārāntāndvitīyake aiṃbījairveṣṭayetturyyaṃ hrīṃbījena tato bahiḥ puruṣārthakṛtaṃ yantraṃ tvaṣṭāsreṇaiva veṣṭayet alaktaṃ caiva kāśmīrakastūrīrocanānvitam āyurārogyasampattikīrttikṛtprītivardhanam likhedaṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ karṇikāyāṃ tu vartulam praṇavasyottare glauṃ cāgre tasya jaṭhare tu gam p. 773)bhūbījodaragaṃ haṃ ca pūrvāśādiṣu vinyaset kamalaṃ vā tato lekhyaṃ caturasradvayākṛti tasya garbhe vakāraṃ ca sabinduṃ koṇamastake tadbahiścaturasraṃ ca glauṃ tatkoṇeṣu saṃlikhet ādityabudhaśukrāṇāṃ madhye kasyāpi vāsare pradīpadīpite tatra tathaivārdrakasaṃyutām sthānāṣṭake gaṇeśasya variṣṭhāṃ pādasammitām paścātsaṃśodhayitvā tāṃ pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyayā paścāttāṃ lepayenmantrī śubhe sūkṣme sitembare atra prāṇānpratiṣṭhāpya pūjitaṃ guṭikīkṛtam

vinirmāya tribhirbhāgairniśāyāṃ taddhṛdi kṣipet gandhapuṣpādinaivedyairabhyarcya gaṇanāyakam saṃjapya pūjayedbhaktyā pītavarṇaiśca puṣpakaiḥ taṇḍulāñcchālisambhūtānprasthamānamitāñcchubhān guḍaṃ caiva tathā bhūyo nārikelaṃ ca tatsamam tadardhaṃ jīrakaṃ cājyaṃ kuḍavārdhasamaṃ bhavet pacetsiddhaudanaścāyaṃ gaṇeśasya mahāpriyaḥ karpūravāsitaiḥ pūgaistāmbūlaiścandanādibhiḥ praṇameddaṇḍavadbhūmau stutvā stutibhirādarāt stambhayetsādhakaḥ satyaṃ yuddhabhūmau mahāniśi tattatsthānagatānsarvāñjanānsastaṃmbhayennaraḥ aśvavāraṇaśālāsu kṣaṇātsarvānupadravān stambhayedakhilaṃ viśvaṃ kimpunarvāñchitaṃ janam haridrāṃ śodhayedveśmamṛdā proktena vartmanā tasya madhye sādhyanāma praṇavāveṣṭitaṃ likhet tadveṣṭayetsādhyanāma hraṃgaṃbhyāṃ haridakṣaraiḥ hrīṃkārairveṣṭanaṃ kṛtvā likhedaṣṭadale punaḥ vidikpātraṃ veṣṭayecca pūrvavaccāṣṭakoṣṭhakam vidikpatreṣu saṃlikhya śūlānkoṣṭhāgrato likhet sampuṭīkṛtya saṃlikhya māyayā koṇayugmake kṛtaprāṇapratiṣṭhaṃ taddharidrāvighnakukṣigam cakrihastamṛdāpohya gaṇeśāgāramṛttikām vinyasya taṃ gaṇeśānaṃ kusumairaruṇairyajet dvitīyena śarāveṇa vidadhīta susādhakaḥ sādhakasya samāyāti sannidhau vāñchito janaḥ

āgacchanti na sandeho mantriṇaḥ klinnacetasaḥ pūjitaṃ sthāpitaprāṇaṃ dugdhenaivābhiṣecayet p. 775)tadānīmānayennūnaṃ kāmayānāṃ tu sundarīm svinnena mardayitvā tu kṛtvā sādhyākṛtiṃ śubhām kṣaṇādāyāti kāmārttā vāñchitā varavarṇinī sīmantinī samāyāti śīghraṃ yauvanagarvitā yamuddiśyātra tasyāpi kṣaṇādākṛṣṭikārakam śatayojanadūrāttu sādhyamākarṣayeddhruvam manumenaṃ vidhānena sa tadākarṣayeddhi tam tatsthāne kāmabījaṃ ca kāmamadhye tu gaṃ likhet veṣṭayetkāmabījena śeṣaṃ pūrvavadeva hi vidhinā sthāpitaprāṇaṃ śare vinyasya taṃ japet manau sādhyābhidhāṃ dattvā sthānepūrvasamīrite sādhyadiksammukho bhūttvā mantraṃ mantrī samāhitaḥ evaṃ dinatrayaṃ kurvansaptabhirdivasairbudhaḥ vaśayetsādhakaḥ śīghraṃ yāvajjīvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ acalāṃ kamalāṃ labdhvā vaśayedviśvamañjasā tatsamena guḍenāpi madhunā saindhavena ca nirmāya gaṇapaṃ tena yantraṃ taddhṛdiniḥkṣipet pratimāṃ bhakṣayetpaścātsādhyā vaśyā bhaveddhruvam aṣṭādhikaśataṃ japtvā pūjitāṃ sthāpitānilām vaśayedvāñchitaṃ sādhyaṃ sadā sarvasvadāyinam lakṣeṇa vaśayetsādhyaṃ vasumātrasya sādhakam mṛgebhamadasaṃyuktā hyaṣṭāṅgaṃ vighnanāśane arccanādi tathā kṛtvā japitvāṣṭottaraṃ śatam

īkṣaṇātsparśanātsadyastrilokīṃ vaśamānayet candanenaiva vā kuryyādvidhimenaṃ phalapradam bandhūkavālakośīraviṣṇukrāntābalāstathā sarvauṣadhirasenaiva niśā bhāgārdhasammitā prāṇasaṃsthāpanaṃ kṛtvā japedaṣṭasahasrakam trailokyasampadā sopi tiraskuryyāddhanādhipam ādāya brahmacaryyeṇa bheṣajairuditaṃ samam ghṛtaplutaṃ dahenmantrī śoṣayitvaidhitenale samīraṇaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya gaṇapaṃ tatra pūjayet nidhāya lepayedbhasma lalāṭādiṣu sādhakaḥ labdhvā lokapriyo bhūtvā dīrghajīvī bhaveddhruvam kuryyādāyuṣyavṛddhyarthaṃ yo vai vijayasampade p. 777)raktāmbarasuvarṇaistu proktabheṣajapūrvakam dīpaṃ prajvālya tenaiva japenmantraṃ punaḥ punaḥ netre dattvā ca vaśayennikhilaṃ viśvamojasā abhimantrya naraṃ yaṃ vā tilakaṃ prakaroti yā aṅgānuvarttinaṃ kuryyādyāvañjīvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ proktaṃ gaṇapatermantraṃ naro japtvā sahasrakam śikhāyāṃ bandhayennityaṃ sarvato jayamāpnuyāt āpaṇavyavahāreṣu dyūte vāde mahārṇave parāṅganāsamūheṣu śobhate manmatho yathā akhilaṃ vāñchitaṃ sādhyaṃ vaśyaṃ nayati tatkṣaṇāt abhimantrya śataṃ sāgraṃ lakṣayedvaśayejjagat sampātaṃ lakṣayedyantraṃ vaśamāyāti socirāt vaśīkaraṇamantrasya prayogoyamudāhṛtaḥ

uktarītyā likhedyantraṃ huṃkāraṃ tasya madhyataḥ tasya madhye sādhyanāma yaṃ likhetpatramadhyataḥ koṇekoṇe triśūlañca śūlāgreṣu niveśitam ṣaḍbījasthāna ālikhyaṃ yaṃbījena ca veṣṭitam p. 778)yantrametatsamālikhya sthāpayedīraṇaṃ tataḥ śmaśānavahnau saṃdahya bhasmādāya tadudbhavam yantramadhye pravinyasya punastadguṭikīkṛtam peṣayecca citāṅgāraṃ kapikacchuṃ ca vānarīm tattasyā madhyagaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ prāṇānpraveśayet śarāvayugalaṃ mantrī nirmāyānyatra cobhayoḥ manāvuccāṭayadvandvaṃ yojayitvā japenmanum nikhanedyasya ca dvāri māsenoccāṭayecca tam yantraṃ pūrvadine lekhyaṃ madhye yaṃ ca sabījakam triśūlāgre tu haṃkāraṃ haṃkāreṇa tu veṣṭayet dvitritridviguṇaṃ piṣṭvā hemapatrāmbunā tataḥ pañcāṅgaṃ pāribhadrasya kākiṇīñca tathā punaḥ saṃvṛtya vighnarājasya kukṣau pūrvavadarcayet vidveṣayadvayaṃ mantre japetsaṃyojya sāṣṭakam prītayorvidhinānena vidveṣo bhavati dhruvam vairamprajāyate śīghraṃ deśanāśo bhaveddvayoḥ gacchatāṃ pādasaṃsparśādvivādastu mahānbhavet vairaṃ ca prāṇivattatra svairaṃ bhavati sarvadā bhāgaikaṃ maricasyāpi niśāyāśca tathaiva ca p. 779)iti vidveṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ māraṇaṃ kathyatedhunā lekhyaṃ daleṣvagnibījaṃ tadbāhyeṣṭāsrakaṃ bhavet

trikoṇaṃ tadbahiḥ kāryaṃ trikoṇe ca vare likhet tadvahirvahnikoṇeṣu vahnibījaṃ samālikhet citāṅgārotthaya maṣyā kākapakṣaśalākayā kaṇārāmaṭhacavyākhyaniśāmaricasadvacāḥ kāraskarasya pañcāṅgairaṇḍabījānvitāmṛtām samīraṃ ca pratiṣṭhāpya kṛtvā gaṇapatiṃ tataḥ mātṛsadmasamudbhūtāṃ gaṇeśāgāramṛttikām śmaśānamṛttikāṃ tadvatkaravīradrumūlajām [druśabdo vṛkṣaparyāyaḥ ||] piṣṭvā śarāvayugalaṃ kṛtvā cānyatra cobhayoḥ kāraskarabhavaiḥ patrairnaivedyaiśca yathā purā mānayetpūjayeccaiva sahasraṃ sāṣṭakaṃ japet catvare pretabhūmau ca mātṛvighnagṛhetha vā sādhyo yamapuraṃ yāti saptāhājjvarapīḍitaḥ bhūdevavyatirikteṣu rājavairiṣu yojayet karttāpi taddaśāṃśena prāyaścittaṃ samācaret ṣaṭṣaṭkarmakarāṇyāśu gopanīyāni yatnataḥ aṣṭapatraṃ likhetpūrvaṃ mātakūṭaṃ tu madhyataḥ tasyordhvaṃ bhūpuraṃ kuryāṃdracaneyaṃ pradarśitā prātarmūrdhni śirobindumadhyasthaṃ sarvasampade abhiṣekācca dhanakṛtpūjanāllokavaśyakṛt sauvarṇe rājate tāmre paṭṭe vā yantramuddharet yantramadhye mahādevaṃ samyagdhyātvā tu tatra ca spṛṣṭvā yantraṃ japenmantramaṣṭottarasahasrakam tatra samyakpūjayitvā mṛdā bhūmiṃ ca pūjayet sānnidhyaṃ devatāyāḥ syātsādhakaḥ sukhamāpnuyāt

likhedaṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ tanmadhye jñānino manum jñānimantraṃ vasudale pūrvādiṣu likhetkramāt iṃ-īṃ-uṃ-ūṃ ca aiṃ lekhyaṃ cāṣṭapatreṣu mantriṇā yantrakoṣṭhe tatra saṃsthairvarṇaiḥ sādhyasya nāmakam vṛttena yantramuktaṃ tanmātṛkāyāstathaiva ca sarvaśāntikaraṃ rāhorohiṇyāmudite sati etasyā eva devyāstu vakṣya uccāṭamāraṇam haṃkāpeśvarāya namaḥ proktaścāṣṭākṣarastviha yaṃ śaṃ vaṃ haṃ ca prācyāṃ hi prāgvadvā saṃ samālikhet bahistu te veṣṭanīyā vāyumaṇḍalacakrataḥ p. 781)vāyumaṇḍalametatsyātsnātvā mandodaye sati yadā tadā bhavecchatroruccāṭo nātra saṃśayaḥ karau svaṭhau naiphaḍ namo manuraṣṭākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥ uṃ īṃ khaṃ chaṃ ṭhaṃ ca yaṃ ca haṃsaṃ ceti praveṣṭayet siddhādicakre kathitā ye varṇāstaiśca saṃyutam śmaśānāṅgārakeṇāpi sa sādhyaḥ syādyamātithiḥ kāśmīrīyāvakābhyāntu bhūrjjapatre likhetpunaḥ sarvatra kurute rakṣāṃ yantrametatsudurlabham tatkarṇikāyāṃ tu likhedoṃ-voṃ-viṃ-viṃ vidhuntudā prādakṣiṇyena pūrvādau varṇānbījena saṃyutān prāgvatsādhyaṃ ca mitrārṇayuktaṃ samyak kramāllikhet tatastu veṣṭayetsarvamadhacandraiḥ suśobhanaiḥ kucandanodakenaitadbhuktambhakṣyeṇa bhāgyadam likhedaṣṭadale prāgvatprādakṣiṇyena saṃpuṭān sādhyanāmārṇakānmitravarṇādyānapi cāgrataḥ

likhitaṃ gairikairetatsarvopadravanāśanam navayonyātmakaṃ samyaktrikoṇantasya madhyataḥ sasārvakūṭamekaikaṃ likhettāni vadāmyaham nādavindusamāyuktaṃ madhyayonāvidaṃ likhet nādabinduyutau caiva taddale ca samālikhet visargādyamidaṃ kūṭaṃ tṛtīye sulikhettataḥ vṛttadvayantu tadbāhye vīthikāyāmpraveṣṭayet caturasradvayenaiva karttavyantatra saṃlikhet lākṣayā ca trilohena homasampātasādhitam athānyattraipuraṃ vakṣye bhūrjje ṣaṭkoṇamālikhet kuryyātpatreṣu sulikhetkāmabījāni tadvahiḥ tadvahiścaturasrantu kuryyādyantraṃ sulekhataḥ karoti kavitākīrttiṃ sādhakasya na saṃśayaḥ ādau likhitvā ṣaṭkoṇantanmadhye kāmabījakam ṣaṭkoṇasandhau huṃkāraṃ sarvaṃ strīṃkāraveṣṭitam tannaḥ klīṃ pracodayāt tena yantraṃ bhavetsiddhamīritaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ yantraṃ pañcadalaṃ cādau kṛtvā tatra tu saṃlikhet agnyādiprādakṣiṇyena drāṃ-drīṃ-klīṃ-klūṃ-sa-ityapi veṣṭayetprathamāṃ vīthīṃ drāṃ-drīṃ-klīṃ-blūṃ-sa ityapi caturasreśakoṇāttu kāmabījaṃ samālikhet dadyādyathepsitānkāmānsādhakāya raṇe drutam p. 783)suvarṇaracite paṭṭe lekhanyā svarṇarūpyayā kāśmīrīrocanaiṇeyayutacandanavārimiḥ sādhyanāmānvitaṃ tatra hrīṃ klīṃbījadvayaṃ likhet

aṃ namaḥ prathame patre'nyasminbhagavatīti ca caturthe pañcame patre syātsarvamukharañjinī etāmapi likhettatra sarvarāja vaśaṃkarām tṛtīye sarvaduṣṭeti likhenmṛgavaśaṅkarām pañcame sarvaloketi likhenmantraṃvaśaṃkarām svāhā saptamapatresya śrīṃ hrīṃ-aiṃ-sauṃ ca klīṃ ca aiṃ bījaṣaṭkoṇake proktamaṣṭapatraṃ dvitīyake tatoṣṭapatrajairvarṇairlikheccaivāgratastadā sādhyanāmākṣarayutānmātṛkārṇānkramātkramāt sādhyanāmayutaṃ kāmabījamatyantaśuddhimat etadyantraṃ likheccaiva japtvā mantramananyadhīḥ pūjyate tridaśādyaiśca kiṃ punarmānavottamaiḥ avaśyameva labhate puruṣo nātra saṃśayaḥ kuryyācca ṣaḍdalaṃ padmaṃ karṇikāyāṃ ca hṛllikhet bahirvṛttadvayaṃ kṛtvā vīthikāyā praveṣṭayet bhūpuraṃ yantrametattu vandhyānāmapi putradam p. 784)ādau sulikhya ṣaṭkoṇaṃ māyāṃ sādhyasamanvitām etadyantraṃ vaśyakaraṃ pūjitaṃ bāhumadhyagam ādau kuryyācca ṣaṭkoṇaṃ koṇā vajrasamanvitāḥ vṛttatrayaṃ bahiṣkuryyāttatra vīthīdvayaṃ bhavet śrīkhaṇḍarocanābhyāṃ tu lekhyaṃ sarvajayapradam māyāsthāne tu mantraṃ vā bhuvaneśyāḥ samālikhet aṣṭapatraṃ likhetpadmaṃ karṇikāyāṃ samālikhet likhetsvarānpatramadhye kādivargāṣṭakaṃ likhet sarvavāñchāpradaṃ yantraṃ sampatsantatidaṃ param

bhūrjjapatre likhetpadmaṃ karṇikāyāṃ dhruvaṃ nyaset tatkesareṣu saṃlekhyaṃ śrīṃ-hrīṃ-klīṃ ca digaṣṭake vācaṃ māyāṃ ramāṃ kāmaṃ hasanau iti kūṭakam tadbāhye ṣoḍaśadale kesareṣu dvayaṃdvayam tāro hrīṃ kavacaṃ keṃ-keṃ-kṣeṃ-kṣeṃ-śrīṃ-hrīṃ tataḥ param sarvasaubhāgyadaṃ cāpi sarvaduḥkhavimocanam ṣaṭkoṇamadhye sādhyākhyāṃ bhuveneśīṃ samālikhet bahirdvādaśapatre ca varṇānetānsamālikhet drāṃ-drīṃ-klīṃ-blūṃ-sa ityetairbāṇabījaiḥ praveṣṭayet svāhetyekādaśārṇena veṣṭayenmātṛkārṇakaiḥ tṛtīyā tadbahiḥ kuryyādbhūpure caiva śaṅkaram koṣṭhe likheccakārantu sādhyanāmāsya codare jñāṃ saṃ caṃ vaṃ tathaikaikamakṣaraṃ ceśakoṇataḥ evameva ca nairṛtyādvāyavyāntaṃ punarlikhet oṃ-hrīṃ-hraṃ-kheṃ ca kṣeṃ kṣaḥ strīṃ-hraṃ-kṣaṃ-hrīṃ ca vaṣaṇmanuḥ caṃ mālikāṃ tu tadbāhye kumbhaṃ kuryyātsuśobhanam kuṃkumairlākṣayā cāpi likhitaṃ svarṇapaṭṭake sampūjya japasaṃsiddhiṃ prāpnuyādyatra tatra vai gajāśvapaśavastvanye sukhinaḥ prāṇino bhṛśam alakṣmī śāntaye cāśu siddhaye sarvasampadām etadyantrottamaṃ proktaṃ tvaritāyā ghaṭārgalam hrīṃkāraṃ tasya madhye tu sādhyanāma samālikhet tvaritāyā bahiḥ kuryātṣaṭkoṇaṃ ca bahiścaret rakṣojayaḥ syātsaṃgrāme vivāde vijayastathā navavyūhābhidhaṃ yantraṃ navavargādināmake kṛtvā cāṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ karṇikāyāntu hrīṃ likhet

tataścāṣṭadale lekhyamauṃ hrīṃ phaṭkāravarjitam hrīṃkāraistasya bāhye tu lekhyā cauṃkāraśṛṅkhalā evamasyaiva mantrasya karṇikāyāṃ samālikhet tathā tārādivarṇāṃśca prāgvatpatreṣu saṃlikhet hrīṃkārapuṭitānvarṇānoṃkārāntāndaleṣu ca śubhalakṣmīyaśodhānyavāsasāṃ purudāyakam ekādaśānāṃ vargeṇa tulyā lekhyāstathāgrake tasya madhye sādhyanāma caturdikkoṣṭhakeṣu ca kṣaṃstrīṃhraṃkṣaṃ tathā phaṭ ca bāhye prākārake tataḥ āmadhyāntaṃ dhruvaṃ varma kaṃ khaṃ caṃ cheti varṇakān savyāsavye tathā haṃ-khaṃ-vaṃ-kṣeṃ varṇacatuṣṭayam hraṃ-kṣaṃ ceti trayo varṇālekhyā vāme ca dakṣiṇe hrasvairvarṇaiḥ savyamapasavyaṃ caiva tathā likhet hraṃkāraṃ pañcame dhyātvā prākāre kevalaṃ dhruvam māyāhīnāṃśca dvidvyarṇāṃstvaritāyā manoḥ kramāt praveśamārgatasturyyatulyasaṃkhyāvṛtirbhavet grahabhītiharaṃ nityaṃ jayalakṣmīyaśaḥpradam śatrūṇāṃ yatkṣamaṃ yantraṃ yanna kvāpi ca kuṇṭhitam catasṛṣu likhedbījacatuṣkantannigadyate samālikhecchalokarūpaṃ tathā naiṛtyakoṇataḥ veṣṭayedyamamantreṇābhicāryyaścetpumānbhavet yaṃ-raṃ-bhyāṃ veṣṭayedduḥkhaṃ kālīyamamanū yathā mododenanadedomorakṣamatvatvamakṣara vāmomūririmūmovāṭīṭalīlalalīṭaṭī viṣamaṣyā samālekhyaṃ lekhinyā kākapakṣayā

śatrurduḥkhamavāpnoti sadyo yantraprabhāvataḥ pūritaṃ karivṛkṣādhaḥ putrastrīṇāṃ viyogakṛt tvaritāyantramaparaṃ tūrddhvādhoṣṭāṣṭakoṣṭhakam paścācca yamamantrārṇairveṣṭayeccaiva taddhruvam kālīmantreṇāvaguṃṭhya yantramāveṣṭayedbahiḥ kapikacchvā punarliptvā japitavyamadhomukham śmaśānāṅgāranimbādyaniryāso gehadhūmakaḥ koṣṭhamadhye tu nāmāni bahūnāṃ yatprayojanam upadravā mahāmārī tvasādhyā tatra jāyate bhūrjjapatre samālekhyaṃ haritālaniśārasaiḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadakṣaro mantro bagalāyāḥ sa ucyate duṣṭānāmiti coccāryya vācammukhamatho padam buddhiṃ vināśayānte tu tārabījāgnisundarīḥ veṣṭayetpītasūtreṇa kulālasya gṛhaṃ vrajet kārayecca mṛdā tatra haritālena lepayet duṣṭānāṃ stambhayedvācaṃ sākṣādvācaspaterapi paṭṭe vāpyatha pāṣāṇe hrīṃkārapuṭitaṃ likhet pūrvamantreṇa saṃveṣṭya cordhvaṃ trivalayaṃ likhet athānyadvakṣyate yantraṃ śmaśānasthamadhomukham mantritaṃ nihitambhūmau ripūṇāṃ stambhayedgatim pūjitampītapuṣpaistadvācaṃ saṃstambhayeddviṣām vilikhya tāraṃ sādhyākhyāṃ glauṃbījena praveṣṭayet vajrādikantathā tasya prānte praṇavamālikhet dharābījena saṃveṣṭya bhūpuraṃ mūlavidyayā vārttāli vārāhiyugaṃ vārāhamukhi vāgbhavam

namo jṛmbhe jṛmbhiṇīti namo mohe ca mohini sarvaduṣṭapraduṣṭānāṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvavāgvadet huṃphaṭ svāheti mūlākhyā vidyā vedeśavarṇikā huṃkāreṇa dvitīyāntu vīthikāmpariveṣṭayet ripumuccāṭayecchīghraṃ sthitaṃ varṣaśatādapi santrastāstadravaṃ śrutvā palāyante virodhinaḥ dṛṣṭvā ca śatravaḥ sarve palāyante na saṃśayaḥ daśāradvitayampañcadaśāsrabhūgṛhadvayam ṣaṭkoṇe pūrvato vācaṃ ca hrīṃkrīṃśrīṃ ca huṃ tathā uccāṭanīśvarīṃ cāpi śoṣiṇīṃ śoṣiṇīśvarīm trāsinīṃ trāsinīśīṃ ca kampinīṃ kampinīśvarīm vastujāteśavrīṃ paścātsarvasampādinīśvarīm daśāre vinyasetsvasya bījapūrvāndigīśvarān dvitīye daśapatre tu vajrādīnyāyudhāni ca oṃhrīṃ namaśca vārāhi ghore svapnaṃ visargayuk etadyantraṃ punaḥ samyaṅmātṛkārṇaiḥ praveṣṭayet bhūrjjādau yantramālikhya japasampātasādhitam bahunā kimihoktena vārāhīṣṭaṃ prayacchati hakāramadhye vilikhetsakāraṃ sādhyasaṃyutam ṣaḍdīrghayukkṣakāreṇa bahistadveṣṭayetpure rakṣā bhavati yatraitaddhanaṃ svarṇādiveṣṭitam bhūrjjapatre likhedyantramalaktakarasena tu tadbahiścāṣṭapatrasya keśareṣu dviṣaṭḥ svarān pītāmbareṇa saṃveṣṭya badhnīyātpaṭṭasūtrataḥ vāmabāhau tu nārīṇāṃ baddhaṃ putrapradaṃ matam

p. 790)jñānadaṃ jñānamicchūnāṃ rājñāṃ tu vijayapradam caturasradalenaiva kuryyādaṣṭadalaṃ budhaḥ veṣṭayeccaturasreṇa catuṣkoṇeṣu vaṃ likhet jātīkāṣṭhasya lekhanyā vaśyakṛtparamaṃ matam catuṣpatrasya padmasya karṇikāyāṃ samālikhet ekaikamakṣaraṃ tasya bāhye'ṣṭadalamālikhet vṛttadvayaṃ tu tadbahye madhyavīthyāṃ samālikhet sauraṃ yantramidannṛṇāṃ sarvāmayavināśanam dhanadhānyapradaṃ vaśyaṃ sarvarakṣākaraṃ param ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vilikhettasya madhye pūrvādita kramāt madhyapūrvakrameṇaiva lekhyamekaikamakṣaram arcitaṃ vā dhṛtaṃ dehe nāśayedvividhaṃ viṣam oṃhrīṃ ca mekhale svāhā saptārṇoyaṃ manurmataḥ samyaksuniṣṭhito gehe kalahādi na jāyate samantraṃ tripurāyantraṃ pañcapañcālayaṃ likhet kuryyāddalāni catvāri koṣṭhārdhaṃ ca tathā tale adhaḥ koṣṭhacatuṣke tu haṃkāraṃ tu samālikhet aṣṭasaptamayorlekhyaṃ sādhyanāmno dvayaṃ dvayam p. 791)likheddhūpaṃ tato dattvā kaṇṭhe yantraṃ tu dhārayet garbhaṃstambhayayugmaṃ ca ḍākinīdoṣamityapi dvirmuñcayāgnigṛhiṇīkutrivarṇo manurmataḥ caturdaśāsitāṃstantūṃstantunā tena bandhayet triḥ kaṭyāṃ veṣṭayedbhāryyāgarbharakṣākaraṃ param ādau ṣaṭkoṇamālikhya tanmadhye praṇavaṃ likhet sahasrāre huṃphaḍiti koṇeṣvekaikamakṣaram cakrāya svāheti padaṃ tadā ṣaṇmantrasambhavaḥ

caturdalantu kramato dvidvivarṇāndaledale keśareṣu likhitvātha patramadhye tato likhet rāharūpāya bhūrbhuvaḥ saṃlikhecca dvitīyake me dehi dāpaya svāhā likhetpatre caturthake dalamadhyedhunā proktavārahārṇaḥ kṛtākṣaraḥ tadbahiḥ ṣoḍaśadale kādisāntāndviśo likhet adhunā cāṣṭapatrantu padmaṃ tasya bahiścaret sādhyākṣareṇa puṭitaṃ hrīṃbījena tṛtīyakam tayā saṃveṣṭayetpaṃktiṃ tadagre bhūpuraṃ likhet hrīṃglauṃ teṣu likhedetadyantraṃ vārāhamadbhutam gomayasyāmbhasā piṣṭaṃ lekhanadravyamīritam svarṇapatrekhilāvāptī rājate cāyurāpyate bhūphale kṣaumavastre syādbhūrjje saṃsāramānyatā janmacandraṃ vinā dhāryyaṃ tadbhavedakhileṣṭadam dikṣu muktāśuddharāgairbhājayennātra saṃśayaḥ sasādhyaṃ praṇavaṃ tasya madhyakoṇāṣṭake ca hram gavatyai dakṣiṇadale dhāriṇyai dakṣapaścime svāhā vāyudale lekhyā glauṃhrīmomīśapatrake tatrādyavīthyāṃ praṇavaṃ namo bhagavate varā paravīthyāṃ mātṛkārṇāṃstato bhūpuramālikhet bāhau dhṛte jagadvaśyaṃ pūrṇāyuḥ sukhamedhate ādau ṣaṭkoṇamālikhya tanmadhye praṇavaṃ caret bāhye dhruvaṃ jabhadhṛtī vahirvṛttadvayaṃ caret tadbahirdvādaśadalaṃ tatraikaikākṣaraṃ nyaset vṛttadvayāntarālaṃ ca māyābījaiḥ praveṣṭayet

dvātriṃśatpatrake lekhyaṃ śalāmekaikamakṣaram nṛsiṃhaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ bhadraṃ mṛtyumṛtyuṃ namāmyaham evamagre tu prāgbhāge kakārādīnsabindukān śakārādīnvāmabhāge nyasya hyauṃ ca tathā likhet rogādhihṛdvastravarṇacaturvargaphala pradam prāgaṣṭa patraṃ rekhāśca pañca syurdakṣiṇetarāḥ tasyāgrimagatā rekhāḥ phaṇākārā vivardhayet phaṇāsu lekhyaṃ krauṃ bījaṃ koṣṭhe ślokamanuṣṭubham samastarogabhūtādikṛtyāpīḍāpahārakam aṣṭapatrakarṇikāyāṃ sādhyākhyāṃ karmasaṃyutām caturaścaturo varṇānanupatraṃ tato likhet yantraṃ kṣudrāmayaharaṃ sarvarakṣākaraṃ param veśmabhūpurayugmena koṇeṣu kṣauṃ samālikhet ramyaṃ navapadaṃ kṛtvā kalaśaṃ sthāpayediha vastrayugmasamāyuktamāvāhya nṛhariṃ vibhum aṣṭādhikaṃ tato mantraṃ sahasraṃ prajapetsudhīḥ amiṣiñcanmṛtyumukhādavaśyaṃ sa nivarttate bhojayeddevatābuddhyā bhūdevāṃstoṣayettathā labhetaihikasiddhiṃ sa paratrāpi ca modate ṣaṭkoṇakarṇikāmadhye hṛllekhāṃ sādhyasaṃyutām bahiraṣṭadalaṃ kṛtvā svaradvandvaṃ likhettataḥ p. 794)nṛsiṃhānuṣṭmmanorbahirvṛttadvayaṃ likhet nṛsiṃhaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ bhadraṃ mṛtyumṛtyuṃ namāmyaham likheccintāmaṇeḥ kūṭaṃ koṇeṣu prāgudīritam viṣarogaripukleśabhūtagrahabhayādikam

sarvarogapraśamanaṃ sarvaśatruvināśanam tatkarṇikāyāṃ praṇavaṃ tanmadhye cāmukaṃ jahi likhejjvālāvarttine ca krauṃ bījaṃ ca jahidvayam japasampātasaṃsiddhaṃ rakṣohṛdrogaśatruhṛt dadhivāmanadevasya vaidikānāṃ viśeṣataḥ sasādhyaṃ praṇavaṃ madhye ṣoḍaśasvaraveṣṭitam daleṣvekekaśo varṇānkrameṇa ca likhennamaḥ svāheti ca namoyuktaṃ praṇavābhyāṃ ca sampuṭam bhūrje gandhāṣṭakādyena likhitaṃ śrīdharāpradam kṛtvā cāṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ tanmadhye sādhyasaṃyutam namo nārāyaṇāyeti likhedekaikamakṣaram oṃ namo viṣṇave brūyātsurānte pataye mahā vṛttatrayaṃ tataḥ kuryyādantarvīthyāṃ suveṣṭayet bāhyavīthyāṃ mātṛkābhiriti yantraṃ prakīrttitam ādau sulikhya ṣaṭkoṇaṃ tanmadhye vṛttamālikhet sādhakākhyāṃ karmanāma madhye caiva samālikhet śrībījaṃ tacca sakalaṃ praṇavābhyāṃ ca sampuṭet ṣaṭkoṇapārśvayormāyābījaṃ cāgre ca manmatham vāgbhavena bahiṣpadmamaṣṭapatraṃ sakeśaram patrāgreṣu likhenmālāmantravarṇāṃstathaiva ca rakṣoghnaviśadāyeti madhureti padaṃ tataḥ balāyeti ca rāmāya viṣṇave nama ityayam tadbāhyeṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ śrībījaṃ keśarāṣṭake namo nārāyaṇāyeti tadbāhyerkadalaṃ likhet akārādikṣakārāntānantyapatre ca saptakam

tāro namo bhagavate vāsudevāya sa smṛtaḥ namaḥ pratyekavarṇaṃ tu dalamadhye samālikhet aṃghaṃ kramācca bījāni bāhye ṣoḍaśapatrake dalasya purvabhāgeṣu rāmasyānuṣṭubarṇakān daśāsyāntaka māṃ rakṣa dehi dāpaya me śriyam purā nṛsiṃhayantre ca kathitotra nigadyate nṛsiṃhaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ bhadraṃ mṛtyumṛtyuṃ namāmyaham kṣrauṃbījaṃ ca caturdikṣu haṃbījaṃ ca vidikṣu ca sādhitaṃ japapūjābhyāṃ homasaṃpātakena ca rakṣākaraṃ maheśāni mahadaiśvaryavardhanam bhuktimuktipradaṃ caiva gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ ādau sulikhya ṣaṭkoṇaṃ tanmadhye bījamālikhet sādhakākhyāṃ tadūrdhvaṃ tu karma madhye samālikhet śrībījena ca rāmāya namo varṇaiḥ praveṣṭayet etaivarṇaiśca daśabhirveṣṭayetkoṇaṣaṭkakam hrīṃ śrīmiti ca koṇāgre koṇapārśveṣu haṃ likhet daleṣu pūrvayantroktamālāmantrārṇakāṁllikhet sabindukaiśca tadbāhye bhūpure kṣrauṃ diśāsu ca sarveṣṭaphaladaṃ mokṣadāyakaṃ śrīkaraṃ param mūlārṇānvasukoṇeṣu ṣaḍdīrghaṃrī ca sandhiṣu dakṣiṇe kāmabījaṃ ca bahiraṣṭadalaṃ likhet dalamadhye likhettasya bahirvṛttatrayaṃ caret kādikṣāntairbahirvīthyāṃ tadbahirbhūpuraṃ caret kīrttilakṣmīvijayadaṃ rāmayantraṃ na saṃśayaḥ ṣaṭkoṇāntarlikhetkāmaṃ sādhyākhyāṃ karmasaṃyutām

bāhye daśadalaṃ padmaṃ tatkiñjalkeṣu saṃlikhet vāsudevāya kavacaṃ phaṭsvāhānto nakhākṣaraḥ p. 797)koṇeṣu madanākrāntaṃ bhūgṛhaṃ racayettataḥ hemapaṭṭe vidhānena guṭikīkṛtya pūjitam gopālayantrametaddhi puṇyavadbhiḥ kare dhṛtam kīrtyādivardhanaṃ caiva putrapautravivardhanam etadyantraṃ smarettatra japennaśyati tatkṣaṇāt ādauvṛttaṃ samālikhya tanmadhye glauṃ samālikhet tāro namaśca kṛṣṇāya daleṣvekaikamakṣaram ācakrāya tataḥ svāhā prathamoyaṃ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ sucakrāya tataḥ svāhā tṛtīyopi ṣaḍakṣaraḥ asurāntakacakrāya svāhāntoyaṃ navākṣaraḥ tadbāhyeṣṭādaśadalaṃ tatra varṇānimāṁllikhet tadbāhyejinapatreṣu kṛṣṇagāyatrivarṇakān tannaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pracodayāt tadbāhye dantapatreṣu gopālānuṣṭhubhaṃ likhet vallabhāyāgnijāyānto mantroyaṃ radavarṇakaḥ dvitīyāṃ mātṛkāvarṇairāṃkrīṃbhyāṃ ca tṛtīyikām dharmakāmārthaphaladaṃ śatrūndasyūnnivārayet putrapautrapradaṃ loke bhūtavetālanāśanam abhaktāya na dātavyaṃ na devabrāhmaṇadviṣe likhetsasādhyaṃ glauṃbījaṃ tacca samyakpraveṣṭayet koṇeṣu saṃlikhedvarṇānpatrākṣaramanostathā gopījanavallabhāya svāhā mantro daśākṣaraḥ tadbahiṣṣoḍaśadalaṃ keśareṣu svarāṁllikhet

tatkeśareṣu cālikhyadalamadhye ca pūrvavat vṛttadvayāntarvīthyāmāṃkrāṃbījābhyāṃ praveṣṭayet aṣṭārṇakaikavarṇantu manumetaṃ sudurlabham padmamaṣṭadalaṃ kṛtvā karṇikāyāṃ samālikhet daleṣu saṃlikhedvarṇāṃścaturaścaturomanoḥ khagapataṅgādyupadravānnāśayapadaṃ vadet tadantarālavīthyāṃ tu kādikṣāntāṁllikhetkramāt pradāya lakṣmaṇetyuktvā dātre sītāpadaṃ vadet darppahāyeti sarveti ṅento duṣṭavināśanaḥ pataṅgādiduṣṭasattvavināśanapadaṃ vadet tadbahiścaturasraṃ ca yantrametatsulekhayet gogale vātha saṃlekhyaṃ rocanānābhikeśaraiḥ bālagrahāmayavyāghrabhayādyaṃ kramaśo haret kuryyādaṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ karṇikāyāṃ samālikhet tataścādyadale lekhyā a-umāstāravarṇakāḥ caturthe dakṣiṇā ceti mūrttaye pañcame likhet ccha svāhetyaṣṭame patre vṛttayorantare tataḥ catuṣkoṇe caturthasya vargasya prathamākṣaram likhecchaivāṣṭagandhena bhūrjje dhāryyaṃ sadāgale kṛtyāpasmārabhūtādināśanaṃ sarvakāmadam likhedaṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ karṇikāyāṃ likheddhruvam vidikpatreṣu so lekhyo bahirbhūpuramālikhet yantraṃ mṛtyuñjayasyedaṃ japahomādisādhitam graharogaviṣādīnāṃ nāśanaṃ mṛtyubhañjanam etadyaḥ pūjayennityamapamṛtyurvinaśyati
