ālikhyāṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ karṇikāyāṃ samālikhet baṭukāyetyakṣarāṇi bahiḥ ṣoḍaśapatrake lekhya ekaikavarṇoyaṃ bahiḥṣoḍaśapatrake kakārādisakārāntānbahirbhupūramālikhet śrīpadaṃ duritavyādhiduṣṭagrahanikarttanam iti śrīmahāmāyāmahākālānumate merutantre śivapraṇīte daivatayantrakathanaṃ nāma trayastriṃśaḥ prakāśaḥ rakṣasā nihatā yena tvatto labdhavarā api cāturyugāṃtānākalpasaṃsthitānsiddhidāyakān tāraṃ ca vāgbhavaṃ lakṣmīṃ hrīṃhrīṃhuṃ ca samuccaret prakṛtyākṛtivedārṇairbindurudrasvarānvitaiḥ dvitīyakūṭametatsyādādyantakṛtavarṇakaiḥ ādyantasiddhākṛtyabdhivarṇairīśasvarānvitaiḥ tāro namo hanumate prakaṭeti parākrama līkṛtajagattritaya vajradeha jvaleti ca rudrāvatāra laṃketi purīdahana saṃvadet taka sītāśvāsaneti vadedvāyusuteti ca nandakara kapisainyaprākati tato vadet kāraṇadroṇaparveti totpāṭanapadaṃ vadet akṣakumārakaccheti dahaneti padaṃ tataḥ brahmāstreti brahmaśaktigrahamuktvā ca lakṣmaṇa samānayana bāleti saṃvadedbhānumaṇḍala indrajidvadhakāreti ṇeti sītetirañjaka kumbhakarṇādivadhakṛtparāyaṇapadaṃ vadet samudravyomapadataḥ samullaṅghana saṃvadet na svāmivacanetyuktvā sampāditārjaneti ca

dīnbhīṣaya padānte śabdodayapadaṃ vadet caleti sakaletyuktvā mantrāgapadato vadet p. 801)jvaroccāṭana sarveti vadecca vighnanāśana sarvaduṣṭapadānte ca nibarhaṇapadaṃ tathā sarvaśatrucchedaneti vadenmama parasya ca napuṃsakātmakaṃ sarvānte vadejjīvaṃpadaṃ tataḥ sampādayadvayam nānāmunidhyeya tato vadet sevakānkuruyugmaṃ ca sarvaśastrāstra saṃvadet hāhāhā pāhi pāhīti prāguktaṃ kūṭapañcakam vṛttāni parasainyāni kṣobhayadvitayaṃ mama sarvaduṣṭadurjaneti mukhyāni kīlayadvayam mālāmantro hanumato nāganāgaśarākṣaraḥ tāro namo bhagavate cāñjaneyāya hṛnmanuḥ tāro namo bhagavate śikhā vāyusutāya ca brahmāstranivāraṇāya naravakttrāstramantrakaḥ kuṇḍaladvayasaṃśobhi mukhāmbhojaṃ smarenmuhuḥ ayutañca puraścaryyā rāmasyāgre śivasya ca jitendriyaścaṇakāśī hanumaddhyānatatparaḥ mahārogādiśāntyarthamaṣṭottarasahasrakam grahādayaśca naśyanti tathā sarvebhicārakāḥ dhyāyaṃstathākṣahantāraṃ saṃgrāme vijayeta ca p. 802)ayutenāpyavicchinnasandhimāpnotyasaṃśayam hauṃbījaṃ samyaguccāryya pūrvoktaṃ kūṭapañcakam jagatīchanda uddiṣṭaṃ hanumāndevatā mataḥ ṣaḍbījaiḥ prathamairnyāsaḥ ṣaḍaṅgosya prakīrtitaḥ

kukṣau nābhau dhvaje jānvoḥ pādayormanuvarṇakān pādayorvinyasenmantraṃ ṣaḍbījāni padadvayam nādenaiva trāsayantaṃ sugrīvādikasevitam yajedaṣṭadale padme keśareṣvaṅgapūjanam droṇādrihārako merupīṭhakārcanakārakaḥ evaṃ patreṣu nāmāni pūjayecca dalāgrataḥ suṣeṇaṃ dvividaṃ caiva bhupūre dikpatīnapi evaṃ siddhamanurmaṃtrī prayogānācarettathā dvāviṃśatiṃ brahmacārī viprānsambhojayettataḥ aṣṭottaraśatenābhimantritaṃ viṣanāśanam yo narastasya naśyanti rājaśatruprabhītayaḥ bhasmabhiḥ salilairvāpi tāḍayejjvariṇaṃ krudhā tanmantritauṣadhaṃ jagdhvā nīrogo jāyate dhruvam tajjaptabhasmaliptāṅgaḥ śatrusaṃghairna bādhyate trirmantritena saṃspṛṣṭastridinādyāti śuṣkatām kīlakaṃ bhasma cādāya saptāhāvadhi saṃyutam vidveṣādbhayamāpannāḥ palāyante'rayocirāt krūrāḥ svayaṃ tu caurādyā bhavanti vividhā vaśāḥ aṃguṣṭhamātrāṃ pratimāṃ samvidhāya hanūmataḥ gṛhasyābhimukhīṃ dvāre nikhanenmantramantritām pratyahaṃ dhanaputrādyairedhate tadgṛhaṃ ciram śatroḥ pratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā hṛdi nāma samālikhet mantrānte proccarecchatrornāma cchindhi ca bhindhi ca evaṃ saptadinaṃ kurvanhanyācchatrūnna saṃśayaḥ muktakeśaḥ śmaśānastho balāsaurāṣṭrikāyutaiḥ

kākakauśikagṛdhrāṇāṃ pakṣaiḥ śleṣmāntakākṣajaiḥ homaṃ kuryyātsmaranmantraṃ mārayedripumuddhatam uditaṃ kurute sarvaṃ kiṃkarībhūya mantriṇaḥ sādhyanāmadvitīyāntaṃ vimocayavimocaya evamaṣṭottaraśataṃ likhitvā mārjayetpunaḥ evaṃ vidveṣaṇādīni kuryyāttatpallavaṃ likhet kusumaistasya kāṣṭhairvā jīrakairmaricairapi tailāktābhiśca nirguṇḍīsamidbhirvā samācaret sugandhipuṣpairvaśyārthaṃ saptadhānyaistadāptaye vivāde stambhane caiva bhūtabhūtau ca saṃkaṭe mantroyaṃ sādhito dadyādiṣṭasiddhiṃ nṛṇāṃ dhruvam navagrahairhanumato japātsiddhividhāyakān prayogāśca parijñeyāḥ sādhakairdvādaśārṇavat pūrvoktamālāmantrasya bījamekādaśantu tat vadennamo hanumate vadennamaḥ parasya ca ekāhikadvyāhiketi tryāhiketi caturthakaḥ tajvareti ca mantreti jvaraśūlabhagandara karṇaśūletyakṣiśūlavadeccaradaśūlaka vyādhīnkṣaṇāttrāsayeti bhindhi chindhi vināśaya mahāvīrapadantāraṃ hanuman hrāṃdvayaṃ vadet mālāmantroyamuddiṣṭaḥ sarvarogavināśakaḥ vadennamo bhagavate rākṣaseti kuleti ca raṃ tu rūṃhaṃ bhīmanādaṃ vadenmama parasya ca vādidveṣakāraketi kāryyabhañjaka saṃvadet kopāveśena hatveti cāmukānvai samuccaret

daha saṃhāraya dvirdvirdvirmohayapadaṃ vadet vatsadyaḥ padamuccāryya prāṇinaḥ padamuccaret bandhaya dviḥpātaya dvirmameti ca parasya ca hrāṃhruṃ tridhā ca phaṭsvāhā mantroyaṃ samudīritaḥ vadennamo hanumate mahābalaparākrama kinī ḍāpadamuccāryya kinī yakṣiṇikā ca pū vadedbhairavavetālagraheti brahmarākṣasā bhañjayadvitayaṃ procya vadeddvedhā nirāsaya bandhaṃdvedhā mocaya dvirmāmenaṃ ca padaṃ vadet hāhāhraṃhraṃ tridhā huṃphaṭsvāhāyamudito manuḥ puṃstrīnapuṃsakānbhūtabhaviṣyadvarttamoccaret tathā saṅkarajātijātānpadaṃ caiva samuccaret samatāpuruśaktīti sametāndhanurā vadet vakānmantrisacivasakhīnuktvātyantikānkṣaṇāt nānopāyairmārayadviḥ śatrūṃśchedayacchedaya bhindhibhindhi ca samprocya tvagninā jvālayadvayam pādatalākramaṇena tanuṃ caiva śilātale krudhā ceti padaṃ procya nakhairdvedhā vidāraya dvirdhvaṃsaya trāsaya dvirvadetpaścādbhayāturān bhasmībhūtāṃstato dvedhā vadedutpāṭayeti ca sarvatra māṃ vadedenaṃ rakṣarakṣa ca hā punaḥ vedapañcatrivarṇoyaṃ sarvābhīṣṭapradāyakaḥ mahābhayāni sarveti vyāghrataskara saṃvadet kṛtrimopaviṣamahāsaṃgrāme ca padaṃ vadet dvirgrāsaya troṭaya dvirbhañjaya stambhaya tridhā

mahāvīreti māmenaṃ rakṣarakṣa tridhātridhā sarvapīḍāharo rāmavaśakṛdbhāgyadāyakaḥ tāro namo hanumate vadetsarvagrahāniti bhūteti ca bhaviṣyacca varttamānānpadaṃ vadet uccāṭayadvayaṃ procya pareti ca balāni ca hrāṃhrīṃhrūṃdvistrayaṃ phaṭ ca svāhāntoyaṃ manurmataḥ parakṛtayantramantraparāhaṃkārasaṃvadet dṛṣṭirogādikānprocya dvistrāsaya nivāraya ityevāyaṃ manuḥ proktassarvāpattinivārakaḥ lakṣmaṇaprāṇadātre ca sītāśokavināśakaḥ duṣṭavināśanāyeti ripucaurapadaṃ vadet duṣṭasattvavināśeti nāya huṃphaḍ hutāṅganā viśeṣatopamṛtyośca nāśako rāmavallabhaḥ uccāṭaya huṃphaṭ ca svāhānto manurīritaḥ mahāvīrotra hanumāndevatā samprakīrtitaḥ ekādaśakūṭapūrvaṃ nāmanyāsaṃ samācaret hanumānrāmadūtaśca lakṣmaṇaprāṇadāyakaḥ netrāntamevaṃ kṛtvā tu laṅkāprāsādabhañjakaḥ saptāhājjāyate siddhirvāyuputraprasādataḥ daśa vāsaraparyyantaṃ rājaśatrubhayaṃ haret tenābhimantritaṃ dattaṃ sarvaṃ saphalatāṃ vrajet carcitaṃ parabādhādi tasya naśyatyasaṃśayam dāsatāṃ yāti devopi manuṣyeṣu ca kā kathā prakāreṇa mahābīrajvaritaḥ śāntitāmiyāt dvādaśārṇaprayogāṃśca nikhilāṃstatra kārayet

śālmalīkusumaṃ tālaṃ haridrāmalakīphalam uccāṭārthaṃ niśi hunecchleṣmāntakavibhītakān vaśyārthaṃ homayeddrākṣāmapūpānatha guggulam pañcakhādyairnālikerairikṣubhiḥ kadalīphalaiḥ saubhāgyārthaṃ tu kāśmīrakastūrītvaksamīraṇaiḥ dhattūraphalapuṣpāṇi samidho mohane smṛtāḥ ****?ddhṛtāni kūṭāni pañca tānyeva mantrataḥ p. 808)tatoñjanāsutaḥ proktaḥ sītāśokavināśakaḥ kaperetāni nāmāni kūṭapūrvāṇi santi ca dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ vijñeyaṃ dvādaśārṇavat navagrahādimantrāṇāṃ bījānyekādaśaiva tu taddhyānapūjānyāsāda jñaya ca dvādaśārṇavat namo bhagavate procya āñjaneyāya saṃvadet svāhā śaktiścāñjaneyo rudramūrttiḥ suro mataḥ dvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgāni tathāṃguṣṭhādiṣu nyaset kirīṭinaṃ kuṇḍalinaṃ dhyāyedvānaranāyakam ayutaṃ prajapenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ juhuyāttilaiḥ japitvā kṣudrarogebhyo mucyate divasatrayāt mahāroganivṛttyai tu sahasraṃ tridinaṃ japet rākṣasaughaṃ vinighnantamacirājjayati dviṣaḥ prajapyāyutamātraṃ tu sandhiṃ kuryyādviruddhayoḥ śatrūṇāṃ pradahedgrāmānacirādeva sādhakaḥ yo yāti socirātsveṣṭaṃ sādhayitvā gṛhaṃ vrajet āyurllakṣmyaḥ pravarghante tasya naśyantyupadravāḥ ṣaḍdīrghayuktā hṛllekhā praṇavenaiva sampuṭā

ṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ p. 809)etatprabhāvājjhaṭiti cādhivyādhivivarjitaḥ prasthānakāle japatāṃ naśyeyustaskarādayaḥ aṣṭagandhairlikhedrūpaṃ kapirājasya sundaram jayatyarigaṇānsarvāndarśanādeva niścitam dhvajamādāyoparāge saṃsparśānmokṣaṇāvadhi gacchedraṇe dhvajaṃ dṛṣṭvā palāyanterayocirāt hāṃhuṃ hanumate hṛcca ṅentaṃ kapipatiṃ tataḥ hāntaṃ jinamitārṇoyaṃ munyādi dvādaśārṇavat gadaṃ duṣṭaṃ nūtanena paṭenācchādayettataḥ tadādāya jvaladvahnau yaścaivaṃ triḥ pratāpayet saptakṛtvastato mantrī śakaladvitayaṃ khalu yakṛdvṛddhau caivameva dakṣapārśve samācaret vajrakāya vajratuṇḍa vadetkapilapiṅgala taḍijjihva mahāraudra daṃṣṭrotkaṭa kahadvayam laṃkeśvaravadhāyānte mahāsetupadantataḥ ehyehi bhagavanprocya mahābalaparākrama mahāraudrapadamprocya dīrghapucchena veṣṭaya bāṇanetrenduvarṇotra mālāmantro'khileṣṭadaḥ ataḥ parampravakṣyāmi kārtavīryyārjunasya ca iti śrīmahāmāyāmahākālānumate merutantre śivapraṇīte hanumanmantrakathanaṃ nāma catustriṃśaḥ prakāśaḥ etattvayā purā proktaṃ tasya mantrānprabrūhi me pañcāmnāyagatānmantrānarjunasya bravīmite dharmādīnāṃ pādabhedāddevi tulyaṃ bravīmi te tripād dvayoranindyastu bhaktiśraddhāsamanvitaḥ

sārūpyampādahīnaṃ syātsāyujyampūrṇamucyate yamaiśca niyamairyuktaḥ pūrṇadharmastu kevalaḥ svadharmeṇārjjitaṃ dravyaṃ kevalaṃ tatra sādhanam tena kālasvarūpatvaṃ tatkaivalyamprakīrttitam ūrddhvena dakṣiṇenaikadīpādikramatokhilāḥ tatra saṃkaraśūdrādyā viprāntāścādhikāriṇaḥ hīnasevā tūttamānāṃ rāsabhārohaṇaṃ yathā yaḥ sudarśanacakrasyāvatāraḥ kṣitimaṇḍale vedhā dharenduśāntyāḍhyo nidrārghīśāgnibinduyuk repho bindvāsanonanto vahnijau karṇasaṃsthitau ūnaviṃśativarṇoyantārādirnakhavarṇakaḥ kārttavīryyārjuno devo bījaṃ śaktidhruvaśca hṛt ūṃhaṃ śikhā samākhyātā kroṃśrīṃ kavacamīritam hṛdaye jaṭhare nābhau jaghane guhyadeśake vinyasedbījadaśakampraṇavadvayamadhyagam p. 811)bhruvoḥ śrutyostathaivākṣṇornasi vakttre galeṃsayoḥ sarveṣṭasiddhaye dhyāyetkārttavīryyārjjuneśvaram dhyeyo raktāṃśukoṣṇīṣī nānākalpavirājitaḥ dadhaṭṭaṃkāraśabdaiśca trāsitākhiladurjanaḥ bhūpālamukuṭāghṛṣṭapādapadmobjalocanaḥ vaiṣṇave tu yajetpīṭhe padmaṃ daśadalaṃ caret agnīśāsuravāyavyakoṇeṣu hṛdayādikāḥ khaḍgacarmmadharā dhyeyāścandrābhā aṅgamūrttayaḥ caturbhujā rocamonāḥ sarve raktavilocanāḥ cauramadavibhañjano mārīmadavibhañjanaḥ

duḥkhanāśo duṣṭanāśo duritāmayanāśakaḥ kṣemaṅkarā vaśyakarī śrīkarī ca yaśaskarī tadbahirbhūpure pūjyā lokapā astrasaṃyutāḥ tilājyataṇḍulairvāpi puraścaryyā sarittaṭe prayogānapi kurvīta śṛṇu tānadhuneśvari śuddhabhūmāvaṣṭagandhairlikhedyantraṃ taducyate phroṃklīṃ oṃ aiṃ ca patreṣu praṇavādyāni saṃlikhet oṃmādidaśavarṇāśca keśareṣu samālikhet veṣṭayetkādikairvarṇaiḥ śeṣaiḥ sahavivarjitaiḥ nānākāmaprabhedena bhūvāyvagninabhombhasām pañcavargāḥ pañca yādyāḥ ṣasahāśca lakṣau kramāt māraṇe taijasaiḥ śāntau vātaiḥ puṣṭau ca pārthivaiḥ kumbhaṃ spṛṣṭvā japenmantraṃ sahasraṃ tena secayet vāksiddhaścāpi tejasvī pratāpī vijitendriyaḥ saṃsthāpayedidaṃ yantraṃ vairibhītinivṛttaye likhedaṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ sasādhyaṃ cāndramapyuta manubījāṣṭakaṃ cānte dale lekhyaṃ punaśca phaṭ triśaḥ svarānantareṣu tridhoṣmārṇasamanvitān ūṣmārṇāṃścaturasre tu vajrāṣṭakasamanvitān snānārthaṃ ghaṭapānīyamanyatpūrvavadīritam sarṣapāriṣṭalaśunakārpāsairmāryate ripuḥ kaṭutailamahiṣyājyaiḥ plutaṃ kṛtvā tu homayet dhattūraistabhyate nimbairdveṣyate vaśyatembujaiḥ yavairhutaiḥ śriyaḥ prāptistilairājyairaghakṣayaḥ strīvaśyakṛtpriyaṃgūnāṃ guggulorbhūtaśāntidaḥ

samidho labhate hutvā putrānāyurdhanaṃ sukham rocanāgomayaiḥ stambho bhūprāptiḥ śālibhirhutaiḥ ekonaviṃśatyarṇoyaṃ tārādirnakhavarṇakaḥ p. 813)svabījādyo daśārṇosāvanye navaśivākṣarāḥ svakāmābhyāṃ tṛtīyosau svabhrūbhyāṃ tu caturthakaḥ svāṃkuśābhyāṃ saptamaḥ syātsvaramābhyāmathāṣṭamaḥ eteṣu mantravaryyeṣu svānukūlaṃ manuṃ bhajet daśamantrā ime proktā yadā syuḥ praṇavādikāḥ evaṃ viṃśatimantrāṇāṃ yajanaṃ pūrvavanmanoḥ dīrghāḍhyamūlabījena kuryyādeṣāṃ ṣaḍaṅgakam caturdaśārṇo mantroyamasyejyā pūrvavanmatā tāro hṛdbhagavānṅentaḥ kārttavīryyārjunastathā trivedasaptayugmākṣivarṇaiḥ pañcāṅgakaṃ manoḥ sarvaduṣṭāntakāyeti tapobalaparākramaiḥ janyacūḍāmaṇirṅentaḥ sarvaśaktimate tataḥ triṣaṣṭivarṇavānproktaḥ smaraṇātsarvasiddhikṛt māhiṣmatīpatiḥ paścāccaturthaḥ samudīritaḥ daśāsyaśceti ṣaḍbhiḥ syātpadairetaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam hastairjalaughaṃ rundhantaṃ dhyātvā mattaṃ nṛpottamam pūrvavatsarvametasya samārādhanamīritam māhiṣmatyāṃ mantrimadhye samāsīnamalaṃkṛtam bāhubhiḥ śaracāpāsigadāmudgaraśūlakān paracakrastenarājabhayaṃ dhyānamudīritam p. 814)trailokyabhīṣaṇaṃ dhyāyedayutāśvarathasthitam dordaṇḍamaṇḍalairbāṇānkṣipantaṃ tīvradhārakān

gajayūthairaśvavāhaiḥ kuṇḍaladyotitāsyakam āhave śatrusaṃghātaṃ jitvā sa sukhamedhate ekādaśāvikhyātaṃ dhyānapūjādikaṃ manoḥ ādau caturdalaṃ padmaṃ cāṣṭāraṃ radapatrakam hrāṁbījamatha patreṣu praṇavaṃ sādhyanāma ca ekonaviṃśatyarṇasya dvau namo haritārṇakān tadbahiḥ ṣoḍaśadale kāmabījaṃ samālikhet bahistasya prakurvvīta tato vṛtacatuṣṭayam dvitīyāyāṃ kṣakārādikakārāntānvilomataḥ tato bījāni ca likhettatpare ca caturdale cuṃ chuṃ juṃ jhuṃ tathāṭuṃṭhuṃḍuṃḍhuṃ ṣoḍaśadale punaḥ punaruktadale kādihāntabījāni saṃlikhet kāryyānurūpaṃ sulikhettadbāhye bhūtalaṃ śubham ahaṃ jānāmi viṣṇuśca tatrepadvetti tadguhaḥ rājate rājyalābhāya tāmre rakṣākaraṃ bhavet kaṇṭhe nibaddhametattu bhṛśaṃ rakṣati bālakān kāraskarasya phalake roganāśāya saṃlikhet viśāle kalināśāya samakṣityāṃ śilātale patākāyāṃ dhvaje vāpi jayadaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ lākṣāmṛgamadādyaiśca likhedvaśyādikarmakṛt tadyantrakalaśāsekādvandhyā putraṃ prasūyate tasya saṃsmaraṇādeva hṛtaṃ naṣṭaṃ ca labhyate munyādikaṃ ca pañcāṅganyāsaḥ sarveṇa kīrtita mahāgajasamārūḍhaṃ madāghūrṇitalocanam dhāvamānamarātīnāṃ vadhārthaṃ saṃsmarennṛpam

evaṃ dhyātvāyutaṃ japtvā bhayānyanyāni saṃtaret suprasannaṃ maṇigaṇālaṅkṛtaṃ dīptatejasam āyurvṛddhaye rogaśāntyai dvādaśārṇaḥ prakīrttitaḥ dvātriṃśadarṇamantrasya vidhirevamudāhṛtaḥ tannorjunaḥ pracodayāt palāyante gṛhāddūraṃ havanāttarppaṇādapi prāgvanmunyādikaṃ chando gāyattraṃ pūrvavaddhatiḥ gāyatrījapamātreṇa mantravīryapravarddhanam hatāścaurā bhaviṣyanti hṛtaṃ dravyaṃ ca sidhyati mahābalāya dhīmahi tannorjjunaḥ pracodayāt huṃ phaṭ svāhā radārṇoyaṃ prokto mantraścaturddaśaḥ p. 816) saptasapteṣunavabhiścaturbhiścāṅgapañcakam maṇḍalānmriyate śatrurvikalāṅgotha vā bhavet akharvabhayanāśaḥ syādekaviṃśatibhirddinaiḥ hṛtaṃ ca pūrvasaṃproktaṃ dravyaṃ labhyet sattvaram kārttavīryyārjjunāyeti haihayeti padaṃ vadet kareti sarvaduṣṭāntakāyeti ca padaṃ paṭhet āgantukāṃśca pravadeddasyūnvasuvilumpakān svahastodbhūtamusalasahasrairmarddayadvayam svahastodbhūtacakrāṇāṃ sahasrairvinikartaya trāsaya dvirmohaya dvirudvāsayayugaṃ vadet dvirbhedaya stambhaya dvirjṛmbhayadvayamāvadet uccāṭayoccāṭayeti vināśayavināśaya śrīkārtavīryyārjuneti sarvaga svālaye vadet corasamūhānsamyagvadedunmūlayadvayam

dattātreyo muniśchando gāyatryanyacca pūrvavat māhiṣmatīnivāsoyaṃ śiromantro nagākṣaraḥ hahaiyādhipatirṅentaḥ kavacasya manurmataḥ udagrabāṇāṃścāpāni dadhataṃ sūryasannibham kārttavīryanṛpaṃ dhyāyedgaṇḍaśobhitakuṇḍalam trisahasro japaḥ proktaḥ śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret p. 817)cakreṣūnmusalaṃ śūlakuṭhārau pāśameva ca balāḍhyamaruṇaṃ ghoraṃ tattvamātaṅgasaṃsthitam niśītheṣṭottaraśataṃ naṣṭadravyādisiddhaye saṃprārthya mantriṇe corāḥprayacchantyakhilaṃ dhanam japedaṣṭottaraśataṃ dhyātvā bhūpaṃ samāhitaḥ dhyātvaivaṃ sarvapaśavo dhruvamāyānti mocitāḥ hṛtaṃ prakāśamāyāti svaṃ svasthāne nacānyathā daśadikṣu japenmaṃtraṃ rāṣṭrāde rakṣaṇaṃ bhavet kṣiptāni mantriṇā yatra tatra rakṣā bhavenniśi munipūjādikaṃ prāgvallakṣamekaṃ puraskriyā prāgvatprayoga ityevamūrddhvāmnāyaḥ prakīrttitaḥ aṣṭau śatānyaśītiśca yeṣāṃ saṃsādhanā kalau hindudharmapraloptāro jāyante cakravarttinaḥ phiraṅgabhāṣayā mantrāsteṣāṃ saṃsādhanādbhuvi iṃgrejā nava gadyāśca laṇḍaneṣvapi bhāvinaḥ tadbījapūrvvāḥ sarvepi manavo vāmasiddhidāḥ vāmācāreṇa śūdrāṇāmiha loke phalapradaḥ atho dīpavidhiṃ vakṣye kārttavīryyapriyaṅkaram māghe ca phālgune māse dīpārambhaḥ praśasyate

p. 818)dvidaivate ca rohiṇyāṃ dīpārambhaḥ praśasyate prītau harṣe ca saubhāgye śobhanāyuṣmatorapi eṣu yogeṣu pūrvāhṇe dīpārambhaḥ kṛtaḥ śubhaḥ yadi tatra ravervāraḥ śravaṇaṃ bhaṃ tu durlabham ādye hyupoṣya niyato brahmacārī śayīta kau prāṇānāyamya saṃkalpaṃ nyāsānpūrvoditāṃścaret madhye kāmaṃ samālikhya ṣaṭkoṇeṣu samālikhet kroṃ śrīṃ huṃphaṭ ca pūrvādidiśāsu vilikhetkramāt evaṃ vilikhite yantre nidadhyāddīpabhājanam kāṃsyapātraṃ mṛnmayaṃ ca kaniṣṭhaṃ lohajaṃ mṛtau śāntaye mudgacūrṇotthaṃ sandhau godhūmacūrṇajam arkadigvasuṣaṭpañcacatūrāmāṃgulairmitam ājyeyutapale pātraṃ palapañcaśatīkṛtam trisahasre ghṛtapale śarārkapalabhājanam śatekṣiśarasaṃkhyātamevamanyatra kalpayet śatravastasya naśyanti nātra kāryyā vicāraṇā jīvedvarṣaśataṃ mantrī pāpāni kṣayamāpnuyuḥ tithimānādyāsahasraṃ tantusaṃkhyā vinirmitā sahasrapalasaṃkhyādidaśāntaṃ kāryyagauravāt tadardhāṃ vā tadardhāṃ vā sūkṣmāgrāṃ sthūlamulikām pātrāddakṣiṇadigdeśe muktvāgulacatuṣṭayam dīpaṃ prajvālayettatra gaṇeśasmṛtipūrvakam taṇḍulāṣṭadale vāpi vidhivatsthāpayed ghaṭam etatproktaṃ dvijātīnāṃ vāmibhirvāmabhāgake jalākṣatatilānhaste gṛhītvā mantramuccaret

kārttavīryyārjunāyeti vadenmāhiṣmatīpadam sahasrakratuśabdānte dīkṣitāya pdaṃ vadet anusūyāgarbharatnāya huṃphaṭ ca pravadettataḥ duṣṭānnāśayayugmaṃ syāttathā pātaya ghātaya anena dīpavaryyeṇa paścimābhimukhena ca vadedvarṇāṃstakārādīndaśa tāraṃ hutāṅganām dattātreyo muniśchandobhitaṃ devorjunaḥ smṛtaḥ dhyātvā devaṃ mantrametamaṣṭottarasahasrakam aṃkuśaṃ ca punastāraṃ manuḥ prokto navākṣaraḥ evaṃ dīpapradānasya karttāpnotyakhilepsitam tasminnavasare kāryyaṃ siddhambhavati nānyathā atiyatnātkāryyasiddhiṃ kuryyāccaiva vilambataḥ vyatyaye sati kāryyasya naiva siddhiḥ prajāyate ākhvotvordarśanaṃ duṣṭaṃ gavayasya sukhāvaham p. 820)saśabdā bhayadā karturujjvalā sukhadā gatā pakṣādarvāk tadā gacchedyajamānoyamālayam vartyantaraṃ yadā kuryyātkāryyaṃ sidhyedvilambataḥ aśucisparśane vyādhirdīpanāśe tu caurabhīḥ pātrārambhe vasupalaiḥ kṛto dīpokhileṣṭadaḥ pañcāśatā kṛto dīpaḥ śatruvaśyāya ceṣyate śatena śatrunāśaḥ syātsahasreṇākhilāḥ kriyāḥ āsamāpteḥ prakurvīta brahmacaryyañca bhūśayam japetsahasraṃ pratyekaṃ mantrarājaṃ navākṣaram sahasraṃ prajapedrātrau sobhīṣṭaṃ kṣipramāpnuyāt kumbhodakena karttāramabhiṣiñcenmanuṃ smaran

palānāṃ tu daśāṃśena mukhyaṃ prāṅmukhyabhājane gurau tuṣṭe dadātīṣṭaṃ kṛtavīryyasuto nṛtaḥ pratyutānubhavatyeva hānimeva padepade duṣṭebhyaḥ kathito mantro vakturduḥkhāvaho bhavet tilatailaṃ tu tādṛk syātkanīyojādijaṃ ghṛtam siddhārthasambhavenātha dviṣatāṃ nāśahetave kāryyasiddhistadā kuryyāttrivāraṃ dīpajaṃ vidhim yathākathaṃcidyaḥ kuryyāddīpadānaṃ svaveśmani p. 821) sarvadā jayamāpnoti putrānpautrāndhanaṃ yaśaḥ stutipriyo mahāviṣṇurgaṇeśastarppaṇapriyaḥ tasmātteṣāṃ pratoṣāya kuryyāttattu ca tādṛśam ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ vaktavyaṃ tatpṛcchata surottamāḥ iti śrīmahāmāyāmahākālānumate merutantre śivapraṇīte kārttavīryyārjunamantrakathanaṃ nāma pañcatriṃśattamaḥ prakāśaḥ
